4fe66c3d623e0da636e4bc23ac6dcb1451a4e402.src: Beyond that point the line falls under the model’s assumptions. The extra cash no longer reduces loan interest, while the separate-savings alternative continues to earn the entered savings rate on all of its balance. The result is a cost comparison, not a verdict that holding more than the loan balance is wrong. Cash above the loan balance may serve as an emergency reserve, a sinking fund or a daily transaction buffer.

0023f7ca341c50043cea82f982e6426426509daf.src: Hypothetical fifteen-year net-cash ledger with January ages 60–74 and a December birthday. The temporary bridge pays through the December turning 65 and stops the following January. CPP starts in January at the entered whole age. All income figures are independently entered net cash, held constant; no statutory pension calculation, CPP age adjustment, income indexing, OAS, GIS, final tax, mortality or benefit eligibility is calculated. The ending balance alone does not establish that every earlier month was funded.

022309a9c4bf71cad695fb7abae126c53d17e102.src: That cancellation requires an exact relationship in this idealized model. It is not evidence that an available pair of investments is risk-free. Estimated correlations depend on the observations, frequency, currency and measurement period; future relationships can differ. Zero correlation also does not generally establish statistical independence.
022309a9c4bf71cad695fb7abae126c53d17e102.zh: 这种取消需要在此理想化模型中存在精确的关系。这并不能证明现有的投资组合是无风险的。估计的相关性取决于观察、频率、货币和测量周期；未来的关系可能会有所不同。零相关性通常也不能建立统计独立性。

0387bbebf412c653b30b15c72242b3517108cf74.src: Two hypothetical fixed schedules advance the same principal at time zero and receive one payment at each month-end, starting one full month later. Flat interest equals original principal × flat annual quote × months / 12 and is divided equally across payments; allocated principal declines in equal amounts. The reducing-balance quote is nominal annual divided by twelve, charged to each month’s opening unpaid principal; the fixed payment amortizes it over the same number of months. Full-precision amounts are used, with only display rounding; these are mathematical schedules rather than cent-rounded lender invoices. The final reducing-balance payment closes floating-point residuals. The flat periodic equivalent solves advance = present value of the complete monthly payment schedule, then compounds that monthly rate for twelve months: (1 + monthly equivalent)^12 − 1. It is a defined effective annual cash-flow equivalent, not a jurisdiction-specific APR/EIR disclosure or legal-compliance test. At a zero advance the cost ratio is undefined and the headline stays N/A. Fees, insurance, taxes, defaults, early settlement, rebates and household funding are excluded. The principal chart is an allocation schedule, not a contractual early-payoff quote. All rate/term matrix cells use a normalized positive one-dollar advance, independently of selected loan size and quotes.
0387bbebf412c653b30b15c72242b3517108cf74.zh: 两个假设的固定时间表在时间零预支相同的本金，并在每个月末收到一笔付款，从一整月后开始。固定利息等于原始本金 × 固定年报价 × 月数 / 12，并在各付款中平均分配；分配的本金等额减少。余额递减报价按名义年度除以十二计算，从每月期初未付本金中扣除；固定付款在相同的月份数内摊销。使用全精度量，仅显示舍入；这些是数学时间表，而不是四舍五入的贷款机构发票。最终的减少余额付款将关闭浮点残差。固定定期等值求解预付款 = 完整每月付款计划的现值，然后将十二个月的月利率复合：(1 + 每月等值)^12 − 1。它是定义的有效年度现金流等值，而不是特定于司法管辖区的 APR/EIR 披露或法律合规性测试。预付款为零时，成本比率未定义，标题仍为 N/A。费用、保险、税收、违约、提前结算、回扣和家庭资金不包括在内。主要图表是分配时间表，而不是合同提前付款报价。所有利率/期限矩阵单元格都使用标准化正一美元预付款，与选定的贷款规模和报价无关。

03900ad5ef8f26d9bf6178beaf82b3cbb982b4d2.src: A quote of CAD 9,000 in age-60 purchasing power would imply a different nominal age-67 amount under that same price assumption: about CAD 10,338.17. The quotation-basis bars compare those two interpretations of the same numeral. They do not calculate two available benefits or recommend a claiming age.
03900ad5ef8f26d9bf6178beaf82b3cbb982b4d2.zh: 60 岁购买力的 9,000 加元报价将意味着在相同价格假设下，67 岁名义金额不同：约 10,338.17 加元。引用基础条比较同一数字的两种解释。他们不会计算两项可用福利或建议索赔年龄。

03c73ddf0b64b6c04b8e70669c78ead1fd1b166f.src: Original hypothetical independent-year model, not observed household incident data or an estimate of anyone’s actual risk. Each complete year has either zero events or one event, with the same independently entered probability; years are mutually independent. Every event costs the same entered whole-CAD amount. All costs and the one opening whole-CAD reserve are in a common constant-dollar basis. The reserve is available initially, used only for these events and never replenished; there is no income, insurance reimbursement, interest, inflation, borrowing, investment or other spending. The event count follows the binomial model under these assumptions. Total cost equals count × cost per event. An unfunded cost occurs only when total cost is STRICTLY GREATER than the reserve; exactly using all of it is fully funded for this limited exercise. Probability-weighted unfunded cost sums max(total cost − reserve, 0) across all outcomes, including zero for funded outcomes. It is not a conditional tail average, a confidence limit, a worst-case amount or a recommended reserve. The count distribution retains every outcome; counts five and above share one labelled display bucket. No event timing within a year, real-world independence or statistical calibration is established.
03c73ddf0b64b6c04b8e70669c78ead1fd1b166f.zh: 原始假设的独立年模型，没有观察到的家庭事件数据或对任何人实际风险的估计。每个完整的年份要么有零个事件，要么有一个事件，具有相同的独立输入概率；年是相互独立的。每个活动的费用都是相同的输入的全加元金额。所有成本和一期全部加元准备金均以共同的不变美元为基础。储备金最初可用，仅用于这些活动，并且不会补充；没有收入、保险报销、利息、通货膨胀、借款、投资或其他支出。在这些假设下，事件计数遵循二项式模型。总成本等于计数 × 每个事件的成本。仅当总成本严格大于储备金时，才会出现无资金支持的成本；确切地说，所有这些都已为这项有限的活动提供了充分的资金。所有结果的概率加权无资助成本总和 max(总成本 − 储备, 0)，其中资助结果为零。它不是有条件尾部平均值、置信限度、最坏情况金额或建议储备。计数分布保留每个结果；数量为 5 人及以上，共用一个贴有标签的展示桶。一年内没有事件发生时间，建立了现实世界的独立性或统计校准。

03ca20b6ab9fdcc34ba253ab7957f3e41bbfb453.src: The first curve therefore answers a precise question: what is the modeled chance of one or more events within the selected number of years? It does not say exactly one event will occur, identify its date or establish the probability of a cash shortage.
03ca20b6ab9fdcc34ba253ab7957f3e41bbfb453.zh: 因此，第一条曲线回答了一个精确的问题：在选定的年份内一个或多个事件的建模概率是多少？它没有具体说明将发生某一事件、确定其日期或确定现金短缺的概率。

For a zero-coupon bond, Macaulay duration equals its final payment year, while modified duration differs when yield is positive. Neither modified duration nor a bond fund’s duration is a promise that an interim loss will recover after that many years. The exit-yield control does not change these purchase-date measures.

Coupon amounts are fixed by face and coupon rate; the yield changes their reinvestment growth and the price of unpaid cash flows.

044a108be28e58820a8348f48b842426033808bf.src: The three columns are the selected assignments, one more job assigned to person A, and one more job assigned to person D, each capped at the three-job input limit. The top row divides by the number of jobholding people, so its denominator changes between cells; the bottom row always divides by all four people. At the default assignments the same two multiple-jobholding people are 2 of 3 jobholding people (66.7%) but 2 of 4 people overall (50%). If nobody has an assigned job, the top row is undefined rather than zero percent. These invented fractions do not estimate any official rate, and official counts would need a compatible total-employment denominator before a share could be calculated.
044a108be28e58820a8348f48b842426033808bf.zh: 三列是选定的任务，分配给人员 A 的另一项工作和分配给人员 D 的另一项工作，每项上限为三工作输入限制。最上面一行除以有工作的人数，因此其分母在单元格之间发生变化；最下面一排总是被所有四个人分开。在默认分配中，同样的两个同时担任多项工作的人是 3 名同时担任工作的人中的 2 人 (66.7%)，但总体上是 4 人中的 2 人 (50%)。如果没有人分配工作，则顶行未定义而不是百分之零。这些发明的分数不会估算任何官方利率，官方统计需要一个兼容的总就业分母才能计算份额。

0271790575aca90b5cb08e50ea7cbcd34bc89125.src: Both scenarios give each individual year the same entered event probability. Under independence, the chance of no event is (1 − p)^years. In the fully linked stress, a single hypothetical indicator determines every year, so the chance of at least one event equals p for any positive horizon. The curve compares windows, not a forecast path or the chance conditional on earlier events.
0271790575aca90b5cb08e50ea7cbcd34bc89125.zh: 两种方案都为每个年份提供了相同的输入事件概率。在独立条件下，不发生任何事件的概率是 (1 − p)^年。在完全关联的压力中，每年都有一个假设指标决定，因此对于任何积极的视野，至少发生一个事件的机会等于 p。该曲线比较的是窗口，而不是预测路径或以早期事件为条件的机会。

0760656c79a6129c49ade5759c6a15ac0f93aad1.src: Original, completely specified two-outcome probability examples for one holding year. The probabilities are chosen assumptions, not estimated historical frequencies or forecasts for any security. Both cases have the selected population mean and population standard deviation. The unequal case changes outcome values when its lower-outcome probability changes so those moments stay fixed. Each case has exactly two possible returns; no normal distribution, sample, p-value, confidence interval or simulation is used. The bounds on controls keep every modeled gross return positive; they are demonstration limits, not market risk limits. There are no contributions, withdrawals, fees, taxes, inflation, leverage, serial dependence or multiyear compounding. An outcome below the required return fails the goal; equality meets it, allowing only machine-precision tolerance. The minimum outcome is a bound in this invented distribution, not an actual investment’s maximum possible loss.
0760656c79a6129c49ade5759c6a15ac0f93aad1.zh: 原始、完全指定的一个持有年份的两种结果概率示例。这些概率是选定的假设，而不是估计的历史频率或任何证券的预测。两种情况都有选定的总体平均值和总体标准差。当较低结果概率发生变化时，不平等情况会改变结果值，因此这些时刻保持固定。每个案例都有两种可能的回报；不使用正态分布、样本、p 值、置信区间或模拟。控制范围使每个建模的总回报保持正值；它们是示范限额，而不是市场风险限额。没有供款、提款、费用、税收、通货膨胀、杠杆、序列依赖或多年复利。低于所需回报的结果未能实现目标；平等满足它，只允许机器精度的公差。最低结果是本发明分配中的界限，而不是实际投资的最大可能损失。

FortisBC’s equal payment plan describes a similar smoothing idea with its own review periods, and separates how natural gas and electricity reviews work.

0844f8e2d483c77053f8e5c67fe79fe07ff4501c.src: All amounts, dates and discount rates are independently entered hypothetical assumptions. The alternatives are mutually exclusive receipts: the upfront amount is received at time zero, while the equal annual payments occur at first-payment year plus successive whole years. Year 0 means an immediate first payment. Enter spendable amounts on a consistent tax and cost basis; no tax calculation is made. Every scheduled payment is assumed paid in full on its stated date. The effective annual discount rate converts amounts to time-zero value and is not an available investment yield, inflation estimate or probability adjustment. Cumulative receipt totals exclude reinvestment, spending and borrowing. Present value is an analytical measure, not extra money available in the bank. Credit risk, benefit eligibility, life contingencies, assignment rights and actual contract terms are outside this calculation.
0844f8e2d483c77053f8e5c67fe79fe07ff4501c.zh: 所有金额、日期和折扣率均独立输入假设。替代方案是相互排斥的收款：预付款在零时间收到，而等额的年度付款发生在第一个付款年份加上连续的整年。第 0 年表示立即首次付款。在一致的税收和成本基础上输入可支出金额；不进行税收计算。每笔预定付款均假定在规定日期全额支付。有效年度贴现率将金额转换为零时间值，并且不是可用的投资收益率、通胀估计或概率调整。累计收入总额不包括再投资、支出和借款。现值是一种分析指标，而不是银行中可用的额外资金。信用风险、福利资格、寿险意外事件、转让权和实际合同条款不在此计算范围内。

068766ba4f82b9d11353f34d63c9e53b713081df.src: Original hypothetical retailer gift-card purchase, not a quoted promotion, bank account or investment return. The card is purchased at month zero for face value × (1 − entered discount). Both cases buy the same selected amount at each month-end through the entered final shopping month, then stop those purchases; the reporting window can end sooner. Card balance is used first, with any uncovered part paid in cash. Unused purchasing credit stays on the card without fees, expiry, cash refund, resale, reload, interest or recovery valuation in this scenario. The final shopping month is a household-use assumption, not a legal expiry date. Matched purchase amounts are assumed all-in and equally eligible at the same prices. No extra purchases are induced by the card. The card must replace 90.00% of its original face value in purchases to reach equal cumulative cash outlay. The card case does not catch up with pay-as-you-go cash within this selected purchase plan and reporting window. The remaining nominal purchasing balance is not cash returned to the household or a measured fair value. Retailer failure, fraud, loss, restrictions, borrowing costs, time value of money and alternative-store prices are not modeled. Actual terms and applicable rules require separate review.
068766ba4f82b9d11353f34d63c9e53b713081df.zh: 原始假设的零售商礼品卡购买，而不是报价促销、银行账户或投资回报。该卡是在零月份购买的，金额为面值 ×（1 − 输入的折扣）。两种情况在输入的最终购物月份的每个月末购买相同的选定金额，然后停止这些购买；报告窗口可以更快结束。首先使用卡内余额，未使用的部分以现金支付。在这种情况下，未使用的购买信用保留在卡上，没有费用、到期、现金退款、转售、重新充值、利息或恢复评估。最后购物月份是家庭使用的假设，而不是法定的有效期。匹配的购买金额假定为全押，并且以相同的价格同等资格。该卡不会诱导额外购买。该卡在购物时必须替换其原始面值的 90.00%，才能达到相等的累计现金支出。在此选定的购买计划和报告窗口内，卡盒无法赶上现收现付现金。剩余的名义购买余额不是返还给家庭的现金或计量的公允价值。零售商失败、欺诈、损失、限制、借贷成本、货币时间价值和替代商店价格均未建模。实际条款和适用规则需要单独审核。

0833175f36696b5b1642c00039586c0e851d0d8d.src: The waterfall uses squared percentage points to make the arithmetic readable. Its default first term is (0.6 × 6)² = 12.96. The second is (0.4 × 18)² = 51.84. The covariance cross term is 2 × 0.6 × 0.4 × 0.2 × 6 × 18 = 10.368. Together they produce variance of 75.168 squared percentage points. Its square root is approximately 8.66995 percentage points.

0950e8bf82607a2c6fbc131f50924b3f9330eb91.src: Hypothetical retirement survivor-household cash stress, not a pension, insurance, support or tax calculation. 0a86192375e38750458f8118fb9dcb960c4cbe2c.src: Rows replace rate A and columns replace rate B, holding the initial loan and equal-principal repayment calendar fixed. A positive cell means putting A first costs more interest; a negative cell means it costs less. Zero occurs when rates match or there is no principal. Cells are deterministic comparisons, not estimates of future rate paths.
0a86192375e38750458f8118fb9dcb960c4cbe2c.zh: 行替换利率 A，列替换利率 B，保持初始贷款和等本还款日历固定。正细胞意味着将 A 放在第一位会花费更多的利息；负电池意味着成本更低。当利率匹配或没有本金时，就会出现零。单元格是确定性比较，而不是对未来费率路径的估计。

0a86b90e3a73e851a5ef97336d2822f1823de1c8.src: A fee larger than the maximum modeled covered repair amount produces no equality within 0–100%. If the contract pays none of the repair, it cannot reduce expected repair costs in this model; a positive fee only adds expense. With no fee and no covered amount, the two choices are equal for every probability.
0a86b90e3a73e851a5ef97336d2822f1823de1c8.zh: 大于最大建模承保维修金额的费用不会产生 0–100% 范围内的相等。如果合同不支付任何维修费用，则无法减少该模型中的预期维修成本；正的费用只会增加开支。由于不收取任何费用，也没有承保金额，这两种选择在任何概率下都是相同的。

0a8e7a1ef80cf4574d6de9c47ce96860913bfc74.src: The same total payment can reduce different parts of a card balance. Interest cost depends on which balances remain, so the allocation rule belongs beside the payment amount and the rates.

0bbf5a70600fb0d42308ae3b6865aebcff7cf66f.src: Original deterministic return illustration, with one initial amount and no external deposits or withdrawals. Every complete pair contains mean plus spread and mean minus spread; the arithmetic mean is therefore held constant. The selected number of pairs always produces an even horizon. Returns are nominal total returns with all distributions retained; no separate dividend yield is added. The smooth comparison earns the mean every year as a mathematical reference, not an available guaranteed return. A reversed pair changes interim balances but has the same complete-pair product without cash flows. No asset prices, historical series, market forecast, probabilities, inflation, fee, tax, contribution schedule or suitable allocation is calculated. Holding an arithmetic mean fixed while changing the spread is a controlled comparison, not a claim about achievable investments.
0bbf5a70600fb0d42308ae3b6865aebcff7cf66f.zh: 原始的确定性回报说明，具有一个初始金额，没有外部存款或取款。每个完整的对都包含均值加价差和均值负价差；因此算术平均值保持不变。选定的对数始终会产生偶数水平线。回报是保留所有分布的名义总回报；不添加单独的股息收益率。平滑比较赚取每年的平均值作为数学参考，而不是可用的保证回报。反向货币对会改变中期余额，但具有相同的完整货币对产品，但没有现金流。不计算资产价格、历史序列、市场预测、概率、通货膨胀、费用、税收、缴款表或适当的分配。在改变利差的同时保持算术平均值固定是一种受控比较，而不是对可实现投资的主张。

0c275917a755fe96886e84509abd2f6d88bfbbbc.src: Original deterministic nominal-CAD saving illustration. The project price grows at the entered constant annual rate. Starting savings and equal month-end deposits earn a constant effective annual return converted to a monthly rate; negative rates are allowed, but no uncertain return path is simulated. The full project bill is paid at the end of the selected whole-year period, with no earlier deposits to suppliers. A positive gap means a shortfall and a negative gap excess savings relative to this modeled bill. No tax, fees, borrowing, reserve earmark or guarantee is included. The sensitivity chart changes one input at a time: quote ± the selected percentage; monthly saving ±25%; return and price growth ±2 percentage points, bounded to their stated baseline ranges; and the deadline ±1 year, bounded to 1–15 years. Quotes and deposits are scaled stress cases, so their tested endpoints may exceed baseline form limits. All tested inputs are listed in the data table. Ranges are authored assumptions, not confidence intervals, probability distributions, equally likely outcomes or a global sensitivity decomposition. The combined case applies its five changes together in the stated order, without calling it a worst case.
0c275917a755fe96886e84509abd2f6d88bfbbbc.zh: 原始确定性名义加元储蓄插图。项目价格按输入的恒定年增长率增长。起始储蓄和等额月末存款可赚取转换为月利率的恒定有效年回报；允许负利率，但不会模拟不确定的回报路径。全部项目账单在选定的全年期间结束时支付，无需提前向供应商支付押金。正缺口意味着相对于该模拟法案的储蓄不足，负缺口意味着超额储蓄。不包括税收、费用、借款、储备金专款或担保。灵敏度图表一次改变一个输入：报价±所选百分比；每月节省±25%；回报和价格增长±2个百分点，限于其规定的基线范围；期限±1年，范围为1-15年。报价和存款是按比例缩放的压力情况，因此它们的测试端点可能会超出基线形式限制。所有测试的输入都列在数据表中。范围是编写的假设，而不是置信区间、概率分布、同等可能的结果或全局敏感性分解。组合案例按规定的顺序一起应用五项更改，而不是称其为最坏情况。

0d1bd83d3cb4a3ea02a7a11e3b006db7d50d2df5.src: At 35 days, the selected December receipt moves to 15 January 2027. 0d1cc6e5d23ffc74f45612192cd48e07b4ecd8e4.src: That is a net-pay figure. It is not the gross salary to request from an employer, and converting it requires an independently appropriate payroll estimate. It also leaves out pension accrual, employer matching, insurance benefits, stock compensation and other non-cash terms. A higher break-even amount can result when new cash costs are substantial even though the advertised salary increase looks large.
0d1cc6e5d23ffc74f45612192cd48e07b4ecd8e4.zh: 这是一个净工资数字。它不是向雇主要求的总工资，转换它需要独立适当的工资估算。它还遗漏了养老金应计、雇主匹配、保险福利、股票补偿和其他非现金条款。当新的现金成本很高时，即使广告上的加薪看起来很大，也可能会导致更高的收支平衡。

0d1d105d1f23a326340926f5f682a20ec06626da.src: Conversely, the strongest upside proof would combine repeatable pre-provision growth, sound consumer credit, accepted control improvements and capital returned at sensible prices. That combination would support confidence in a durable return on equity. The research stance should change with that evidence and the entry valuation together. A higher EPS forecast alone is insufficient if the risk-adjusted multiple required to justify the share price has risen just as much.
0d1d105d1f23a326340926f5f682a20ec06626da.zh: 相反，最有力的上行证据将包括可重复的预拨备增长、良好的消费者信贷、可接受的控制改进以及以合理价格返还的资本。这种结合将支持人们对持久股本回报的信心。研究立场应该随着证据和进入估值的变化而改变。如果证明股价合理所需的风险调整倍数也同样上涨，仅靠较高的每股收益预测是不够的。

0da39a46dd402b6c065c7b90892a3ff238e099de.src: Reconcile actual payment confirmation separately from internal cash earmarking. A reserve can make a bill affordable without sending anything to the issuer. These charts connect the timing and funding questions, while leaving the real account’s dates, conditions and completed payment to be verified from its records.
0da39a46dd402b6c065c7b90892a3ff238e099de.zh: 将实际付款确认与内部现金指定用途分开进行核对。储备金可以使账单变得负担得起，而无需向发行人发送任何内容。这些图表将时间安排和资金问题联系起来，同时保留真实账户的日期、条件和已完成的付款，以便从其记录中进行验证。

0da561dd5c711a5c133f633b659172fc7f61aeac.src: Cells show the maximum qualifying amount within each tax-year deduction capacity and the remaining lifetime AIP relief ceiling, holding the entered AIP fixed. Column capacities and prior relief used are CAD, shown as $0, $10k, $25k and $50k. The current example’s AIP is CAD 26,000. Previous qualifying relief reduces only the lifetime ceiling; it is not the same as RRSP deduction capacity. Values do not establish that a payment or deduction qualifies.
0da561dd5c711a5c133f633b659172fc7f61aeac.zh: 单元格显示每个纳税年度扣除能力内的最大合格金额以及剩余终身 AIP 减免上限，保持输入的 AIP 固定。塔容量和先前使用的救济以加元计算，显示为 $0、$10k、$25k 和 $50k。当前示例的 AIP 为 26,000 加元。以前的资格减免仅降低终身上限；它与RRSP扣除能力不同。数值并不表明付款或扣除符合条件。

0da719e4cfb67f6935185c5e91f2d8b288ffc6ea.src: Published 6 November 2023; reviewed 25 October 2026. General distinction between capital replacement and annual maintenance, and the role of component costs and remaining life. This original household model uses hypothetical prices and intervals and is not a formal reserve study or a CMHC cost/lifespan estimate.
0da719e4cfb67f6935185c5e91f2d8b288ffc6ea.zh: 发布于 2023 年 11 月 6 日； 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查。资本更换和年度维护之间的一般区别，以及组件成本和剩余寿命的作用。这个原始家庭模型使用假设的价格和时间间隔，并不是正式的准备金研究或 CMHC 成本/寿命估计。

0daa600c0ae3bdab10f8d9c9859f5bcde0bacaf7.src: The second bar is monthly net cash income × 12, assuming that amount continues. It is not the official sector disposable-income definition. Dividing the first bar by the second gives the displayed personal stock ratio. That quotient is not a repayment schedule: living costs and interest still need funding.
0daa600c0ae3bdab10f8d9c9859f5bcde0bacaf7.zh: 第二个栏是每月净现金收入 × 12，假设该金额持续存在。这不是官方部门的可支配收入定义。将第一个条形除以第二个条形即可得出显示的个人股票比率。该商数不是还款计划：生活成本和利息仍然需要资金。

The axes keep both questions visible: how much does the midpoint recipient report, and what proportion of the age group reports the selected income? 0dadb5880c85dc653153e5b8a27997bac53d1535.src: Each bar is the equity amount at that snapshot times the selected negative equity change. Other assets are assumed unchanged. The peak snapshot is selected from the modeled whole-year checkpoints. The shocks are independent comparisons and are never deducted repeatedly from the contribution path. They are not probabilities, volatility estimates or maximum possible losses.
0dadb5880c85dc653153e5b8a27997bac53d1535.zh: 每个条形都是净值该快照的金额乘以选定的负资产变化。其他资产假设不变。峰值快照是从建模的全年检查点中选择的。冲击是独立比较，不会从贡献路径中重复扣除。它们不是概率、波动性估计或最大可能损失。

0db2414203d5675ad211d0524c07d73c133a115c.src: After A’s immediate first payment, cash is CAD 100. In week two, CAD 350 of payments leave before the week-end surplus, putting cash at negative CAD 150. The same week ends at negative CAD 50 after the CAD 100 resource arrives.
0db2414203d5675ad211d0524c07d73c133a115c.zh: A 立即支付第一笔款项后，现金为 100 加元。第二周，在周末盈余之前支付 350 加元的付款，使现金为负 150 加元。在 100 加元资源到达后，同一周结束时为负 50 加元。

0db25f8bd595d4dbbaa386c648efb099568f2eb0.src: The matrix has no assigned probabilities, risk premium or current yield curve. Its cells are conditional arithmetic, not estimates of the likelihood of meeting a goal.
0db25f8bd595d4dbbaa386c648efb099568f2eb0.zh: 该矩阵没有指定概率、风险溢价或当前收益率曲线。其单元格是条件算术，而不是对实现目标的可能性的估计。

0db4b1dc9c57cc883569203775fc7765c5002b00.src: Dividing CAD 10,000 by twenty-four gives an unrounded monthly payment of CAD 416.666…. The calculator keeps fractional cents internally so the principal is fully repaid at the selected final date. An actual lender may round payments and adjust the last instalment.
0db4b1dc9c57cc883569203775fc7765c5002b00.zh: 将 10,000 加元除以 24 得出每月未四舍五入的付款 416.666 加元……。计算器在内部保留小数美分，以便在选定的最终日期全额偿还本金。实际贷款机构可能会四舍五入付款并调整最后一笔分期付款。

0db4dc1bc47bc4b6c8a63dc58db7374755bb0f9a.src: The matrix changes the bill and the accessible share of the selected unused limit. A zero cell means that cash plus an actual draw can cover that particular bill. It does not mean the bill was paid entirely from savings or that later debt payments will fit the budget.
0db4dc1bc47bc4b6c8a63dc58db7374755bb0f9a.zh: 该矩阵会更改账单以及所选未使用限额的可访问份额。零单元格意味着现金加上实际提款可以支付该特定账单。这并不意味着账单完全由储蓄支付，也不意味着以后的债务支付将符合预算。

0db956cff25929784487a1bfab178c46f0673192.src: The default 3% net discount rate produces a combined need of CAD 759,067.82, including CAD 50,000 of immediate costs. A discount rate is an assumption about funding the future payments. It is not a guaranteed return available from an investment or an insurance policy. A lower assumed rate increases the amount needed today for the same positive future shortfalls.
0db956cff25929784487a1bfab178c46f0673192.zh: 默认的 3% 净折扣率会产生加元的综合需求759,067.82，其中包括 50,000 加元的直接费用。贴现率是为未来付款提供资金的假设。它不是投资或保险单的保证回报。较低的假设利率会增加当前所需的金额，以应对未来相同的积极缺口。

0dbf6949d24b046e794c8bb9433544a9eaad6f53.src: Relative to the CAD 104.50 alternative, that saving is about 4.31%. The difference comes from comparing an actual assumed basket price instead of using the card’s face amount as the only baseline. No merchant prices or available deals have been collected; the 5% difference is an authored input.
0dbf6949d24b046e794c8bb9433544a9eaad6f53.zh: 相对于 104.50 加元的替代方案，节省约 4.31%。差异来自于比较实际假设的篮子价格，而不是使用卡的面额作为唯一的基准。尚未收集商家价格或可用交易； 5% 的差异是作者输入的。

0dc7ffabd6e2d0130e5fa719dd518c8c4420fa2d.src: Liquidity adds resilience: LCR125%, NSFR112%, high-quality liquid assets about C$487bn against modeled 30-day outflows C$389bn. 0dd140fd658e81fb103149f04aa912461a6d7d66.src: A regular investment schedule is easier to sustain when near-term spending has its own cash. Adjusting purchases after an income change is a budget decision; it does not require predicting the next market turn.
0dd140fd658e81fb103149f04aa912461a6d7d66.zh: 当短期支出有自己的现金时，定期投资计划更容易维持。收入变化后调整购买是一项预算决策；它不需要预测下一个市场转向。

0dd49cdf9f85b7b330d13ffe9ec9a57f86e686fb.src: A fund can send cash to its investors while its unit value declines. That combination raises a useful question: how much value remains in the investment, how much has moved outside it, and how have the two together changed? Looking at only the payout or only the unit price leaves part of the answer out.
0dd49cdf9f85b7b330d13ffe9ec9a57f86e686fb.zh: 基金可以在其单位价值下降时向投资者发送现金。这种组合提出了一个有用的问题：投资中剩余了多少价值，有多少价值转移到了投资之外，以及两者一起发生了怎样的变化？只看支出或只看单价会漏掉部分答案。

0e5f6b2c6fccb125506d81c6000de157bd5654dc.src: For independent arithmetic, suppose an invented household stops working at age sixty, needs CAD 42,000 annually and receives an independently assumed income only from age sixty-five. Five years of that spending total CAD 210,000 before any returns, inflation, taxes or other income. Those authored numbers do not come from the retirement-age table and do not define a recommended reserve.
0e5f6b2c6fccb125506d81c6000de157bd5654dc.zh: 对于独立算术，假设一个发明的家庭在 60 岁时停止工作，每年需要 42,000 加元，并且仅从独立假设的收入中获得收入六十五岁。五年来，扣除任何回报、通货膨胀、税收或其他收入，支出总额为 210,000 加元。这些编写的数字并非来自退休年龄表，也没有定义建议的储备金。

0e6527a6f2776d251ba98b350f92625626926dff.src: It is tempting to subtract a claimed deduction from undeducted contributions and then reuse the original deduction-capacity figure. That changes one side of the reconciliation while freezing the other. The grouped bars show a paired bookkeeping allocation instead.
0e6527a6f2776d251ba98b350f92625626926dff.zh: 人们很容易从未扣除的捐款中减去已申请的扣除额，然后重新使用原始的扣除额容量数字。这改变了和解的一方面，同时冻结了另一方。分组的条形图显示成对的簿记分配。

0e661fcfdb726aee40e19f67753c5c613caf2b62.src: All amounts are before taxes and fees. The account wrapper and applicable rules need their own review.

0e6cbeedf0b34d922cea870a43f5c108829c7880.src: The tool does not model taxes, benefits, extra wages, borrowing, investment returns or an assessment of care suitability. A negative cash remainder represents missing funding rather than access to credit. A negative time remainder represents incompatible exclusive requests rather than a medical or safety diagnosis.

0e707afcc9a6309ad73c6301b4c4c25a753eb343.src: The U.S. contribution requires special scrutiny because a reduction in commercial-real-estate risk and related allowances can support earnings while the underlying franchise is still rebuilding. A better test is pre-provision revenue after funding and compensation, the persistence of operating deposits, and the loss experience of the remaining loan book. Selling a troubled exposure can improve future risk without proving that the original lending decision created value.
0e707afcc9a6309ad73c6301b4c4c25a753eb343.zh: 美国的捐款需要进行特殊审查，因为商业房地产风险和相关津贴的减少可以在基础特许经营权仍在重建的同时支持收入。更好的检验是融资和补偿后的预拨备收入、经营性存款的持续性以及剩余贷款账面的损失经历。出售有问题的风险敞口可以改善未来的风险，而无需证明最初的贷款决策创造了价值。

0e718ba836f4cd01538a5d3724c802bf9efee5ec.src: The percentage calculation would then exceed the unchanged CAD 4,000 cap. The gross formula amount is still CAD 4,000, representing about 33.78% of the earnings assumed eligible at that later review.

0ea56a73b31fa28896a26cf58d4c5f926c2b0d1c.src: At year t, purchasing power equals the fixed monthly payment divided by (1 + inflation)^t. The year-zero point shows the initial payment amount for comparison, not a payment received at purchase. No indexed annuity quote is inferred.
0ea56a73b31fa28896a26cf58d4c5f926c2b0d1c.zh: 在 t 年，购买力等于每月固定付款除以 (1 + 通货膨胀)^t。年零点显示用于比较的初始付款金额，而不是购买时收到的付款。不会推断指数年金报价。

0ea796bedf452b06c9597eb48a2d7706d498b5eb.src: The horizontal axis varies an assumed existing loan balance from zero to the surrender quote and includes the selected balance exactly. Both gross quotes stay fixed. This is a sensitivity at one dated basis, not a timeline, interest projection, loan offer or forecast that coverage survives each debt level. Each additional CAD 1 of assumed debit reduces each alternative amount by CAD 1. The two lines are not added together. If the surrender quote is zero, only the zero-loan point exists.
0ea796bedf452b06c9597eb48a2d7706d498b5eb.zh: 横轴将假设的现有贷款余额从零变化到退保报价，并准确包含所选余额。两个总报价保持不变。这是一种基于某一日期的敏感性，而不是时间表、利息预测、贷款报价或对每个债务水平的承保范围的预测。假设借方每增加 1 加元，每个替代金额就会减少 1 加元。这两行不会相加。如果退保报价为零，则仅存在零贷款点。

0ea8ab77828851470e07a8a99488c835cc0bfd00.src: Every modeled year credits interest to the opening balance, then pays tax immediately from that balance. The next year earns interest only on what remains. This convention makes the compounding effect of retained net interest inspectable.
0ea8ab77828851470e07a8a99488c835cc0bfd00.zh: 每个模型年度都会将利息计入期初余额，然后立即从该余额中纳税。下一年只赚取剩余部分的利息。这一惯例使留存净利息的复利效应变得可以检查。

0eb0a2cad0e60bc3f537298cfcfbfee2b9788ccb.src: The relevant risk for a fixed-date goal is having too little usable money when the bill arrives. A potential recovery after that date may not solve the problem.

0cb3676c339ed639ca3cce11d37cfcab619ffa0b.src: The paths have the same number of observations and the same full-window index return. The paired path alternates multiplicative up/down adjustments around the same underlying log trend. At the default zero trend and 10% swing, each pair is +10% then approximately −9.0909%, returning the benchmark to its prior pair-end level. It is not +10% followed by −10%. No path is historical, probable or a forecast.
0cb3676c339ed639ca3cce11d37cfcab619ffa0b.zh: 这些路径具有相同数量的观测值和相同的全窗口索引返回。配对路径围绕相同的基础对数趋势交替进行乘法向上/向下调整。在默认的零趋势和 10% 波动下，每对上涨 10%，然后约为 -9.0909%，将基准返回到之前的货币对结束水平。它不是+10%后跟-10%。没有一条路径是历史的、可能的或预测的。

1044e0aeb746f1494ba037077a377f1f26f9fc4b.src: Before settlement, award cash equals the gross retroactive receipt and the earmark equals the modeled repayment. At the selected day-end, cash falls by the repayment and the earmark becomes zero. Cash minus the unpaid earmark stays the same; subtracting the already-paid repayment again would double-count it. A zero-day lag shows only the post-settlement day-0 balance. The earmark is a claim against the same cash; the lines are not added together. No regular benefits, household bills or withholding enter this isolated ledger. The chosen lag is an invented timing assumption, not a permitted deadline.
1044e0aeb746f1494ba037077a377f1f26f9fc4b.zh: 结算前，奖励现金等于追溯收入总额，专项资金等于模型还款。在选定的日终，现金因还款而减少，指定用途为零。现金减去未支付的专项资金保持不变；再减去已经支付的还款额就会重复计算。零日滞后仅显示结算后的第 0 天余额。指定用途是对同一现金的索偿；这些线没有加在一起。没有常规福利、家庭账单或预扣税进入这个孤立的分类账。所选择的滞后是虚构的时间假设，而不是允许的最后期限。

1046632c008730fdb03215b16e88afe4865e3e9c.src: The estimate should describe money avoided, not simply a percentage change in energy use without a price basis. Weather, occupancy, operating settings, the existing equipment and future prices can affect the actual bill difference.
1046632c008730fdb03215b16e88afe4865e3e9c.zh: 估算应描述避免的资金，而不仅仅是没有价格基础的能源使用百分比变化。天气、入住率、操作环境、现有设备和未来价格都会影响实际的账单差异。

104e5366d64b58196540aff7290187466c9c28c6.src: Salary is employment income reported through payroll, with withholding and employer obligations that this model does not calculate. A salary expense may reduce corporate income when the payment is deductible under the applicable rules; the model simply assumes that treatment. The actual facts, records, services and amount matter. Do not use this calculator to decide how much remuneration is reasonable or deductible.

10a63da2a767560521b670006717eb0a95848d2c.src: The no-rent-month input is a cash stress, not a local vacancy statistic or an assessment of a tenancy. 10a6d60589e35884776a3ac956061f73ac4c2076.src: Original hypothetical historical 2025 example for ordinary eligible capital property, one loss vintage and no other adjustments. All entered losses are already allowable amounts and gains are already taxable amounts on a matching inclusion-rate basis; no inclusion factor is applied again. Same-year use comes first. A separately requested total limits carryback allocation, then the model visits 2022, 2023 and 2024 in that authored order, capped by each entered available gain and the remaining loss. This destination-year ordering is an illustration, not a legal priority or tax-optimization result. Available prior gains and loss eligibility are assumed verified independently. No tax refund, bank receipt, assessment, tax bracket, benefit adjustment, future-year deduction or interest is computed. Earlier loss vintages, inclusion-rate conversion, pre-1985 special rules, business investment losses, listed personal property, denied losses and superficial-loss testing are excluded.
10a6d60589e35884776a3ac956061f73ac4c2076.zh: 原始假设历史 2025 年示例，适用于普通合格资本财产，一个亏损年份且无其他调整。所有输入的损失都已经是允许的金额，并且收益已经是基于匹配的包含率的应税金额；不再应用包含因子。同年使用优先。单独请求的总限制回转分配，然后模型按该编写顺序访问 2022 年、2023 年和 2024 年，并以每个输入的可用收益和剩余损失为上限。此目的地年份排序仅供参考，并非法律优先权或税收优化结果。假设现有的先前收益和损失资格经过独立验证。不计算退税、银行收据、评估、税级、福利调整、未来年度扣除或利息。较早的损失年份、包含率换算、1985 年之前的特殊规则、商业投资损失、列出的个人财产、否认的损失和表面损失测试均被排除在外。

For this assumed balance-based interest rule, applying 8% to the full original CAD 24,000 for all four years would ignore the principal repayments entirely. A contract that explicitly uses a flat original-principal basis is a different calculation.
10aa985e764d88af253a1037efdab4eaea05b4b6.zh: 这些最后的百分比是本发明表的算术摘要，不是受监管的年利率、引用的年度借款成本或用于评估指定日期付款的替代值。对于这个假设的基于余额的利息规则，在所有四年内对原始 24,000 加元全额应用 8% 将完全忽略本金偿还。明确使用固定原始本金基础的合同则采用不同的计算方式。

11d2218b02f4269963653f7cc42db1a83474c770.src: NASAA's fee-disclosure discussion highlights a formula clients can use to verify charges and agreement terms that match billing. A lower rate or invoice alone does not show that two engagements meet the same needs.

122c05575ebaf1f86d546a74c709f8b625190487.src: One invented non-registered Canadian mutual-fund holding, one opening purchase, a fully reinvested taxable distribution, a later cash return of capital and one sale of every unit. The taxable distribution input is its actual cash-equivalent amount, not a dividend gross-up or income-tax amount. The post-distribution reinvestment NAV equals the entered opening purchase NAV by explicit assumption; the pre-distribution NAV is higher by distribution per original unit. Fractional units are allowed. Cash return of capital is retained outside and reduces NAV and ACB without changing units. Input limits keep NAV and ACB positive, so zero-basis and excess-return-of-capital rules are excluded. Selling expense reduces sale proceeds and is not deducted from ACB again. No taxes, inclusion rate, loss offsets, withholding, foreign currency, registered account, other identical holdings, additional trades or deemed dispositions are calculated. Intermediate book-cost and NAV stages are assumed, not observed fund performance. Calculations keep full precision until display.
122c05575ebaf1f86d546a74c709f8b625190487.zh: 一项发明的非注册加拿大共同基金持有、一次首次购买、一次完全再投资的应税分配、随后的资本现金返还以及一次出售每个单位。应税分配投入是其实际现金等价金额，而不是股息总额或所得税金额。通过明确假设，分配后再投资资产净值等于输入的开仓购买资产净值；按原始单位分配，预分配资产净值较高。允许使用小数单位。资本现金返还保留在外部，并在不改变单位的情况下减少NAV和ACB。输入限制使 NAV 和 ACB 保持为正值，因此零基差和超额资本回报规则被排除在外。销售费用会减少销售收入，并且不会再次从 ACB 中扣除。不计算任何税费、包含率、损失抵消、预扣税、外币、注册账户、其他相同持有量、额外交易或视为处置。中间账面成本和资产净值阶段是假设的，没有观察到基金表现。计算在显示之前保持完全精确。

11eabc672717c72f07766f86a68a50f88292ea7b.src: Original hypothetical capacity test, not an issuer authorization engine. The first incidental/security hold is requested on day one and is absent from its selected release day onward. The second is requested on day three and absent from day twelve onward. Both are assumed released in full without converting into posted purchases; underlying booking costs are outside this example. Existing debt changes only by one payment, applied on the entered usable-credit day and capped at the opening balance; credit balances and excess payment cash are not modeled. Each day shows that payment and hold releases before testing capacity. A separate day-four purchase is tested but never posted to the balance, even when it fits. Aggregate demands above the entered limit identify an infeasible scenario, not a promise that the issuer accepts holds or over-limit transactions. No interest, fees, foreign exchange, rewards, bank cash ledger or credit score is calculated. Release and payment-processing dates are assumptions, not standard service times.
11eabc672717c72f07766f86a68a50f88292ea7b.zh: 原始假设容量测试，而不是发行人授权引擎。第一次杂费/安全保留是在第一天提出的请求，并且从选定的发布日起就不再存在。第二次在第三天请求，从第十二天开始缺席。假设两者均已完全释放，且未转换为已发布的购买量；基本预订成本不在本示例之内。现有债务仅通过一笔付款改变，在输入的可用信用日应用，并以期初余额为上限；贷款机构余额和超额支付现金未建模。每天都会显示付款和保留在测试容量之前释放。单独的第四天购买会被测试，但从未过帐到余额，即使它适合。高于输入限额的总需求表明一种不可行的情况，而不是发行人接受持有或超限额交易的承诺。不计算利息、费用、外汇、奖励、银行现金分类账或信用评分。发布和付款处理日期均为假设日期，并非标准服务时间。

11f5af0268e7599d085be01e6cc1931bbdde4c72.src: For the interest attribution, cash first funds the replacement price and charges, then any remaining old shortfall. If cash pays the entire transaction need, there is no financed shortfall and no new-loan interest attributed to it. This allocation is a declared way to explain the numbers, rather than a lender’s separate account for each dollar borrowed.
11f5af0268e7599d085be01e6cc1931bbdde4c72.zh: 对于利息归属，现金首先支付重置价格和费用，然后支付任何剩余的旧缺口。如果现金支付全部交易需求，则不存在融资缺口，也不会产生新贷款利息。这种分配是一种解释数字的声明方式，而不是贷款机构为借入的每一美元设立的单独账户。

0c78684f6e1ed784f188b3bf01e8fff454b7dd38.src: A no-loan alternative invests only the same CAD 20,000 of own capital. 0c78684f6e1ed784f188b3bf01e8fff454b7dd38.zh: 无贷款替代方案仅投资相同的 20,000 加元自有资本。为了保持家庭资源比较的一致性，它每月还收到同样的 200 加元的外部资金。它以零回报现金的形式保留这笔钱，因为它不需要支付贷款利息账单。

0c7979d5c605cc64271cf3e1871e085305f4e250.src: Each rule assigns the full shared bills plus shared savings transfer. Income shares use A income divided by combined income, and the corresponding B share. If combined income is zero, no income percentage is invented. Assigned amounts do not establish that either person can afford them.
0c7979d5c605cc64271cf3e1871e085305f4e250.zh: 每条规则分配全部共享账单以及共享储蓄转账。收入份额采用 A 收入除以合并收入，得到相应的 B 份额。如果合并收入为零，则不会发明收入百分比。分配金额并不表明任何人都能负担得起。

0c81763de345d738b53ac7231de486f86211360b.src: The matrix replaces the comparison package size and price while holding monthly use, the reference package and the selected horizon constant. Every cell applies the same whole-package rule and carries stock forward. A larger package need not have a lower unit price, and even a low unit price can require a larger payment on the first shopping trip.

0c887811ea897669ebf56c82e673c384f9b6c46a.src: Each nominal ending balance is divided by (1 + entered inflation)^year. If pay growth differs from inflation, that schedule changes in real terms. The displayed purchasing power inherits the hypothetical price assumption and smooth return; it is not a household-specific cost-of-living estimate.

10ebc1cc0bc16d3e2b8d781b96872464a7d5429d.src: Columns replace net cash income with 80%, 90%, 100% or 110% of its entered value. Rows replace scheduled payments with 80%, 100%, 120% or 140%. Living costs and the annual-bill reserve stay fixed. Payment changes are independent cash assumptions, not mechanically calculated interest-rate shocks or offers to change a contract.
10ebc1cc0bc16d3e2b8d781b96872464a7d5429d.zh: 列将净现金收入替换为其输入值的 80%、90%、100% 或 110%。行将预定付款替换为 80%、100%、120% 或 140%。生活费用和年度账单准备金保持不变。付款变更是独立的现金假设，而不是机械计算的利率冲击或更改合同的提议。

10ec42f34cb72d831f37134db5558fba4d9ac373.src: Start with a payment that can be sustained and note its modeled finish date. Next test a modest increase, then a higher rate. If the plan depends on a promotional rate staying low, include the period after it expires using the separate balance-transfer guide.
10ec42f34cb72d831f37134db5558fba4d9ac373.zh: 从可以持续的付款开始，并记下其建模的完成日期。接下来测试适度的增长，然后测试更高的速度。如果计划依赖于保持较低的促销利率，请使用单独的余额转账指南将其到期后的期限包括在内。

125a7e72f1e44de5c25aed54d441bcb4c2be3f43.src: TreasuryDirect’s TIPS overview describes U.S. Treasury Inflation-Protected Securities: principal adjusts with inflation or deflation, the coupon rate is fixed, and interest is paid every six months on adjusted principal. At maturity, principal redemption is the greater of the adjusted amount and original principal.
125a7e72f1e44de5c25aed54d441bcb4c2be3f43.zh: TreasuryDirect 的 TIPS 概述描述了美国国债通胀保值证券：本金随通货膨胀或通货紧缩而调整，票面利率固定，每六个月根据调整后的本金还款利息。到期时，本金赎回为调整后金额与原本金中的较大者。

125ac7451f5b77f3e9873dbf9a21fed368989674.src: Change completed service to three years. The default cliff rule now vests all 600 units, with CAD 30,000 of gross value at the entered price. The five-year gradual rule vests only three-fifths, or 360 units, with CAD 18,000 of gross value.
125ac7451f5b77f3e9873dbf9a21fed368989674.zh: 将已完成的服务期限更改为三年。默认悬崖规则现在授予所有 600 个单位，按输入价格计算的总价值为 30,000 加元。五年渐进规则仅授予五分之三，即 360 个单位，总价值为 18,000 加元。

125cc4dfe1039d9b84188ff297c857e0465eecdb.src: This table’s Canada selection covers tax filers aged at least 18 in the ten provinces who filed in both years. It is not a count of every Canadian resident, child or household. The measure uses census-family after-tax income adjusted by the square root of family size, with a threshold based on half the median adjusted income.
125cc4dfe1039d9b84188ff297c857e0465eecdb.zh: 此表的加拿大选择涵盖了这两个年度提交的 10 个省份中年满 18 岁的纳税人。这并不是对每个加拿大居民、儿童或家庭的统计。该衡量标准使用按家庭规模平方根调整的人口普查家庭税后收入，阈值基于调整后收入中位数的一半。

1260593648d88470d34c908e35b3bdef6aec2a1d.src: An endorsement described as guaranteed replacement cost may pay above the stated dwelling amount, but only when its own conditions are satisfied; the Insurance Bureau of Canada’s wildfire guidance describes a common same-site rebuilding requirement. A fixed annual growth input in this model is not an inflation-protection clause or evidence that such an endorsement applies. A positive comparison gap can coexist with a qualifying endorsement, and a zero gap can coexist with exclusions, deductibles or unmet conditions, so neither sign determines the actual settlement.
1260593648d88470d34c908e35b3bdef6aec2a1d.zh: 描述为保证重置成本的背书可能会支付高于规定的住房金额的费用，但前提是满足其自身条件；加拿大保险局的野火指南描述了常见的同一地点重建要求。该模型中的固定年增长投入并不是通货膨胀保护条款，也不是此类认可适用的证据。正比较差距可以与合格认可共存，零差距可以与排除、免赔额或未满足的条件共存，因此这两个标志都不能决定实际的结算。

1265a10ee7ebefe57616f466dfb0e49dc5c35612.src: A ten-year outcome with no event spends none of the reserve. One event spends it exactly. Two events cost CAD 10,000 and leave CAD 5,000 unfunded. The unused reserve in the zero-event outcome cannot be transferred across possible futures to pay the second event in another outcome.
1265a10ee7ebefe57616f466dfb0e49dc5c35612.zh: 没有事件的十年结果不会花费任何准备金。一项活动正好花费了它。两场活动花费了 10,000 加元，还有 5,000 加元没有资金。零事件结果中未使用的准备金不能跨可能的期货转移以支付另一个结果中的第二个事件。

126bbc73a410a011a182f09ac783f43faf43244c.src: The domestic franchise needs to convert improved margins into durable customer value. Better deposit relationships can lower reliance on expensive marginal funding and create opportunities across borrowing, payments and advice. Loan growth alone is less persuasive if it requires concessions on pricing or weaker underwriting. The next results should show whether revenue expands alongside primary relationships and controlled acquisition and servicing costs.
126bbc73a410a011a182f09ac783f43faf43244c.zh: 国内特许经营店需要将提高的利润转化为持久的客户价值。更好的存款关系可以降低对昂贵的边际融资的依赖，并在借贷、支付和咨询方面创造机会。如果贷款增长需要定价方面的让步或承保力度减弱，那么光靠贷款增长就不那么有说服力了。接下来的结果应显示收入是否随着主要关系以及受控的获取和服务成本而增长。

10cb47f2db762581a4ae21f53d321152615db2e3.src: Hypothetical stress arithmetic in CAD, not a fund forecast, historical crisis replay or probability estimate. The first year applies the entered equity and bond total returns to starting weights, then deducts the fee from the resulting portfolio. Every later year uses the independently entered whole-portfolio gross return, then the same fee. Changing the equity weight changes the first-year stress only; it does not estimate later returns. Inflation applies in every year including year one. Distributions are retained within total return. No new deposits, withdrawals, taxes, trading spreads or additional charges are calculated. Actual fund expenses accrue differently; do not subtract this fee again from a published return already net of it. No recovery date is guaranteed.
10cb47f2db762581a4ae21f53d321152615db2e3.zh: 以加元为单位的假设压力算法，而不是基金预测、历史危机重演或概率估计。第一年将输入的股票和债券总回报应用于起始权重，然后从最终的投资组合中扣除费用。以后的每一年都使用独立输入的整个投资组合总回报，然后收取相同的费用。改变股权权重只会改变第一年的压力；它不估计以后的回报。通货膨胀适用于每一年，包括第一年。分配保留在总回报内。不计算新的存款、取款、税收、交易点差或额外费用。实际基金费用的累计情况不同；不要再从已扣除该费用的公布报表中扣除该费用。无法保证恢复日期。

1365d295476237e243fc892693b68593dfc16935.src: Our thesis would need revision if U.S. return improvement stalls after credit normalization, core costs outrun revenue, or strong market businesses conceal disappointing customer-banking economics. Trade disruption could affect commercial borrowers on both sides of the border; funding competition can pressure margins before a clear deterioration appears in credit losses. Transaction execution and minority investments add further uncertainty. We would also challenge the favorable case if capital release is repeatedly needed to sustain distribution targets. The evidence that would change our view is explicit: recurring return on total equity, realized common-income growth and disciplined purchase prices for both acquisitions and the bank's own shares.
1365d295476237e243fc892693b68593dfc16935.zh: 如果美国的回报改善在信贷正常化后停滞不前，核心成本超过收入，或者强劲的市场业务掩盖了令人失望的客户银行经济状况，我们的论文就需要修改。贸易中断可能会影响边境两侧的商业借款人；在信贷损失出现明显恶化之前，融资竞争可能会对利润率造成压力。交易执行和少数股权投资进一步增加了不确定性。如果需要反复释放资本来维持分配目标，我们也会对有利的情况提出质疑。改变我们观点的证据是显而易见的：总股本的经常性回报、实现的共同收入增长以及收购和银行自有股票的严格购买价格。

148384a3ea99db180ca400cb4853b35af5658651.src: At the default 3% annual return, the financed account ends at CAD 10,609 and the cash buyer’s account at about CAD 10,925.36. Financing’s endpoint advantage is therefore negative CAD 316.36. A positive return gives the financed buyer more time earning on retained cash, while the cash buyer earns on a smaller opening balance and later deposits. The matrix compares that timing effect with different cash discounts. Higher-return rows are conditional arithmetic, not forecasts, deposit quotations or evidence that an uncertain investment can safely fund a fixed payment commitment.
148384a3ea99db180ca400cb4853b35af5658651.zh: 按照默认的 3% 年回报率，融资账户最终为 10,609 加元，现金买家账户约为 10,925.36 加元。因此，融资的终点优势为负 316.36 加元。正回报使融资买家有更多时间通过保留现金赚取收入，而现金买家则通过较小的期初余额和后续存款赚取收入。该矩阵将时间效应与不同的现金折扣进行了比较。高回报行是条件算术，而不是预测、存款报价或不确定投资可以安全地为固定付款承诺提供资金的证据。

15f7466d04ded7a1733483c181a52eae320af3bb.src: Ordinary hypothetical two-calendar-year TFSA ledger. No investment returns, other transactions, direct transfers, specified distributions, non-resident periods, excess history or tax on excesses are calculated.
15f7466d04ded7a1733483c181a52eae320af3bb.zh: 普通假设的两年 TFSA 分类账。假设已在所有持有人的 TFSA 之间协调一致，并始终具有加拿大居住权和资格，即可开始使用未使用的房间。捐款上限为模拟的可用房间；未放置的请求永远不会进入帐户。提款的上限为模拟值，并且不会恢复同年的房间。第 2 年添加未使用的房间、实际的普通第 1 年提款和输入的新美元房间假设。该假设不是官方的未来年份限制或预测。不计算投资回报、其他交易、直接转账、指定分配、非居民期间、超额历史记录或超额税。

A path that falls and then recovers can differ from a smooth path with the same final price.

16a53430c34fe09346484eda8c31231fd0e825fa.src: Two invented ten-year inflation sequences contain exactly the same annual rates in opposite order. Block A is 8% for 3 years; block B is 2% for 7 years. The first spending request is made immediately at the start of year one, before any price increase or investment return. Later requests reflect the previous year-end price index. Each requested amount can use only available capital; any gap stays unfunded and is never borrowed automatically. The constant nominal return then applies to remaining capital, followed by that year’s inflation update for the next year. Thus the tenth inflation update affects closing purchasing power but no eleventh spending request is included. Opening-capital requirements discount all ten requested start-of-year withdrawals at the selected constant nominal return. They are deterministic funding identities, not safe-withdrawal recommendations or probabilities. No tax, fees, pensions, consumption substitution or additional income is modeled.

17d04500ca32d53878b648cfea7e4fc1fdd07556.src: Hypothetical ordinary open-card group with positive stated limits. Ratios are balances divided by limits, not predicted scores or approval odds. A 31-day illustration starts with the entered balances. 17d69a002eb52af44d528800ffd9e1f67848fd7d.src: Hypothetical two-asset portfolio with one immediate withdrawal, no price movement, tax, fees, settlement delay or account restriction. Requested cash is capped at total assets and any unfunded remainder is reported. A fully spent portfolio has no remaining allocation. The chosen target is a reader assumption, not a recommended risk level or a forecast.

1c3d0ceabd5b4eb186dc6de443bbee6017539af7.src: Original deterministic annual-cost illustration. The entered cost has constant starting-date purchasing power. The first payment is at the END of year one, so its nominal amount already includes one year of the selected price growth; the final payment is at the selected year-end. All rates are effective annual. “Nominal” here means a money/price basis that includes the assumed inflation effect, not a nominal compounding-frequency quote. Equivalent real discount growth equals nominal discount growth divided by price growth; the real rate can be negative and is not clamped to zero. Correct nominal-cash/nominal-rate and real-cash/real-rate valuations describe the same payment plan at time zero. Two deliberately mismatched calculations illustrate basis errors, not alternative legitimate cost forecasts. No account balance, saving contribution, portfolio return, tax, fee, household risk model or funding adequacy is calculated. Constant inflation and discount assumptions are independently entered scenarios, not official forecasts or recommended personal rates. Full-precision rates are used in calculations even when the displayed real rate is rounded.
1c3d0ceabd5b4eb186dc6de443bbee6017539af7.zh: 原始确定性年度成本说明。输入的成本具有恒定的起始日期购买力。第一次付款是在第一年结束时，因此其名义金额已经包括所选价格增长的一年；最后一次付款是在选定的年底。所有费率均每年有效。这里的“名义”是指货币/价格基础，包括假设的通货膨胀效应，而不是名义复利频率报价。等效实际折扣增长等于名义折扣增长除以价格增长；实际利率可以为负值并且不会被限制为零。正确的名义现金/名义利率和实际现金/实际利率估值描述了零时的相同付款计划。两个故意不匹配的计算说明了基础错误，而不是替代的合法成本预测。不计算账户余额、储蓄贡献、投资组合回报、税收、费用、家庭风险模型或资金充足性。恒定的通货膨胀和折扣假设是独立输入的情景，而不是官方预测或建议的个人利率。即使显示的实际汇率经过四舍五入，计算中也会使用全精度汇率。

1c9359ac8d4ce4e7574d71cf1288e5511907cc12.src: Original nominal-CAD cost comparison. The same net amount is available for the loan purpose in every case. The optional single premium is either paid from separate cash at time zero or added to the loan principal and sent to the insurer; financing it does not create additional spendable loan proceeds. A separate recurring-premium case uses the entered flat premium at each month-end through the scheduled loan term. The loan has a fixed nominal annual rate divided by 12, monthly payments in arrears, no other fees and no early repayment. The final payment clears residual arithmetic; no monthly cent rounding is applied. Premium quotes are independent assumptions, not offers, and coverage, eligibility, exclusions, claims and refund rights are not assessed or assumed equivalent. No claim benefit, premium refund, tax effect or return on retained cash is included. The no-policy row is a cost baseline with no insurance benefit; it is not an equally protected alternative.
1c9359ac8d4ce4e7574d71cf1288e5511907cc12.zh: 原始名义成本与 CAD 成本比较。在每种情况下，可用于贷款目的的净额相同。可选的单期保费可以在零时间用单独的现金支付，也可以添加到贷款本金中并发送给保险公司；为其提供融资不会产生额外的可支出贷款收益。单独的经常性保费案例使用在预定贷款期限内每个月末输入的固定保费。该贷款有固定的名义年利率除以12，每月分期付款，无其他费用，也不得提前还款。最后付款清除剩余算力；不应用每月美分四舍五入。保费报价是独立的假设，而不是要约，并且承保范围、资格、排除、索赔和退款权利未经过评估或假设为等效的。不包括索赔福利、保费退款、税收影响或保留现金回报。无保单行是没有保险福利的成本基准；

1b7b4777312e75b7d9f54ee25b141bc379f12939.src: The adverse path combines slower revenue with more credit costs and less flexibility to repurchase shares. Holding one variable constant can conceal that interaction. The sensitivity section therefore includes a combined downside, and the bear valuation allows the market multiple to fall as earnings weaken. A favourable path would show improving impaired formations without reliance on more generous reserve assumptions, alongside capital generation after funding the continuing business.

1f738754d95a3d32e73b82af38183a542d856bc8.src: Under the scheduled case, receipts occur in months six through twelve before the lender’s bill. That is seven payments, or CAD 7,000. 1f22d2002309515bb920acc200d08741e527947e.src: Original hypothetical CAD illustration of one proposed in-kind contribution from non-registered capital property to the same owner’s TFSA. Assume an eligible Canadian resident, a permitted qualified investment, verified allocated adjusted cost and independently verified available room across all TFSAs. Prices remain unchanged during the illustrated movement. No sale cash is received. Transaction fees, other contributions, withdrawals, non-residency, special property rules, inclusion rates, offsets, personal tax and future returns are excluded. A negative room remainder identifies a proposed contribution exceeding the entered capacity; it is not an executable plan or a calculation of legal excess tax. The tool does not automatically shrink the proposed transfer or establish eligibility.
1f22d2002309515bb920acc200d08741e527947e.zh: 原始假设 CAD 说明，其中显示了从非注册资本财产向同一所有者的 TFSA 提出的一项实物捐助。假设一名符合资格的加拿大居民、一项允许的合格投资、经过验证的分配调整成本以及所有 TFSA 中独立验证的可用房间。在图示的走势中，价格保持不变。未收到销售现金。交易费用、其他供款、提款、非居民、特殊财产规则、包含率、抵消、个人税和未来回报不包括在内。剩余房间数为负表示提议的贡献超出了输入的容量；它不是可执行的计划或合法超额税的计算。该工具不会自动缩减拟议转让或确定资格。

2183ddb07abcf6f63bf23c776d9a70bd5a59a3d4.src: Hypothetical five-rung ladder with equal principal, initial maturities at the ends of years 1–5, and annual cash interest paid before that year’s spending. Every initial rung uses the same entered rate regardless of term. Each maturing principal is immediately reinvested for five years at the entered renewal rate, including subsequent renewals; neither quoted rates nor future availability are predicted. The old rate pays through its maturity year and the renewed rate begins the following year. All principal stays invested and nominal principal remains unchanged. Interest is paid outside the ladder rather than compounded. Outside cash earns zero; annual spending is fixed. No tax, inflation, default, deposit-insurance assessment, fees, early redemption or within-year cash timing is modeled. Negative outside cash is an unmet funding need, not a sale of principal or an automatic loan.
2183ddb07abcf6f63bf23c776d9a70bd5a59a3d4.zh: 假设本金相等的五级阶梯，初始到期日为第 1-5 年末，年度现金利息在当年支出之前支付。无论期限如何，每个初始梯级都使用相同的输入速率。每项到期本金立即按输入的续约利率再投资五年，包括后续续约；报价价格和未来供应情况均无法预测。旧利率在到期年度支付，更新利率从次年开始。所有本金保持投资，名义本金保持不变。利息是在阶梯之外支付而不是复利。外部现金收入为零；每年的支出是固定的。没有对税收、通货膨胀、违约、存款保险评估、费用、提前赎回或年内现金时间进行建模。负外部现金是未满足的资金需求，而不是出售本金或自动贷款。

1f39ad12db2620d4050553424aef055031229bab.src: Hypothetical closed tax-and-prepayment exercise in CAD, not a completed return, eligibility determination or CRA refund estimate. Tuition is an assumed eligible amount; the entered conversion rate produces a baseline value only. Usable relief is capped at the entered tax otherwise payable. Tax and prepayments must describe the same scope. Unabsorbed baseline value is not a Schedule 11 tuition carryforward balance, a future credit valuation or a cash entitlement. No deduction from taxable income, Top-Up Tax Credit, other credit ordering, transfers, future-year use, provincial tax, Alternative Minimum Tax, refundable benefit, interest or assessment offset is calculated. The 14% default reflects the general 2026 federal baseline described by Finance Canada; it does not implement all 2026 return rules. A refund here comes only from matched prepayments exceeding the modeled remaining tax, and cannot exceed those prepayments.

221d0c8c3af2cb34a56a60f3991bad4461cb2de0.src: Funding the lowest point matters even if the full period eventually produces a surplus. Upfront payments may need cash before later income arrives. Conversely, early monthly surpluses can help fund later shortfalls if that money remains available. The model retains both effects rather than simply adding every negative month while ignoring the positive ones.
221d0c8c3af2cb34a56a60f3991bad4461cb2de0.zh: 即使整个时期最终产生盈余，为最低点提供资金也很重要。在后续收入到来之前，预付款可能需要现金。相反，如果资金仍然可用，早期的每月盈余可以帮助弥补以后的短缺。该模型保留了这两种影响，而不是简单地添加每个负面影响，同时忽略正面影响。

22e5ac6ea140dfdbab47f1869ac43c5d9704ceb2.src: The curve evaluates NPV directly at 121 equally spaced rate assumptions; the IRR metric comes from an independent quadratic solution, not from counting sampled sign crossings. The horizontal zero reference is a valuation threshold, not a bank balance.
22e5ac6ea140dfdbab47f1869ac43c5d9704ceb2.zh: 该曲线直接在 121 个等间隔利率假设下评估 NPV； IRR 度量来自独立的二次解，而不是来自对采样的符号交叉进行计数。正切零可以是不与轴相交的重复数学根。超出显示范围的费率不会显示。水平零参考是估值阈值，而不是银行余额。

234f94d2c807fddab0096d5db11ee2f314a8b059.src: The default repair-event probability is an assumed 40% over the entire comparison window. The assumed eligible share is 70% of those repair events. Multiplying them gives a 28% eligible-event probability. The excluded-event probability is 40% × 30%, or 12%, and the no-repair probability is 60%.
234f94d2c807fddab0096d5db11ee2f314a8b059.zh: 在整个比较窗口中，默认修复事件概率假设为 40%。假定合格份额为这些维修事件的 70%。将它们相乘得出合格事件概率为 28%。排除事件概率为 40% × 30%，即 12%，不修复概率为 60%。

238dde0e14c3b0342e123221176dbc833cc62ee4.src: Percentages in the matrix are calculated from whole-person counts, so they can look precise while resting on four invented people. 2558371defb531b26a6c95119ba842f16b6f5513.src: A premium reduction and a larger per-claim cash commitment belong in the same comparison. Check whether the household can fund the retained risk when a loss occurs.
2558371defb531b26a6c95119ba842f16b6f5513.zh: 保费减少和每次索赔现金承诺更大属于同一比较。检查发生损失时家庭是否能够为保留风险提供资金。

25590fc1dd7a963f29c66a1e59910c811ca4afa7.src: The first chart applies those factors to one common assumed age-65 entitlement. At the default CAD 1,000 per month, the illustrative payments are CAD 640 at 60, CAD 1,000 at 65 and CAD 1,420 at 70. The CAD 1,000 input is neither an official maximum nor an average payment.
25590fc1dd7a963f29c66a1e59910c811ca4afa7.zh: 第一个图表将这些因素应用于一项常见的假定 65 岁权利。在默认每月 1,000 加元的情况下，说明性付款为 60 岁时为 640 加元、65 岁时为 1,000 加元、70 岁时为 1,420 加元。输入的 1,000 加元既不是官方最高付款额，也不是平均付款额。

256474ba8f0de4e64b94f3daee60681144ace7e6.src: A personal cash budget therefore starts separately with usable receipts and actual payment obligations. It can account for the services and benefits the household expects to receive under the applicable arrangements, but it should not insert a national-accounts allocation as an extra bank deposit.
256474ba8f0de4e64b94f3daee60681144ace7e6.zh: 因此，个人现金预算分别从可用收据和实际付款义务开始。它可以说明家庭在适用的安排下预期获得的服务和福利，但不应插入国民账户分配作为额外的银行存款。

256974e5e919f0c783b415e258b0e921cbe8cc8d.src: The default adds an allowance equal to 10% of the entire CAD 18,000 base quote, or CAD 1,800. That makes the fully funded stress budget CAD 19,800. The allowance is an additional modeled expense at the final payment date; it is not an observed price increase or a probability-based estimate.
256974e5e919f0c783b415e258b0e921cbe8cc8d.zh: 默认添加相当于整个加元 10% 的津贴基本报价为 18,000 美元，即 1,800 加元。这使得全额资助的压力预算为 19,800 加元。津贴是最终付款日期的额外模拟费用；它不是观察到的价格上涨或基于概率的估计。

256b62abd7eb122416fd7cc8e09ad34f2cdc8bbf.src: This tool excludes sales tax, income tax, debt payments, new equipment, extra staffing, inventory timing and unpaid customer invoices. Even its positive operating surplus is not automatically after-tax household income or cash available for an owner withdrawal.
256b62abd7eb122416fd7cc8e09ad34f2cdc8bbf.zh: 此工具不包括销售税、所得税、债务支付、新设备、额外人员配备、库存时间和未付客户发票。即使其正营业盈余也不会自动成为税后家庭收入或可供业主提取的现金。

25716ee8ba8c28cdf5f14ed4624ad4bf4c1aa649.src: Read negative cash as an unfunded position
25716ee8ba8c28cdf5f14ed4624ad4bf4c1aa649.zh: 将负现金视为无资金头寸

257209ed2b387bcff9542a661dc43287fc43b10e.src: The interactive example isolates thresholds. It deliberately uses a constructed schedule rather than estimating a Canadian return. Actual planning requires the applicable federal and provincial or territorial rules, credits, deductions and other payroll items.
257209ed2b387bcff9542a661dc43287fc43b10e.zh: 交互式示例隔离了阈值。它故意使用一个构建的时间表，而不是估计加拿大的回报。实际规划需要适用的联邦和省或地区规则、抵免、扣除和其他工资项目。

2575249ab6478903e1686c8cb429c6b786ec6e1b.src: The entered 20% cut lowers the selling price from CAD 100 to CAD 80. Since the same unit still costs CAD 60, its contribution falls from CAD 40 to CAD 20. A 20% reduction in the selling price has produced a 50% reduction in contribution per unit.
2575249ab6478903e1686c8cb429c6b786ec6e1b.zh: 输入的 20% 削减会将售价从 100 加元降低至80 加元。由于同一装置的成本仍为 60 加元，因此其贡献从 40 加元降至20 加元。售价降低 20%，单位缴款额减少 50%。

2575f79fb972c0182cd325c383466d048b3bae3b.src: The illustration offsets receipts and spending within each month, uses only the starting reserve and ignores ordinary surplus saving. It does not determine benefits, severance, insurance claims, tax or access to credit. Earlier bill dates can need another timing buffer. The purpose is to make the joint-risk assumption visible before a more complete, evidence-based household plan is prepared.
2575f79fb972c0182cd325c383466d048b3bae3b.zh: 该图抵消了每个月内的收入和支出，仅使用起始准备金，忽略普通盈余储蓄。它不决定福利、遣散费、保险索赔、税收或获得信贷的机会。较早的账单日期可能需要另一个时间缓冲。目的是在制定更完整、基于证据的家庭计划之前，让联合风险假设变得可见。

2576ae46e7c770cbcd4e64dd54ed25d70d490fd1.src: CRA’s contribution guidance states that investment-value changes do not affect TFSA contribution room and that an investment loss does not count as a withdrawal. The loss itself is not added back as room.
2576ae46e7c770cbcd4e64dd54ed25d70d490fd1.zh: CRA 的缴款指南指出，投资价值变化不会影响 TFSA 缴款空间，并且投资损失不算作提款。损失本身不会作为空间添加回来。

2578212fd06bb624484f90e560e40107c2b6f080.src: Read the period and seasonal-adjustment label first. A repeated monthly rate is a scenario; the total of a year’s changing bills also needs their dates.
2578212fd06bb624484f90e560e40107c2b6f080.zh: 首先阅读期间和季节性调整标签。重复的月费率是一种情况；一年中变化的账单总数也需要日期。

25797a8887529d75556e21b8c36eba42f88a5445.src: Original monthly comparison beside CMHC’s published reference ratios, reviewed 25 October 2026. This does not issue a mortgage qualification, pre-approval or affordable home price. Gross income, net income, actual mortgage P&I and qualifying mortgage P&I are independent inputs: no tax conversion, amortization, stress-test payment or income eligibility is calculated. The assessed housing amount includes qualifying P&I, property tax, heat and 50% of condo fees. TDS adds the independently assessed other-debt obligation, which can differ from actual repayments. The separate cash budget uses actual P&I, full condo fees, all entered other home costs, actual other debt, non-housing living costs and planned saving against take-home income. Costs must not overlap. No default-insurance premium, down payment, credit decision, loan-to-income restriction, rental offset, ground rent, variable-income review or exceptional underwriting rule is modeled. Negative remaining cash is an unfunded monthly budget, not an available overdraft. The 39% / 44% references are scoped to the cited material and are not universal approval promises.
25797a8887529d75556e21b8c36eba42f88a5445.zh: 除 ​​CMHC 公布的参考比率外，原始月度比较于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审核。这不涉及抵押贷款资格、预先批准或经济适用房价格。总收入、净收入、实际抵押贷款 P&I 和合格抵押贷款 P&I 是独立的输入：不计算税收转换、摊销、压力测试付款或收入资格。评估的住房金额包括合格的 P&I、财产税、供暖费和 50% 的公寓费。 TDS 添加了独立评估的其他债务义务，该义务可能与实际还款不同。单独的现金预算使用实际保赔、全额公寓费用、所有输入的其他住房成本、实际其他债务、非住房生活成本和计划的实得收入储蓄。成本不得重叠。没有对违约保险费、首付、信贷决策、贷款收入限制、租金抵消、地租、可变收入审查或特殊承保规则进行建模。负剩余现金是没有资金的每月预算，而不是可用的透支。 39% / 44% 的参考范围仅限于所引用的材料，并非普遍批准承诺。

2587c11dad60295c8338c659f948461488fcda34.src: Survey popularity does not measure advice quality. Define the service you need, verify its scope and price, and draw the payment calendar before judging the cost.
2587c11dad60295c8338c659f948461488fcda34.zh: 调查受欢迎程度并不能衡量建议质量。定义您需要的服务，验证其范围和价格，并在判断成本之前绘制付款日历。

25884abf4414524483502a2b64a8850022166dd9.src: Compare allocated cash with the fund needed at every date data
25884abf4414524483502a2b64a8850022166dd9.zh: 在每个数据日期将分配的现金与所需资金进行比较

25b127a20b86d27f127153fb87d091f4eced9b05.src: When a comparison attracts attention, write down the group, year, unit and denominator. Ask whether it is a mean or median, whether the spending category includes nonspenders and whether the figure measures annual consumption, monthly cash flow or income. Resolve those differences before treating a gap as a problem to fix.
25b127a20b86d27f127153fb87d091f4eced9b05.zh: 当比较引起注意时，写下组、年份、单位和分母。询问它是平均值还是中位数，支出类别是否包括非支出者，以及该数字是否衡量年度消费、每月现金流或收入。先解决这些差异，然后再将差距视为需要解决的问题。

25b38f5bd807cd17419eceaa1e16887a762083f2.src: Change only the valuation price to CAD 15. Market value becomes CAD 1,018.875 before display rounding, and the unrealized cash result becomes a loss of CAD 181.125. The six-price arithmetic average and purchase-price harmonic mean have not changed. A purchase average below an arithmetic average can therefore coexist with an investment loss.
25b38f5bd807cd17419eceaa1e16887a762083f2.zh: 仅将估价价格更改为 15 加元。在显示舍入之前，市场价值变为 1,018.875 加元，未实现的现金结果变为 181.125 加元的损失。六价算术平均数和采购价格调和平均数没有变化。因此，低于算术平均值的购买平均值可能与投资损失并存。

25b62fc6ddb20bfcd92a388a6254c323e37caadb.src: The active-use median comes from respondent-level estimates using duration-category midpoints and reported weekly frequency. The source assigns 7.5 hours to the open-ended daily category above six hours. The second median summarizes estimated additional time needed without AI. Neither is a directly timed experiment, and subtracting these aggregate medians does not establish an individual net saving.
25b62fc6ddb20bfcd92a388a6254c323e37caadb.zh: 活跃使用中位数来自使用持续时间类别中点和报告的每周频率的受访者级别估计。消息来源将 7.5 小时分配给 6 小时以上的开放式每日类别。第二个中位数总结了在没有人工智能的情况下预计所需的额外时间。两者都不是直接定时实验，减去这些合计中位数并不能得出个人净节省。

25bae304a07ac8b5310febc4cad1d5ea42cd5486.src: The official table records a correction dated 17 November 2025 to average-age estimates for all reference periods. The charts use the corrected download reviewed on 25 October 2026. An older saved figure should not silently be combined with a newer corrected series.
25bae304a07ac8b5310febc4cad1d5ea42cd5486.zh: 官方表格记录了 2025 年 11 月 17 日对所有参考期平均年龄估计值的修正。这些图表使用 2026 年 10 月 25 日审核的更正下载。较旧的保存数据不应默默地与较新的更正系列合并。

25c1546e109e00c76c7b2ea85ab1648dbf070306.src: The two parts sum to that year’s eligible bills. The household part already contains the deductible, percentage cost sharing and expenses above the insurer-payment cap; adding those amounts again would double count them. Premiums and ineligible bills are outside this chart.
25c1546e109e00c76c7b2ea85ab1648dbf070306.zh: 这两部分合计为当年的合格账单。家庭部分已包含免赔额、费用分摊百分比以及超出保险公司支付上限的费用；再次添加这些金额会重复计算它们。保费和不合格账单不在该图表内。

25c23f016a8b888a89cc94c78d6a25b50983539f.src: At the selected monthly draw, the illustrative cash position is still positive after month seven and negative after month eight. The negative section represents unfunded cash needs. It does not assume a bank permits an overdraft, a family member lends money, or a provider allows payment to be postponed.
25c23f016a8b888a89cc94c78d6a25b50983539f.zh: 在选定的每月抽奖中，说明性现金头寸在第七个月后仍为正值，在第八个月后仍为负值。负数部分代表没有资金支持的现金需求。它不假定银行允许透支、家庭成员借钱或提供商允许推迟付款。

25c3c329ef3ebc3a480a813b544897205b57d5a5.zh: 探索较高的当地 CPI 指数并不能确定哪个城市的成本更高：保持价格锚

25c528c1e5c1eacf20ec27b70fcd82a9beed52c7.src: Known payments already assigned to that cash (CAD)
25c528c1e5c1eacf20ec27b70fcd82a9beed52c7.zh: 已分配给该现金的已知付款（加元）

25c78b67c7763c889474125030e41ccba62e6171.src: Only the deposit changes along this curve. Project price, price growth, return, starting savings and the payment date stay selected assumptions. The horizontal axis is a monthly cash commitment, not time. The zero crossing is the deposit that funds the modeled bill under this constant-return case; it is not a deposit that guarantees success under uncertain prices or returns.
25c78b67c7763c889474125030e41ccba62e6171.zh: 之后的每股收益只有存款沿着这条曲线变化。项目价格、价格增长、回报、起始节省和付款日期保持选定的假设。横轴是每月的现金承诺，而不是时间。零交叉是在这种恒定回报情况下为模型票据提供资金的存款；在价格或回报不确定的情况下，存款并不能保证成功。

25cb0fbac449e993c08f271781fafb6d0b435fe5.src: Under the reference schedule, the immediate deposit leaves CAD 16,000. After the first monthly saving and the CAD 6,000 extra bill, cash is CAD 14,000. The month-two payment leaves CAD 6,000, and the final payment leaves a CAD 2,000 shortfall. The lowest point is therefore negative CAD 2,000.
25cb0fbac449e993c08f271781fafb6d0b435fe5.zh: 根据参考时间表，即时存款剩下 16,000 加元。扣除第一个月的储蓄和 6,000 加元的额外账单后，现金为 14,000 加元。第二个月的付款还剩 6,000 加元，最后一次付款还有 2,000 加元的缺口。因此最低点为负 2,000 加元。

25898fce3b88cdfd97199534c09ec68f7db253dd.src: That distinction matters when saving continues. An account can become more conservatively allocated by one percentage measure while its equity amount remains larger than it was earlier. Neither the mix nor the amount alone tells us whether a retirement income plan is adequate.
25898fce3b88cdfd97199534c09ec68f7db253dd.zh: 当储蓄继续存在时，这种区别很重要。一个账户的分配可以更加保守，增加一个百分比，而其净值金额仍然比以前大。无论是组合还是金额本身都无法告诉我们退休收入计划是否足够。

2589d087e0c96c5f339cff113802a1122169d0a4.src: Public sources reviewed on 25 October 2026. All amounts are original hypothetical bookkeeping scenarios. The fixed twelve-month window and one-model-month payment lag are teaching assumptions. Official sources supply general budgeting, credit-card and net-worth context, not these transaction amounts or dates. Original scenario calculations and research checklists are TickerLantern’s educational analysis; attributed publisher examples retain their stated source and scope. Recheck current issuer documents for any product-specific decision.
2589d087e0c96c5f339cff113802a1122169d0a4.zh: 公开资料于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审核。所有金额均为原始假设的簿记情景。固定的十二个月窗口和一个模型月的付款滞后是教学假设。官方来源提供一般预算、信用卡和净资产背景，而不是这些交易金额或日期。原创情景计算和研究清单是 TickerLantern 的教育分析；归属出版商的示例保留其声明的来源和范围。重新检查当前发行人文件以了解任何特定于产品的决定。

2589dc740c29c19b2b50ab233bb5a6d32b9643bf.src: The U.S. National Association of Insurance Commissioners’ hurricane-deductible explainer describes percentage deductibles that use a home’s insured value. It also explains that the applicable triggers depend on the contract and jurisdiction. That source supplies a concrete reason to inspect the base; it does not establish a Canadian rule or determine which deductible applies to a particular loss.
2589dc740c29c19b2b50ab233bb5a6d32b9643bf.zh: <a href="https://content.naic.org/insurance-topics/hurricane-deductibles">美国全国保险专员协会的飓风免赔额解释器描述了使用房屋保险价值的百分比免赔额。它还解释了适用的触发因素取决于合同和司法管辖区。该消息来源提供了检查该基地的具体理由；它没有制定加拿大规则或确定哪种免赔额适用于特定损失。

258ffe9e439d7a2d71ef3d00fd954339a892fec2.src: The adjusted request can fall through repeated cuts even if assets remain positive. Funded spending can fall below that request when cash runs out. A chosen reduction in flexible spending and an inability to fund an essential bill are separate outcomes.
258ffe9e439d7a2d71ef3d00fd954339a892fec2.zh: 即使资产保持正值，调整后的要求也可能会因反复削减而落空。当现金耗尽时，资助支出可能会低于该要求。选择减少灵活支出和无法支付基本账单是不同的结果。

259407185d7d42a32446f3a5168b781a2e5f954a.zh: 2024 年调查数据中报告的财务建议来源

2672d042de79c1a58ac9a768788f572432a9543e.src: Only the contribution changes along the curve. The plotted range ends no higher than CAD 200,000 and may not reach a distant target. 26732a077f21d5efb308c0d235824795953b8756.src: The calculator assumes cash settlement today and no financing, tax calculation, refund, warranty recovery, inflation or another failure. It does not value convenience, downtime or differences in product quality. If the old item’s sale receipt arrives after the new purchase payment, the upfront bridge understates the interim cash needed and a separate timing plan is required.
26732a077f21d5efb308c0d235824795953b8756.zh: 计算器假定今天进行现金结算，并且没有融资、税收计算、退款、保修恢复、通货膨胀或其他故障。它不重视便利性、停机时间或产品质量的差异。如果旧商品的销售收据在新的购买付款之后到达，则前期桥会低估所需的临时现金，并且需要单独的计时计划。

26754a194058db782db61fcd1fdec4b1b4551393.src: The transfer is assumed paid on time even when the sender’s modeled ledger is negative. That negative point flags a funding issue to resolve; in reality it could also affect the recipient’s expected cash. No overdraft, new loan or access to the other household’s funds is approved or assumed.

2677d1f72556c8c671bd161c4b968d2f14e3ada0.src: Each year CAD 10,000 comes due and is immediately committed to another five-year term. It is a return and reinvestment of principal, not new interest earned. Counting it as spending money while also retaining the renewed rung would create resources twice.
2677d1f72556c8c671bd161c4b968d2f14e3ada0.zh: 每年 10,000 加元到期并立即承诺另一任期五年。这是本金的回报和再投资，而不是新赚取的利息。将其算作支出，同时保留更新的梯级将创造两倍的资源。

2678cde1bcf315895d91bf3ff286c65c75d4a142.src: The default 181.5-share result includes half of a new share. It is a mathematical entitlement before any real-world fractional-share treatment. The calculator retains that half share in every value and return calculation.
2678cde1bcf315895d91bf3ff286c65c75d4a142.zh: 默认的 181.5 份额结果包括新份额的一半。这是任何现实世界的部分股份处理之前的数学权利。计算器在每个值和回报计算中保留这一半份额。

26e6f08ff445753457cc4b9079e4e6ec92d0ee23.src: The horizontal axis changes the common eligible expense, while both rates, unused maximums and the separately ineligible amount stay selected. The ineligible amount therefore remains in the household share even at zero common eligible expense. These are distinct hypothetical claim sizes, not cumulative claims, changing balances over time or probabilities.
26e6f08ff445753457cc4b9079e4e6ec92d0ee23.zh: 横轴更改了常见的合格费用，而费率、未使用的最高金额和单独不合格的金额仍保持选中状态。因此，即使共同合格费用为零，不合格金额仍保留在家庭份额中。这些是不同的假设索赔规模，而不是累积索赔，余额随时间或概率的变化。

26d5815479e2233bb911095b150f5c8bba5be5e8.src: Original hypothetical one-period cost comparison, using identical opening debt and cash. The full-offset example keeps cash in a separate linked account, pays no interest on any linked cash, and charges loan interest on max(gross principal − linked cash, 0). Cash above the loan amount cannot produce negative loan interest. The alternative keeps the full loan interest base and earns the entered gross savings interest on the same cash. Loan quotes may differ. All rates are independently entered annual SIMPLE assumptions on actual days / fixed 365, held unchanged; no market quote, APR or actual mortgage compounding convention is reproduced. Loan principal and cash balances remain constant throughout the selected period. No installment, principal repayment, interest capitalization, savings compounding, transaction date, bank balance, tax, interest deduction or payoff horizon is calculated. The entered extra offset fee applies ONCE to the whole selected period and is not automatically prorated when days change. Cost advantage equals alternative loan interest minus separate savings interest, minus offset loan interest and extra fee; positive means lower modeled net financing cost with offset. It is not a cash receipt or portfolio return. Avoided interest at the offset quote alone is not this complete comparison. The source describes an Australian product concept; the hypothetical CAD labels establish no Canadian product availability, tax treatment or local legal rule. Actual access, linkage, full/partial offset and pricing require the product terms.
26d5815479e2233bb911095b150f5c8bba5be5e8.zh: 原始假设的单期成本比较，使用相同的期初债务和现金。全抵消示例将现金保存在单独的关联账户中，对任何关联现金不支付利息，并按 max(总本金 - 关联现金, 0) 收取贷款利息。高于贷款金额的现金不能产生负贷款利息。另一种选择保留全部贷款利息基础，并以相同的现金赚取输入的总储蓄利息。贷款报价可能有所不同。所有费率均按实际天数独立输入年度简单假设/固定 365，保持不变；没有复制市场报价、年利率或实际抵押贷款复利惯例。贷款本金和现金余额在整个选定期间保持不变。不计算分期付款、本金偿还、利息资本化、储蓄复利、交易日期、银行余额、税收、利息扣除或还款期限。输入的额外抵消费用一次性应用于整个选定期间，并且不会在日期变化时自动按比例分配。成本优势等于替代贷款利息减去单独储蓄利息，减去抵消贷款利息和额外费用；正数意味着模型净融资成本较低且具有抵消作用。它不是现金收入或投资组合回报。仅通过抵消报价避免利息并不是完整的比较。消息来源描述了澳大利亚的产品概念；假设的 CAD 标签没有规定加拿大产品的可用性、税收待遇或当地法律规则。实际访问、链接、全额/部分抵消和定价需要产品条款。

27b6c944e47ce04250fd0ca801760287c015ffe1.src: The 38 matched entries contain only 10, 4, 3 greedily selected disjoint holding windows for one, three and five years. For the full three-year fit, residual RMSE is 20.42 percentage points; an approximate calendar-time HAC slope interval is -21.94 to -11.13 percentage points per P/E turn. The Bartlett bandwidth is three calendar years with an n/(n −2) correction. These approximate intervals do not solve source breaks, overlap, missing cycles or forecast selection. No calibrated return interval or crash probability is supplied.
27b6c944e47ce04250fd0ca801760287c015ffe1.zh: 38 个匹配条目仅包含10, 4, 3 贪婪地选择一年、三年和五年的不相交保持窗口。对于完整的三年拟合，剩余 RMSE 为 20.42 个百分点；日历时间 HAC 斜率区间大致为每 P/E 周-21.94 至 -11.13 个百分点。 Bartlett 带宽为三个日历年，修正为 n/(n −2)。这些近似间隔不能解决源中断、重叠、缺失周期或预测选择的问题。未提供校准的回报间隔或崩溃概率。

283fe25ac18d61d3111a34b2fea21f018b24e841.src: The first two charts are fixed 2023 Canadian household survey observations from the release dated 21 May 2025, reviewed 25 October 2026. Shares use total current consumption, not income; the amounts are nominal annual CAD including sales taxes. Canada-level estimates cover the provinces only. These release figures are not presented as the latest revised table, a median or a recommended budget. The separate editable exercise uses selected monthly CAD cash spending and household take-home cash, with no claim of exact reconciliation to survey classifications. Each expense is entered once. Unentered debt repayments, saving, taxes not already withheld and irregular bills still need funding. A negative remainder is a cash gap, not assumed credit. Zero denominators are shown as unavailable shares rather than invented percentages.
283fe25ac18d61d3111a34b2fea21f018b24e841.zh: 前两张图表是固定的 2023 年加拿大家庭调查观察结果，发布日期为 2025 年 5 月 21 日，审查日期为 2026 年 10 月 25 日。股票使用当前总消费，而不是收入；这些金额为名义年加元，包括销售税。加拿大层面的估计仅涵盖各省。这些发布数据并非以最新修订表、中值或建议预算的形式呈现。单独的可编辑练习使用选定的每月加元现金支出和家庭带回家的现金，没有声称与调查分类完全一致。每项费用输入一次。未输入的债务偿还、储蓄、尚未预扣的税款和不规则账单仍然需要资金。负余额是现金缺口，而不是假定的信用。零分母显示为不可用份额，而不是发明的百分比。

27d97cfd74f4a6b79cde959476af6e9feeafdef3.src: The real series divides the entire budget by cumulative general inflation. These are chosen paths, not observed retiree-spending statistics.
27d97cfd74f4a6b79cde959476af6e9feeafdef3.zh: 真实序列将整个预算除以累积的一般通货膨胀。护理价格可能会以不同的方式上涨，因此缩减后的金额不必等于原始护理投入。简单的初始预算比较既没有酌情改变，也没有增加护理费用。这些是选择的路径，而不是观察到的退休人员支出统计数据。

27da1cea3ab3056ab5f676429acf4de007f023e1.src: The endpoint is opening cash plus receipts less payments. It does not establish that the schedule was fundable at every earlier date. A refund after month 6 is excluded from this endpoint rather than treated as permanently lost.
