2637969d8dab9759e26ea36ee9eee8e49f10290b.src: Fixed public snapshot released 29 April 2026, reviewed 25 October 2026. Canada; Total - Gender; Employment income. The year control selects observed 2022–2024 cross-sections and never forecasts. All income amounts are annual 2024 constant CAD, with zero incomes excluded from the published means and medians. Income is not take-home pay or a full-time-worker salary quote. Counts and conditional income measures have different denominators. Quality letters are retained from the source: A Excellent, B Very good, C Good, D Acceptable. They are not confidence intervals, and no comparison is declared statistically significant. Different age bands contain different people; no individual career path, causal age effect or future pay increase is estimated.
2637969d8dab9759e26ea36ee9eee8e49f10290b.zh: 2026 年 4 月 29 日发布的固定公开快照，2026 年 10 月 25 日审核。加拿大；总计 - 性别；就业收入。年份控制选择观察到的 2022-2024 年横截面，而不是预测。所有收入金额均按 2024 年不变加元计算，公布的均值和中位数不包括零收入。收入不是实得工资或全职工人的工资报价。计数和有条件收入衡量标准具有不同的分母。保留来自来源的质量字母：A 优秀、B 非常好、C 良好、D 可接受。它们不是置信区间，并且没有声明任何比较具有统计显着性。不同年龄段包含不同的人；没有估计个人职业道路、因果年龄效应或未来加薪。

263a9a2d935e09f42bfbf02f82575cf3a4a64409.src: The waterfall reconciles that signed difference. It adds staged interest and fees, subtracts the immediate schedule’s interest and fee, then adds back the income already deducted from the immediate cost. This last sign matters: ignoring the income would exaggerate the staged schedule’s advantage. No extra principal deduction belongs in the comparison because the same CAD 60,000 debt remains in both alternatives.
263a9a2d935e09f42bfbf02f82575cf3a4a64409.zh: 瀑布可以调节签名差异。它添加阶段性利息和费用，减去即时计划的利息和费用，然后加回已从即时成本中扣除的收入。最后一个迹象很重要：忽略收入会夸大分阶段时间表的优势。比较中不存在额外的本金扣除，因为两种方案中都存在相同的 60,000 加元债务。

29068e4a624d7cd45124ce7ab5c2b9caf3bd3c0e.src: The Moneris agreement adds a separate capital event: BMO expects an approximately C$600 million after-tax gain and roughly 15 basis points of CET1 benefit on closing, anticipated by the end of Q1 FY2027. We exclude that gain from recurring earning power. Sale proceeds, accounting gains and free capital are different quantities. Our preferred distribution policy retains capacity for credible lending opportunities and adverse credit outcomes, then repurchases shares when their prospective return is attractive. Maximizing the near-term EPS lift would be a weaker objective than improving long-term value per share.

294652a2ced35c744fceffe9b72c277b346f9c22.src: All three formulas in these charts deliberately use a 365-day year. Their labels define the conventions used here. The calculator does not assert that a particular market, dealer or instrument quotes yield this way. Confirm an actual quote’s price basis, day-count convention, settlement date and yield definition before comparing it with another product.

294d86f3a0f3684e451c2d56893ad4f73fd46be2.src: The account finishes at CAD 22,500. Of the CAD 12,500 increase from its opening balance, CAD 10,000 is new money. The remaining CAD 2,500 is investment gain. The waterfall makes those components explicit. Dividing the entire balance increase by the opening investment would label an external deposit as profit and produce a misleading percentage.
294d86f3a0f3684e451c2d56893ad4f73fd46be2.zh: 账户最终价格为 22,500 加元。较期初余额增加 12,500 加元，其中 10,000 加元为新资金。剩下的 2,500 加元是投资收益。瀑布使这些组件变得明确。将全部余额增量除以期初投资会将外部存款标记为利润，并产生误导性的百分比。

2951c3d3bc50136b26d35917a8926b8ec394270f.zh: 五个图表中的信贷利用率：卡、总额和快照日期 | TickerLantern

2954ec4741a8ffdad874fa5eb995a914e2ed8692.zh: 企业主可以在客户付款之前记录有利可图的销售。即使企业已经使用现金购买股票，并且仍然需要资金来支付运营费用，家庭也可能将利润视为可用收入。

295b8060bfa2257dda62751bb7c97ae3e38e1c64.zh: 将期限条视为团体平均值，而不是路线实验

295e52e72f057cb16a5ddbc1af2baf8d9f519b35.src: The central question is whether incremental earnings come from deeper relationships and a better operating model, or from favourable credit comparisons, buoyant markets and fewer shares. These sources can coexist, but they deserve different multiples. Customer relationships and repeatable service efficiency support a durable premium. Market activity and provision normalization can lift earnings quickly while offering less protection when conditions reverse.
295e52e72f057cb16a5ddbc1af2baf8d9f519b35.zh: 核心问题是增量收入是来自更深层次的关系和更好的运营模式，还是来自有利的信用比较、活跃的市场和较少的股票。这些来源可以共存，但它们应该有不同的倍数。客户关系和可重复的服务效率支持持久的溢价。市场活动和拨备正常化可以快速提升收益，但在情况逆转时提供的保护较少。

29612743136042ca5d5a3d2e084cef6a8b65fdca.src: The curve uses balances from CAD 1,000 to CAD 50,000 and keeps all tier rates fixed. The balance field does not move this fixed-range comparison; it selects the other figures and metrics. Each additional dollar above CAD 10,000 earns the top rate, but earlier dollars continue earning lower rates. The whole-balance average therefore remains below the top rate at every finite balance in this schedule.
29612743136042ca5d5a3d2e084cef6a8b65fdca.zh: 该曲线使用 1,000 加元到 50,000 加元的余额，并保持所有等级费率固定。余额字段不会移动这个固定范围的比较；它选择其他数字和指标。每增加 10,000 加元以上的美元即可赚取最高利率，但较早的美元继续赚取较低的利率。因此，本表中每个有限余额的整体余额平均值仍低于最高利率。

29625565c4b7cd2f2dc3efb534847bf1c8be4a37.src: If all coupon cash is spent and no reserve is built, the modeled capital retained at maturity is the CAD 10,000 face repayment. A fully funded default reserve adds CAD 1,000, producing CAD 11,000 before the excluded bond tax and costs.
29625565c4b7cd2f2dc3efb534847bf1c8be4a37.zh: 如果所有息票现金均已用完且未建立准备金，则到期时保留的模型资本为 10,000 加元面还款。全额融资的违约准备金会增加 1,000 加元，在扣除债券税和成本之前产生 11,000 加元。

2963316c9e884af97d600ba937f97ab15c35f907.src: Technology investment should be judged through service, unit costs and loss control over time. Announced AI initiatives may improve productivity, but the forecast assigns no separate earnings premium to a technology label. A credible efficiency case needs expense discipline after implementation and maintenance costs, together with evidence that customer outcomes and controls remain sound.
2963316c9e884af97d600ba937f97ab15c35f907.zh: 技术投资应通过服务、单位成本和随时间的损失控制来判断。已公布的人工智能计划可能会提高生产力，但预测并未为技术标签分配单独的收益溢价。可信的效率案例需要在实施和维护成本之后进行支出纪律，并提供客户成果和控制仍然健全的证据。

288a980588efcde258a26e913730fb262bf7c9e8.src: Earlier receipts remain in cash without interest. Later claims are not sold early, pledged for a loan or treated as available cash before their dates. Reinvestment returns, tax, call provisions and settlement delays are excluded.
288a980588efcde258a26e913730fb262bf7c9e8.zh: 早期收据仍为现金，无利息。较晚的索赔不会提前出售、抵押贷款或在日期之前被视为可用现金。再投资回报、税收、赎回条款和结算延迟不包括在内。

288cf919203f640eaab17885fb1569dea00d923d.src: Use an up-to-date personal estimate and verify the applicable rules before implementing a start date. Keep the entitlement estimate, age adjustment, payment timing and bridge funding as distinct inputs. The four charts make one part of that decision visible while leaving room for the circumstances that a receipt-only model cannot resolve.
288cf919203f640eaab17885fb1569dea00d923d.zh: 在实施开始日期之前，使用最新的个人估算并验证适用的规则。将权利估算、年龄调整、付款时间和过桥资金保留为不同的输入。这四张图表使该决定的一部分变得可见，同时为仅收据模式无法解决的情况留出了空间。

288d4592ea99edbd78dca2c07ef6035e5b43550c.src: The Government of Canada’s parental-benefit overview lists basic replacement rates of 55% for standard and 33% for extended benefits, subject to weekly caps and eligibility. One parent can receive up to thirty-five standard or sixty-one extended parental-benefit weeks; shared-family maxima differ.
288d4592ea99edbd78dca2c07ef6035e5b43550c.zh: 加拿大政府的父母福利概述列出了标准福利的基本替代率 55% 和扩展福利的基本替代率 33%，但有每周上限和资格。一位家长最多可获得三十五周的标准或六十一周的延长育儿福利周；共享家庭最大值不同。

28942354b632203c69ffef3f8ed24266606655a8.src: A recipient charge changes the foreign-currency amount that must be purchased. For example, a 20 FCU deduction means funding 1,020 FCU to leave 1,000 FCU net. The model applies the service’s rate to the full 1,020 FCU. At a zero net target, it assumes no transfer at all and charges nothing, so the flat-fee curve has a separate zero-transfer boundary.
28942354b632203c69ffef3f8ed24266606655a8.zh: 收款人费用会改变必须购买的外币金额。例如，扣除 20 FCU 意味着资助 1,020 FCU，留下 1,000 FCU 净额。该模型将服务费率应用于全部 1,020 个 FCU。在净值为零的目标下，它假设根本不进行转账且不收取任何费用，因此固定费用曲线具有单独的零转账边界。

289d3d48ed0ce04e15f974cc02e35c5ce2dd178c.src: Both bars use the same original units and entered price. Their totals therefore match, while the vesting classification can differ. A notional value on an award screen is not a deposit balance. No part of the unvested segment is treated as money already available, and the vested segment is not converted into after-tax cash.
289d3d48ed0ce04e15f974cc02e35c5ce2dd178c.zh: 两个柱使用相同的原始单位和输入的价格。因此，它们的总数是匹配的，而归属分类可能不同。奖励屏幕上的名义价值不是存款余额。未归属部分的任何部分均不被视为已可用资金，归属部分不会转换为税后现金。

28b788cec499a9a85653ea5aba1bda6f6a0d3806.zh: 正 NPV 表示按选定利率进行折扣后预计收益超过建模成本；消极意味着他们不这样做。结果取决于该比率、节省实现和运营期限。它不包括任何尚未在预付报价中结算的销售溢价、设备故障或经济奖励。

28b9335cdaf331b393523b01586b318164426a28.src: The line chart starts with an annual after-tax gap and increases it each year at the selected escalation rate. 28e0bf4dc06b3d83e4824a975e80f498e4f75e96.src: A later bill shortens the borrowing interval but also leaves more principal earning the cashable rate before withdrawal. The calculation includes both effects. Changing the bill’s percentage changes how much principal leaves the cashable deposit and how much the bridge must advance.
28e0bf4dc06b3d83e4824a975e80f498e4f75e96.zh: 较晚的账单缩短了借款间隔，但也留下了更多本金在提款前赚取可兑现利率。计算包括这两种效应。更改帐单的百分比会改变可兑现存款的本金金额以及桥必须预付的金额。

28e615393fbdcff72495fcac6d34fa339e45ff2b.src: Change the accepted damage to CAD 5,000 while leaving the CAD 12,000 threshold unchanged. In this formula, the household bears CAD 5,000 and the insurer portion is zero. The calculation does not make the household pay CAD 12,000 on top of that repair.

27e90beba178a94f1626e3d093589543a2d6760b.src: For all households, the reported shares are 21.5% in 2018, 19.5% in 2021, 22.0% in 2022 and 23.2% in 2024. These are separate survey-cycle observations. 28164eaaa7796eb35350fb19ed660bbb2945a97c.src: The related reimbursement guide examines that timing issue. The related fixed-deductible guide considers premium and reserve trade-offs, while the rebuilding guide addresses coverage limits. Those are distinct from identifying the base of this percentage.
28164eaaa7796eb35350fb19ed660bbb2945a97c.zh: 相关报销指南研究了该时间问题。相关的固定免赔额指南考虑了保费和准备金的权衡，而重建指南则解决了承保范围限制。这些与确定该百分比的基数不同。

2817e673ab1f60db000665b5711e27b6c8dabeed.src: Interest credited earlier becomes part of the next month’s opening balance in the calculation. It can therefore use some of the eligible cap. Setting the cap to zero removes the promotional tier entirely. If a selected promotional rate is below the base rate, the model applies that lower rate to the eligible tier rather than silently substituting a better rate.
2817e673ab1f60db000665b5711e27b6c8dabeed.zh: 提前记入的利息将成为计算中下个月期初余额的一部分。因此，它可以使用一些符合条件的上限。将上限设置为零会完全删除促销级别。如果选定的促销费率低于基本费率，该模型会将较低的费率应用于符合条件的级别，而不是默默地替换为更好的费率。

2a1417c24b0aa34dffa4f03d3037bdf3be9df3fc.src: For each day, next account capital = current account capital × (1 + multiple × that day’s simple benchmark return). This rule applies the daily objective exactly before all excluded costs. It does not multiply the benchmark’s complete-window return after the fact. Neither line is an ETF quotation, an actual net asset value series or an achievable return guarantee.

2a0e27eeb313ef21808385e95b8b557b2331e419.src: Settlement occurs on Day 8 · Mon and the assumed bank receipt on Day 10 · Wed. An entirely fictional calendar: Day 1 is Monday; weekends are closed, plus the entered number of consecutive fictional weekdays beginning Day 8. One shared open-day calendar is used for settlement and bank processing, although real calendars and cutoffs can differ. The executed sale is assumed completed on the selected first-week weekday; no order is placed or guaranteed. Positive business-day waits exclude their starting day; zero post-settlement wait means an explicitly assumed same-day bank receipt. Receipts are available before the bill within a day. The bill occurs on its entered day even on a closed day; no automatic due-date shift is modeled. Negative bank positions are unfunded scheduled payments, not an available overdraft. Net sale proceeds are an independent input; security prices, fees, taxes, account eligibility, holds and registered-account consequences are not calculated. Settlement alone does not promise withdrawal eligibility or bank availability. The modeled receipt date is within the displayed window.
2a0e27eeb313ef21808385e95b8b557b2331e419.zh: 结算发生在第 8 天·周一，假定的银行收据发生在第 10 天·周三。完全虚构的日历：第一天是星期一；周末关闭，加上从第 8 天开始输入的连续虚构工作日数。一个共享的开放日日历用于结算和银行处理，但实际日历和截止时间可能有所不同。假设已执行的销售在选定的第一周工作日完成；不下订单或不保证订单。积极的工作日等待不包括其开始日期；结算后零等待意味着明确假定当天银行收据。收据可在账单前一天内获得。即使在休息日，账单也会在输入的日期发生；没有对自动到期日转移进行建模。银行负头寸是指没有资金支持的预定付款，而不是可用的透支。净销售收入是一项独立投入；证券价格、费用、税收、账户资格、持有和注册账户后果不予计算。结算本身并不保证提款资格或银行可用性。建模的收货日期位于显示的窗口内。

2a6b0b9c0efe34cc76c8fa746e83cca3bb40ea97.src: Dated public extract from Statistics Canada’s Distributions of Household Economic Accounts release of 13 April 2026, reviewed 25 October 2026. The selector chooses Q4 2024 or Q4 2025; it does not project to a later date. Mean net worth is nominal assets less liabilities per household, not a median or available cash. The release combines the lowest two wealth quintiles into a bottom-40% group; the other three groups each represent 20%. For the share and cumulative charts, multiply each rounded published group mean by its population share, then divide by the sum of those weighted amounts. Normalising that weighted sum makes the four approximate derived shares add to 100%. The Q4 2025 weighted mean is CAD 1,078,641.80, versus the published CAD 1,078,642; the 20-cent difference is rounding. Source estimates involve data, models and assumptions and may be revised. No confidence bounds are supplied by this release table and none are invented. Within-group wealth distributions, individual households’ transitions, cash availability, inflation-adjusted changes and investment returns are not measured here.
2a6b0b9c0efe34cc76c8fa746e83cca3bb40ea97.zh: 摘自加拿大统计局 2026 年 4 月 13 日发布的家庭经济账户分布的公开摘录，并于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审核。选择者选择 2024 年第 4 季度或 2025 年第 4 季度；它不会预测到以后的日期。平均净资产是每个家庭的名义资产减去负债，而不是中位数或可用现金。该报告将财富最低的两个五分位数合并为后 40% 的群体；其他三组各占20%。对于份额和累积图表，将每个已发布组的四舍五入平均值乘以其人口份额，然后除以这些加权金额的总和。对该加权和进行标准化后，四个近似派生份额的总和将达到 100%。 2025 年第四季度加权平均值为 1,078,641.80 加元，而公布的为 1,078,642 加元； 20 美分的差异是四舍五入。来源估计涉及数据、模型和假设，并且可能会被修改。该发布表没有提供置信界限，也没有发明任何置信界限。这里没有衡量群体内的财富分配、个体家庭的转变、现金可用性、通货膨胀调整后的变化和投资回报。

29f8167fc60badedb7ce50632b6602ff6cb4d09f.src: A shorter intended ownership period can change the comparison. 2af6523c474a2def743d6f99145fd4acc2b5c0ef.src: If the real plan includes staged payments or savings already held in the foreign currency, one terminal conversion is an incomplete representation. Such a plan needs separate dated amounts and currency balances. This example isolates a single CAD-funded payment so the units remain easy to follow.

2af6750e0a2778c3e525552b0fa2ae00cdf6b99d.src: The federal component incurs no new modeled interest but its opening balance is repaid. Other debt adds interest under the hypothetical rate. Opening amounts may include earlier accrued amounts already owed; the chart does not erase those or calculate their contractual payment priority.

2afc4790f826345054ab31e371a73020eb44f34e.src: Saving more can increase that dollar amount because more capital is present. This does not make saving less a stronger plan. A smaller portfolio may show a smaller modeled loss while providing fewer resources for the goal. Likewise, reducing the equity share changes exposure but does not itself determine an achievable return or sufficient retirement income.
2afc4790f826345054ab31e371a73020eb44f34e.zh: 储蓄更多可以增加美元金额，因为存在更多资本。这并不意味着减少储蓄成为一个更强有力的计划。较小的投资组合可能会显示较小的模型损失，同时为目标提供的资源较少。同样，减少股权份额会改变风险敞口，但其本身并不决定可实现的回报或足够的退休收入。

2afd09ee697763bd1e88f40833eee28ec83ad97d.src: The default net cash budget subtracts CAD 2,000 of shelter, CAD 2,000 of other living costs, CAD 300 of other required debt payments and CAD 500 assigned to saving. That leaves CAD 200 per month not yet assigned. The waterfall makes each subtraction visible instead of treating everything beyond shelter as discretionary money.
2afd09ee697763bd1e88f40833eee28ec83ad97d.zh: 默认净现金预算减去 2,000 加元的住房费用、2,000 加元的其他生活费用、300 加元的其他所需债务支付以及分配给储蓄的 500 加元。每月还有 200 加元尚未分配。瀑布使每次减法都可见，而不是将庇护所之外的所有东西都视为可自由支配的钱。

2bc0fee1a204cd268c26ce43fec6219ab688a9ba.src: Endpoints use the published expectation plus or minus its published margin, rounded to the source’s two decimal places. The short whiskers can be visually small on a zero-based years axis; exact bounds remain in the labels and table. They do not say that 95% of individuals die inside this narrow range, or establish a statistically tested difference between sex categories. All values refer to preliminary 2022–2024 period mortality.
2bc0fee1a204cd268c26ce43fec6219ab688a9ba.zh: 端点使用已发布的期望加上或减去其已发布的边距，四舍五入到源的两位小数。在从零开始的年份轴上，短胡须在视觉上可能很小；确切的界限保留在标签和表格中。他们并没有说 95% 的人会在这个狭窄的范围内死亡，也没有建立经过统计检验的性别类别之间的差异。所有值均指 2022-2024 年期间的初步死亡率。

2c43ba2b5a3c0280413ee6bf09474e5f36badb11.src: Single-year ordinary RRIF illustration using the All other RRIFs factors reviewed 25 October 2026. RRIF exists before the year begins; annuitant’s whole age at year-start is used, with no spouse-age election, legacy qualifying/pre-1986 treatment or locked-in annuity contract. Minimum = start-of-year fair market value × prescribed factor. Modeled gross withdrawal is the larger of that minimum and the request, capped at the entered balance; no in-year asset-value change is modeled. The selected percentage is only a budget allowance, not prescribed withholding or final tax. No actual tax, benefit interaction, pension splitting, locked-in plan limits or lifetime sustainability is calculated. Negative remaining cash means assigned spending needs another source.
2c43ba2b5a3c0280413ee6bf09474e5f36badb11.zh: 使用 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查的所有其他 RRIF 因素的单年普通 RRIF 说明。RRIF 在年初之前已存在；使用年金受益人年初的整个年龄，没有配偶年龄选择、遗产资格/1986 年之前的待遇或锁定年金合同。最小值=年初公平市场价值×规定系数。模拟的总提款额是该最小值和请求中的较大者，上限为输入的余额；没有对年内资产价值变化进行建模。选定的百分比只是预算津贴，而不是规定的预扣税或最终税。不计算实际税收、福利互动、养老金分割、锁定计划限额或终身可持续性。剩余现金为负数意味着分配的支出需要其他来源。

2d22248b5a32c740a5ac03eca888ebf3dd6302c2.src: Original hypothetical comparison of tax-saving cash from the same already-funded, eligible RRSP contribution and deduction amount. The RRSP contribution, investment path and future withdrawal treatment are held identical and excluded from the charts. No second contribution is assumed. Time 0 is when the current tax saving is available; the later saving becomes available after the selected full years. These are cash-availability dates, not a tax-year filing or assessment calendar. Rates are assumed average incremental income-tax reductions over the entire deduction, not published brackets or a personal tax calculation. A saving may reduce tax owing rather than produce a refund cheque. All of the current saving is retained and compounds outside the RRSP at the constant selected return after assumed tax and costs; the later saving is received only at the comparison endpoint. No benefit interaction, deduction-room test, excess-contribution review, borrowing, refund processing time or future tax-law prediction is calculated. Carrying a deduction forward does not create new contribution room.
2d22248b5a32c740a5ac03eca888ebf3dd6302c2.zh: 来自相同已资助、合格的 RRSP 供款和扣除金额的节税现金的原始假设比较。 RRSP 供款、投资路径和未来提款待遇保持相同，并被排除在图表之外。不假设有第二个贡献。时间0是当前可以节税的时间；稍后的节省将在选定的整年之后可用。这些是现金可用日期，而不是纳税年度申报或评估日历。税率假定为整个扣除额的平均增量所得税减免，而不是公布的等级或个人税计算。储蓄可以减少所欠税款，而不是产生退款支票。所有当前储蓄均被保留，并在 RRSP 之外以假定的税收和成本后的恒定选定回报率进行复利；稍后的保存仅在比较端点处接收。不计算利益互动、扣除室测试、超额供款审核、借款、退款处理时间或未来税法预测。结转扣除不会创造新的供款空间。

The future bill is about CAD 60,832.65, savings about CAD 43,883.22, and the gap about CAD 16,949.42.

2d9a0c48933dde8b4a6ea764ce1569f189648975.src: Original hypothetical closeout ledger reviewed against CRA public guidance on 25 October 2026. Assume the RESP contract and promoter permit a valid AIP to one original subscriber who meets all current CRA payment conditions; the subscriber is resident in Canada. The specific beneficiary, age and plan-history eligibility checks have already been confirmed outside this model. Subscriber contributions and government/provincial benefits shown have been confirmed payable/refundable or repayable by the promoter. Only contribution refund, benefit repayment and eligible AIP balances enter the snapshot. The modeled subscriber qualifies for the AIP-related lifetime tax reduction; its remaining CAD 50,000 lifetime limit, actual available tax-year deduction capacity and AIP amount each cap the comparison. The entered regular rate is an illustrative flat incremental assumption, not an actual tax bracket, return, advice or prediction. Additional tax is 20% outside Quebec; Quebec’s 12% rate is excluded. All scenario amounts and individual tax components are rounded to cents. The result compares no qualifying deduction with the maximum amount supported by the inputs; it does not verify eligibility, RRSP room, contribution timing, promoter terms, withholding, final tax or future RRSP withdrawal tax. No cash-payment date, benefit eligibility, inflation, investment return, fees or school/EAP scenario is modeled. The first AIP requires RESP termination by the end of February in the following year. This model neither schedules that deadline nor calculates other termination or provincial rules.
2d9a0c48933dde8b4a6ea764ce1569f189648975.zh: 根据 CRA 公共指导于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审核的原始假设结算账本。假设 RESP 合约和发起人允许向满足所有当前 CRA 付款条件的一名原始订阅者提供有效的 AIP；订户居住在加拿大。具体受益人、年龄和计划历史资格检查已在此模型之外得到确认。显示的认购者捐款和政府/省福利已确认由发起人支付/退还或偿还。仅缴款退款、福利偿还和符合条件的 AIP 余额进入快照。建模订户有资格享受与 AIP 相关的终身减税；其剩余的 50,000 加元终身限额、实际可用的纳税年度扣除能力和 AIP 金额均限制了比较。输入的常规税率是说明性的固定增量假设，而不是实际的税级、回报、建议或预测。魁北克省以外地区的附加税为 20%；魁北克省 12% 的税率不包括在内。所有情景金额和个别税收成分均四舍五入为美分。结果将无资格扣除与输入支持的最大金额进行比较；它不验证资格、RRSP空间、供款时间、发起人条款、预扣税、最终税或未来RRSP提款税。没有对现金支付日期、福利资格、通货膨胀、投资回报、费用或学校/EAP 场景进行建模。第一个 AIP 要求在次年 2 月底之前终止 RESP。该模型既不安排截止日期，也不计算其他终止或省级规则。

2ddae52fcabc1f7766f936f85f4df879077aef03.src: The appropriate scorecard combines organic common-income growth, share count, book value per share and CET1. Management deserves credit when all four evolve consistently with better returns. A shrinking share count accompanied by weak underlying growth or pressure on capital would be less persuasive. Capital returned to shareholders is useful evidence of financial capacity; it should not substitute for evidence that the reshaped franchise can compound value.
2ddae52fcabc1f7766f936f85f4df879077aef03.zh: 适当的记分卡结合了有机共同收入增长、股票数量、每股账面价值和 CET1。当这四个方面持续发展并带来更好的回报时，管理层就值得赞扬。股票数量的减少伴随着潜在增长疲弱或资本压力将缺乏说服力。返还给股东的资本是财务能力的有用证据；它不应取代重塑特许经营权可以复合价值的证据。

2dde2823943c5f48feed2213afadb5b9723a5332.src: Capital return is more measurable. Compare completed repurchases with the authorized program, average prices paid, diluted shares and the CET1 bridge. A reduction in surplus capital should be explained by distributions or productive deployment. Persistent excess capital with weak reinvestment returns would weaken the efficiency thesis; aggressive payouts accompanied by deteriorating credit or operating controls would weaken its resilience.
2dde2823943c5f48feed2213afadb5b9723a5332.zh: 资本回报更容易衡量。将已完成的回购与授权计划、支付的平均价格、稀释股份和 CET1 桥进行比较。剩余资本的减少应通过分配或生产性部署来解释。持续的过剩资本和疲软的再投资回报将削弱效率论点；激进的支出加上信用或运营控制恶化会削弱其弹性。

2df109bb7a0c16167cf20715f8b3680a62494c3a.src: With no unused-time refund, the annual plan remains CAD 300 even if use stops early. Monthly cost is CAD 30 multiplied by the number of consecutive months used. Ten months therefore produces a tie at CAD 300. At eleven or twelve months, the annual plan is cheaper under these assumptions.
2df109bb7a0c16167cf20715f8b3680a62494c3a.zh: 由于没有未使用时间退款，即使提前停止使用，年度计划仍为 300 加元。每月费用为 30 加元乘以连续使用月数。因此，十个月的价格为 300 加元。在十一个月或十二个月时，在这些假设下，年度计划会更便宜。

2df16362e524fd14776fe9c58ee0cbcbb72aaafc.src: The default uses one hypothetical holding worth CAD 100,000 with a total adjusted cost base of CAD 60,000. The spending goal is CAD 20,000 after a flat CAD 100 selling cost and a separate tax earmark. Fractional units are allowed, so the model can solve a continuous sale amount rather than rounding to a whole number of units.
2df16362e524fd14776fe9c58ee0cbcbb72aaafc.zh: 默认情况下使用一笔价值 100,000 加元的假设持有，调整后的总成本基础为 60,000 加元。在 100 加元的固定销售成本和单独的税收专项拨款之后，支出目标是 20,000 加元。允许使用小数单位，因此该模型可以求解连续销售金额，而不是四舍五入到整数单位。

2df18da7d35965902c7854398379678152e53c8c.src: Review the actual maturity instructions and the wider plan
2df18da7d35965902c7854398379678152e53c8c.zh: 查看实际到期说明和更广泛的计划

2df24227934c7d6b1e125b3b34824c8c9adba9eb.src: One project can have two internal rates of return: keep the later payment in the picture
2df24227934c7d6b1e125b3b34824c8c9adba9eb.zh: 一个项目可以有两种内部收益率：将稍后付款保留在图中

2df42e80b1db6c1f48f95a75ab1cb5bc07562583.zh: 测试稍后付款到达时会发生什么变化

2dfe633cccf8577ab272c4117f1c01aed51498ff.src: In the first quarter, the original 20 shares generate CAD 50 of cash. The modeled post-distribution price is about CAD 250.5681. The whole-share rule cannot buy a share, so it retains 20 shares worth about CAD 5,011.36 and CAD 50 in cash.
2dfe633cccf8577ab272c4117f1c01aed51498ff.zh: 在第一季度，最初的 20 股可产生 50 加元的现金。模拟的分销后价格约为 250.5681 加元。整体股份规则无法购买一股，因此它保留了价值约 5,011.36 加元的 20 股和 50 加元的现金。

2dfe9f1aa228b1cae898c95329d16f448d07666b.src: Build a one-year rental cash ledger, then test how missing rent and a capital project change the amount retained or supplied by the owner.
2dfe9f1aa228b1cae898c95329d16f448d07666b.zh: 建立一年期租金现金分类账，然后测试缺失的租金和资本项目如何改变所有者保留或提供的金额。

2e15dbfbcb16b8d93eb792869d221d3c04864ce7.src: A spousal or common-law partner RRSP involves two roles. The contributor makes deposits for the other person’s plan, while the annuitant is the person entitled to receive the plan amounts. A useful withdrawal review keeps those roles and the relevant records clear before discussing a tax result.
2e15dbfbcb16b8d93eb792869d221d3c04864ce7.zh: 配偶或同居伴侣 RRSP 涉及两个角色。供款人为他人的计划存入存款，而年金受益人是有权获得计划金额的人。在讨论税务结果之前，有用的提款审查可以使这些角色和相关记录保持清晰。

2e161e212fd218729d1a7d09e4f7f0f2de3ab9ea.src: The upfront payment and recurring dues create a different cash path

2e1730d7b880db0c0900bfb1245130b7642e074e.src: The sensitivity range also allows a negative second-year return. Such a scenario reduces the value of the amount carried into that year. It is an independently selected stress, rather than a statement about a protected deposit or any actual provider’s terms.
2e1730d7b880db0c0900bfb1245130b7642e074e.zh: 敏感度范围还允许第二年出现负回报。这种情况会减少当年结转金额的价值。这是一个独立选择的压力，而不是有关受保护存款或任何实际提供商条款的声明。

2e1795e164a5949aaeae75bcf19306f7a84400ae.src: A disability prevalence statistic is not your future income-loss probability | TickerLantern
2e1795e164a5949aaeae75bcf19306f7a84400ae.zh: 残疾患病率统计数据并不是您未来收入损失的概率 | TickerLantern

2e2056d485a6f800fce7a51b83e9e440c0662910.src: The assumed support schedule is an independent net cash input. It is not an EI calculation, a promise of approval or a statutory payment window. Delaying its start moves the entire modeled payment window; it does not create an arrears cheque. If new earnings begin sooner, the example stops support at that point. Real arrangements may behave differently and need a separately confirmed schedule.
2e2056d485a6f800fce7a51b83e9e440c0662910.zh: 假定的支持计划是独立的净现金投入。它不是 EI 计算、批准承诺或法定付款窗口。延迟启动会移动整个建模的支付窗口；它不会创建拖欠支票。如果新的收益开始得更早，该示例将在此时停止支持。实际安排可能会有所不同，需要单独确认时间表。

That is useful consistency context; its public-sector social discount rates are not adopted as household rates in this guide.
2e2968e4617670a139619aa6248ea07e70f301f1.zh: 英国财政部的绿皮书将贴现与通货膨胀调整区分开来，并要求其实际评估率与实际价值配对。这是有用的一致性上下文；本指南不采用其公共部门社会折扣率作为家庭费率。

2e2fe4cab348ac17eaf1214b52b6e13d3cfc5be3.src: An 80% reimbursement is not an unlimited benefit: chart the annual cap and the cash needed first
2e2fe4cab348ac17eaf1214b52b6e13d3cfc5be3.zh: 80% 报销并非无限福利：图表首先是年度上限和所需现金

2e2fe76afa9f2df6d6a0266e69fdae9f85f66340.src: The target line is flat because it shows the bill already projected to the deadline, translated at the selected terminal rate. It is not a claim that the bill costs that amount at every earlier date. All savings remain in CAD until one conversion at the end.
2e2fe76afa9f2df6d6a0266e69fdae9f85f66340.zh: 目标线是平坦的，因为它显示账单已预计到截止日期，并按选定的最终汇率换算。这并不是说账单在每个较早日期的费用都是如此。所有节省的金额均保留为加元，直到最后一次转换为止。

2e31ad73708bc0d65b465194e770bbe774e5c750.src: Only starting gross earnings are replaced. The selected raise, tax rate, maximum benefit, phase-out rate and fixed threshold stay unchanged. Each row compares its own before/after resources. A larger gain from a different starting income does not establish a higher benefit or compare overall living standards.
2e31ad73708bc0d65b465194e770bbe774e5c750.zh: 仅替换起始总收入。选定的提高幅度、税率、最高福利、逐步淘​​汰率和固定起征点保持不变。每行都会比较自己的前后资源。不同起始收入带来的较大收益并不意味着更高的福利或比较整体生活水平。

2e36a4e8d9650cb60d501bceae302eb97b235012.zh: 标记为2026年4月9日修改的页面； 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查了在寻找工作或临时解雇期间连续几周不工作的定义。用作衡量定义，而不是未来持续时间模型。

2e3fa6066e1b9a01883967f8f611ab38bfc33c6a.src: Live public HTML reviewed 25 October 2026 for questions on service, cost, compensation and the working relationship. Every fee is hypothetical. The modeled asset-linked charge is one separate assumed charge; it is not a calculation of a product’s MER or an all-in cost.
2e3fa6066e1b9a01883967f8f611ab38bfc33c6a.zh: 2026 年 10 月 25 日审核了实时公共 HTML，以了解有关服务、成本、报酬和工作关系的问题。每项费用都是假设的。建模的资产挂钩费用是一项单独的假定费用；它不是产品 MER 或总成本的计算。

2e77f3c58504799ec44e07ddca0644943db24b90.src: Let g be the change in NAV per unit, p-in the entry premium and p-out the exit premium, written as fractions. With no distribution and fixed units, the market-price growth factor is (1+g) × (1+p-out) ÷ (1+p-in).
2e77f3c58504799ec44e07ddca0644943db24b90.zh: 令 g 为每单位资产净值的变化，p-in 进入溢价和 p-out 退出溢价，写为分数。由于没有分配和固定单位，市场价格增长因子为(1+g) × (1+p-out) ÷ (1+p-in)。

2e7908f96da467640b6b9da0d622cfa7af4bd13c.src: The remaining charts use only the four invented assignments. They show individual job counts, the partition of people into job-count groups, a comparison of people and positions across one edit, and a matrix of shares under named denominators. Read every row label before reading a percentage, and read every bar label before adding two series together.
2e7908f96da467640b6b9da0d622cfa7af4bd13c.zh: 其余图表仅使用四个发明的分配。它们显示了个人的工作计数、将人员划分为工作计数组、一次编辑中人员和职位的比较，以及指定分母下的份额矩阵。在读取百分比之前先读取每一行标签，在将两个系列添加在一起之前读取每个条形标签。

2e7bfedbcdc69d4c58dc36828ec9e58bfbc73cbc.src: The waterfall starts with purchase cost, replaces it with the correctly aged sale or redemption value, then adds the first coupon once. It is a reconciliation of ending cash, not an assumption that purchase cost itself earns an additional payment. No reinvestment rate is required because the only received coupon arrives at the endpoint.
2e7bfedbcdc69d4c58dc36828ec9e58bfbc73cbc.zh: 瀑布从购买成本开始，用正确的时效销售或兑换价值替换它，然后添加第一张优惠券一次。这是期末现金的调节，而不是假设购买成本本身可以赚取额外的付款。不需要再投资率，因为唯一收到的优惠券到达端点。

2e7c5bd63828ca40744f63a6d5ddb2329e38228e.src: The budget tool has its own rent-quote input. It does not choose a city average for you. The default uses CAD 2,400 rent, CAD 150 utilities outside that rent, CAD 40 tenant insurance and CAD 200 transport for the location.
2e7c5bd63828ca40744f63a6d5ddb2329e38228e.zh: 预算工具有自己的租金报价输入。它不会为您选择城市平均值。默认使用 2,400 加元的租金、150 加元的租金外水电费、40 加元的租户保险和 200 加元的交通费。

2e7d8fe217cc088f397515b0c9f2531ae69ef867.src: The chart deliberately focuses its vertical scale on CAD 1,500 to CAD 1,530. This makes the modest within-year differences visible, so read the axis before judging the size of the movement. The absolute levels remain available in the data table.
2e7d8fe217cc088f397515b0c9f2531ae69ef867.zh: 该图表特意将其垂直刻度集中在 1,500 加元到 1,530 加元。这使得年内的微小差异显而易见，因此在判断变动幅度之前先阅读轴。数据表中仍保留绝对水平。

2e7db990de8f3607e4a83916e4b6d240a79c15a1.zh: 在评估服务价值之前比较累计名义支出

2e802ffcb2fa4caebc52fbb1e0a8759b54b7913e.zh: 建立财务缓冲：家庭支出和紧急储备

2e8157619589dfc311c727e65e02567db62be6b8.src: The first-year rate does not set the rate on later purchases · percent
2e8157619589dfc311c727e65e02567db62be6b8.zh: 第一年费率不会影响以后购买的费率 · 百分比

2e83f9c09653410eaf10e87b99caea6526a8ae29.zh: 核对所有者份额，无需计算免赔额两次

2e85b9b18ba60ac00dca721c5b3216fe68646ddf.src: The same in-kind resource appears on both sides of the accounts
2e85b9b18ba60ac00dca721c5b3216fe68646ddf.zh: 账户两侧显示相同的实物资源

2e870a579470ed3833c2b03a784076b3b54b5a5b.src: Positive amounts increase replacement’s cost relative to repair; negative amounts reduce it. The first step already includes today’s old-item sale proceeds and the avoided repair quote. The exit step subtracts replacement sale proceeds less repaired-item sale proceeds, discounted from the same final date. A negative endpoint means lower modeled present cost for replacement, not a guaranteed saving or a financing offer. The bridge adds exactly to the difference between the two headline present values.
2e870a579470ed3833c2b03a784076b3b54b5a5b.zh: 正数会增加相对于维修而言的更换成本；负数会减少它。第一步已经包括今天的旧物品销售收益和避免的维修报价。退出步骤减去更换销售收益减去修理品销售收益，从同一最终日期打折。负终点意味着较低的模型当前更换成本，而不是保证节省或融资。该桥恰好增加了两个标题现值之间的差异。

2e88461a006fe3d1b148d83e5dc58756fe0f1761.src: The model keeps negative scheduled cash visible as an accounting shortfall. It does not treat it as a permitted overdraft, silently skip a bill or reduce a food purchase. Without an additional resource or a change in commitments, all the scheduled outflows cannot be funded at that point.
2e88461a006fe3d1b148d83e5dc58756fe0f1761.zh: 该模型将负计划现金作为会计缺口显示出来。它不会将其视为允许的透支、默默地跳过账单或减少食品购买。如果没有额外资源或承诺发生变化，届时将无法为所有计划的资金流出提供资金。

2e89e1df4ba07aaee3183c5f033f0e6140ac1c93.src: This guide uses Statistics Canada’s release table 3 published on 13 April 2026. It contains average net worth per household for the fourth quarters of 2024 and 2025. The selector changes between those two dated snapshots; it does not estimate a current account balance or create a later observation.
2e89e1df4ba07aaee3183c5f033f0e6140ac1c93.zh: 本指南使用加拿大统计局于 2026 年 4 月 13 日发布的发布表 3。它包含2024 年和 2025 年第四季度每户平均净资产。选择器在这两个日期快照之间变化；它不会估计当前帐户余额或创建稍后的观察。

2e46e5790b77738ee7649e3977ac850398c9320d.src: The matrix combines no-rent months with alternative capital cash payments. It assigns no likelihood to either stress. A negative cell records money the owner would need to supply over the year; it does not authorize borrowing, identify an available credit line or show the maximum balance that could be needed between actual receipt and payment dates.
2e46e5790b77738ee7649e3977ac850398c9320d.zh: 该矩阵将无租金月份与替代资本现金支付结合起来。它没有给任何一个压力分配任何可能性。负数单元格记录业主一年内需要提供的资金；它不授权借款、确定可用信用额度或显示实际收款和付款日期之间可能需要的最大余额。

2e4c5440bf030ece6afe78e065cc99b413bb74b5.zh: 个人税前个人总收入111,000 美元

2e54730044fcfd3af298e988b7c79191374d912a.src: Both alternatives use the same fixed payment while debt remains. The transferred balance starts above original principal when a fee is financed. After payoff its line stays zero; freed payments are not assumed to be invested. Not repaid means not cleared within 120 months.
2e54730044fcfd3af298e988b7c79191374d912a.zh: 两种选择在债务期间使用相同的固定付款仍然存在。当费用融资时，转移的余额开始高于原始本金。支付后，其线保持为零；释放的付款不假定用于投资。未偿还意味着 120 个月内未清算。

2e5e6fbacd54f3664c26da7ae47c1ed8395b71c7.src: The inputs already assume that the promoter has established the benefit-repayment amount and the AIP that can be paid. A grant percentage cannot be applied to the total plan balance to infer a repayment. Contributions may previously have been withdrawn, beneficiaries and provincial benefits may affect the result, and the relevant records matter.
2e5e6fbacd54f3664c26da7ae47c1ed8395b71c7.zh: 输入内容已假设发起人已确定福利偿还金额和可支付的 AIP。补助金百分比不能应用于总计划余额来推断还款。供款可能之前已提取，受益人和省级福利可能会影响结果，相关记录很重要。

2e64dd28c95acb5d725ab9e6b060291bfeac1dd2.src: Basic Canadian price-based down-payment rule reviewed 25 October 2026, combined with hypothetical cash allowances. This is an ordinary owner-occupied illustration, not mortgage approval. Modeled down payment is the greater of the requested percentage, the basic minimum and the credited deposit, capped at price. Credited deposit is capped at price and assumed fully applied without a refund. Cash available now excludes that already-paid deposit. Closing percentages are editable allowances, not calculated transfer taxes. Fixed costs must exclude items already in the percentage allowance. Reserve is retained cash, not a fee. No mortgage-insurance premium, premium tax, rebate, lender qualification, monthly affordability or financing cost is calculated; include separately confirmed cash charges once in the appropriate allowance.

2f2957ea6d97aa197964bb28d93fcbe190b2356d.src: Original hypothetical probability model, not an observed loss rate, insurance quote or recommended reserve. Each year has at most one event, the same independently chosen marginal event probability and the same cash cost. The main distribution assumes statistical independence across years. All cash is available at the start, and event costs only reduce it: no saving, replenishment, interest, inflation, income interruption, borrowing or insurance recovery is included. Reserve coverage means total modeled cost is at most the entered cash balance. The separate fully linked stress has either no events or an event in every year, with the same annual marginal probability. Neither dependence structure is estimated from evidence.
2f2957ea6d97aa197964bb28d93fcbe190b2356d.zh: 原始假设概率模型，并非观察到的损失率、保险报价或建议准备金。每年至多有一个事件，相同的独立选择的边际事件概率和相同的现金成本。主要分布假设多年来的统计独立性。所有现金一开始就可用，事件成本只会减少现金：不包括储蓄、补充、利息、通货膨胀、收入中断、借款或保险追偿。储备覆盖率意味着总建模成本最多为输入的现金余额。单独的完全关联压力要么没有事件，要么每年都有事件，具有相同的年边际概率。这两种依赖结构均不是根据证据估算的。

Divestiture-related goodwill reductions explain much of that divergence. Our nine-month bridge attributes the C$1.409 billion increase in adjusted income to C$1.210 billion higher pre-provision profit, C$655 million lower credit provisions and C$456 million higher tax. Performing allowances account for C$439 million of the credit improvement. The calculation supports an operating recovery, while also identifying a benefit that should not automatically recur.

2ffbcdc3e9405ac3199f374cc7dd27c4f8924b23.src: All categories retain the entered dollar amounts and the dated source rates. Compare the absolute increase, not just the percentage: a larger shelter amount can add more dollars even when its rate is below food’s.

2ffc15ff34e6677b64d69d38e367439a54fffc5f.src: Original two-plan teaching formula, not an insurer claim decision. Primary and secondary status are assumed already confirmed; this calculator does not determine or let the claimant choose priority. Both plans are assumed to use the same entered eligible expense. Primary pays the lesser of its percentage amount and unused maximum. Secondary pays the least of the remaining common eligible expense, its standalone percentage amount and its unused maximum. The secondary percentage applies to the original common eligible expense, not to the unpaid remainder. The separately entered ineligible amount is covered by neither plan. No deductible, differing eligible-fee schedules, exclusions, service limits, tax, premium, claim date or reimbursement delay is modeled. Rates, maximums and eligibility must be checked in the actual plans; different terms require different calculations.
2ffc15ff34e6677b64d69d38e367439a54fffc5f.zh: 原始的两个计划教学公式，而不是保险公司的索赔决定。假定主要和次要地位已经确定；该计算器不会确定或让索赔人选择优先权。假定两个计划使用相同的输入合格费用。主要支付其百分比金额和未使用的最高限额中的较小者。次要支付剩余常见合格费用、其独立百分比金额及其未使用最高金额中的最少金额。第二百分比适用于原始常见合格费用，不适用于未支付的剩余费用。单独输入的不符合资格的金额不在这两个计划的承保范围内。没有对免赔额、不同的合格费用表、排除、服务限制、税、保费、索赔日期或报销延迟进行建模。必须在实际计划中检查费率、最高限额和资格；不同的条款需要不同的计算。

30a137f9502c0e0f33d17884a66d670326aa3c2f.src: Hypothetical month-end household cash ledger. Temporary salary/sick-pay receipts arrive in the initial selected months. Insurance first pays after the full selected waiting months and then pays for the selected number of months, limited by the illustrated horizon. Benefit input is assumed approved and available after all taxes and offsets; the model does not apply coordination rules. Continuing income, temporary pay and net insurance receipts are added as entered, including any overlap. Setup cost is paid at time zero. No interest, inflation, claim assessment, medical eligibility, premium, statutory benefit, recovery date or administrative delay is calculated. Negative cash positions represent unfunded needs, not an approved loan.

320ed0d3d783ddca91699e226ab33bca4cb1ff61.src: This article models a change in the person funding an otherwise unchanged loan. 3211e925ab56b0193f336d40f97f6391e8efce7d.src: Every step is already in CAD. 32174d47d843631ef3e3ea5763fbbe51c1aa3a07.src: An honest answer to crash anxiety combines acknowledgement with specific choices: losses are possible; the amount matters; spending dates matter; and the portfolio should fit those facts. Balanced investing is useful when it creates a sustainable mix for the person and goal, rather than a story that markets must recover on schedule.
32174d47d843631ef3e3ea5763fbbe51c1aa3a07.zh: 对崩溃焦虑的诚实回答将确认与具体选择结合起来：损失是可能的；损失是可能的；金额很重要；消费日期很重要；并且投资组合应该符合这些事实。当平衡投资为个人和目标创造可持续的组合时，而不是市场必须按计划恢复的故事，它是有用的。

3217adb341d88485d59b2a67993001df3a4ffdf7.src: This is a classification bridge, not a payment ledger. 316c74af1b7185a2f28ec91d015c1f015f3f30e0.src: Two separate exercises. Statistical context uses Canada’s preliminary 2022–2024 period life table, Statistics Canada Table 13-10-0114-01, released 13 January 2026 and retrieved 25 October 2026. Each marginal share is lx / l65 within the source categories Males and Females. The illustrative pair begins with one from each category, both age 65. Its joint figures additionally assume that the published marginal shares apply to the pair and, for the independence line, independent remaining lifetimes. These are not observed Canadian couple probabilities or personal survival forecasts. The bounds vary dependence while preserving those assumed marginals; they are not sampling confidence intervals. The source extract stops at age 100, where survival is still positive. Budget controls do not change these fixed statistics. The separate cash exercise chooses a transition year; it does not predict a death date or survival-weight the budget. Real CAD gaps are paid at year-end, with a constant real discount rate after assumed tax and costs. No benefits, household income, actual investment path, tax return, mortality improvement, annuity price or guaranteed funding level is calculated.
316c74af1b7185a2f28ec91d015c1f015f3f30e0.zh: 两个单独的练习。统计背景使用加拿大2022-2024年期间的初步生命表，加拿大统计局表13​​-10-0114-01，于2026年1月13日发布并于2026年10月25日检索。在源类别男性和女性中，每个边际份额为lx / l65。示例性的一对从每个类别中的一个开始，年龄均为 65 岁。其联合数据还假设已发布的边际份额适用于该对，并且对于独立线，独立的剩余寿命。这些不是观察到的加拿大夫妇概率或个人生存预测。边界变化依赖性，同时保留那些假设的边际；他们没有对置信区间进行采样。源提取物在 100 岁时停止，此时存活率仍然为正。预算控制不会改变这些固定的统计数据。单独现金行使选择过渡年；它不会预测死亡日期或生存权重预算。实际加元缺口在年底支付，扣除假定税收和成本后实际贴现率恒定。不计算任何福利、家庭收入、实际投资路径、纳税申报表、死亡率改善、年金价格或保证资金水平。

333d474ca6660afd3892524cf51017954260817a.src: A negative endpoint is additional cash needed to make the full payment. It is not a bank overdraft, permission to pay less, or a calculation of the card’s resulting interest. A positive endpoint is remaining assigned cash after this one modeled obligation.
333d474ca6660afd3892524cf51017954260817a.zh: 负面终点是全额付款所需的额外现金。它不是银行透支、允许减少支付或计算卡产生的利息。积极的终点是在这一建模义务之后剩余分配的现金。

3340ecf0a4ce593a9705af3b655f3aee5f24f8a0.src: Rows replace the immediate price decline; columns replace the maximum loan-to-collateral ratio. Cells are outside cash used to reduce debt while keeping the stressed collateral unchanged. They are not additional collateral requirements, loss estimates or calls issued by a lender. A lower allowed ratio can require cash at the same asset value and debt, including before any price decline.
3340ecf0a4ce593a9705af3b655f3aee5f24f8a0.zh: 行取代立即价格下跌；列取代了最大贷款与抵押品比率。单元是外部现金，用于减少债务，同时保持压力抵押品不变。它们不是贷款人发出的额外抵押品要求、损失估计或催缴通知。较低的允许比率可能需要相同资产价值和债务的现金，包括在任何价格下跌之前。

336493ce82cd1a0784656d0b3e0d66af4b0fda28.src: Review the budget against current records and the actual tax treatment of each receipt. A clearly defined replacement ratio can summarize a completed calculation, but the spending, deductions and timing should remain inspectable underneath it. That lets the plan respond to a real change in commitments instead of relying on an unchanged headline percentage.
336493ce82cd1a0784656d0b3e0d66af4b0fda28.zh: 根据当前记录和每张收据的实际税务处理审查预算。明确定义的替代率可以总结完整的计算，但支出、扣除和时间安排仍应在其下方进行检查。这使得该计划能够对承诺的实际变化做出反应，而不是依赖于不变的总体百分比。

356179375680bde87b73855170f64b4090e65a97.src: Month zero contains the opening reserve only. Each later point adds one month of both assumed incomes and subtracts one month of spending. 356461d54eb2eef84d5fc3841a7440e3ff845c01.src: Every row begins with the same opening snapshot and repeats the entered annual assumptions for its own labeled horizon. Each difference is [(1 + fund annual return)^years − 1] minus [(1 + benchmark annual return)^years − 1]. It is a percentage-point difference between two cumulative returns, not an annual expense ratio, relative wealth ratio or estimate of tracking error. Negative means the fund ends below the benchmark; positive means above. Dividing a cumulative gap by the number of years does not recover the annual tracking difference.

3643fcb4db0ea664b5cd226625ded744e376aabf.src: Original hypothetical six-month management ledger for an assumed GST/HST registrant using a simplified regular-method illustration. Sales, output tax, operating cash costs and input tax are separately entered monthly amounts. All invoices are paid and all expense/input-tax payments occur in the same month. The input-tax amount is assumed fully eligible, documented and claimed in the relevant period; eligibility is not tested. Months 1–3 form one model period and months 4–6 a second. At the start of month 4, the positive first-period net tax is remitted; a negative first-period amount becomes a separate potential receivable with no assumed refund cash during these six months. This is a chosen planning calendar, not a calculated statutory filing or payment deadline. Positive unsettled net tax stays within the bank position but is reserved; a receivable is not added to cash. No opening tax liability, owner draw, income-tax provision, payroll obligation, inventory, capital transaction, adjustment, quick method, tax rate or registration test is calculated. Negative cash positions are unfunded needs, not an assumed overdraft.
3643fcb4db0ea664b5cd226625ded744e376aabf.zh: 使用简化的常规方法说明，假设 GST/HST 注册人的原始假设六个月管理分类账。销售、销项税、经营现金成本和进项税分别按月输入。所有发票均已支付，所有费用/进项税均在同一个月支付。假定进项税额完全合格，并在相关期间记录并申报；资格未经过测试。第 1-3 个月形成一个模型周期，第 4-6 个月形成第二个模型周期。第4月初，汇出第一期净税额为正；第一期金额为负数将成为单独的潜在应收款，并且在这六个月内不会假定退款现金。这是选定的计划日历，而不是计算出的法定提交或付款截止日期。未结算的正税净额仍保留在银行头寸内，但已保留；应收账款不添加到现金中。不计算期初纳税义务、所有者提取、所得税拨备、工资义务、库存、资本交易、调整、快速方法、税率或注册测试。负现金头寸是没有资金支持的需求，而不是假设的透支。

3626fdc969688ec2461a78e9cf5d1e047ccab6ce.zh: 这是使用相同术语的两条绝对成本曲线之间的差异和津贴。其明确的零参考标记等于与距离相关的成本。在这个有限的比较中，负值有利于 B；正值有利于 A。集中的符号差异量表有助于显示较小的成本差距，除了较大的总费用之外，这些差距很难看到。该曲线是确定性的，不附加驱动概率。

36290d9d82b992f39aa2810770207d8e7c2dbd4b.src: Real tax payments follow the applicable reporting and payment requirements. 36dfc7f6d9c7751912f0f8084f481e1bdc281843.src: Over sixty model months, the unchanged-payment path pays CAD 144,000 in cash and incurs about CAD 146,639.47 of interest charges. Its ending debt is therefore CAD 400,000 + CAD 146,639.47 − CAD 144,000 = CAD 402,639.47.
36dfc7f6d9c7751912f0f8084f481e1bdc281843.zh: 超过 60 个模型月，不变的付款路径支付 144,000 加元现金，并产生约 146,639.47 加元的利息费用。因此，其期末债务为400,000 加元 + 146,639.47 加元 - 144,000 加元 = 402,639.47 加元。

3646292c869a7dce20e206060a7826aedc6e7719.src: The compounding line is an accrued contract value, not an early-redemption quotation or immediately available cash. The payout line excludes interest already spent. At maturity, contract proceeds replace the corresponding contract asset; principal is not counted twice.
3646292c869a7dce20e206060a7826aedc6e7719.zh: 复利线是应计合同价值，而不是提前赎回报价或立即可用现金。支付线不包括已支出的利息。到期时，合约收益替代相应的合约资产；主体不计算两次。

36490f05580f4be08d62c4c7be9d9aabcfc917b6.src: Hypothetical three-component replacement schedule over twelve years, not a building inspection, lifespan table or condominium reserve study. In the base case, first replacement occurs after the selected interval and repeats at that interval. Each event costs today’s entered amount grown to its event year at the selected constant rate. Contributions arrive monthly before any year-end replacements. Reserve earns zero interest. Routine upkeep is a separate constant monthly cash allowance; it does not enter or leave this replacement reserve. Required monthly saving is the largest cumulative funding requirement at any event, rounded up to cents, given starting reserve. Negative balances are unmet needs, not borrowing. No emergency repair, tax, insurance recovery, renovation scope change, investment risk or costs after year twelve are calculated.
36490f05580f4be08d62c4c7be9d9aabcfc917b6.zh: 假设的十二年三部分更换时间表，不是建筑检查、使用寿命表或公寓储备研究。在基本情况下，第一次替换发生在选定的时间间隔之后，并以该时间间隔重复。每项活动的费用都按照所选的恒定比率将今天输入的金额增长到其活动年份。捐款每月在年底更换之前到达。储备金赚取零利息。日常维护是一项单独的每月固定现金津贴；它不会进入或离开此替换储备。所需的每月储蓄是在任何情况下最大的累积资金需求，四舍五入到美分，考虑到起始准备金。负余额是未满足的需求，而不是借款。不计算紧急维修、税收、保险赔偿、装修范围变更、投资风险或第 12 年之后的成本。

365044ff4f663ba1a43e822e20561c253b767206.src: Each bar reconciles to the same original CAD 64,400 balance. Current tax combines assumed regular incremental tax on AIP after any allowed deduction with the separate additional 20% on the residual AIP. The RRSP/PRPP/SPP slice remains a pre-future-tax retirement asset, not free cash or a permanent tax saving. No portfolio return or retirement withdrawal is projected.

3659b0dc9b5def785b7f913f8d03777b01a1970d.src: That distinction matters before comparing a number with a salary. A family can contain more than one income recipient, while its resources support more than one person. Dividing a family median by two does not produce an observed individual median, and dividing it by twelve does not establish what any particular employee receives on a payday.
3659b0dc9b5def785b7f913f8d03777b01a1970d.zh: 在比较数字之前，这种区别很重要有薪水。一个家庭可以有多个收入接受者，而其资源也可以养活多个人。将家庭中位数除以二并不能得出观察到的个人中位数，将其除以十二也不能确定任何特定员工在发薪日收到的金额。

It does not contain coupons already paid, a later sale, or a reinvestment return. A longer term can create a larger price response; maturity is only one determinant of real-world interest-rate sensitivity.
36604a4647f1884326856f72c1f0855e57276122.zh: 每个单元格都是一个优惠券边界的价格，具有选定的面和优惠券，但显示期限和收益率。它不包含已支付的优惠券、后续销售或再投资回报。较长的期限可以产生更大的价格反应；成熟度只是现实世界利率敏感性的决定因素之一。

36e0c245b0ca102be813d2ac2efc986b5922f456.src: Original cash-budget illustration with two equally long periods, each containing twelve months per selected year. Both monthly premium amounts are independently entered assumptions; they do not establish an available policy, guaranteed renewal, conversion right, underwriting result or coverage amount. Each month the selected household assignment arrives before that month’s premium. Unspent cash stays in a separate household reserve earning zero. The second premium starts in month 121. No death event, claim, cancellation, lapse, policy cash value, tax, premium refund, inflation or further renewal is simulated. Negative balances are unfunded premiums, not automatic borrowing. The same household assignment continues throughout both periods and must be affordable outside this sub-budget.
36e0c245b0ca102be813d2ac2efc986b5922f456.zh: 原始现金预算插图有两个同样长的期间，每个选定年份包含十二个月。每月保费金额均为独立输入的假设；他们不制定可用的保单、保证续保、转换权、承保结果或承保金额。每个月选定的家庭分配都会在该月的保费之前到达。未使用的现金保留在单独的家庭储备中，收入为零。第二次保费从第 121 个月开始。不会模拟死亡事件、索赔、取消、失效、保单现金价值、税收、保费退款、通货膨胀或进一步续保。负余额是无资金准备的保费，而不是自动借款。相同的家庭分配在两个时期内持续进行，并且必须在此子预算之外负担得起。

36e324848965912d3d140359bc31acadd54ef9fd.src: The annual positive-gain rule charges 20% of that second-year CAD 20,000 gain, or CAD 4,000. Its account ends at CAD 96,000. That fee is consistent with the invented annual rule even though the investor has not recovered the initial capital after fees. The first year’s loss does not carry forward under that rule.

36e9b3bd6345e7c2990a55e00e3ae50658d7a1eb.src: These rows are separate snapshots of the same proceeds, not three assets or three receipts to add. The middle category includes broker processing and transfer transit; it does not promise that funds remain a withdrawable brokerage balance throughout that interval. A zero post-settlement wait collapses the middle interval to the same day, rather than creating extra cash. This chart traces the gross entered receipt before its bill allocation, while the separate bank ledger deducts the bill. A sale exchanges an investment for proceeds; it does not create this amount as earned income.
36e9b3bd6345e7c2990a55e00e3ae50658d7a1eb.zh: 这些行是同一收益的单独快照，而不是要添加的三个资产或三个收据。中间类包括经纪加工和中转中转；它不承诺资金在整个期间保持为可提取的经纪余额。零结算后等待将中间间隔压缩到同一天，而不是创造额外的现金。该图表跟踪账单分配之前输入的收据总额，而单独的银行分类账则扣除账单。销售以投资换取收益；它不会将此金额创建为赚取的收入。

36eb5f586491bfd92035c4fa62137d6bd4c03943.src: The model therefore tests capacity on specific days. It does not predict an issuer’s approval decision or infer that a charge was made simply because a merchant requested a hold. Every amount and date is an independent hypothetical assumption, with no standard hold period implied.
36eb5f586491bfd92035c4fa62137d6bd4c03943.zh: 因此，该模型会测试特定日期的容量。它不会预测发行人的批准决定，也不会仅仅因为商家请求暂缓而推断出收费。每个金额和日期都是独立的假设，没有隐含标准持有期限。

36f380607b3700505aedcefdb0b7bf6678167397.src: The default bills arrive at the start of months three, six and nine. The first two monthly periods therefore pass before the first bill. Changing the spacing moves all three dates together while keeping their amounts equal. A spacing of four places the final bill at the start of month twelve.
36f380607b3700505aedcefdb0b7bf6678167397.zh: 默认账单在第三、第六和第九个月开始时到达。因此，前两个月的周期在第一个账单之前就已经过去了。更改间距会将所有三个日期移到一起，同时保持它们的数量相等。间隔四次后，最终账单将在十二月初产生。

But the first housing bill arrives before either pay deposit. Paying it turns the account balance negative CAD 1,300. The positive final total cannot make that earlier funding requirement disappear.
37372dc20caeb131e59e4cbc1780c6fe34812320.zh: 在借贷费用、收据和支出之前，月底留下 1,000 加元：500 加元 + 4,400 加元 – 3,900 加元。但第一笔住房账单是在支付押金之前到达的。支付后，账户余额将变为负 1,300 加元。正的最终总额不能使早期的资金需求消失。

373ac7b98f96b50a0b59668cdae25ab09f91b6e4.src: A rental budget can show several different measures: scheduled rent, rent collected, operating income, debt payments and cash retained. Giving each number a separate name prevents one from being used as a substitute for another.

376cba6ca3e044b61cf2599d52c8af610cb2c08e.src: The principal chart stops before the optional deadline top-up. Increasing that final payment does not pretend that the same money reduced balances during earlier months. Once a scheduled payment would exceed the principal still owed, only the remaining principal is taken; the model does not create an overpayment or a negative debt.

376e5ab584a55ac2ead4c1f66c7e43ed6c74dfb8.src: Hypothetical penalty-free permitted lump sum applied at time zero. Mortgage rate is nominal annual compounded semi-annually, converted to a monthly rate, and held fixed through the selected horizon. Both choices retain the original monthly payment computed before prepayment. Savings earn the entered constant effective annual return after tax/costs, converted monthly. Each month savings earn interest, mortgage payments occur, and any unused part of the identical payment budget is deposited into savings. Prepayment is capped at debt; excess starting cash stays liquid. Home value is identical and excluded. No prepayment charge, actual privilege, mortgage interest deduction, renewal, account restriction or investment risk distribution is calculated.
376e5ab584a55ac2ead4c1f66c7e43ed6c74dfb8.zh: 假设零罚金允许一次性支付。抵押贷款利率为名义年复利，每半年复利一次，转换为月利率，并在选定的期限内保持固定。两种选择都保留预付款之前计算的原始每月付款。储蓄赚取输入的税/成本后的恒定有效年度回报，每月转换。每个月储蓄都会产生利息，抵押贷款会发生，并且相同付款预算的任何未使用部分都会存入储蓄。提前还款以债务为上限；多余的起始现金保持流动性。房屋价值相同且被排除。不计算提前还款费用、实际优惠、抵押贷款利息扣除、续约、账户限制或投资风险分配。

3778cdd47ef741e07f2460c23e62a92e904bbfab.src: That difference does not establish that a borrower or estate must pay the shortfall from other assets. For a specifically attributed example, HomeEquity Bank describes a conditional No Negative Equity Guarantee for CHIP. Its stated conditions include maintaining the property, paying property taxes and insurance, and meeting mortgage obligations. It excludes administrative expenses and interest accumulated after the due date.
3778cdd47ef741e07f2460c23e62a92e904bbfab.zh: 这种差异并不意味着借款人或遗产必须用其他资产支付差额。举一个具体的例子，HomeEquity Bank 描述了针对 CHIP 的有条件无负资产担保。其规定的条件包括维护财产、缴纳财产税和保险以及履行抵押贷款义务。它不包括管理费用和到期日后累积的利息。

3804739dbe51fa52b76aef698d213c58cd985da6.src: Hypothetical month-end contributions compounded at a constant user-entered annual return converted to an equivalent monthly rate. Contributions step up once each year at the year’s start; no initial lump sum, withdrawals, tax, inflation-linked return forecast, changing fund allocation or market sequence is modeled. The reported historical September 2026 figures are fixed official observations and do not set any scenario input. The pay-growth assumption is not an individual wage forecast; a household may receive no raise or a different increase. Fees are represented only through the user-entered after-fee return and must not be subtracted again.
3804739dbe51fa52b76aef698d213c58cd985da6.zh: 假设的月末捐款以用户输入的恒定年回报率复合，并转换为等值的月费率。捐款额每年在年初增加一次；没有对初始一次性付款、提款、税收、与通胀挂钩的回报预测、不断变化的资金分配或市场顺序进行建模。报告的 2026 年 9 月历史数据是固定的官方观察结果，未设置任何情景输入。工资增长假设不是个人工资预测；一个家庭可能得不到加薪或有不同的加薪。费用仅通过用户输入的费用后回报来体现，不得再次扣除。

391ac84323ee88b43d987081f33e80c048ef469b.src: Original hypothetical three-period monthly energy bill, not an Ontario tariff, utility quote or full actual bill estimate. Prices are entered in cents per kWh and divided by 100 for CAD charges. The selected fraction of original on-peak consumption moves to off-peak, with no change in total energy, mid-peak use or the entered fixed amount. 70 kWh move within a total of 700 kWh. The consumption-weighted energy price changes from 14.00 to 12.80 cents/kWh. The simplified whole bill falls by 7.12%. The tool does not determine whether the assumed energy can actually be shifted. The fixed amount represents only charges chosen to remain unchanged; it does not assert that every delivery or non-energy charge on a real bill is fixed. Variable delivery charges, losses, demand charges, tiers, taxes, rebates, seasonal price schedules, equipment costs and changes in efficiency are excluded. The period labels do not enforce a price hierarchy: a higher entered off-peak rate can make the shift more expensive.
391ac84323ee88b43d987081f33e80c048ef469b.zh: 原始假设的三期每月能源账单，不是安大略省电价、公用事业报价或完整的实际账单估算。价格以每千瓦时美分输入，然后除以 100 计算加元费用。原始高峰消耗量的选定部分转移到非高峰期，总能源、中峰使用量或输入的固定量没有变化。 70 kWh 在总共 700 kWh 内移动。消费加权能源价格从 14.00 美分/千瓦时变为 12.80 美分/千瓦时。简化整账单下降7.12%。该工具无法确定假设的能量是否可以实际转移。固定金额仅代表选择保持不变的费用；它并不断言实际账单上的每项交付或非能源费用都是固定的。不包括可变交付费用、损失、需求费用、等级、税收、回扣、季节性价格表、设备成本和效率变化。期间标签不会强制执行价格层次结构：输入的非高峰费率越高，转变的成本就会越高。

399f4267da910356aaab70b8d5e4243cd3b5f147.src: The first three charts use published CSCE interpolated medians from the Bank of Canada’s 19 October 2026 release and its linked quarterly data group, retrieved 25 October 2026. The online survey was collected 5–27 August 2026; follow-up interviews ran 24 August–4 September. Quarterly data keys mark the start of the reference quarter, not an interview or release date. The data summarize respondent perceptions and expectations; they are not actual CPI observations or the Bank’s own inflation forecast. Eight quarters from 2024 Q4 to 2026 Q3 are retained. No respondent-level data, sampling interval or significance test is supplied here. The final two charts are separate hypothetical annual-cost scenarios. Their price-growth input is independent of every survey observation, is applied once per complete year, and is held constant solely for the exercise. The displayed future cost is an annual amount at that date, not cumulative spending, present value, savings required or a promised bill. No income, investment return, tax, fee or payment account is calculated.
399f4267da910356aaab70b8d5e4243cd3b5f147.zh: 前三张图表使用加拿大央行 2026 年 10 月 19 日发布的 CSCE 插值中位数及其关联的季度数据组，检索于 2026 年 10 月 25 日。在线调查收集于 2026 年 8 月 5 日至 27 日；后续采访于 8 月 24 日至 9 月 4 日进行。季度数据关键标记参考季度的开始，而不是采访或发布日期。这些数据总结了受访者的看法和期望；它们不是实际的消费者物价指数观察结果，也不是央行自己的通胀预测。保留2024年第四季度至2026年第三季度的八个季度。这里没有提供受访者级别的数据、抽样间隔或显着性检验。最后两张图表是单独的假设年度成本情景。他们的价格增长输入独立于每次调查观察，每年应用一次，并且仅在练习中保持不变。显示的未来成本是该日期的年度金额，而不是累计支出、现值、所需储蓄或承诺的账单。不计算任何收入、投资回报、税金、费用或付款账户。

3aa04ec7935e9e74064156cbda98c94bde5008c9.src: CIBC has earned a more serious profitability discussion. The research question is whether the improved return is sufficiently durable to justify a premium valuation after Canadian margin gains, strong market activity and easier U.S. credit comparisons. A favourable answer on the business still needs a separate answer on the price. At the C$159.59 TSX close on 23 October 2026, investors are paying for continued execution rather than merely the possibility of stabilization.

3bcde8d960052cd4de3c1c6f2c5123d3326a8ebe.src: Original, fully observed, invented one-year cohort of eight funds A–H, each with the same opening amount. Base simple total returns, with all income retained and before fees and taxes, are +20%, +12%, +8%, +4%, 0%, −5%, −15% and −40%. All eight complete-period returns and ending values remain known, including for omitted directory records. Omission is an assumed end-of-period listing status, not an estimated closure probability, an actual liquidation or a rule that causes performance. The control omits H first, then G, then F; its return adjustment changes only the currently omitted records. No real funds, market observations, causal estimates, confidence intervals, p-values or simulated samples are used. Group means are equal-weight arithmetic means across funds over one common year. Equal opening positions with no cash flows make the full-cohort mean equal to that original buy-and-hold basket’s simple return; the filtered mean uses a smaller denominator and is not the return earned by the original whole basket. Returns are assumed complete total-return inputs; no additional fee, tax, currency change, sales charge, new entry, merger, reinvestment after liquidation or missing-period return is modeled. An omitted record is never treated as a zero ending value. The directory is seen after the return period and does not supply an investable selection rule or a future return assumption.
3bcde8d960052cd4de3c1c6f2c5123d3326a8ebe.zh: 原创、充分观察、发明的一年期基金 A-H，每支基金的开仓金额相同。基本简单总回报（保留所有收入且扣除费用和税金）为+20%、+12%、+8%、+4%、0%、-5%、-15% 和 -40%。所有八个完整期间的回报和结束值仍然已知，包括省略的目录记录。遗漏是一种假设的期末上市状态，而不是估计的关闭概率、实际清算或导致绩效的规则。控制先省略H，然后G，最后F；其返回调整仅更改当前省略的记录。不使用真实资金、市场观察、因果估计、置信区间、p 值或模拟样本。群体平均值是一个共同年份内各基金的等权算术平均值。没有现金流的相同开仓头寸使得全队列均值等于原始买入并持有篮子的简单回报；过滤后的平均值使用较小的分母，并且不是原始整个篮子获得的回报。假设回报是完整的总回报输入；没有额外费用、税收、货币变动、销售费用、新进入、合并、清算后再投资或错过期限回报的模型。省略的记录永远不会被视为零结束值。该目录是在回报期结束后看到的，不提供可投资的选择规则或未来回报假设。

3d3127a18ceeb91e7ae71dec70d8a7779be1dc34.src: Invented record example in CAD, on a single frozen deduction-capacity basis. Prior undeducted contributions have already been deposited; they are not unfilled contribution room or current account market value. Each new monthly contribution occurs after the reconciled starting snapshot and is not already included in the prior record. No deduction claim occurs in the monthly ledger. Negative headroom means the contribution record exceeds ordinary capacity; the display does not authorize that schedule. The separate CAD 2,000 reference assumes the statutory prior-taxation-year age condition and all other relevant conditions are satisfied; it does not determine eligibility or additional deductible room. No tax, penalty, refund or corrective withdrawal is calculated. There are no new-year room additions, reassessments, withdrawals, first-60-day prior-year allocations, HBP/LLP repayments, PRPP/SPP transactions, mandatory group-plan amounts, special transfers or historical adjustments. Months are synthetic and do not represent a filing calendar.
3d3127a18ceeb91e7ae71dec70d8a7779be1dc34.zh: 在单一冻结扣除能力的基础上发明了 CAD 记录示例。之前未扣除的捐款已经存入；它们不是未填补的供款空间或经常账户市场价值。每个新的每月捐款发生在协调的起始快照之后，并且尚未包含在先前的记录中。月度账簿中没有发生任何扣除申请。负净空指贡献记录超出普通能力；显示未授权该计划。单独的 2,000 加元参考假设法定的纳税年度前年龄条件，并且满足所有其他相关条件；它并不决定资格或额外免赔额。不计算任何税款、罚款、退款或纠正性提款。没有新年房间增加、重新评估、提款、前一年的前 60 天分配、HBP/LLP 还款、PRPP/SPP 交易、强制性团体计划金额、特别转移或历史调整。月份是合成的，并不代表归档日历。

3d436100b7c7b3f9512fad57142d1b73369e14fc.src: BMO offers exposure to a recovery in the earnings power of a large North American banking franchise. The investment question is how much further the return on shareholder capital can improve once easier credit comparisons fade. At the October 23 close of C$236.87, the shares trade at an analyst-calculated 16.47× trailing adjusted EPS and 2.10× July book value. The former uses FY2025 adjusted EPS of C$12.16 plus nine-month FY2026 EPS of C$11.11, less the comparable C$8.89: a C$14.38 trailing measure. Neither the price nor the multiple describes an undiscovered turnaround.
3d436100b7c7b3f9512fad57142d1b73369e14fc.zh: BMO 提供了北美大型银行特许经营盈利能力恢复的机会。投资问题是，一旦更容易的信用比较消失，股东资本回报率还能提高多少。截至 10 月 23 日收盘价为236.87 加元，分析师计算出该股的交易价格为16.47× 追踪调整后每股收益和 2.10× 7 月账面价值。前者使用 2025 财年调整后每股收益 12.16 加元加上 2026 财年九个月每股收益 11.11 加元，减去可比的 8.89 加元：追踪指标 14.38 加元。无论是价格还是倍数都没有描述出未被发现的转变。

3d4fe6881ef0e8abb571e5531558d66a3775a3c4.src: The pool starts at zero because the opening money buys the bond. A redemption creates a large cash receipt and then compounds under the selected reinvestment assumption. A larger pool before original maturity does not establish greater total wealth: the value of an outstanding bond is excluded. At original maturity both cases have redeemed, so the endpoint contains all retained proceeds in each matched case.
3d4fe6881ef0e8abb571e5531558d66a3775a3c4.zh: 资金池从零开始，因为开仓资金购买债券。赎回会产生大量现金收入，然后根据选定的再投资假设进行复利。在原始到期之前更大的资金池并不会建立更大的总财富：未偿还债券的价值被排除在外。在最初到期时，两个案例均已赎回，因此端点包含每个匹配案例中的所有保留收益。

3d9511d7766839e3efb6129bef4db1ae07796804.src: Original hypothetical comparison of completing the same task yourself or hiring it out. The quote and DIY outlays include all known taxes and fees. New tools are paid in full, with no resale or later-use credit. Only the entered share of DIY hours actually removes paid work, valued at independently entered after-tax earnings lost; the other DIY hours use non-work time. Hiring uses the entered coordination hours from non-work time only. The time-value input is a subjective valuation of non-work hours, not an extra invoice, payroll amount or claim that all free time could be sold for wages. Cash-resource totals include vendor outlays plus actual earnings forgone. Combined totals add the separate subjective time value once. No skill assessment, quality difference, project failure, safety guidance, financing, insurance, warranty value, tax deduction or other work opportunity is modeled.
3d9511d7766839e3efb6129bef4db1ae07796804.zh: 自行完成相同任务或雇用它的原始假设比较出来。报价和 DIY 支出包括所有已知的税费。新工具是全额付款的，没有转售或以后使用的信用。只有输入的 DIY 时间份额才能真正去除带薪工作，按独立输入的税后收入损失计算；其他DIY时间利用非工作时间。招聘仅使用输入的非工作时间协调时间。时间价值输入是对非工作时间的主观评估，而不是额外的发票、工资金额或声称所有空闲时间都可以出售来换取工资。现金资源总额包括供应商支出加上实际损失的收入。合并总计将单独的主观时间值添加一次。没有对技能评估、质量差异、项目失败、安全指导、融资、保险、保修价值、税收减免或其他工作机会进行建模。

3c03cc8540860514e58d5535022e3876f2de07c1.src: The second source panel asks respondents to select every applicable use of the time they felt AI had helped release. The listed options concern task quality, additional tasks, work-life balance, learning or training, and creative work.

3c04f155eda015aacb5f69b4896e6562ddba764b.src: Change the final payment to CAD 13,225 while retaining the original initial cost and receipt. The two growth-factor roots meet at 1.15. The solver lists a single distinct 15% rate, and the NPV curve touches zero there rather than crossing into a positive region.

3c0f2e7ee2a10a20eadd033c5c3f4f4cc026e1f8.src: The first row gives each date’s price equal weight. The second weights price by units bought, equivalently dividing total purchase cash by total units. With positive prices and equal cash purchases, it is the harmonic mean of prices. This compares accounting statistics rather than two alternative trading strategies.
3c0f2e7ee2a10a20eadd033c5c3f4f4cc026e1f8.zh: 第一行赋予每个日期的价格相同的权重。第二个是按购买单位对价格进行加权，相当于将总购买现金除以总单位。在正价格和同等现金购买的情况下，它是价格的调和平均值。这比较的是会计统计数据，而不是两种替代交易策略。

3e4cca8c2de251981d68c3bb5a4d87fb0c51f640.src: With the model’s assumptions, preserving buying power requires gross interest times one minus the assumed tax rate to equal inflation. At 40% tax and 3% inflation, that implies a 5% gross annual rate. The threshold covers no fee, withdrawal or other cost.
3e4cca8c2de251981d68c3bb5a4d87fb0c51f640.zh: 根据模型的假设，保持购买力需要总利息乘以 1 减去假设的税率才能等于通货膨胀。如果税率为 40%，通货膨胀率为 3%，则意味着年毛利率为 5%。该阈值不包含费用、提款或其他费用。

3e62df3abefab1d95b48755a51fae89d464abed4.src: Original hypothetical annual capacity budget for a sole operator. Exactly 52 equal weeks; leave and other downtime are non-overlapping weeks with no work. Remaining weeks have the entered hours, split between billable and unpaid work. Every billable hour is sold, invoiced and collected within this same year at the same rate. Rates exclude sales tax. Variable cash costs use collected fees; fixed business costs and a separate personal provision are counted once. Remaining cash is before personal income tax, CPP/QPP, EI and other personal liabilities. No tax deductibility, legal employment status, guaranteed demand, collection delay, corporate tax, debt, investment return or replacement of an actual employee benefit is calculated. Personal provision is a cash allocation, not a deemed business expense or tax deduction.
3e62df3abefab1d95b48755a51fae89d464abed4.zh: 单一运营商的原始假设年度容量预算。正好 52 个相等的周；休假和其他停工时间是不重叠且不工作的周。剩下的几周有输入的时间，分为计费工作和无偿工作。每个计费小时均在同一年内以相同的费率出售、开具发票和收取。房价不含销售税。可变现金成本使用收取的费用；固定业务成本和单独的个人准备金计算一次。剩余现金是在个人所得税、CPP/QPP、EI 和其他个人负债之前。不计算税收减免、合法就业状况、保证需求、收款延迟、公司税、债务、投资回报或实际员工福利的替代。个人拨款是现金分配，而不是视为业务费用或税收减免。

3e66092240de11d3dc8bc1fee4d1ff5cd4ca7acf.src: Actual weighted-average share counts reflect transaction dates. Potential dilution can depend on award terms and the applicable accounting method. Our simplified closing-share calculation is a teaching scenario, not a reconstruction of a company’s reported diluted EPS.
3e66092240de11d3dc8bc1fee4d1ff5cd4ca7acf.zh: 实际加权平均股份数反映交易日期。潜在的稀释可能取决于奖励条款和适用的会计方法。我们简化的期末股份计算是一个教学场景，而不是对公司报告的稀释每股收益的重建。

3e6c20669bbcd13f242ca3a7d6a0052683a02474.src: Rows replace the target equity share; columns replace the year-end contribution. Initial capital, target years and the selected equity decline stay fixed. Cells show positive loss magnitudes in CAD. The initial equity share changes the interim path but not this endpoint calculation. A smaller cell does not establish that a goal is funded or an allocation is suitable.
3e6c20669bbcd13f242ca3a7d6a0052683a02474.zh: 行取代了目标股本份额；栏目取代了年终捐款。初始资本、目标年份和选定的股本下降保持固定。细胞在 CAD 中显示出正损失量。初始股权份额会改变临时路径，但不会改变此终点计算。较小的单元格无法确定目标是否已获得资助或分配是否合适。

3e6e8cbb0ca29cb5c17d12b12c33841417d28fef.zh: 添加逐年利息差异以协调最终缺口数据

3e719576b0551eb119f409878a85d21eb26aa318.src: Monthly memo accrual uses the opening principal before that month’s end payment. It accumulates without interest on the memo itself. A positive endpoint is a potential conditional charge, including when the deadline top-up later qualifies the entire memo for waiver. It is not another cash payment during these months.
3e719576b0551eb119f409878a85d21eb26aa318.zh: 每月备忘应计使用当月末付款之前的期初本金。它的积累对备忘录本身没有任何利息。积极的终点是潜在的有条件收费，包括当最后期限充值稍后使整个备忘录符合豁免资格时。这不是这几个月中的另一次现金支付。

3e72b0b96c9d8f3dfec16bf79750126468ed2924.src: Each strategy has the same monthly budget and targets. Shares cap at the amount needed, with excess redistributed within that month. A missed deadline remains missed even if cash becomes unallocated later.
3e72b0b96c9d8f3dfec16bf79750126468ed2924.zh: 每个策略都有相同的每月预算和目标。股份上限为所需数量，多余部分将在当月内重新分配。即使稍后现金未分配，错过的截止日期仍然会错过。

3e8522253b43a80d0067510e092546fa03ceb30e.src: If income exceeds spending, the withdrawal request is zero. That surplus is left unallocated rather than automatically saved. A real plan can assign it a destination, but doing so would introduce an additional decision about contributions, access and future use.
3e8522253b43a80d0067510e092546fa03ceb30e.zh: 如果收入超过支出，提款请求为零。该盈余未分配而不是自动保存。真正的计划可以为其分配一个目的地，但这样做会引入有关贡献、访问和未来使用的额外决策。

3e85529bd00051e92f22ff59875155fee8874bad.src: Deposit rules and processes depend on the jurisdiction and tenancy. As one local example, British Columbia’s deposit guidance describes condition inspections, a written forwarding address and procedures for returning or retaining deposits. Check the applicable process and actual records before treating a refund as available cash. This calculator determines no entitlement, lawful deposit cap or statutory deadline.
3e85529bd00051e92f22ff59875155fee8874bad.zh: 押金规则和流程取决于司法管辖区和租赁。作为当地的一个例子，不列颠哥伦比亚省的押金指南描述了状况检查、书面转发地址以及退还或保留押金的程序。在将退款视为可用现金之前，请检查适用的流程和实际记录。该计算器确定无权利、合法存款上限或法定期限。

3ef53d435c9e3144e2d5f4d78c3b94c5288c3bf2.src: Every possible count from zero through the number of years is included once. The last row combines all counts of five or more when they are possible. 3ef53d435c9e3144e2d5f4d78c3b94c5288c3bf2.zh: 从零到年数的每个可能的计数都包含一次。最后一行在可能的情况下合并所有五个或更多的计数。它并不正好代表五个事件，并且它的概率不能乘以五来重建预期成本。精确计数概率保留在模型中并确定所有成本计算。

41c737f7481ed26f772f9c06679d86280cdbc1aa.src: The first two figures are fixed Bank of Canada published indicators based on TransUnion aggregates, updated 25 September 2026 and reviewed 25 October 2026. The borrower measure uses at least one 60+ account; product-loan measures use 90+. Downloadable FVI_FIN_STRESS metadata says households while the current public chart explicitly defines indebted borrowers; this guide follows the explicit chart definition and does not reconstruct households. Exact lender coverage, counts, joint-account handling and within-quarter timing are not supplied in the reviewed notes. The final three figures are a completely separate fictional counting sample: four borrowers A–D, exactly two outstanding toy accounts each, and each account belongs to only one borrower. C/D account codes remain 0; only A/B codes are editable. Codes are assigned teaching labels: 0 = below 60 days; 1 = 60–89 days; 2 = 90+ days. They are not calculated from dates, missed instalments, partial payments, agreements or credit reports. Code 0 does not mean never late. No actual borrower, reporting rule, legal status, lending decision, credit score or future-default probability is assessed. The toy’s fixed grouping is not a claim about TransUnion deduplication. Source rates stay unchanged when codes change.
41c737f7481ed26f772f9c06679d86280cdbc1aa.zh: 前两个数字是加拿大银行根据 TransUnion 汇总发布的固定指标，于 2026 年 9 月 25 日更新并于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审核。借款人衡量标准至少使用一个 60+ 账户；产品贷款措施使用 90+。可下载的 FVI_FIN_STRESS 元数据显示的是家庭，而当前的公共图表明确定义了负债借款人；本指南遵循明确的图表定义，并不重建家庭。审阅的说明中未提供确切的贷款机构覆盖范围、计数、联合账户处理和季度内时间安排。最后三个数字是一个完全独立的虚构计数样本：四个借款人 A-D，每个借款人正好有两个未偿还的玩具账户，每个账户只属于一个借款人。 C/D账户代码保持为0；仅 A/B 代码可编辑。代码分配有教学标签：0 = 低于 60 天； 1 = 60–89 天； 2 = 90+ 天。它们不是根据日期、错过的分期付款、部分付款、协议或信用报告计算的。代码 0 并不意味着永不迟到。不评估实际借款人、报告规则、法律地位、贷款决定、信用评分或未来违约概率。该玩具的固定分组并不是 TransUnion 重复数据删除技术的主张。代码更改时源费率保持不变。

420d97c858bdb8725806ae307b3d4d126436daa1.src: After T years, the log of the wealth multiple has mean Tm and standard deviation s√T. A percentile is starting capital × exp(Tm + s√T × z), where z is the corresponding standard-normal quantile. Expected ending wealth is starting capital × (1 + r)T. These relations explain why changing dispersion while preserving the expected simple return can change the median without changing the mean.
420d97c858bdb8725806ae307b3d4d126436daa1.zh: T年后，财富倍数的对数有平均值 Tm 和标准差 s√T。百分位数是起始资本 × exp(Tm + s√T × z)，其中 z 是相应的标准正态分位数。预期期末财富为起始资本×(1 + r)T。这些关系解释了为什么在保持预期简单回报的同时改变离散度可以在不改变均值的情况下改变中位数。

The comparison would still not be automatically favourable: the linked cash could have earned savings interest elsewhere, and the fee would still apply. Conversely, a lower offset quote can add value through the rate-difference row. The direction of the whole result depends on both quotes, the savings assumption, the cash amount and the fee together.
420db0cbe87d98a404d2795335f91a5ff928e215.zh: 如果两笔贷款的利率相同，则利率溢价行将消失。这种比较仍然不会自动有利：相关现金可以在其他地方赚取储蓄利息，并且费用仍然适用。相反，较低的抵消报价可以通过汇率差行增加价值。整个结果的方向取决于两个报价、储蓄假设、现金金额和费用。

4247bfcb3e74c8b2fcc0096347400b3a4132995a.src: At a positive rate, a longer amortization lowers the scheduled payment but keeps money borrowed for longer. Under an unchanged rate and a fully repaid loan, total scheduled interest is payment × number of payments − original principal. A lower monthly payment can therefore accompany a larger cumulative interest bill.
4247bfcb3e74c8b2fcc0096347400b3a4132995a.zh: 在正利率下，较长的摊销会降低预定付款，但可以延长借入资金的时间。在利率不变且全额偿还贷款的情况下，计划利息总额为还款额×还款次数-原始本金。因此，较低的每月还款额可能会伴随着较高的累积利息账单。

414b8f2152568531dac7fb4d8ed8867e6857e442.src: Original three-date project illustration: an outflow immediately, an inflow exactly one year later, and a required outflow exactly two years later. Cash flows are independently entered nominal CAD and contain no taxes, financing, interim deposits, bank balances or additional terminal value. The NPV input is an effective annual discount assumption, not a promised yield or an automatically suitable hurdle rate. IRRs are mathematical roots of NPV = 0. The solver lists distinct finite roots at or above 0% only; any negative roots are outside the stated domain. A repeated root is listed once. The profile shows 0% to the greater of 30% and the selected discount input, so an admissible root beyond that range can be listed in the metric without appearing in the plot. No reinvestment or final household wealth is calculated. A later obligation remains payable regardless of how much of the earlier receipt has been spent.
414b8f2152568531dac7fb4d8ed8867e6857e442.zh: 原始的三期项目说明：立即流出，一年后流入，两年后所需流出。现金流量以名义加元独立输入，不包含税费、融资、临时存款、银行余额或额外终值。 NPV 输入是有效的年度折扣假设，而不是承诺的收益率或自动合适的门槛利率。 IRR 是 NPV = 0 的数学根。求解器仅列出等于或高于 0% 的不同有限根；任何负根都在指定域之外。重复的根仅列出一次。该配置文件显示 0% 到 30% 中的较大值以及选定的折扣输入，因此超出该范围的允许根可以在度量中列出，而不会出现在图中。不计算再投资或最终家庭财富。无论先前收据的金额有多少，后续的义务仍需支付。

4387159456e1777b61d8f050d03bd661da213b17.src: The first two charts are fixed official Canadian Housing Survey estimates for Canada (provinces only), released 21 September 2026 and reviewed 25 October 2026. They do not change with the cash controls. Reported repair needs are not prices, individual future probabilities, engineering inspections or decisions about who must pay. The last three figures use an independently invented quoted cash price, a selected extra-cost assumption, dedicated opening cash and monthly saving. The entire stressed bill is assumed to be incurred and paid once at the end of the selected month, immediately after that month’s saving. This is a cost stress, not unused contingency cash automatically treated as spent in every actual project. Both paths continue saving through the due month. Monetary inputs and the assumed bill are rounded to cents; required equal monthly saving is rounded upward to a cent. No interest, inflation, deposit schedule, grants, insurance proceeds, borrowing, legal liability, contractor-performance or repair-urgency assessment is included. Negative scheduled reserve means missing funding. The example assumes this hypothetical payer has independently established responsibility for the whole bill; reported tenure alone cannot establish that.
4387159456e1777b61d8f050d03bd661da213b17.zh: 前两张图表是加拿大住房调查官方固定估计值（仅限各省），于 2026 年 9 月 21 日发布，于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查。它们不会随着现金控制而改变。报告的维修需求不是价格、个人未来概率、工程检查或关于谁必须付款的决定。最后三个数字使用独立发明的现金报价、选定的额外成本假设、专用的期初现金和每月储蓄。假设整个压力账单在所选月末、即该月储蓄之后立即产生并支付一次。这是成本压力，而不是在每个实际项目中自动视为支出的未使用的应急现金。两种途径都会在到期月份继续储蓄。货币投入和假定账单四舍五入为美分；每月所需的等额储蓄向上舍入为一美分。不包括利息、通货膨胀、存款计划、赠款、保险收益、借款、法律责任、承包商绩效或维修紧急程度评估。负预定储备意味着资金缺失。该示例假设该假设付款人已独立确定对整个账单的责任；仅报告的任期无法证明这一点。

4421e9a364dd0f726263fbcf9060fffdfdc253e6.src: Every row replaces USD gross proceeds with the original USD acquisition cost, making the USD difference zero. The entered acquisition rate, original cost and CAD selling expense stay fixed. The rows use 80%, 100% and 120% of the acquisition rate plus the selected sale rate, with stress rates rounded to four decimals before calculation and duplicate rates removed.
