4423caac679368151ef7c32f397f105b35eac06e.src: An actual loan may instead keep total payments level, change payments after a reset, calculate interest daily, charge fees or capitalize unpaid interest. Those terms can change the principal path and require another model. Record the rate basis, outstanding debt and repayment rule together before using a rate average in a budget. The five views isolate that relationship while keeping total interest, principal repayment and affordability as separate planning questions.
4423caac679368151ef7c32f397f105b35eac06e.zh: 实际贷款可能会保持总付款水平、重置后更改付款、每日计算利息、收取费用或将未付利息资本化。这些术语可能会改变主要路径并需要另一种模型。在预算中使用平均利率之前，将利率基础、未偿债务和还款规则记录在一起。这五种观点隔离了这种关系，同时将总利息、本金偿还和负担能力作为单独的规划问题。

452820baa0ee4dcf5f73fe091e9c37f96a7d6687.src: Original hypothetical two-location example, with no actual city names, published CPI observations or live price quotes. The same quantities and quality of a modeled annual spending bundle are assumed in both locations and both periods. Each location’s own baseline cost is independently set to index 100. A current local time index equals current bundle cost divided by that location’s baseline cost, multiplied by 100. It measures change within that location; the missing cross-location price anchor cannot be recovered from the two time indexes alone. This simple fixed-bundle illustration does not reproduce official CPI basket updates, sampling or quality adjustments. The two quoted baseline costs are separate assumptions, rather than prices inferred from a CPI comparison. After obtaining current costs, the cash scenario holds them and the independently entered after-tax annual incomes constant for all completed future years. It does not apply the current index repeatedly as an annual inflation forecast. Moving cost is paid at time zero; the annual cash advantage arrives at each year-end. The cumulative line shows only the incremental B-minus-A cash difference, with no opening bank balance, financing, interest or affordability assessment. Negative annual amounts and negative cumulative differences remain visible. The bundle covers only the stated modeled recurring spending; a real comparison needs complete actual budgets, route and housing comparability, commitments, income reliability and separately available upfront cash. No tax calculation, benefit estimate, property purchase, return, borrowing or recommendation to relocate is supplied.

45cd40e03f5a7ab14a61168cc76226bbf337e766.src: The forecast should start with actual nine-month results and an explicit fourth-quarter estimate. Annualizing the best quarter can quietly embed favorable trading activity, seasonal effects and lower preference-share distributions into every future period. Each forecast change should have a named driver: revenue, expense, impaired losses, performing allowances, taxes or shares. Earnings quality improves when ordinary customer activity carries more of the growth and the need for adjustments narrows. A widening reported-to-adjusted gap would warrant a lower confidence rating even if headline adjusted EPS meets our estimate.
45cd40e03f5a7ab14a61168cc76226bbf337e766.zh: 预测应从实际的九个月结果和明确的第四季度估计开始。将最佳季度年化可以悄悄地将有利的交易活动、季节性影响和较低的优先股分布嵌入到未来的每个时期。每个预测变化都应该有一个指定的驱动因素：收入、费用、减值损失、绩效津贴、税收或股票。当普通客户活动带来更多增长并且调整需求减少时，盈利质量就会提高。即使总体调整后每股收益符合我们的预期，报告与调整后差距的扩大也会导致信心评级较低。

45ce5bee5e1dc2fbf0378798d113e88bae746413.src: The first two figures contain fixed official Survey of Financial Security estimates for persons of all ages and all family types in the ten provinces; the three territories are excluded. They are percentages of persons, not household counts or probabilities of job loss. Reference years end in 2023; the table was released 29 October 2024 and reviewed 25 October 2026. Whiskers retain the published 95% confidence bounds. The remaining figures and all metrics are separate hypothetical arithmetic. The entered annual benchmark is invented, not an official current LIM threshold or a survey classification. Entered cash is an after-cost, after-tax amount assumed available when required; the survey asset definition includes a broader set of holdings. The model does not infer household eligibility, portfolio liquidity or a recommended reserve. With zero essential expenses the expense target is zero and the expense-month ratio is unavailable.
45ce5bee5e1dc2fbf0378798d113e88bae746413.zh: 前两个数字包含对十个省份所有年龄段和所有家庭类型的人员的固定官方财务安全调查估计；这三个领土被排除在外。它们是人口百分比，而不是家庭人数或失业概率。参考年结束于 2023 年；该表于 2024 年 10 月 29 日发布，并于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审核。晶须保留已发布的 95% 置信区间。其余数字和所有指标都是单独的假设算术。输入的年度基准是发明的，而不是官方当前的 LIM 阈值或调查分类。输入的现金是成本后、税后金额，假设需要时可用；调查资产定义包括更广泛的资产。该模型不推断家庭资格、投资组合流动性或建议的储备金。如果基本费用为零，则费用目标为零，并且费用月比率不可用。

4796334e6633048a97a15886cea5bd69b2218f2e.src: Original full-year job comparison in nominal CAD. Each monthly take-home amount is entered independently after payroll deductions and is received for all twelve months. Commuting days equal days per working week × the shared number of working weeks. Return-trip cash cost and return-trip time are entered per commuting day. Other work costs are constant monthly amounts incurred throughout the year. Take-home pay less these specified work costs is a partial cash comparison, not a complete household budget. Negative remaining cash is a deficit to fund separately. No tax, gross-to-net salary conversion, bonus, benefit, employer match, moving cost, start-date gap or pension valuation is calculated. Time is shown separately without assigning an hourly money value. Paid work hours, overtime, caregiving and job quality are outside the comparison. The entered amounts are assumptions, not observed salary or commuting statistics.

It does not create CAD 51,953.72 of accessible cash, nor does it establish that borrowing against future receipts would be available or inexpensive. 485d008bd98c10f93beddcb235c8ad9e61417a9e.src: The pool starts at zero and receives the same deposit at every year-end. Its value excludes the bond itself and all coupon cash spent elsewhere. The path assumes every required deposit is actually funded, including any necessary outside top-up. The target restores a nominal amount at maturity, not purchasing power or an interim market price.

485d1fbf50b25ec6b6361979d5e1a9330b09d49a.src: A lower outflow ratio after the cap binds is not a reason to request more money. A larger payment can lower that ratio while still removing more dollars from the plan. The actual cash need and the permitted payment are separate decisions.

48c19043d8af1e856ffef5b586677dcab92df587.src: The exact annual real rate is one plus the after-tax nominal rate, divided by one plus inflation, minus one. Here that is 1.024 divided by 1.03, minus one: approximately negative 0.58%. Simply subtracting 3% from 2.4% gives a nearby approximation, rather than the exact compound relationship.
48c19043d8af1e856ffef5b586677dcab92df587.zh: 确切的年度实际利率是一加税后名义利率，除以一加通货膨胀再减一。这里是 1.024 除以 1.03，减一：大约为负 0.58%。只需从 2.4% 中减去 3% 即可得出近似值，而不是精确的复合关系。

48c1d75e8d45ccaf8c0df79c01c51ab609d0604f.src: Selling an investment changes the form of existing assets. Transferring the proceeds between accounts changes their location. Neither operation creates the sale amount as new earned income. This tool tracks a receipt’s timing without reconstructing the unsold security’s value or the household’s total net worth.
48c1d75e8d45ccaf8c0df79c01c51ab609d0604f.zh: 出售投资会改变现有资产的形式。在帐户之间转移收益会改变其位置。这两种操作都不会将销售金额创建为新的收入。该工具可以跟踪收据的时间，而无需重建未售出证券的价值或家庭总净资产。

48c2d1ed1c6da2a640e53b059c6fcba13f14fb59.src: The matrix compares first-year employer deposits across employee contribution rates and matching percentages. The selected eligible-pay cap remains fixed. Horizon, investment return and future pay growth do not affect those first-year cells; they matter to the long-term path. No cell represents an available job offer or plan entitlement.
48c2d1ed1c6da2a640e53b059c6fcba13f14fb59.zh: 该矩阵比较了第一年雇主存款与员工缴款率和匹配百分比的关系。选定的合格工资上限保持不变。视野、投资回报和未来薪资增长不会影响第一年的细胞；它们对长期道路很重要。没有单元格代表可用的工作机会或计划权利。

48c5a98e0c2e78bfd076f55b2f006d6b9fe43521.src: The four figures answer narrower questions: does the cash ledger reconcile; how much gross cash reaches the owner under the assumptions; what potential RRSP-room amount can be attributed to salary; and how sensitive is the residual dividend to a different corporate-rate input? They do not rank strategies. Change the assumptions to understand the moving pieces, then verify current rules and your actual CRA records with a qualified tax professional.

497f6937b53cbd839877e650c73af00bc8d70e79.src: Fixed official public-source snapshot checked 25 October 2026. The new-beneficiary mean refers to July 2026. Maximum retirement-pension amounts refer to new starts in each labelled month at age 65. They are not one person’s payment history, a personal quotation or a contribution record. The first two figures do not change when the cash inputs change. The last two are original household cash scenarios: pension and other income are independently entered spendable amounts after any assumed tax allowance. They are not copied from the official gross benefit statistics or capped to their mean/maximum. All cash inputs stay constant and arrive at each month-end, immediately before that month’s spending. No tax calculation, benefit entitlement, indexation, investment return, borrowing, intra-month bills or spending beyond the selected horizon is modeled. Negative balances are provisional unfunded cash, not an authorized loan.
497f6937b53cbd839877e650c73af00bc8d70e79.zh: 2026 年 10 月 25 日检查的固定官方公共来源快照。新受益人平均值指的是 2026 年 7 月。最高退休金金额是指 65 岁时每个标记月份的新起点。不是一个人的付款历史、个人报价或捐款记录。当现金投入变化时，前两个数字不会变化。最后两种是原始家庭现金情景：养老金和其他收入在任何假设的税收减免后独立输入可支出金额。它们不是从官方总效益统计数据中复制的，也不是以其平均值/最大值为上限。所有现金投入保持不变，并在每个月底、即该月支出之前到达。没有对税收计算、福利权利、指数化、投资回报、借款、月内账单或超出选定范围的支出进行建模。负余额是临时无资金支持的现金，而不是授权贷款。

4981020659c233bf36dd5ad6b931ba8571f50e26.src: The first-year bars compare average monthly housing outflows before investing any cost difference. Mortgage principal is included because it must be paid, but it also reduces debt. Therefore, the outflow bars are not a pure economic-expense comparison between rent and interest.
4981020659c233bf36dd5ad6b931ba8571f50e26.zh: 第一年的条形图比较了投资任何成本差异之前的平均每月住房流出量。抵押贷款本金被包括在内，因为它必须支付，但它也减少了债务。因此，流出栏并不是租金和利息之间纯粹的经济支出比较。

49815f1a2970d91de342bbfc2a375d71167425c7.src: The distinction matters because commercial resolutions can improve the group total while consumer migration worsens elsewhere. Provision releases and builds are forward-looking estimates, not cash receipts or losses already realized. The model should therefore distinguish the loss-rate assumption from loan growth and test both together. A weaker economy can raise provisions at the same time that slower lending restrains revenue, producing a disproportionate hit to common earnings.
49815f1a2970d91de342bbfc2a375d71167425c7.zh: 这种区别很重要，因为商业解决方案可以改善群体总数，而消费者迁移到其他地方则恶化。拨备发放和建设是前瞻性估计，而不是已经实现的现金收入或损失。因此，该模型应区分损失率假设和贷款增长，并将两者一起进行测试。经济疲软可能会提高准备金，同时贷款放缓会限制收入，从而对共同收入造成不成比例的打击。

498d5d4a06be74443c09d7a061e5dc8a4b80b8f1.src: Hypothetical six-month construction period after the selected preparation months. Base price includes all known taxes and fees. The reference base-price schedule pays 10% at the deposit date, then 30% two, four and six months later; the alternative pays 50%, 25%, 15%, 10% on those same dates. These are invented comparison schedules, not recommended deposits or legal contract terms. The selected additional approved cost is paid one month after the deposit in both cases. Monthly saving arrives before that month’s bills; month zero has no saving receipt. Accessible project cash earns zero. The required extra is the largest negative project balance over the full calendar, with no automatic borrowing or cash injection. No financing, rebates, property-value gain, insurance claim, legal holdback or emergency fund is assumed. Preparation adds saving months; prices and the six-month build duration stay fixed.
498d5d4a06be74443c09d7a061e5dc8a4b80b8f1.zh: 选定准备月份后的假设六个月建设期。基本价格包括所有已知的税费。参考基价表在存款日支付 10%，然后在二、四个和六个月后支付 30%；替代方案在同一日期支付 50%、25%、15%、10%。这些是发明的比较表，而不是推荐的存款或法律合同条款。在这两种情况下，所选的额外批准费用均在存款后一个月支付。每月的储蓄在该月的账单之前到达；零月没有储蓄收据。可获得的项目现金收益为零。所需的额外费用是整个日历中最大的负项目余额，没有自动借款或现金注入。不假定任何融资、回扣、财产价值收益、保险索赔、法律保留或应急基金。准备工作可节省数月时间；价格和六个月的建设期限保持不变。

49a2911946491c40227b3acd04ba29f38a4b4138.src: The extra fee is entered once for the entire selected period. Changing the day count does not automatically prorate it, because the model treats it as a flat arrangement cost already agreed for that period. A real fee may be monthly, annual, upfront or bundled into a package. Convert it to the same period as the interest comparison, and do not count the same charge twice.
49a2911946491c40227b3acd04ba29f38a4b4138.zh: 在整个选定期间内输入一次额外费用。更改天数不会自动按比例分配，因为模型将其视为该期间已商定的固定安排成本。实际费用可以是按月、按年、预付费用或捆绑在套餐中。将其转换为与利息比较相同的期间，并且不要将相同的费用计算两次。

49fa8eba0916b6ad50d43d16cd49ff28ec03a4d0.src: Released 19 October 2026; reviewed 25 October 2026. Reports 3.1% year-over-year all-items CPI growth for Canada in September 2026. The statistic is contextual and is not used as an input to the editable scenario.
49fa8eba0916b6ad50d43d16cd49ff28ec03a4d0.zh: 2026 年 10 月 19 日发布；审查日期为 2026 年 10 月 25 日。报告显示，2026 年 9 月加拿大所有项目 CPI 同比增长 3.1%。该统计数据是上下文相关的，不用作可编辑场景的输入。

49fba8d5c67a494af3b785d97eeae276306a8627.src: A negative waterfall endpoint remains a funding gap; the tool does not repair it with an overdraft or another loan. Other closing costs must exclude the down payment, financed premium and separately entered premium tax to prevent overlap.
49fba8d5c67a494af3b785d97eeae276306a8627.zh: 负瀑布端点仍然是资金缺口；该工具不会通过透支或其他贷款来修复它。其他成交成本必须排除首付、融资保费和单独输入的保费税，以防止重叠。

49fd183884cefea46403d8401733ef9e1f88790a.src: Both households start with the annual-price amount before the payment choice and receive the same monthly resources. The annual payer begins the plotted path after paying that price. The monthly payer holds the original cash and pays bills from new monthly resources. 4a239ea5758605ef5e04e857412df94945caafdf.src: Original hypothetical comparison in nominal CAD. One unhedged foreign-currency asset exposure is purchased at the start, with no additional deposits or withdrawals. The local-currency asset return is a total-return assumption with any distributions reinvested locally. Currency change always means the percentage change in CAD per one foreign currency unit: a positive value raises each foreign unit’s CAD value; a negative value reduces it. The same two annual factors repeat for the selected years, with no probabilities or forecast claim. The unchanged-currency comparator holds the currency quote constant and is not the result of a modeled hedge. No trading or conversion charges, taxes, inflation, borrowing, currency controls or fund-specific exposures are calculated. All values are scenario assumptions, not historical performance or current exchange-rate quotes.

4b6e1ee3c0f99fcf80da26d6b19b81b5216deebb.src: Hypothetical identical twelve-month insurance coverage. The annual price includes all known taxes and fees and is paid immediately. Monthly billing divides the annual price plus the entered total surcharge into twelve equal month-end bills, with no initial deposit. Both cases start with cash equal to the annual price and receive identical new monthly budget resources equal to the monthly bill. The annual payer saves those resources; the monthly payer uses them to pay each bill. Existing cash earns the selected effective annual return, converted monthly, before each month-end receipt and payment. No cancellation, refund, missed payment, renewal, different coverage, financing fee beyond the entered surcharge, tax on interest or use of cash for another purpose is modeled. The effective rate equates the annual price with the present value of twelve month-end bills; it is a mathematical comparison, not a quoted or legally disclosed APR. Zero annual price makes that rate undefined.
4b6e1ee3c0f99fcf80da26d6b19b81b5216deebb.zh: 假设相同的十二个月保险范围。年度价格包括所有已知的税费，并立即支付。每月计费将年度价格加上输入的附加费总额分成十二份等额的月末账单，无需初始押金。这两种情况都以相当于年度价格的现金开始，并获得与每月账单相同的新每月预算资源。年度付款人可以节省这些资源；每月付款人用它们来支付每笔账单。现有现金赚取选定的有效年度回报，每月转换一次，然后在每个月末收款和付款之前。不会对取消、退款、错过付款、续订、不同承保范围、超出输入附加费的融资费用、利息税或将现金用于其他目的进行建模。有效利率等于年价格与十二个月末账单的现值；这是一个数学比较，而不是引用或合法披露的年利率。零年度价格使得该比率未定义。

4bb4cc057fcd880a5f0e55d5135d00101bbd94dc.src: Original amortizing-loan illustration. The nominal annual rate is divided by twelve; interest accrues on the outstanding contract principal and payments arrive at each month-end. The full term equals the repayment period. A percentage fee is withheld once at origination, reducing cash received without reducing the principal owed or being added as a second financed amount. The effective cash-flow rate discounts the equal payments to that net advance and compounds its monthly rate over twelve periods. This is not a calculation of a statutory disclosed APR, legal compliance, lender eligibility or an available offer. No insurance, other fees, missed or extra payments, early settlement, taxes, irregular dates or cent-by-cent payment rounding is included; tiny final numerical residuals are reconciled at the last payment.
4bb4cc057fcd880a5f0e55d5135d00101bbd94dc.zh: 原始摊销贷款插图。名义年利率除以十二；未清偿合同本金产生利息，并在每个月末付款。完整期限等于还款期限。在发起时就扣留一定比例的费用，减少收到的现金，但不会减少所欠本金或作为第二笔融资金额添加。有效现金流量利率将等额付款折现为净预付款，并在十二个时期内复合其月利率。这不是对法定披露的年利率、法律合规性、贷款机构资格或可用报价的计算。不包括保险、其他费用、错过或额外付款、提前结算、税费、不规则日期或按分付款四舍五入；微小的最终残差在最后一次付款时进行核对。

4690295b29b68e68e016c43e7c512bf9b228ee12.src: Hypothetical thirty-year category budget beginning at retirement, with year one at the entered starting prices. Essentials increase at general inflation. Discretionary quantity is unchanged for years 1–10, then resets to the selected share from year 11; its prices still increase at general inflation. Additional care starts in the selected year. Its input is in retirement-start dollars, inflated from year one at the separate care price rate, including the years before care begins. Non-portfolio income is entered net and increases at its own assumed rate. Annual funding gap is max(spending minus income, zero). No benefit entitlement, tax, portfolio return, withdrawal order, probability of care, mortality, present value or required starting portfolio is calculated. Surplus income is not saved or carried to later years in the gap total. Care is an additional non-overlapping budget; remove displaced costs separately in a personal plan.
4690295b29b68e68e016c43e7c512bf9b228ee12.zh: 假设的三十年类别预算从退休时开始，第一年按输入的起始价格计算。必需品随着总体通货膨胀而增加。第 1-10 年的可自由支配数量保持不变，然后从第 11 年开始重置为所选份额；其价格在总体通货膨胀的情况下仍会上涨。额外护理在选定的年份开始。它的输入是退休开始美元，从第一年开始就按单独的护理价格率膨胀，包括护理开始前的几年。非投资组合收入按净额记入，并按其假定的增长率增长。年度资金缺口最大（支出减去收入，零）。不计算福利权利、税收、投资组合回报、提款令、护理概率、死亡率、现值或所需的起始投资组合。盈余收入不会在缺口总额中保存或转入以后年份。护理是一项额外的非重叠预算；

4d1b28ef33d5e182cc170a07e493abd7300e6e18.src: Original static nominal-CAD collateral illustration. This fictional contract tests debt divided by eligible collateral against the entered maximum ratio. The limit is not a CIRO, FINRA, legal or lender requirement. All entered collateral receives full eligibility value with no haircut; it falls instantly by the selected percentage. Debt stays fixed until the illustrated adjustment, with no interest, fees, tax, price slippage or intervening transactions. The selected loan-to-collateral ratio is 71.43%. External repayment reduces debt while keeping this collateral fixed. Posting additional eligible collateral leaves debt fixed. Both use resources outside the initially entered collateral pool and are alternative mathematical cases, not costs to add together or rights under an actual agreement. Under the same fictional terms, selling CAD 20,000 of existing collateral and using all proceeds immediately to repay debt would meet the test, leaving CAD 50,000 of collateral and CAD 30,000 of debt. No response deadline, sale price, extension, acceptable deposit or ability to transact is promised. Actual contracts and eligibility can differ or change.
4d1b28ef33d5e182cc170a07e493abd7300e6e18.zh: 原始静态名义加元附属插图。该虚构合约测试债务除以合格抵押品与输入的最大比率。该限制不是 CIRO、FINRA、法律或贷款机构的要求。所有输入的抵押品都会获得完整的资格价值，没有折扣；它会立即按选定的百分比下降。在所示的调整之前，债务保持固定，没有利息、费用、税收、价格滑点或干预交易。选定的贷款抵押比为71.43%。外部偿还减少了债务，同时保持了抵押品的固定。提供额外的合格抵押品可以使债务保持固定。两者都使用最初输入的抵押品池之外的资源，并且是替代数学案例，而不是加在一起的成本或实际协议下的权利。根据相同的虚构条款，出售 20,000 加元的现有抵押品并立即使用所有收益来偿还债务将满足测试要求，留下 50,000 加元的抵押品和 30,000 加元的债务。不承诺回复截止日期、销售价格、延期、可接受的押金或交易能力。实际合同和资格可能有所不同或发生变化。

4c541d2f7963635ff1c29be6c3fa062ad44a19a7.src: Credit normalization is another part of quality, even though it does not appear in the issuer adjustment list. A release of expected-loss allowances is a legitimate accounting outcome. It also reduces the credit burden below a case that assumes no further release. Our operating forecast therefore makes the total annual PCL assumption visible, and the stress tool adds a separate credit charge rather than asserting that the latest credit outcome repeats indefinitely.
4c541d2f7963635ff1c29be6c3fa062ad44a19a7.zh: 信用标准化是质量的另一部分，尽管它没有出现在发行人调整列表中。释放预期损失准备金是合法的会计结果。它还将信用负担降低到假设不再进一步释放的情况下。因此，我们的运营预测使年度总 PCL 假设可见，压力工具增加了单独的信贷费用，而不是断言最新的信贷结果无限期地重复。

Under this annual convention, modified duration divides that number by 1 + 0.05, giving approximately 7.7217. The CFA Institute public duration overview distinguishes these measures and explains the limits of linear price estimates.

4e0cc74643824b21f9bd72e309ec423775f64212.src: Hypothetical funding and repayment exercise. Use uncommitted cash first, then draw only what remains needed and accessible from the entered unused borrowing limit. The availability percentage is an independent stress assumption, not a forecast or interpretation of a credit agreement. Unfunded bill amounts remain separate from debt actually drawn. For the next 24 months, interest on opening debt is paid in full each month at nominal annual rate divided by 12, plus the selected principal repayment capped at outstanding debt. 4ddf0e841997640ec9a86d8db0d3ef4c3d102ae5.src: Original contribution-only allocation illustration. The portfolio starts with selected capital and receives equal year-end contributions. Every asset earns zero return before the separate shock comparison, so the balance is capital plus deposits rather than an investment forecast. The planned equity share changes linearly between the selected endpoints; each year-end portfolio is reset to that mix without transaction costs or tax. The remaining allocation is called other assets. In the isolated one-time shock, only equities fall and other assets do not change; that is a scenario assumption, not a claim that other assets are safe. Start, peak-exposure and target shocks are separate snapshots, not sequential losses on one path. No withdrawals, inflation, fees, rebalancing restrictions, actual fund holdings or adequate-retirement-income assessment is included. A target-date fund’s actual glide path may differ; the model stops at the selected target.
4ddf0e841997640ec9a86d8db0d3ef4c3d102ae5.zh: 原始贡献分配插图。该投资组合从选定的资本开始，并收到同等的年终捐款。在单独冲击比较之前，每项资产的收益为零，因此余额是资本加存款，而不是投资预测。计划的股权份额在选定的端点之间线性变化；每个年终投资组合都会重置为该组合，无需交易成本或税收。剩余的分配称为其他资产。在孤立的一次性冲击中，只有股票下跌，其他资产不变；这是一种情景假设，而不是声称其他资产是安全的。开始、峰值暴露和目标冲击是单独的快照，而不是一条路径上的连续损失。不包括提款、通货膨胀、费用、再平衡限制、实际基金持有量或充足的退休收入评估。目标日期基金的实际下滑路径可能有所不同；模型在选定的目标处停止。

4d78dcfbdfe740fcb9fe8421d82a8ac35dd2bd5c.src: Hypothetical gross cash comparison from the election date, assuming both fully completed payment options buy the same separately quoted additional pension. Upfront cost is paid now; deductions begin at month one. Pension payments begin at the end of month (waiting years × 12 + 1), rise once after each twelve payments, and continue for thirty receipt years conditional on survival. Monthly discounting uses the effective annual nominal rate. All scheduled deductions fit inside this full horizon. Quoted deductions are entered directly, not derived from a loan rate. No tax deduction, PSPA, RRSP transfer, eligibility, bridge-benefit change, survivor benefit, death probability, refund, investment alternative or plan approval is calculated. Present value is conditional cash arithmetic, not actuarial value or a recommendation.
4d78dcfbdfe740fcb9fe8421d82a8ac35dd2bd5c.zh: 从选举日期开始的假设总现金比较，假设两种完全完成的支付选项购买相同的单独报价的额外养老金。预付费用现已支付；扣除从第一个月开始。养老金支付从月底开始（等待年数×12+1），每十二次支付后增加一次，并以生存为条件持续三十年。每月贴现使用有效年度名义利率。所有预定的扣除都在这个完整的范围内。报价扣除额是直接输入的，而不是从贷款利率得出的。不计算减税、PSPA、RRSP 转移、资格、过桥福利变更、遗属福利、死亡概率、退款、投资替代方案或计划批准。现值是有条件的现金算术，而不是精算值或建议。

4cf224f9503831b11f094419161eb0d87c764b55.src: A home-value assumption does not change the loan’s compounding rate. Likewise, slower home appreciation does not automatically reduce the amount owed in the model. Keeping these assumptions independent makes the effect of each visible.
4cf224f9503831b11f094419161eb0d87c764b55.zh: 房屋价值假设不会改变贷款的复利利率。同样，房屋升值速度放缓并不会自动减少模型中的欠款金额。保持这些假设的独立性可以使每个假设的影响可见。

4cf533fce2cfb4c85e4afbaedc389cb413d9f890.src: The first-year stacked bars divide actual cash paid between principal and interest. A principal payment reduces the liability; interest is the cost of borrowing. The accelerated path has more principal reduction in part because it receives more cash. Its lower individual payment than the monthly amount should not be read as a smaller annual commitment.
4cf533fce2cfb4c85e4afbaedc389cb413d9f890.zh: 第一年的堆积条将实际支付的现金除以本金和利息。本金还款减少了负债；利息是借贷成本。加速路径有更多的本金减少，部分原因是它收到了更多的现金。其个人付款额低于每月金额，不应被视为较小的年度承诺。

4eb070341ab32f32c70732657d64f088c2f631f6.src: All values are annual national-accounts group means in current CAD per household, from one public 13 April 2026 vintage, covering 2021–2025. The 75 selected observations use Canada, “Value per household,” five income quintiles and three canonical measures. They are not medians, personal salary thresholds, bank deposits, account balances or inflation-adjusted dollars. Income quintiles are assigned using equivalized household disposable income; the plotted values are per household, not per consumption unit. Social transfers in kind are added service and goods value, not an extra general-purpose cash transfer. Same-named same-named entries were reconciled and not counted twice. Four of the 25 published income identities differ by CAD 1 because values are rounded to whole dollars; the bridge preserves that residual. No missing or flagged observation was filled with zero.
4eb070341ab32f32c70732657d64f088c2f631f6.zh: 所有值均为年度国民账户组平均值，以每户当前加元计算，来自 2026 年 4 月 13 日的一个公开年份，涵盖 2021-2025 年。 75 个选定的观察结果使用了加拿大的“每户价值”、五个收入五分位数和三个规范指标。它们不是中位数、个人工资门槛、银行存款、账户余额或通货膨胀调整后的美元。收入五分位是使用等值家庭可支配收入来分配的；绘制的值是按家庭计算的，而不是按消费单位计算的。实物社会转移是附加服务和商品价值，而不是额外的通用现金转移。相同名称的同名条目已被核对并且不会被计算两次。 25 个公布的收入恒式中，有 4 个相差 1 加元，因为数值四舍五入为整数；这座桥保留了剩余的部分。没有缺失或标记的观察结果均以零填充。

50737d8ac5a329f4dd9f44ea320b13f6b3269546.src: Original hypothetical CAD quotation arithmetic at one date, not an actual policy appraisal or a recommendation to surrender, retain, replace or borrow. The death input is the complete conditional death amount before the stated loan debit, not base face to which cash value is automatically added. The surrender input is already after contract surrender charges but before the same loan debit and any tax. The loan is an existing insurer policy loan including accrued interest at that date; no new advance is received. Each alternative deducts that loan once. Full surrender ends this example’s coverage; the death branch assumes a covered payable claim and no prior surrender. Amounts concern different recipients and alternative events, and are not added or present-valued. This teaching case accepts only loan ≤ surrender quote ≤ total death quote; those arithmetic limits establish neither borrowing eligibility nor continuing coverage. No future policy value, dividend, premium, interest accrual, lapse threshold, withdrawal, external collateral loan, claim delay, tax or fee estimate is modeled. Obtain the actual quote basis and policy status before treating any amount as available cash.
50737d8ac5a329f4dd9f44ea320b13f6b3269546.zh: 某一日期的原始假设加元报价算术，不是实际的保单评估或放弃、保留、替换或借用的建议。死亡输入是规定贷款借记之前的完整有条件死亡金额，而不是自动添加现金价值的基础面。退保投入已经在合同退保​​费用之后，但在相同的贷款借方和任何税费之前。该贷款是现有的保险公司保单贷款，包括该日的应计利息；没有收到新的预付款。每个替代方案都会扣除该贷款一次。完全投降结束了这个例子的覆盖范围；死亡部门承担承保的应付索赔，并且没有事先退保。金额涉及不同的接收者和替代事件，并且不增加或现值。本教学案例仅接受贷款≤退保报价≤全死亡报价；这些算术限制既不能确定借款资格，也不能确定持续承保范围。没有对未来保单价值、股息、保费、应计利息、失效阈值、提款、外部抵押贷款、索赔延迟、税收或费用估算进行建模。在将任何金额视为可用现金之前，请先获取实际报价基础和保单状态。

The strongest falsifier of the turnaround thesis would be renewed credit deterioration alongside capital pressure and stagnant core income. At the current premium to book, investors should demand proof of the former while keeping explicit room for the latter in scenario valuation.

50d5dcb15ace63d9c49ca84e8a182ad520c4f278.src: Original hypothetical nominal-CAD TFSA illustration using the ordinary-room framework in the cited CRA guidance, reviewed 25 October 2026. The opening contribution is assumed lawful and already completed; the separately entered unused room is the reconciled amount remaining across all the holder’s TFSAs afterward. The holder is assumed eligible and resident in Canada throughout the illustrated sequence. One investment-value change is followed by one ordinary withdrawal; proceeds remain as outside cash with no spending or further return. The investment-value change alters account value but not unused contribution room. The ordinary withdrawal’s amount is added back on 1 January of the next calendar year, not immediately. The next-year room chart is only carried unused room plus this withdrawal’s addback: it deliberately excludes the new annual dollar limit and every other transaction or adjustment, so it is not a full next-year room calculation. No actual contribution request, excess tax, fee, direct transfer, specified distribution, non-resident period, non-qualified investment or personal eligibility determination is modeled.
50d5dcb15ace63d9c49ca84e8a182ad520c4f278.zh: 使用所引用的 CRA 指南中的普通房间框架的原始假设名义 CAD TFSA 说明，于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查。开仓供款假定合法且已完成；单独输入的未使用房间是之后所有持有人的 TFSA 中剩余的调节金额。在整个所示顺序中，持有者被假定为符合资格并且居住在加拿大。一次投资价值变化之后是一次普通撤回；收益仍作为外部现金，没有支出或进一步回报。投资价值的变化会改变账户价值，但不会改变未使用的供款空间。普通提款金额会在下一个日历年的 1 月 1 日加回，而不是立即加回。明年的房间图表仅包含未使用的房间加上本次提款的附加值：它故意排除新的年度美元限额和所有其他交易或调整，因此它不是完整的明年房间计算。未对实际供款请求、超额税收、费用、直接转账、指定分配、非居民期、不合格投资或个人资格确定进行建模。

512f83a78cc91bcc3c0d7ee227f23c57e07feb84.src: Hypothetical single benefit category with confirmed eligible bills for 24 consecutive months, beginning at the start of a benefit year. Each twelve-month service year resets the deductible and insurer-payment maximum. The annual maximum caps benefit dollars, not eligible expenses. Deductible applies first, then the coverage percentage, then the remaining benefit maximum. Eligibility and prices are assumed confirmed independently; no claim adjudication is calculated. Each bill is paid before that month’s income allocation and reimbursement receipts arrive at month-end. Reimbursement follows the entered whole-month lag, including zero. A payment received in a later year still consumes the benefit year of its service. The chart continues after month 24 only to collect delayed receipts; no more bills or allocations occur then. No premiums, clinical decision, treatment scheduling advice, coordination of benefits, tax credit, policy interpretation, return or borrowing is modeled. Negative cash is an unfunded bill, not credit approval.
512f83a78cc91bcc3c0d7ee227f23c57e07feb84.zh: 假设的单一福利类别，从福利年度开始起连续 24 个月确认符合条件的账单。每十二个月的服务年度都会重置免赔额和保险公司的最高付款额。年度最高限额为福利金额，不包括合格费用。首先适用免赔额，然后是承保百分比，最后是剩余福利最高限额。假定资格和价格是独立确认的；不计算索赔裁决。每张账单均在该月的收入分配和报销收据于月底到达之前支付。报销按照输入的整月滞后进行，包括零。稍后一年收到的付款仍会消耗其服务的福利年。该图表在第 24 个月后继续，仅收集延迟收据；然后就不再发生账单或分配。没有对保费、临床决策、治疗安排建议、福利协调、税收抵免、政策解释、回报或借款进行建模。负现金是指无资金支持的账单，而不是信贷审批。

5176a35c4eb079c3c199f73da4130c96327d2903.src: The first two figures use fixed 2025 Bank of Canada consumer-purchase payment shares, reviewed 25 October 2026; report metadata is dated August 2026. The nine published payment bins are retained. The second figure explicitly combines three credit bins and three debit bins for a one-year calculation; standalone Credit/Debit in the first figure are not those combined totals. The 2025 categories cannot be fully harmonized with earlier years. Source rounding is preserved, with count shares summing to 100.0% and value shares to 100.1%; no normalization or personal probability is inferred. The final three figures are a separate invented purchase tally, not a reconstruction of the survey. Each purchase has one method; assumed mean final prices include applicable taxes and are rounded to cents. There are no refunds, fees, split tenders or currency conversions. Counts are whole numbers. Count shares require a positive total count; dollar shares require positive total dollars. Empty distributions display an empty ring and unavailable shares. An entered ticket for a method with no purchases contributes no dollars. The tally calculates no income, available cash, card repayment, interest, rewards, merchant acceptance, outage or fraud risk. A credit purchase is counted once at purchase; later settlement is a separate cash-flow question.
5176a35c4eb079c3c199f73da4130c96327d2903.zh: 前两个数字使用固定的 2025 年加拿大银行消费者购买付款份额，于 10 月 25 日审查2026；报告元数据的日期为 2026 年 8 月。保留九个已发布的付款箱。第二个数字明确结合了三个贷款机构仓和三个借方仓以进行一年的计算；第一个图中的独立贷款机构/借方不是这些合计总额。 2025 年的类别无法与往年完全一致。保留来源四舍五入，计数份额总计为 100.0%，价值份额总计为 100.1%；没有推断出标准化或个人概率。最后三个数字是单独发明的购买统计，而不是调查的重建。每次购买都有一种方法；假设平均最终价格包括适用的税费并四舍五入为美分。不存在退款、费用、分割投标或货币兑换。计数为整数。计数股份要求总计数为正；美元股票需要正总美元。空分配显示空环和不可用的共享。为没有购买的方法输入的票证不会贡献任何资金。该统计不计算收入、可用现金、卡还款、利息、奖励、商户承兑、中断或欺诈风险。信用购买在购买时计算一次；后期结算是一个单独的现金流问题。

520f0be86426bc894e6c37c2269ea0867eba0e40.src: Neither mean can be reconstructed accurately by assigning arbitrary midpoints to the displayed duration bins. The longest bin is open-ended, and the table does not reveal the individual durations within each category. Likewise, a change in the mean alone does not explain whether hiring conditions changed for a particular occupation, place or worker. The selected source table supplies point estimates without observation-specific confidence bounds; the charts do not invent them or claim a statistically tested change.
520f0be86426bc894e6c37c2269ea0867eba0e40.zh: 通过向显示的持续时间段分配任意中点，都无法准确重建这两种均值。最长的分箱是开放式的，并且该表没有显示每个类别中的单独持续时间。同样，仅平均值的变化并不能解释特定职业、地点或工人的招聘条件是否发生变化。所选源表提供点估计，没有特定于观察的置信界限；这些图表并非发明它们或声称经过统计检验的变化。

521f59d8b1510298ef71b0c84a2887d1d4153ce2.src: In year four alone, however, the mark-rule fee of CAD 2,160 exceeds the annual-reset fee of CAD 2,073.60. That does not contradict the earlier loss-recovery protection. The mark-rule account retained more capital and consequently generated a larger later dollar gain. Compare each eligible base and the complete path, rather than assuming that one fee rule must produce a smaller dollar charge in every single year.
521f59d8b1510298ef71b0c84a2887d1d4153ce2.zh: 然而，仅在第四年，2,160 加元的标记规则费用就超过了年度重置费用费用 2,073.60 加元。这与之前的损失恢复保护并不矛盾。标记规则账户保留了更多的资本，因此产生了更大的后期美元收益。比较每个符合条件的基础和完整路径，而不是假设一项费用规则必须在每一年产生较小的美元费用。

522193649965c6a6ce9bd4ef437696a6b7a2856a.src: Showing changes makes this transfer visible beside a larger face holding. The chart ends before the sale and excludes both fees. Between the chosen purchase and sale quotes, the clean-value path is assumed linear; it is not a bond-pricing model or a forecast.
522193649965c6a6ce9bd4ef437696a6b7a2856a.zh: 显示更改使此转让在更大面额持有旁边可见。该图表在销售之前结束，不包括这两项费用。在选定的购买和销售报价之间，清洁价值路径假设为线性；它不是债券定价模型或预测。

53100070edb36d1326a65b3288048558f894aefe.src: The default case pays CAD 30,000 at the start, then CAD 1,300 of first-year dues and a CAD 100 booking charge in each year with use. It uses seven nights per year for a fifteen-year reporting window. Dues rise by an assumed 4% annually, and a hypothetical CAD 5,000 assessment arrives in year eight.
53100070edb36d1326a65b3288048558f894aefe.zh: 默认情况下，首先支付 30,000 加元，然后支付 1,300 加元的第一年会费，并在使用后每年支付 100 加元的预订费。它每年使用七个晚上作为十五年的报告窗口。假定会费每年上涨 4%，假设在第八年评估为 5,000 加元。

531051a60685acbcc288d299f1782cd554e27bf3.src: The loan begins at the undiscounted full price. Its fee is paid from cash rather than financed. Identical ownership of the purchased item is omitted from both cash comparisons; no resale or depreciation estimate is needed to compare these two payment methods.
531051a60685acbcc288d299f1782cd554e27bf3.zh: 贷款以未贴现的全价开始。其费用以现金支付，而非融资。两次现金比较中都忽略了所购买物品的相同所有权；比较这两种付款方式不需要转售或折旧估算。

5312456a7fa74f785d8b48e0e529228f9d3d6648.src: The transfer date is an editable input. Days one through twenty-eight exist in every month, so the selected instruction has twelve occurrences. The separate month-end comparison uses each month’s actual final calendar day. Neither schedule includes holidays, bank holds, transfer delays or a change in payroll policy.
5312456a7fa74f785d8b48e0e529228f9d3d6648.zh: 转移日期是可编辑的输入。每个月都有第一天到第二十八天，因此所选指令有十二次出现。单独的月末比较使用每个月的实际最后日历日。这两个时间表均不包括假期、银行暂扣、转账延迟或工资政策变更。

5316ee21dad3d996a7f361ceb6121532bca9a3b2.src: Two further numbers stay outside that equation. The amount due or arrears is what the provider states is payable, with its own deadline. A refund is a separate return of cash already paid. Neither is produced automatically by the sign of the running difference.
5316ee21dad3d996a7f361ceb6121532bca9a3b2.zh: 另外两个数字不在此列。 应付金额或拖欠金额是提供商规定的应付金额，有其自己的截止日期。 退款是对已支付的现金进行单独返还。两者都不是通过运行差异的符号自动生成的。

5318ef30ecd0c27f2c5f339ef6ee4184687f90d0.src: After the CAD 100 selling cost, that particular CAD 20,000 sale has a modeled gain of CAD 7,900: CAD 20,000 minus CAD 12,000 minus CAD 100. The tool then earmarks the entered 25% of that full positive gain, or CAD 1,975. Only CAD 17,925 remains available for the spending goal.
5318ef30ecd0c27f2c5f339ef6ee4184687f90d0.zh: 在 100 加元的销售成本之后，特定的 20,000 加元销售的建模收益为 7,900 加元：20,000 加元减去 12,000 加元减去 100 加元。然后，该工具指定输入的全部正收益的 25%，即 CAD 1,975。只剩下 17,925 加元可用于支出目标。

5326eb8710c3511ecdb24b4fc051b6e001425cf8.src: Suppose a purchase list contains six small cash purchases, three debit purchases and one larger credit purchase. A count-based chart gives every purchase one unit. A dollar-based chart instead weights each purchase by its amount. The same list can therefore have very different method shares without any arithmetic error.
5326eb8710c3511ecdb24b4fc051b6e001425cf8.zh: 假设购买清单包含六笔小额现金购买、三笔借记购买和一笔较大额信用购买。基于计数的图表为每次购买提供一个单位。相反，基于美元的图表按每次购买的金额进行加权。因此，同一个列表可以有非常不同的方法共享，而不会出现任何算术错误。

533150f18cb6485c4909201c9a4c7c88374c87bc.src: A positive endpoint is a shortfall; a negative endpoint is money above the modeled target. The headline floors a shortfall at zero, while this signed reconciliation retains any surplus. The starting balance and every new contribution are counted once.
533150f18cb6485c4909201c9a4c7c88374c87bc.zh: 积极的终点是不足；积极的终点是不足。负端点是高于模型目标的资金。标题将缺口定为零，而签署的和解协议保留了任何盈余。起始余额和每笔新捐款均计算一次。

FCU means the chosen foreign-currency measurement unit; it does not identify every operating exposure of a fund. The investment is unhedged, with no contributions or withdrawals; all distributions remain invested in FCU and are already included in total return. Starting and ending quotes are CAD per 1 FCU. A positive quote change increases each FCU’s CAD value. Trading and reporting currency labels do not establish the underlying exposure. No fees, conversion spread, taxes, inflation or actual hedge result is calculated. Do not translate a return already reported in CAD again. Quote and FCU labels are rounded for display; calculations retain precision.

536ea008eea7f5ca0185770257db4e751700b9fc.src: Teaching arithmetic for a hypothetical full repayment of a closed mortgage during its term, with no prepayment privilege assumed. Three months means balance × annual contract rate × 3/12. Simple IRD means constant balance × positive annual rate difference × remaining months/12. The selected illustrative rule takes the higher amount. 544d0f04ff05a16a5079796cb2305f4d819dc071.src: Under fixed thresholds, more of the inflation-adjusted salary increase can enter higher nominal slices. This effect is often called bracket creep. Full threshold indexation alone does not guarantee a household’s expenses, benefits or actual take-home income move in step.
544d0f04ff05a16a5079796cb2305f4d819dc071.zh: 在固定阈值下，更多经通胀调整的工资增长可以进入更高的名义切片。这种效应通常称为支架蠕变。尽管存在这种影响，实际加薪仍然可以提高净购买力；比较必须保留实际薪酬假设。仅完全阈值指数化并不能保证家庭的支出、福利或实际实得收入同步变化。

Fractional units are retained mathematically, without promising a broker can execute that quantity. No bid–ask spread, commission, separate expense deduction, tax, currency conversion, settlement delay or new cash flow is added. NAV change is a selected price change, not a total-return or annual-return forecast. No ETF, actual quote, current premium, historical spread or future exit opportunity is estimated.

546264de1480a24f45e1efb2270005a3d4f763da.src: The first two figures use a dated public extract of all-gender Canadian Survey on Disability estimates for 2017 and 2022, from Statistics Canada Table 1.1.A modified 28 May 2024 and reviewed 25 October 2026. Source rates are published percent; charts store them as fractions. These are estimates of disability prevalence for the survey’s covered population, not annual incidence, a lifetime probability, an insurance-claim probability or a measure of inability to work. The source’s 95% confidence intervals are retained in the first figure and its data table. The controls affect only a separate arithmetic illustration: two invented populations containing ages 25–64 and 65+, with fixed 2022 subgroup estimates and chosen age shares. Ages 15–24 are excluded from that illustration. Neither selected share is an observed national age mix. The last two charts and headline aggregates are derived scenarios, with no confidence interval or forecast inferred from subgroup bounds. Changing a share does not alter any source estimate.
546264de1480a24f45e1efb2270005a3d4f763da.zh: 前两个数字使用了 2017 年和 2022 年全性别加拿大残疾调查估计的已注明日期的公开摘录，摘自加拿大统计局表 1.1.A，于 2024 年 5 月 28 日修改并于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查。图表将它们存储为分数。这些是对调查覆盖人群的残疾患病率的估计，而不是年发病率、终生概率、保险索赔概率或无法工作的衡量标准。源的 95% 置信区间保留在第一个图及其数据表中。这些控制仅影响一个单独的算术说明：两个发明的人口，包含年龄在 25-64 岁和 65 岁以上的人口，具有固定的 2022 年亚组估计值和选定的年龄比例。 15 至 24 岁的人被排除在该说明之外。这两个选定的比例都不是观察到的全国年龄组合。最后两个图表和标题汇总是派生情景，没有从子组界限推断出的置信区间或预测。更改份额不会改变任何来源估算。

55671adb2d2ef0e45feb947c5f8fb8f70572634c.src: The model follows one inventory batch, one sale, one operating expense and one proposed owner transfer over six months. It is a cash-planning illustration, rather than formal financial statements or a determination of salary, dividend or taxable income. All amounts and dates are hypothetical, and the customer is assumed to pay the full invoice.
55671adb2d2ef0e45feb947c5f8fb8f70572634c.zh: 该模型遵循六个月内一批库存、一笔销售、一项运营费用和一项拟议的所有者转让。它是现金计划说明，而不是正式的财务报表或工资、股息或应税收入的确定。所有金额和日期均为假设，并且假设客户支付了全部发票。

556cf84419cf11ebb8bebd03737d810e21bc4e05.src: Contributions are summed across their actual modeled years. The growth step can be negative. Employer funding is a contribution, rather than an annualized investment return or cash automatically available for withdrawal.
556cf84419cf11ebb8bebd03737d810e21bc4e05.zh: 捐款是在实际建模年份中汇总的。增长步长可以是负数。雇主资金是一种捐款，而不是年化投资回报或自动可提取的现金。

556e5ced5538bf6f065a43f356051f57e71d4df4.src: The variation control scales the authored deviations from the first-price base. At 100%, the default six-price shape is 1, 0.8, 0.6, 0.9, 1.2 and 1 times the base. Zero variation makes all execution prices equal. Changing it does not select a historical market episode or assign probabilities to a decline.
556e5ced5538bf6f065a43f356051f57e71d4df4.zh: 变化控制可衡量与第一价格基础的编写偏差。在 100% 时，默认的六种价格形状为基数的 1、0.8、0.6、0.9、1.2 和 1 倍。零变化使所有执行价格相同。更改它不会选择历史市场事件或指定下跌的概率。

54237002796ff45b54cd1562ca589f6b1d370ae9.src: Hypothetical three-debt schedules. Interest is charged monthly at nominal annual rate / 12 before month-end payments. Each active debt first receives its entered fixed base payment, capped at amount owed. The initial active base payments plus extra form one fixed household budget; released or unused base payments roll to the priority debt in the same month. Highest-rate order breaks ties by balance; smallest-balance order uses balances after base payments and breaks ties by rate, then debt letter. Zero starting debts receive no budget allocation. No fees, new borrowing, changing rates, contractual minimum-payment formula, arrears or credit-score effects are modeled. Not repaid means not cleared within 120 months; interest for an incomplete schedule is partial.
54237002796ff45b54cd1562ca589f6b1d370ae9.zh: 假设的三债务时间表。每月在月底付款前按名义年利率/12 收取利息。每笔活跃债务首先收到其输入的固定基本付款，上限为所欠金额。初始主动基本付款加上固定家庭预算的额外费用；已释放或未使用的基本付款在同月转入优先债务。最高费率订单通过平衡打破平局；最小余额顺序使用基本付款后的余额，并按利率打破联系，然后是债务信函。零起始债务没有预算分配。没有对费用、新借款、利率变化、合同最低付款公式、欠款或信用评分影响进行建模。未偿还指120个月内未清偿；不完整的时间表的利息是部分的。

56963231d70df331a5b88ee51f595aeea881d68d.src: Original hypothetical fixed-quantity goal, priced in nominal CAD. The goal price rises at the entered constant effective annual rate, compounded proportionally across months. The saving account earns its own constant effective annual return converted monthly; contributions arrive at month-end after growth. Starting savings belong exclusively to this goal. The solver uses the same horizon, rates and payment timing and floors the required contribution at zero when starting funds already cover the modeled target. No withdrawals, fees, tax, account contribution limits, uncertain returns, price volatility, credit or changes in the goal quantity are modeled. The goal-price increase is not a forecast for homes, tuition or consumer prices. All alternative deadlines reprice the goal at their own date.
56963231d70df331a5b88ee51f595aeea881d68d.zh: 最初假设的固定数量目标，以名义加元计价。目标价格按照输入的恒定有效年率上涨，并按月按比例复利。储蓄账户每月赚取自己的恒定有效年化收益；捐款在增长后于月底到达。开始储蓄完全属于这个目标。当启动资金已经覆盖建模目标时，求解器使用相同的范围、利率和付款时间，并将所需的贡献降至零。没有对提款、费用、税收、账户供款限制、不确定的回报、价格波动、信贷或目标数量的变化进行建模。目标价格上涨并不是对住房、学费或消费价格的预测。所有替代截止日期都会在各自的日期重新定价目标。

58195b6c4137e3c63708617812b632cb08ff165b.src: Each line starts with today’s net cash outlay and adds year-end running costs. Only the final point subtracts the entered exit sale receipt, so a final decline can be a sale effect rather than lower running costs. Connecting segments join discrete year-end observations; they do not imply that bills or sale receipts arrive continuously. Neither line includes the original price already paid. The same end date and required service apply to both alternatives.
58195b6c4137e3c63708617812b632cb08ff165b.zh: 每条线都从今天的净现金支出开始，并增加年终运行成本。只有最后一个点减去输入的退出销售收据，因此最终下降可能是销售效果，而不是较低的运行成本。连接片段连接离散的年终观察结果；它们并不意味着账单或销售收据会连续到达。这两行均不包含已支付的原始价格。两种选择均适用相同的结束日期和所需服务。

581ce6a496f28fe3f36a59790c3659492d5a6059.src: A household balance sheet records what you own and what you owe. Net worth is assets − liabilities. The Financial Consumer Agency of Canada’s financial-planning lesson explains this calculation using current values and distinguishes the balance sheet from the household budget.
581ce6a496f28fe3f36a59790c3659492d5a6059.zh: 家庭资产负债表记录您拥有的资产和所欠的资产。净值是资产-负债。 加拿大金融消费者管理局的财务规划课程使用当前值解释了这一计算，并将资产负债表与家庭预算区分开来。

5820ac32fc4c27c6698bce02a8a415cff796d541.src: Define the baseline and fund the upfront cost first. Then test the savings, maintenance and useful operating horizon rather than treating one payback number as a guarantee.
5820ac32fc4c27c6698bce02a8a415cff796d541.zh: 定义基线并首先支付前期费用。然后测试节省、维护和有用的运营期限，而不是将一个投资回收期数字视为一种保证。

582208be295592f0e2c97bd8e6f6e4dd69356465.src: This is a budget subtotal rather than the bond’s return. A negative endpoint means the coupon cannot fund the whole reserve deposit: there is no coupon left for spending and outside cash would be needed for the deficit. A price at or below face value creates no positive premium gap and requires no premium reserve in this model.
582208be295592f0e2c97bd8e6f6e4dd69356465.zh: 这是预算小计，而不是债券的回报。负端点意味着优惠券无法为全部准备金存款提供资金：没有剩余的优惠券可用于支出，并且需要外部现金来弥补赤字。在此模型中，等于或低于面值的价格不会产生正的保费差距，也不需要保费准备金。

5912722ef45635055a0e863f9e37e25b168be6ea.src: There is no universal 60/40 balanced fund. Sixty percent equities and forty percent bonds are simply the starting illustration here. A balanced mutual fund and an asset-allocation ETF may provide similar broad exposures while differing in implementation, pricing, distribution channels and charges. Compare the actual exposure and full cost of the available series or share class.
5912722ef45635055a0e863f9e37e25b168be6ea.zh: 没有通用的 60/40 平衡基金。百分之六十的股票和百分之四十的债券只是这里的开始说明。平衡共同基金和资产配置 ETF 可能提供类似的广泛风险敞口，但在实施、定价、分销渠道和收费方面有所不同。比较可用系列或份额类别的实际风险和全部成本。

5914924fa30cc430c775847a82ce431780380f2f.src: Check whether employer coverage continues after a job change and whether the benefit amount, policy term and conditions match the period being modeled. 5918613d667636388debf8151fd89d2e549cd113.src: The monthly scenario must first fund three months before its first benefit receipt. Those months create a cumulative CAD 15,000 deficit. During months four through fifteen, benefit payments and other income exceed recurring spending by CAD 1,500 a month. The final three months have no modeled benefit and consume CAD 3,000 each. The ending balance is CAD 4,000, but an earlier point still falls below zero.
5918613d667636388debf8151fd89d2e549cd113.zh: 每月方案必须在收到第一份福利之前三个月首先提供资金。这几个月累计出现了 15,000 加元的赤字。在第四个月到十五个月期间，福利金和其他收入每月超出经常性支出 1,500 加元。最后三个月没有建模效益，每个月消耗 3,000 加元。期末余额为 4,000 加元，但之前的点仍低于零。

5919ae2d9533ba1d00a8bb11689de79ef1c44c5c.src: The reference-day denominator differs from reporting unpaid care at any time over twelve months. 58a0df3d3fa89c02d9375b76691eaa11968ec9f6.src: A home can be valuable while supplying little cash for monthly bills. Borrowing against it can convert some financing capacity into spendable money, but the cash arrives with a liability. A useful plan therefore tracks both the money delivered and the amount that will eventually need to be addressed.

58a4a146638fd00d2da17e60870a2d2c612e2a82.src: That threshold is slightly different from dividing CAD 30 by CAD 10,000, because the exit spread concession also grows with the exit midpoint. The tool solves the cash equality directly rather than treating every cost as a fixed opening-dollar amount.

59411bd94806adaf0aaaec7de1448d4341727968.src: Two fixed official source charts describe 2022 Time Use Survey daily person estimates, released 5 June 2024 and reviewed 25 October 2026. All-person daily means and activity-specific participant means have different denominators; daily participation is not past-year caregiver participation. These observations do not populate the controls. The final three figures are independent invented time and cash plans. The time model assigns exclusive non-overlapping blocks within one person’s 168-hour week: a fixed 71 hours for sleep, personal and other commitments, work/travel, and own domestic/care time. The 71-hour block is a teaching assumption, not a sleep, health or care standard. Before/after own-time inputs are separately assumed; a quote does not determine their difference. Negative remaining hours mean an overscheduled request, not a physically feasible week. Unassigned time does not establish usable leisure or paid-work capacity. The cash model compares four repeated weekly budgets with four total service invoices, rounding cash inputs to cents. Four weeks is not an average calendar month; receipt/invoice dates are not modeled. No provider-hour conversion, unpaid-work wage, additional earnings, benefits, taxes, borrowing or care-suitability conclusion is inferred.
59411bd94806adaf0aaaec7de1448d4341727968.zh: 两个固定的官方来源图表描述了 2022 年时间使用调查每日人员估计，于 2024 年 6 月 5 日发布并于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查。所有人每日平均值和特定活动参与者平均值具有不同的分母；日常参与不是去年护理人员的参与。这些观察结果不填充控件。最后三个数字是独立发明的时间和现金计划。该时间模型在一个人每周 168 小时内分配专属的不重叠的时间段：固定的 71 小时用于睡眠、个人和其他事务、工作/旅行以及自己的家庭/护理时间。 71 小时是一个教学假设，而不是睡眠、健康或护理标准。分别假设之前/之后的本时输入；报价并不能决定它们的差异。负的剩余时间意味着超额安排的请求，而不是实际可行的一周。未分配的时间并不能建立可用的休闲或有偿工作能力。现金模型将四份重复的每周预算与四份总服务发票进行比较，将现金投入四舍五入到美分。四个星期不是平均日历月；收据/发票日期未建模。不会推断提供者工时转换、未付工作工资、额外收入、福利、税收、借贷或护理适宜性结论。

594b184939295422fd55ee8ef6f6146b804a850f.src: Outside Quebec, Service Canada says CPP contributions are generally based on employment income between the annual minimum and maximum pensionable amounts, subject to exceptions. For 2026, it lists a CAD 74,600 first earnings ceiling and a second range up to CAD 85,000. CRA explains that CPP pensionable earnings for an employee generally include contributory salary and wages. For many working owner-managers, salary paid for pensionable employment can therefore affect contributions and future benefit calculations; dividends do not themselves create CPP pensionable employment earnings.
594b184939295422fd55ee8ef6f6146b804a850f.zh: 在魁北克省以外，加拿大服务部表示，CPP 缴款通常基于每年最低和最高养老金金额之间的就业收入，但有例外。对于 2026 年，它列出了 74,600 加元的第一收入上限，第二个上限为 85,000 加元。 CRA解释说，雇员的CPP应计养老金收入通常包括缴费工资和工资。因此，对于许多在职业主兼经理来说，应计养恤金工作的工资可能会影响缴款和未来福利的计算；股息本身并不创造 CPP 可领取退休金的就业收入。

5a8bd2572c0c0bc63a736c010ff0499136d430ed.src: A household can regularly set money aside for tax without having sent that money to the tax authority. The reserve is a funding arrangement inside the household. An instalment is an actual payment on a separately confirmed schedule. Treating the reserve transfer as if it were tax already paid can hide both a payment obligation and the cash needed to meet it.
5a8bd2572c0c0bc63a736c010ff0499136d430ed.zh: 家庭可以定期留出资金用于纳税，而无需将该资金汇给税务机关。储备金是家庭内部的一项资金安排。分期付款是按照单独确认的时间表实际付款。将储备金转移视为已缴税款可以隐藏付款义务以及履行付款义务所需的现金。

5a1fb89ddf1b1bc26a3a6b2121a2fecbd1fe550f.src: Equal starting cash and equal new contributions available only at the beginning of each modeled week. One model year contains exactly 52 weeks; four-week purchases therefore mean 13 opportunities per year, not calendar-month purchases. A purchase is scheduled every selected number of weeks. It occurs only when available cash exceeds the fixed fee; the fee is paid from that cash and the rest is invested. Cash earns its weekly-equivalent effective return and assets earn their weekly-equivalent effective return after that week’s purchase. No contribution is borrowed from future weeks. All terminal comparisons include uninvested cash, even when the horizon ends between scheduled purchases. Fractional units, unchanged rates and costless deposits are assumed. No selling, spread, ongoing fund cost, tax, minimum lot, settlement delay or commission-free offer is modeled.
5a1fb89ddf1b1bc26a3a6b2121a2fecbd1fe550f.zh: 仅在每个模拟周开始时提供相等的起始现金和相等的新捐款。一个车型年正好包含 52 周；因此，四个星期的购买意味着每年有 13 个机会，而不是日历月的购买。每隔选定的周数就会安排一次购买。仅当可用现金超过固定费用时才会发生；费用用该现金支付，其余部分用于投资。现金将获得每周等效的有效回报，而资产则在该周购买后获得每周等效的有效回报。未来几周不会借用任何捐款。所有终端比较都包括未投资的现金，即使计划购买之间的期限结束也是如此。假设采用小数单位、利率不变和无成本存款。没有对销售、点差、持续资金成本、税费、最低手数、结算延迟或免佣金优惠进行建模。

The tax-provision factor is a user-entered effective teaching assumption applied to the gross distribution, not a Canadian marginal rate, capital-gains inclusion rate, issuer withholding rate or actual tax calculation. No income-character mix, dividend gross-up/credit, foreign tax, cost-base calculation, sale or tax from a sale is modeled. Dedicated outside cash is counted once. A cash gap is identified, not automatically funded. Net resources deduct the full modeled liability whether cash is available or not; they do not prove that liability has been paid. No tax payment date or filing requirement is determined. Registered-account treatment is outside this illustration.

5d88ea20fb0f67dfabc23526c10fbea634a8a564.src: An independent non-registered compound-investment illustration, not a tax return, GIC offer or filing calendar. Interest compounds annually, no principal or interest is accessible before maturity, and maturity occurs after the final investment year. Each year’s interest is multiplied by one constant assumed tax rate. For a deliberately simplified funding exercise, that amount is paid at each investment-year-end after the month’s reserve transfer; the final year’s payment follows receipt of maturity proceeds. These are hypothetical funding dates, not CRA deadlines, tax withholding or actual anniversary reporting dates. Outside cash earns zero interest. New reserve allocations are external household money, not investment return. Negative provisional cash signals an unfunded requirement and is not an authorized overdraft; no extra cash is silently added. The ending cash arithmetic does not establish that earlier payment dates were affordable. No brackets, credits, benefits, instalments, penalties, registered accounts, ownership attribution, fees or early redemption are calculated.
5d88ea20fb0f67dfabc23526c10fbea634a8a564.zh: 独立的非注册复合投资说明，而不是纳税申报表、GIC 要约或归档日历。利息每年复利，到期前无法提取本金或利息，到期发生在最终投资年度之后。每年的利息乘以一个恒定的假定税率。对于有意简化的融资活动，该金额在每个投资年末当月准备金转移后支付；最后一年的付款是在收到到期收益后进行的。这些是假设的融资日期，而不是 CRA 截止日期、预扣税或实际周年报告日期。外部现金赚取零利息。新的储备分配是外部家庭资金，而不是投资回报。负的临时现金表明没有资金到位的需求，并且不是授权的透支；没有额外的现金被默默地添加。最终的现金计算并不能证明提前付款日期是可以承受的。不计算括号、积分、福利、分期付款、罚款、注册账户、所有权归属、费用或提前赎回。

5d1894c96ddd76f9591ddc14d8809aa8f0dd293f.src: Original deterministic ten-year total-return illustration. The annual return list is [-15%, -5%, 8%, 10%, 12%, 6%, 4%, 8%, 7%, 5%] times the selected scale. The second path reverses exactly those scaled returns. Both receive the same initial capital and equal deposits on the same eligible year-end dates. Each annual return applies before that year-end deposit; a deposit first earns return in the following year. The selected opening delay skips deposits without later catch-up. No contribution earns return before it arrives. All distributions are retained within the assumed total returns. There are no withdrawals, fees, taxes, market data, probabilities, investment recommendations or future-return estimates. The comparison keeps the same full-period product and arithmetic mean; with no deposits, the two ending values agree.
5d1894c96ddd76f9591ddc14d8809aa8f0dd293f.zh: 原始确定性十年总回报图。年化收益榜为所选规模的[-15%,-5%,8%,10%,12%,6%,4%,8%,7%,5%]倍。第二条路径恰好逆转了这些比例回报。两者在相同的合格年终日期收到相同的初始资本和同等的存款。每份周年申报表在年终存款之前适用；存款首先在次年获得回报。所选的开放延迟会跳过存款，而不会稍后追上。任何贡献都不会在到达之前就获得回报。所有分布均保留在假定的总回报范围内。没有提款、费用、税收、市场数据、概率、投资建议或未来回报估计。比较保持相同的全期乘积和算术平均值；如果没有存款，则两个最终值一致。

5e918a7c39d71b6d13e00bb20437df78f9177e76.src: Two original contract-calendar illustrations share an independently selected annual payment. This does not imply equal purchase premiums, equivalent value, an available quote or an appropriate product choice. Contract A pays for the annuitant’s life, with a guaranteed minimum payment period; if death occurs earlier, a beneficiary receives remaining scheduled guarantee payments. Contract B pays only for that fixed term, with remaining instalments directed to a beneficiary after an earlier death. Payment one occurs at the end of year one; death is assumed immediately after the selected year’s payment. No mortality probabilities or life-expectancy estimates are used. Totals include only the chosen display window, whereas the full remaining-guarantee metric refers to the entire schedule after the assumed death and may extend beyond the window. It is not an immediate lump sum, account balance or additional money to add to already counted receipts. Payments are undiscounted and before tax; purchase prices, inflation, discounting, commutation, cashback, joint-survivor benefits, fees, surrender values and insurer-default protection are not calculated.
5e918a7c39d71b6d13e00bb20437df78f9177e76.zh: 两个原始合同日历插图共享独立选择的年度付款。这并不意味着同等的购买溢价、同等价值、可用报价或适当的产品选择。合同A支付年金受益人的生命，并有保证的最短付款期限；如果死亡发生得较早，受益人将收到剩余的预定担保金。合同 B 仅支付该固定期限的费用，剩余的分期付款将直接支付给较早死亡的受益人。第一次付款发生在第一年年底；在选定年份的付款后立即假定死亡。不使用死亡率概率或预期寿命估计。总计仅包括所选的显示窗口，而完整的剩余保证指标是指假设死亡后的整个时间表，并且可能会超出窗口。它不是立即一次性付款、帐户余额或添加到已计算的收据中的额外资金。付款未打折且税前；购买价格、通货膨胀、折扣、折算、现金返还、共同幸存者福利、费用、退保价值和保险公司违约保护均不计算在内。

5e71347f62614eebfca90a0196a7e6191e7f4bc8.zh: 四小时的差异完全来自所选的自己时间假设。该计算器不是从提供商的发票、服务期限或调查平均值中得出的。如果安排增加协调或其他个人时间，之后的数字可以超过之前的数字。在审查实际计划时，每个输入都需要自己的证据。

5e758640cdfe014225413c10560930b0221ec526.src: The model lifts a request below the minimum and caps a request above the entered asset balance. This is an educational convention, not a carrier instruction, verification of account liquidity or calculation for a newly established RRIF.
5e758640cdfe014225413c10560930b0221ec526.zh: 该模型将请求提升到低于最低值，并将请求限制为高于输入的资产余额。这是一个教育惯例，而不是承运人指令、账户流动性验证或新设立的 RRIF 计算。

5e768de45eaa4795b7219d91eed9421ac1bb5a0c.src: The calculation is a same-date snapshot. It projects no interest, new deposit, withdrawal or tax payment. Future credited interest can change the balance relative to a cap, which is why the related headroom guide follows growth over time.
5e768de45eaa4795b7219d91eed9421ac1bb5a0c.zh: 计算是同一日期的快照。它不计利息、新存款、取款或纳税。未来的贷记利息可能会改变相对于上限的余额，这就是为什么相关的净空指南会随着时间的推移而增长。

5e9640892ca691ce82654b0832a7f3f93e1d1b4f.src: After each payment, update the actual amount, remaining balance and next deadline. This is a one-year illustration; it does not automatically assume the same opening balance in every future year. Recalculate as prices, plans and bill dates change, and connect the transfer schedule with the income that funds it.
5e9640892ca691ce82654b0832a7f3f93e1d1b4f.zh: 每次付款后，更新实际金额、余额和下一个截止日期。这是一年的插图；它不会自动假定未来每年的期初余额相同。随着价格、计划和帐单日期的变化重新计算，并将转账时间表与为其提供资金的收入联系起来。

5e98f1d235bb397be257a819300469dcf9710184.src: Rows replace the initial foreign-currency allocation; columns replace the terminal quote in CAD per FCU. 5ea26d7e92b9e88d6c5fb8cdd2abe634986f6ba7.src: With a positive additional balance, divide annual fees avoided by that balance to find the break-even effective annual return. 5ea26d7e92b9e88d6c5fb8cdd2abe634986f6ba7.zh: 如果额外余额为正，则用该余额除以避免的年费即可找到盈亏平衡的有效年回报率。默认计算为 180 加元 ÷ 2,500 加元 = 7.2%。获得该回报后，替代方案可赚取 180 加元，与额外余额选择保留的费用预算相匹配。

5f10ca28eaffaf6d25c37975dc6bbbf1f51ef955.src: The matrix combines four stopping dates with four refund assumptions. Positive values mean the annual plan costs less; negative values mean monthly billing costs less. Prices remain fixed. At a twelve-month stopping date, no time is unused, so changing the refund percentage has no effect.
5f10ca28eaffaf6d25c37975dc6bbbf1f51ef955.zh: 该矩阵结合了四个停止日期和四个退款假设。正值表示年度计划成本较低；负值意味着每月的计费成本较低。价格保持不变。在 12 个月的停止日期，没有任何时间是未使用的，因此更改退款百分比不会产生任何影响。

5f145d4ef2816693085c117eed8a3bbd7f2a8fab.src: Fidelity’s duration guide explains interest-rate sensitivity and why the estimate becomes less accurate for larger changes. Effective duration is commonly used when embedded options affect cash flows; read which measure a fund reports. Duration is not a maturity date or a guarantee of recovery by a particular year.
5f145d4ef2816693085c117eed8a3bbd7f2a8fab.zh: Fidelity 的久期指南解释了利率敏感性以及为何估算在较大变化时变得不太准确。当嵌入期权影响现金流量时，通常使用有效久期；阅读基金报告的衡量指标。期限不是到期日，也不是特定年份收回成本的保证。

5f1d800717c170cee6d3cf15581a326103743f5c.src: These statements do not mean the remaining card balance has vanished. They distinguish where the resources are held. The pay-as-you-go household has retained more bank cash, while the other has prepaid purchasing capacity at the retailer. This model records the latter at nominal face value without claiming an equivalent cash refund, resale price or fair value.
5f1d800717c170cee6d3cf15581a326103743f5c.zh: 这些陈述并不意味着卡内余额已消失。他们区分资源的持有位置。现收现付家庭保留了更多的银行现金，而其他家庭则拥有在零售商处预付的购买能力。该模型以名义面值记录后者，而不要求等额现金退款、转售价或公允价值。

5ef92609e974ff738dc5ed8a6c4447e1647098a1.src: The fifteen-year default is a measurement window. It does not establish that a deed, lease-like arrangement or membership ends then, that a buyer will appear, or that a provider will release the household from further charges. No resale receipt, exit payment or rental income from unused rights is included.

5ef98d920083272e139057e99447ff75fc61af25.src: An operating subtotal is different from cash available to the owner. Principal repayments, capital payments and tax cash can create a funding need even when a narrower income measure is positive.

5eff771b7dfb6fb6c0309c20bb89ac54b8013029.src: None of these steps pays cash into the account. The convexity adjustment is the difference between two price estimates, rather than a coupon, contribution or reimbursement. The residual is the difference still needed to reconcile the approximation to this model’s repricing.

Confirm whether caps apply by month, year, category or account, and whether spending above a cap receives a base rate. Review exclusions, redemption conditions, additional-card fees and any applicable merchant charges.
5f0237f8a292fb28f545fe2f16a4c18c23b13782.zh: 为了进行真正的比较，请使用每个发行人的资格规则对支持的购买历史记录进行分类。确认上限是否按月、年、类别或账户适用，以及超出上限的支出是否会获得基本费率。查看排除项、兑换条件、附属卡费用和任何适用的商户费用。

5f028554954b71892dffae8585ae77b91c3203f0.zh: 年度客房和计划存款遵循日历

Keep the source population visible before comparing a chart with a household’s records: claiming tax filers, residents and people who actually gave are different groups.
5f03377aa25a22be314448959dd17932c195afd7.zh: 年份控件在此注明日期的摘录中选择纳税年度。它不会预测给予或估计家庭的税收抵免。在将图表与家庭记录进行比较之前，先让来源人口可见：报税者、居民和实际捐款人是不同的群体。

5f03dec3b636d29da26c5aed4746a5825a73b0cb.src: For a real plan, list each payment and its cancellation conditions, record the required notice date, and keep confirmation of the promised repayment form. Put any expected cash receipt on its own date. Use a range of cancellation assumptions to understand the price trade-off, then check that the chosen upfront bill fits resources still available after other household commitments.
5f03dec3b636d29da26c5aed4746a5825a73b0cb.zh: 对于真正的计划，请列出每笔付款及其取消条件，记录所需的通知日期，并保留承诺还款表的确认。将任何预期的现金收据放在其自己的日期上。使用一系列取消假设来了解价格权衡，然后检查所选的预付账单是否适合其他家庭承诺后仍然可用的资源。

5f07f3db5099e101049308f709759023cdcf28c9.src: CRA’s current worked example describes a Canadian resident who sells a principal residence and buys another home in the same calendar year. The plus-one rule can treat both properties as eligible for the principal-residence exemption for that year, even though only one property may be designated as the family’s principal residence for that year. 5fb38619730affd2796a0a46a6aff0e031b07d47.src: A deduction limit, unused contributions and available contribution room answer different questions. Available contribution room concerns the capacity for new contributions after the prior contribution record has been recognized.

60cbaa7b8cee8541a60b1516c0b3039aa154527e.src: Original hypothetical formula, not an insurance quote or a benefit determination. At each review, a possible new eligible claim would receive the smaller of the stated percentage of eligible monthly gross earnings and the fixed monthly gross dollar cap. Eligibility and payment are assumed only to illustrate that arithmetic. Eligible earnings rise at the selected constant rate before each separate possible claim-start date; the percentage and cap stay unchanged. The sequence is not a payment path for one ongoing disability claim, and it does not add salary and insurance as concurrent receipts. All values are nominal gross amounts before any applicable tax. Actual definitions of insured earnings, disability, claim approval, benefit offsets, tax, waiting periods, duration, indexation, premiums and coverage amendments are excluded. The formula ratio is not a comparison of net take-home income and is not an assessment that household expenses are covered. Future earnings and unchanged policy terms are assumptions, not forecasts or insurer commitments.

5df76bf269352071aeea4cc7528a530e47173335.src: “What if another financial crisis happens?” deserves a direct answer: a portfolio can fall sharply, and nobody can promise when it will recover. A useful conversation then connects that possibility with the money’s purpose. Is it next year’s home deposit, a retirement fund intended to support several decades, or a reserve for a job interruption?
5df76bf269352071aeea4cc7528a530e47173335.zh: “如果再次发生金融危机怎么办？”值得一个直接的答案：投资组合可能会大幅下跌，没有人能保证它何时会复苏。然后，进行一次有用的对话，将这种可能性与这笔钱的用途联系起来。是明年的住房存款、旨在支持几十年的退休基金，还是工作中断的准备金？

60e709f77a4c7d128ce048a426d7973eabd1554b.src: In the model, the additional amount is incremental. Consensus and house forecasts remain distinct. A new validated snapshot is published to GitHub. Sources include rolling documents, research feeds and older dated references. Fixed older reports are checked for revisions; a successful check does not turn them into a current rolling ten-year window. Open pages check for new snapshots every five minutes while visible, and when the page becomes visible again. The update button checks the latest published snapshot; it does not force a publisher to produce new data. Nasdaq and Edelweiss reject the hosted server, so their reports also have a scheduled browser check at 1 p.m. Vancouver time. That check requires a manual check in the owner’s desktop browser. Its independent verification time is preserved; checks older than 48 hours are flagged as overdue and the last figures are retained.

620b23904ba95ba612668e2958bd1f1e82cff0bc.src: Original same-date snapshot, using CDIC public guidance reviewed 25 October 2026 and a CAD 100,000 principal-plus-interest limit for each included qualifying category at each member. A and B are hypothetical and assumed to be genuinely distinct CDIC member institutions. One depositor owns all modeled balances. Only the one-name non-registered category and the separate TFSA eligible-deposit category are included. Every input is independently assumed to be an eligible deposit, includes interest accrued to the common observation date, and is held in client name. Direct and client-name brokered deposits in the same member/category are combined before applying the cap. Nominee-name deposits, trusts, joint accounts, other registered categories, foreign-currency conversion and provincial insurance schemes require their own rules and are excluded. A statement, platform, broker, branch, product name or account count does not establish a separate issuing member. No actual product eligibility or ownership record is verified. This is not a contribution-room calculation, transfer instruction, payout forecast, credit-risk estimate or maturity/access calendar. Future interest and balance movements are not projected. An amount above a modeled cap is not a predicted loss.
620b23904ba95ba612668e2958bd1f1e82cff0bc.zh: 原始同日快照，使用 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查的 CDIC 公共指导意见，以及每个成员的每个合格类别的本金加利息限额为 100,000 加元。 A 和 B 是假设的，并假定它们是真正不同的 CDIC 成员机构。一名存款人拥有所有模型余额。仅包括单名非注册类别和单独的 TFSA 合格存款类别。每个输入都被独立地假定为合格存款，包括到共同观察日期应计利息，并以客户名义持有。同一会员/类别中的直接存款和客户名义经纪存款在应用上限之前合并。名义存款、信托、联名账户、其他注册类别、外币兑换和省级保险计划需要各自的规则，因此不包括在内。声明、平台、经纪商、分支机构、产品名称或账户数量不建立单独的发行成员。没有验证实际的产品资格或所有权记录。这不是供款室计算、转账指令、支付预测、信用风险估计或到期/访问日历。未预测未来的利息和余额变动。高于模型上限的金额并非预测损失。

62f45ce9a1c4ca94f3809f9cb2535bc6df5b3cc7.zh: 地理位置造成了多元化和更苛刻的承保问题。墨西哥的增长机会必须弥补贸易敏感性和信用风险；智利与通胀挂钩的抵押贷款需要关注借款人的承受能力；秘鲁不断改善的投资组合仍需要在整个周期中展现弹性。不同的国家税率、融资结构和少数股东权益意味着一美元的分部利润根据其来源对普通股东来说可能具有不同的价值。

647c555e181bad19ff2e41a53fab6e51d9122e79.src: Original deterministic nominal-CAD illustration. The entered original purchase price of CAD 2,200 is already paid and unrecoverable; it is context only and never enters the forward costs. Each option is assumed to provide the same required service throughout the common whole-year horizon, without another failure, replacement or difference in usage. Repair is paid at time zero. Replacement purchase and installation are paid at time zero, less net proceeds from selling the old item at that same time. Running costs are constant nominal amounts paid at each year-end. Each item is sold for its independently entered net value at the common final year-end, after that year’s running cost. No intermediate sale is assumed. Present values use the entered effective annual nominal discount rate; they are alternatives to undiscounted totals, not additional bills. No loan, interest charge, tax calculation, refund, warranty recovery, inflation forecast, service interruption or environmental benefit is modeled. Costs may be negative if entered sale receipts exceed outlays. Changing the past-price context does not change any metric or chart.
647c555e181bad19ff2e41a53fab6e51d9122e79.zh: 原始确定性标称 CAD 插图。输入的原购买价 2,200 加元已支付且无法收回；它只是上下文，永远不会进入远期成本。假设每个选项在共同的全年范围内提供相同的所需服务，而不会出现其他故障、更换或使用差异。维修费用在零时间支付。更换购买和安装在零时支付，减去同时出售旧物品的净收益。运行成本是每年年底支付的固定名义金额。每件商品均按共同最终年末独立输入的净值（扣除当年的运行成本）出售。假设没有中间销售。现值使用输入的有效年度名义贴现率；它们是未贴现总额的替代方案，而不是额外的账单。没有对贷款、利息费用、税收计算、退款、保修恢复、通货膨胀预测、服务中断或环境效益进行建模。如果输入的销售收据超过支出，则成本可能为负。更改过去的价格背景不会更改任何指标或图表。

6320c107324968d9b4acc2cec8adba1b74afe8a3.src: Hypothetical private-benefit claims, not a public dental/health-program or insurer quote. Identical invoices arrive at the start of consecutive months in one benefit year. Recognized amount is capped at invoice value; remaining deductible is applied first, then the coverage percentage, then the remaining insurer-payment maximum. No maximum reset occurs. Claim m pays at the end of month m + delay, even at zero delay. Other budget surplus arrives at month-end. The model runs through claim months + delay and measures shortages immediately after bills, before receipts. All claims are assumed eligible and approved; no clinical need, adjudication, coordination, tax credit, premium, direct billing or borrowing cost is calculated.
6320c107324968d9b4acc2cec8adba1b74afe8a3.zh: 假设的私人福利索赔，而不是公共牙科/健康计划或保险公司报价。相同的发票在一个福利年度的连续月份开始时送达。确认金额以发票金额为上限；首先应用剩余的免赔额，然后是保险范围百分比，然后是剩余的保险公司最高付款额。不发生最大复位。索赔 m 在 m + 延迟月末支付，即使延迟为零。其他预算盈余于月底到达。该模型贯穿索赔月+延迟，并在账单之后、收据之前立即测量短缺情况。所有索赔均被视为合格并获得批准；不计算临床需求、裁决、协调、税收抵免、保费、直接计费或借贷成本。

643cbb4eceacf17a07846329564e0a4e7bbd8cb6.src: Original hypothetical calendar ledger using CRA’s general spousal-RRSP calendar-year review described in the cited public guidance, reviewed 25 October 2026. The amounts aggregate one contributor’s deposits to the same annuitant’s RRSPs across the entered years; they are not the annuitant’s own deposits, investment returns, contribution room, deductions or transfers. Each review totals the withdrawal calendar year and the two preceding calendar years. Totals identify records to review; they are not attributed income or tax payable. No withdrawal amount, prior attribution, income allocation, final tax, withholding, account eligibility, relationship exception, residency exception, RRIF minimum, SPP or FHSA transfer is calculated. Future dates are examples conditional on the reviewed rule, not a promise that future law will stay unchanged. The separate 2026 example date remains a date illustration even when its annual deposit amount is zero. Month gaps compare month labels without day-of-month precision. A calendar window alone does not establish a tax-free or permitted withdrawal.

64543f285b12661971d4a07bc68140bad13d43c7.src: Original hypothetical cash-matching illustration for one fixed nominal bill in generic foreign-currency units (FCU). Both quotes are CAD paid per one FCU and are independent assumptions, not observed or forecast exchange rates. The selected share of the starting CAD budget is converted immediately at the starting quote; the remainder stays in CAD. Both cash balances then earn zero until the single bill date. Foreign cash is used directly in the bill’s currency and remaining CAD cash is converted at the terminal quote. CAD values are reporting translations, not an assumed sale and repurchase of the foreign cash. There are no conversion spreads, fees, taxes, deposit interest, price changes in the foreign bill, transfer delays, account failures or other household assets. A funding position is these earmarked resources less this one bill; it is not a full household net-worth statement or a present value. Allocating 100% to foreign cash removes terminal-quote sensitivity of the FCU amount under these assumptions, but does not fix an initially inadequate budget or establish that the account and payment route are suitable.

6498fdd473aba26fd757098ab9516479f97256c1.src: Hypothetical schedule beginning in an already confirmed required repayment year, with the entered HBP balance and 1–15 years remaining. The year field is a label and does not derive a due date from a withdrawal year. Each year’s minimum is opening balance divided by required years remaining. Designated repayment is the annual amount plus the first-year extra where applicable, capped at balance. A shortfall below the minimum becomes an income inclusion and reduces the HBP balance without adding money to an RRSP. Extra designated repayments reduce later minima; they do not skip the remaining schedule. First-year extra occurs in this modeled required year, not before the repayment period. Designated repayments are not deducted again. The flat percentage on income inclusions is a separate budget allowance, not withholding or a tax-return calculation. No investment growth, earlier transactions, eligibility test, changed residency, death, age-71/72 exception, new withdrawal, missed designation or other special repayment situation is modeled. Reconcile the actual CRA statement and filing requirements.
6498fdd473aba26fd757098ab9516479f97256c1.zh: 假设时间表从已确认的所需还款年份开始，输入 HBP 余额，剩余 1-15 年。年份字段是一个标签，不会从提款年份得出到期日。每年的最小值是期初余额除以所需的剩余年数。指定还款额是每年金额加上第一年额外费用（如适用），上限为余额。低于最低限额的差额将成为收入包含项，并减少 HBP 余额，而无需向 RRSP 增加资金。额外指定还款可降低后期最低还款额；他们不会跳过剩余的时间表。第一年额外费用发生在这个建模的要求年份，而不是在还款期之前。指定还款额不再扣除。收入包含的统一百分比是一项单独的预算津贴，不是预扣税或纳税申报表计算。没有对投资增长、提前交易、资格测试、居住地变更、死亡、71/72 岁例外、新提款、错过指定或其他特殊还款情况进行建模。协调实际的 CRA 报表和申报要求。

64a7b50130389b6bff9895541c72c03df8e9e7f8.src: Month one illustrates the order. A 12% loss reduces CAD 10,000 to CAD 8,800; the CAD 500 deposit then raises it to CAD 9,300. The 20% exit threshold has not yet been reached. In month two, another 12% decline leaves CAD 8,184 before the next deposit, or CAD 8,684 afterward. The index is now 22.56% below its initial peak, triggering the default exit and its CAD 8.684 switching cost.
64a7b50130389b6bff9895541c72c03df8e9e7f8.zh: 第一个月说明了这一顺序。 12% 的损失可将 10,000 加元减少至 8,800 加元； 500 加元押金然后将其提高到 9,300 加元。 20%的退出门槛尚未达到。第二个月，又下降了 12%，下次存款前为 8,184 加元，之后为 8,684 加元。该指数目前比初始峰值低 22.56%，触发默认退出及其 8.684 加元的转换成本。

64afcf62e365f262ca4320ba293b76d5d665859d.src: Canadian Banking gives the investment a measurable operating anchor. Q3 revenue was C$3.646 billion, expenses C$1.674 billion and PCL C$498 million. The next test is whether improvement comes with durable primary relationships and deposits, rather than a temporary gap between asset yields and funding costs.
64afcf62e365f262ca4320ba293b76d5d665859d.zh: 加拿大银行为该投资提供了可衡量的运营锚点。第三季度收入为 36.46 亿加元，支出为 16.74 亿加元，PCL 为 4.98 亿加元。其净息差为2.38%，净资产收益率为19.4%。这些数字表明，组合、融资和执行可以在资产负债表不发生异常扩张的情况下创造价值。下一个测试是改善是否来自持久的主要关系和存款，而不是资产收益率和融资成本之间的暂时差距。

667e1f42fd0322210b5c17107909c89af53fa767.src: The Bank of Canada’s credit-performance definitions distinguish two measures. The borrower indicator concerns indebted borrowers with at least one account whose payments are late by sixty days or more. Product indicators concern loans in a given class whose payments are late by ninety days or more.
667e1f42fd0322210b5c17107909c89af53fa767.zh: 加拿大银行的信用绩效定义区分了两种衡量标准。借款人指标涉及至少一个账户逾期还款六十天或更长时间的负债借款人。产品指标涉及特定类别的贷款，其付款延迟九十天或以上。

6680c54b7eddd1f0a55543c33d3c63b2b5ba84ef.src: A four-year average interest rate can hide the order in which rates occur. If principal falls during the loan, a high rate in an early year applies to more money than the same high rate near the end. Counting how often each rate appears is therefore insufficient to identify the total dollar interest.
6680c54b7eddd1f0a55543c33d3c63b2b5ba84ef.zh: 四年平均利率可以隐藏利率发生的顺序。如果本金在贷款期间下降，那么早年的高利率比临近年底的相同高利率适用的资金更多。因此，计算每个利率出现的频率不足以确定美元利息总额。
