66871d8d30fd0681cb013fad42c8cc0b81168409.src: A hypothetical approved owner-occupied purchase using three selected CMHC premium-on-total-loan bands reviewed 25 October 2026. Price is capped at CAD 500,000 and down payment at 5%–19.99%; this is not an eligibility, minimum-down-payment or affordability decision. Traditional down payment and an amortization of at most 25 years are assumed. No portability credit, refund, non-traditional premium, surcharge or lender-specific adjustment is applied. The entire premium is financed, while entered premium tax and other closing costs are paid in cash. Tax defaults to zero as a placeholder, not a province-specific finding. Nominal annual loan rate is compounded semi-annually, with equivalent monthly payments, held unchanged over the full amortization. Calculations are unrounded until display; no prepayments, renewals, later fees or market-rate comparison are modeled.
66871d8d30fd0681cb013fad42c8cc0b81168409.zh: 使用三个选定的假设批准的业主自住购买CMHC 总贷款溢价范围于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查。价格上限为 500,000 加元，首付为 5%–19.99%；这不是一个资格、最低首付或负担能力的决定。假设传统的首付和最多 25 年的摊销。不适用可转移信贷、退款、非传统保费、附加费或贷款机构特定调整。全部保费均由资金承担，而输入的保费税和其他结算费用则以现金支付。税收默认为零作为占位符，而不是特定于省份的结果。名义年贷款利率每半年复利一次，每月还款额相等，在全额摊销期间保持不变。计算结果在显示前四舍五入；没有对预付款、续订、后期费用或市场费率比较进行建模。

6687b0ffb355399288845c0b11f152cc70675add.src: Filled teal marker: lower input. Open navy marker: higher input. Zero means no change from the baseline gap.

668980bcd4ca1b423c20f432c963c3ccacf86741.src: Buying the same dollar amount at regular intervals does not buy the same number of units. The price at each purchase date determines how many units that cash can acquire. An average of price observations therefore answers a different question from the average cost of the units actually owned.
668980bcd4ca1b423c20f432c963c3ccacf86741.zh: 定期购买相同的美元金额并不购买相同数量的单位。每个购买日期的价格决定了现金可以购买的单位数量。因此，价格观察的平均值回答了与实际拥有单位的平均成本不同的问题。

671545d248969076ef1594c987e910938c97c1da.src: A reserve can do its job successfully and still leave a household exposed afterward. Paying an urgent bill reduces the cash available for the next one. 66eaf2b6d732fea7e670cd1473241559f705e958.src: Only one cut is applied per annual review. The model does not repeatedly cut within the same year until the withdrawal ratio falls under the threshold.

6749c4a2a799bf7c599fb359c14224a2e23e05ff.src: A partial sale can reduce risk now. Size it against an intended portfolio weight. Approximate shares to sell = (current RBC value − target weight × portfolio value) / price, before tax and costs, assuming proceeds remain in the portfolio.

681817c348ae67a5a68abf046b1f3efdcbb53b68.zh: 加拿大统计局将固定篮子价格指数与完整的生活成本衡量标准区分开来。本文并未对某个地点的福祉、公共服务、家庭支持或其他对家庭至关重要的功能进行定价。

6819b26f5418fe22ebdcf9c068b72bb5c5f59fc5.src: Looking only at that positive month-end amount would miss the earlier funding need. The model therefore computes its opening contribution from the minimum across ordered events, rather than monthly closing balances alone. It makes the requirement visible without assuming that a lender or the household will supply the money.
6819b26f5418fe22ebdcf9c068b72bb5c5f59fc5.zh: 仅关注月末的正金额可能会错过早期的资金需求。因此，该模型根据有序事件的最小值计算其期初贡献，而不是单独计算月期末余额。它使要求可见，而无需假设贷款机构或家庭将提供资金。

681f0bd9bfed19b9de7da2389aaacfb1124c22e4.src: The example has monthly net income of CAD 3,500 from A and CAD 2,500 from B, essential spending of CAD 4,500, and a six-month window. If A is absent, B’s income reduces the monthly gap to CAD 2,000, creating a CAD 12,000 window need. If B is absent, the gap is CAD 1,000 per month, or CAD 6,000.
681f0bd9bfed19b9de7da2389aaacfb1124c22e4.zh: 该示例的月净收入为 A 的 3,500 加元，B 的月净收入为 2,500 加元，基本支出为 4,500 加元，期限为 6 个月。如果 A 缺席，B 的收入会将每月缺口减少到 2,000 加元，从而产生 12,000 加元的窗口需求。如果 B 不存在，则差距为每月 1,000 加元，或 6,000 加元。

681f470803740740c8513567c5ac6e5e77e7facd.src: The October update provides a practical test of consistent definitions. The expected C$55 million Chile deferred-tax-asset writedown reduces both reported and bank-adjusted fourth-quarter earnings. An analyst may separately examine earnings without that discrete item, but that would be an independently normalized measure requiring a visible reconciliation. The announced KeyCorp contribution also needs to enter the model once, with the associated funding cost already reflected, rather than being layered onto earnings that already contain it.
681f470803740740c8513567c5ac6e5e77e7facd.zh: 10 月的更新提供了一致定义的实际测试。智利预计将有 5500 万加元的递延税资产减记，从而减少第四季度报告收益和银行调整后收益。分析师可以单独检查没有该离散项目的收益，但这将是一个独立的标准化指标，需要明显的调节。宣布的 KeyCorp 捐款也需要输入模型一次，相关的融资成本已经反映，而不是分层到已包含该成本的收入中。

69053590f69dc13da126ef2ff6c4f2d1dff33fc9.src: A month-one instalment needs opening cash. If it exceeds the opening reserve, no amount saved later each month can fund it on time. The matrix marks that case unavailable instead of dividing by zero or pretending the first transfer arrived early. Different approved instalment dates would require a new calendar, not a more optimistic label.
69053590f69dc13da126ef2ff6c4f2d1dff33fc9.zh: 一个月的分期付款需要期初现金。如果超过了期初准备金，那么每个月以后节省的金额都无法按时提供资金。该矩阵标记该情况不可用，而不是除以零或假装第一次传输提前到达。不同的批准分期付款日期需要新的日历，而不是更乐观的标签。

6907037377e31a05133a581d1c95bad33821fa54.src: The illustrative allocation q is the smaller of CAD 10,000, starting capacity and the ending contribution record: CAD 10,000 for these inputs. Subtract q from both records. Their difference remains CAD -5,000. This identity does not establish an eligible claim, issue a new CRA limit or calculate next-year room. 68b425451d6aabab4ca714bb689fde5ce4af4fd0.src: Hypothetical incremental upgrade versus a defined baseline, not an engineering assessment or energy-price forecast. The cost control is additional cash paid now, after distinguishing any baseline work that would happen anyway; no future grant receipt is assumed. First-year avoided energy spending grows at the selected nominal annual rate, while additional maintenance stays constant in nominal CAD. Both occur at year-end. All benefits are assumed to continue for the selected full years, with no replacement cost or terminal property-value credit. NPV discounts those nominal cash flows at the selected nominal rate; it is not an internal rate of return or a guaranteed yield. Zero upfront cost gives recovery at year zero even if later flows are negative. No financing, rebate eligibility, taxes, carbon calculation, weather model, equipment sizing or comfort/health valuation is calculated.
68b425451d6aabab4ca714bb689fde5ce4af4fd0.zh: 相对于定义的基线的假设增量升级，而不是工程评估或能源价格预测。在区分无论如何都会发生的任何基准工作之后，成本控制是现在支付的额外现金；假定未来不会收到赠款。第一年避免的能源支出以选定的名义年增长率增长，而额外维护的名义加元保持不变。两者都发生在年底。假定所有福利在选定的整年内持续有效，没有重置成本或最终财产价值信用。 NPV 按选定的名义利率贴现这些名义现金流量；它不是内部收益率或保证收益率。即使后期流量为负，零前期成本也能在零年实现恢复。不计算融资、回扣资格、税收、碳计算、天气模型、设备尺寸或舒适/健康评估。

69bb99217d2ab65293daacaacc9472e212fb781b.src: The senior cases explicitly use 30/50/20 judgment weights, not measured or statistically calibrated probabilities. The added dividend-reinvestment study is an exploratory association and chronology-controlled screen, not a validated point-in-time threshold backtest. A normalized six-bank forecast model and current individual portfolio/tax information are unavailable. These gaps prevent a precise “best day,” guaranteed sale price or claim that a fall is very likely above one multiple.

6a9304ed38b800ec339a0a792b83618a649a7574.zh: 默认余额为 12,000 加元（18%）和 8,000 加元（12%），每个都剩余两年。建议的替代方案是五年内 10%，费用为 300 加元。此处显示的利率并非贷款机构批准的报价或预估。

6a971e008808c8e2e6ad49662bbe1ea7e27c9cba.zh: 同一日期付款和福利流 · 加元

6a99896946bd517cea296e1b77c847b369a93af2.zh: 以现金 (加元) 支付的单独销售费用

6aa1d7243bd214bf3ff705a397f654162a299b35.src: The fourth chart translates selected nominal annual quotes across annual, twice-yearly, monthly and 365-period compounding. It shows effective annual percentages to two decimal places, with more precision retained inside the calculation. The 365-period row is a mathematical count, not a dated daily-accrual contract; it does not address leap years or an actual day-count rule.
6aa1d7243bd214bf3ff705a397f654162a299b35.zh: 第四张图表将选定的年度、每年两次、每月和 365 个周期复利的名义年度报价进行转换。它显示了有效的年度百分比，精确到小数点后两位，并在计算中保留了更高的精度。 365 个周期的行是一个数学计数，而不是一个注明日期的每日应计合约；它不涉及闰年或实际日数规则。

6aa3dab82f0005fa41d4d009b4d0a7ca63fd3392.src: The acquisition-year residence condition matters: CRA says the purchaser must be resident in Canada during the year the new principal residence is purchased to use the extra year. Do not count a bonus year simply because two homes overlapped. A person who was non-resident throughout the acquisition year does not qualify for this addition under CRA’s explanation.
6aa3dab82f0005fa41d4d009b4d0a7ca63fd3392.zh: 购买年份居住条件很重要：CRA 表示，购买者必须在购买新主要住宅的当年居住在加拿大才能使用额外的一年。不要仅仅因为两处房屋重叠而算作奖金年。根据 CRA 的解释，在整个收购年度中为非居民的人不符合此项附加条件。

6aa8a362871f1c9af3bfb3726a3ad067842ad622.src: At the assumed nominal annual loan rate of 8%, the unchanged CAD 30,000 principal requires CAD 200 of interest each month. Across three years, the household supplies CAD 7,200 of outside cash. The model pays it as it arises, so it is not added to the loan balance.
6aa8a362871f1c9af3bfb3726a3ad067842ad622.zh: 假设名义年贷款利率为 8%，不变的 30,000 加元本金每月需要 200 加元的利息。三年来，该家庭提供了 7,200 加元的外部现金。该模型会在出现时进行支付，因此不会将其添加到贷款余额中。

6aac3905da2f0bf5b6c6fe0817220cc2bf1b3877.src: The grouped bars change owned cash while keeping the bill and assumed usable borrowing capacity fixed. They show two distinct consequences: new debt drawn and the immediate amount still without funding. Both should be read before deciding that a reserve is adequate.
6aac3905da2f0bf5b6c6fe0817220cc2bf1b3877.zh: 分组的金块会更改拥有的现金，同时保持账单和假设可用借款能力固定。它们表现出两种不同的后果：新的债务被提取以及仍然没有资金的直接金额。在确定准备金是否充足之前，应阅读这两篇文章。

6ab300eec36b1fdb2b004975852ff00f26203250.src: A one-year favorable residual is not automatically a repeatable skill. Read the fund’s reports, benchmark methodology, replication policy, and lending disclosures before extrapolating it. Avoid choosing a fund because of a tiny return advantage that cannot be explained or survives only over one chosen interval.
6ab300eec36b1fdb2b004975852ff00f26203250.zh: 一年期优惠剩余并不自动成为可重复的技能。在进行推断之前，请阅读该基金的报告、基准方法、复制政策和贷款披露信息。避免因为无法解释或仅在选定的时间间隔内存在的微小回报优势而选择基金。

6a5ac9bc099cde9ec78499a04296d90b86dbf092.zh: 根据一项共同合格费用协调两项假设的计划金额

6a5c4bcdfe7519113ff70a432606cfb5abcef632.src: The debt line ends after each regular payment and before payment of the balloon. It deliberately finishes at CAD 10,000 for the balloon choice. That point is an unpaid liability, rather than debt forgiveness or the balance after every obligation has been met.
6a5c4bcdfe7519113ff70a432606cfb5abcef632.zh: 债务线在每次定期付款之后和大额付款之前结束。为了选择气球，特意将价格定为 10,000 加元。该点是未偿负债，而不是债务减免或履行每项义务后的余额。

6a5ea56cefe14d79a765a1af2d0b0557fe510cfc.src: The charts use Statistics Canada Table 11-10-0024-01, selecting Canada, Both sexes and the Variable low income measure. They retain the first and second years of each transition pair rather than treating the observation as a single-year level.
6a5ea56cefe14d79a765a1af2d0b0557fe510cfc.zh: 图表使用加拿大统计局表格11-10-0024-01，选择加拿大、男女和可变低收入衡量标准。他们保留每个过渡对的第一年和第二年，而不是将观察结果视为单年水平。

6a65d754786fa81b8c5b8c8a0da4408cc50a61f5.src: Use the adjusted concept when the question requires the broader resources that include in-kind services. Use an explicitly defined cash ledger when the question is whether money is available to make a dated payment. A difference between these measures does not make either one erroneous; it identifies different accounting scopes.
6a65d754786fa81b8c5b8c8a0da4408cc50a61f5.zh: 当问题需要更广泛的资源（包括实物服务）时，请使用调整后的概念。当问题是是否有钱可以进行指定日期的付款时，请使用明确定义的现金分类帐。这些措施之间的差异并不意味着其中任何一个都是错误的。它可以识别不同的会计范围。

6a6cd3d0480f7896e64a05d94ad11df9e6c28297.src: Finding the best cell after seeing every monthly return is hindsight. A person implementing the rule would need to choose those settings before knowing which path arrived. The matrix is useful because it shows sensitivity, not because its most attractive number supplies a reliable future setting.
6a6cd3d0480f7896e64a05d94ad11df9e6c28297.zh: 在查看每个月收益后找到最佳单元格是事后诸葛亮。实施该规则的人需要在知道哪条路径到达之前选择这些设置。该矩阵很有用，因为它显示了敏感性，而不是因为它最有吸引力的数字提供了可靠的未来设置。

A real prepayment charge, access restriction or change in contract terms would need to be added to the decision.
6a74b3f343b6d3bd256114642733d7b4b1e61432.zh: 此比较假设允许选择的一次性付款而不会受到处罚。它不计算特权或验证特定抵押贷款。决策中需要考虑实际的预付款费用、访问限制或合同条款的变更。

6a7eb5d3f2238ff49f4f611a39579d0362874790.src: Treat the memo as a conditional charge, not monthly cash spending
6a7eb5d3f2238ff49f4f611a39579d0362874790.zh: 将备忘录视为有条件费用，而不是每月现金支出

6a80ff2083af9f98e1a9b2925425e0e2893400ef.src: The separate CAD 7,500 government repayment explains the reduction from the original CAD 100,000 combined resources under that retained-cash assumption. Spending the beneficiary payment would create a further change outside this plan-only ledger.
6a80ff2083af9f98e1a9b2925425e0e2893400ef.zh: 单独的 7,500 加元政府还款解释了在保留现金假设下原始 100,000 加元合并资源的减少。支出受益人付款将在仅限计划的分类帐之外产生进一步的变化。

6a82fb4bd54927aa666751ba7969f25231e09de8.src: Each point replaces only the repair-event probability; the contract price, eligible share, repair cost, deductible and payment cap stay fixed. The crossover is a cost-equality threshold under those assumptions, not an estimate of how likely the product is to fail. Values above 100% are infeasible. This full-range comparison curve stays unchanged when only the selected event probability changes; the headline metrics and state probabilities do update.
6a82fb4bd54927aa666751ba7969f25231e09de8.zh: 每个点仅替换修复事件概率；合同价格、合格份额、维修费用、免赔额和付款上限保持不变。交叉是这些假设下的成本平等阈值，而不是对产品失败可能性的估计。高于 100% 的值是不可行的。当只有选择的事件概率发生变化时，这条全范围比较曲线保持不变；标题指标和状态概率确实会更新。

For parental leave, the Government of Canada’s EI information explains that amounts and duration depend on the applicable program and circumstances, and that some employers provide top-ups. Confirm the actual arrangement before entering the cash-flow schedule.
69ef1a1aa6a8b82955279fd0b4ebe483e5dac3c3.zh: 该模型并不假设休假会产生享受福利的资格。对于育儿假，加拿大政府的 EI 信息解释说，育儿假的金额和期限取决于适用的计划和情况，并且一些雇主提供补充。在输入现金流量表之前确认实际安排。

69f70758fc02886057e0c30d277664e5aee55950.src: A sensitivity ranking depends on the input ranges you test. Changing one assumption at a time does not describe every joint outcome or assign probabilities to the results.
69f70758fc02886057e0c30d277664e5aee55950.zh: 敏感度排名取决于您测试的输入范围。一次更改一个假设并不能描述每个联合结果或为结果分配概率。

69fcafe8c7523761c573ae5d88452bee1e512f50.zh: 这是所选储蓄行为下的等端资源阈值。这不是必需的银行余额。将年费除以有效年收益率会使用不同的计时捷径，因此不需要给出完全相同的结果。

69fedbb2c7982f242213031a203cc973ee13e610.zh: 收入中断会改变供款计划的承受能力 · 加元

6a01d43596c855c5cb6353718f35a30ef88e4a7b.zh: 定期和第一年还款数据中的假定税收减免

6a04e9d16461466b95a7922cc70d28681caf6b84.src: The example deliberately retains CAD 10,000 after closing. That money remains an asset, but it must be funded if the purchase is to leave the intended reserve intact. Calling it a closing fee would misdescribe it; leaving it out would hide the desired cash cushion.
6a04e9d16461466b95a7922cc70d28681caf6b84.zh: 示例成交后故意保留 10,000 加元。这笔钱仍然是一种资产，但如果购买要保持预期储备完好无损，就必须为其提供资金。称其为成交费是错误的描述。忽略它会隐藏所需的现金缓冲。

6a06a26835d51075f841856a82dfd590147ed01d.src: Original hypothetical USD capital-property example for one purchase, no later adjusted-cost changes and a full disposition. Acquisition cost is translated at its independently entered acquisition-date CAD-per-USD rate; gross disposition proceeds use the disposition-date rate. Eligible disposition expenses are supplied already in CAD and subtracted once. No quoted market rates are imported. All chart results are CAD arithmetic before an inclusion rate, tax, loss-eligibility rules or other income. No actual currency conversion, settlement receipt, spending cash, later disposition of USD cash, pooled-cost calculation, partial sale, reinvestment, dividend or registered-account treatment is modeled. A negative result is an arithmetic loss, not a determination that it may be claimed.
6a06a26835d51075f841856a82dfd590147ed01d.zh: 一次购买的原始假设美元资本财产示例，没有后期调整成本变化和完整处置。购置成本按独立输入的购置日期加元兑美元汇率换算；处置收益总额使用处置日汇率。符合条件的处置费用已以加元形式提供并扣除一次。不导入市场报价。所有图表结果均为加元算术，未考虑包含率、税收、损失资格规则或其他收入。没有对实际的货币兑换、结算收据、现金支出、美元现金的后续处置、集合成本计算、部分销售、再投资、股息或注册账户处理进行建模。负结果是算术损失，而不是可以索赔的决定。

6a08845c56d313d424d59fe0802c9afe4047c899.src: A practical follow-up is to ask what would make an earlier start feasible: a smaller initial transfer, redirecting an expense, or a gradual increase as income changes. A larger assumed return can make a spreadsheet balance without making the required outcome reliable.
6a08845c56d313d424d59fe0802c9afe4047c899.zh: 实际的后续行动是询问什么可以使较早开始变得可行：较小的初始转移、重新分配费用或随着收入变化而逐渐增加。较大的假设回报可以使电子表格平衡，但不会使所需的结果变得可靠。

6a0fb55254cb098594d36fc8ae81e5eba62f6990.src: The default starts with CAD 400,000 of debt, a 5% nominal annual rate compounded monthly and CAD 2,400 paid at each month-end. Interest is the opening monthly balance multiplied by the annual quoted rate divided by twelve.
6a0fb55254cb098594d36fc8ae81e5eba62f6990.zh: 违约起始为 400,000 加元的债务，每月复利 5% 的名义年利率，并在每个月末支付 2,400 加元。利息是期初每月余额乘以年度报价利率除以 12。

6a1109f1cfa27fc8259238e49f4858f5a041f46c.zh: 为什么缩水付款值得重新审视

After the final payment, the pay-now path holds about CAD 17,969 and the financed path about CAD 17,268. Both have no purchase debt remaining and own the same item.
6a1e9a2ca4281009180acb2b3470583bd12d7e2e.zh: 正现金余额可赚取选定的有效年度回报，并转换为每月等值回报。在最初的例子中，假设是 3%。最终付款后，立即付款路径约为 17,969 加元，融资路径约为 17,268 加元。两者都没有剩余的购买债务，并且拥有相同的物品。

6a1f85b428b838539792bc95f5bfe3299c7d67aa.zh: 固定的外国账单转换为加元

6a24381f91a348cd22fbcc2e059ab95214c2cc6b.zh: 每次预定付款后购买本金的加元

The depreciation assumption here is independently selected and smooth. It is not an appraisal, a source-reported depreciation schedule or a forecast of used-car prices.
6a278076847970763badf4bf70ae2624fa4c5762.zh: 尝试更长的贷款期限和更快的价值下降。较小的每月付款可以与在预定销售日期的更多债务共存。这里的折旧假设是独立选择的并且是平滑的。它不是评估、来源报告的折旧表或二手车价格预测。

6a323b20bdda2fc633a26f8fe6cf5b8b111505a3.src: Time zero is after immediate costs. Every later point is after that month’s receipts and spending. This partial payoff reconciliation excludes accrued interest, adjustments and any unlisted costs. It does not determine how much a new lender will advance or whether a replacement loan is affordable.
6b7b7fde64ce40791e6401f4c0d08f1e340c59e0.zh: 委托人消灭所输入的债务；这不是违约金。费用和其他费用是额外的现金使用。该部分支付调节不包括应计利息、调整和任何未列出的成本。它并不能确定新贷款人将预付多少资金，也不能确定替代贷款是否负担得起。

6b7c024ad2f74d4ddda25f1e825f3db0f402a0ac.src: OSC’s GIC explanation describes staggered maturities and choices at maturity, including reinvestment or taking cash. Here renewal is an explicit instruction in the model. The charts do not infer an actual bank’s automatic-renewal terms.
6b7c024ad2f74d4ddda25f1e825f3db0f402a0ac.zh: OSC 的 GIC 解释描述了交错期限和到期时的选择，包括再投资或提取现金。这里的更新是模型中的明确指令。这些图表并不推断实际银行的自动续订条款。

6b7f84f46e6fe3320376ba8660924bd9d826f134.src: Management may exclude restructuring, acquisition costs, impairments, or compensation from an adjusted earnings measure. Start with the reconciliation and ask what economic activity produced each adjustment. Repeated exclusions need a reason to disappear from a future forecast.
6b7f84f46e6fe3320376ba8660924bd9d826f134.zh: 管理层可能会从调整后的收益指标中排除重组、收购成本、减值或补偿。从调节开始，询问每次调整是由哪些经济活动产生的。重复排除需要有理由从未来预测中消失。

6b871c9d4c8af13e42ab2bd0b0d2aa30393a6349.src: The release explains that the lowest two quintiles are combined because the lowest quintile’s average liabilities exceeded its assets. A positive average for the combined bottom 40% therefore does not establish that its least wealthy households have positive net worth. The missing detail matters.
6b871c9d4c8af13e42ab2bd0b0d2aa30393a6349.zh: 该新闻稿解释说，将最低的两个五分之一合并起来，因为最低的五分之一的平均负债超过其资产。因此，底部 40% 人口总和的平均值为正并不能证明其最不富裕的家庭拥有正的净资产。缺失的细节很重要。

6b98419fe903ddd476b44652d427d18a59755df2.src: Keep the withdrawal record, the securities position and the bank statement in distinct roles. The incremental payment can be isolated because the payment formula is linear in principal. The assumed rate stays unchanged for the full horizon; actual mortgage terms and renewal rates can differ.

6b46ce6b41ec8348a8e45b4c479497d8f6ad5409.src: Interest avoided is only one part of the comparison. Track accessible savings and debt separately, and keep the monthly payment allocation identical in both choices.
6b46ce6b41ec8348a8e45b4c479497d8f6ad5409.zh: 免息只是比较的一部分。分别跟踪可用储蓄和债务，并在两种选择中保持每月付款分配相同。

6b4857db9d237fa13533553ae6ebc809a01bc7c4.src: From the next cycle, the example charges a 22% nominal annual rate divided by twelve on remaining debt before the payment. Actual cards can calculate daily interest and use different payment allocation rules. The illustration uses one explicit monthly convention so the schedule can be inspected.
6b4857db9d237fa13533553ae6ebc809a01bc7c4.zh: 从下一个周期开始，该示例对付款前的剩余债务收取 22% 的名义年利率除以 12。实际的卡可以计算每日利息并使用不同的付款分配规则。该插图使用了一个明确的每月约定，以便可以检查时间表。

6b53311392a370e2ae5265e968d061d3d956cba0.src: After depletion, the portfolio remains at zero; this model adds no new deposits. The unfunded curve is neither an investment account nor an available credit line. It records spending the assumed portfolio could not supply, without assuming that spending was financed elsewhere.
6b53311392a370e2ae5265e968d061d3d956cba0.zh: 耗尽后，投资组合仍为零；该模型不增加新的存款。无资金曲线既不是投资账户，也不是可用的信用额度。它记录假设的投资组合无法提供的支出，而不假设支出是在其他地方融资的。

6ba2487be643cf11de74c9b6d3068cf474c938b2.src: Those monthly totals do not establish a complete wealth advantage over the fully amortizing loan. The balloon fund also starts with CAD 2,000 already allocated, and the two choices can leave different cash available elsewhere. A fair whole-household comparison must state what happens to that initial money and any differences in later monthly resources.
6ba2487be643cf11de74c9b6d3068cf474c938b2.zh: 与全额摊销贷款相比，这些月度总额并没有形成完全的财富优势。气球基金也从已分配的 2,000 加元开始，这两种选择可以在其他地方留下不同的可用现金。公平的全家庭比较必须说明初始资金的情况以及以后每月资源的任何差异。

6d14ae9572e6cd2511d7253e37cc2479c072bd5f.src: Original hypothetical four-year comparison. All paths receive the same entered gross total-return percentages with no contributions or withdrawals. One path has no modeled fees. The annual-reset path charges the selected fraction of each positive annual dollar gain, with no carryforward of past losses. The high-water-mark path charges only on gross year-end value above its prior highest post-fee year-end balance, starting at initial capital. After charging, its mark is the larger of the old mark and the new net balance. Fees crystallize once per year and are deducted inside each account; no outside fee cash is added. These are explicitly invented rules, not a description or quote for a specific fund. Management fees, hurdles, benchmarks, subscriptions, redemptions, equalization, tax and other costs are excluded. No high-water mark guarantees principal or prevents losses. Future return effects on earlier fee deductions may be positive or negative.
6d14ae9572e6cd2511d7253e37cc2479c072bd5f.zh: 最初假设的四年比较。所有路径都收到相同的输入总总回报百分比，没有贡献或提取。一种路径没有模型费用。年度重置路径收取每个正年度美元收益的选定部分，不结转过去的损失。高水位线路径仅对高于其先前最高收费后年终余额的年终总价值收费，从初始资本开始。充值后，其标记为旧标记与新净余额中较大者。费用每年结晶一次并在每个账户内扣除；不添加任何外部费用现金。这些是明确发明的规则，而不是对特定基金的描述或报价。管理费、障碍、基准、认购、赎回、均衡、税收和其他成本不包括在内。没有高水位线可以保证本金或防止损失。未来回报对早期费用扣除的影响可能是正数，也可能是负数。

6d16f8f6261532cb5bc79e89011a17f04992400e.src: The assistance holdback amount, or AHA, is a defined measure of recent government assistance, reduced by relevant amounts already repaid. It is not simply every grant and bond ever received, and it is not automatically the entire RDSP balance.
6d16f8f6261532cb5bc79e89011a17f04992400e.zh: 援助保留金额 (AHA) 是近期政府援助的一项明确衡量标准，减去已偿还的相关金额。它不仅仅是收到的每笔赠款和债券，也不会自动成为整个 RDSP 余额。

6ca649a5283925ee819dec76a463225cebc1c122.src: Hypothetical event budget with fixed quotes and no inflation or interest. Fixed, guest and other costs are fully inclusive of any taxes and fees; no tax is calculated. The booking deposit is the selected share of the full base quote and is paid immediately, before any new saving. The rest of that quote plus the full additional contingency allowance is paid at the beginning of the selected event month. Saving arrives at each earlier month-end only; the event month’s paycheque cannot fund its opening bill. Guests and prices stay fixed after booking. No gifts, reimbursements, refunds, cancellation, contract interpretation, credit, return or other household goal is assumed. Negative cash is unfunded spending. A higher future saving rate cannot repair a booking deposit already due. The additional allowance is assumed fully spent in this stress budget; it is not a statistical forecast.
6ca649a5283925ee819dec76a463225cebc1c122.zh: 假设的活动预算具有固定报价，没有通货膨胀或利息。固定费用、宾客费用和其他费用完全包含任何税费；不计算任何税款。预订押金是完整基本报价的选定份额，并在任何新的节省之前立即支付。该报价的其余部分加上全额额外应急津贴将在所选活动月份开始时支付。储蓄仅在每个较早的月底到达；活动月份的薪水无法为其开业账单提供资金。客人和价格在预订后保持不变。不承担任何礼品、报销、退款、取消、合同解释、信用、退货或其他家庭目标。负现金是没有资金支持的支出。未来较高的储蓄率无法修复已到期的预订押金。假设额外津贴已全部用于此压力预算；这不是统计预测。

6cc0a454d7146e39bc239270eca3094be993a4f4.src: Three limits belong beside that arithmetic. It assumes the forecast is realized exactly. It assumes every installment arrives on time. And it is an illustration, not a provider’s adjustment algorithm or a household’s right to select an installment.

6925d6c1dc140bd1157ed16dfebe09dbf47c2e16.src: This is an accounting identity under unchanged execution prices, rather than a full household wealth forecast. Tax, transaction costs and subsequent price movements would create additional changes. Outside money may also have an existing purpose elsewhere in the household plan. Improving a ratio by transferring that money does not make its previous obligation disappear or establish that the investment has earned back its loss.
6925d6c1dc140bd1157ed16dfebe09dbf47c2e16.zh: 这是执行价格不变的会计恒等式，而不是完整的家庭财富预测。税收、交易成本和随后的价格变动将带来额外的变化。外部资金也可能在家庭计划的其他地方有其现有用途。通过转移资金来提高比率并不会使之前的义务消失，也不会证明投资已赚回损失。

693788c47718d0f3b532a65c0cdc03f52ebcfc0f.src: With CAD 4,000 of monthly essentials, CAD 1,000 of replacement cash and a six-month interruption, the original hold-shares example accumulates CAD 10,000 of unfunded bills. 693788c47718d0f3b532a65c0cdc03f52ebcfc0f.zh: 每月 4,000 加元的必需品、1,000 加元的替代现金和 6 个月的中断，最初的持有股份示例累计了 10,000 加元的无资金账单。其中一些差距出现在第七个月：第一张恢复的 6,000 加元工资收据仍然在该月的账单之后到达。仅年度总额就可以掩盖此时间问题。

6d7ef7fd93453bdd12d40751a27fc6c433b755cb.src: A payment credited after a snapshot cannot change the balance already observed at that earlier point. An earlier payment may also be capped against a smaller then-outstanding balance, leaving later purchases to accumulate. The month-end result can therefore depend on timing when the requested payment is larger than early debt.

6d7f05eef122ac1a815812506df766e30ed105cb.src: The stock-compensation add-back deserves separate attention. It is noncash in this period, but new shares can dilute ownership. 6dc2723574176e1a51e3a35d7bee522a40cb0d23.src: For every month m, compare cumulative bills due by that month with the starting reserve R. A constant monthly contribution C must satisfy R + Cm ≥ cumulative bills through month m. The smallest non-negative C is the largest value of (cumulative bills − R) ÷ m across the twelve months, floored at zero.
6dc2723574176e1a51e3a35d7bee522a40cb0d23.zh: 对于每个月 m，将该月到期的累计账单与起始准备金 R 进行比较。恒定的每月供款 C 必须满足 R + Cm ≥ m 月份的累计账单。最小的非负 C 是 12 个月内(累积账单 − R) ÷ m 的最大值，下限为零。

6dff0c810edf3d702daf3b6dd474022f978df80b.src: Hypothetical two-bucket allocation arithmetic in CAD, not an asset-mix recommendation or a security order. The chosen target is restricted to 5–95% for this illustration. Prices and existing holdings stay fixed; all new money is allocated, with no sales. Desired A buying equals target share times the post-contribution total minus current A, capped between zero and available new money; the rest buys B. The cash threshold rounds up to cents, while allocations otherwise allow fractional values. No actual lot size, spread, trading fee, tax, contribution-room limit, return, risk score or price movement is calculated. An empty portfolio has no defined zero-contribution weight; positive new money can still be allocated in the chosen proportions. A target reference row is not a claim that the available contribution can achieve it.
6dff0c810edf3d702daf3b6dd474022f978df80b.zh: CAD 中假设的两桶分配算法，不是资产组合建议或安全指令。在此示例中，所选目标限制为 5–95%。价格和现有持有量保持不变；所有新资金均已分配，没有销售。期望的 A 购买等于目标份额乘以后贡献总额减去当前 A，上限在零和可用新资金之间；其余人购买 B。现金门槛四舍五入为美分，而分配则允许小数。不计算实际手数、点差、交易费用、税收、供款限额、回报、风险评分或价格变动。空投资组合没有定义的零贡献权重；积极的新资金仍然可以按照选定的比例进行分配。目标参考行并不是声称可用捐款可以实现该目标。

6e1f93c9d4b68d7cfd1ad0423178bca7e37aeff8.src: A mathematical illustration, not a reverse-mortgage quote, qualification or credit-limit calculation. Interest uses an entered effective annual rate converted to monthly compounding; it accrues before each month-end advance. Opening capitalized fees also accrue interest. There are no repayments or later fees, and all entered advances are assumed available throughout; real draw limits, rates and contract conditions can differ. Cash advances are borrowed principal, not investment income. Their subsequent spending or retention is not tracked, so this is not whole-household net worth. Sale residual is signed arithmetic before other debts, taxes, penalties or estate costs; it does not determine legal shortfall liability, contractual guarantees or an estate entitlement.
6e1f93c9d4b68d7cfd1ad0423178bca7e37aeff8.zh: 数学说明，而非反向抵押贷款报价、资格或信用额度计算。利息使用输入的有效年利率转换为月复利；它在每个月末预付款之前累积。开业费用资本化也会产生利息。没有还款或后期费用，并且所有输入的预付款均假定自始至终可用；实际提款限额、利率和合同条件可能有所不同。预借现金属于借入本金，而非投资收益。他们随后的支出或保留没有被追踪，因此这不是整个家庭的净资产。销售剩余额在其他债务、税收、罚款或遗产成本之前进行算术签名；它不确定法律短缺责任、合同担保或遗产权利。

6c79338c8c3eac295962dbd579cb7d1505bcffb7.src: Wealth, insurance and wholesale broaden the earnings base but bring their own sensitivities. Rising asset markets support fees; active financing and trading support wholesale; insurance claims can interrupt the apparent annuity. Diversification helps most when the engines respond differently to stress. The underwriting should not give every business its best environment simultaneously. Segment ROEs also use allocated capital, so their levels should not be read as directly interchangeable with consolidated shareholder returns.
6c79338c8c3eac295962dbd579cb7d1505bcffb7.zh: 财富、保险和批发扩大了收入基础，但也带来了敏感性。资产市场支持费上涨；积极的融资和贸易支持批发；保险索赔可能会中断表观年金。当引擎对压力的反应不同时，多元化最有帮助。承保不应该同时为每个企业提供最好的环境。部门 ROE 也使用分配资本，因此其水平不应被理解为与合并股东回报直接互换。

6f445729303dfad4fcb7535b1c36398df5c29ff5.src: Original constant-rate example of fully taxable interest on accessible savings. At each year-end, interest is credited, the assumed combined tax rate applies to that interest, and that tax is paid immediately from the same savings balance. Only net interest stays invested. This timing is an arithmetic convention, not tax withholding, a filing deadline or a CRA instalment schedule. There are no new deposits, withdrawals other than the modeled tax, fees, tax credits, loss offsets, benefit interactions or changes in tax brackets. The tax rate is a user-selected assumption, not a calculated Canadian personal tax rate. The inflation input is a constant assumption, not current CPI. Real values are expressed in the purchasing power of the starting date. The before-tax reference is a mathematical comparison, not a registered-account recommendation or promise of a market yield.

7137a447a5e7366edb61ce22f3c524f6f2d0c12b.src: Original USD illustration of an inflation-indexed bond, not an actual TIPS quote, observed CPI series or investment recommendation. The reference price index starts at 1 and compounds at the selected constant annual rate; half-year index levels use fractional powers. Coupons are paid at each half-year end on the then-adjusted principal. Principal may fall below original face before maturity; the original-face floor is applied only to principal redemption, never to the coupon calculation. This simplified schedule omits actual TIPS daily reference-CPI conventions, publication lag, interpolation, accrued interest and settlement rounding. The purchase outlay is entered independently as a percentage of original face; no market yield or fair price is estimated. All coupons are retained as cash earning zero interest and are never added to indexed principal. No fees, tax, default, early sale, fund distributions or currency conversion is included. Base-year coupon amounts divide each payment by the same model index at its own payment date; they are not the purchasing power of an accumulated cash account at maturity. USD indexation does not establish protection for a CAD spending goal or a personal spending basket.
7137a447a5e7366edb61ce22f3c524f6f2d0c12b.zh: 通胀指数债券的原始美元说明，而非实际的 TIPS 报价、观察到的 CPI 系列或投资建议。参考价格指数从1开始，按选定的固定年利率复利；半年指数水平使用分数幂。每半年末根据当时调整后的本金还款息票。本金可能在到期前低于原面值；原面下限仅适用于本金赎回，不适用于息票计算。这个简化的时间表省略了实际的 TIPS 每日参考 CPI 约定、发布滞后、插值、应计利息和结算舍入。购买费用以原始面额的百分比形式单独输入；没有估计市场收益率或公平价格。所有优惠券均保留为赚取零利息的现金，且绝不会添加到指数本金中。不包括任何费用、税费、违约、提前出售、资金分配或货币兑换。基准年息票金额将每笔付款除以其付款日期的相同型号指数；它们不是累积现金账户到期时的购买力。美元指数化并不能为加元支出目标或个人支出篮子提供保护。

70a1576fe0ec28aa86cb1cfbd7c4c78ef40d9d7a.src: Original two-asset moment calculations, not historical data or forecasts. Weights are long-only and sum to 100%; no leverage, cash flows, fees, taxes, FX, trading restrictions or serial-return model is included. All return means, standard deviations and correlations are independently selected assumptions, without an estimated covariance matrix for any actual investment. Mean return is arithmetic over one year. Standard deviation measures dispersion; it is not a maximum loss, drawdown, loss probability or guaranteed range. Translating standard deviation to dollars changes the scale, not the investment risk percentage. Correlation stresses describe alternative assumptions and have no assigned probabilities. No distributional shape or normality is assumed.
70a1576fe0ec28aa86cb1cfbd7c4c78ef40d9d7a.zh: 原始两种资产矩计算，而不是历史数据或预测。权重仅为多头，总和为 100%；不包括杠杆、现金流、费用、税收、外汇、交易限制或连续回报模型。所有回报均值、标准差和相关性都是独立选择的假设，没有任何实际投资的估计协方差矩阵。平均回报是一年的算术回报。标准差衡量分散度；它不是最大损失、回撤、损失概率或保证范围。将标准差换算成美元会改变规模，而不是投资风险百分比。相关应力描述了替代假设，并且没有指定的概率。不假设分布形状或正态性。

70d551430239878644770a631cd6fd4e7b8ad13e.src: One invented all-in purchase, no financed interest and no down payment. Cash discount applies only to immediate full payment; a separate financing fee is paid upfront. Both choices start with purchase price plus the financing fee in cash and receive the same monthly amount, equal to one instalment. The cash buyer saves that monthly amount; the financed buyer uses it for the payment. Accounts earn the same constant entered return after tax and costs before each month-end flow. Both finish with the same item and no purchase debt. No actual credit terms, statutory APR, late charges, default, resale value or return guarantee is calculated.
70d551430239878644770a631cd6fd4e7b8ad13e.zh: 一项发明了全包购买，无需融资利息，无需首付。现金折扣仅适用于立即全额付款；预先支付单独的融资费用。两种选择都是从购买价格加上现金融资费用开始，每月收到相同的金额，相当于一笔分期付款。现金购买者每月保存该金额；融资买家用它来付款。在每个月末流量之前，账户在税后和成本后获得相同的恒定输入回报。两者都以相同的物品完成，并且没有购买债务。不计算实际信用条款、法定年利率、滞纳金、违约、转售价值或退货保证。

715002c9463848a35b7eb725bdd9707f8e39e187.src: Hypothetical twelve-month cash ledger with equal invoices each month and no opening receivables or payables. Operating cash costs and owner withdrawals occur at each month’s start; invoice m is collected at the end of month m + delay. Only receipts inside twelve months are counted; later invoices remain receivable. Positive invoice-based operating profit creates a month-end tax earmark even before collection. This percentage is a planning allowance, not actual tax or CPP/QPP. Earmark is held, with no remittance modeled; if cash is insufficient it is an unfunded target, not a funded account. Free cash deducts the target once. No corporate salary/dividend rules, GST/HST, deductible-expense assessment, depreciation, bad debt, financing cost or tax deadline is calculated. Negative points are unfunded needs, not an approved overdraft.
715002c9463848a35b7eb725bdd9707f8e39e187.zh: 假设的十二个月现金分类账，每月都有相同的发票，并且没有期初应收账款或应付账款。运营现金成本和所有者提款发生在每个月开始时；发票 m 在 m + 延迟月末收取。仅计算十二个月内的收据；以后的发票仍然是应收的。基于发票的正营业利润甚至在征收之前就可以产生月末税收专款。该百分比是计划津贴，而不是实际税收或 CPP/QPP。持有专款专用，无汇款模式；如果现金不足，则为无资金目标，而不是有资金账户。自由现金扣除目标一次。不计算公司工资/股息规则、GST/HST、可扣除费用评估、折旧、坏账、融资成本或纳税期限。负分是指没有资金支持的需求，而不是经批准的透支。

725320294fee545db2ff738b16c4ba84c5665bcb.zh: 将立即一次性付款与有限的年度付款流进行比较，将每张收据贴现到同一日期，并将最终总额与当前账单的可用现金区分开来。

72568e43debb45942531c66abc33d37462680b6b.src: The selected-level chart puts graduation amounts beside still-owing interview amounts, while its captions retain the subgroup condition. It does not label their difference as the amount repaid or the return on paying down a loan.
72568e43debb45942531c66abc33d37462680b6b.zh: 选定级别的图表显示毕业金额除尚欠访谈金额外，而其标题保留了分组条件。它没有将它们的差异标记为偿还金额或偿还贷款的回报。

725cf89ad1c6d7476d310c3a355604d49c5aa35a.src: The model funds a level shortfall in today’s purchasing-power dollars, paid at each year-end. For annual gap G, real return r and n years, the reserve is G[1 − (1 + r)−n] ÷ r. At zero return, it is G × n. A negative real return increases the starting reserve required for the same future purchasing power.
725cf89ad1c6d7476d310c3a355604d49c5aa35a.zh: 该模型为当今美元购买力的水平缺口提供资金，并在每年年底支付。对于年缺口 G、实际回报 r 和 n 年，准备金为 G[1 − (1 + r)−n] ÷ r。归零时，为 G × n。负实际回报会增加相同未来购买力所需的起始准备金。

726012c7225aae05a542bb2af493e71f4af7725c.src: Put their amounts on a consistent net-cash basis.
726012c7225aae05a542bb2af493e71f4af7725c.zh: 将其金额以一致的净现金为基础。

7261ef62e25b3d734ad5e83213a3d7bc97fdc68c.zh: 当前季度减去上一季度 · 个百分点

720fd78e96cbd124989e10b548b186ab30c4a8ec.src: The calculator’s categories are bookkeeping allocations of the current contract total. They need not match every invoice line. Each amount belongs in one category only, and the three amounts together should reconcile to the quote being reviewed.
720fd78e96cbd124989e10b548b186ab30c4a8ec.zh: 计算器的类别是当前合同总额的簿记分配。它们不需要匹配每个发票行。每项金额仅属于一个类别，三项金额合计应与正在审查的报价一致。

721090c85a2c68025e916a5eff0ff73618628c26.src: A fixed insured-value threshold caps the household share only within this simplified covered-loss formula
721090c85a2c68025e916a5eff0ff73618628c26.zh: 固定保险价值阈值仅在简化的承保损失公式内限制家庭份额

7210a9f5cbab196552084ed97b2297d1d9c65dc8.zh: 五个图表中的抵押贷款终止费用：三个月的利息、利率差距和支付现金

721232a5762118b266082ac647738ef2e2ec648c.src: Plan a break from work: map the income drop and the reserve before you leave
721232a5762118b266082ac647738ef2e2ec648c.zh: 计划下班休息：在离开之前绘制收入下降和储备金

72165b3b81e3568afd985cb33ef3be7e6e3ade8a.src: This is a deliberately limited baseline. The current role might also change, and a new career might improve health, flexibility or job satisfaction. Those outcomes matter, but the charts do not assign them invented dollar values.
72165b3b81e3568afd985cb33ef3be7e6e3ade8a.zh: 这是一个故意限制的基线。当前的角色也可能会发生变化，新的职业可能会改善健康、灵活性或工作满意度。这些结果很重要，但图表并未赋予它们发明的美元价值。

721bd91a07bb5445aeb9626ae31aa183bef17b7c.src: Invented 2027 calendar, not an employer payroll schedule. Pay arrives every 14 days from the selected January day, without holiday shifts. Fixed bills occur on the chosen day of every month; other spending occurs on all 365 calendar days. Bills and daily costs precede any same-day payday. Net receipts are entered independently; no payroll deduction, interest, overdraft or borrowing facility is calculated. Negative cash means an unfunded requirement.
721bd91a07bb5445aeb9626ae31aa183bef17b7c.zh: 发明了 2027 年日历，而不是雇主工资表。从选定的 1 月那天起，每 14 天发一次工资，没有假期班次。固定账单发生在每月选定的一天；其他支出发生在所有 365 个日历日。账单和日常费用先于任何当天发薪日。净收入独立输入；不计算工资扣除、利息、透支或借贷便利。负现金意味着没有资金支持。

72282c568631ff7a4b1ffc75d67c7987267deef0.src: Original hypothetical fuel-only comparison, not actual vehicle ratings, fuel quotes or a prediction of annual driving. Each vehicle travels the same entered annual kilometres and city-distance share. Litres per 100 km are weighted by distance, then multiplied by kilometres/100 and that vehicle’s required fuel price. The selected weighted consumption is 8.200 L/100 km for A and 7.225 for B. The entered annual fuel costs tie at 56.91% city-distance share. Fuel prices are constant over the modeled year. No purchase price, financing, depreciation, maintenance, insurance, tax calculation, non-fuel energy, equipment spending, time savings or resale value is included. The city/highway inputs may describe synthetic cases that do not match any actual vehicle; the tool does not recommend substituting a fuel type or grade. Laboratory labels are comparison tools, and actual consumption can differ with conditions. Display rounding does not feed back into the calculations.
72282c568631ff7a4b1ffc75d67c7987267deef0.zh: 最初假设的仅燃料比较，而不是实际车辆评级、燃料报价或每年驾驶的预测。每辆车行驶的年公里数和城市距离份额相同。每 100 公里升数按距离加权，然后乘以公里/100 以及该车辆所需的燃油价格。 A 选择的加权消耗量为 8.200 L/100 km，B 为 7.225 L/100 km。输入的年度燃油成本与城市距离份额的 56.91% 一致。燃油价格在模型年份保持不变。不包括购买价格、融资、折旧、维护、保险、税收计算、非燃料能源、设备支出、节省时间或转售价值。城市/高速公路输入可能描述与任何实际车辆不匹配的合成案例；该工具不建议替换燃料类型或等级。实验室标签是比较工具，实际消耗量可能因情况而异。显示舍入不会反馈到计算中。

7230560e896e11282eed568ca61dd53d8ac28276.zh: 将可兑现利率应用于剩余本金

71e49a8822a03a380b6c23d7f279117b9586edf2.src: The example buys a hypothetical bond with CAD 100,000 face value, a fixed 5% annual coupon and ten years to maturity. Its purchase yield is 5% effective annually, so the purchase price is CAD 100,000. The purchase occurs immediately after a coupon boundary, with no accrued interest or dealing cost.
71e49a8822a03a380b6c23d7f279117b9586edf2.zh: 该示例购买一张面值 100,000 加元、固定年利率 5% 且到期时间为 10 年的假设债券。其购买收益率为年有效5%，因此购买价格为10万加元。购买发生在优惠券边界之后，没有应计利息或交易成本。

71e6bd8b4a63497844d26c98b436145ad1710469.src: Begin with CAD 10,000 at CAD 1.25 per USD. Ignoring conversion costs, you acquire USD 8,000 of assets. Assume the USD investment earns 8% with distributions reinvested, leaving USD 8,640. Translate the ending wealth under three hypothetical exchange rates.
71e6bd8b4a63497844d26c98b436145ad1710469.zh: 从 10,000 加元开始，价格为每美元 1.25 加元。忽略转换成本，您获得了 8,000 美元的资产。假设美元投资收益 8%，分配再投资，剩下 8,640 美元。将最终财富换算为三种假设汇率下的结果。

71e9eeea59c94742eb1ea2ebafc961ab6063cd64.src: For each source category, the value at later age y is ly divided by l65. Every series starts at 100% at the conditioning birthday. Counts are life-table survivors, not observed survey participants. No age beyond 100 is plotted, no individual prognosis is fitted and no future improvement is added. The published ex margin cannot be reused as uncertainty around this ratio.
71e9eeea59c94742eb1ea2ebafc961ab6063cd64.zh: 对于每个来源类别，晚年 y 的值除以 l65。每个系列在调节生日时都以 100% 开始。统计的是生命表中的幸存者，而不是观察到的调查参与者。没有绘制超过 100 岁的年龄，没有拟合个人预后，也没有添加未来的改善。由于该比率存在不确定性，公布的除息保证金不能重复使用。

71ea85689edb79203b5f8518bbfbd4b651dab079.src: Reviewed 25 October 2026 for rights issue, renounceable and non-renounceable terminology. No Australian record-date rule, settlement period or actual offer is applied. All theoretical values, cash requirements and alternative-resource comparisons are independently authored.
71ea85689edb79203b5f8518bbfbd4b651dab079.zh: 于 2026 年 10 月 25 日针对供股、可放弃和不可放弃术语进行了审核。不适用澳大利亚记录日期规则、结算期或实际要约。所有理论值、现金需求和替代资源比较均独立编写。

71ecad9a3cd3855990e7e29e2af95f2a0cdf976a.src: At 60,000 total kilometres, A’s charge is 12,000 × CAD 0.20 = CAD 2,400. B has no excess-distance charge but still pays its CAD 900 premium. B’s modeled distance-related cost is therefore CAD 1,500 lower at this use level.
71ecad9a3cd3855990e7e29e2af95f2a0cdf976a.zh: 总公里数为 60,000 公里时，A 的费用为 12,000 × 0.20 加元 = 2,400 加元。 B 没有超程费，但仍需支付 900 加元的保费。因此，B 的建模距离相关成本在此使用水平下降低了 1,500 加元。

71ecf58154fae83eca98144c2f6f721f192e003d.zh: 探索维修或更换：比较未来现金、当前转售价值和共同退出日期

It changes task hours and the share that actually displaces paid work, holding the quote, materials, tools and after-tax earnings selected. Subjective time value does not affect those cells. This keeps an affordability question separate from how a household chooses to value its time.
7202ea1d82b07f7994f531d31185e171f7e5de10.zh: 矩阵相反，只收现金。它改变了任务时间和实际取代有偿工作的份额，保留了选定的报价、材料、工具和税后收入。主观时间值不会影响这些单元格。这使得负担能力问题与家庭如何选择珍惜时间分开。

72034a42dfeed66c85834d40bd0da9df4cd59c86.zh: 两人的差距始终保持在 24,000 美元

72048373ee6d649d6444545312715b84ee639933.zh: 已审核2026 年 10 月 25 日的两个结果固定概率分布及其平均值。不会复制事件数据集、拟合参数、发布者数据或概率估计。所有家庭情景假设均独立编写。

6fadf7559367cfdd96b8b0552db67963204fcf60.src: Each point is a separate contribution-date scenario, not the return earned through that month. The return path and contribution amount stay selected. The path is known only because it is invented here; this comparison cannot identify a future best time to invest.
6fadf7559367cfdd96b8b0552db67963204fcf60.zh: 每个点都是一个单独的贡献日期场景，而不是该月赚取的回报。返回路径和贡献金额保持选定状态。这条路之所以为人所知，只是因为它是在这里发明的；这种比较无法确定未来的最佳投资时机。

6fae0857d8c1a1c4bc435a3e289613f6fd265543.src: This bridge concerns 2025 benefits. Its endpoint is before ordinary income tax and excludes supplements. It is not twelve times the future monthly cash result, which concerns a later payment period and can use a different gross pension amount.
6fae0857d8c1a1c4bc435a3e289613f6fd265543.zh: 此桥梁涉及 2025 年的收益。其终点是普通所得税前，不包括补贴。它不是未来每月现金结果的十二倍，这涉及到以后的付款期，并且可以使用不同的养老金总额。

6fae828c66aa349f9a24c89b865ea4cca6af7f2e.src: The objective is a realistic personal funding calendar. It is not a prediction of a future levy or a recommendation that a particular building should collect or spend its reserves.
6fae828c66aa349f9a24c89b865ea4cca6af7f2e.zh: 目标是一个现实的个人资金日历。它不是对未来征税的预测，也不是特定建筑物应收集或支出其储备金的建议。

6faf32712b1d0de71c0fc1708ea694bfb3f2ec3f.zh: 距气球日期整整几个月

6fb257cc3adfdc8cd2e81146e9369d22c46626e4.zh: 协调差额，无需计算两次兑换

6fb8956811488f4124156efd8ea9ecb8a6da3b04.src: An invented arithmetic example makes the means easier to read. If three of ten people record four hours each and seven record zero, total time is twelve hours. The population mean is 1.2 hours, the participant mean is four hours and participation is 30%. With consistent unrounded quantities, 30% × four equals 1.2.
6fb8956811488f4124156efd8ea9ecb8a6da3b04.zh: 发明的算术示例使方法更易于阅读。如果十人中的三人每人记录四小时，七人记录零，则总时间为十二小时。总体平均值为 1.2 小时，参与者平均值为 4 小时，参与率为 30%。在不四舍五入数量一致的情况下，30% × 4 等于 1.2。

72980e10db435bb0bb6e3a3cd70f680cd09b54b7.src: The model must reduce cash capital and share count together. It should then test how much capital remains after risk-weighted asset growth, ordinary dividends and continuing control investment. Repurchases are most compelling when the bank can distribute surplus resources without constraining high-return customer opportunities. An eventual slowdown in repurchases is not inherently negative if capital is being reinvested productively; the accompanying return evidence determines the interpretation.
72980e10db435bb0bb6e3a3cd70f680cd09b54b7.zh: 该模型必须同时减少现金资本和股票数量。然后应该测试在风险加权资产增长、普通股息和持续控制投资之后还剩下多少资本。当银行能够在不限制高回报客户机会的情况下分配剩余资源时，回购最具吸引力。如果资本被有效地进行再投资，那么回购的最终放缓本质上并不是负面的。随附的返回证据决定了解释。

729a55b91b33cbb8d08012c33caa2fa46c9e7e07.src: The charts apply those payment definitions to one hypothetical opening mortgage. They keep the selected rate unchanged through payoff to isolate the mechanics. An actual mortgage has a term, renewal conditions and contractual payment provisions that can change the path. No future renewal rate is inferred from the example.

73a1daad0d3ed2b99ae174f4b737a92d7ccb62b3.src: The recomputed path keeps the same charges and the same installments already paid, then spreads the current difference plus the forecast remaining charges over the remaining months. 7384c6654301bbbf303eefeb634f94887ce7b2bb.src: Actual policies can differ in eligibility, insured events, maximum benefits, definitions, exclusions and claim timing. 739b2b910f45ea4c8ef240b563c3e8f687eebab8.src: Keep the evidence and the scenario visible side by side. A round number in a calculator is not evidence about future prices.

739b8a37c3c0758e9e7ee903a3b13fe286a8e6dd.src: The payment may contain taxable amounts. This illustration does not calculate that composition, tax payable, benefit interactions or the beneficiary’s after-tax spending money. “Gross beneficiary payment” is deliberately the label used in the charts.
739b8a37c3c0758e9e7ee903a3b13fe286a8e6dd.zh: 付款可能包含应税金额。本图并未计算该构成、应缴税款、福利互动或受益人的税后支出。 “总受益人支付”是图表中特意使用的标签。

739fd7ba32d56afe38d0f64d35ae70b65705afba.src: In the model, avoided energy spending grows 2% annually because of the selected nominal price-growth assumption. Maintenance stays constant at CAD 100 each year. This isolates the two lines explicitly; it is not a forecast that every project cost or energy tariff follows the same rate.
739fd7ba32d56afe38d0f64d35ae70b65705afba.zh: 在模型中，由于选定的名义价格增长假设，避免的能源支出每年增长 2%。每年维护费用保持在 100 加元不变。这明确地隔离了两条线；这并不是每个项目成本或能源关税都遵循相同比率的预测。

73a0911df34a1785837e257d88b8b55cc4d0bf6a.src: Rows replace the opening reserve; columns replace the month-end transfer. All four entered payment amounts and dates stay selected. Cells show extra starting cash needed to cover every modeled event, rather than the final annual deficit. They do not assess instalment eligibility, required amounts or tax-payment compliance.
73a0911df34a1785837e257d88b8b55cc4d0bf6a.zh: 行取代期初储备；列取代月末转账。所有四个输入的付款金额和日期均保持选中状态。单元显示了支付每个模拟事件所需的额外起始现金，而不是最终的年度赤字。他们不评估分期付款资格、所需金额或纳税合规性。

73a10301e97aaf548438756872aa5fc7b135cefd.src: Other monthly costs can include a separately estimated change in work meals or clothing. Count only the relevant additional amount if an expense would also occur at home. Do not enter the same parking or travel bill in both fields. A new vehicle, relocation, child care or a substantial change in insurance needs more detail than this compact comparison provides.
73a10301e97aaf548438756872aa5fc7b135cefd.zh: 其他每月费用可能包括单独估算的工作餐或服装变化。如果家里也会发生费用，则仅计算相关的额外金额。请勿在两个字段中输入相同的停车或交通账单。新车、搬迁、儿童保育或保险的重大变化需要比这个紧凑的比较提供的更多细节。

73562382512c7d086a8a0080d073a8f1bc809489.src: The CRA states that rental-property mortgage or loan principal repayments are not deductible. This is one reason a tax-oriented income number and an owner’s cash flow can differ. The model does not assume that a principal payment becomes a freely available asset that can pay the next bill.
73562382512c7d086a8a0080d073a8f1bc809489.zh: CRA 规定，租赁房产抵押贷款或贷款本金还款不可扣除。这是税收收入数据和所有者现金流量可能不同的原因之一。该模型并不假设本金付款成为可以支付下一笔账单的可自由使用的资产。

7366d0206c624b4ce8547d7889a506d50c09280b.src: A fair timing comparison starts with the same available capital, includes all waiting cash and ends on the same date. A smooth scenario explains the arithmetic; it does not establish which future market path will occur.

7369fe8fdefca7380b1ff066eb05b11176828325.src: At the default horizon, CAD 36,000 of fixed annual income buys about what CAD 17,193.80 bought at the start. 736ab1eee44f0f1fd3edff895c979733e3c64301.src: These are compounded sensitivities. They are not a construction-price forecast, a probability of a loss or a statement that an insurer will increase a particular limit by 2%. 736ab1eee44f0f1fd3edff895c979733e3c64301.zh: 这些都是复杂的敏感性。它们不是建筑价格预测、损失概率或保险公司将特定限额提高 2% 的声明。这些线条显示了当两个独立输入的数量以不同速率增长时会发生什么。

737302b83a64f1b8a2fe664d466230571e79534e.src: A useful comparison begins with homes that provide comparable housing services and households that start with the same money. A larger property with a different location or quality changes the living arrangement as well as the financing decision.

737ca89f88333f65bbac869f8ab6ba76702f6cc1.src: The lower regular payment leaves more debt outstanding for longer under these assumptions. 745647f28b7764ca75a2adc87c8ab3134656f35a.src: The loan uses a fixed monthly interest rate equal to the nominal annual rate divided by twelve. 7506c05e62b81bbbc0ef958462d16f148cbdde8b.src: Our credit thesis requires evidence across several quarters: stable formations, manageable watch-list migration, cash recoveries and losses consistent with the risk embedded in new lending. A falling impaired-loan balance alone is insufficient because write-offs and loan sales can also reduce it. Commercial files can make quarterly losses uneven, so a single favorable quarter should not set the terminal loss assumption. Stress cases should combine weaker revenue, higher impaired losses and renewed performing allowances rather than vary only one benign input.
7506c05e62b81bbbc0ef958462d16f148cbdde8b.zh: 我们的信用理论需要几个季度的证据：稳定的结构、可管理的观察名单迁移、与新贷款中嵌入的风险一致的现金回收和损失。仅减少减值贷款余额是不够的，因为冲销和贷款销售也可以减少减值贷款余额。商业文件可能会使季度亏损不均匀，因此单个有利季度不应设定终端亏损假设。压力情况应结合较弱的收入、较高的减值损失和更新的绩效津贴，而不是仅改变一项良性输入。

753268ec74adbfee9a5153f85e7717e39ee46bcb.src: Each point solves (1 + asset total return) × (1 + quote change) = 1. The curve replaces the selected asset-return assumption; it is independent of principal, starting quote and the selected ending quote. For the selected 8% asset return, the required quote change is -7.4074%, or an ending quote of 1.1574 CAD per FCU. Some thresholds lie outside the quote-change control’s −50% to +50% range. The curve excludes a −100% asset loss, for which no finite exchange rate restores the initial wealth. Costs or intermediate CAD cash flows would change the break-even calculation.

75d6c75d923b6ee90b50a7b5b2be464e96fe247f.src: If the same balance subsequently earns 2% for eight model months, its full twelve-month interest is about CAD 608.15. 7691b16d70b0cf83d81e4a1699dbff00d77c59bd.src: Original deterministic compounding illustration, not a real index, ETF, backtest, simulation of likely prices or investment recommendation. Both synthetic benchmark paths start at 100 and finish at 100.00 after 20 numbered trading days. Each account starts with the same CAD capital and is assumed to deliver exactly the entered multiple of each benchmark’s simple daily return, compounded on its own changing capital. The smooth path has a constant daily log return; the other adds and subtracts log(1 + swing parameter) in each two-day pair, so both benchmark endpoints match. The swing parameter is neither an annualized volatility estimate nor symmetric plus/minus simple returns. All permitted daily account factors remain positive. The full-period arithmetic reference is starting capital × (1 + multiple × complete-window index return); it is not a product return promise or modeled investable portfolio. Fees, financing, tracking error, tax, distributions, trading spreads, intraday purchase timing and external cash flows are excluded. Reordering the same set of daily returns changes intermediate values but not either final product in this cash-flow-free model. Different paired-swing settings change the return set rather than merely reorder it.
7691b16d70b0cf83d81e4a1699dbff00d77c59bd.zh: 原始确定性复利说明，不是真实的指数、ETF、回测、可能价格的模拟或投资建议。两条综合基准路径均以 100 开始，在 20 个交易日后以 100.00 结束。每个账户都以相同的加元资本开始，并假定能够准确交付每个基准简单每日回报的输入倍数，并根据其自身变化的资本进行复利。平滑路径每日日志回报恒定；另一个在每个两天对中添加和减去 log(1 + 波动参数)，因此两个基准端点都匹配。波动参数既不是年化波动率估计，也不是对称正负简单回报。所有允许的每日账户因素仍然为正。全期算术参考为起始资金×（1+倍数×全窗指数回报）；它不是产品回报承诺或建模的可投资投资组合。费用、融资、跟踪误差、税收、分配、交易价差、日内购买时间和外部现金流不包括在内。在这种无现金流模型中，对同一组每日收益进行重新排序会改变中间值，但不会改变最终产品。不同的配对秋千设置会改变回报集，而不仅仅是重新排序。

74b5ad195c456ac8ad115c693745b0670d3b7852.src: The residual is the current budget left after the four named uses of pay. Saving is a cash allocation, rather than current consumption. Costs that continue belong in the residual instead.
74b5ad195c456ac8ad115c693745b0670d3b7852.zh: 剩余是在四种指定的工资用途之后剩下的当前预算。储蓄是现金分配，而不是当前消费。债务支付可以包含本金和利息；整个付款必须实际结束才能从退休现金预算中删除。继续存在的成本属于残差。

74b696173a4080a8efb03a590bb24d0a0528215c.src: Rows replace the constant annual index change; columns replace purchase outlay as a percentage of original face. Face and years stay selected. Cells equal principal redemption minus purchase outlay, in nominal USD. Coupons are deliberately excluded from this principal-only comparison, so a negative cell is not the total investment result. A price above original face can exceed the maturity floor. These deterministic alternatives have no probabilities and are not market quotations.

76df1405fbed142dc16e55956a5769ea3d9e00da.src: A ratio of 4.0 means CAD 1 reaches the beneficiary before tax and CAD 3 is repaid to government. It does not mean the household loses CAD 4 if the beneficiary retains the CAD 1. Larger payments can lower the ratio after a cap binds while still increasing the dollars leaving the plan; that is not a recommendation to withdraw more.
76df1405fbed142dc16e55956a5769ea3d9e00da.zh: 比率为 4.0 意味着 1 加元在税前到达受益人，3 加元偿还给政府。这并不意味着如果受益人保留 1 加元，家庭就会损失 4 加元。较大额付款可以在上限约束后降低比率，同时仍增加离开计划的金额；这并不是建议提取更多资金。

The GDS/TDS ratios therefore stay unchanged, even though the amount of actual cash remaining can move from a surplus to a shortfall.

76e6c6ddf6f8b319f93e588ebdca884d359a0eff.src: The default CAD 600 payment becomes usable credit on day six. Existing posted debt falls from CAD 900 to CAD 300, creating CAD 600 of headroom while both holds remain active. Day six is therefore the first modeled date, searching from day four, when the separate CAD 600 purchase fits.
76e6c6ddf6f8b319f93e588ebdca884d359a0eff.zh: 默认的 600 加元付款将在第六天变为可用信用。现有已公布债务从 900 加元降至 300 加元，创造了 600 加元的净空，同时两项持有仍保持活跃。因此，第六天是第一个建模日期，从第四天开始搜索，此时适合单独购买 600 CAD。

76f02728b3942351f8757c9ef9197fd82b1e3519.src: At smaller claim sizes, the percentages can determine the result. With the default CAD 1,000 maximum available under each plan, combined payments cannot exceed CAD 2,000 even when the common eligible expense becomes much larger.

78d9122a2941f370e1a7506da688338e27803ad1.src: Employer shares deserve a household view: employment income, future bonuses, and invested wealth may all depend on the same company. A real-estate-heavy household may also carry local economic exposure outside its brokerage account. These observations broaden the analysis without pretending that every household asset has a continuously observable market price.
78d9122a2941f370e1a7506da688338e27803ad1.zh: 雇主股票值得家庭看待：就业收入、未来奖金和投资财富可能都取决于同一家公司。房地产密集型家庭还可能在其经纪账户之外承担当地经济风险。这些观察结果拓宽了分析范围，但并不假装每项家庭资产都有一个持续可观察的市场价格。

78da60c037f22c2e404663aca3e236d11bab609b.src: Choosing whether a policy meets a household need and choosing how to pay for it are related decisions, but they answer different questions. 78e3f242225bfc68343627dfaa1f255e92fbc72e.src: After each purchase, residual cash is smaller than the cost of one share at that period’s price. The cash remains part of account value. Ignoring it would understate the resources held by the whole-share account.
78e3f242225bfc68343627dfaa1f255e92fbc72e.zh: 每次购买后，剩余现金会更少高于该时期价格的一股成本。现金仍然是账户价值的一部分。忽略它会低估整个共享帐户所持有的资源。

78eab4e9059e6528e7295b42cf44c9033c569ba8.src: Likewise, an alternative shop may have different prices, availability or travel costs. A retailer balance can constrain where the purchases happen, so a face-value discount alone cannot establish the cheapest complete basket. This tool does not estimate those differences.
78eab4e9059e6528e7295b42cf44c9033c569ba8.zh: 同样，替代商店可能有不同的价格、可用性或旅行费用。零售商余额可能会限制购买地点，因此仅凭面值折扣无法建立最便宜的完整购物篮。此工具不会估计这些差异。

78ef56f4f4bc6d3dbdce576b2e3bc34a836fbcbf.src: Negative investment-minus-debt values remain negative. If a sale does not cover principal, another repayment source would be required. Extending the horizon does not guarantee recovery or remove the obligation to pay the loan.

78b4a2f1215371f9f32b69f76955752935ed4a4c.src: Yahoo labels a fiscal-year forecast endpoint, sometimes more than 12 months ahead. 78b6d3836da96bd7398a32554c0fa46b9a625bf1.src: A negative number is useful information. Replacing all negative headroom with zero would make a CAD 500 overshoot look the same as a CAD 5,000 overshoot. 78b74897b8d4215ef1f3f76c5b776bb735fa2799.src: The same debt table separately records CAD 29.421 billion of net borrowing during Q2. That is a flow over the quarter. 78b8c3334a32064f36d87c1bff15317d657ae878.src: The first chart uses non-overlapping categories, including unknown duration. 773a594103225648a5d5259ecb033a8a7c3059e5.src: The government’s grant guide requires an earlier contribution history for CESG at ages sixteen and seventeen: by the end of the calendar year turning fifteen, either CAD 2,000 must have been contributed and not withdrawn, or at least CAD 100 in each of four years.

7abb4f2b9bcd88baa5daa998191a686eba850ac8.src: Original hypothetical four-year declining-principal loan. Each of four equal one-year periods starts with the shown principal; that year’s annual rate applies to the entire opening balance. Interest is paid in full at year-end, followed by repayment of one quarter of the initial principal. Total payments therefore vary with interest; this is not a level-total-payment amortization or a current lender quote. Block A applies for two years and block B for two years, then their order is reversed. Both cases have the same principal path, term and unweighted average annual rate. No interest is capitalized, and no extra borrowing, prepayment, fees, tax, payment delay or discounting is modeled. Principal repayments use separate household cash and end the balance at zero after year four. The model explains rate timing on a shrinking balance; it does not forecast variable rates, calculate a regulated APR or establish affordability.
7abb4f2b9bcd88baa5daa998191a686eba850ac8.zh: 最初的假设四年期本金递减贷款。四个相等的一年期中的每一个都以所示的本金开始；该年的年利率适用于整个期初余额。利息在年底全额支付，然后偿还初始本金的四分之一。因此，总付款额随利息而变化；这不是水平总付款摊销或当前贷款机构报价。 A 组申请两年，B 组申请两年，然后顺序相反。两种情况具有相同的主路径、期限和未加权平均年利率。没有利息被资本化，也没有对额外借款、预付款、费用、税、付款延迟或折扣进行建模。本金偿还使用单独的家庭现金，第四年后余额为零。该模型解释了余额萎缩时的利率时机；它不会预测可变利率、计算受监管的年利率或确定承受能力。

7a3b58c21e77beca1a8567477425889de2ea3737.src: A one-point debt line therefore means no payment cycle could be projected under those assumptions. 7a3c871f0f8d1eac0646230ae50207a11e101a8b.src: For CAD 100,000 of opening capital, the corresponding loss values are CAD 40,000, CAD 20,000, CAD 5,000, negative CAD 5,000 and negative CAD 12,000. Positive loss represents money lost; negative loss represents a gain.

7a3e66a5bd9fd17e296c7691344a9d643c48e765.src: Hypothetical single future bill in a consistently defined foreign currency unit (FCU). Foreign-currency price rises at the selected annual rate for months / 12 years. The terminal exchange-rate assumption is CAD per FCU; a percentage charge is added to the translated CAD amount, then one flat fee. No fee applies when the bill is zero. CAD savings earn a constant effective annual return converted to a monthly rate, with month-end deposits. 7be323b0da946525f85917e1d96f338e05155e7d.src: A positive reserve is held back from the cash position. A negative current-period net-tax amount, plus any negative first-period amount awaiting cash, is tracked as a potential receivable rather than a negative reserve or automatic deposit. The illustration assumes the entered ITCs qualify; it does not establish a refund entitlement, approval date or processing time.
7be323b0da946525f85917e1d96f338e05155e7d.zh: 从现金头寸中保留正准备金。当期净税额为负数，加上等待现金的第一期负数，将被视为潜在应收款，而不是负准备金或自动存款。该插图假设输入的 ITC 符合条件；它不规定退款权利、批准日期或处理时间。

7be357b2d01c41288577914fc4b8087f91fb10cb.src: The portfolio cannot go below zero. The second curve is accumulated nominal spending shortfall, not an asset, debt balance or funded payment. It receives no interest. Future income surpluses do not retrospectively fund an earlier shortfall.
7be357b2d01c41288577914fc4b8087f91fb10cb.zh: 投资组合不能低于零。第二条曲线是累计名义支出缺口，而不是资产、债务余额或融资支付。它没有利息。未来的收入盈余不会追溯性地弥补之前的短缺。

7be5c6979c9956e70f2a1dd5b5dbaff026415a79.src: At 20%, the default lower-priced booking remains CAD 1,800. The alternative becomes 2,100 − 0.20 × 2,000 = CAD 1,700. One actual booking does not produce an automatic CAD 1,700 invoice: under these assumptions, the alternative costs either CAD 2,100 if used or CAD 100 if cancelled with the refund received.
7be5c6979c9956e70f2a1dd5b5dbaff026415a79.zh: 按 20% 计算，默认较低价格预订仍为 1,800 加元。替代方案变为2,100 − 0.20 × 2,000 = CAD 1,700。一次实际预订不会自动生成 1,700 加元的发票：在这些假设下，替代方案的费用要么是 2,100 加元（如果使用），要么是 100 加元（如果取消并收到退款）。

7bbb95e658f0b0a042e6280a142e14bacf48597f.src: Credit provisions and valuation can deteriorate together. A table holding P/E constant understates that joint downside; the bear scenario explicitly lowers both earnings and the multiple. Review flags below trigger a new analysis rather than an automatic trade.
7bbb95e658f0b0a042e6280a142e14bacf48597f.zh: 信贷准备金和估值可能会同时恶化。保持市盈率不变的表格低估了联合下行的影响；熊市情景明显降低了收益和市盈率。查看下面的标志会触发新的分析，而不是自动交易。

7bbb9df1242a1b52b32762f421222a7c86ea39ae.src: The order in the formula matters. An actual contract may apply limits, deductibles, replacement provisions or other adjustments differently. This illustration applies no coinsurance percentage and does not generalize a foreign jurisdiction’s underinsurance rule. It provides a transparent assumed cash calculation rather than determining an actual claim.
7bbb9df1242a1b52b32762f421222a7c86ea39ae.zh: 公式中的顺序很重要。实际合同可能会以不同的方式应用限制、免赔额、更换条款或其他调整。该说明不适用共同保险百分比，也没有概括外国管辖区的保险不足规则。它提供透明的假设现金计算，而不是确定实际索赔。

7bbd935a500610f1a1e5deacf2a2e1ea1d040579.src: A bond can carry a fixed coupon and still have a changing market price. The face amount is the principal the issuer is scheduled to repay at maturity. The purchase price is what the buyer pays today. The coupon is a contractual cash payment, often expressed as a percentage of face. These quantities are related but are not interchangeable.
7bbd935a500610f1a1e5deacf2a2e1ea1d040579.zh: 债券可以带有固定息票，但市场价格仍然会变化。票面金额是发行人计划到期偿还的本金。购买价格是买家今天支付的价格。优惠券是一种合同现金支付，通常以面值的百分比表示。这些数量相关，但不可互换。

7bbd9dbdbce3e97dcbcc721d96482f1dd95309c9.src: The holder's full entitlement is twenty-five new shares and requires CAD 150 of cash. After exercise, one hundred twenty-five shares at the theoretical CAD 9.20 are worth CAD 1,150. The increase from the original CAD 1,000 shareholding includes CAD 150 newly paid in.
7bbd9dbdbce3e97dcbcc721d96482f1dd95309c9.zh: 持有人的全部权利为 25 股新股，并需要 150 加元现金。行权后，理论价格为 9.20 加元的 125 股股票价值 1,150 加元。原有1,000加元持股增加包括新缴纳的150加元。

7bc2fe97a18928ca01105d728df71983ff14b01c.src: Scenarios reveal sensitivity; they do not supply probabilities. A precise-looking loss estimate remains conditional on the shocks selected. Record the assumptions and test several narratives rather than presenting one stress as the expected outcome.
7bc2fe97a18928ca01105d728df71983ff14b01c.zh: 情景揭示敏感性；他们不提供概率。精确的损失估计仍然取决于所选的冲击。记录假设并测试多种叙述，而不是将一种压力呈现为预期结果。

The calculator models no embedded option and does not estimate a portfolio’s changing credit spreads or a non-parallel yield curve.

7bcb73349a51a38584a2614da27f58e2086ebf86.src: The phrase “multiple jobholders” sounds like a count of extra jobs. Statistics Canada’s annual table 14-10-0044-01 and monthly table 14-10-0045-01 count something narrower and more precise: persons employed in two or more jobs simultaneously during the reference week. The same person is counted once, no matter how many jobs that person holds.
7bcb73349a51a38584a2614da27f58e2086ebf86.zh: “多个工作人员”一词听起来像是对额外工作的计数。加拿大统计局的年度表 14-10-0044-01 和 月度表 14-10-0045-01 统计了一些更窄且更精确的内容：在参考周内同时从事两项或更多工作的人员。无论同一个人拥有多少份工作，都被计算一次。

7be5e2fad2d6b489c9409349e99c4111a0dd99b7.src: The first two panels use or derive from the published overall CSCE perceived probability of missing one required minimum debt payment over the next three months. Five quarterly observations, 2025 Q3–2026 Q3, were retrieved 25 October 2026. The latest report was released 19 October; online collection was 5–27 August and follow-up interviews were 24 August–4 September. The statistic is an interpolated median of self-assessed probabilities, not an observed arrears rate, a count of missed payments or a personal risk estimate. The methodology paper’s inversion applies to its composite financial-health index; these charts keep the raw positive probability. The remaining panels use independent fictional CAD inputs for one already-quoted payment, one dedicated opening cash amount and one cleared receipt. No survey value enters the cash arithmetic. The receipt is assumed usable before the payment on a shared day. Dates represent usable funds and the required funding deadline, not a guaranteed processing service or statutory grace period. The stepped calendar is a funding ledger: negative values identify resources missing against the full scheduled obligation, not an authorized overdraft or a claim that an unfunded payment actually cleared. No other bills, credit, interest, late fees, benefit changes, taxes or subsequent instalments are modeled. Enter net usable cash after other commitments; no amount is allocated twice.

79ff67006b0d4dde9398842135dd0f4f42542458.src: Adjusted earnings are useful for forecasting the continuing business because they remove specified accounting and transaction items. They also require economic judgment. Excluding an acquisition-related goodwill charge does not reimburse shareholders for the original purchase price. An analysis that accepts the recurring earnings benefit but ignores the capital loss gives an incomplete account of value creation. We therefore use adjusted common income for the earnings model, and retain reported book value and capital allocation as independent tests.
79ff67006b0d4dde9398842135dd0f4f42542458.zh: 调整后的收益对于预测持续业务非常有用，因为它们删除了指定的会计和交易项目。他们还需要经济判断。排除与收购相关的商誉费用并不能向股东偿还原始购买价格。接受经常性收益收益但忽略资本损失的分析对价值创造的解释是不完整的。因此，我们使用调整后的共同收入作为盈利模型，并保留报告的账面价值和资本分配作为独立测试。

7b8041e22add98bd6b8df31a630043ef56acf7dd.src: Hypothetical monthly-compounding loan illustration, not a lender agreement or approval to capitalize interest. Annual quoted rates are divided by twelve. Interest is charged on opening monthly debt; the selected payment arrives at month-end. When payment is below interest, the shortfall is added to debt in this model. The alternative uses the same opening path, then the separately selected payment after the rate change. No fees, arrears charges, renewal, property tax, penalty or lender intervention is calculated. The illustrative trigger is payment × 12 ÷ debt at the change, and must not substitute for a contractual trigger rate.

Cash needs differ with income support, bill dates, access terms and willingness to sell assets. No statistical reserve target is inferred.
7c8b15ccf2b8ff73f96ffab81c413f6ae01f3a91.zh: 负终点是无资金支持的需求，而不是透支便利。房屋净值、养老金和其他投资在这里不会自动变成现金。现金需求因收入支持、账单日期、使用条款和出售资产的意愿而异。未推断出统计储备目标。

7c930a3eed40ecc72409d46db97bbd0f0b112a99.src: Hypothetical joint stress, not a prediction of a company’s shares, employment or benefit eligibility. The employer-share shock occurs immediately before month one; other investment values stay fixed as a control. Both paths receive the same household income schedule and essential bills over twelve months. The hold path sells nothing. The sale path assumes all entered shares are vested, saleable and sold immediately after the shock; only the independently entered usable percentage of gross value enters cash. The remainder is excluded from spending, without calculating tax, gains, withholding or fees. Any real tax shortfall must be funded separately. Unvested awards, options, blackout restrictions and future awards are outside this model. Bills arrive at the start of each month; net income arrives at month-end. Bills can use only accessible cash then available. Unfunded amounts remain recorded separately, without automatic debt or retroactive payment from later income. Cash earns no interest. The comparison neither sells other investments nor values the long-term benefits of continuing to hold shares.
7c930a3eed40ecc72409d46db97bbd0f0b112a99.zh: 假设的联合压力，而不是对公司股票、就业或福利资格的预测。雇主份额冲击发生在第一个月之前；其他投资价值保持固定作为对照。两种途径在十二个月内都获得相同的家庭收入表和基本账单。保留路径没有任何价值。出售路径假设所有进入的股票均已归属、可出售并在冲击后立即出售；只有独立输入的总价值的可用百分比才能输入现金。剩余部分不计入支出，不计算税收、收益、预扣税或费用。任何实际税收缺口都必须单独资助。未归属的奖励、期权、停电限制和未来奖励不在此模型之内。账单在每个月初到达；净利润在月底到达。账单只能使用当时可用的现金。未提供资金的金额仍单独记录，没有自动债务或从以后的收入中追溯付款。现金不赚取利息。该比较既不出售其他投资，也不重视继续持有股票的长期利益。

The curve is not a probability model, an expiry schedule or a reason to buy unwanted items. It assumes the same prices and goods in both payment cases.
7b943b99362c15f36d734efba52f9fd6bdd62aa1.zh: 该曲线会根据其他计划的购买实际使用的信用而变化，与所选日历无关。正值意味着更多的现金支出，负值意味着更少。在全额赎回时，最大的模拟现金减少是面值减去预付价格。该曲线不是概率模型、到期时间表或购买不需要的物品的理由。它假定两种付款情况下的价格和商品相同。

7dded7b53ea0893e0999bf6c807f07682730a5d3.src: A credit-card transaction has more than one relevant date. The purchase may be made on one day and posted to the account on another. The statement then closes on its own schedule, and the payment is due on the date shown for that statement. Treating those dates as interchangeable can lead to a cash plan built around the wrong deadline.
7dded7b53ea0893e0999bf6c807f07682730a5d3.zh: 一笔信用卡交易有多个相关日期。购买可能在某一天进行，并在另一天过帐到帐户。然后，该对帐单将按其自己的时间表关闭，付款到期日为该对帐单显示的日期。将这些日期视为可互换的可能会导致围绕错误的截止日期制定现金计划。

7de0dac439ff180c3c630439990e625c4025a485.src: The selected source dimension is seasonally adjusted at annual rates. The displayed amounts should not be read as literal cash received or spent over the three calendar months alone.

7de245f0192b6050bede77889bebeb6fd46b6a12.zh: 每个当前值都将某个位置与其自己的基线进行比较。这两个 100 并不能断言该捆绑包最初在两个地方的价格相同。当前值越高，意味着两个基准期重合时，其起始价格的涨幅越大；它不会独立对当前的美元成本进行排名。

7f20c8f908f75465e0084c62b71805e29c32e2ad.src: Hypothetical repeated net-pay increase, not a salary or investment forecast. Year one has only the starting monthly saving. At the start of each later year, monthly take-home pay increases by the same entered dollar step; earlier increases continue. The chosen percentage of all accumulated raises adds to monthly saving and the rest is assigned to additional spending. Ordinary spending and the original saving must already fit the starting household budget. Existing savings grow immediately; deposits arrive at month-end. The return is effective annual, converted to an equivalent monthly rate. No account limits, employer match, taxes, fees, job interruption or inflation adjustment are calculated. Dollar increases are nominal: a household must separately budget higher essential costs before treating a raise as available.
7f20c8f908f75465e0084c62b71805e29c32e2ad.zh: 假设的重复净工资增长，而不是工资或投资预测。第一年只有起始的每月储蓄。在随后的每一年年初，每月实得工资都会按输入的相同美元步骤增加；早些时候的上涨仍在继续。所有累积加薪的选定百分比将添加到每月储蓄中，其余部分将分配给额外支出。普通支出和原始储蓄必须已经符合家庭起始预算。现有储蓄立即增长；存款月底到账。回报率按年计算，转换为等值的月度回报率。不计算账户限制、雇主匹配、税收、费用、工作中断或通货膨胀调整。美元上涨是名义上的：家庭必须单独预算更高的基本成本，然后才能将加薪视为可用。

80b370f65e7155cc23c8ee61635f8ea3b97a750f.src: That figure is undiscounted and does not carry a surplus from one year to another. It is neither an opening capital requirement nor a recommended portfolio withdrawal. Converting a sequence of gaps into a funded asset plan requires starting assets, returns, costs, withdrawal timing, taxes and a rule for handling any surplus.
80b370f65e7155cc23c8ee61635f8ea3b97a750f.zh: 该数字未贴现，并且不会从一年到另一年产生盈余。它既不是开仓资本要求，也不是建议的投资组合撤资。将一系列缺口转换为资助资产计划需要起始资产、回报、成本、提款时间、税收和处理任何盈余的规则。

80b521b5d33e7b079fbe3b38472e3f52fb00dd5e.src: A response amount should therefore be matched to actual access to funds. An asset already assigned to another goal cannot also be counted as free collateral, and an unused borrowing limit does not establish that cash will remain available during the same stress.
80b521b5d33e7b079fbe3b38472e3f52fb00dd5e.zh: 因此，响应金额应与实际获得资金的情况相匹配。已分配给另一个目标的资产也不能算作免费抵押品，并且未使用的借款限额并不能证明在相同压力下仍可使用现金。

80b8c2e5ee3d1c8d3544df6c7e5014b8cd5b4e67.src: Official CAFC category observations for calendar 2025, from the page issued and modified 25 February 2026, retrieved 25 October 2026. All three charts use the same selected categories; the derived-ratio chart reorders them by that ratio. Published dollar losses are rounded millions, not exact underlying claim totals. Derived ratios are rounded again to the nearest CAD 100 and are not medians, personal risk estimates or household loss forecasts. The all-category headline is a lower-bound statement, not an exact denominator for shares. Reports, source-listed victims and dollars are distinct measures; the table does not establish unique people across categories or full population coverage. No underreporting multiplier, population probability, causal effect or promised reimbursement is calculated. N/A losses in the source’s frequency table remain unavailable, not zero, and are not inserted into this dollar-loss ranking.
80b8c2e5ee3d1c8d3544df6c7e5014b8cd5b4e67.zh: 2025 年日历的官方 CAFC 类别观察，来自于 2026 年 2 月 25 日发布和修改的页面，于 2026 年 10 月 25 日检索。控件仅更改显示的行数，选择源报告的美元损失排名中的前 N ​​个类别。它从不编辑报告、受害者人数或损失观察。所有三个图表都使用相同的选定类别；派生比率图表按该比率对它们重新排序。公布的损失金额约为数百万美元，而不是确切的基本索赔总额。得出的比率再次四舍五入至最接近的 100 加元，并非中位数、个人风险估计或家庭损失预测。所有类别的标题是一个下限声明，而不是股票的确切分母。报告、来源列出的受害者和资金是不同的衡量标准；该表没有建立跨类别的独特人群或完整的人口覆盖范围。不计算漏报乘数、总体概率、因果效应或承诺报销。 N/A 源频率表中的损失仍然不可用，不为零，并且不会插入到此美元损失排名中。

80cabb283e8ed44c73d33c1ceb49ef5f2a5ecd6a.src: Hypothetical fixed-rate, non-cashable deposits with no default. Capital is invested at time zero. No interim spending, early redemption, automatic rollover, tax, account withdrawal rule, fee, deposit-insurance calculation or rate offer is modeled. Negative cash is an unmet funding need, not automatic borrowing. Returned principal is cash released, not interest income.
80cabb283e8ed44c73d33c1ceb49ef5f2a5ecd6a.zh: 假设的固定利率、不可兑现存款，无违约情况。资本在零时间投入。阶梯购买五笔等额本金，原始期限为一年至五年；比较购买一个五年期限。每个期限都使用相同的输入有效年利率，每年复利，仅在到期时用本金还款。不会发生续约或再投资。每年的到期日都会在年底现金需求之前到来。单独的储备金收益为零。没有对临时支出、提前赎回、自动展期、税收、账户提款规则、费用、存款保险计算或利率报价进行建模。负现金是未满足的融资需求，而不是自动借款。返还的本金是释放的现金，而不是利息收入。

8146251aece431b1780333bae99e373f21330500.src: The annual inputs in this tool represent one contributor’s deposits to the same annuitant’s RRSPs across calendar years. They are hypothetical totals, not contribution-room estimates or instructions to make deposits. The annuitant’s own contributions are a separate history and are not silently added to this contributor’s ledger.
8146251aece431b1780333bae99e373f21330500.zh: 此工具中的年度输入代表一个供款人跨日历年向同一年金受益人的 RRSP 存款。它们是假设的总数，而不是供款室估计或存款指示。年金受益人自己的缴款是一个单独的历史记录，不会默默地添加到该缴款人的分类账中。

814870ffbaf40c36f44d1b06aa4b114e452dcc9c.src: Mean and standard deviation do not identify a return distribution. A smaller chance of losing can coexist with a much larger loss when the lower outcome occurs.

80659285b52082031b6a4745dd362e76782a948d.src: In a separate illustration, suppose revenue rises from 800 to 1,000 while year-end receivables rise from 80 to 150. Receivables increase from 10% to 15% of annual sales. That is a useful warning flag; it does not prove customers are failing to pay. Seasonality, acquisitions, payment terms, and the timing of large invoices can all change the ratio. Average balances and credit-sales data would improve the test.
80659285b52082031b6a4745dd362e76782a948d.zh: 在另一个示例中，假设收入从 800 增加到 1,000，而年终应收账款从 80 增加到 150。应收账款从年销售额的 10% 增加到 15%。这是一个有用的警告标志；它并不能证明客户没有付款。季节性、收购、付款条件和大额发票的时间都会改变该比率。平均余额和赊销数据将改善测试。

82c553e59848f19d309342e12426d002d2f32363.src: The first two charts contain fixed official Labour Force Survey annual estimates for Canada excluding territories, ages 15 and over, Total - Gender. Annual estimates average monthly observations; they are not counts of distinct people becoming unemployed during a year. The latest reference year shown is 2025; the table was released 9 January 2026 and reviewed 25 October 2026. Duration describes continuous weeks without work while looking for work or on temporary layoff, not a personal forecast of time remaining until employment. The two mean series preserve their different top-code definitions. No observation-specific confidence bounds are supplied in this selected table, so none are invented. All metrics and the last two charts use separate hypothetical assumptions: cash is available today and each week’s entered inflow is available alongside that week’s expenses. No source mean or duration share initializes the household inputs. No benefit entitlement, payment lag, severance, job-finding probability, return, tax or inflation is calculated. Existing earmarks and past spending must already be removed from the cash input.

The tool does not calculate an employer pension, CPP/QPP/OAS entitlement, start-age adjustment, withholding or actual birthday-month proration; changing a start date does not reprice an income quote. No survivor/disability events or spending beyond the horizon are included.
