83f40259455c000fcc98a74875c28fcb8ab49f7d.src: Original hypothetical nominal-CAD bond illustration. A fixed non-callable bond is bought immediately after a coupon at the entered price, pays one annual coupon at each year-end and repays face value at maturity. All issuer payments are assumed honoured. The cash-flow yield is the effective annual discount rate equating these annual receipts with the purchase price; it is not a dealer’s semiannual or day-count quote conversion, a forecast or a guaranteed realised compound return. The separate reserve target is the positive difference between purchase price and face amount, with no inflation allowance. Equal reserve deposits are made at each year-end after prior reserve cash earns the selected return. That reserve return is assumed after its own tax and costs, while bond coupons and redemption are shown before bond tax and transaction costs. If the reserve deposit exceeds the coupon, outside cash is required to fund the illustrated plan; no borrowing or extra money is silently supplied. Calculations retain fractional cents; actual payment rounding would change a final adjustment. No interim bond valuation, early call, default, accrued interest, tax treatment or fee is calculated.
83f40259455c000fcc98a74875c28fcb8ab49f7d.zh: 原始假设名义加元债券插图。固定不可赎回债券在息票后立即按输入的价格购买，每年年底支付一次年息，并在到期时偿还面值。假设发行人的所有付款均已兑现。现金流收益率是将这些年度收入与购买价格等同的有效年度贴现率；它不是交易商的半年或日数报价转换、预测或保证实现的复合回报。单独准备金目标是购买价格与票面金额之间的正差，不考虑通货膨胀因素。等额准备金存款于每年年底在之前的准备金现金赚取选定的回报后存入。准备金回报是在其自身的税收和成本之后假设的，而债券息票和赎回是在债券税和交易成本之前显示的。如果准备金超过息票，则需要外部现金来为所示计划提供资金；没有任何借款或额外的钱是默默提供的。计算保留小数美分；实际付款四舍五入会改变最终调整。不计算中期债券估值、提前赎回、违约、应计利息、税务处理或费用。

852d95eec4cd437520f3ecd22dee5a58e65a9174.src: Under some combinations of a fast-growing price and a lower account return, extending a sufficiently distant deadline may stop reducing the required monthly amount. This is a property of those assumptions, not a prediction that waiting is always harmful. The appropriate response is to review the goal, saving capacity and timing together. Raising the return assumption solely to make an unaffordable plan appear funded leaves the underlying uncertainty unresolved.

Counting the project loan as sufficient to cover both the bills and those separate interest payments would overstate the funds provided.

86aee789475edebe005e00303440f982d8435437.src: The matrix compares assumed nominal returns with inflation rates. A positive account return can still mean a loss of purchasing power. The exact relationship is real return = (1 + nominal return) ÷ (1 + inflation) − 1.

86b7a57b238cf0fdfa850bee632d3014d503fb42.src: Hypothetical single transferred balance with no new purchases or other rate buckets. Fee is financed into the balance and receives the same modeled rate. Rates are nominal annual divided by 12; interest is charged before each fixed month-end payment. The within-promotion payment is rounded up to cents, with the final payment capped at debt owed. Promotional rate applies to the first selected monthly cycles, then the follow-on rate applies prospectively to remaining debt. No retroactive interest, late payment, promotion cancellation, annual fee, contractual minimum formula or actual issuer allocation rule is calculated. Both alternatives stop at payoff or 120 months; incomplete interest is partial. These are assumptions, not available card offers.
86b7a57b238cf0fdfa850bee632d3014d503fb42.zh: 假设的单笔转账余额，没有新​​的购买或其他利率范围。费用存入余额并获得相同的模型费率。名义年利率除以 12；利息在每个固定月末付款之前收取。促销内付款四舍五入为美分，最终付款上限为所欠债务。促销利率适用于第一个选定的每月周期，然后后续利率适用于剩余债务。不计算追溯利息、逾期付款、促销取消、年费、合同最低公式或实际发行人分配规则。两种选择都在还清或 120 个月时停止；不完全的兴趣是部分的。这些只是假设，并非可用的卡优惠。

The traveler voluntarily cancels before using the booking; an eligible cash refund is assumed accepted. This excludes supplier cancellation, statutory disruption rights, travel insurance, vouchers, partial use, replacement travel, interest and all other trip costs. Refund equals the entered percentage of that contract’s full price less its retained fee, floored at zero; a fee cannot create an additional cancellation bill here. Probability is an assumption, not a forecast or survey statistic. The weighted average is not the amount a single booking will necessarily cost. Both prices are paid at time zero; the cash chart shows the cancellation branch only, with no new saving or borrowing.
874da4d856d28a7d10ee8c2586f7b04adb3518fe.zh: 加元的独立假设合同，而非旅行价格、保单报价或合法退款决定。旅客在使用预订前自愿取消；假定接受符合条件的现金退款。这不包括供应商取消、法定中断权利、旅行保险、代金券、部分使用、替代旅行、利息和所有其他旅行费用。退款等于该合同全价减去保留费用的输入百分比，下限为零；此处的费用不能产生额外的取消账单。概率是一种假设，而不是预测或调查统计数据。加权平均值并不是单次预订所需的费用。两种价格均在零时刻支付；现金图表仅显示取消分行，没有新的储蓄或借款。

87befe7955014a9c782ad07490ab5c65567b15c5.src: A qth-percentile cost is the smallest possible modeled cost with cumulative probability at least q. The step-shaped count distribution can give more than exactly 90% or 95% coverage at that amount. The expected cost averages all outcomes and need not equal any possible bill. The maximum is limited by one fixed-cost event per year; it is not a bound on actual household emergencies.
87befe7955014a9c782ad07490ab5c65567b15c5.zh: qth-percentile 成本是最小可能的建模成本，累积概率至少为 q。阶梯形计数分布可以提供超过 90% 或 95% 的覆盖率。预期成本是所有结果的平均数，不需要等于任何可能的账单。上限仅限于每年一次固定成本活动；它不是对实际家庭紧急情况的限制。

87c475a64460d2cd8088d136139bf0d9b9745452.src: The cited release tables do not provide confidence intervals. The graphics therefore report observations without error bars and make no statistical-significance claim. A visible difference is not evidence that a particular household should change its allocation or take more investment risk.
87c475a64460d2cd8088d136139bf0d9b9745452.zh: 引用的发布表不提供置信区间。因此，这些图表报告的观察结果没有误差线，并且没有提出统计显着性声明。明显的差异并不表明特定家庭应该改变其分配或承担更多的投资风险。

8782bae96e35cba277252cda714f923f51d04fba.src: The period names alone do not enforce a lower price in the arithmetic. If the entered off-peak rate exceeds the on-peak rate, moving energy raises the modeled bill and the saving metric becomes negative. If the two rates match, timing alone produces no energy saving.
8782bae96e35cba277252cda714f923f51d04fba.zh: 期间名称本身并不强制算术中的较低价格。如果输入的非高峰费率超过高峰费率，则移动能源会提高建模费用，并且节省指标变为负数。如果两个费率匹配，仅靠时间安排并不能节省能源。

8784645937bc490fb804761f837fb4ddf9d6343d.src: Our central distinction is between recurring customer economics and the environment supporting them. Deeper commercial, wealth and household relationships can improve the quality of earnings. A favourable interest-rate mix, strong asset markets or provision reversals can also improve earnings quickly, but provide less evidence about performance through a full credit and market cycle. A reasonable multiple should reflect both kinds of contribution.

88675900328fb904df14d677692e933c7bf25100.src: The first two figures are fixed Statistics Canada estimates, released 29 April 2026, reviewed 25 October 2026. They concern persons living in households with a survey classification, not the percentage of households or a forecast for the reader. Survey results do not change with the controls. Food spending is an entered cash assumption, not a nutrition standard or a recommended cut. No household survey status, benefit entitlement, health outcome or probability is inferred. A negative scheduled balance is an unfunded plan, not available borrowing. No spending is automatically reduced, no debt or support payment is invented, and no interest is added. 89fdad15752311f7552eb6b609b253a6d541e143.src: The matrix changes owner withdrawals and the hypothetical earmark percentage. It measures additional opening cash, rather than recommending a draw or claiming that a selected percentage settles the tax bill. More available opening cash can bridge timing; it does not make an ongoing loss sustainable.
89fdad15752311f7552eb6b609b253a6d541e143.zh: 该矩阵更改了所有者提款和假设的专用百分比。它衡量额外的期初现金，而不是建议提取或声称选定的百分比来结算税单。更多可用的开业现金可以弥补时机；它不会使持续的损失变得可持续。

8a01cd3231206af50c422f9a34bef1a9948536a9.src: Rows replace the fee and columns replace the interval. Every cell subtracts a weekly strategy with that same row fee, starting cash, deposit budget, horizon and return assumptions. Positive favours that interval only in this case. Zero-fee batching can still change the result because contributions earn different returns while waiting. The matrix has no probabilities or recommended trading frequency.
8a01cd3231206af50c422f9a34bef1a9948536a9.zh: 行替换费用，列替换间隔。每个单元格减去具有相同行费用、起始现金、存款预算、期限和回报假设的每周策略。仅在这种情况下，正值才支持该间隔。零费用批处理仍然可以改变结果，因为贡献在等待时获得不同的回报。该矩阵没有概率或建议的交易频率。

8a023633c2853119f144ff23cddb8e1e1f845781.src: For Canadian mortgage context, FCAC’s deferral guidance explicitly states an expectation that federally regulated institutions not charge interest on deferred interest. That mortgage-specific context is one reason not to assume a payment pause automatically means compounding all unpaid interest into an interest-bearing balance. This generic model is not an assessment of a particular mortgage relief measure.
8a023633c2853119f144ff23cddb8e1e1f845781.zh: 对于加拿大抵押贷款情况，FCAC 的延期指南明确规定联邦监管机构不会对延期利息收取利息。这种特定于抵押贷款的背景是不假设付款暂停自动意味着将所有未付利息复利为计息余额的原因之一。此通用模型并非对特定抵押贷款减免措施的评估。

8ad3624ff8b4fa0427badcbb2d44480ab793c351.src: Original instantaneous balance-sheet illustration under an invented equity/assets requirement. Amounts are CAD, with no actual security, broker, jurisdictional margin schedule or eligibility calculation. The loan stays fixed during the selected asset-price move. Three mutually exclusive adjustments then target the same ratio: use outside cash to repay debt; add outside cash to collateral assets while leaving debt unchanged; or sell original assets and apply all proceeds to debt. The separate held-cash case is an assumed collateral arrangement, not a claim that a broker will permit cash to remain without netting the loan. If a firm applies a deposit against debt, the repayment case describes that accounting. A sale-only repair of a remaining funded account is unavailable when equity is zero or negative. No deadline, actual margin call, tax, fees, interest, further price move or lender approval is modeled. Adding outside cash is new funding, not recovered investment performance. Every displayed adjustment preserves the same pre-adjustment investment equity after subtracting its new outside funding.
8ad3624ff8b4fa0427badcbb2d44480ab793c351.zh: 发明的股权/资产要求下的原始瞬时资产负债表说明。金额为加元，没有实际的证券、经纪人、司法管辖区保证金计划或资格计算。在选定的资产价格变动期间，贷款保持固定。然后，三个相互排斥的调整目标是相同的比率：使用外部现金偿还债务；将外部现金添加到抵押资产中，同时保持债务不变；或出售原始资产并将所有收益用于债务。单独的持有现金案例是假设的抵押品安排，而不是声称经纪人将允许保留现金而不扣除贷款。如果一家公司用存款来抵偿债务，那么还款案例会描述该会计处理。当净值为零或负数时，无法对剩余资金帐户进行仅销售修复。没有对截止日期、实际追加保证金、税收、费用、利息、进一步的价格变动或贷方批准进行建模。增加外部现金是新的资金，而不是恢复的投资业绩。每次显示的调整在减去新的外部资金后都保留相同的调整前投资权益。

87d709cd20e64b21263704ffbf2016ea541df968.src: A stronger outcome would combine durable deposit and fee growth, disciplined credit selection and productive capital redeployment. That combination can support both faster EPS growth and greater confidence in the earnings multiple. A weaker outcome could begin with modest operating disappointment and become more severe if investors simultaneously demand a higher equity return. This is why the scenario model must vary earnings and valuation together. A bank can remain profitable and well capitalized while its shares decline substantially as the market removes a premium.
87d709cd20e64b21263704ffbf2016ea541df968.zh: 更强劲的结果将结合持久的存款和费用增长、严格的信贷选择和生产性资本重新部署。这种组合可以支持更快的每股收益增长和对市盈率的更大信心。较弱的结果可能始于适度的经营失望，如果投资者同时要求更高的股权回报，结果会变得更加严重。这就是情景模型必须同时改变收益和估值的原因。随着市场消除溢价，银行的股价大幅下跌，但银行仍可保持盈利和资本充足。

8bb2c6a9d798ce8a728c03aae49fe0f52f3bd729.src: Original hypothetical single-loss settlement in CAD, not a policy quote, claim decision, Canadian insurance rule or implementation of a U.S. storm policy. This teaching contract applies one percentage to the entered declared insured-value basis. For damage already accepted as covered, household share = min(damage, percentage × insured basis), and insurer share = max(0, damage − that threshold). Supported damage never exceeds the minimum declared basis; the example adds no policy-limit shortfall. The loss-based percentage and flat-dollar rows are different assumed rules for comparison, not alternative deductibles the claimant may choose. The cash reserve funds only the final household share; it does not model paying the whole repair invoice before reimbursement. No peril trigger, minimum deductible, aggregate, repeated claim, sublimit, coinsurance, exclusion, depreciation, premium difference, tax, claim probability or payment lag is included. The declared basis is an input, not a market value, purchase price or recommended insurance amount. A threshold above the accepted damage does not make the household owe more than that damage under this stated formula.
8bb2c6a9d798ce8a728c03aae49fe0f52f3bd729.zh: 以加元计算的原始假设单项损失结算，而不是保单报价、索赔决定、加拿大保险规则或美国风暴保单的实施。本教学合同适用于所输入的申报保险价值基础的百分之一。对于已接受承保的损害，家庭份额 = min（损害，百分比 × 保险基础），保险公司份额 = max（0，损害 − 该阈值）。支持的伤害绝不会超过声明的最低基础；该示例没有增加政策限制的不足。基于损失的百分比和固定美元行是不同的假设比较规则，而不是索赔人可以选择的替代免赔额。现金储备只为最终家庭份额提供资金；它不会模型在报销之前支付整个维修发票。不包括危险触发因素、最低免赔额、合计、重复索赔、次级限额、共同保险、排除、折旧、保费差异、税、索赔概率或付款滞后。申报的基础是一个输入值，而不是市场价值、购买价格或建议的保险金额。高于可接受损害的阈值不会使家庭所欠的金额超过该公式下的损害。

8d43e76faf5223c866c6591c8561aa57ce720c9e.src: Original hypothetical five-year comparison, not quoted GIC rates. Both alternatives invest identical principal at time zero. One-year deposits pay all interest at each annual maturity; every dollar is immediately reinvested for another year. The entered first rate applies only in year one and the entered renewal rate applies in each of years two through five. The five-year deposit compounds at its selected annual rate and pays principal plus interest only at its final maturity. Intermediate locked-deposit values are accrued mathematical values, not accessible cash or redemption quotes. No tax, fee, default, deposit-insurance limit, extra contribution, withdrawal, early redemption, account rule or gap between maturities is modeled. The break-even later rate is a constant hypothetical rate for four renewals; it can be negative mathematically and is undefined when no principal is invested.
8d43e76faf5223c866c6591c8561aa57ce720c9e.zh: 原始假设的五年比较，未引用的 GIC 利率。两种选择在零时间投资相同的本金。一年期存款在每年到期时支付所有利息；每一美元都会立即再投资一年。输入的第一费率仅适用于第一年，输入的续订费率适用于第二年到第五年的每一年。五年期存款按选定的年利率复利，并仅在最终到期时支付本金和利息。中间锁定存款价值是应计的数学价值，无法获得现金或赎回报价。没有对税收、费用、违约、存款保险限额、额外供款、提款、提前赎回、账户规则或期限之间的差距进行建模。后期盈亏平衡率是四次续约的恒定假设率；在数学上它可以是负数，并且在没有本金投资时未定义。

8cdf28ceccb215c6276f74e02b79a29e7fc726b9.src: Rows replace correlation and columns replace A’s allocation, with the rest in B. Standalone standard deviations stay selected; mean returns and capital do not affect these cells. 8ce17777d0473aaf5f5bd7c9ff0359d34b8d95f7.src: Each bar totals its own requested spending over the horizon. 8b346d43392012dd62b37a20e4af208dd4481126.src: Public sources reviewed on 25 October 2026. This is an invented, fully subscribed, transferable-rights benchmark with no market-price change or fee. It evaluates no actual security or offer, guarantees no dealing price and models no tax, deadline date or broker-specific entitlement rounding. Original scenario calculations and research checklists are TickerLantern’s educational analysis; attributed publisher examples retain their stated source and scope. Recheck current issuer documents for any product-specific decision.

8b3515cff9e1457c34db07c3c02469575b242f70.src: The guarantee described here concerns a number of scheduled payments. It is not a promise to refund an unspecified original premium. No purchase premium is entered, and no cash-refund rider or separate survivor’s lifetime income is assumed.

8b35ccbb654d34c497c3193c01a15ba64235823b.src: The signed bars state each horizon explicitly. 8e696e205b8f6650401f856ec5913e2fea310709.src: Calling value unapplied here is not a claim that it expires forever. Carryforward, transfer and use in another year depend on the actual credit. None is modeled. Similarly, two credits with the same headline eligible amount can have different calculations and conditions, so the comparison must begin with supported tax-offset values.
8e696e205b8f6650401f856ec5913e2fea310709.zh: 此处调用值未应用并不意味着它永远过期。结转、转让、下年度使用，按实际贷记情况确定。没有一个被建模。同样，具有相同标题合格金额的两个学分可以具有不同的计算和条件，因此必须从支持的税收抵免值开始进行比较。

8e6a48a2c5b3c65c4118617ea4fc461f67fc9777.src: A simple average of card A’s 30% and the other card’s 10% would give 20%, which is a different measure. Their limits are unequal. The combined ratio weights each account through its dollar limit by summing balances and limits first.

It is not the amount of cash guaranteed to be needed.

8e09ce4fa82fdf4493a4d74d70a4cea4553c78d8.src: The controls start from a reconciled snapshot. Every new monthly contribution occurs after that snapshot and is absent from the prior undeducted input. If the same transaction appears in both inputs, it is counted twice. If a later deposit appears in neither, the model understates contributions already made.
8e09ce4fa82fdf4493a4d74d70a4cea4553c78d8.zh: 控制从协调快照开始。每个新的每月供款都发生在该快照之后，并且不包含在先前未扣除的输入中。如果同一笔交易出现在两个输入中，则计算两次。如果两者都没有出现后来的存款，则该模型低估了已缴纳的捐款。

8dab0167288c358d0312f2a55f14417812fe12c5.src: A workable reduction needs named expenses and realistic cancellation dates. Required loan payments, insurance and basic housing costs may be less flexible than travel or optional subscriptions. The control caps spending at zero if the entered reduction exceeds the normal budget; it does not treat an unused reduction as new income. New work-related expenses should be included in the normal budget or assessed separately.
8dab0167288c358d0312f2a55f14417812fe12c5.zh: 可行的减少需要指定费用和实际的取消日期。所需的贷款支付、保险和基本住房费用可能不如旅行或可选订阅灵活。如果输入的削减额超过正常预算，则控制将支出上限为零；它不会将未使用的减少视为新收入。新的与工作相关的费用应纳入正常预算或单独评估。

8dacb08a6c68c0c1dfb1593cc68d86aa1944df65.src: The step order is an accounting reconciliation, not a closing calendar. In particular, adding mortgage funding as a later step does not assert that the borrower must first pay the purchase price entirely in cash. The model assumes the settlements occur together; a different sequence requires a separate timing and bridging review.
8dacb08a6c68c0c1dfb1593cc68d86aa1944df65.zh: 步骤订单是会计对账，而不是结算日历。特别是，将抵押贷款融资作为后续步骤并不意味着借款人必须首先完全以现金支付购买价格。该模型假设定居点同时发生；不同的顺序需要单独的时间和过渡审查。

8e9b13e43d9772368f4722f88f99bc64e6c975ba.src: A favourable business view does not automatically establish an attractive entry price. Upside requires earnings to outperform that disciplined baseline or a premium multiple to persist. Downside can arise from multiple compression even when absolute earnings continue to grow.

8f5937cfd35b1b4bb2b71a837afe99ea4adc7ee3.src: Commercial banking and wealth add a useful connection between operating businesses, owners and investable assets. That connection can support recurring fees, but market appreciation can enlarge the fee base without equivalent net customer flows. A slowdown in markets can affect wealth and capital markets together. Our model therefore does not treat each business as an independent source of diversification under every stress.
8f5937cfd35b1b4bb2b71a837afe99ea4adc7ee3.zh: 商业银行和财富在经营企业、所有者和可投资资产之间建立了有用的联系。这种联系可以支持经常性费用，但市场升值可以在没有同等净客户流量的情况下扩大费用基础。市场放缓会同时影响财富和资本市场。因此，我们的模型不会将每项业务视为每种压力下的独立多元化来源。

8f5d9c890bbd6e47d4100d5914db0e314bab5b52.src: This second route helps identify omissions. Face principal is already represented by selling the bond and cannot be added again as a redemption. Neither fee is deducted a second time. The coupon percentage alone does not identify the holding-period gain or yield to maturity.
8f5d9c890bbd6e47d4100d5914db0e314bab5b52.zh: 第二条路线有助于识别遗漏。面本金已通过出售债券代表，不能再次添加作为赎回。两次费用均不会被扣除。票面利率本身并不能确定持有期收益或到期收益率。

8f610b827dbbbe6f1ecfd1a5936c3cd85282ef98.src: Original single-period arithmetic for one compatible tax bucket. Tax before the selected credit and the credit’s already-calculated tax-offset value are entered independently; no income, deduction, bracket, basic personal amount, tax year, provincial/federal conversion or entitlement is determined. The credit input is NOT an eligible expense or a credit-base amount that still needs multiplication by a statutory percentage. Non-refundable usage is capped at the entered tax. The refundable comparison hypothetically uses the same entered credit value under a different refundability rule; these are alternative teaching cases, not a choice of legal classification or two claims to combine. Payments already credited are then subtracted once. A positive settlement balance means owing; a negative balance means a modeled refund before offsets, reassessment or other adjustments. Unapplied non-refundable value has no current-period cash benefit here; no carryforward, transfer or permanent-expiry conclusion is calculated. No payment date, receipt guarantee, interest, benefit phaseout or full tax return is modeled.
8f610b827dbbbe6f1ecfd1a5936c3cd85282ef98.zh: 针对一个兼容税桶的原始单期算法。所选抵免前的税额和已计算的抵免额的税收抵免值是独立输入的；没有确定收入、扣除额、等级、基本个人金额、纳税年度、省/联邦转换或权利。信用投入不是合格费用或仍需要乘以法定百分比的信用基础金额。不可退还的使用上限为输入的税费。假设可退款比较在不同的可退款规则下使用相同的输入信用值；这些是可供选择的教学案例，而不是法律分类的选择或两种主张的结合。已存入的付款将被扣除一次。结算余额为正数表示欠款；负余额是指在抵消、重新评估或其他调整之前的模拟退款。未应用的不可退还价值在此没有当期现金收益；不计算结转、转移或永久到期结论。没有对付款日期、收据保证、利息、福利逐步取消或全额纳税申报表进行建模。

8ea5341965b2b81b5f8ce2ec615165448af15b62.src: A zero cash goal makes no sale and incurs no fee. A positive sale incurs the flat selling cost, capped at its proceeds. A tiny sale can therefore produce little or no usable cash. Actual trading spreads, percentage commissions or redemption charges would require a different cost function and must not be assumed covered by the single flat input.
8ea5341965b2b81b5f8ce2ec615165448af15b62.zh: 零现金目标不会产生任何销售，也不产生任何费用。积极的销售会产生固定的销售成本，其上限为收益。因此，一笔小额销售只能产生很少或根本没有可用现金。实际交易点差、百分比佣金或赎回费用将需要不同的成本函数，并且不得假设由单一固定输入涵盖。

900041312dfdf960b52828d54bb87490adf328cd.src: Original coupon-bond cash illustration. Annual coupon cash is split into two equal payments. The single coupon period has an invented 180-day denominator, with straight-line accrued coupon from day zero; it is not an Actual/Actual, Actual/365 or 30/360 market-convention calculation. The entered day is the settlement observation, not a trade-date settlement-rule calculation. The buyer is assumed entitled to the entire next coupon, paid in full on day 180, and sells the still-outstanding bond immediately afterward at the selected clean price. There is no maturity principal repayment. The quote path between those two selected prices is a linear teaching assumption, not a yield-based bond valuation or market forecast. Fees are separate cash charges. Embedded spreads, markdowns, default, ex-coupon trading, taxes, reinvestment, withholding and settlement delays are not calculated. The valuation chart excludes fees; both fees enter the final cash reconciliation exactly once. 90 model days remain until the coupon. Results are holding-period dollars, not yield to maturity, an annualized return or a product recommendation.

900ca8f4f5a53d8feac1e140682871bb812e58f1.src: One invented noncallable, option-free fixed-rate annual-pay bond, priced immediately after a coupon date with exactly the entered whole years remaining. Coupon and required yields use annual compounding. All promised cash flows are assumed paid in full and on time; no default or recovery is simulated. The first price comparison reprices instantly before any payment. The separate one-year calculation receives one coupon and sells immediately after that coupon at the entered exit yield; a one-year bond instead repays principal then. There is no coupon reinvestment within this single period. No accrued interest, tax, commissions, spread, currency, inflation, embedded option, yield-curve shape or future trades are included. Rates and prices are assumptions, not market observations or bond-fund forecasts. Macaulay duration is 8.1078 years and modified duration is 7.7217 under this annual convention.

90462d080629c04668cf134f090f8b51856e8e09.src: Two original principal-only receipt schedules, already assumed held at time zero. One splits the entered future principal equally between mean year minus spacing and mean year plus spacing. The other receives all principal at the mean year. Face amounts, rather than purchase prices or market values, determine the stated weighting. Purchase costs and pricing are absent, so equal face totals and mean dates do not imply equal investment costs or returns. All principal is assumed paid in full and on time. A single bill is due in the entered whole year; receipts in that same year arrive immediately before the bill. Opening cash and earlier receipts remain available without interest. The fixed twelve-year chart includes every permitted receipt and bill. Negative cash records an unfunded payment requirement; the model supplies no loan, early sale, overdraft or delayed payment. No coupons, reinvestment, taxes, inflation, default, calls, settlement delays, fund redemptions or bond-price sensitivity is modeled. The mean is not modified duration or proof of cash-flow matching.
90462d080629c04668cf134f090f8b51856e8e09.zh: 两个原始的仅本金收据时间表，已假设在时间零持有。将输入的未来本金平均分为平均年份减去间隔和平均年份加间隔。另一个在平均年份收到所有本金。面值而非购买价格或市场价值决定了规定的权重。不存在购买成本和定价，因此相同的面总数和平均日期并不意味着相同的投资成本或回报。假设所有本金均按时足额支付。输入的全年内有一张账单到期；同年的收据紧接在账单之前到达。期初现金和早期收据仍然可用，无利息。固定的十二年图表包括每一份允许的收据和账单。负现金记录无资金支持的付款要求；该模式不提供贷款、提前出售、透支或延迟付款。没有对息票、再投资、税收、通货膨胀、违约、看涨期权、结算延迟、基金赎回或债券价格敏感性进行建模。平均值不是经过修改的期限或现金流匹配证明。

Clear evidence of stronger recurring returns would support the price; progress that plateaus near today’s profitability would leave limited room for disappointment.
91160b8f9377dae6f8fad002fc9b7019e5b88919.zh: 我们的核心问题是证明价格合理所需的可持续回报。使用 10.5% 的股本成本和 4% 的增长率进行稳态诊断意味着两倍账面价值的可持续 ROE 约为 17%。该诊断表明了为什么投资需要持续改善，超越最新的 14.2% 的结果。经常性回报增强的明确证据将支撑价格；接近今天的盈利能力的稳定进展将给失望留下有限的空间。

90c8e41dd0977033ed5cd71d10eb4f9d7fe0bd19.src: An ordinary-rule illustration for a DTC-eligible beneficiary before the calendar year in which they turn 60, with no specified disability savings plan or other exception. It assumes the issuer has independently confirmed that the proposed payment is permitted and has supplied the applicable assistance holdback amount (AHA). Government repayment is the least of three times gross payment, pre-payment plan fair market value and the entered AHA. Input bounds keep assets sufficient and the pre-payment AHA fully covered after the beneficiary payment; they are illustration limits, not program limits. No assistance entitlement, ten-year date calculation, annual payment limit, loss of DTC status, plan closure, death, tax, withholding, fee, benefit interaction or investment return is calculated. All outflows are treated as one completed transaction with no intervening changes. The beneficiary payment leaves the RDSP but may remain an outside asset; combined plan outflow is not automatically household wealth lost.
90c8e41dd0977033ed5cd71d10eb4f9d7fe0bd19.zh: 符合 DTC 资格的受益人在年满 60 岁的日历年之前的普通规则说明，没有指定的残障储蓄计划或其他例外情况。它假设发行人已独立确认允许提议的付款并已提供适用的援助保留金额 (AHA)。政府还款额是总付款额、预付款计划公平市场价值和输入的 AHA 的三倍中的最小值。输入限额保持资产充足，并在受益人付款后完全覆盖预付款 AHA；它们是插图限制，而不是程序限制。不计算援助权利、十年日期计算、年度付款限额、DTC 状态丧失、计划关闭、死亡、税收、预扣税、费用、福利互动或投资回报。所有流出均被视为一笔已完成的交易，没有任何中间变化。受益人付款离开 RDSP，但可能仍然是外部资产；合并计划流出不会自动造成家庭财富损失。

8f22aace044f6d371a5da57814bde33f198a2afd.src: The default account return is a hypothetical 3% effective annual rate after taxes and costs. It is converted to a monthly compound rate using (1 + annual rate)1/12 − 1. The calculator does not simply divide the effective annual rate by twelve.

90e5dd360a7b20acc202ab07f44d3defb22d6e22.src: The model assumes the member survives throughout the selected receipt period, then ends the calculation. It does not model a death event, refund, survivor pension or estate payment. Those omissions make a personal plan quote and its protection terms essential before interpreting the result as a complete economic comparison.
90e5dd360a7b20acc202ab07f44d3defb22d6e22.zh: 该模型假设会员在选定的接收期内生存，然后结束计算。它不模拟死亡事件、退款、遗属抚恤金或遗产付款。这些遗漏使得在将结果解释为完整的经济比较之前，个人计划报价及其保护条款至关重要。

90e6aab6927fe42d60a8d276ed2c3f9dfb13f315.src: To keep that original surplus with unchanged fixed costs, contribution must remain CAD 4,000. The required volume is CAD 4,000 ÷ CAD 20 = 200 units. The business must double its original unit sales, rather than merely increase volume by 20% or match the old revenue.
90e6aab6927fe42d60a8d276ed2c3f9dfb13f315.zh: 为了在固定成本不变的情况下保持原始盈余，供款必须保持为 4,000 加元。所需数量为4,000 加元 ÷ 20 加元 = 200 单位。企业必须将其原始单位销售额翻倍，而不仅仅是将销量增加 20% 或与旧收入持平。

90e72551571f0c3e823cd51e06f9e1e797357dc1.src: Different purchase sizes can produce such a pattern, as the invented tally demonstrates. The public shares alone do not identify why payment methods and amounts are associated. They do not establish that choosing a card causes higher spending or that a reader will face an equivalent distribution.
90e72551571f0c3e823cd51e06f9e1e797357dc1.zh: 不同的采购规模可以产生这样的模式，正如发明的统计所显示的那样。仅公开份额并不能确定支付方式和金额为何相关。他们并没有确定选择一张卡会导致更高的支出或读者将面临同等的分配。

90e8e2e679ab54322476b11d27dab5767777db8a.src: The effective annualised equivalent uses the factor (10,000 ÷ 9,890)365/180 − 1, giving approximately 2.2683%. It compounds the holding-period factor across a year, rather than multiplying the period return by the number of periods.

90f45bdaa69cdffb4fcc0e1de730aec489be6e3e.src: Hypothetical remaining nominal CAD targets with no opening earmarked balances, interest, inflation or account restrictions. One shared contribution arrives at each month-end, including a deadline month. Deadline-first funding fills the earliest unfinished goal and spills to the next; equal shares divide each month among all active unfinished goals and redistribute capped shares. Tied deadlines use goal letter. A goal freezes after its deadline and receives no later contribution. Funding earmarks money; actual purchases are not modeled. Unused budget is tracked separately, not assigned twice. These mechanical rules do not rank the personal importance of goals.
90f45bdaa69cdffb4fcc0e1de730aec489be6e3e.zh: 假设的剩余名义加元目标，没有期初指定余额、利息、通货膨胀或账户限制。每个月末都会收到一份共享捐款，包括截止日期月份。截止日期优先的资金填补了最早未完成的目标，并溢出到下一个目标；每月将平均份额分配给所有活跃的未完成目标，并重新分配上限份额。固定期限使用目标信。目标在截止日期后冻结，并且不会收到任何后续贡献。资金专款专用；实际购买并未建模。未使用的预算单独跟踪，不会分配两次。这些机械规则不会对目标的个人重要性进行排名。

90f4b82381356b8e4c822911f2dd552664ffeb2a.src: A savings-rate table can list several percentages without showing how much interest a particular balance will earn. 90fe9100d78bfd810922252d49b87a3839b32c64.src: The assumed cash obligations are CAD 1,800 of final old-home rent and CAD 1,000 of new deposit cash on day one, CAD 600 of moving costs on day fourteen, and CAD 2,000 of new-home rent on days fifteen and forty-five. 9103485eb16846cef9322c0edfb0b4b8f78b2710.src: Suppose the available after-tax saving budget is B and the tax relief on a fully deductible RRSP contribution is t. The modeled gross RRSP contribution is B ÷ (1 − t). Tax relief finances the difference between that contribution and B. The TFSA receives B directly.

925212913058dbbd835aaba61397bb119b0ab4b2.src: The cumulative cash chart shows why this does not automatically make buying easier to fund. 91d44c00011d0bf90bf8ee3a6a0a3cd8601d80d7.src: An invented monthly tax-and-benefit system, not the law, eligibility rules or tax year of any country. All amounts are hypothetical CAD per month. Tax is a flat entered percentage of ALL gross earnings, without brackets, allowances, credits or payroll contributions. A separate nontaxable cash benefit begins at the entered maximum and falls by the selected rate on gross earnings above a fixed CAD 1,500 threshold, stopping at zero. The benefit is never negative; no cliff or repayment debt is modeled. Both earnings and the benefit are assumed received in the same modeled month; no prior-year assessment, withholding/refund settlement or receipt lag is calculated. Resources equal gross earnings minus this modeled tax plus this modeled benefit. The selected-raise offset share is (extra tax + lost benefit) / the full gross increase; it is undefined when the increase is zero. The right-hand local offset at the selected STARTING income is 70.00%, which can differ from the full-increase share when a phase-out boundary is crossed. A zero phase-out rate keeps the benefit constant. Combined local offsets may exceed 100% under deliberately extreme entered assumptions, and negative resource gains are retained. No employee/employer contributions, household costs, inflation, work incentives or behaviour, real benefit entitlement, tax deduction or personal affordability is inferred. This is not an OECD country estimate or an employer-labour-cost tax wedge.
91d44c00011d0bf90bf8ee3a6a0a3cd8601d80d7.zh: 发明的每月税收和福利制度，而不是任何国家的法律、资格规则或纳税年度。所有金额均为每月假设的加元。税收是所有总收入的固定百分比，没有括号、津贴、抵免或工资缴款。单独的免税现金福利从输入的最高限额开始，并根据总收入高于 1,500 加元的固定阈值按选定的比率下降，直至为零。好处永远不会是负的；没有对悬崖或偿还债务进行建模。假设收入和福利均在同一月份收到；不计算上一年的评估、预扣/退款结算或收款滞后。资源等于总收入减去该模型税收加上该模型福利。选择性加薪抵消份额为（额外税金+损失的福利）/全额总增长；当增量为零时，它是未定义的。所选起始收入的右侧局部抵消为 70.00%，这可能与跨越逐步淘汰边界时的完全增加份额不同。零淘汰率使效益保持不变。在故意输入的极端假设下，合并的当地抵消可能会超过 100%，并且保留负资源收益。不推断雇员/雇主缴款、家庭成本、通货膨胀、工作激励或行为、实际福利权利、税收减免或个人负担能力。这不是经合组织国家的估计，也不是雇主劳动力成本税收楔子。

93d82f8837b91536671cb0635bbafc1bb02cc603.src: Original deterministic illustration in today’s CAD throughout: all returns are real, so no further inflation increase is applied to expenses. Essential and flexible amounts are the spending requested from this portfolio after any income funded elsewhere. At the start of each year, before withdrawal and that year’s return, compare the planned essential plus remaining flexible request with opening assets. If it strictly exceeds the selected percentage, cut the remaining flexible amount once by the selected proportion. Essential requests stay unchanged; cuts persist and are never automatically restored. A zero balance with a positive request triggers the rule. Pay essential requests first, then flexible requests, using available assets only. Record unpaid requests without borrowing. Apply the selected first-year loss to assets left after withdrawal; subsequent years use the constant real return. No pension calculation, tax, fees, RRIF rule, benefit adjustment, mortality or probability of success is included. The trigger is a chosen teaching input, not a safe withdrawal rate or a published guardrail method.
93d82f8837b91536671cb0635bbafc1bb02cc603.zh: 今天加元的原始确定性说明：所有回报都是真实的，因此支出不会进一步增加通货膨胀。基本和灵活金额是指在其他地方资助的任何收入之后从该投资组合中请求的支出。每年年初，在提款和当年的回报之前，将计划的基本要求和剩余的灵活要求与期初资产进行比较。如果严格超出选定的比例，则将剩余的弹性金额按选定的比例削减一次。基本要求保持不变；削减仍然存在，并且永远不会自动恢复。零余额和正请求会触发该规则。首先支付基本请求，然后仅使用可用资产支付灵活请求。记录未付请求而不借用。将选定的第一年损失应用于提取后留下的资产；随后的年份使用恒定的实际回报。不包括养老金计算、税收、费用、RRIF 规则、福利调整、死亡率或成功概率。触发因素是选定的教学输入，而不是安全提款率或已发布的护栏方法。

93805e070cba74b4b452e1956fb9f6e88226f20c.zh: 在所有 15 年中，指定还款总额为 25,500 加元，收入包含总额为 4,500 加元。他们共同清偿了 30,000 加元的期初余额。因此，最终 HBP 余额为零并不能证明原来的 30,000 加元已完全恢复为退休储蓄。

93825c25f3a15167b58a0abda6849674123d500e.src: Then prepare a weaker-income case and a longer-search case, alongside a household reserve plan. Part-time training may cost less foregone income but take longer; comparing it properly requires entering its own duration, retained earnings and costs.

9384baca73d249d751c2ee17b804429126267115.src: The first two charts reproduce selected 2024 survey observations from the FCAC spotlight issued 17 November 2025 and modified 21 November 2025, retrieved 25 October 2026. They describe reported source use, not advisor quality or the effect of obtaining advice. The other two charts are separate hypothetical fee schedules. Both start immediately. The project path pays the initial fee at time zero, then a review after every selected number of complete years, only if its payment date falls before the end of the selected service window. The retainer path pays at the start of every service year. Future review and retainer quotes grow at the selected annual rate; the initial project fee is paid once without escalation. The discount rate converts dated payments to starting-date present cost and is not an expected portfolio return. No household funding account, investment performance, taxes, reimbursement, product costs or service outcomes are calculated. The two packages are not assumed to provide equivalent services.
9384baca73d249d751c2ee17b804429126267115.zh: 前两张图表再现了 2025 年 11 月 17 日发布、2025 年 11 月 21 日修改、2026 年 10 月 25 日检索的 FCAC 焦点中选定的 2024 年调查观察结果。它们描述了报告的来源使用情况，而不是顾问质量或获得建议的效果。另外两张图表是单独的假设费用表。两者都立即开始。项目路径在零时间支付初始费用，然后在每个选定的完整年份后进行审核，前提是其付款日期在选定的服务窗口结束之前。保留路径在每个服务年度开始时支付。未来的审查和保留报价以选定的年增长率增长；初始项目费用一次性支付，无需升级。贴现率将到期付款转换为起始日期当前成本，而不是预期的投资组合回报。不计算家庭资金账户、投资绩效、税收、报销、产品成本或服务成果。不假定这两个软件包提供同等的服务。

92f10eb11de0cfa1186203a11561b64d479e07b9.src: Original four-purchase bookkeeping illustration. The same positive CAD amount becomes available and is invested at each stated purchase date in one hypothetical unit class. Units are bought at the entered price, fractional units are allowed without limit, and none are sold. There is no starting investment, no initial lump sum waiting beside the schedule, and no claim that future contributions exist today. No fees, bid/ask spread, taxes, distributions, currency conversion, stock split, minimum lot or execution delay is modeled. Full precision is retained in calculations; displayed quantities and currency are rounded. Average purchase cost is total cash invested divided by units acquired, not the simple mean of the four price observations. Final value is calculated immediately after purchase four at that fourth price. Its difference from contributions is a dollar gain or loss, not an annualized return, a money-weighted rate, a strategy ranking or a tax adjusted-cost-base calculation. The path is an entered scenario, not historical performance or a forecast.
92f10eb11de0cfa1186203a11561b64d479e07b9.zh: 原始四次采购簿记插图。在每个规定的购买日期，可以获得相同的正加元金额并投资于一个假设的单位类别。单位按输入的价格购买，小数单位不受限制，且不出售。没有启动投资，没有在时间表之外等待的初始一次性付款，也没有声称今天存在未来的捐款。没有对费用、买入/卖出价差、税收、分配、货币兑换、股票分割、最小手数或执行延迟进行建模。计算中保留完整的精度；显示的数量和货币均四舍五入。平均购买成本是投资的总现金除以购买的单位，而不是四个价格观察值的简单平均值。以第四个价格购买四个后立即计算最终价值。它与捐款的区别在于美元收益或损失，而不是年化回报、货币加权利率、策略排名或税收调整成本基础计算。该路径是输入的情景，而不是历史表现或预测。

92f4e558842c69346bc5313fb43733ff99e1c954.src: A larger reserve can fund the illustrated calendar, but this horizon omits later care needs, survivor changes and spending after the final year. It is an annual transition exercise, not a lifetime adequacy assessment.
92f4e558842c69346bc5313fb43733ff99e1c954.zh: 更大的准备金可以为所示的日历提供资金，但此范围忽略了后来的护理需求、幸存者的变化以及最后一年之后的支出。这是年度过渡活动，而不是终身充足性评估。

92f55751348c23f8b23473268fce7811ea32348a.src: The example uses a fixed 365-day year, simple interest, no fees and no tax. It does not model rollovers, emergency access rights or lending approval. Its purpose is to compare equal starting resources, the same expense and a common finish date while making the cost and availability of the earlier funding explicit.
92f55751348c23f8b23473268fce7811ea32348a.zh: 该示例使用固定的 365 天一年、单利、无费用和无税款。它不会对展期、紧急访问权或贷款审批进行建模。其目的是比较相同的起始资源、相同的费用和共同的完成日期，同时明确早期资金的成本和可用性。

92f5bfa2a3e1dc83b46dac0809e109f031cafe2c.src: The bars assume the immediate receipt remains invested at the entered constant rate with no withdrawals. If the cash is used for living costs, the resulting future balance will differ. Actual spending may meet a real need, but it cannot simultaneously remain available to compound toward the later comparison.
92f5bfa2a3e1dc83b46dac0809e109f031cafe2c.zh: 条形图假定立即收据仍按输入的固定利率进行投资，不提款。如果现金用于生活费用，则未来的余额将会有所不同。实际支出可能满足实际需求，但不能同时用于后期比较。

9538e81477be4419e48da055557ae3a13e16a715.zh: 按 5% 计算，两年后移动默认流会使其现值从 51,953.72 加元降至约 47,123.56 加元。这等于原始现值除以 1.05 的平方。未折扣总额仍为 60,000 加元，因为没有删除或减少任何付款。

954565501c3f4a63775fd2853c9d1b28500a1e87.src: For the nine months ended July 31, 2026, adjusted EPS was C$7.59 versus C$6.19 a year earlier. The clean trailing calculation is C$8.37 for FY2025, less C$6.19 for its first nine months, plus C$7.59 for the latest nine months: C$9.77. This is a historical earnings measure. It is neither a forecast nor an assertion that the latest quarter can be repeated unchanged.
954565501c3f4a63775fd2853c9d1b28500a1e87.zh: 截至 2026 年 7 月 31 日的九个月，调整后每股收益为 7.59 加元，而去年同期为 6.19 加元。 2025 财年的干净追踪计算为 8.37 加元，减去前 9 个月的 6.19 加元，加上最近 9 个月的 7.59 加元：9.77 加元。这是一个历史收益指标。这既不是预测，也不是断言最新季度可以不变地重复。

94f69c61c66b55e2b3d7b79b3e0a0dbe79c0b879.src: The matrix varies the repair cost as well as its assumed chance. It holds the selected fee and deductible constant. A repair amount below the deductible leaves no covered portion, while a more expensive eligible repair can change the comparison sharply. The matrix therefore helps locate which severity and probability assumptions support a result, without assigning confidence to any cell.
94f69c61c66b55e2b3d7b79b3e0a0dbe79c0b879.zh: 该矩阵会改变修复成本及其假设机会。它保持选定的费用和免赔额不变。低于免赔额的维修金额不会留下承保部分，而更昂贵的合格维修可能会急剧改变比较结果。因此，该矩阵有助于确定支持结果的严重性和概率假设，而无需为任何单元格指定置信度。

94dfab40b81af844b4f3a533a49176b8d7b1ee9f.zh: 公开来源已审核2026 年 10 月 25 日。所有美元金额和收款日期均为原始假设输入。该工具比较独立的场景 A 和 B。它不会合并索赔、确定资格、计算税收或抵消、定价保险或衡量疾病概率。原创情景计算和研究清单是 TickerLantern 的教育分析；归属出版商的示例保留其声明的来源和范围。重新检查当前发行人文件，了解任何特定于产品的决策。

94e29226332e4f98fa1f59e110f9b27d23ce7936.src: Our 13× base exit multiple recognises a more focused and improving franchise while retaining a penalty for international credit, currency, associate-investment and execution uncertainty. The 11× bear and 15× bull assumptions are judgment-based stress points. They are not a documented historical trading range or a statement of consensus fair value.
94e29226332e4f98fa1f59e110f9b27d23ce7936.zh: 我们的 13 倍基本退出倍数认可了更加专注和不断改进的特许经营权，同时保留了对国际信贷、货币、联营投资和执行不确定性的惩罚。 11× 熊市和 15× 牛市假设是基于判断的压力点。它们不是记录在案的历史交易范围，也不是共识公允价值的声明。

94e2b59c6862558c1319edf1441b03894b0f7e6b.src: The FCAC’s budgeting guidance treats saving goals as part of the same plan as income and expenses. This article applies that idea to money already accumulated. It does not prescribe a reserve size or decide which personal goal should receive priority.
94e2b59c6862558c1319edf1441b03894b0f7e6b.zh: FCAC 的预算指南将储蓄目标视为与收入和支出相同的计划的一部分。本文将这个想法应用到已经积累的金钱上。它没有规定储备规模或决定哪个个人目标应优先考虑。

94e327fa9975e3a9c2e59c1a533e6fc75f5738c8.src: At current common P/B of 2.89× and 4% perpetual growth, the model implies sustainable ROE of 21.4% at a 10% required return, or 18.5% at 9%. Latest adjusted quarterly ROE is 18.1%; a single annualized quarter is not a perpetual forecast.
94e327fa9975e3a9c2e59c1a533e6fc75f5738c8.zh: 按照目前 2.89 倍的普通市盈率和 4% 的永久增长率，该模型意味着在 10% 的所需回报率下可持续股本回报率为 21.4%，或在 9% 的回报率下为 18.5%。最新调整后季度ROE为18.1%；单个年化季度并不是永久预测。

94e49106dba6af4c5ef72f95f368a041eb26cc0a.src: For a household decision, start with current bill amounts and the dates they become payable. Such a calculation would require defensible assumptions about which incidents are missing and how their losses differ.

That does not prove more nights are available or desirable, and travelling more can create costs excluded here. Also avoid comparing the ownership average directly with today’s rental quote: rental prices change across the window too. Compare the same period and cost basis on both sides.
96090c4c30506ca37211f3a8197f985ec3286c30.zh: 敏感性矩阵显示了实际使用的重要性。更多的住宿天数将相同的假设购买和固定年费分散到更多的消费中。这并不能证明有更多的夜晚可供选择或值得拥有，更多的旅行可能会产生此处不包括的成本。还要避免将平均拥有量与今天的租金报价直接进行比较：租金价格也会随着时间的推移而变化。比较双方相同的周期和成本。

960b72fd90d0c83951505abeabf0d8ed61921eae.src: Darker cells mean larger values. Scale: $0 to $11k.
960b72fd90d0c83951505abeabf0d8ed61921eae.zh: 较深的单元格意味着较大的值。规模：0 美元到 11,000 美元。

960eed98ffc3ba75e5836f56149035e03e2b7726.src: Start with a fully inclusive quote rather than an attractive per-person headline. This example separates CAD 6,000 of fixed event costs, CAD 100 per guest and CAD 4,000 of other fixed costs. At eighty guests, the base quote is CAD 18,000. These are hypothetical teaching amounts, not a survey of wedding prices or a supplier offer.
960eed98ffc3ba75e5836f56149035e03e2b7726.zh: 从完整的报价开始，而不是吸引人的标题。此示例将 6,000 加元的固定活动成本、每位客人 100 加元和 4,000 加元的其他固定成本分开。容纳 80 位客人，基本报价为 18,000 加元。这些是假设的教学金额，不是对婚礼价格或供应商报价的调查。

960f05f46e1ea5c04213105e87ca126d5abfd81a.src: Both bookings are paid in full at time zero. With CAD 2,500 assigned to the purchase, the lower-priced choice leaves CAD 700 and the alternative CAD 400 immediately. The conditional cash chart assumes cancellation in month two and refund two months later.
960f05f46e1ea5c04213105e87ca126d5abfd81a.zh: 两次预订均在零时间全额支付。由于购买金额为 2,500 加元，价格较低的选择立即剩下 700 加元，而替代品则立即剩下 400 加元。有条件现金图表假设第二个月取消并在两个月后退款。

9613ba38bcb5a90b6787e9de5cf5483bcd477464.src: Columns: new loan term. Rows: shortfall fully financed. Cells: interest alone (CAD)
9613ba38bcb5a90b6787e9de5cf5483bcd477464.zh: 列：新贷款期限。行：缺口得到充分资助。单元格：仅利息 (CAD)

9615db5f090c80a16f16db431c3e31af34986c00.src: Do not compare the hypothetical current balance sheet directly with constant-2023-dollar observations as if they shared a valuation date. The tool does not calculate a ranking, recommended saving rate or retirement funding requirement. Its purpose is to keep the statistical comparison and the household decision clearly defined.
9615db5f090c80a16f16db431c3e31af34986c00.zh: 不要将假设的当前资产负债表与 2023 年不变美元观察结果直接进行比较，就好像它们共享一个估值日期一样。该工具不计算排名、建议储蓄率或退休资金需求。其目的是明确界定统计比较和家庭决策。

961a43c6d22ba1ad00c3c2638fbc931cc9a2b4b5.src: The reported mean changes when durations above 99 weeks are capped data
961a43c6d22ba1ad00c3c2638fbc931cc9a2b4b5.zh: 当持续时间超过 99 周时，报告的平均变化数据

961a8cfe6a50a30dc8c419d2ce8baaaf85e1cdfa.src: Cash with one receipt at the mean year
961a8cfe6a50a30dc8c419d2ce8baaaf85e1cdfa.zh: 平均年份一张收据的现金

961af66c5abfde231fa69bdd9d7e037fe8a64501.src: Tracking error measures how variable the gap is
961af66c5abfde231fa69bdd9d7e037fe8a64501.zh: 跟踪误差衡量差距的变化程度

961d9c81e90a0f86f33ed5f7450c89bfc08e8404.src: The fixed principal-repayment rule makes the outstanding balances identical data
961d9c81e90a0f86f33ed5f7450c89bfc08e8404.zh: 固定本金还款规则使未结余额数据相同

961fda7535d1dd76d72db66630ccacf89a861106.src: Compare the same purchase before assigning a value to the points
961fda7535d1dd76d72db66630ccacf89a861106.zh: 在为积分分配价值之前比较相同的购买

961ff1bd9b61811c6e13afde984d1cbfce74d112.src: Compare the repurchase price with a value range
961ff1bd9b61811c6e13afde984d1cbfce74d112.zh: 将回购价格与价值范围进行比较

96200f50cc2ab9d540ec04064606a438a98de80c.src: “Salary or dividend?” is often framed as a personal tax comparison. Before comparing tax, locate each dollar: salary is paid from the corporation to the working owner; a dividend is generally distributed from corporate after-tax profits. A corporation’s deduction for salary and the owner’s personal tax are separate calculations. The corporate tax on remaining income depends on the business, province or territory, tax year, small-business-deduction eligibility, business limit and other facts.
96200f50cc2ab9d540ec04064606a438a98de80c.zh: “工资还是股息？”通常被视为个人税收比较。在比较税收之前，先找到每一块钱：工资是公司支付给工作所有者的；股息一般从企业税后利润中分配。公司的工资扣除和所有者的个人税是分开计算的。剩余收入的企业税取决于企业、省或地区、纳税年度、小企业扣除资格、业务限制和其他事实。

93dd87f07da64ad94db23dcd60eaf35d912b9cf2.src: Current ratios exceed every observation in this ten-year fiscal year-end sample. That supports “historically expensive” within the sample; it does not establish an all-time extreme or a crash probability.
93dd87f07da64ad94db23dcd60eaf35d912b9cf2.zh: 流动比率超过了十年财年末样本中的所有观察结果。这支持样本中的“历史昂贵”；它并未建立历史上的极端概率或崩溃概率。

93e50cb914959cb4f059c9a2620ba40f8e5958e0.src: A dollar available sooner and a dollar received decades later have different timing. The present-value bars discount each monthly payment back to age 60 using the selected real annual rate, converted to an equivalent monthly rate.
93e50cb914959cb4f059c9a2620ba40f8e5958e0.zh: 较早可用的一美元和几十年后收到的一美元有不同的时间。现值条使用选定的实际年利率（转换为等值的月利率）对 60 岁之前的每月付款进行折扣。

93e7158b3385f2e0515763536c86d59ddba98aac.src: Rows replace the waiting period and columns replace the later average incremental tax-saving rate. The entered deduction, current saving rate and opportunity return remain fixed. Each row compares the alternatives at its own later receipt date; amounts across rows occur at different dates. Positive and negative signs show which alternative has more tax-saving cash then. These are scenarios, not assigned probabilities.
93e7158b3385f2e0515763536c86d59ddba98aac.zh: 行取代等待期，列取代后来的平均增量节税率。输入的扣除额、当前储蓄率和机会回报保持不变。每行在其自己较晚的接收日期比较替代方案；跨行的金额发生在不同的日期。积极和消极的迹象表明哪种替代方案有更多的节税现金。这些是情景，而不是指定的概率。

93ec6fc83ad2ea28e440f34f68e757bba9e41db2.src: The history chart places the unadjusted and seasonally adjusted series on a common index scale and explicitly focuses the vertical axis on 160 to 172. This makes their modest differences easier to inspect, while the labelled range prevents a small movement from being mistaken for a change from zero.
93ec6fc83ad2ea28e440f34f68e757bba9e41db2.zh: 历史图表将未经调整和季节性调整的序列放在共同的指数范围内，并明确地将垂直轴集中在 160 到 172 上。这使得它们的适度差异更容易检查，而标记的范围可以防止小幅变动被误认为是从零开始的变化。

93f7e12c79348fa47af04536d55e7fa8095211e5.src: Annual purchase amount eligible for bonus rate (CAD)
93f7e12c79348fa47af04536d55e7fa8095211e5.zh: 符合奖金率（加元）条件的年度购买金额

93f89c359cb6d65d192afe9adc5f912672455d49.src: Price is one part of the comparison. Confirm the insured person, policy term, beneficiary, coverage limit, exclusions, evidence requirements and whether the contract continues when a mortgage is refinanced or moved. The calculator does not verify any of those terms.
93f89c359cb6d65d192afe9adc5f912672455d49.zh: 价格是比较的一部分。确认受保人、保单期限、受益人、承保限额、除外责任、证据要求以及抵押贷款再融资或转移时合同是否继续。计算器不会验证任何这些术语。

93fc6bb970bc9f44de959cd69d5ee2e1ea3603ee.src: Net worth is a balance-sheet amount: assets less liabilities. It can contain property and other assets whose value cannot be spent immediately without a transaction. A wealth-group mean therefore cannot be copied into a household cash plan as if it were an available bank balance.
93fc6bb970bc9f44de959cd69d5ee2e1ea3603ee.zh: 净值是资产负债表中的金额：资产减去负债。它可以包含财产和其他资产，其价值在没有交易的情况下无法立即花费。因此，财富组均值不能像可用银行余额一样复制到家庭现金计划中。

94003c793ee1080e72d5fae8b34af98e8b618212.src: A zero flat quote produces zero interest and a zero equivalent cost rate. At a selected zero advance, however, there is no actual loan cash-flow ratio to infer. The headline reports N/A while the independent positive-unit matrix remains defined.
94003c793ee1080e72d5fae8b34af98e8b618212.zh: 零统一报价产生零利息和零等价成本率。然而，在选定的零预付款下，没有实际的贷款现金流比率可供推断。标题报告 N/A，但独立正单位矩阵仍保持定义。

94015482a8770f701f6cfca61f15abef7e3ee210.src: Live official HTML reviewed 25 October 2026; page modified 2 September 2026. Supports separating cancellation, interruption and medical coverage and reviewing policy terms. No insurer, premium, claim probability or coverage recommendation is supplied.
94015482a8770f701f6cfca61f15abef7e3ee210.zh: 实时官方 HTML 审核于 2026 年 10 月 25 日；页面于 2026 年 9 月 2 日修改。支持将取消、中断和医疗保险分开并审查保单条款。未提供保险公司、保费、索赔概率或承保范围建议。

94029d840b6737070e1a6809ed60dbcc7804265c.src: Statistics Canada’s 2023 Survey of Household Spending release, dated 21 May 2025, compares households grouped into income quintiles. This article retains that dated release’s figures. It does not describe current prices or claim to reproduce the latest revised statistical table.
94029d840b6737070e1a6809ed60dbcc7804265c.zh: 加拿大统计局于 2025 年 5 月 21 日发布的2023 年家庭支出调查对家庭进行了比较分为收入五分位数。本文保留了该日期发布的数据。它不描述当前价格，也不声称重现最新修订的统计表。

968d1e2eb6698a4b626dfe1b17298c02d5363384.src: Years in block A; block B fills the remaining ten years
968d1e2eb6698a4b626dfe1b17298c02d5363384.zh: 在 A 区的岁月； B区块填满剩余十年

968da3ae29155741846fad3eb8328208c72b4607.src: Financial planning · Cash flow · 3 charts + interactive scenarios
968da3ae29155741846fad3eb8328208c72b4607.zh: 财务规划·现金流·3张图表+互动场景

968dc2d23a695ae658cdef6716ebfb038bd63140.src: Inspect the market path and the whole balance sheet
968dc2d23a695ae658cdef6716ebfb038bd63140.zh: 检查市场路径和整个资产负债表

968effc98a9d3662fe7f7af74ad12bf5f453736d.src: Separate extra deposits from their modeled investment effect
968effc98a9d3662fe7f7af74ad12bf5f453736d.zh: 将额外存款与其建模投资效果分开

969099225a26caab3cc89ebf58207569e24775ef.src: TD: recovery has a price; controls still matter
969099225a26caab3cc89ebf58207569e24775ef.zh: TD：恢复是有代价的；控制仍然很重要

9691087834de1d1793a1749816931c6ab7d9fc69.src: The first number in a job-loss budget is the cash that can actually pay the next bill. Separate accessible savings from locked deposits, securities that would have to be sold, an expected settlement and unused borrowing capacity. They have different receipt dates, conditions and consequences. Do not add an undrawn credit limit to savings without also modeling the resulting debt.
9691087834de1d1793a1749816931c6ab7d9fc69.zh: 失业预算中的第一个数字是实际可以支付下一笔账单的现金。将可用储蓄与锁定存款、必须出售的证券、预期结算和未使用的借贷能力分开。它们有不同的收货日期、条件和后果。如果不对由此产生的债务进行建模，请勿将未提取的信用额度添加到储蓄中。

9691229ebcd1fc5f7a9194513dba3355a0a7355c.src: The annual purchase total stays selected. Bonus purchases above the cap earn the base rate; changing the mix does not remove that cap or make ineligible merchants eligible.
9691229ebcd1fc5f7a9194513dba3355a0a7355c.zh: 年度购买总额保持选定状态。超出上限的奖励购买可赚取基本费率；更改组合不会取消该上限或使不符合条件的商家符合资格。

9692e7d8b6283d24220a224962aabd035af21fed.src: Read the matrix as a stress comparison

969474d829176301d7ab78d8cd04a1ae85ba707b.src: Hypothetical example: CAD 10,000 initially, CAD 500 at each month-end, 5% effective annual return for 30 years. Before tax, fees and inflation. This is not a forecast.
969474d829176301d7ab78d8cd04a1ae85ba707b.zh: 假设示例：CAD初始10,000，每个月末500加元，30年有效年回报率5%。扣除税费、费用和通货膨胀之前。这不是预测。

96965e8d1283de33128856459d76903740cff6ee.src: Reconcile the ending-cash difference over equal time data
96965e8d1283de33128856459d76903740cff6ee.zh: 协调相同时间数据的期末现金差异

9697116f0588df7b08cd931111271455ef93bf35.src: A slower increase can leave the price index at a higher level data
9697116f0588df7b08cd931111271455ef93bf35.zh: 较慢的增长可能会使价格指数处于较高水平 data

969ccc571a215eef2994085a7cf0bb8373718967.src: Plan the years before the pension starts
969ccc571a215eef2994085a7cf0bb8373718967.zh: 在养老金开始前的几年进行计划

969cfaa928a724dc64dd2c133a23042e3aa5c541.src: The line follows the selected group’s five annual means from 2021 through 2025, with an explicit zero comparison. It helps distinguish the direction of a change from the sign of the level. Exact calendar years and values remain in the data table.
969cfaa928a724dc64dd2c133a23042e3aa5c541.zh: 该线遵循所选组从 2021 年到 2025 年的五个年度平均值，并进行了明确的零比较。它有助于区分变化的方向和水平的符号。准确的日历年和值保留在数据表中。

969ded28fa7b4f2f2fee3fd10bea8794423bf9e3.src: Rows replace the effective annual fund return after tax and costs; columns replace month-end saving. Loan principal, rate, term, balloon share and initial fund cash stay selected. Zero means the modeled fund reaches the balloon; it does not establish that every regular loan payment is affordable.
969ded28fa7b4f2f2fee3fd10bea8794423bf9e3.zh: 行取代税费和成本后的有效年度资金回报；列取代月末储蓄。贷款本金、利率、期限、气球份额和初始资金现金保持选定。零意味着模型基金达到气球；它并没有确定每笔定期贷款还款都是可以负担的。

96a2ade4a5a3a12b26f599b780412f056b6f01fa.src: With the default 60% component, CAD 4,000 of eligible earnings produces a CAD 2,400 formula amount under every displayed cap. CAD 16,000 of eligible earnings with a CAD 3,000 cap instead produces an 18.75% gross ratio.
96a2ade4a5a3a12b26f599b780412f056b6f01fa.zh: 使用默认的 60% 部分，4,000 加元的合格收入在每个显示的上限下产生 2,400 加元的公式金额。符合条件的收入为 16,000 加元，上限为 3,000 加元，总比率为 18.75%。

96a6eab266acb761f80c0f809ab3a2fbc7f6c7ad.src: Preserve the limits of the holdings data

96adc0d50e93daef31f3f0f287301dbab421944d.src: Let W be the upfront contract price, p the whole-window repair probability, q the eligible share and P the provider payment in an eligible event. Expected extra owner cost is W − p × q × P. If qP is positive, cost equality occurs at p = W ÷ (qP).
96adc0d50e93daef31f3f0f287301dbab421944d.zh: 令 W 为前期合同价格，p 为整个窗口修复概率，q 为合格份额，P 为合格事件中的提供商付款。预期额外所有者成本为W − p × q × P。如果 qP 为正，则成本相等的情况为 p = W ÷ (qP)。

96b0311c52fe0030db6f6b9c7c87e9d9c8b7d451.src: Stress the new bill beside the obligations already due
96b0311c52fe0030db6f6b9c7c87e9d9c8b7d451.zh: 除了已到期的债务外，还要强调新账单

96f039253f5ed45794db5b19fdf6dbfaac8bd705.src: Match a spending date with an actual cash payment. Index-adjusted principal, market value and purchase outlay are different amounts, and a floor on original face does not promise every purchase price back.
96f039253f5ed45794db5b19fdf6dbfaac8bd705.zh: 将消费日期与实际现金付款相匹配。经指数调整的本金、市场价值和购买支出是不同的金额，原始面值的下限并不保证收回所有购买价格。

96f0a498bcc451301d97e85b73c63e0528421250.src: A low annual usage charge can hide a substantial upfront payment and continuing fees. Divide the complete cost by nights actually used, and keep the model’s finish date separate from the contract’s obligations.
96f0a498bcc451301d97e85b73c63e0528421250.zh: 较低的年使用费可能隐藏大量的预付款和持续费用。将总成本除以实际使用的天数，并将模型的完成日期与合同义务分开。

96f20666200e6579a4898dc92b3d6a85f6833576.src: Use the calendar as the start of the income-reporting review
96f20666200e6579a4898dc92b3d6a85f6833576.zh: 使用日历作为收入报告审核的开始

96f3595acf8b598ac73704a2107b7f5872717d14.src: Most confusion about equal payments comes from collapsing four different numbers into one.
96f3595acf8b598ac73704a2107b7f5872717d14.zh: 对等额付款的最大困惑来自于将四个不同的数字合并为一个。

96f4578d84b42357efc4e5c27050bf03ff88f0cf.src: Use the timing grid without turning it into a score forecast
96f4578d84b42357efc4e5c27050bf03ff88f0cf.zh: 使用时间网格不将其转化为分数预测

96f46e280ac2eb524badd2b80a485d711f4bef1a.src: The example starts with CAD 5,000 in bucket A at an assumed 18% nominal annual rate and CAD 2,000 in bucket B at 30%. There are no new transactions, promotional expiries, fees, grace periods or rate changes. Interest is simplified to the opening monthly balance multiplied by its annual rate divided by twelve.
96f46e280ac2eb524badd2b80a485d711f4bef1a.zh: 该示例从 A 桶中的 5,000 加元开始，假设名义年利率为 18%，B 桶中的 2,000 加元为 30%。没有新交易、促销到期、费用、宽限期或费率变化。利息简化为期初月余额乘以年利率除以十二。

96f7e8bd294c645db45d3cd1c5721f3f6d3440d3.src: The horizontal axis is a price stress, not a probability or time path. A ratio above the dashed line fails the fictional test even if collateral still exceeds debt. These percentages are loan-to-value ratios, not investment returns or the equity percentage required by a particular margin rule. A starting case can already exceed the selected limit; the tool does not assume that the original borrowing would have been approved.
96f7e8bd294c645db45d3cd1c5721f3f6d3440d3.zh: 横轴是价格压力，而不是概率或时间路径。即使抵押品仍然超过债务，高于虚线的比率也无法通过虚构测试。这些百分比是贷款价值比率，而不是投资回报或特定保证金规则要求的股本百分比。起始案例可能已超出所选限制；该工具并不假设原始借款已获得批准。

96fa7b2ae9fb259674eb787b3c1ce6489e5b3fec.src: Which essential expenses are covered by reliable income outside the portfolio?
96fa7b2ae9fb259674eb787b3c1ce6489e5b3fec.zh: 投资组合之外的可靠收入涵盖了哪些基本费用？

96ff4cd4737404dddd38172db890bb605abeea95.src: At the default 95% level, both gain states contribute 80% of probability. Including the CAD 5,000 loss state adds another 15%, reaching 95%. The defined 95% VaR is therefore CAD 5,000.
96ff4cd4737404dddd38172db890bb605abeea95.zh: 在默认的 95% 水平下，两种收益状态贡献了 80% 的概率。加上5000加元的损失状态再增加15%，达到95%。因此，定义的 95% VaR 为 5,000 加元。

9707bce0c55628ccf17fb027acad12850fe6a6fe.src: The latest quarter provides evidence of execution: adjusted diluted EPS reached C$2.28 and adjusted annualized ROE reached 14.2%. Those results strengthen the case that the bank can earn an acceptable return on its capital. They also raise the burden of proof. Investors need to establish that the mix of margins, credit costs and capital-markets income can survive less favourable conditions before treating one quarter’s return as a durable earnings base.

97a095d400a72c79cd9c549ab2caedd3243dcca7.src: An invented ETF quote, not live market data or an execution prediction. Quotes are symmetric around their midpoint: half the full entered spread is paid on each respective side. All units are assumed bought at the entry ask and later sold at the exit bid; each side has the selected number of executed orders at the same respective quote, with sufficient depth and no price impact. Total units are unchanged when order count changes. No distributions, fund expenses, taxes, foreign exchange, partial fills, ticket-fee exceptions or time value of waiting are modeled. Quote midpoint is not NAV or verified fair value; a limit order does not guarantee a fill or eliminate the spread.
97a095d400a72c79cd9c549ab2caedd3243dcca7.zh: 虚构的 ETF 报价，而不是实时市场数据或执行预测。报价围绕中点对称：双方支付全部输入价差的一半。假设所有单位均按入场要价买入，随后按出场出价出售；双方都以各自相同的报价执行选定数量的订单，具有足够的深度并且没有价格影响。当订单数量发生变化时，总单位数不变。没有对分配、基金费用、税收、外汇、部分成交、门票费用例外或等待时间价值进行建模。报价中点不是资产净值或经过验证的公允价值；限价订单不保证成交或消除价差。

97d32e657e73fc65bd717b9657b8b44ba8e391cf.src: The funding waterfall begins with the covered rebuilding bill. It subtracts the assumed insurer payment and then the cash assigned to the owner’s share. 97d32e657e73fc65bd717b9657b8b44ba8e391cf.zh: 资金瀑布从涵盖的重建法案开始。它减去假定的保险公司付款，然后减去分配给所有者份额的现金。积极的终点确定了额外的资金；负端点标识分配的剩余现金。

97d5cf9437b0c7bef7cf09463c16eb5c62d30118.src: The reduction is subject to a CAD 50,000 lifetime maximum across qualifying AIP relief, the eligible contribution amount, the deduction capacity and its timing. The CRA payment guide says the contribution must be made in the receipt year or the first 60 days of the following year, with sufficient deduction limit and the deduction claimed for the applicable year. Past use of the AIP lifetime limit is separate from available RRSP room.

97d7894a7c80f174dda9b0c98ee53ea24a772621.src: Each return lies fifteen percentage points from that mean. Population variance is the probability-weighted squared distance from the mean: 0.5 × 15² + 0.5 × 15² = 225 squared percentage points. The square root gives a standard deviation of fifteen percentage points, conventionally displayed here as 15% return volatility.

97db2d5cd9ab0e3bac7f35fc575d35b9b7eda45d.src: Every cell uses the same selected mean and standard deviation and replaces both the goal and unequal-case lower-outcome probability. 97db2d5cd9ab0e3bac7f35fc575d35b9b7eda45d.zh: 每个单元格都使用相同的选定平均值和标准差，并替换目标概率和不等情况的较低结果概率。重新计算两个返回值以保留这些时刻。如果所需回报甚至超过上限结果，目标就 100% 失败。平等就达到了目标。所选的目标控制会影响指标；矩阵保留这些固定目标行。

96dee2e3460e9f84a7ba2e3914bb12915eab16f6.src: Each value subtracts the paid-rent average from the asking-rent average for the same CMA, unit type and quarter. Positive values mean a higher asking average, zero means equal averages, and negative values mean a lower asking average. The underlying apartments and tenant populations are not matched, so these differences cannot predict an individual move’s cost or a renewal increase.

96e09c9294c84c7478f18b43b3247e3143d842e8.src: The sensitivity matrix holds the CAD 26,000 AIP constant. Columns change assumed available deduction capacity from zero to CAD 50,000; rows change how much of the AIP lifetime ceiling was already used. If no lifetime relief has been used, room and the AIP amount can bind. Once CAD 40,000 has been used, only CAD 10,000 remains even in the CAD 50,000 capacity column.
96e09c9294c84c7478f18b43b3247e3143d842e8.zh: 敏感度矩阵保持 26,000 加元 AIP 不变。列将假设的可用扣除能力从零更改为 50,000 加元；行更改已使用的 AIP 生命周期上限的数量。如果未使用终身减免，则房间和 AIP 金额可能会绑定。一旦使用了 40,000 加元，即使在 50,000 加元的容量栏中也只剩下 10,000 加元。

96e366a66f9beb01f133aeb0d812bb01525ad9e3.src: The duration term is −initial price × modified duration × yield change. The convexity term is +½ × initial price × convexity × yield change squared. Yield change is a fraction, so a 2-percentage-point move enters as 0.02. The final correction equals exact repricing minus the two-term estimate. Every step is a valuation change; no step pays cash into the account.
96e366a66f9beb01f133aeb0d812bb01525ad9e3.zh: 期限为 - 初始价格 × 修改期限 × 收益变化。凸度项是 + 1/2 × 初始价格 × 凸度 × 收益率变化的平方。收益率变化是一个分数，因此 2 个百分点的变动将输入 0.02。最终修正等于准确的重新定价减去两项估计。每一步都是估值的变化；没有步骤将现金存入帐户。

9676e109c43ec33788ea186a73b49b4f4202a854.src: This decomposition helps locate the assumption driving the result. The first-year quote is not irrelevant, but it is only one part of a five-year sequence. If later renewal rates were higher instead, the outcome could change. The model isolates that possibility without claiming to know which future rate path will occur.
9676e109c43ec33788ea186a73b49b4f4202a854.zh: 这种分解有助于找到驱动结果的假设。第一年的报价并非无关紧要，但它只是五年序列的一部分。如果后来的续订率更高，结果可能会改变。该模型隔离了这种可能性，但没有声称知道未来会发生哪种利率路径。

967ca52c160cb627172459db6fd8c5bb8be4d7d9.src: The purchase price is paid immediately. Running cost is paid after each full year of use, including the final service year. It represents the year just completed, rather than an optional overhaul performed after the item is discarded.

967ef4200b6df1b24fd201bbed08fc48361e59a0.src: The cash floor itself is not maintained through the interruption: essentials take cash below it and eventually to zero. Its role is to restrict new purchases, rather than forbid emergency spending or pull money from the portfolio to keep the cash line at a target.

968ca27631e94cd76ce1aa1761da485e098eb1eb.src: Both lines begin at zero and end at their twelve-period totals. Where paid cash is above charges, the household has advanced money to the provider. Where charges are above paid cash, the household has consumed service it has not yet paid for in this ledger. Crossing points are timing events, not billing notices.
968ca27631e94cd76ce1aa1761da485e098eb1eb.zh: 两条线均从零开始，以十二个周期的总计结束。如果支付的现金高于费用，则家庭向提供者预付资金。如果费用高于支付的现金，则该家庭已经消费了该分类帐中尚未支付的服务。交叉点是计时事件，而不是计费通知。

9958cc67a0e2c42db3e51b5254cdf0e056ecbd69.src: The 2022 Concepts and Methods Guide describes activity limitations connected with a long-term condition or health-related problem. Its framework considers the interaction between functional limitations and environmental barriers. That is a broader subject than a particular insurance contract’s definition of a payable claim.
9958cc67a0e2c42db3e51b5254cdf0e056ecbd69.zh: 2022 年概念和方法指南描述了与长期病症或健康相关问题相关的活动限制。其框架考虑了功能限制和环境障碍之间的相互作用。这是一个比特定保险合同的应付索赔定义更广泛的主题。

9958fd07f4633da7abbd2f29a0c0176dce2ca790.src: Page dated 14 October 2025; reviewed 25 October 2026 for general distinctions between the loan amount, interest, payment terms and other costs. No quoted loan example, statutory interest ceiling, approval rule or actual repayment formula is applied. All rates, equal-principal annual payments, rate orders and dollar calculations are independently authored hypothetical assumptions.
9958fd07f4633da7abbd2f29a0c0176dce2ca790.zh: 页面日期为 2025 年 10 月 14 日；于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查了贷款金额、利息、付款条件和其他费用之间的一般区别。不适用引用的贷款示例、法定利息上限、审批规则或实际还款公式。所有利率、等本年付款、利率指令和美元计算均独立编写的假设。

995d12ef0c36ff581cb6fc432de88b44ad754a34.src: At the defaults, CAD 12,000 plus a 20% assumed extra cost of CAD 2,400 gives CAD 14,400. The survey’s 7.1% is not used anywhere in this arithmetic. The selected stress assumes the extra amount is actually incurred for this scenario; a contingency held for possible work need not all be spent in practice. This is neither a contractor quote nor an estimate based on the property’s market value.
995d12ef0c36ff581cb6fc432de88b44ad754a34.zh: 默认情况下，12,000 加元加上 20% 的假设额外成本 2,400 加元，得出 14,400 加元。该算术中没有使用调查中的 7.1%。所选压力假设在这种情况下实际会产生额外金额；为可能的工作而准备的应急资金不必全部花在实践中。这既不是承包商的报价，也不是基于房产市场价值的估计。

995fc4c6dd315658b0586e9deed2b7b535e46b5c.src: The ask and bid already incorporate the assumed spread. Reconcile the actual cash paid and received before adding costs, and keep trading costs separate from fund expenses and market returns.
995fc4c6dd315658b0586e9deed2b7b535e46b5c.zh: 要价和出价已包含假设的价差。在增加成本之前对实际支付和收到的现金进行核对，并将交易成本与资金费用和市场回报分开。

99615cd48d3d521596a62ead74a157f67c02bdab.src: Strategy B puts the same initial CAD 5,000 in the alternative account. Its CAD 16 outside budget pays the monthly fee every month. The model does not also remove that fee from B’s invested balance, because doing both would charge the same expense twice.
99615cd48d3d521596a62ead74a157f67c02bdab.zh: 策略 B 将相同的初始 5,000 加元存入替代账户。其每月 16 加元的外部预算支付月费。该模型并没有从 B 的投资余额中删除该费用，因为两者都会收取两次相同的费用。

9961b2dc4ef348dc47c846d098bb55dcb5001a3c.src: That is a deliberately narrow stress, not a recommendation that every family hold six months of the same expenses. Actual needs depend on job income, available support, payment dates, insurance and the consequences of selling assets. FCAC’s goal-setting guidance identifies access to short-term savings as a separate consideration.
9961b2dc4ef348dc47c846d098bb55dcb5001a3c.zh: 这是一个故意缩小的压力，而不是建议每个家庭持有六个月的相同费用。实际需求取决于工作收入、可用支持、付款日期、保险和出售资产的后果。 FCAC 的目标设定指南将获得短期储蓄作为单独的考虑因素。

99629eca8f9ff5980a98cdee500dfe3a3366d703.src: An entry rate and an exit rate cannot be directly subtracted to find the change in people. Reconcile the starting populations and flows, then use actual household dollars for a reserve plan.
99629eca8f9ff5980a98cdee500dfe3a3366d703.zh: 不能直接减去进入率和退出率来发现人员的变化。核对起始人口和流量，然后使用实际家庭资金制定储备计划。

997564a43df5d1c0f8487b68b6e73a9e5b53d3f8.src: After the sixth period the charges total CAD 870 and cash paid totals CAD 900, so the difference is negative CAD 30. Forecast charges for the remaining six periods are CAD 1,130. The recomputed installment is (−30 + 1,130) ÷ 6 = CAD 183.33, with a final period adjusted by two cents if the plan is settled to the cent.
997564a43df5d1c0f8487b68b6e73a9e5b53d3f8.zh: 第六个周期之后，费用总计 870 加元，现金支付总计 900 加元，因此差额为负 30 加元。其余六个周期的预测费用为 1,130 加元。重新计算的分期付款金额为 (−30 + 1,130) ÷ 6 = CAD 183.33，如果计划结算到美分，最后期限将调整 2 美分。

999aaf4ddef621f0ea539b4a8fd093a8f1e89b20.src: The rows are stresses, not probabilities. The columns are durations, not forecasts of time needed to find work. Even the zero-interruption column needs enough opening cash for the first bill because ordinary pay arrives afterwards. If the replacement amount exceeds normal income, a longer interruption can improve cash in this model; the tool preserves that input rather than assuming a direction.
999aaf4ddef621f0ea539b4a8fd093a8f1e89b20.zh: 这些行是压力，而不是概率。这些列是持续时间，而不是对找到工作所需时间的预测。即使是零中断专栏也需要足够的现金来支付第一张账单，因为普通工资是随后到达的。如果更换金额超过正常收入，则较长时间的中断可以改善该模型中的现金；该工具会保留该输入，而不是假设一个方向。

99c901d7350eb2fe2626e37569f35e7ab410d7a6.src: The next chart subtracts remaining purchase debt from the financed account. At index zero, that net position is zero, while the cash buyer has CAD 600 and no purchase debt. The identical item is excluded from both sides, so its value is not counted twice or assigned a different resale price to favour one choice.
99c901d7350eb2fe2626e37569f35e7ab410d7a6.zh: 下一张图表从融资账户中减去剩余的购买债务。在指数为零时，净头寸为零，而现金买家有 600 加元且没有购买债务。相同的商品不会被双方计算在内，因此其价值不会被计算两次，也不会为其中一种选择分配不同的转售价格。

99c9095644f20afb403a34eb36fa6c3b2a598075.src: The negative line is not an actual overdraft balance or permission to keep paying bills without money. It displays the amount missing from the selected resources. The model also assumes receipts arrive every month without a waiting period; it makes no Employment Insurance calculation or promise of replacement income.
99c9095644f20afb403a34eb36fa6c3b2a598075.zh: 负线并不是实际的透支余额，也不是允许在没有钱的情况下继续支付账单。它显示所选资源中缺失的数量。该模型还假设收据每月都会到达，无需等待期；它不进行就业保险计算，也不承诺替代收入。

9b43b9e91504946b6b3cffb72d365713e6b87954.src: Opening cash and monthly saving are identical in both paths. The due month includes its saving contribution before the complete bill is paid. At the defaults, six CAD 1,500 contributions plus CAD 3,000 opening cash fund the CAD 12,000 quote exactly, while the stressed bill leaves an unfunded CAD 2,400. Negative values do not assume overdraft access or a delayed bill.
9b43b9e91504946b6b3cffb72d365713e6b87954.zh: 两种路径中的期初现金和每月储蓄是相同的。到期月份包括支付完整账单之前的储蓄缴款。在此日期之前，两条路径重合；连接每月积分并非每日交易账本。在默认情况下，六笔 1,500 加元的捐款加上 3,000 加元的开户现金，正好为报价的 12,000 加元提供资金，而有压力的账单留下了 2,400 加元的无资金来源。负值并不意味着透支或延迟账单。

9b147e321dbe55c1e4e67003909926ae1cf3e00d.src: An independently entered owner-level assessment schedule, not a calculation of legal liability or of a building’s funding adequacy. Equal instalments are due at the start of their selected months, before that month’s personal saving arrives. Ordinary strata fees and all other household bills must already be paid outside this reserve. The strata corporation’s operating and reserve funds are not personal accessible cash and are not deducted from the entered owner assessment. Cash earns zero interest. Every bill can use only personal cash then available; unpaid amounts remain separate, without automatic borrowing or later retrospective payment. New saving continues through the full displayed horizon and is not capped after the final instalment. Provincial rules, voting, unit entitlement, sale adjustments, interest on arrears and actual assessment dates require independent confirmation.

9c726f758ef0e5dd5ef6c22873028fa2cf51fc9d.src: Hypothetical thirty-day balance ledger, excluding interest, fees, refunds and pending transactions. One purchase posts on each day, then the entered payment posts on its chosen day, capped at the balance then owed. The assumed reporting snapshot is after all transactions on that selected day. The other card balance and limit stay fixed and are assumed observed at the same snapshot. Utilization is balance divided by the stated limit; combined use is total balance divided by total limit, not an average of individual percentages. Report timing is an independent scenario assumption, not an issuer reporting schedule. This tool does not calculate a credit score, predict a score change, decide a lender outcome, establish available funds for the payment, assess whether an over-limit purchase would be authorized or model a payment deadline/grace period. Use actual statements and required payment dates.
9c726f758ef0e5dd5ef6c22873028fa2cf51fc9d.zh: 假设的三十天余额分类账，不包括利息、费用、退款和待处理交易。每天发布一次购买，然后在所选日期发布输入的付款，上限为当时所欠的余额。假设的报告快照是在选定日期的所有交易之后。其他卡的余额和限额保持固定，并假设在同一快照中观察到。利用率是余额除以规定的限额；合并使用是总余额除以总限额，而不是单个百分比的平均值。报告时间是一个独立的情景假设，而不是发行人的报告时间表。该工具不会计算信用评分、预测评分变化、决定贷款机构结果、建立用于付款的可用资金、评估是否会授权超限购买或对付款期限/宽限期进行建模。使用实际的报表和所需的付款日期。

9dab2260aa24de68f6d40d99df941060128eb123.src: The income offsets part of the immediate schedule’s borrowing cost, but it does not turn borrowed principal into new household wealth. 9db5ae753a8c00ad0edbe7af5c06f00c105edbb8.src: One hypothetical CAD holding in a non-registered account, sold proportionately with fractional units allowed. Gain equals proceeds minus proportionate adjusted cost base minus a flat selling cost. The entered percentage applies to the full positive gain as a cash earmark; it is neither a statutory inclusion rate nor a personal marginal rate or tax-return calculation. A loss generates no assumed refund. The sale is capped at the holding value, so an unaffordable target remains a visible shortfall. Tax cash is retained separately and unavailable for the goal. No other income, losses, account rules, settlement delay, FX or price movement during execution.
9db5ae753a8c00ad0edbe7af5c06f00c105edbb8.zh: 非注册账户中假设持有一笔加元，按比例出售，允许小数单位。收益等于收益减去按比例调整的成本基础再减去固定销售成本。输入的百分比适用于作为现金专项用途的全额正收益；它既不是法定的包含率，也不是个人边际税率或纳税申报表计算。损失不会产生假定退款。此次出售的上限为持有价值，因此无法承担的目标仍然是一个明显的缺口。税款现金单独保留，不可用于目标。执行期间没有其他收入、损失、账户规则、结算延迟、外汇或价格变动。

9db5ff759528e0db2d3db43ec72ecd0bbd7a0b0a.src: FCAC’s guidance to try to use less than 30% of total limits is not a guaranteed scoring cliff or a reason to carry interest-bearing debt. 9ffed4aad19d3e94e19ea40fd9d53034e995180e.src: Finally, connect the investment to the spending plan. a0a8ffc951da9e47f0baa3814dd424599614d794.src: Hypothetical three-plan schedule with four equal quarters per purchase, zero interest and no fees. A starts at week zero; B starts after the selected gap and C after twice that gap. Each first instalment is immediate and the next three occur every two weeks. Payments are counted once, not alongside the full purchase price. All plans finish by week twelve. At each week’s start payments leave before the weekly cash surplus arrives at week-end; no surplus arrives at time zero. Equal quarters use unrounded arithmetic rather than reproducing an issuer’s cent allocation. Actual plans can have other terms. Negative points are unfunded needs, not approved overdrafts or an assumption that missed payments are accepted. No late fee, credit approval, refund, deferred-interest clause, new borrowing or cancelled payment is calculated.
a0a8ffc951da9e47f0baa3814dd424599614d794.zh: 假设的三计划时间表，每次购买四个相等的季度，零利息且不收取任何费用。 A 从第 0 周开始； B 在选定的间隙后开始，C 在该间隙的两倍后开始。每个第一期都是立即进行的，接下来的三期每两周发生一次。付款只计算一次，而不是与全额购买价格一起计算。所有计划均在第十二周完成。每周开始时，在周末现金盈余到达之前付款；零时没有剩余到达。等季度使用不四舍五入的算术，而不是复制发行人的美分分配。实际计划可以有其他条款。缺点是没有资金支持的需求、未批准的透支或假设接受错过的付款。不计算滞纳金、信贷审批、退款、延期利息条款、新借款或取消付款。

a0d4339e2c4869cf3c544852ec99f285a5be5fc7.src: Adjusted household disposable income includes an allocated value of in-kind goods and services. It supports a broader resource comparison, while household payments still require a separately defined cash ledger.

a0d4b2e5cbe215918234cb938b5787d184a482ec.src: Two fixed official-data graphics provide context; the household controls are separate hypothetical assumptions. Additional take-home pay is already net of payroll deductions. Care, commuting and work costs are incremental to the comparison baseline; lost income is other net household income that stops or falls, entered independently. All recurring changes apply for every selected full month, with the first month’s full pay received inside that month; no payroll delay is modeled. Setup is paid at time zero. Cumulative difference is relative to the same non-return baseline, not an actual bank balance. Setup recovery is the first nonnegative month inside the horizon; zero setup means month zero even if later cash change is negative. No subsidy, child-care deduction, income tax, benefit eligibility, pension accrual, career progression or non-financial value is calculated.
a0d4b2e5cbe215918234cb938b5787d184a482ec.zh: 两个固定的官方数据图表提供了背景信息；家庭控制是单独的假设。额外的实得工资已经扣除工资扣除额。护理、通勤和工作成本相对于比较基线而言是增量的；收入损失是指独立输入的停止或下降的其他家庭净收入。所有经常性变更适用于每个选定的完整月份，并在该月内收到第一个月的全额工资；没有对薪资延迟进行建模。安装费用在零时间支付。累积差异是相对于相同的非回报基准，而不是实际的银行余额。设置恢复是范围内的第一个非负月份；零设置意味着零月份，即使后来的现金变化为负。不计算补贴、儿童保育扣除、所得税、福利资格、养老金应计、职业发展或非财务价值。

a0d825efe1e5acf4863ce1bd5903ef6b6708b1d6.src: Hypothetical arithmetic, not a reverse-mortgage offer, approval, property appraisal or actual payout quote. One initial gross advance is borrowed; entered upfront costs and the listed old-debt payout are deducted from its proceeds and are not added to the new debt again. No further borrowing or regular repayments occur. The constant nominal annual rate is divided by 12 and interest capitalizes monthly; actual contract rates and compounding may differ. Home value changes at an independent assumed annual rate, and selling costs are a percentage of the modeled sale value. The debt balance is deliberately uncapped. A negative raw property remainder is an arithmetic gap before contractual protections, not a finding of personal or estate liability. No lender guarantee is calculated. Taxes, property upkeep, insurance, accrued post-due interest, other liens and the use of the cash advance are excluded.
a0d825efe1e5acf4863ce1bd5903ef6b6708b1d6.zh: 假设算术，不是反向抵押贷款要约、批准、财产评估或实际支付报价。借入一笔初始预付款；输入的前期成本和列出的旧债务支出将从其收益中扣除，并且不会再次添加到新债务中。不会再发生借贷或定期还款。固定名义年利率除以12，利息按月资本化；实际合同利率和复利可能有所不同。房屋价值以独立的假设年率变化，销售成本是模型销售价值的百分比。债务余额被故意设定为不上限。负原始财产剩余是合同保护之前的算术差距，而不是个人或遗产责任的认定。不计算贷款人担保。税费、财产维护费、保险费、应计逾期利息、其他留置权以及预付现金的使用均不包括在内。

a13c76a75b5636ceeed4d6e8f18500cf12fd354b.src: Twelve authored hypothetical monthly total returns; no historical index, financial crisis replay, forecast or probability. Selected path: Fast rebound. Returns are treated as already net of ongoing fund expenses, with income reinvested. Both strategies start with the same capital and receive the same month-end new cash. The timing rule makes at most one exit and one re-entry: after the current return and deposit, exit on the entered drawdown from the observed index peak; while out, earn the entered cash interest and re-enter at a later close when the index reaches the entered rise from the exit close. It participates in market returns again only in the next month. Exit month: 2; re-entry month: 3. Proportional trade costs are deducted at each switch; initial implementation and final liquidation costs are excluded for both. Cash is included even if re-entry never happens. Taxes, inflation, settlement delays and interest-rate changes are excluded. This monthly-close rule is not a stop order or a recommendation.
a13c76a75b5636ceeed4d6e8f18500cf12fd354b.zh: 十二位作者撰写了假设的每月总回报；没有历史指数、金融危机重演、预测或概率。选择路径：快速反弹。回报被视为已扣除持续基金支出，收入再投资。两种策略均以相同的资本开始，并获得相同的月末新现金。计时规则最多 1 次退出和 1 次再入场：当前收益和存款后，在观察到的指数峰值出现回撤时退出；退出时，赚取输入的现金利息，并​​在稍后收盘时，当指数达到退出收盘时输入的涨幅时重新进入。仅在下个月再次参与市场回报。退出月份：2；重新进入月份：3、每次切换按比例扣除交易费用；两者均不包括初始实施和最终清算费用。即使从未重新进入，现金也包含在内。税收、通货膨胀、结算延迟和利率变化不包括在内。此每月平仓规则并非止损单或建议。
