a0eb9cedc13989b943c20fa3eff9fb4f2f5a2fec.src: Two independently authored promotional contracts finance one purchase with identical on-time principal payments. The true-zero contract assesses no interest for the promotional months. The conditional contract records an unposted interest memo for each complete month, using that month’s OPENING purchase principal × annual quote ÷ 12, rounded to the nearest cent each month. The first payment occurs at the end of month one, not on the purchase date. Unposted memo interest does not itself earn interest. Each scheduled payment is capped at remaining principal and allocated entirely to this one purchase. After the last month-end payment, an additional selected whole percentage of the still-remaining purchase principal is received before a separate deadline assessment. If any principal remains, all memo interest is posted once; if principal is zero, the entire memo is waived. All minimum-payment and other conditions are assumed satisfied; there are no late fees, other purchases, payment-allocation conflicts, taxes or setup charges. This simplified monthly method is not a daily-interest reconstruction, APR disclosure, lender quote or universal contract rule. The endpoint is a debt balance, not a demand that the entire amount be paid immediately. No subsequent interest, repayment schedule, bank balance or source of the top-up cash is modeled.
a0eb9cedc13989b943c20fa3eff9fb4f2f5a2fec.zh: 两份独立撰写的促销合同为一笔购买提供相同的按时本金还款。真正的零合同在促销月份不收取任何利息。有条件合同记录每个完整月份的未过账利息备忘录，使用该月的开仓购买本金 × 年度报价 ÷ 12，四舍五入到每月最接近的美分。第一次付款发生在第一个月末，而不是购买日期。未过帐的备忘录利息本身并不赚取利息。每笔预定付款的上限为剩余本金，并完全分配给这一次购买。最后一次月末付款后，在单独的截止日期评估之前收到仍然剩余的购买本金的额外选定的全部百分比。如果有剩余本金，则所有备忘利息均过账一次；如果本金为零，则放弃整个备忘录。假设满足所有最低付款额和其他条件；没有滞纳金、其他购买、付款分配冲突、税费或安装费。这种简化的月度方法不是每日利息重建、年利率披露、贷款机构报价或通用合同规则。终点是债务余额，而不是要求立即支付全部金额。不会对后续利息、还款计划、银行余额或充值现金来源进行建模。

a16cfc7c8e1b264a60f29bfc9a495762a2a44a2a.src: Original hypothetical annual cash-budget reconciliation, with all amounts in one common price basis. It is a comparison of one working-year budget with one retirement-year budget, not a multi-year projection. Current deductions, take-home saving, ending work costs, ending debt payments and continuing cash needs are disjoint uses of gross pay. All four percentage inputs use current gross pay as their denominator. Current deductions exclude the saving entered separately. The residual continuing budget includes any debt service or work-related cost that will continue. The stated ending costs actually cease in this scenario, and the current saving transfer stops. Additional retirement spending is added to the continuing budget. Modeled retirement receipts are one assumed gross taxable cash stream with the same flat average tax fraction at every tested income. The tax fraction is an entered assumption, not a marginal tax bracket, a withholding rate or a calculation under current law. No pension entitlement, benefit reduction, payroll contribution rule, account-specific tax treatment, tax-free withdrawal, return of capital, spouse’s income, capital balance or withdrawal strategy is calculated. The gross ratio comparison first subtracts its assumed retirement tax, then compares net cash with spending. A positive difference is cash excess in this one-year budget, not proof that retirement is funded. Inflation between dates, longevity, changing spending phases, investment uncertainty, ongoing saving and large one-time costs require separate schedules. The input bounds keep the current continuing budget positive; the derived retirement gross ratio may exceed 100% and is not capped.
a16cfc7c8e1b264a60f29bfc9a495762a2a44a2a.zh: 最初假设的年度现金预算调节表，所有金额均以一个共同价格为基础。这是一个工作年预算与一个退休年预算的比较，而不是多年预测。当期扣除、实得储蓄、结束工作成本、结束债务支付和持续的现金需求是工资总额的不相干用途。所有四个百分比输入均使用当前总工资作为分母。当前扣除额不包括单独输入的储蓄。剩余持续预算包括任何将持续的偿债或与工作相关的成本。在这种情况下，规定的最终成本实际上停止了，当前的储蓄转移也停止了。额外的退休支出被添加到持续预算中。建模退休收入是一种假定的应税现金流总额，每项测试收入具有相同的平均税率。税率是输入的假设，而不是边际税级、预扣税率或现行法律下的计算结果。不计算养老金权利、福利减少、工资缴款规则、特定账户税收待遇、免税提款、资本返还、配偶收入、资本余额或提款策略。毛比率比较首先减去假定的退休税，然后将净现金与支出进行比较。一个积极的差异是一年预算中的现金过剩，而不是退休金得到资助的证据。日期之间的通货膨胀、寿命、不断变化的支出阶段、投资不确定性、持续储蓄和大量一次性成本需要单独的时间表。投入范围使当前持续预算保持正值；导出的退休总比率可能会超过 100%，并且没有上限。

a16d0e403d83dc799a2caf2ae617d97f2e6d4511.src: At the defaults, the ninety-day teaching numerator contains only A1 and B2: two of eight accounts, or 25%. a16d0e403d83dc799a2caf2ae617d97f2e6d4511.zh: 默认情况下，九十天教学分子仅包含 A1 和 B2：八个账户中的两个，即 25%。六十天账户分子还包括 B1，占八分之三，即 37.5%。分母是相同的八个账户；资格条件发生变化。

a16e992f4a7f4f2ccb97d7d4bbcbcdc153ccca23.src: All amounts are discounted to the election date. The same pension stream is assumed under both options. a1a3ebf0050161c03c6dc3062827c17f53d083c8.src: Changing a payment from a year-end to a year-start is a timing change, not a price-basis conversion. a1a81f956d76aece41cd199247ae07fe873162d2.src: Payment dates and prior repayments matter when an issuer determines the applicable amount. A plan can have a modest charge and still need a substantial amount of money before payday.
a17793411db0bc4fbcd68d4cbc33fb492d0757b1.zh: 存款首先会减少负账户余额，然后留下正现金。该模型不将透支视为自由储蓄，也不将其限额计为收入或假设利息支付会减少本金。计划的收费可能较低，但在发薪日前仍需要大量资金。

a180b4a9756fdcc4f078a4532c231868f5d6c8dc.src: The installment billed is the amount the provider asks for. It is a request, not a receipt. The cash paid is what actually reached the provider in the period. The running difference is cumulative charges minus cumulative cash paid. A positive value means charges recognized so far exceed cash paid so far; a negative value is a modeled credit.
a180b4a9756fdcc4f078a4532c231868f5d6c8dc.zh: 分期付款是提供商要求的金额。这是一个请求，而不是一个收据。 支付的现金是在此期间实际到达提供商的金额。 运行差异是累计费用减去累计支付的现金。正值意味着迄今为止确认的费用超过迄今为止支付的现金；负值是建模信用。

a187dda3135fbb6cf86d0daf20404d3c08ecbdc8.src: The comparison starts each alternative with CAD 50,000 and ends both after five years. There are no extra contributions or spending withdrawals.

a1bd85dfde08b3e1d07141585158a30e0ef9ab3e.src: That gap is not a bill sent by the issuer during the holding period. a1bd85dfde08b3e1d07141585158a30e0ef9ab3e.zh: 该缺口并非发行人在持有期间发出的票据。它是选定的未来资本目标与预期回报本金之间的差额。预留资金来填补它是一项单独的储蓄决策，会减少可用于其他支出的优惠券现金。

a1ca76ca8183f47164eec48ab0eec9f4b70b1642.src: The Canadian relationship bank is the anchor. Volume growth purchased through aggressive rates would be less valuable than growth from customers using several products. Watch the relation between loan growth, deposit growth, margin and acquisition costs, rather than declaring victory from any one volume measure.

a294bdf5304511507fd2b3bb7ba13986c4b2fe3d.src: For dispositions under the current rule, B generally includes one extra year when the taxpayer was resident in Canada in the year containing the acquisition date, plus the qualifying years when the property was designated as the principal residence and the taxpayer was resident. The Folio says “during” the acquisition year means at any time in that year, not necessarily throughout the year. If the taxpayer was not resident during that year, the formula does not give the extra year. The exact result also depends on the legal definition of the acquisition date and residence; the model uses user-entered year counts to make the arithmetic visible.
a294bdf5304511507fd2b3bb7ba13986c4b2fe3d.zh: 对于现行规则下的处置，B 通常包括纳税人在购买日期所在年份居住在加拿大的额外一年，加上该财产被指定为主要居所且纳税人为居民时的合格年份。 Folio 表示，“在收购年度期间”是指当年的任何时间，而不一定是全年。如果纳税人在那一年不是居民，则该公式不会给出额外的一年。确切的结果还取决于购买日期和居住地的法律定义；该模型使用用户输入的年份计数来使算术可见。

a3655c4bb8cb6905f8ab9a969441115e6c095c4e.src: One invented manufacturing company, one common year and perimeter; all amounts are CAD millions. Each operating balance change means closing minus opening. Fixed inputs: depreciation/amortization 25 and share compensation 10 already included in net income; total cash capex 45, opening cash 40, borrowing 20, debt principal paid 30 and dividends 25. Other expensed cash outlays are assumed paid within the year. No acquisitions, disposals, FX, write-offs, reclassifications, other accruals or omitted cash flows are modeled. Operating payables exclude debt and capex creditors. The controls form conditional reconciliations, not complete financial statements or actual company data. Noncash add-backs reverse profit expenses; they are not cash receipts or proof of no economic cost. Free cash flow here means operating cash minus total cash capex, not unrestricted discretionary cash, FCFF or FCFE. The maintenance split is only an analytical assumption and cannot change cash already spent. Negative closing cash is an unfunded plan, not an available overdraft. This manufacturer template is not intended for banks or insurers. Operating cash / positive net income is 100.00%; that ratio alone is not an earnings-quality score.
a3655c4bb8cb6905f8ab9a969441115e6c095c4e.zh: 一个发明的制造公司，一个共同的年份和周长；所有金额均为百万加元。每次营业余额变化意味着期末减去期初。固定投入：折旧/摊销 25 和股权补偿 10 已计入净利润；总现金资本支出 45，期初现金 40，借款 20，已付债务本金 30 和股息 25。其他支出现金支出假设在年内支付。没有对收购、处置、外汇、冲销、重新分类、其他应计费用或省略的现金流量进行建模。经营应付款项不包括债务和资本支出债权人。这些控制形成有条件的调节，而不是完整的财务报表或实际公司数据。非现金回加冲销利润费用；它们不是现金收据或无经济成本的证明。这里的自由现金流是指运营现金减去总现金资本支出，而不是不受限制的可自由支配现金、FCFF 或 FCFE。维护分割只是一个分析假设，不能改变已经花费的现金。负期末现金是一项无资金筹措的计划，而不是可用的透支。此制造商模板不适用于银行或保险公司。营业现金/净利润为100.00%；该比率本身并不是盈利质量得分。

a3a8886e68bd3c6802bd4a304dade0c826e274ed.src: The opening point is immediately before Day 1. The sale amount enters this bank ledger once, only on its assumed bank-receipt day; the bill leaves once on its entered day. A negative point is the earlier payment amount that still needs funding. At the defaults, receipt and the bill are both on Day 10, so receipt-first posting funds the bill. In that default case, adding one fictional closure shifts receipt to Day 11 and creates a CAD 3,000 earlier gap despite the same CAD 2,000 endpoint. Other household bills and receipts are outside this partial plan.
a3a8886e68bd3c6802bd4a304dade0c826e274ed.zh: 起始点紧接在第 1 天之前。销售金额仅在其假定的银行收据日进入此银行分类账一次；该账单在输入的日期离开一次。缺点是较早的付款金额仍需要资金。默认情况下，收据和账单均在第 10 天进行，因此收据优先过帐为账单提供资金。在这种默认情况下，添加一个虚构的关闭会将收货转移到第 11 天，并创建 3,000 加元的较早差距，尽管端点相同，但为 2,000 加元。其他家庭账单和收据不在此部分计划范围内。

a45366c4b0e927c1d0648faea20c2ea4728d3fcc.src: Original two-year mathematical comparison, with independently selected annual effective rates and CAD capital. The two-year path pays capital × (1 + two-year spot rate)² at year two. The rolling path earns the selected one-year rate in year one, then reinvests the full receipt at the selected year-two rate. Neither path permits interim withdrawals in this calculation. An implied forward is the rate that makes their terminal values equal, not a forecast, a tradable forward quote, a product promise or a current market observation. Any market-pricing interpretation requires comparable currency, credit risk, dates and conventions. No fees, tax, inflation, default, borrowing, early sale or later rate change is modeled. Negative year-two rates are hypothetical value-decline stresses, not an available deposit quote.
a45366c4b0e927c1d0648faea20c2ea4728d3fcc.zh: 独创的两年数学比较，独立选择年有效利率和加元资本。两年期路径在第二年支付资本 × (1 + 两年期即期汇率)²。滚动路径在第一年赚取选定的一年期利率，然后以选定的第二年利率将全额收益再投资。在此计算中，两种路径均不允许临时提款。隐含远期是使它们的终值相等的利率，而不是预测、可交易远期报价、产品承诺或当前市场观察。任何市场定价解释都需要可比较的货币、信用风险、日期和惯例。没有对费用、税收、通货膨胀、违约、借款、提前出售或后期利率变化进行建模。第二年负利率是假设的价值下降压力，而不是可用的存款报价。

a5417dc82016e7873da93ea493fcbfffb82a9465.src: With monthly account rate r and n contributions, the accumulated value of one dollar contributed at each month-end is ((1 + r)n − 1) ÷ r. The required monthly transfer is the remaining future funding need divided by that factor. When the account return is zero, the factor is simply n. If starting funds alone already cover the modeled goal, the required new contribution is zero.
a5417dc82016e7873da93ea493fcbfffb82a9465.zh: 根据每月账户利率 r 和 n 供款，每个月底供款的 1 美元的累计价值为 ((1 + r)n − 1) ÷ r。所需的每月转账是剩余的未来资金需求除以该系数。当账户收益为零时，该因子就是n。如果仅启动资金就已涵盖建模目标，则所需的新缴款为零。

a4bd59aa0e6ca9dd08c32ffd6176ef5789859213.src: Statistics Canada’s annual DHEA table includes both household disposable income and adjusted household disposable income. The adjustment adds social transfers in kind: an allocated value of goods and services financed by governments and non-profit institutions serving households.
a4bd59aa0e6ca9dd08c32ffd6176ef5789859213.zh: 加拿大统计局的年度 DHEA 表包括家庭可支配收入和调整后的家庭收入可支配收入。此次调整增加了实物社会转移：由政府和为家庭服务的非营利机构资助的商品和服务的分配价值。

a4bdb2793bc6420debf0711ea86de06a5e4565e5.src: All three paths use identical starting capital, deposits, scaling, thresholds, cash interest and trade costs. They were authored to expose different tradeoffs and are not a representative backtest. No occurrence probability or expected advantage can be inferred from three examples.
a4bdb2793bc6420debf0711ea86de06a5e4565e5.zh: 所有三种路径都使用相同的启动资本、存款、规模、门槛、现金利息和交易成本。它们的目的是揭示不同的权衡，并不是具有代表性的回测。从三个示例中无法推断出发生概率或预期优势。

a4bfe31cdfc7f027d3c7596c1eba77767e40bcdf.src: Document the net saving cost, how the tax relief will be funded and used, and a plausible range for future withdrawal tax. Then compare the result with the goal’s timing and liquidity requirements. A transparent comparison helps identify the variables that need review; the largest gross balance alone does not settle the account decision.
a4bfe31cdfc7f027d3c7596c1eba77767e40bcdf.zh: 记录净节省成本、税收减免将如何提供资金和使用，以及未来提款税的合理范围。然后将结果与目标的时间安排和流动性要求进行比较。透明的比较有助于识别需要审查的变量；最大的总余额本身并不能解决账户决策。

a5aa3db8b316f2cf87dbabe6a74c10ec4bc93639.src: Raising the entered cap beyond CAD 750 cannot increase the default eligible payment because there is no more modeled eligible cost left to fund. Likewise, if the deductible reaches or exceeds the repair cost, the modeled payment becomes zero. A large number printed as a limit is not automatically a large economic benefit.
a5aa3db8b316f2cf87dbabe6a74c10ec4bc93639.zh: 将输入的上限提高到 750 加元以上并不能增加默认的合格付款，因为没有更多的建模合格成本可供资助。同样，如果免赔额达到或超过维修成本，则模型付款将变为零。作为限额打印的大量数字并不自动带来巨大的经济效益。

a5ae4f9dc70b1c06805e0714983e11054dc17f13.src: Uses the official CPP adjustment factors of 0.6% per month before 65 and 0.7% per month after 65, applied to an assumed common age-65 amount. CAD amounts are hypothetical, not maximum or average benefits.
a5ae4f9dc70b1c06805e0714983e11054dc17f13.zh: 使用官方 CPP 调整系数，65 岁之前每月 0.6%，65 岁之后每月 0.7%，适用于假定的常见 65 岁金额。加元金额为假设值，并非最大或平均收益。

a5afb151271d96a5955e752083d88445b3ab747c.src: A policy review can change the relevant inputs. Updated measurements, renovations, materials, local labour conditions and the contract’s actual replacement provisions need to be reflected in a fresh assessment rather than assumed away by a smooth curve.
a5afb151271d96a5955e752083d88445b3ab747c.zh: 政策审查可以更改相关输入。更新的测量、装修、材料、当地劳动条件以及合同的实际更换条款需要反映在新的评估中，而不是通过平滑曲线来假设。

a5b0a7de6813d52517248bc4deb1b93de4a25508.src: Use the person counts to reconstruct the two denominators
a5b0a7de6813d52517248bc4deb1b93de4a25508.zh: 使用人数来重建两个分母

a5b3704c995fc9e195afebe4bc0fbce673ac5825.src: Compare hypothetical cashable and locked deposits at the same end date, fund the same earlier bill and reconcile the interest cost of a separately assumed bridge loan.
a5b3704c995fc9e195afebe4bc0fbce673ac5825.zh: 比较同一结束日期的假设可兑现和锁定存款，为相同的早期账单提供资金，并调节单独假设的过桥贷款的利息成本。

a5b6668e6080419e443a580ea5a29a308000b037.src: The control preserves a common set of categories across all three charts. Expanding to ten reveals more of the source’s loss ranking; it does not turn the selection into the entire reporting system. The selection is by dollar loss, so it should not be presented as the ten most frequent categories or as a ranking of how likely one household is to encounter each type.
a5b6668e6080419e443a580ea5a29a308000b037.zh: 该控件在所有三个图表中保留一组通用的类别。扩展到 10 个可以揭示更多来源的损失排名；它不会将选择转化为整个报告系统。该选择是根据美元损失进行的，因此不应将其呈现为十个最常见的类别，也不应呈现为一个家庭遇到每种类型的可能性的排名。

a5b8e040fe4ff7d3b63c24a0deb616ab14770946.src: A requested gift may exceed the funds left at its payment date data
a5b8e040fe4ff7d3b63c24a0deb616ab14770946.zh: 请求的礼物可能超出其付款日期时剩余的资金数据

a5b97bd3e08468739019ba739475014ff5a08bff.src: Reviewed 25 October 2026 for entry/exit denominator definitions, the distinction from the official poverty-line indicator and publication coverage. The hub states that 2023/2024 transitions are expected in spring 2027. Its rounded headline person totals are not substituted for the original CSV counts used here.
a5b97bd3e08468739019ba739475014ff5a08bff.zh: 于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查了进入/退出分母定义、与官方贫困线指标的区别以及出版物报道。该中心表示，预计 2023/2024 年的过渡将于 2027 年春季进行。其四舍五入的标题人数总数不会取代此处使用的原始 CSV 计数。

a5bcc37b06c0029c3adfe3130f4524ebe98d1a17.src: Subtracting CAD 150 from the CAD 275 of cash avoided leaves CAD 125 of positive comparison value under these assumptions. The last step is an opportunity-value deduction, not another cash payment. It does not establish that the points could actually be sold or redeemed for CAD 150 in cash.
a5bcc37b06c0029c3adfe3130f4524ebe98d1a17.zh: 从避免的现金 275 加元中减去 150 加元，在这些假设下留下125 加元正比较值。最后一步是机会价值扣除，而不是另一笔现金支付。它并不表明这些积分实际上可以出售或兑换为 150 加元的现金。

a5bedef999480e5a2f5129a52d5063a45356296a.src: Return adjustment applied only to omitted records (percentage points)
a5bedef999480e5a2f5129a52d5063a45356296a.zh: 退货调整仅适用于省略的记录（百分比）

a5c0bf4574a27ddc2b1a5d4d043380a34a061596.src: The retained life-table extract ends at age 100. Its survival shares are still positive there. The plot therefore stops because the selected data stop; it does not say everyone has died by that age. The article does not calculate a joint life expectancy from this truncated extract.
a5c0bf4574a27ddc2b1a5d4d043380a34a061596.zh: 保留的记录生命表提取到 100 岁结束。此时其生存份额仍然为正。由于所选数据停止，绘图因此停止；它并没有说每个人都在那个年龄去世了。本文不会根据此截断的摘录计算联合预期寿命。

a5c1673d9e21be88d7806679eb155a5eaaf6e107.src: Actual quotes can have different deposits, fees, cancellation terms or payment dates. Those details matter. The model uses twelve equal month-end bills and no initial deposit. It does not reproduce an insurer’s payment plan, and the invented surcharge should not be read as a typical charge. Confirm the all-in annual amount and every instalment before comparing real alternatives.
a5c1673d9e21be88d7806679eb155a5eaaf6e107.zh: 实际报价可能有不同的押金、费用、取消条款或付款日期。这些细节很重要。该模型使用十二张等额月末账单，并且没有初始存款。它不会复制保险公司的付款计划，并且所发明的附加费不应被视为典型费用。在比较真正的替代方案之前，请确认每年的总金额和每期分期付款。

a5c192039be80da5c1a138dbf9be14599bd76fa0.src: It also does not supply uncertainty around the derived survivor ratios. The article therefore shows no invented confidence band around that curve, and it does not reuse the expectation’s margin for a different statistic. The displayed source counts are rounded, so derived ratios should not be treated as exact personal probabilities.
a5c192039be80da5c1a138dbf9be14599bd76fa0.zh: 它也不提供衍生的幸存者比率的不确定性。因此，该文章没有显示该曲线周围的任何发明置信带，并且它没有将期望边际重新用于不同的统计数据。显示的来源计数已四舍五入，因此得出的比率不应被视为精确的个人概率。

a5c25ce5f0eaa408d16723264d16f895bd3b2b92.src: At the fictional 7% nominal annual rate over seventy-two months, the CAD 43,000 loan requires an unrounded monthly payment of about CAD 733.11 when displayed to cents. The model divides the annual rate by twelve and assumes equal month-end payments, with no balloon or payment holiday.
a5c25ce5f0eaa408d16723264d16f895bd3b2b92.zh: 按照 72 个月的虚构 7% 名义年利率，43,000 加元的贷款需要每月支付约 733.11 加元的未四舍五入金额（以美分显示）。该模型将年费率除以 12，并假设月末付款相等，没有气球或付款假期。

a5c3274ff78dcf12cc8bea9ac1e02744c71d0589.src: The matrix varies full waiting months and the number of insurance payments. Each cell is additional starting cash after the selected reserve, calculated across the same household schedule. Temporary pay, ongoing income, spending and the initial cost remain unchanged.
a5c3274ff78dcf12cc8bea9ac1e02744c71d0589.zh: 该矩阵会改变完整的等待月份和保险付款数量。每个单元格是选定储备之后的额外起始现金，根据同一家庭时间表计算。临时工资、持续收入、支出和初始成本保持不变。

a5c6035eec4a5a870063139cf73d9585f75406da.src: Reconcile a reduced-income month without cutting the entered food amount
a5c6035eec4a5a870063139cf73d9585f75406da.zh: 在不减少输入食物数量的情况下调节收入减少的月份

a5c616520df8faa223176547302ea1e3d04c803e.src: Page dated 15 October 2025; reviewed 25 October 2026. General eligibility, fees, accumulating interest, retained ownership and repayment context. No current lender rate, approved amount or compounding schedule is supplied by the charts.
a5c616520df8faa223176547302ea1e3d04c803e.zh: 2025 年 10 月 15 日的页面；审核日期：2026 年 10 月 25 日。一般资格、费用、累积利息、保留所有权和还款背景。图表中未提供当前贷款利率、批准金额或复利时间表。

a5caecdda7cd034c5d7261e989dca39393111f52.src: This example specifies CAD 20,000 of annual spending in today’s purchasing power for ten years. The first payment occurs one year from now. Prices are assumed to rise by 2% every year, and the independently selected nominal discount rate is 5% annually.
a5caecdda7cd034c5d7261e989dca39393111f52.zh: 此示例指定十年内按当今购买力计算的年度支出为 20,000 加元。第一次付款发生在一年后。假设价格每年上涨2%，独立选择的名义折现率为每年5%。

a5cb0d5295d0466a2b3acfc91d17bd5d5a3dcf82.src: Maturity capital reflects the earlier spending choice
a5cb0d5295d0466a2b3acfc91d17bd5d5a3dcf82.zh: 到期资本反映了早期的支出选择

a5cb167469d8823ae69bf67ce1af00b6a1a33c90.src: Financial planning · Renovation cash flow · 4 charts + interactive scenarios
a5cb167469d8823ae69bf67ce1af00b6a1a33c90.zh: 财务规划·装修现金流·4张图表+互动场景

a5cdc90fafa2053e697e962ac4760d0cf8ed4cbf.src: Recheck the reserve against both the annual assumption and the number of years
a5cdc90fafa2053e697e962ac4760d0cf8ed4cbf.zh: 根据年度假设和年数重新检查准备金

a5cfbc3c408d915e57a14f5d234a3686751785ff.src: The minimum constant budget for the deadline-first rule is the largest cumulative amount due divided by its deadline month. The default checks are CAD 500, CAD 750 and CAD 1,000 per month. The binding figure is CAD 1,000, assuming saving can begin now and funds can be earmarked early without restrictions.
a5cfbc3c408d915e57a14f5d234a3686751785ff.zh: 截止日期优先规则的最小恒定预算是最大累计应付金额除以截止日期月份。默认支票为每月 500 加元、750 加元和 1,000 加元。约束数字为 1,000 加元，假设现在就可以开始储蓄，并且可以不受限制地提前指定资金。

a5d075f06c36abeaf3fb3268a487f6d8c00c5833.src: Use the matrix to check the pace against the starting headroom
a5d075f06c36abeaf3fb3268a487f6d8c00c5833.zh: 使用矩阵根据起始空间检查进度

a5d16ea83c75ebd93bfaaf0de468012f42291f1b.src: Official estimator for personalized OAS timing and amount scenarios; assumptions and eligibility should be confirmed with Service Canada.
a5d16ea83c75ebd93bfaaf0de468012f42291f1b.zh: 个性化 OAS 时间和金额方案的官方估算器；假设和资格应与加拿大服务部确认。

a5d357051b7d1beb77fe3aed00d1b6a2b0e68c92.src: Real cash discounted at the matching real rate
a5d357051b7d1beb77fe3aed00d1b6a2b0e68c92.zh: 实际现金按匹配的实际利率贴现

a5d5f12662e0c165ba1d407c9d97677226daf305.src: A coupon bond can be quoted at a price that excludes interest accrued since its preceding coupon date. A purchase cash requirement can therefore exceed the amount obtained by simply multiplying that quote by the face holding.
a5d5f12662e0c165ba1d407c9d97677226daf305.zh: 息票债券可以按不含利息的价格报价自前一个息票日期起累积。因此，购买现金要求可能会超出简单地将报价乘以持有量所获得的金额。

a5d60d86a0db51544859d20491d472f39adfe657.src: Other obligations reduce the mortgage payment room within the references · CAD
a5d60d86a0db51544859d20491d472f39adfe657.zh: 其他义务会减少参考 · CAD 内的抵押贷款还款空间

a5d791728fbaba6e006a787f243b4d197291068d.src: Effective annual interest on waiting cash (%)
a5d791728fbaba6e006a787f243b4d197291068d.zh: 等待现金的有效年利息 (%)

a5db1da942054ef6504ac633e9247e415afc964a.src: Weight the energy prices by actual use instead of averaging the rate labels
a5db1da942054ef6504ac633e9247e415afc964a.zh: 按实际使用情况衡量能源价格，而不是对费率标签进行平均

a5db8a75db428871cc13edc45dde1e45e5c28c78.src: This is a monthly run-rate budget, not a bank-account ledger. It does not test whether income arrives before a payment within the month. Nor does it include new borrowing, loan fees, tax changes, refinancing, unemployment or a change in the selected fixed rate. Those require separate assumptions and, for a real loan, the actual agreement.
a5db8a75db428871cc13edc45dde1e45e5c28c78.zh: 这是每月的运行预算，而不是银行账户分类账。它不会测试收入是否在当月付款之前到达。也不包括新借款、贷款费用、税收变化、再融资、失业或所选固定利率的变化。这些需要单独的假设，对于真实的贷款，需要实际的协议。

a5de0a881a47ab3a8c57aa18168ebe8e4e12655f.zh: 第五年价格 + 未投资股息216.11 加元

a5e1a74408ce293004ed22c6c11b364783f77cc0.src: CAD contribution-capacity arithmetic for the proposal
a5e1a74408ce293004ed22c6c11b364783f77cc0.zh: 提案的加元贡献容量算法

a5e597bd103a6c8326eb8ee31c09587cc8901eb5.src: Net cash from selling the old item now if replacing (CAD)
a5e597bd103a6c8326eb8ee31c09587cc8901eb5.zh: 如果更换，现在出售旧物品的净现金（加元）

a5e5eca69b1caa86ce6c13a59d27f40965246a9e.src: Loss at the start of this month; later than deadline means no loss
a5e5eca69b1caa86ce6c13a59d27f40965246a9e.zh: 本月初的损失；晚于截止日期意味着没有损失

a5e9afce1d968a3fa96ba78d196f5c44401e9790.src: Its numerator is the seasonally adjusted stock of credit-market debt. Its denominator is household disposable income at a seasonally adjusted annual rate. For the latest quarter, those amounts are CAD 3,280,888 million and CAD 1,860,216 million. The calculation is 100 × 3,280,888 ÷ 1,860,216 = about 176.3713%, which rounds to the published 176.37%.
a5e9afce1d968a3fa96ba78d196f5c44401e9790.zh: 其分子是季节性调整后的信贷市场债务存量。其分母是按季节调整后的年率计算的家庭可支配收入。最新季度的金额分别为 32,808.88 亿加元和 18,602.16 亿加元。计算结果为100 × 3,280,888 ÷ 1,860,216 = 约 176.3713%，四舍五入为公布的 176.37%。

a5ea11d1c0f170303ee26c7da000c71e948e8188.src: Read unmet spending beside the remaining portfolio
a5ea11d1c0f170303ee26c7da000c71e948e8188.zh: 在剩余投资组合旁边阅读未满足的支出

a5f14523273f0d6e1119ca3ecc92ae82481e1e1c.src: Add the costs that tuition does not cover
a5f14523273f0d6e1119ca3ecc92ae82481e1e1c.zh: 添加学费所产生的费用不包括

a5f365bce3c5c9fa078cad48c39747643180a81d.src: Real cards can use daily calculations and several balance categories. Fees, grace periods, cash advances, promotional terms and payment dates can change results. This example deliberately uses one rate bucket. It does not reproduce a statement, determine a legally required minimum or model the consequences of a missed payment.
a5f365bce3c5c9fa078cad48c39747643180a81d.zh: 真实卡可以使用日常计算和多个余额类别。费用、宽限期、预付现金、促销条款和付款日期可能会改变结果。此示例特意使用一个速率桶。它不会复制声明、确定法律要求的最低金额或模拟错过付款的后果。

a5f3f50a5307e21d455a211d58ffe371babc3a18.src: Financial Consumer Agency of Canada · Down payments and mortgage loan insurance ↗
a5f3f50a5307e21d455a211d58ffe371babc3a18.zh: 加拿大金融消费者管理局 · 首付和抵押贷款保险 ↗

a5f974caeae6adb5753aff185238ec21f938fc57.src: Four future payments at current rate assumed
a5f974caeae6adb5753aff185238ec21f938fc57.zh: 假定按当前利率计算的四笔未来付款

a5fc12e005ae1ee7a20d4fb96ca80abbc2521a06.src: Property taxes, home insurance, condominium charges, repairs and utilities remain outside the payment calculation. A reserve for these costs can be necessary even when the mortgage payment itself fits. The emergency-fund guide provides a separate way to model an income interruption; mortgage affordability alone does not measure that resilience.
a5fc12e005ae1ee7a20d4fb96ca80abbc2521a06.zh: 财产税、家庭保险、公寓费用、维修和水电费不在付款计算范围内。即使抵押贷款还款本身合适，也可能需要为这些费用预留准备金。应急基金指南提供了一种单独的方法来模拟收入中断；仅靠抵押贷款负担能力并不能衡量这种弹性。

a600940509d7b724f7b75277c72a7aa57ad94fe4.src: This model excludes the initial purchase, down payment, land-transfer costs, selling costs, changes in property value and return on the owner’s invested capital. It therefore does not calculate a property investment return or establish whether purchasing a rental is attractive. It also excludes shared ownership, personal-use portions and short-term-rental-specific rules.
a600940509d7b724f7b75277c72a7aa57ad94fe4.zh: 该模型不包括初始购买、首付、土地转让成本、销售成本、房产价值变化和业主投资资本回报率。因此，它不会计算房地产投资回报或确定购买租金是否有吸引力。它还不包括共享所有权、个人使用部分和短期租赁特定规则。

a60282b16749703c58190796aaf924f4491c3312.src: Reconcile the change with entrants and exits measured in people
a60282b16749703c58190796aaf924f4491c3312.zh: 以人数来衡量进入和退出的变化

a609a53b741f20a823e563ac609edb49fda9d01d.src: CAD owed immediately after assessment · not a monthly payment quote
a609a53b741f20a823e563ac609edb49fda9d01d.zh: 评估后立即欠下的加元·而不是每月付款报价

a60b3042eb0f9a4e4b6313e8e048353e856a6ea2.src: Plan counts and active-member counts describe different quantities. Their dates, units and classifications must be clear before the numbers can inform a planning question.
a60b3042eb0f9a4e4b6313e8e048353e856a6ea2.zh: 计划计数和活跃会员计数描述了不同的数量。在这些数字能够为规划问题提供信息之前，它们的日期、单位和分类必须清楚。

a611be7211e7697471c205445e5ca6c7e4cbeca6.src: Simplified allocation of accounting earnings. Retained earnings are not a separate cash account; actual cash capacity depends on cash flow and financing.

a7784e1e58cebe17d87d47dd4828b286801b0d34.src: Our valuation test separates business progress from the return available to a new shareholder. Faster profit growth can coexist with a disappointing share return if the starting multiple already capitalizes the improvement. A book-value cross-check makes that burden visible: with 4% perpetual growth and a 9.5% equity cost, the observed book multiple implies a sustainable ROE of approximately 15.5%. Raising the equity cost to 10% increases the required ROE to approximately 16.6%. These are stylized steady-state inferences, not price targets.
a7784e1e58cebe17d87d47dd4828b286801b0d34.zh: 我们的估值测试将业务进展与新股东可获得的回报分开。如果起始市盈率已经充分利用了这一改善，则更快的利润增长可能与令人失望的股票回报共存。账面价值交叉检查使这一负担变得显而易见：在 4% 的永久增长率和 9.5% 的股权成本下，观察到的账面倍数意味着可持续的 ROE 约为 15.5%。将股权成本提高到 10% 会使所需的 ROE 增加到大约 16.6%。这些是程式化的稳态推论，而不是价格目标。

a837aeaca539d0dfeb4b6535d903608c1c48259a.src: A repurchase above common book can improve EPS while reducing book per remaining share relative to retaining the cash. That arithmetic does not make it inherently poor allocation. The key question is whether the return offered by the repurchased earnings stream exceeds the return on alternative uses after allowing for risk. A high spot multiple makes that question more demanding.
a837aeaca539d0dfeb4b6535d903608c1c48259a.zh: 高于普通账本的回购可以提高每股收益，同时减少相对于保留现金的剩余每股账面价值。该算术并不意味着它本质上是糟糕的分配。关键问题是，在考虑风险后，回购收益流提供的回报是否超过替代用途的回报。高倍数使得这个问题变得更加困难。

a838584c72f350410070c091e41b909684e31da9.src: The cells are alternative calculations, not forecasts of rates or approval. An entered cash rate above the borrowing rate can even produce negative net carrying cost for the immediate schedule. That is a mathematical consequence of the assumptions, rather than evidence that such an arrangement is available, permitted or attractive after tax and other costs.
a838584c72f350410070c091e41b909684e31da9.zh: 这些单元格是替代计算，而不是利率或批准的预测。输入的现金利率高于借款利率甚至可能会在当前进度中产生负的净账面成本。这是假设的数学结果，而不是证据表明这种安排在税后和其他成本后是可行的、允许的或有吸引力的。

a946a8d476323f3d96818369d97044fd1491aeb2.src: Original hypothetical CAD snapshot applying CDIC public guidance reviewed 25 October 2026. X and Y are assumed genuinely distinct CDIC member institutions. A, B and C are abstract owner labels, not clients. Every entered balance is independently assumed an eligible non-registered joint deposit, including principal and accrued interest through one common observation date. Member records are assumed to state joint ownership and retain every owner’s name and address. The same owner set at the same member is combined before a CAD 100,000 limit is applied, regardless of account count or owner display order. Balances are rounded to cents before aggregation. This illustration verifies no real eligibility, legal ownership, member identity, records or actual reimbursement. Trust/nominee arrangements, other categories, provincial insurance, future interest, currency conversion, tax and estate consequences are excluded. An amount above a modeled limit is not a predicted loss; a within-limit amount is not cash available today. Editing amounts changes no assumed ownership or member identity.
a946a8d476323f3d96818369d97044fd1491aeb2.zh: 应用 CDIC 公共指导的原始假设 CAD 快照已于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审核。X 和 Y 被假定为真正不同的 CDIC 成员机构。 A、B 和 C 是抽象的所有者标签，而不是客户。每一项输入的余额均独立假定为合格的非注册联合存款，包括在一个共同观察日期的本金和应计利息。假设会员记录表明共同所有权并保留每个所有者的姓名和地址。在应用 100,000 加元限制之前，对同一成员设置的相同所有者会合并，无论帐户数量或所有者显示顺序如何。汇总前余额四舍五入为美分。此插图无法验证真正的资格、合法所有权、会员身份、记录或实际报销。信托/代理人安排、其他类别、省级保险、未来利息、货币兑换、税收和遗产后果不包括在内。高于模型限制的金额并非预测损失；今天无法使用限额内的现金。编辑金额不会更改假定的所有权或成员身份。

a9f256dcd992d5696f12d9ab9674dc9a54721583.src: Ordinary single lump-sum RRSP request for a Canadian resident outside Quebec, using CRA withholding rates reviewed 25 October 2026. The applicable 10%, 20% or 30% applies to the entire gross request, not marginal bands. Withholding is rounded to cents for this illustration. Fee is paid separately and applies only to a positive withdrawal. A fee larger than available proceeds creates a cash need, not a negative institutional payout. The final-tax input is an independent assumed effective incremental rate on the whole withdrawal, not an actual bracket or tax-return calculation. A negative settlement means excess withholding under that assumption, not an approved refund or arrival date. Quebec, non-residents, spousal attribution, registered-plan programs, series/aggregation rules, benefit reductions and fee deductibility are outside this model.

a9f2c0ba1307ebf7d40278238961126e2d54b5c4.src: Hypothetical total covered dwelling loss at the selected future date, not an insurance quotation, valuation or claim determination. Actual policy wording may apply limits and deductibles differently. No guaranteed/extended replacement provision, coinsurance, exclusions, bylaw costs, contents, land, additional living expenses, claim delay or future premium is modeled. The reserve is immediately available and earns no interest.
a9f2c0ba1307ebf7d40278238961126e2d54b5c4.zh: 在选定的未来日期假设的承保住房损失总额，而不是保险报价、估价或索赔确定。市场价值仅是上下文，永远不会进入支付。重建成本和覆盖范围限制在单独的恒定假设下增长。教学合同首先将承保费用限制在规定的限额内，然后减去固定免赔额，底线支出为零。实际的保单措辞可能会以不同的方式应用限制和免赔额。没有对保证/延长的更换条款、共同保险、排除、附例成本、内容、土地、额外生活费用、索赔延迟或未来保费进行建模。储备金可立即使用，且不赚取利息。

aa8bfb87fb30e36265010eeb9017b41a7faad0ab.src: Original hypothetical instalment-loan illustration, not a lender quote or a Canadian mortgage calculator. Six month-end payments are made before the agreed pause begins in month 7. Interest each month equals outstanding original principal times the entered nominal annual rate divided by 12. During the pause, no cash is paid and interest is recorded separately. No interest is ever charged on that deferred-interest balance, during or after the pause. Once payments resume, they pay current interest first, then deferred interest, then original principal. One path resumes the original payment; another solves a higher payment to clear both balances by the original final month. The final payment is limited to the amount owed. All payments are assumed affordable and made when due. The agreement, allocation rule and continuing exemption from interest on deferred interest are model assumptions, not a statement that every relief arrangement uses them. There are no fees, rate changes, insurance, property taxes, rounding to cents, tax effects, eligibility tests, credit-reporting results or household savings returns. Lower payments during the pause are temporary cash relief, not income or debt forgiveness.
aa8bfb87fb30e36265010eeb9017b41a7faad0ab.zh: 原始假设分期贷款插图，不是贷款机构报价或加拿大抵押贷款计算器。在第 7 个月开始商定的暂停之前，需支付六个月的月末付款。每月利息等于未偿还的原始本金乘以输入的名义年利率除以 12。在暂停期间，不支付现金，利息单独记录。在暂停期间或暂停之后，不会对该递延利息余额收取任何利息。一旦恢复付款，他们首先支付当前利息，然后支付递延利息，然后支付原始本金。一种路径恢复原始付款；另一种解决方案是支付更高的费用，以便在最初的最后一个月之前结清这两个余额。最终付款仅限于所欠金额。所有付款均假定为负担得起并按时支付。协议、分配规则和递延利息利息的持续豁免是模型假设，而不是每个救济安排都使用它们的声明。没有费用、利率变化、保险、财产税、四舍五入到美分、税收影响、资格测试、信用报告结果或家庭储蓄回报。暂停期间减少付款是暂时的现金减免，而不是收入或债务减免。

adb49171725ec9b0a9b3ae2f87deb7b0e2527d65.src: Original hypothetical 18-month cash ledger. Immediate transition costs are paid at time zero. All monthly receipts arrive at the start of their labeled month, before that month’s spending. Continuing net income remains throughout; new net earnings are additional. Temporary support begins after the entered full delay, lasts at most the entered payment count and stops when new earnings start. There is no catch-up payment for delayed months. One net settlement is received in its independently entered month regardless of work status. The spending reduction applies only before new earnings begin and cannot make spending negative. Accessible cash earns zero. No EI eligibility, statutory amount, waiting period, severance allocation, tax, benefit coordination, legal entitlement, credit facility or investment sale is calculated. Negative cash represents an unfunded requirement, not a permitted overdraft.
adb49171725ec9b0a9b3ae2f87deb7b0e2527d65.zh: 原始假设的 18 个月现金分类账。即时过渡成本在零时间支付。所有每月收据均在标记月份开始时到达，即该月支出之前。持续的净利润始终保持不变；新的净利润是额外的。临时支持在输入的完全延迟后开始，最多持续输入的付款计数，并在新收入开始时停止。延迟几个月没有补缴费用。无论工作状态如何，都会在其独立输入的月份收到一笔净结算。支出削减仅适用于新收入开始之前，并且不会导致支出为负数。可获得的现金收入为零。不计算 EI 资格、法定金额、等待期、遣散费分配、税收、福利协调、法定权利、信贷便利或投资销售。负现金代表无资金要求，而不是允许的透支。

adb7cda4e0e0daf1347e16afa27a2885ac82fa20.src: The final date remains fixed. A twelve-purchase case is not allowed twelve extra months beyond the three-purchase case. Likewise, increasing the purchase count does not add more initial capital. It divides the same original sum into smaller transfers. With a one-purchase schedule, the two modeled paths are identical; this is an accounting check rather than an investment conclusion.
adb7cda4e0e0daf1347e16afa27a2885ac82fa20.zh: 最终日期保持不变。十二次购买案例不得比三次购买案例多十二个月。同样，增加购买数量并不会增加更多的初始资本。它将相同的原始金额分成较小的转账。对于一次性购买计划，两条建模路径是相同的；这是会计检查而不是投资结论。

Annual all-in cost is the reference estimate times the selected change. Authored seasonal weights sum to twelve and allocate that cost across months; they are not measured weather, electricity use or prices. Twelve selected instalments remain fixed; no provider review is simulated. Reserve saving arrives at each month-end, including month twelve, before an assumed settlement after all twelve instalments. Positive provider balance is an extra charge; negative balance is a credit retained on the provider ledger. A credit is never added to household cash as a refund. The household reserve is separate cash, earns zero and funds only a positive extra charge. No opening provider balance, missed payments, interest, late fees, tariffs, rebates or costs outside the entered all-in total are modeled.

98a3eb78bf5bbd09f5a0c88791abda3758344eb3.src: Hypothetical twelve-month household exercise in nominal CAD, using authored investment returns, not crisis observations or a fund forecast. Selected path: Decline and rebound. Each month applies the investment return, receives income, pays essential spending, sells available investment only if cash cannot fund that spending, records any remaining unfunded expense, and then transfers at most the desired amount from cash above the selected floor. The comparison uses the identical order with a zero cash floor. Both start with identical separate cash/investment balances and have identical income and required spending. The floor restricts new purchases; it does not stop cash being used for essentials or guarantee the floor is maintained. No borrowing, tax, fees, cash interest, inflation or settlement delay is modeled. Unfunded essentials: selected-floor rule $0.00; zero-floor rule $0.00. Unpaid spending is a shortfall, not a successful budget.

af401cb28a1c9938b509fd68f12feccfe827152d.src: Original hypothetical six-month business cash plan, not financial statements or a salary/dividend/tax calculation. A batch is purchased for cash at the start of month one; half is delivered and invoiced at the start of month two. That half’s original cost is recognized once as cost of goods sold; the remaining half stays at original cost, without a market valuation or impairment assessment. One operating expense is recognized and paid alongside the sale. The whole customer invoice is assumed collected after opening expenses in its entered month. The one owner withdrawal follows any same-month collection and is a transfer, not an operating expense. Other months have no new sales or operating costs. Negative requested cash balances are unmet funding requirements, not approved overdrafts or completed unfunded payments. The separately shown opening top-up is the amount that would be needed from outside owner cash before events begin; its availability is not assumed proven. No supplier credit, loans, interest, bad debts, inventory resale, sales tax or income tax is modeled. End-of-month and ordered-event views retain different timing detail.
af401cb28a1c9938b509fd68f12feccfe827152d.zh: 原始假设的六个月商业现金计划，而不是财务报表或工资/股息/税收计算。在第一个月开始时以现金购买一批；一半在第二个月开始时交付并开具发票。这一半的原始成本一次性确认为销售成本；其余一半保持原成本，不进行市场评估或减值评估。一项运营费用随销售一起确认和支付。假设整个客户发票是在输入月份的开户费用之后收取的。单一所有者提款是在任何同月收款之后进行的，属于转账，而不是运营费用。其他月份没有新的销售或运营成本。所要求的负现金余额是指未满足的资金需求，而不是批准的透支或已完成的无资金付款。单独显示的开盘充值是在活动开始之前需要从外部所有者现金中获得的金额；假设其可用性尚未得到证实。没有对供应商信贷、贷款、利息、坏账、库存转售、销售税或所得税进行建模。月末和有序事件视图保留不同的时间细节。

af2005186a602fb8d0f75fa7ea04c79c2f9c28ce.src: The September authorization permits up to 25 million share repurchases through September 7, 2027. It is permission to buy, not proof of execution. The approval release identified 695.1 million shares outstanding at August 31. Our model must reconcile future share reductions with the cash and equity spent to achieve them. Buying above book value can increase EPS while reducing book value per remaining share; whether that creates value depends on the return the repurchased earnings stream offers compared with other uses of capital.
af2005186a602fb8d0f75fa7ea04c79c2f9c28ce.zh: 9 月份的授权允许在 2027 年 9 月 7 日之前回购最多2500 万股股票。这是购买许可，而不是执行证明。批准发布确定截至 8 月 31 日已发行股票为 6.951 亿股。我们的模型必须将未来的股份削减与实现这些目标所花费的现金和股权相协调。购买高于账面价值的股票可以增加每股收益，同时减少剩余每股账面价值；是否创造价值取决于回购收益流与其他资本用途相比所提供的回报。

af24292fc010f43691450c2f523bafb03a007974.src: A bounded illustration, not an individual CPP calculation, investment return, break-even recommendation or forecast. Official 2025 maximum employee CPP plus CPP2 contributions total CAD 4,430.10, before the separate employer share; a self-employed person may pay both shares. The official 2026 maximum new PRB at age 65 is CAD 54.69 per month, based on maximum 2025 contributions. The selected share scales those two published maximums proportionally as an explicit scenario assumption. One illustrative contribution year creates a separate increment in the following year; additional years in this chart repeat the same dated 2025/2026 pair as a teaching device and do not predict future limits or benefit amounts. The cumulative chart assumes a constant monthly amount, twelve full payments per displayed year and no indexation, tax, discounting, mortality, processing delay, other income-tested benefits or personal contribution record. Actual PRB amounts depend on earnings, contributions and age on January 1 when the PRB starts. The crossover is not a personal break-even age. Verify an individual estimate through Service Canada.
af24292fc010f43691450c2f523bafb03a007974.zh: 有限说明，而非单独的 CPP 计算、投资回报、盈亏平衡建议或预测。官方 2025 年最高雇员 CPP 加上 CPP2 缴款总额为 4,430.10 加元（不包括单独的雇主份额）；自营职业者可以缴纳两股。根据 2025 年最高缴款额，官方 2026 年 65 岁新 PRB 最高限额为每月 54.69 加元。作为明确的情景假设，所选份额按比例缩放这两个已发布的最大值。一个说明性缴款年份会在下一年产生单独的增量；此图表中的其他年份重复相同日期的 2025/2026 对作为教学设备，并且不预测未来的限制或福利金额。累积图表假设每月金额恒定，每年显示十二次全额付款，并且没有指数化、税收、折扣、死亡率、处理延迟、其他收入测试福利或个人缴款记录。实际 PRB 金额取决于 PRB 开始时 1 月 1 日的收入、缴款和年龄。跨界并不是个人收支平衡的年龄。通过加拿大服务部验证个人估算。

afb28ff20188b03de9f66559f6a7998b856e1945.src: One fixed program-parameter graphic is separate from the editable cash scenarios. This is a single-parent EI planning illustration outside Quebec, not eligibility, benefit-amount or employment-leave advice. The default 35/61 weeks reflect published one-parent maxima, not shared-family maxima or guaranteed entitlement. Parent net leave income is entered independently, potentially including a separately verified employer top-up; published gross percentages are not applied to net pay. The selected leave weeks have level net income and leave spending; work income and work spending begin the following week, with no simultaneous leave payment in the model. Other household income stays fixed. The common 78-week window begins at the first modeled parental week, not a statutory deadline. Setup occurs at time zero; bills precede week-end income. No maternity weeks, waiting/receipt lag, sharing, QPIP, Working While on Claim, tax calculation, changing top-up, childcare subsidy, inflation or job guarantee is calculated. Negative cash is an unmet need, not approved borrowing.
afb28ff20188b03de9f66559f6a7998b856e1945.zh: 一个固定的程序参数图形与可编辑的现金场景是分开的。这是魁北克省以外的单亲EI 规划说明，而不是资格、福利金额或就业休假建议。默认的 35/61 周反映了已发布的单亲最大值，而不是共享家庭最大值或保证的权利。父母净假期收入是独立输入的，可能包括单独验证的雇主充值；公布的总百分比不适用于净工资。选定的休假周具有相同的净收入和休假支出；工作收入和工作支出从下周开始，模型中没有同时支付休假费用。其他家庭收入保持不变。常见的 78 周窗口从第一个模拟育儿周开始，而不是法定期限。建立发生在时间零；账单先于周末收入。不计算产周、等待/收据滞后、共享、QPIP、申领期间工作、税收计算、变更充值、儿童保育补贴、通货膨胀或工作保障。负现金是一种未满足的需求，而不是批准的借贷。

b04ef529666509677f96ba1a17f74746ed340d1f.src: Hypothetical 60-day access interruption. Opening cash is already usable by the person legally authorized to make the modeled payments. A separate existing cash balance becomes usable at the start of the selected day; this is a transfer of existing household resources, not income. Living costs leave daily at the monthly input divided by 30. Income arrives only at the end of days 30 and 60, after that day’s costs. Cash earns zero interest. Negative values are unfunded payments, without automatic borrowing or bill deferral. The assumed release date does not establish legal authority, document validity, account ownership or an institution’s processing time. Existing authority and actual access must be confirmed separately.
b04ef529666509677f96ba1a17f74746ed340d1f.zh: 假设 60 天的访问中断。合法授权进行模拟付款的人已经可以使用开户现金。单独的现有现金余额在选定日期开始时即可使用；这是现有家庭资源而非收入的转移。生活费用每天按每月投入除以 30 计算。收入仅在第 30 天和第 60 天结束时（扣除当天的费用）得出。现金赚取零利息。负值是无资金支持的付款，没有自动借款或账单延期。假定的发布日期并不确定法律权威、文件有效性、帐户所有权或机构的处理时间。现有权限和实际访问权限必须分别确认。

b0904d18e7aaf4a872245faba4e989b92ff61215.src: All companies, prices, income and values are invented. Opening outstanding shares are 100 million and net income for the whole earnings period stays fixed at CAD 500 million. Repurchased shares are removed from the modeled outstanding count; legal retirement, treasury-share treatment and a real award program are not inferred. Newly issued shares are fully outstanding and bring zero modeled cash proceeds. Both count changes occur at the same assumed instant; the entered period fraction determines the simple weighted-average denominator. This is not reported basic/diluted EPS or a reconstruction under a full accounting standard. The separate equity-value snapshot begins with an independently assumed total value of common equity including the spent cash, and subtracts that cash once. It is not enterprise value, book equity, an observed intrinsic value or a price forecast. Sufficient repurchase cash is assumed separately; a total equity-value input does not establish liquidity. No new income is added to this snapshot, no value is assigned to services from issuance, and no compensation expense is inferred. Taxes, interest, foregone cash income, trading costs, market repricing and potential awards/options are omitted. Numerical bounds keep repurchases below opening shares and modeled equity positive; they are not recommended corporate policies.
b0904d18e7aaf4a872245faba4e989b92ff61215.zh: 所有的公司、价格、收入和价值都是发明的。期初流通股为 1 亿股，整个盈利期净利润固定为 5 亿加元。回购股票从模拟的流通股数量中删除；法定退休、库存股待遇和实际奖励计划均未推断。新发行的股票已全部发行，并带来零模型现金收益。两个计数变化发生在同一假定时刻；输入的周期分数决定简单加权平均分母。这不是根据完整会计准则报告的基本/稀释每股收益或重建。单独的股权价值快照从独立假设的普通股总价值（包括花费的现金）开始，并减去该现金一次。它不是企业价值、账面权益、观察到的内在价值或价格预测。单独假设有充足的回购现金；总股权价值输入并不能建立流动性。此快照中不会添加任何新收入，不会为发行后的服务分配任何价值，也不会推断出补偿费用。税收、利息、放弃的现金收入、交易成本、市场重新定价和潜在的奖励/期权均被省略。回购数量限制在开盘股以下，且股本模型为正；它们不是推荐的公司政策。

b0a21f262e08acaaf1cfe899f6730560a55714ba.src: Original hypothetical CAD comparison with equal initial extra funds and the same outside monthly budget. A retains the additional balance in non-interest chequing; in qualifying months, its unused fee budget is saved at month-end in a separate account earning the assumed net yield. Otherwise that budget pays the fee. B puts the same initial funds in the alternative account; the same outside monthly budget pays every fee. B fees are not also deducted from its investment balance. Common operating cash and all other household flows are excluded equally. Only the first selected number of months in each repeated year qualify; eligibility is independently assumed, never inferred from a monthly average or from the additional balance. No daily account ledger or actual bank threshold is calculated. The alternative yield is a constant effective annual net assumption converted to an equivalent monthly rate, not a quoted or guaranteed return. No separate tax, fee change, inflation, account-access feature or product recommendation is calculated.
b0a21f262e08acaaf1cfe899f6730560a55714ba.zh: 原始假设加元与相同初始额外资金和相同外部每月预算的比较。 A保留非利息支票的额外余额；在符合条件的月份，其未使用的费用预算将在月底保存在一个单独的账户中，赚取假定的净收益。否则该预算将支付费用。 B将相同的初始资金存入替代账户；相同的外部每月预算支付所有费用。 B费用也不从其投资余额中扣除。共同经营现金和所有其他家庭流动同样被排除在外。只有每个重复年份中第一个选定的月份数符合资格；资格是独立假设的，绝不会从月平均值或额外余额中推断出来。不计算每日账户分类账或实际银行门槛。另类收益率是转换为等值月利率的恒定有效年净假设，而不是报价或保证回报。不会单独计算税收、费用变化、通货膨胀、帐户访问功能或产品推荐。

b0a60dad3a476a8300b729ce40d9bc03674c77aa.src: Cost sensitivity is a different experiment. Applying a ten percent multiplier to every fictional total charge raises the annual total to CAD 2,200. Holding CAD 150 installments leaves CAD 400 uncovered instead of CAD 200. That is a total-charge scenario, not a tariff change or a measured usage response.
b0a60dad3a476a8300b729ce40d9bc03674c77aa.zh: 成本敏感性是一项不同的实验。对每项虚构的总费用应用 10% 的乘数，将年度总额提高到 2,200 加元。持有 150 加元的分期付款后，剩下 400 加元而不是 200 加元。这是一个总收费方案，而不是费率变化或测量的使用响应。

b0a9b04ad8b9fb67331d2904c65b5c34c6747d8b.src: Columns mean one new share per the stated number of old shares; rows replace the discount to the old quote. Only existing eligible shares and the old quote remain selected for the entitlement-value calculation. These are theoretical values before any fee or market-price change, not cash required to subscribe or returns guaranteed by an offer.
b0a9b04ad8b9fb67331d2904c65b5c34c6747d8b.zh: 列表示每规定数量的旧份额一股新份额；行将折扣替换为旧报价。仅选择现有的合格股票和旧报价来计算权利价值。这些是任何费用或市场价格变化之前的理论值，而不是认购所需的现金或要约保证的回报。

b0ab54913999312faf91eef5554e1eebdd1b08d1.src: All funds, companies, bond issuers and weights are invented. Every fund is fully described by the fixed matrix, which totals 100% per fund. Balances share one hypothetical valuation instant and CAD basis. The same Company A appears in Funds A and B and the optional direct position. This is a long-only unlevered market-value composition model, with no tax, fees, price changes, cash residual, derivatives or nested funds. Editing a balance creates an independent snapshot, not a funded trade. Account labels are not asset classes. Neither fund count nor these allocation percentages calculate volatility, expected loss, correlations, suitability or a safe concentration limit. Underlying dollars describe the existing fund values; they are not additional assets to add to them.
b0ab54913999312faf91eef5554e1eebdd1b08d1.zh: 所有基金、公司、债券发行人和权重都是发明的。每个基金都由固定矩阵完整描述，每个基金总计 100%。余额共享一种假设的即时估值和加元基础。同一家公司 A 出现在基金 A 和 B 中以及可选的直接头寸中。这是一种仅做多的无杠杆市场价值构成模型，没有税收、费用、价格变化、现金剩余、衍生品或嵌套基金。编辑余额会创建独立快照，而不是资助交易。账户标签不是资产类别。基金数量和这些分配百分比都不会计算波动性、预期损失、相关性、适用性或安全集中度限制。基础美元描述了现有基金价值；它们不是可以添加到其中的额外资产。

b1bdfc44544fdccc2f78e439c040a30c561fc38d.src: Columns replace the effective annual nominal discount assumption; rows replace assumed price growth. Each cell is the mixed present cost divided by the correctly matched present cost, minus one, at the selected annual cost and payment count. Negative means understated. Zero inflation removes this price-basis mismatch. N/A preserves an undefined percentage when the entered cost is zero.
b1bdfc44544fdccc2f78e439c040a30c561fc38d.zh: 列取代了有效的年度名义折扣假设；行取代了假设的价格增长。每个单元格都是混合当前成本除以正确匹配的当前成本，然后按选定的年度成本和付款计数减去一。消极意味着低调。零通胀消除了这种价格基础错配。 N/A 在输入的成本为零时保留未定义的百分比。

b1d789eed6a48c01e69480dc25f6d2c385c03e2a.src: Read the row as status in the first year and the column as status in the second. These four cells are mutually exclusive and sum to all matched tax filers in the selected pair. The first row combines those remaining in low income with exits; the first column combines those remaining with entrants. It is a count matrix, not a row-normalised probability matrix or a forecast.
b1d789eed6a48c01e69480dc25f6d2c385c03e2a.zh: 将行读取为第一年的状态，将列读取为第二年的状态。这四个单元格是互斥的，并且对所选对中所有匹配的纳税申报人求和。第一行将剩余低收入者与退出者结合起来；第一列将剩余者与进入者结合起来。它是一个计数矩阵，而不是行归一化概率矩阵或预测。

b1d7b6db1483b132156f03143f15b40ef4202fed.src: Compare the interest retained after tax with price growth. Keep tax-payment timing and inflation adjustments separate before interpreting an account’s growth.

b1d7bf328f2507158c6b72ea1f8436d6ffeba95b.src: Start with the budget before the new arrangement. The model takes the monthly surplus already left after that budget, then calculates what the care arrangement changes. Paid support and additional transport or supplies add outflows. A reduction in net earnings removes receipts even though it is not a bill from a provider.
b1d7bf328f2507158c6b72ea1f8436d6ffeba95b.zh: 在新安排之前先从预算开始。该模型采用预算后剩余的每月盈余，然后计算护理安排的变化。有偿支持和额外的运输或物资增加了资金外流。即使不是来自提供商的账单，净利润的减少也会删除收入。

b1d883c0a155e82e3ec9d8e2dab1df1034fc1c84.src: Reinvestment buys twenty-five additional units, taking the total to 525. Total cost increases by the amount used to acquire those units: CAD 10,000 + CAD 500 = CAD 10,500. The average cost remains CAD 20 per unit at this particular stage.
b1d883c0a155e82e3ec9d8e2dab1df1034fc1c84.zh: 再投资会额外购买 25 个单位，使总数达到 525 个。总成本根据购买这些单位所用的金额而增加：10,000 加元 + 500 加元 = 10,500 加元。在此特定阶段，平均成本仍为每件 20 加元。

b1d9c0e973f9d6f8f35da8792ad57b8f4860c9c0.src: Zero extra cash does not establish that signing is affordable. The selected reserve might already be needed for rent, another debt or an emergency. The model also excludes simultaneous income loss. If both borrowers depend on the same employer or household income, a funding stress could coincide with lower available surplus.
b1d9c0e973f9d6f8f35da8792ad57b8f4860c9c0.zh: 零额外现金并不能证明签约​​是可以承受的。选定的储备金可能已用于支付租金、其他债务或紧急情况。该模型还排除了同时发生的收入损失。如果两个借款人都依赖同一雇主或家庭收入，融资压力可能会与可用盈余减少同时发生。

b1778134c453b6abbb4f89e13571dbb9e5b35e38.src: Hypothetical two-household cash budget, not legal advice or a division of property. Enter net income, cash ownership/access and any net transfer independently from confirmed arrangements; no support entitlement or tax treatment is calculated. Positive transfer means A pays B, negative means B pays A. Transition outflows occur at time zero. Each month the transfer is assumed received on time at the start, running costs are then paid, and net incomes arrive at month-end. The model assumes the transfer can be funded; a negative sender ledger flags an unresolved need that could affect its arrival in reality. Ledgers are separate and funds are not automatically pooled. The previous single-household cost is comparison context only. No shared-debt release, asset sale, borrowing approval, legal fee quote, benefit change, investment return or overlapping old-home costs beyond the entered lines are calculated.
b1778134c453b6abbb4f89e13571dbb9e5b35e38.zh: 假设的两个家庭现金预算，而不是法律建议或财产分割。输入独立于已确认安排的净收入、现金所有权/使用权和任何净转移；不计算支持权利或税收待遇。正转移意味着 A 支付 B，负转移意味着 B 支付 A。转移流出发生在时间零。假设每个月开始时按时收到转账，然后支付运营成本，并在月底到达净收入。该模型假设转移可以得到资助；负的发件人分类帐标志着未解决的需求，可能会影响其实际到达。账本是独立的，资金不会自动汇集。之前的单户成本仅供比较。不会计算超出输入线的共享债务释放、资产出售、借款审批、法律费用报价、福利变化、投资回报或重叠旧屋成本。

b1813694bc2991e1a00f5cf55440c4828973d1cb.src: Even a complete eventual recovery does not pay a bill that was due earlier. Waiting may be possible for a flexible goal; it may create penalties or a failed transaction for a firm obligation. Borrowing is another separate decision with interest, approval requirements and repayment pressure, rather than an automatic bridge embedded in the chart.
b1813694bc2991e1a00f5cf55440c4828973d1cb.zh: 即使最终完全恢复，也无法支付之前到期的账单。等待一个灵活的目标是可能的；它可能会对固定义务造成处罚或导致交易失败。借款是另一个涉及利息、审批要求和还款压力的单独决策，而不是嵌入图表中的自动桥梁。

b1877725011de62c40b19589e9860e6a3d6ffc54.src: The gap consists of the opening capitalized fees plus accrued interest. It is not extra cash delivered to the borrower. An absence of regular repayments in this scenario does not prevent the debt from compounding.

b1e13fbfba761e952b9b3404f00a1b2c069d830d.zh: 桥梁结束和后期收入开始不必重合

b1e5088ba5f43be48580aa74f23798f75527b36e.src: Each cell replaces the saving share and horizon while retaining the net-pay step and return. It subtracts a matching zero-capture baseline over that same horizon. Longer cases contain more annual pay increases and more deposits, as well as additional growth time.
b1e5088ba5f43be48580aa74f23798f75527b36e.zh: 每个单元格都会替换储蓄份额和期限，同时保留净支付步骤和回报。它减去同一范围内匹配的零捕获基线。较长的案例包含更多的年度加薪和更多的存款，以及额外的增长时间。

b1e6c82a3d165bc42c4fc2d9da5d77534c66cb46.src: The displayed path is already known because it was invented for teaching. A favorable date in this comparison cannot identify the future best date to invest. Planning decisions need to account for available cash, goals, risk and uncertainty rather than selecting a past turning point after seeing the outcome.
b1e6c82a3d165bc42c4fc2d9da5d77534c66cb46.zh: 显示的路径是已知的，因为它是为教学而发明的。此比较中的有利日期无法确定未来的最佳投资日期。规划决策需要考虑可用现金、目标、风险和不确定性，而不是在看到结果后选择过去的转折点。

b273b214539d8d58a3f8dcde0f601c21ba2f551a.zh: 年度积分汇总每月付款。交叉将未贴现的现金收入与原始保费进行比较；它不是投资盈亏平衡率、净利润、预期回报或按需收回溢价的能力。假设死亡或终止合同价值后不付款。

b275c0ffc948762836575559de69659f4dab7e82.src: Different software can use different quantile interpolation or boundary conventions. Record the loss sign, cumulative level, holding period and exact definition before comparing results from separate tools.
b275c0ffc948762836575559de69659f4dab7e82.zh: 不同的软件可以使用不同的分位数插值或边界约定。在比较不同工具的结果之前，记录损失符号、累积水平、持有期限和准确定义。

b27af2b912b7138649215b831e8fa0e17ea97daf.src: Original, completely specified one-year probability model with five mutually exclusive outcomes. Baseline simple returns are −40%, −20%, −5%, +5% and +12%, with assumed probabilities 1%, 4%, 15%, 40% and 40%. The scale changes only the three loss sizes; gain outcomes and all probabilities remain fixed. These are chosen numbers, not market observations, estimated frequencies or forecasts. Positive loss means a decline; negative loss means a gain. VaR is the smallest loss value whose cumulative probability is at least the selected level, with no floor at zero. ES averages exactly the worst remaining probability mass, taking only the needed fraction of a boundary state. Confidence here is a cumulative model probability, not a statistical confidence interval. No normality, sample, p-value, simulation, serial returns, leverage, fees, taxes, cash flows or regulatory-capital calculation is used. The largest modeled loss is only a bound of these five invented outcomes and is not an actual investment’s maximum loss. These risk summaries do not determine a sufficient cash reserve or the probability of meeting a household goal.
b27af2b912b7138649215b831e8fa0e17ea97daf.zh: 原始的、完全指定的一年概率模型，具有五个互斥的结果。基线简单回报为−40%、−20%、−5%、+5% 和+12%，假设概率为1%、4%、15%、40% 和40%。尺度仅改变三个损失大小；获得结果并且所有概率保持固定。这些是选定的数字，而不是市场观察、估计频率或预测。正损失意味着下降；负的损失意味着收益。 VaR 是累积概率至少为选定水平的最小损失值，下限为零。 ES 精确地平均了最差的剩余概率质量，仅取边界状态所需的部分。这里的置信度是累积模型概率，而不是统计置信区间。不使用正态性、样本、p 值、模拟、连续回报、杠杆、费用、税收、现金流或监管资本计算。最大的模型损失只是这五种发明结果的界限，并不是实际投资的最大损失。这些风险摘要并不能确定足够的现金储备或实现家庭目标的概率。

b3bac4efd1f5d18c02bfee20e39457b4c03820bd.src: Original mathematical illustration for one positive starting amount, with no later cash flows. Annual gross return is lognormally distributed; log gross returns are independent, normally distributed and identically parameterised across years. The entered mean is the expected simple annual return. Log-return mean equals ln(1 + mean simple return) minus half the squared log-return standard deviation. The volatility input is the standard deviation of log gross return, not the standard deviation of the simple percentage return. Parameters are assumed and are not fitted to any market, fund or security. Every probability is conditional on this chosen distribution; none estimates your real-world likelihood of meeting a goal. Dollar amounts and the goal are nominal, before fees, taxes and inflation. Quantiles are calculated analytically, without random simulation or a historical sample. A normal-CDF numerical approximation is used for probabilities. The zero-volatility case collapses to one deterministic balance; below means strictly below, while equality meets the comparison amount.
b3bac4efd1f5d18c02bfee20e39457b4c03820bd.zh: 初始金额为正值的原始数学说明，无后续现金流。年总回报呈对数正态分布；对数总回报是独立的、正态分布的并且跨年份的参数化相同。输入的平均值是预期的简单年回报率。对数回报平均值等于 ln(1 + 平均简单回报) 减去对数回报标准差平方的一半。波动率输入是对数总回报的标准差，而不是简单百分比回报的标准差。参数是假设的，不适合任何市场、基金或证券。每个概率都取决于所选的分布；没有人能够估计您在现实世界中实现目标的可能性。美元金额和目标是名义上的，未计费用、税收和通货膨胀。分位数是通过分析计算的，没有随机模拟或历史样本。概率使用正态 CDF 数值近似。零波动率的情况崩溃为一种确定性平衡；下面意味着严格低于，而平等满足比较金额。

b48c929b8a97af559c49b2540e4aaa165e19ccf2.src: The favorable case requires deposits and fee relationships to deepen while lending produces acceptable returns after losses. A lower share count can help per-share earnings, but it cannot repair weak economics on the capital that remains deployed. We would become more constructive if recurring returns advance without greater credit risk or a higher valuation multiple. We would become less constructive if the recovery needs persistent reserve relief, unusually strong markets, or repeated disposals to meet the earnings path.
b48c929b8a97af559c49b2540e4aaa165e19ccf2.zh: 有利的情况需要深化存款和费用关系，而贷款在损失后产生可接受的回报。较低的股份数量有助于提高每股收益，但无法修复现有资本的疲软经济状况。如果经常性回报在没有更大信用风险或更高估值倍数的情况下增加，我们将变得更有建设性。如果复苏需要持续的准备金减免、异常强劲的市场或反复处置以满足盈利路径，我们的建设性就会降低。

b4939308f3a68d407d4fcce75f6fb86eacf4927d.src: Original hypothetical CAD cash calendars. A and B are independent alternatives with entered net receipts, not premiums or claim quotations. Do not add them: the model makes no finding that both claims qualify or can be paid together. Supply amounts and receipt dates confirmed after tax and any offsets. Every month adds receipts before paying recurring spending and the month-1 extra cost. Month 0 is opening cash. No within-month payment delay, interest, borrowing, inflation, policy eligibility, medical diagnosis, premium cost or recovery income is calculated. A negative cash point is an unfunded position. Receipts beyond the selected horizon are excluded, without a future settlement credit.
b4939308f3a68d407d4fcce75f6fb86eacf4927d.zh: 原始假设的 CAD 现金日历。 A 和 B 是独立的选择，输入的是净收入，而不是保费或索赔报价。不要添加它们：该模型没有发现这两项索赔符合条件或可以一起支付。供应金额和收货日期在税后和任何抵消后确认。每个月都会在支付经常性支出和第一个月的额外费用之前添加收据。第 0 个月是期初现金。不计算月内付款延迟、利息、借款、通货膨胀、保单资格、医疗诊断、保费成本或恢复收入。负现金点是指没有资金的头寸。超出选定期限的收款被排除在外，且没有未来结算信用。

b4970644f97322fb7d37af1034c761f479fa162a.src: At eight months, two-thirds of the annual period has been used. A straight-line allocation assigns CAD 200 of the CAD 300 price to used months and CAD 100 to the four unused months. The stacked bar keeps the full upfront price visible while separating the portion assumed returned.
b4970644f97322fb7d37af1034c761f479fa162a.zh: 八个月时，已使用年度期限的三分之二。直线分配将 300 加元价格中的 200 加元分配给已使用的月份，将 100 加元分配给四个未使用的月份。堆叠条使完整的预付费用可见，同时分隔假定返回的部分。

b4988587044ac9825975eefc02375d765f13ee1e.src: A 13.5× base P/E values the improving recurring earnings stream while asking for evidence that U.S. returns on total equity can continue rising. The bear case pairs credit pressure with 11.5×, and the bull case allows 15× for better persistence. These choices are research judgments, not a claim that BMO historically trades inside this range.
b4988587044ac9825975eefc02375d765f13ee1e.zh: 13.5倍的基础市盈率重视不断改善的经常性收益流，同时要求有证据表明美国的总股本回报率可以继续上升。熊市情况下将信用压力与 11.5 倍配对，而牛市情况下则允许 15 倍以获得更好的持久性。这些选择属于研究判断，并非 BMO 历史上在此范围内交易的主张。

b4f6ccc0a40c35940e86406198116ae284a13d31.zh: 财务规划 · 了解不确定性 · 视觉规划指南

b4f767deac47aaaedda919dc26ceb98cdfe9c268.src: For first annual gap G, escalation g, discount rate d and n support years, the income amount today is Σ G(1 + g)t−1 ÷ (1 + d)t, summed from t = 1 to n. Immediate costs are then added without discounting. Escalation and discounting are different operations; using a real rate while also inflating the cash flows would mix conventions.
b4f767deac47aaaedda919dc26ceb98cdfe9c268.zh: 对于第一个年度差距 G、升级 g、贴现率 d 和 n 支持年，今天的收入金额为 Σ G(1 + g)t−1 ÷ (1 + d)t，从 t = 1 到 n 求和。然后立即添加成本而不打折扣。升级和折扣是不同的操作；使用实际利率同时增加现金流量会混淆惯例。

b4fba1950dd14dfdca091944bac3124928c0e875.src: The government repayment is additional money leaving the plan; it is not deducted again from the gross payment shown for the beneficiary. The beneficiary’s payment may contain taxable amounts, which are not calculated here.
b4fba1950dd14dfdca091944bac3124928c0e875.zh: 政府还款是计划外的额外资金；它不会再次从受益人显示的付款总额中扣除。受益人的付款可能包含应税金额，此处不进行计算。

b4fd0ae78256aed779bbf61e2323989c2e2736ae.src: Use consistent common-share, currency and period definitions before deciding whether a multiple is high. All amounts below are Canadian dollars; financial statement totals are in millions.

b508502ac714b1bb2ff5067b9698f80e53c94266.src: Someone can have employment income for only part of the reference year. These charts do not select full-time, full-year workers, identify hours worked or calculate an hourly wage. Dividing a published annual median by a standard number of working hours would not turn it into a verified wage rate.
b508502ac714b1bb2ff5067b9698f80e53c94266.zh: 某人只能在参考年的部分时间有就业收入。这些图表不选择全职、全年工人、确定工作时间或计算小时工资。将公布的年度中位数除以标准工作时间并不能将其转化为经过验证的工资率。

b50b58adabf576d1d21740a9f4c36ccce72b94d8.src: The source asks respondents to check all applicable uses of time in the AI-work module. Keep that question-specific respondent denominator; these are not shares of all Canadians or mutually exclusive worker groups. The extract does not reveal how answers overlap, how much time went to each use or how many workers earned additional pay.
b50b58adabf576d1d21740a9f4c36ccce72b94d8.zh: 消息来源要求受访者检查人工智能工作模块中所有适用的时间用途。保留特定问题的受访者分母；这些并不是所有加拿大人或相互排斥的工人群体的共同特征。该摘录没有透露答案如何重叠、每次使用花费了多少时间或有多少工人获得了额外工资。

b51495e8cfbc0ea665dc470ef8fbad4da6bece1f.src: Changing household size affects both exercises for different reasons. It changes the denominator of the income measures, while also changing the number of per-person cost amounts in the cash scenario. The tool keeps those calculations distinct.
b51495e8cfbc0ea665dc470ef8fbad4da6bece1f.zh: 家庭规模的变化会因不同原因影响这两项练习。它改变了收入衡量标准的分母，同时也改变了现金情景中人均成本金额的数量。该工具使这些计算保持清晰。

b51a1776c787a670d8c8f5c8e151e851ef44e2ff.src: New contributions can move weights toward a chosen target without selling. Whether they reach it depends on the existing holdings, the target and the cash available.
b51a1776c787a670d8c8f5c8e151e851ef44e2ff.zh: 新的贡献可以将权重移向选定的目标，而无需出售。是否达到目标取决于现有持仓、目标和可用现金。

b52bc2ba8afb0fb45d453fd4fd486ff6e6be0edd.src: The median among the forty positive-debt units is CAD 10,000 because every one owes that amount. The median across all 100 units is zero: after sorting all balances, both the fiftieth and fifty-first observations are zero.
b52bc2ba8afb0fb45d453fd4fd486ff6e6be0edd.zh: 四十个正债单位的中位数为 10,000 加元，因为每个单位都欠这个金额。所有 100 个单位的中位数为零：对所有余额进行排序后，第 50 个和第 51 个观测值均为零。

b5307b03721219ef3200c6528d2941f01b29e83c.src: These fixed entries sum to −0.28 percentage points, matching the original worked article example. They remain unchanged if the selected annual-gap control changes. No actual fund, fee schedule, tax recovery or lending revenue has been observed. The operating-expense entry is a component of the illustrated return gap, not another deduction from the NAV wealth path. In real analysis, distinguish disclosed measurements from modeled explanations and unexplained residuals.
b5307b03721219ef3200c6528d2941f01b29e83c.zh: 这些固定条目的总和为 -0.28 个百分点，与原始工作文章示例相匹配。如果选定的年度缺口控制发生变化，它们将保持不变。没有观察到实际的资金、费用表、税收回收或贷款收入。运营费用条目是所示回报差距的组成部分，而不是资产净值财富路径中的另一项扣除。在实际分析中，将披露的测量结果与建模解释和无法解释的残差区分开来。

b5310bab7c0415c0cb3f6df2c1ffb8c160466df1.src: Build the household cash schedule from actual balances and contract terms.
b5310bab7c0415c0cb3f6df2c1ffb8c160466df1.zh: 根据实际余额和合同条款制定家庭现金计划。

b53370625528f66a3dcea7a20332ea0da028fba8.src: Public sources reviewed on 25 October 2026. Four original hypothetical figures compare principal-only promises without purchase pricing, coupon income or early sales. The stated average is weighted by future face amounts and is not a duration calculation or an available investment recommendation. Original scenario calculations and research checklists are TickerLantern’s educational analysis; attributed publisher examples retain their stated source and scope. Recheck current issuer documents for any product-specific decision.
b53370625528f66a3dcea7a20332ea0da028fba8.zh: 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查的公共来源。四个原始假设数据比较了仅本金承诺，没有购买定价、优惠券收入或提前销售。所述平均数按未来面值加权，并非久期计算或可用投资建议。原创情景计算和研究清单是 TickerLantern 的教育分析；归属出版商的示例保留其声明的来源和范围。重新检查当前发行人文件以了解任何特定于产品的决定。

b533f7ce1e9437377cb10922e750b4f18dde205b.src: Tax relief and withdrawal tax are entered as constant percentages applying to the full relevant amount. Real deductions and withdrawals can span brackets and interact with other income, benefits and credits. The percentages here are hypothetical assumptions, not published federal or provincial tax rates.
b533f7ce1e9437377cb10922e750b4f18dde205b.zh: 税收减免和提款税按适用于全部相关金额的固定百分比输入。实际扣除和提款可以跨越不同的范围，并与其他收入、福利和信贷相互作用。这里的百分比是假设的，不是公布的联邦或省税率。

b5347716cb3c85a0db9a90d4b65c1a52c7f81de1.src: Add the calendar before relying on a positive annual total
b5347716cb3c85a0db9a90d4b65c1a52c7f81de1.zh: 在依赖正的年度总额之前添加日历

b5380bbbd46c35ee8965bf8dd37017ad1de3ba5f.src: A lower first payment does not settle the full cost comparison
b5380bbbd46c35ee8965bf8dd37017ad1de3ba5f.zh: 较低的首付款并不能解决全部成本比较

b53af6b3fa8d1fe49a7d410184aeeeb057ce2be2.src: The same-year loss use is capped at the smaller of entered allowable losses and taxable gains. If gains exceed losses, this record is zero and the unused gain stays a positive gain; no negative loss is invented. Gross economic losses, sale proceeds and tax paid are different quantities and must not be entered as if they were already allowable amounts.
b53af6b3fa8d1fe49a7d410184aeeeb057ce2be2.zh: 同年损失的使用上限为输入的允许损失和应税收益中的较小者。如果收益超过损失，该记录为零，未使用的收益保持为正收益；没有发明负损失。总经济损失、销售收入和已付税款是不同的金额，不得将其视为已允许的金额。

b53ee68a0bca83672be1ba4eca6af4e19c1467a1.src: Protecting an essential request does not guarantee its payment
b53ee68a0bca83672be1ba4eca6af4e19c1467a1.zh: 保护基本请求并不能保证其付款

b54286418363d199aafc6fe6662ad9685592cc4b.zh: 测试收租月份和较大的现金支出

b55b3a70357f2f076bfa892e6661793ff104bd25.zh: 确定离开计划的每一美元的去向

b55bd977f7610e07e9825854817ddbd64aba75e8.src: The independent performance assumption is a constant 5% effective annual fund total return before investor costs. The model converts it to an equivalent monthly growth factor. Each month, the unit NAV first grows by that factor and then the scheduled per-unit distribution is deducted.
b55bd977f7610e07e9825854817ddbd64aba75e8.zh: 独立业绩假设是投资者面前的恒定 5% 有效年度基金总回报成本。该模型将其转换为等效的月增长因子。每个月，单位资产净值首先按该系数增长，然后扣除预定的单位分配。

b55d297e7797f02c1f161d4642f86b5219463c34.src: Explore A construction-price index is not your renovation quote: build the budget from its actual parts
b55d297e7797f02c1f161d4642f86b5219463c34.zh: 探索 建筑价格指数不是您的装修报价：根据其实际部分制定预算

b55f9dd9af0932cb916f0b1f36e382fb28c389be.src: Choose the planning question before ranking the inputs
b55f9dd9af0932cb916f0b1f36e382fb28c389be.zh: 在对输入进行排序之前选择规划问题

b56075312d4b32c44ae553af0ff47b0cb08fe724.src: That follows because the first-year growth factor is already large relative to the selected two-year factor. It does not forecast negative deposit rates or verify that this combination of opportunities can actually be traded. The chart retains the sign so the calculation is not silently floored at zero.
b56075312d4b32c44ae553af0ff47b0cb08fe724.zh: 这样做是因为第一年增长系数相对于所选的两年系数已经很大。它不会预测负存款利率，也不会验证这种机会组合实际上可以进行交易。图表保留了符号，因此计算不会默默地归零。

b5613db0e9ea12cab42d53b73b3d50066f33133e.src: The 360 denominator does not say that only 360 calendar days exist or that five actual days should be removed from the interval. Conversely, a fixed-365 definition does not automatically become a 366 definition when included dates fall in a leap year.
b5613db0e9ea12cab42d53b73b3d50066f33133e.zh: 360 分母并未表示仅存在 360 个日历日，也未表示应从间隔中删除 5 个实际天数。相反，当包含的日期属于闰年时，固定 365 定义不会自动变为 366 定义。

b562cee6639b13300dbec6436bf10be176efe64c.src: During the first period, each CAD 150 assignment pays a CAD 50 premium and retains CAD 100. With no interest and no withdrawals, 120 monthly differences build a CAD 12,000 cash reserve.
b562cee6639b13300dbec6436bf10be176efe64c.zh: 在第一个期间，每项 150 加元的作业需要支付 50 加元的溢价并保留 100 加元。在没有利息和提款的情况下，120 个每月差额可建立 12,000 加元的现金储备。

b566cf09e65d0916557fb4cde58decf682b128ee.src: Read the quotation basis before adding or subtracting amounts. Surrender cash and a conditional death payout serve different events, and a loan already deducted from a quote must not be deducted twice.
b566cf09e65d0916557fb4cde58decf682b128ee.zh: 在添加或减去金额之前请先阅读报价基础。退还现金和有条件死亡赔付适用于不同的事件，已从报价中扣除的贷款不得重复扣除。

b5686b7f2bb9eb39866182b07699cd30ff2ff000.src: Annual quoted rate after promotion and on any excess balance (%)
b5686b7f2bb9eb39866182b07699cd30ff2ff000.zh: 促销后和任何超额余额的年度报价利率 (%)

b577ba3c08294dca88cd7afe674b1ab08d17aea5.zh: 剩余 AIP 的说明性常规税 · 结束于 4,800 美元

b57c4cfdba8c171e81cb34af1e51e632fec34f95.src: The smallest-balance rule is based on current balances after the month’s base payments. Rate and debt letter resolve ties. The highest-rate rule resolves ties by balance and then letter. These conventions keep an otherwise ambiguous comparison reproducible.
b57c4cfdba8c171e81cb34af1e51e632fec34f95.zh: 最小余额规则基于当月基本付款后的当前余额。利率和债务信解决了联系。最高率规则通过平衡然后字母来解决关系。这些约定使原本不明确的比较可重现。

b57fe1e3aef9fd38ad307cc7e284b36a37d42d7c.src: Immediately after the next coupon, the default assumed clean sale quote is still 98.5. Gross sale value is CAD 9,850. Subtracting a separate CAD 10 sale charge leaves CAD 9,840 of sale cash.
b57fe1e3aef9fd38ad307cc7e284b36a37d42d7c.zh: 在下一张优惠券之后，默认的假定干净销售报价仍然是 98.5。总售价为 9,850 加元。减去 10 加元的单独销售费用，剩下 9,840 加元的销售现金。

b58163e3bb64882ceade61288c7e31ca5d192180.src: Rows replace the comparison package size; columns replace its price. The reference package, monthly quantity and horizon remain entered. Positive cells require more cumulative checkout cash than the reference; negative cells require less. Each cell uses whole packages and retains its own leftover stock, so it does not compare perfectly equal ending inventories or imply all products have equal quality.
b58163e3bb64882ceade61288c7e31ca5d192180.zh: 行取代比较包装尺寸；列取代其价格。参考包、每月数量和范围仍保留输入。阳性细胞需要比参考细胞更多的累积结账现金；阴性细胞需要较少。每个单元都使用整个包装并保留自己的剩余库存，因此它不会比较完全相等的期末库存或暗示所有产品具有相同的质量。

b58b9ce9b793114237826554cc531286c4e3b934.src: Completed months of the policy year
b58b9ce9b793114237826554cc531286c4e3b934.zh: 保单年度已完成的月份

b58c5321414bc013329987ac503199490b63300b.src: A customer invoice can record work completed without putting money into the bank. Operating profit can be positive while cash is tied up in receivables. An owner’s withdrawal then moves cash into the household budget without changing the modeled operating profit.
b58c5321414bc013329987ac503199490b63300b.zh: 客户发票可以记录已完成的工作，而无需将钱存入银行。当现金被应收账款占用时，营业利润可能为正。然后，业主的提款会将现金转移到家庭预算中，而不会改变建模的运营利润。

b58d1835b4d0384acc20f3d5b5eacb5984256db3.src: The operating result is a deliberately simplified teaching measure. It does not represent a formal financial statement or determine taxable income. A useful personal plan needs a separate, dated decision about what the business can release after its own obligations are funded.
b58d1835b4d0384acc20f3d5b5eacb5984256db3.zh: 运营结果是一种刻意简化的教学措施。它不代表正式的财务报表或确定应税收入。一个有用的个人计划需要一个单独的、过时的决定，决定企业在自己的义务得到资助后可以释放什么。

b58f1f6e538a8f946176a82dda5a74fe5e512ff5.src: All benefits and payment costs here are gross cash amounts. The illustration excludes deductions, tax relief, changes to contribution room, past service pension adjustments and transfers from registered savings. A tax deduction or direct transfer should not be assumed to be freely available cash.
b58f1f6e538a8f946176a82dda5a74fe5e512ff5.zh: 这里的所有福利和支付费用均为现金总额。该图不包括扣除额、税收减免、缴款空间的变化、过去的服务养老金调整和注册储蓄的转移。税收减免或直接转账不应被视为可自由使用的现金。

b58f4993e2037b37f834ffd91f880950f1486696.src: A replacement reserve needs enough money when each bill arrives. Dividing the final total by the full horizon can miss an earlier funding gap.
b58f4993e2037b37f834ffd91f880950f1486696.zh: 每张账单到达时，备用储备金都需要足够的资金。将最终总额除以整个期限可能会错过早期的资金缺口。

b5b6ebbd9179377a5303a792c9694ada90ff462a.src: Two details in those descriptions matter for any household budget. First, the review cadence and the anniversary treatment are provider-specific, so one utility’s rule cannot be imported into another’s plan. Second, an installment is a requested planned payment, not proof that cash moved. BC Hydro’s payment page lists equal payments separately from pre-authorized withdrawals and notes that online-banking payments can take several business days to appear.

b5b998d51db352daec369344b0469dee445d2c84.src: The waterfall starts with the original CAD 1,500 surplus. First, applying the CAD 20 price reduction to the original 100 units removes CAD 2,000. Then the additional 50 units contribute 50 × CAD 20 = CAD 1,000 at the new margin. The endpoint is CAD 500.

b671e10e5b81aedd8ec779ee6ac3f14dc7c83a81.src: A simple bill identity helps keep the two apart. If a charge equals a fixed component plus a unit price multiplied by quantity, then price and quantity move the variable part while the fixed component stays fixed. Actual tiered rates, time-of-day pricing, taxes and other line items are outside that identity, so the model does not claim that equal billing locks either the price or the consumption.

b6b8fa811f401709f27217ca5ad3529c5ef04c2d.src: Hypothetical constant-rate planning exercise. Year 1 uses the entered monthly take-home income and expenses; annual increases first apply in year 2. Later expenses multiply both the price factor and the lifestyle factor, so their combined growth is (1 + price growth) × (1 + lifestyle expansion) − 1. Positive monthly surpluses are deposited at month-end; an equivalent monthly return compounds existing savings first. Negative surpluses are recorded as unfunded living costs, with no debt and no withdrawals from the saved-surplus portfolio. If that gap is positive, the displayed portfolio is conditional on finding other funding or reducing expenses. No opening investments, tax calculation, benefit changes, fees, irregular bills or salary forecast is included. Starting-price portfolio values deflate the finish-date balance over the full selected horizon; income and expense levels are constant within each year.
b6b8fa811f401709f27217ca5ad3529c5ef04c2d.zh: 假设的固定利率计划练习。第 1 年使用输入的每月实得收入和支出；年度增长首先在第 2 年应用。后来的支出同时乘以价格因素和生活方式因素，因此它们的综合增长为 (1 + 价格增长) × (1 + 生活方式扩展) − 1。每月正盈余在月底存入；首先，等值的每月回报使现有储蓄复利。负盈余被记录为无资金支持的生活成本，没有债务，也没有从储蓄盈余投资组合中提取资金。如果该差距为正，则显示的投资组合取决于寻找其他资金或减少费用。不包括期初投资、税收计算、福利变化、费用、不规则账单或薪资预测。起始价格投资组合价值会缩小整个选定范围内的结束日期余额；每年的收入和支出水平保持不变。

b7adb1562c0408570b6c13ba4c65addd10002d68.src: Write the weights as fractions wA and wB, standalone standard deviations as σA and σB, and correlation as ρ. Portfolio variance is wA²σA² + wB²σB² + 2wAwBρσAσB. Portfolio standard deviation is the square root of that total.

b8d5d6bbb521444396ec81370c14f39afee03a6d.src: An original twelve-period teaching ledger with fictional monthly total charges and one paid installment per period. It is not a BC Hydro, FortisBC or any other provider invoice, tariff or annual reconciliation statement. Each entered charge is already the complete fictional cost assigned to that period, so no tax, rebate, deposit, late fee, interest or meter correction is added. The running difference is charges minus cash paid: a positive value means cumulative charges exceed cumulative cash paid and a negative value means a modeled credit. It is not the provider’s amount due, an arrears balance, approved borrowing, an available refund or spendable bank cash. The annuity-style recomputation divides the current signed difference plus forecast remaining charges by the remaining months and assumes those forecasts are realized exactly and every installment arrives on time. It is not a provider adjustment formula or a right to choose an installment. A separate hypothetical refund is capped at an existing modeled credit and returns previously paid cash; it is not income, and the same credit must not also be carried forward. No reduction in the underlying charges, coverage of a shortfall, payment arrangement or collection outcome is modeled, and no current tariff, actual account or usage recommendation is supplied.
