b9b52a3093124f70597a59ce9c4e21920d76c787.src: In the fully linked stress there are zero events with probability 1 − p and exactly one event in every year with probability p. Each year still has marginal probability p, and expected total cost remains years × p × cost. Dependence changes the distribution. Either percentile can equal zero at sufficiently low event probability; that is not a recommendation to hold no reserve. This all-or-none illustration is not an estimate of actual clustering.
b9b52a3093124f70597a59ce9c4e21920d76c787.zh: 在完全关联的压力下，概率为 1 − p 的事件为零，而每年概率为 p 的事件恰好有一个。每年仍有边际概率 p，预期总成本仍为年 × p × 成本。依赖性改变了分布。在事件概率足够低的情况下，任一百分位数都可以为零；这并不是建议不持有储备金。这个全有或全无的说明并不是对实际聚类的估计。

ba002914a39d986139de5ec04d7d0ff0e5a089b7.src: An offset-style arrangement links a cash account to a loan. The cash stays in the account, but the lender subtracts it from the loan balance before calculating interest. Moneysmart, the Australian Securities and Investments Commission’s consumer site, describes a mortgage offset account as a transaction account linked to a home loan, generally a variable-rate loan. Its example charges interest on an AUD 700,000 balance when an AUD 750,000 loan is paired with AUD 50,000 in the offset account.
ba002914a39d986139de5ec04d7d0ff0e5a089b7.zh: 冲抵式安排将现金账户与贷款联系起来。现金保留在账户中，但贷款机构在计算利息之前将其从贷款余额中扣除。 澳大利亚证券和投资委员会的消费者网站Moneysmart将抵押贷款冲抵账户描述为与住房贷款（通常是浮动利率贷款）相关的交易账户。其示例在 750,000 澳元贷款与冲抵账户中的 50,000 澳元配对时，对 700,000 澳元余额收取利息。

ba016a2926a7b179acfe1034daa2be48d465993d.src: It also does not assign a source to the extra payment. A mathematical top-up that waives interest still needs cash available on the correct date. Connect the verified repayment amount with the household's own receipt and bill calendar before treating it as funded.
ba016a2926a7b179acfe1034daa2be48d465993d.zh: 它也不会为额外付款分配来源。免除利息的数学充值仍然需要在正确的日期提供可用现金。将经过验证的还款金额与家庭自己的收据和帐单日历联系起来，然后将其视为已资助。

ba03a517bd8592eaf794a8b384ccda00e5681da0.src: The test prevents return outcomes from extending beyond their forecast date in the training set. bae26ff9b22db110550852f4b6bcae14edab79b4.src: Ordinary proportional-repayment illustration only: beneficiary remains DTC-eligible, is under 60, and the issuer has independently confirmed the AHA and remaining annual payment capacity. It does not determine DAP/LDAP entitlement, annual statutory limits, tax composition or net cash after tax. Requested cash is capped at the entered annual capacity and plan value above the confirmed AHA. The government repayment is the lesser of three times that gross payment and the entered AHA, reducing both plan value and the AHA. No new grants, withdrawals, returns or passage of time are assumed. AHA above plan value produces no payment here and requires issuer review. DTC loss, SDSP/specified-year exceptions, closure and death require different treatment.
bae26ff9b22db110550852f4b6bcae14edab79b4.zh: 仅普通比例还款说明：受益人仍符合 DTC 资格，年龄低于 60，发行人已独立确认AHA及剩余年度支付能力。它不决定 DAP/LDAP 权利、年度法定限额、税收构成或税后净现金。请求的现金上限为输入的年容量和高于确认的 AHA 的计划价值。政府还款额是总付款额和输入的 AHA 的三倍中的较小者，从而减少了计划价值和 AHA。不假设有新的拨款、提款、回报或时间的流逝。高于计划价值的 AHA 在此不会产生付款，需要发行人审核。 DTC 损失、SDSP/指定年份例外、关闭和死亡需要不同的处理。

bbcbb0531e021efbd9044e61b75a29192725722a.src: Three interpretations of the same entered annual rate number, not three current offers. A nominal quote j with m compounding periods has annual growth factor (1 + j/m)^m. Its equivalent monthly rate is that factor raised to 1/12, minus one. An already-effective annual quote uses (1 + j)^(1/12) − 1 instead. Each loan has the same principal and full repayment horizon, constant converted monthly interest, no fees and a capped final payment. The rate is assumed unchanged for the entire displayed horizon; an actual mortgage term can be much shorter than its amortization. Compounding frequency and monthly payment frequency are separate. The numerical effective annual rate here is an interest-conversion measure, not an all-in APR disclosure or a loan-eligibility result. Day-count rules, leap years, dated accrual, renewals, penalties and other charges are excluded.
bbcbb0531e021efbd9044e61b75a29192725722a.zh: 对相同输入的年利率数字的三种解释，而不是三种当前报价。具有 m 个复利期的名义报价 j 的年增长率为 (1 + j/m)^m。其等效月费率为该系数提高到 1/12 减一。已经有效的年度报价使用 (1 + j)^(1/12) − 1 代替。每笔贷款均具有相同的本金和全额还款期限、恒定转换的每月利息、无费用和有上限的最终付款。假设整个显示范围内的速率不变；实际抵押期限可能比摊销期限短得多。复利频率和每月付款频率是分开的。这里的数字有效年利率是一种利率转换指标，而不是全部年利率披露或贷款资格结果。天数规则、闰年、日期累积、续订、罚款和其他费用均不包括在内。

bc47b1d301e94b6c064b15a78ae33740848df11e.src: The first two panels reproduce published aggregate survey results from the Bank of Canada’s CSCE 2026 Q3 AI-work module, released 19 October 2026 and retrieved 25 October. Online collection was 5–27 August; follow-up interviews were 24 August–4 September. Hours are interpolated medians: active weekly use is estimated from reported duration categories and frequency, while additional time without AI is a respondent estimate of a counterfactual. The uses question permits multiple answers, so its shares overlap and need not sum to 100%. These are categorical observations, not a daily time series. No sample counts, response overlaps, causal productivity effect or earnings gain are inferred. The last three panels use independently entered weekly time, weeks, paid conversion, gross receipts per converted hour and out-of-pocket annual cost. They do not copy any survey median or response share into the scenario. All additional paid-work receipts are assumed actually received within this one-year horizon; no unpaid invoice or collection lag is added. A fixed-pay path assumes no overtime, bonus or pay rise and therefore has no extra receipts, but bears the same entered out-of-pocket cost. Cash change after that cost is before personal tax, other work costs and benefit changes; it is not take-home pay, business profit, a tax deduction or proof of affordability. No monetary value is imputed to leisure, quality, learning or the person’s existing salary.
bc47b1d301e94b6c064b15a78ae33740848df11e.zh: 前两个面板再现了英国央行发布的汇总调查结果加拿大的 CSCE 2026 Q3 AI-work 模块，2026 年 10 月 19 日发布，10 月 25 日检索。在线收集时间为 8 月 5 日至 27 日；后续访谈于 8 月 24 日至 9 月 4 日进行。小时数是插值中位数：每周的活跃使用时间是根据报告的持续时间类别和频率估计的，而没有人工智能的额外时间是受访者对反事实的估计。使用问题允许有多个答案，因此其份额重叠并且不需要总和为 100%。这些是分类观察，而不是每日时间序列。没有推断样本计数、响应重叠、因果生产力效应或收入增益。最后三个面板使用独立输入的每周时间、周数、付费转换、每转换小时的总收入和自付费用的年度成本。他们不会将任何调查中位数或响应份额复制到场景中。所有额外的有偿工作收入均假定在一年内实际收到；不会添加未付发票或收款滞后。固定工资路径假设没有加班、奖金或加薪，因此没有额外收入，但承担相同的自付费用。该成本后的现金变化未计个人税、其他工作成本和福利变化；它不是实得工资、商业利润、税收减免或负担能力的证明。闲暇、质量、学习或人员现有工资均不具有货币价值。

bcf5aaccf6d9b4ca363f9be308ac46ab34a22bfb.src: Original hypothetical twelve-month cash ledger. There is one starting bank balance, not a separate copy for each earmark. Opening allocations use an illustrative order: protect the selected floor, then assign the required bill, then the planned purchase, each only from remaining cash. This order is not a legal priority or an optimized plan. All bills are nevertheless paid in full on their selected month; negative balances are unfunded needs, not automatic borrowing. New monthly money arrives before that month’s bills, and same-month bills are added. The protected floor is held as cash throughout, not paid away as another bill. Cash earns zero. Required bill and purchase amounts are independently entered, with no tax calculation, credit, fees, refund, return or other household expenses. The additional starting cash covers the lowest cash point relative to the floor, not just the final balance.
bcf5aaccf6d9b4ca363f9be308ac46ab34a22bfb.zh: 原始假设的 12 个月现金分类帐。每个专项资金都有一份起始银行余额，而不是单独的副本。期初分配使用说明性顺序：保护选定的楼层，然后分配所需的账单，然后分配计划的购买，每次仅使用剩余现金。该命令不是法律优先权或优化计划。尽管如此，所有账单均在所选月份全额支付；负余额是没有资金支持的需求，而不是自动借款。新的每月资金先于该月的账单到达，并添加同月的账单。受保护的下限自始至终都以现金形式持有，而不是作为另一张账单支付。现金收益为零。所需的账单和购买金额是独立输入的，无需计算税收、抵免、费用、退款、退货或其他家庭开支。额外起始现金涵盖相对于下限的最低现金点，而不仅仅是最终余额。

bd6391a3a8d131a08efc315b9c622241d365e23b.src: Hypothetical fully amortizing fixed-rate loan; nominal annual interest ÷ 12, with a capped final payment. The annual price and take-home growth assumptions are converted through fractional-year compounding. Budget points are monthly run rates at each modeled date, not a salary-receipt ledger. Real values divide nominal amounts by the cumulative selected price factor and are expressed in starting-date dollars. Neither the contractual payment nor the interest rate changes with inflation. Household surplus equals take-home income less non-debt living costs and the contractual payment; a negative result is a funding gap, not automatic credit. The final-date budget still includes the last loan payment; the following month is outside the chart. No new debt, refinancing, fees, tax changes, job loss or account balance is modeled.
bd6391a3a8d131a08efc315b9c622241d365e23b.zh: 假设完全摊销固定利率贷款；名义年利息 ÷ 12，最终付款有上限。年价格和实得增长假设通过分数年复利进行转换。预算点是每个建模日期的每月运行率，而不是工资收据分类账。实际值除以名义金额除以累积选定的价格系数，并以起始日期美元表示。合同付款和利率都不随通货膨胀而变化。家庭盈余等于实得收入减去非债务生活成本和合同付款；负面结果是资金缺口，而不是自动信贷。最终日期预算仍包括最后一次贷款支付；下个月在图表之外。没有对新债务、再融资、费用、税收变化、失业或账户余额进行建模。

bdc47894c8a15dfe92944289ca1497e1a2bed1a4.src: Hypothetical full-term comparison ending with no vehicle owned and no purchase-loan balance: the purchased car is sold and remaining principal paid; the leased car is returned. Price and lease payment are all-in quote inputs, with no tax calculation. Purchase down payment is capped at price. The loan uses constant nominal annual interest divided by twelve, monthly payments and unrounded intermediate amounts; payments stop at payoff. Lease signing cash excludes monthly instalments and refundable deposits; instalments arrive at month-end in the model. Return charges are separately entered. Sale proceeds are net of selling and loan-closure charges but before repaying principal. Identical operating costs cancel; selected additional monthly costs are included for each option. No lease buyout, residual-value shortfall guarantee beyond entered charges, early termination, refundable deposit, approval, mileage forecast, discounting or investment return is modeled.
bdc47894c8a15dfe92944289ca1497e1a2bed1a4.zh: 假设的长期比较结束时没有拥有车辆且没有购买贷款余额：所购买的汽车被出售并支付剩余本金；租赁的汽车已归还。价格和租赁付款均为报价输入，不计算税费。购买首付款以价格为上限。贷款使用不变的名义年利率除以十二、每月付款和未四舍五入的中间金额；付款在付款时停止。签订租赁合同的现金不包括每月分期付款和可退还押金；模型中的分期付款于月底到达。退货费用单独输入。销售收益扣除销售和贷款结清费用，但在偿还本金之前。相同的运营成本取消；每个选项都包含选定的每月额外费用。没有对租赁买断、超出输入费用的剩余价值差额保证、提前终止、可退还押金、批准、里程预测、折扣或投资回报进行建模。

bdf10da1778b8e29e409a15f79b4bed849e99562.src: FY2025 reported earnings include the Schwab sale and should not anchor a recurring P/E argument. Equally, adjusted earnings should not become a licence to remove every inconvenient expense. AML remediation and related governance investments already burden the operating result. A model that adds them back again would create an earnings number that the published adjusted measure does not support.
bdf10da1778b8e29e409a15f79b4bed849e99562.zh: 2025 财年报告的收益包括嘉信理财的出售，不应成为经常出现的市盈率争论的焦点。同样，调整后的收入不应成为消除所有不便支出的许可。反洗钱整治和相关治理投资已经给运营业绩带来了负担。再次将它们添加回来的模型将创建一个已发布的调整后的衡量标准不支持的收入数字。

bdf13c1262778ca3a15c28c814775dd5ddc1470e.src: Combining the two ledgers incorrectly would add the CAD 100 forgone sale to repair and subtract it from replacement. That would count the same opportunity twice and produce a false CAD 1,100 difference. The calculator uses the cash ledger throughout: the old sale appears once as a receipt in the replacement alternative.
bdf13c1262778ca3a15c28c814775dd5ddc1470e.zh: 错误地组合两个分类帐会将 100 加元的放弃销售添加到修复并从替换中减去它。这会将同一个机会计算两次并产生 1,100 加元的错误差异。计算器自始至终都使用现金分类帐：旧销售在替代方案中作为收据出现一次。

be4bbed7235eb893597245a78d71b96acede47ac.src: Weighting those returns by q and 1 − q cancels their deviations from m. Weighting the squared deviations gives s². These are exact population moments of the specified distribution, rather than sample estimates. There is no division by a sample count minus one and no confidence interval to estimate from observations.
be4bbed7235eb893597245a78d71b96acede47ac.zh: 用 q 和 1 − q 对这些回报进行加权可以消除它们与 m 的偏差。对偏差平方进行加权得出 s²。这些是指定分布的精确总体矩，而不是样本估计值。样本数不除以减一，也没有根据观察结果进行估计的置信区间。

be6376b586f082826dc7eaadef41c7a4e6f31941.src: The model divides the quoted annual rate by twelve, credits interest on the opening monthly balance and then adds the month-end deposit. c015e8a9bcaa26b1a86fa78c097cba0a6069993d.src: CRA generally calculates the new RRSP deduction-room component using the lesser of 18% of prior-year earned income and the annual dollar limit, with pension adjustment, prescribed amount, pension adjustment reversal and past-service adjustment mechanics. Its earned-income definition includes employment earnings and certain other items. A dividend is investment income rather than employment or self-employment earnings in that definition, so it does not add RRSP earned income in the way salary can.
c015e8a9bcaa26b1a86fa78c097cba0a6069993d.zh: CRA 通常使用上一年收入的 18% 和年度美元限额中的较小者来计算新的 RRSP 扣除室部分，以及养老金调整、规定金额、养老金调整冲销和过往服务调整机制。其劳动收入定义包括就业收入和某些其他项目。在该定义中，股息是投资收入，而不是就业或自营职业收入，因此它不会像工资那样添加 RRSP 收入。

c081cdb849d0903df48524bee0e08769680c83bb.src: The first two charts retain a fixed May 2025 Statistics Canada snapshot, released 26 August 2025 and reviewed 25 October 2026. The selected main-mode shares and group means do not change with the personal controls. Commuters usually work most hours outside the home; the survey population is ages 15–69 in the provinces, with the source exclusions stated below. The selected shares are not a complete partition and are not renormalized. No confidence intervals or causal estimates are calculated. The last two charts are original hypothetical calculations using independent inputs, not source fare or route estimates. Every included month has the same number of on-site days. A pass is bought in every included month, including one with zero on-site days, and covers every modeled transit trip. Per-use fare is the complete return-trip cash, without fare caps, transfers, concessions or non-work travel. Car cash includes only costs actually avoided when a return commute is not made; purchase cost, financing, retained insurance and other continuing ownership costs are excluded. One independently entered route takes the same time in both directions, including all travel components the reader supplies. Time is not converted into wages or available bank cash. The alternatives are separate scenarios and are not added together. No tax deduction, employer reimbursement, future fare inflation or recommendation of a travel mode is calculated.
c081cdb849d0903df48524bee0e08769680c83bb.zh: 前两张图表保留了 2025 年 5 月加拿大统计局的固定快照，于 2025 年 8 月 26 日发布并于 2026 年 10 月 25 日进行审查。所选的主模式份额和组均值不会随着个人控制而改变。通勤者通常大部分时间都在外面工作；调查人群为各省 15 岁至 69 岁的人群，排除来源如下。所选共享不是完整分区，并且不会重新规范化。不计算置信区间或因果估计。最后两张图表是使用独立输入的原始假设计算，而不是源票价或路线估计。每个包含的月份都有相同的现场天数。在每个包含的月份购买一张通行证，包括零现场天数的月份，并涵盖每次模拟的交通旅行。每次使用的票价是完整的返程现金，没有票价上限、转乘、优惠或非工作旅行。汽车现金仅包括不进行返程通勤时实际避免的费用；购买成本、融资、保留保险和其他持续拥有成本不包括在内。一条独立输入的路线在两个方向上花费相同的时间，包括阅读器提供的所有旅行组件。时间不会转化为工资或可用的银行现金。替代方案是单独的场景，不会添加在一起。不计算税收减免、雇主报销、未来票价上涨或旅行模式建议。

c02bce464b79a0ab8cce7e9502b13fdbe6a13a4f.src: Original hypothetical merchant gift-credit arrangement, not a current offer. Cash paid loads equal paid credit plus the entered bonus. Paid and bonus credit form one assumed noncash pool, with no expiry, fees or restrictions on the selected basket during the modeled horizon; actual paid and promotional balances may have different terms. Use is entered as a plan, not a forecast or probability, and occurs uniformly at each month-end. Basket amounts are comparable total checkout amounts; tax is not calculated separately. The alternative pays cash for exactly the same purchases when they occur at the selected lower total price. Prices stay fixed, and no interest, discounting, reward points or extra unplanned purchases are assumed. Remaining credit stays visible and is not written off, refunded or assigned a terminal cash value. The cash-outlay difference is therefore not an overall investment return, saving rate or realized loss. Positive means more cash has been committed to the card than the matched purchases have so far required elsewhere; negative means less.
c02bce464b79a0ab8cce7e9502b13fdbe6a13a4f.zh: 原始假设的商家礼品信贷安排，而不是当前优惠。现金支付的金额等于支付的信用额加上输入的奖金。付费和奖金信用形成一个假定的非现金池，在建模期限内所选篮子没有到期日、费用或限制；实际支付余额和促销余额可能有不同的条款。使用是作为计划而不是预测或概率输入的，并且在每个月末统一发生。篮子金额是可比较的总结账金额；税费不单独计算。另一种选择是在以选定的较低总价进行完全相同的购买时支付现金。价格保持固定，不存在利息、折扣、奖励积分或额外的计划外购买。剩余信用保持可见，不会被注销、退款或指定最终现金价值。因此，现金支出差异并不是总体投资回报、储蓄率或已实现损失。积极意味着该卡上投入的现金比迄今为止在其他地方进行的匹配购买所需的现金还要多；负数表示较少。

c0ec37ff8aac76b2b8ece7915e12ae1fe8e37052.src: The explorer starts with CAD 120,000 of hypothetical profit before owner salary. It assigns CAD 60,000 to salary, applies an editable 15% rate assumption to the CAD 60,000 left, and distributes the after-tax CAD 51,000 as a dividend. Under those deliberately narrow assumptions, the ledger is CAD 60,000 salary + CAD 9,000 assumed corporate tax + CAD 51,000 dividend = CAD 120,000. The owner’s CAD 111,000 gross receipts are before personal tax and payroll deductions. This is arithmetic, not a claim that 15% is the corporation’s actual rate.
c0ec37ff8aac76b2b8ece7915e12ae1fe8e37052.zh: 浏览器从 CAD 开始扣除所有者工资之前的假设利润为 120,000。它将 60,000 加元分配给工资，对剩余的 60,000 加元应用可编辑的 15% 利率假设，并将税后 51,000 加元作为股息分配。在这些刻意狭隘的假设下，账本是 60,000 加元工资 + 9,000 加元假设的公司税 + 51,000 加元股息 = 120,000 加元。业主的总收入为 111,000 加元，未扣除个人税和工资扣除额。这是算术计算，而不是声称 15% 是公司的实际利率。

c11a4e45664c08d335eafb026223f9423974f095.src: A household with two incomes can face four simplified receipt patterns: both continue, only A is absent, only B is absent, or both are absent. c11a4e45664c08d335eafb026223f9423974f095.zh: 拥有两种收入的家庭可能面临四种简化的收据模式：两者都继续，只有 A 不存在，只有 B 不存在，或者两者都不存在。即使家庭每月的普通支出不变，每种模式也会产生不同的现金需求。

c11a848a47a88ba17f872b457cd797426b4b8de3.src: The other CAD 4,000 is the difference between receipts and operating cash payments excluding GST/HST. It is a narrow operating cash subtotal, not a calculation of taxable income or an owner’s after-tax pay. Income tax, payroll, capital purchases, debt payments and other commitments are outside this tool.

c11fb813ec467c2631d4208e3205428084b431a2.src: This fixed comparison replaces the trade day and closure count while retaining the selected settlement and post-settlement waits. It always compares zero and one Day-8 closure, even if the main closure control is two or three. Longer bars mean a later calendar day of bank receipt, not more money or a probability. An arrival after Day 14 remains on its actual model day rather than being clipped into the bank ledger.
c11fb813ec467c2631d4208e3205428084b431a2.zh: 这种固定比较取代了交易日和平仓计数，同时保留了选定的结算和结算后等待。它总是比较零和一个 Day-8 闭合，即使主要闭合控制是两个或三个。较长的条形意味着银行收据的日历日较晚，而不是更多的钱或概率。第 14 天之后的到达仍保留在其实际模型日，而不是被夹入银行分类帐。

bfcec1acb65cae0ce10734f67702e375d0180f42.src: The default flat arrangement has ten days with a negative end-of-day transaction balance before the final interest debit. The per-debit arrangement has twelve. Fees can make a nearly balanced day negative and keep it negative until another receipt. The two paths therefore need separate ledgers rather than a common debt balance with two fee totals attached afterward.
bfcec1acb65cae0ce10734f67702e375d0180f42.zh: 默认固定安排在最终利息借记之前有十天的日终交易余额为负数。每借方安排有十二个。费用可能会使几乎平衡的一天变成负数，并在收到另一笔收据之前一直保持负数。因此，这两条路径需要单独的账本，而不是共同的债务余额，并在之后附加两项费用总额。

bfcf5585d8929944b99b14fa12f6e2452c15a490.src: Each survival line starts at 100% at age 65. Later points divide the source’s survivor count at that age by its survivor count at 65, within the same sex category: conditional survival = lx ÷ l65. This conditioning matters because the comparison begins with people who have already reached 65.
bfcf5585d8929944b99b14fa12f6e2452c15a490.zh: 每条生存线从 65 岁开始为 100%。后面的点将源在该年龄的幸存者计数除以同一性别类别中 65 岁的幸存者计数：条件生存 = lx ÷ l65。这种条件很重要，因为比较是从已经年满 65 岁的人开始的。

bfd021c1c311fb6f2af69bd61ce3aeee4914ad2e.src: Different arrangements may also change the caregiver’s earnings, travel or support eligibility. The fixed-grid comparison isolates hours and duration, so those related effects must be considered separately. A new quote or confirmed work schedule provides a reason to update the inputs.
bfd021c1c311fb6f2af69bd61ce3aeee4914ad2e.zh: 不同的安排也可能会改变看护者的收入、旅行或赡养资格。固定网格比较隔离了时间和持续时间，因此必须单独考虑这些相关影响。新的报价或确认的工作计划提供了更新输入的理由。

bfd76825f65d6d8794d9287d18c41d909886aeaa.src: Gross EAP and contribution refunds are different payment types. The ledger deducts only the entered budget allowance from EAP, without calculating a student’s tax. Positive cash can arise from outside funding above the budget; negative cash is an unfunded need.
bfd76825f65d6d8794d9287d18c41d909886aeaa.zh: 总 EAP 和缴款退款是不同的付款类型。分类账仅从 EAP 中扣除输入的预算津贴，而不计算学生的税款。超出预算的外部资金可以产生正现金；负现金是一种没有资金支持的需求。

bfd958152acc25a0f5cc071aa0de68d57db7b13a.zh: 在从标题限制得出结论之前更改重叠

bfd9ef4bd8219da3bd578cc4d5c9d73508d40d53.src: Each bar is an authored assignment of zero to three simultaneous jobs, not a survey answer. Person C’s three jobs are one person holding three positions. A zero bar means no job in this tally alone; it does not establish unemployment, job search, hours, pay or Labour Force Survey eligibility. The four values sum to the position total, which is not the number of people.
bfd9ef4bd8219da3bd578cc4d5c9d73508d40d53.zh: 每个条形图都是针对零到三个同时工作的创作作业，而不是调查回答。 C人三职即一人身兼三职。零条意味着仅在这个统计中没有工作；它不规定失业、求职、工作时间、工资或劳动力调查资格。这四个值的总和就是职位总数，而不是人数。

9f770113c145265068e585f45eabc53d7bc5e73c.src: Twelve CAD 200 instalments total CAD 2,400. Against the CAD 2,760 modeled cost, the provider balance is an extra CAD 360 charge. The waterfall shows this reconciliation without deducting the household reserve, because that cash has not yet been paid.
9f770113c145265068e585f45eabc53d7bc5e73c.zh: 分十二期 200 加元，总计 2,400 加元。相对于 2,760 加元的模拟成本，提供商余额是额外的 360 加元费用。瀑布显示了这种调节，但没有扣除家庭准备金，因为现金尚未支付。

9f94aea399bc0cb3c3451f51673bcb54ad5ed54e.src: Read the monthly commitment, full payment total, fee and effective cash-flow measure together. A lower payment can help a monthly budget while extending indebtedness. A lower annualized measure can coexist with a larger full-term dollar cost. None of those measures alone decides whether the loan meets a household’s needs.
9f94aea399bc0cb3c3451f51673bcb54ad5ed54e.zh: 一起阅读每月承诺、全额付款总额、费用和有效现金流量指标。较低的付款可以帮助每月预算，同时扩大债务。较低的年化指标可以与较高的长期美元成本共存。这些措施都不能单独决定贷款是否满足家庭的需求。

9f95312cca573b98ffd316ea4128b6346f0ca5c9.src: Set the flexible share to zero. Both policies then request the fully indexed amount, whatever trigger or cut is entered. This is a useful reality check for a budget dominated by essentials: a theoretical adjustment strategy cannot assume discretionary spending that does not exist.
9f95312cca573b98ffd316ea4128b6346f0ca5c9.zh: 将灵活份额设置为零。然后，无论输入什么触发器或削减，这两个策略都请求完全索引的金额。对于以基本要素为主的预算来说，这是一个有用的现实检验：理论上的调整策略不能假设不存在的可自由支配支出。

9f9ab04ddcae4f464bd46e24baacfe62a90e8089.src: The first two charts are fixed official Canadian Housing Survey observations for the stated cycles; the population is households in the provinces. Each tenure percentage has its own household-group denominator. The remaining charts and all headline metrics use an independent hypothetical budget. The before-tax and net income entries are separate assumptions; no payroll deduction or tax calculation reconciles them. This simple budget ratio does not reproduce the survey’s full measurement process or establish lender eligibility. Monthly cash equals net income minus shelter, other living costs, other debt payments and assigned saving. Shelter costs must include the cash expenses relevant to the household; mortgage principal is still cash leaving the budget. No regional quote, investment return, tax benefit, debt approval or official core-housing-need assessment is calculated. Negative cash is a monthly funding shortfall.
9f9ab04ddcae4f464bd46e24baacfe62a90e8089.zh: 前两张图表是固定周期的加拿大住房调查官方观察结果；人口是各省的家庭。每个保有权百分比都有其自己的家庭群体分母。其余图表和所有标题指标均使用独立的假设预算。税前收入和净利润条目是单独的假设；没有工资扣除或税收计算可以调节它们。这个简单的预算比率并不能重现调查的完整衡量过程或确定贷款人的资格。每月现金等于净收入减去住房、其他生活费用、其他债务支付和指定储蓄。住房费用必须包括与家庭相关的现金支出；抵押贷款本金仍然是离开预算的现金。不计算区域报价、投资回报、税收优惠、债务批准或官方核心住房需求评估。负现金是指每月的资金短缺。

c157296081fc8eba3fcebc417fccc0bd5827f1ae.src: A distribution is a payment from a fund to its holders. Net asset value, or NAV, describes the value remaining per unit. c15948e56a3221667a0c4a78cac57c2d2cbbe16d.src: The first two charts are fixed 2023 Survey of Financial Security observations for Canada, all ages, economic families and persons not in an economic family. Balance amounts are 2023 constant CAD. Published 95% confidence intervals are shown; they describe sampling uncertainty in the estimates, not the range of individual family debts. Categories overlap and are not additive. The last two charts and all metrics use a separate invented, unweighted population of exactly 100 family units, with every debt holder owing the same entered positive amount and everyone else owing zero. No source estimate initializes these controls. The toy population is not a reconstruction of the survey or a model of a reader’s household. Its mean is calculable because every individual value is specified; actual published medians and holding shares alone do not identify a population mean. With zero holders the conditional median is unavailable, rather than zero.
c15948e56a3221667a0c4a78cac57c2d2cbbe16d.zh: 前两张图表是固定的 2023 年加拿大金融安全调查观察结果，涵盖所有年龄段、经济家庭和非经济家庭人员。余额金额为 2023 年不变的加元。显示已发布的 95% 置信区间；他们描述了估计中的抽样不确定性，而不是单个家庭债务的范围。类别重叠且不相加。最后两张图表和所有指标均使用单独发明的、未加权的恰好 100 个家庭单位的人口，每个债务持有者所欠的金额相同，输入的正数相同，而其他人所欠的金额为零。没有源估计初始化这些控件。玩具人口并不是调查的重建，也不是读者家庭的模型。它的平均值是可以计算的，因为每个单独的值都是指定的；实际公布的中位数和持有股份本身并不能确定总体平均值。如果持有人为零，则条件中位数不可用，而不是零。

c226e6b06fb73ef1f87aa4134f5ca028c568113e.src: Let B be starting savings, G the goal, N the number of deposits, k the loss month and h the exposed share multiplied by the loss percentage, both expressed as fractions. When the loss occurs within the horizon, final savings equal B(1 − h) + C[N − (k − 1)h]. Solving for C and flooring it at zero gives the required contribution. The term involving k matters because the first k − 1 deposits also lose money.
c226e6b06fb73ef1f87aa4134f5ca028c568113e.zh: 设 B 为起始储蓄，G 为目标，N 为存款数量，k 为损失月份，h 为暴露份额乘以损失百分比，两者均以分数表示。当损失发生在范围内时，最终节省等于B(1 − h) + C[N − (k − 1)h]。求解 C 并将其定为零即可给出所需的贡献。涉及 k 的项很重要，因为前 k − 1 笔存款也会亏损。

c34d33a077a9e2c0bdf34765808c50408f6db6ee.src: The forward model should preserve these distinctions. Allow a normal credit charge, avoid extrapolating a particularly strong capital-markets quarter indefinitely, and make tax and share assumptions visible. A conservative model can still recognize real productivity benefits. The falsifier is not simply a smaller adjusted-to-reported gap; it is a failure of common earnings to grow after the unusually helpful comparisons and repurchase effects fade.

c3a3bb16f9ef940195d6b67b39f5701243eda083.src: Each bar totals scheduled loan repayments plus insurance paid from separate cash, without discounting. In the financed case, the premium is repaid as principal and its interest is in the interest segment. The premium is counted once. A lower cost does not establish that two policies provide the same protection or that having no policy meets a household need.
c3a3bb16f9ef940195d6b67b39f5701243eda083.zh: 每条柱总计计划贷款偿还加上单独现金支付的保险，没有折扣。在融资情况下，保费作为本金偿还，其利息属于利息部分。保费只计算一次。较低的成本并不表明两项保单提供相同的保护，或者没有保单可以满足家庭需求。

c3a4fa560b8caef6b7261b6f17e67622064ed13a.src: Month zero includes the purchase or cash-paid financing fee. A negative point exposes funding that the monthly budget has not yet supplied. The full month-end ledger is distinct from this payment-date view. Borrowing keeps more cash initially while creating required future payments.
c3a4fa560b8caef6b7261b6f17e67622064ed13a.zh: 第零个月包括购买或现金支付的融资费用。负点暴露了每月预算尚未提供的资金。完整的月末分类账与此付款日期视图不同。借款最初可以保留更多现金，同时创建未来所需的付款。

c3a5fc13b6f1900bd973d826032bfeea1d44ccf4.src: Putting all available cash into FCU fixes the number of foreign units held in this model. It does not establish that the starting budget was large enough.

c2aea376165106a999aa2d195695fe8037ab40dd.src: The selected 2022 estimates are 20.1% for ages 15–24, 24.1% for ages 25–64 and 40.4% for ages 65+. The denominators differ by age group. c2cb0217e141c9f252f8d28ea45350dd2a7cd9cc.src: The model excludes declined payments, NSF charges, linked-account transfers and subsequent-month repayment. It does not compare an authorized overdraft with an unauthorized missed payment or assess eligibility for credit. Its purpose is to show why monthly averages, transaction counts and borrowing days belong together. Reducing charges can help, but a recurring gap also needs a household cash-flow plan and a feasible reserve-building schedule.
c2cb0217e141c9f252f8d28ea45350dd2a7cd9cc.zh: 该模型不包括拒绝付款、NSF 费用、关联帐户转账和后续月份还款。它不会将授权透支与未经授权的逾期付款进行比较，也不会评估信贷资格。其目的是展示为什么月平均数、交易数和借贷天数属于同一组。减少费用会有所帮助，但经常性的缺口还需要家庭现金流计划和可行的储备建设时间表。

c2cdcaa58701c3c92a444c79e94a67159abe46c6.src: Rows vary additional annual spending and columns vary the assumed average retirement tax fraction. Current gross pay and all four current budget shares stay fixed. The cells solve spending divided by one minus the tax fraction, then divide by current gross pay. They are conditional calculations, not published replacement-rate statistics, tax forecasts or recommended targets.
c2cdcaa58701c3c92a444c79e94a67159abe46c6.zh: 行改变额外的年度支出，列改变假设的平均退休税比例。当前的总工资和所有四个当前预算份额保持不变。这些单元计算支出除以一减去税收分数，然后除以当前总工资。它们是有条件的计算，而不是公布的替代率统计数据、税收预测或建议目标。

c2d150f94815c634b572fe9986eebb91e5fce1a5.src: The stacked bars track financial resources separately from the room bars. Before the withdrawal, CAD 8,000 is inside the account. Afterward, CAD 8,000 is outside as retained cash. The total is unchanged by the withdrawal because the model assumes no fees or spending.
c2d150f94815c634b572fe9986eebb91e5fce1a5.zh: 堆叠条与房间条分开跟踪财务资源。提款前，账户内有8000加元。随后，8,000 加元作为保留现金存入外部。提款后总额不会改变，因为该模型假设没有任何费用或支出。

c3d121459d348ec680fba6866cf6e9b5736f9945.src: A zero cell means all units have vested under that mathematical schedule. It does not establish that shares were delivered, that a sale can settle in time or that the proceeds will cover a goal. A positive cell is the gross value still attached to unvested units, rather than a probability-weighted loss.
c3d121459d348ec680fba6866cf6e9b5736f9945.zh: 零单元格表示所有单位均已根据该数学时间表归属。它并没有确定股票是否已交付、出售是否可以及时结算或收益是否可以实现目标。正单元格是仍附加于未归属单位的总价值，而不是概率加权损失。

c3db6d824d256b2daee394d4ae764023824ded8b.src: Those financed fees are not an additional cash advance available for household spending. They nevertheless become part of the balance on which the hypothetical loan interest accumulates. Paying them separately would require a different opening cash plan and a smaller financed balance.
c3db6d824d256b2daee394d4ae764023824ded8b.zh: 这些融资费用不是可用于家庭支出的额外现金预支。然而，它们成为假设贷款利息累积的余额的一部分。单独支付将需要不同的期初现金计划和较小的融资余额。

c3dda5d478445bd5bab1f5e1e142b7e4fdcbbf69.src: Price scenarios can test a range without declaring one survey answer a forecast
c3dda5d478445bd5bab1f5e1e142b7e4fdcbbf69.zh: 价格情景可以测试一个范围，而无需声明一项调查答案为预测

c3dfc617c26bac55921dc32ab196b3bdfc912a58.src: The top-up is included explicitly so every shown cash component is nonnegative. Each stack totals cash, receivables and stock under the hypothetical funded plan. It does not imply the owner can spend the whole stack: an invoice must be collected and inventory must be sold. The inventory value is a cost-carrying illustration, not an estimate of resale proceeds.
c3dfc617c26bac55921dc32ab196b3bdfc912a58.zh: 明确包含充值，因此每个显示的现金部分都是非负的。每个堆栈总计现金、应收账款和假设资助计划下的库存。这并不意味着所有者可以花掉整个堆栈：必须收取发票并必须出售库存。库存价值只是成本说明，而不是转售收益的估计。

c3e1c639018987c951ab84de2932d74b55d7e8d5.src: The chart models one balance and cannot decide the entire order of repayment. Arrears, essential living costs, secured obligations, promotional terms and restrictions may change priorities. It also does not value employer matching contributions, tax effects or access to emergency cash.
c3e1c639018987c951ab84de2932d74b55d7e8d5.zh: 该图表模拟了一项余额，无法决定整个还款顺序。欠款、基本生活费用、担保义务、促销条款和限制可能会改变优先事项。它还不重视雇主匹配的缴款、税收影响或获得紧急现金的机会。

c3e7c34ae5a3541383ee686f87308afe50d0825e.zh: 报销最高限额可以更改以后的索赔数据

c3e8c3da84f5e940020431f8df7e242f32f44cf0.src: A quoted hourly rate becomes annual cash only through hours you can sell and collect. Budget unpaid work and fixed costs before treating the quote as a household income rate.

c40639571a56058461ac0e05bbe1589cccb3078d.src: The instalment remains CAD 200 per month. After the first allocated cost and payment, the provider ledger is positive CAD 145. This interim difference is not treated as an overdue bill under the hypothetical arrangement. It simply records cost accumulated beyond the instalments paid so far.
c40639571a56058461ac0e05bbe1589cccb3078d.zh: 分期付款仍为每月 200 加元。在第一次分配成本和付款后，提供商分类帐为正 145 加元。根据假设安排，此中期差异不会被视为逾期账单。它只是记录迄今为止已支付的分期付款之外的累计成本。

c407d09712ba7d8097417bbc52f457b4e2871a8f.src: A sufficient eventual sale receipt can arrive too late for an earlier bill. Check the bank-receipt date as well as the trade and settlement dates.
c407d09712ba7d8097417bbc52f457b4e2871a8f.zh: 足够的最终销售收据对于较早的账单来说可能太晚了。检查银行收据日期以及交易和结算日期。

c40b2bfa6035555e5068c1ee4c272ef3597af1ee.src: Each curve jumps only at its two possible return values and is flat between them. The vertical coordinate includes the probability exactly at a return. The goal-failure metrics instead use strictly below the required return, so subtract any probability at the goal when reading a jump. The horizontal axis is return, not elapsed time. The table retains the jump locations.
c40b2bfa6035555e5068c1ee4c272ef3597af1ee.zh: 每条曲线仅在其两个可能的返回值处跳跃，并且在它们之间平坦。纵坐标包括恰好返回的概率。相反，目标失败指标严格使用低于所需回报的值，因此在读取跳跃时减去目标的任何概率。横轴是返回时间，而不是经过时间。该表保留跳转位置。

c40d1de98f528d7928f348bc149d4087b3f5901b.src: The default is CAD 30,000 with fifteen required years left. Its first calendar label is 2031. The tool does not establish a withdrawal’s eligibility, identify a first due year from a withdrawal date or apply special repayment exceptions.

c46802e93cb74c91a41e8b88356d7f70651df6c3.src: The derived household cash commitment is CAD 291.67 + CAD 100 = approximately CAD 391.67 per month, with full precision retained in the calculation. The borrowing case pays its interest and invests the remaining CAD 100. The no-loan case invests the entire common amount.

c47af14654deb597750202851c3e466135f6c4b1.src: Its cell is duration-only estimated value minus exact model value. A negative number means the tangent is below the exact curve. For an upward shock that can mean an overstated loss; for a downward shock it can mean an understated gain.
c47af14654deb597750202851c3e466135f6c4b1.zh: 其单元格是仅持续时间的估计值减去精确模型值。负数表示切线位于精确曲线下方。对于可能意味着夸大损失的向上冲击；对于下行冲击，这可能意味着低估的收益。

c47e642e79cfddb0ea4b849e0e6ceffa02674f01.src: The full monthly running budget is paid at the start of each month. Income arrives at month-end. Even if there is no additional benefit-processing gap, cash is still needed for the first bills before that income arrives.
c47e642e79cfddb0ea4b849e0e6ceffa02674f01.zh: 每月月初支付全额每月运行预算。月底到账。即使没有额外的福利处理缺口，在收入到达之前，第一张账单仍然需要现金。

c47f174cf3a6cc7b9f45197089e24c442c5ceace.src: Both cases receive the same face amount from the issuer. The funded plan retains part of each coupon instead of spending it, and requires outside deposits if the coupon is insufficient. Its extra ending capital is not a free gain or higher bond coupon. Cumulative household consumption differs between the cases. When the price is below face value, the premium reserve is zero and maturity face value already exceeds the purchase price.
c47f174cf3a6cc7b9f45197089e24c442c5ceace.zh: 两种情况都会从发行人那里收到相同的票面金额。资助计划保留每张优惠券的一部分而不是花费它，如果优惠券不足，则需要外部存款。其额外期末资本不是免费收益或更高的债券息票。不同情况下的累计家庭消费有所不同。当价格低于面值时，溢价准备金为零，到期面值已超过购买价格。

c480bc498887d64ef2a3dc2d4286f8efcfedf0df.src: These cells are sensitivity calculations, not estimates of investment success. The matrix does not assign probabilities, and it does not allow you to choose a return simply because it is needed to meet a goal.
c480bc498887d64ef2a3dc2d4286f8efcfedf0df.zh: 这些单元格是敏感性计算，而不是投资成功的估计。该矩阵不会分配概率，并且不允许您仅仅因为需要实现目标而选择回报。

c4844eef1d25ff1a3c1a0b3c6cbcb51fcc9251c6.src: A larger cash balance can come from borrowing rather than operations
c4844eef1d25ff1a3c1a0b3c6cbcb51fcc9251c6.zh: 更大的现金余额可以来自借款而不是运营

c48456753ea883a38ccf5227579577438439ecd5.src: The two models share a CAD 10,000 advance at time zero and twenty-four payments, each received at a month-end. The first payment arrives after one complete month. Fees, insurance and other charges are excluded, allowing the rate-base calculation to be inspected separately.
c48456753ea883a38ccf5227579577438439ecd5.zh: 这两个模型在第 0 次和第 24 次付款时共享 10,000 加元的预付款，每次付款均在月末收到。第一笔付款将在一个月后到达。费用、保险和其他费用被排除在外，从而可以单独检查费率基础计算。

c486334bbc9ce7d861e9808156b89a1211fc6436.src: A merchant bonus can add purchasing credit without adding money to a bank account. Before evaluating the percentage, record how much cash must be paid, how much credit is loaded, where it can be used and which planned purchases will actually use it.
c486334bbc9ce7d861e9808156b89a1211fc6436.zh: 商家奖金可以增加购买信用，而无需向银行账户添加资金。在评估百分比之前，记录必须支付多少现金、加载多少信用额、可以在哪里使用以及哪些计划购买将实际使用它。

c48654babc1fbe68d3c338b4f3346a8993801cce.src: Only the gross beneficiary payment is directed to the beneficiary. The separate assistance repayment goes to government. This bridge reconciles the plan alone; it does not treat any cash retained outside the plan as having disappeared from the household.
c48654babc1fbe68d3c338b4f3346a8993801cce.zh: 只有受益人付款总额会直接发送给受益人。单独的援助偿还款归政府所有。这座桥单独协调了计划；它不会将计划外保留的任何现金视为已从家庭中消失。

c4897ff0e784104614b24440d097c1a965eb9c8e.src: Replacement reserves and routine upkeep have different cash roles · CAD
c4897ff0e784104614b24440d097c1a965eb9c8e.zh: 重置储备金和日常维护具有不同的现金角色 · CAD

c48abbe23eb02bac7735d3a246450364674bd3e7.src: Opening cash is available on day 0. The one cleared receipt enters on its usable day and the full minimum is deducted on its funding day. On a shared day the receipt is usable first; the plot shows only the resulting day-end balance, with no intraday claim. A negative segment is a funding gap, not an assumed loan, actual bank overdraft or permission to delay payment. No later cash receipt retroactively funds an earlier deadline.
c48abbe23eb02bac7735d3a246450364674bd3e7.zh: 期初现金在第 0 天可用。一张清算收据在其可用日进入，并在其融资日扣除全部最低金额。在共同的日子里，收据首先可以使用；该图仅显示最终的日终余额，没有日内索赔。负部分是资金缺口，而不是假定的贷款、实际的银行透支或允许延迟付款。较晚收到的现金不会追溯至较早截止日期。

c48c0b0cef5011adf8c4e1a9cc50294c021ea0cf.src: At an exact jump, distinguish “at or below” from “strictly below.” The cumulative curve includes the probability at that return. The goal metrics count equality as success. A goal requiring exactly +10% therefore fails only in the unequal case’s lower outcome, whereas a goal requiring +11% fails in both its possible outcomes.
c48c0b0cef5011adf8c4e1a9cc50294c021ea0cf.zh: 在精确跳跃时，区分“等于或低于”和“严格低于”。累积曲线包括该回报的概率。目标指标将平等视为成功。因此，精确要求 +10% 的目标仅在不平等情况下的较低结果中失败，而要求 +11% 的目标则在两种可能的结果中都失败。

c4968788975129191f62545d63162802bf50c281.src: Multiplying by the selected 1.40 CAD per FCU produces a CAD 30,596.36 reference cost, before rounding the intermediate calculation. The example then adds a 2% conversion charge, approximately CAD 611.93, and one CAD 25 fee. The full unrounded calculation gives a terminal funding target of CAD 31,233.28.
c4968788975129191f62545d63162802bf50c281.zh: 乘以所选的每个 FCU 1.40 加元会得出 30,596.36 加元的参考成本，然后再舍入中间计算。然后，该示例添加了 2% 的兑换费，约为 611.93 加元，以及一笔 25 加元的费用。完整的四舍五入计算得出的最终融资目标为 31,233.28 加元。

c49bd280b5e2bd08ecce5edc3ca4eef45f4ce01a.src: The same expression equals P(y) × (1+y)<sup>H</sup>, where P(y) is the value at time zero of all remaining payments discounted at y. This identity checks the complete cash ledger; it does not mean the investor originally paid the changed-yield price P(y). The actual purchase price remains the value calculated using the original yield.
c49bd280b5e2bd08ecce5edc3ca4eef45f4ce01a.zh: 相同的表达式等于 P(y) × (1+y)<sup>H</sup>，其中 P(y) 是在 y 贴现的所有剩余付款在零时间的值。该身份检查完整的现金分类账；这并不意味着投资者最初支付了改变后的收益率价格P(y)。实际购买价格仍然是使用原始收益率计算的值。

c49cc51f0b20cfbd35f74199d942e0eb53822c48.src: The final waterfall begins with the CAD 100,000 investment, adds the CAD 2,000 opening outside reserve, CAD 3,000 of new monthly saving and CAD 21,665.29 of gross interest, then subtracts all modeled tax. The arithmetic cash endpoint is approximately CAD 120,165.70.
c49cc51f0b20cfbd35f74199d942e0eb53822c48.zh: 最终的瀑布从 100,000 加元的投资开始，加上 2,000 加元的外部储备金、3,000 加元的每月新储蓄和 21,665.29 加元的总利息，然后减去所有模型税。算术现金端点约为 120,165.70 加元。

c49e772762a90d177795cd7808e3c3b27a9cff3b.src: Independent source rounding can make sums differ by a tenth of a percentage point in some years. Keep the source values instead of silently changing a component to force exact agreement. The population total also does not determine a household’s food-spending target, because it contains no suitable household-specific cost or dietary requirement.
c49e772762a90d177795cd7808e3c3b27a9cff3b.zh: 独立来源舍入可能会使总和在某些年份相差十分之一个百分点。保留源值，而不是默默地更改组件以强制完全一致。人口总数也不能确定家庭的食品支出目标，因为它不包含合适的家庭特定成本或饮食要求。

c49f3d43a1f0f0d99d4db7986aab489ea12e79d4.src: The bars display all three amounts so the request is not silently confused with the modeled withdrawal. If opening assets are zero, both the minimum and available gross withdrawal are zero. The separate spending input can still show an unfunded requirement.
c49f3d43a1f0f0d99d4db7986aab489ea12e79d4.zh: 条形图显示所有三个金额，因此请求不会默默地与建模提款混淆。如果期初资产为零，则最低提款额和可用总提款额均为零。单独的支出输入仍然可以显示无资金支持的需求。

c4a000732546bfa390fbc9a15d968ab9defecfc3.src: The matrix changes upfront cost and the proportion of the estimated gross bill saving that materializes. Maintenance, price growth, discount rate and operating years remain selected. A lower saving can materially change the result even if the installation price is unchanged.
c4a000732546bfa390fbc9a15d968ab9defecfc3.zh: 该矩阵会更改前期成本以及预计实现的总账单节省的比例。维护、价格增长、折扣率和运营年限仍处于选择状态。即使安装价格不变，较低的节省也会显着改变结果。

c4a6aecf283d87bd92fe27817ffdd6db1e7adb5b.src: Method dollars equal its whole count times its assumed mean ticket. At the defaults, 6 × 5 + 3 × 40 + 1 × 350 = CAD 500, and CAD 500 ÷ 10 purchases gives a mean of CAD 50. This is a mean, not a median. Raising only the credit ticket to CAD 700 gives CAD 850 total and a mean of CAD 85 while its count share remains 10%. Relabeling the same completed purchases does not change their total cost; a different chosen price or fee would be a different scenario.
c4a6aecf283d87bd92fe27817ffdd6db1e7adb5b.zh: 方法美元等于其总数乘以假定的平均门票。默认情况下，6 × 5 + 3 × 40 + 1 × 350 = 500 加元，购买 500 加元 ÷ 10 得出的平均值为 50 加元。这是平均值，而不是中位数。仅将信用票提高到 700 加元，总计即可达到 850 加元，平均值为 85 加元，而其计数份额仍为 10%。重新标记相同的已完成采购不会改变其总成本；选择不同的价格或费用将导致不同的情况。

c4ea9ed89b580157970aa1584030a288ba5bc300.src: The matrix changes term and yield while preserving face and coupon. A cell is a price at one date. It does not include coupons already received or a future return calculation. Compare the same column across terms to see how a longer stream of fixed payments changes the sensitivity.
c4ea9ed89b580157970aa1584030a288ba5bc300.zh: 该矩阵改变了期限和收益率，同时保留了面子和息票。一个单元格是一个日期的价格。它不包括已收到的优惠券或未来的回报计算。比较不同期限的同一列，了解较长的固定付款流如何改变敏感度。

c4f306350311a295d4884d038545028f6b5edef3.src: The five locations were selected to show several relationships between the measures. They are not a complete ranking of Canadian rental markets, a sample of equivalent apartments or evidence that a particular household should relocate. A CMA also covers a broader area than a single neighbourhood.
c4f306350311a295d4884d038545028f6b5edef3.zh: 选择这五个地点是为了显示措施之间的若干关系。它们不是加拿大租赁市场的完整排名、同等公寓的样本或特定家庭应该搬迁的证据。 CMA 覆盖的区域也比单个社区更广泛。

c4f4f3f2316d4457aad4d3adf365f9bd9742a129.src: The ending balance is CAD 51,200. Its nominal increase is 2.4%, rather than the 4% gross rate. The tax assumption is deliberately simple: it does not calculate federal or provincial brackets, credits, deductions or benefit reductions for a particular household.
c4f4f3f2316d4457aad4d3adf365f9bd9742a129.zh: 期末余额为 51,200 加元。其名义增长率为2.4%，而不是4%的毛利率。税收假设故意简单：它不会计算特定家庭的联邦或省级等级、抵免、扣除或福利减免。

c4f8f213772ed90d03ab9036d4e28d6475d28103.src: Public sources reviewed on 25 October 2026. All four graphics use a curated public Statistics Canada snapshot from Table 11-10-0099-01, released 28 July 2026. The first graphic rebases each reported series to its own 2021 reference value; the other graphics show reported counts. The year control filters that snapshot, with no forecast or personal pension calculation. Original scenario calculations and research checklists are TickerLantern’s educational analysis; attributed publisher examples retain their stated source and scope. Recheck current issuer documents for any product-specific decision.
c4f8f213772ed90d03ab9036d4e28d6475d28103.zh: 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查的公共来源。所有四张图表均使用 2026 年 7 月 28 日发布的表 11-10-0099-01 中加拿大统计局精心整理的公共快照。第一个图表将每个报告的系列重新设定为自己的基础2021年参考值；其他图形显示报告的计数。年份控件过滤该快照，没有预测或个人养老金计算。原创情景计算和研究清单是 TickerLantern 的教育分析；归属出版商的示例保留其声明的来源和范围。重新检查当前发行人文件以了解任何特定于产品的决策。

c4bbf8a2043773b1b1b3afc6b4ed518351d2e8c2.src: Original hypothetical twelve-month comparison for the same account and included services. The entered working floor is the lowest closing balance already planned after ordinary transactions, not the average balance or the full emergency fund. Extra cash is the positive difference between the waiver threshold and that floor. Sufficient additional cash is assumed available at the start. Holding it keeps all waiver conditions satisfied for all twelve months and earns no interest in chequing. Without that extra cash, the fee is charged every month unless the existing floor already qualifies. Both choices start with the same extra cash and receive the same monthly household budget equal to the fee. Unspent monthly budget is retained separately at zero return. In the no-addition choice, the starting extra cash earns the selected effective annual return after its own tax and costs and is not used to pay fees. The normal working cash and other household resources are common and excluded. No actual account quote, daily transaction path, missed waiver, transfer delay, overdraft, product rebate, inflation or personal tax calculation is modeled.
c4bbf8a2043773b1b1b3afc6b4ed518351d2e8c2.zh: 同一帐户和所含服务的原始假设 12 个月比较。输入的工作底线是正常交易后已计划的最低期末余额，而不是平均余额或全额应急资金。额外现金是豁免门槛与该下限之间的正差。假设一开始就有足够的额外现金可用。持有它可以在十二个月内满足所有豁免条件，并且不会赚取支票利息。如果没有额外的现金，除非现有楼层已经符合条件，否则每月都会收取费用。两种选择都以相同的额外现金开始，并获得与费用相同的每月家庭预算。未支出的每月预算单独保留，零回报。在不添加选择中，起始额外现金在扣除自身税费和成本后赚取选定的有效年度回报，并且不用于支付费用。正常的工作现金和其他家庭资源是常见的，但不包括在内。没有对实际账户报价、每日交易路径、错过豁免、转账延迟、透支、产品返利、通货膨胀或个人税计算进行建模。

c4d416e15ee17181516dde1fc2b8e948e9d8b97d.src: One original hypothetical share-linked award, with alternative service-only vesting schedules applied to the same units. “Cliff” means none until the selected whole-year milestone, then all; “gradual” means equal portions after each completed year until full vesting. A single independent CAD share-price assumption values all units and scenarios; it is not a price quote, stock forecast, accounting grant-date fair value or guaranteed payment. No shares are sold and no cash is credited. All amounts are gross, before tax, withholding and dealing costs. Vesting does not establish delivery timing, permission to sell or spendable proceeds. Fractional units are retained mathematically; actual award rounding is not modeled.

c51a797e85283d8ac27f19fd247ca9caeee08dec.src: Hypothetical contracts, not insurance quotations. Both are assumed in force with any modeled death claim fully eligible and accepted. Mortgage-life limit equals the scheduled debt; an individual policy has the entered fixed benefit. Premiums are assumed flat for the comparison horizon; the mortgage-life premium stops after the month the debt is fully paid, while the individual premium continues. The same mortgage uses an unchanged nominal rate compounded semiannually, converted to an equivalent monthly rate, with month-end payments. No renewal-rate change, underwriting, policy exclusion, taxes, death probability, cash surrender value, investment alternative, portability decision or claims advice is modeled. Displayed claims are conditional amounts, not expected receipts.
c51a797e85283d8ac27f19fd247ca9caeee08dec.zh: 假设合同，而非保险报价。假定两者均有效，任何模拟死亡索赔均完全符合资格并被接受。抵押贷款期限等于预定债务；个人保单已输入固定利益。假设比较范围内保费持平；抵押贷款终身保费在债务完全偿还的月份后停止，而个人保费则继续。同一抵押贷款使用不变的名义利率，每半年复利一次，转换为等值的月利率，并在月底付款。没有对续保率变化、承保、保单排除、税收、死亡概率、现金退保价值、投资选择、可转移性决策或索赔建议进行建模。显示的索赔金额为有条件金额，而非预期收据。

c5b5728fe39b9ad18e968607a1f863a092875885.src: 2025-return guide reviewed 25 October 2026 for general disposition and capital-gain calculation context. No published inclusion rate, deduction or personal tax result is imported. The model uses an independent constant tax fraction on the full realized gain and invented payment dates.
c5b5728fe39b9ad18e968607a1f863a092875885.zh: 2025 年回报指南已于 2026 年 10 月 25 日审查，以了解一般处置和资本利得计算背景。不导入公布的包含率、扣除额或个人税结果。该模型对全部实现的收益和发明的付款日期使用独立的固定税率。

c5b73ffc4a1fa13c99608cbbaf2567be1c8a09f5.src: At the 100% setting, one full year of the 2026 dated increment represents CAD 656.28 in twelve gross monthly payments (CAD 54.69 × 12). Dividing CAD 4,430.10 by that annual amount gives about 6.75 years, so a simple undiscounted arithmetic crossing occurs during the seventh full year. This is not a personal break-even age, investment return, recommendation or lifetime guarantee analysis. It ignores the employer-side contribution as a cost to the employee, tax, annual indexing, payment processing, the time value of money, other income-tested benefits, the possibility of death, and the actual age and contribution history. CPP benefits can also affect other income-tested programs.
c5b73ffc4a1fa13c99608cbbaf2567be1c8a09f5.zh: 在 100% 设置下，2026 年的一整年增量代表 12 笔每月付款总额 656.28 加元 (CAD 54.69 × 12)。将 4,430.10 加元除以该年度金额得出大约 6.75 年，因此在第七个完整年份中会发生简单的未贴现算术交叉。这不是个人收支平衡年龄、投资回报、推荐或终身保证分析。它忽略了雇主方缴款作为雇员的成本、税收、年度索引、付款处理、货币时间价值、其他收入测试福利、死亡可能性以及实际年龄和缴款历史。 CPP 福利还会影响其他收入测试计划。

c5bacabac20f7441dc3925931cd8d7af6319cae4.src: Ten hand-picked returns cannot establish a sustainable withdrawal rate or a probability of success. There is no statistical confidence interval here, no simulation distribution and no claim that either sequence is likely to occur.
c5bacabac20f7441dc3925931cd8d7af6319cae4.zh: 十项精心挑选的回报无法确定可持续的提款率或成功概率。这里没有统计置信区间，没有模拟分布，也没有声称任何一个序列都可能发生。

c5ceffccaa7758e7b8ba2132cf6fcc74809e478a.src: A tax-timing comparison can be distorted if one investment is shown before tax while another has already paid it. c5ceffccaa7758e7b8ba2132cf6fcc74809e478a.zh: 如果之前显示一项投资，则纳税时间比较可能会被扭曲税，而另一个人已经缴纳了税款。从相同的资源开始，使用一致的回报假设，并在比较两个结果之前确定最终市场价值中仍然包含的任何税收。

c5cfae48e9cb184459bb7ee38212a6032b894dcc.src: The five charts connect the questions without collapsing them: reported hours, overlapping uses of time, a paid-receipt bridge, two compensation arrangements and a conversion/cost matrix. c6cc6cfde306575d07431d3f7a25b30e74e33d80.src: At a zero-interest loan rate, interest disappears from that bridge, but the fee and forgone discount can remain. The entered rate also excludes the cash-paid fee and discount effect, so it is not an all-in statutory APR disclosure.

c6e8631a6f65b2b804be6c32acfac14f5a7af52e.src: Original hypothetical one-product monthly cost-volume model. Variable cost per unit is calculated from the entered share of the original price, then held at $60.00 through the discount comparison; it is not recalculated as that share of the lower price. The new unit selling price is $80.00 and contribution per new unit is $20.00. Fixed operating costs stay unchanged. The minimum whole-unit volume to meet or exceed the original surplus is 200. This exceeds the separately entered capacity of 180 units. All selected sales are collected and their variable costs paid in the same month. No sales tax, income tax, debt service, new equipment, inventory timing, receivable delay, extra staffing, tiered costs, demand response or owner withdrawal is included. Operating surplus is not after-tax household income or proof that cash is freely distributable. The volume target preserves the original surplus, which can itself be negative; it is different from breaking even at zero profit. No actual price, capacity or demand estimate is supplied.

c862b2cd8afb493dabb0c848374b53e536de2d92.src: Six original hypothetical monthly executions buy the same fictional asset with equal household cash each time. A fixed fee is paid from that cash before buying fractional units at the stated price. At 100% variation, prices are the selected base multiplied by 1, 0.8, 0.6, 0.9, 1.2 and 1; zero variation makes all six prices identical. Other variation settings scale only those authored deviations from the base. A separate valuation price is applied after purchase six. All three headline metrics are CAD per unit, not dollar balances or percentage returns. Fractional units are unrestricted and calculations retain precision. No dividends, splits, cash interest, spreads, price impact, currency changes, sale fees, tax, account limits or market forecasts are included. All-in cash per unit is an accounting comparison, not a determination of tax ACB. No lump-sum strategy, equal-unit strategy, annualized return or historical performance is calculated.

c9e496abe6450db8e4d89b7f93c14b45550a9e2b.src: Two pensions with the same opening payment can develop very different purchasing power. c9e6420d46eb0c9512a205963332923d067fa761.src: The resulting nominal cash difference is not an annualized or inflation-adjusted return. c9a83817e38ea33d8531259f03685fe1f4f58d07.src: Hypothetical refinance with the same starting principal and remaining amortization, compared over the selected 1–60 months. Both quoted nominal annual rates are compounded semi-annually and converted to monthly rates, then held fixed for the comparison window only. Payments occur monthly and are calculated separately for each rate; intermediate amounts are unrounded and final payments capped at debt owed. Break charge and other costs are external quote assumptions, paid in cash at time zero and never financed. With zero opening debt there is no modeled refinance or fee. No extra borrowing, amortization extension, blend-and-extend, future renewal, discounting, tax deduction, investment of payment relief, borrower qualification or actual lender penalty formula is calculated. A positive cost advantage means lower modeled interest plus fees over this window, not approval or a complete lifetime recommendation.
c9a83817e38ea33d8531259f03685fe1f4f58d07.zh: 假设的再融资，具有相同的起始本金和剩余摊销，与选定的 1-60 个月进行比较。两种名义年利率报价均每半年复利一次并转换为月利率，然后仅在比较窗口内保持固定。付款按月进行，并针对每个费率单独计算；中间金额不四舍五入，最终付款以所欠债务为上限。违约金和其他成本是外部报价假设，在零时间以现金支付，并且从未融资。由于期初债务为零，因此没有模拟再融资或费用。不计算额外借款、摊销延期、混合延期、未来续约、贴现、税收减免、付款减免投资、借款人资格或实际贷款人罚款公式。积极的成本优势意味着在此窗口内较低的模型利息加费用，而不是批准或完整的终身建议。

All transfers repeat identical inputs with no rate movement, taxes, funding charges or delivery delay. A zero net target means no transfer and no charge.

cabb27968dc31c64c5837f15fec635f044330c58.src: Debt repayment and saving can affect the balance sheet in different ways. Paying principal with existing cash reduces cash and debt by the same amount, leaving net worth unchanged at that instant. Paying interest reduces cash without reducing principal. Future interest savings, fees, taxes and changes in asset values are separate effects rather than an immediate increase created by moving cash between rows.
cabb27968dc31c64c5837f15fec635f044330c58.zh: 债务偿还和储蓄可以以不同的方式影响资产负债表。用现有现金支付本金可以减少相同数量的现金和债务，从而使净资产保持不变。支付利息会减少现金，但不会减少本金。未来的利息节省、费用、税收和资产价值的变化是单独的影响，而不是通过在行之间转移现金而立即增加。

cac5b5e219749b07677fd3629d3023e9c90f1150.src: At the reference price, C$10 billion would purchase roughly 57 million shares before subsequent price changes. The economic benefit depends on the price paid relative to intrinsic value, not simply the size of the headline. Fewer shares can raise EPS even when total earnings are unchanged. Buying above book value also changes the book-value trajectory, so an earnings-minus-dividends rollforward alone is insufficient.
cac5b5e219749b07677fd3629d3023e9c90f1150.zh: 按照参考价格，100 亿加元将在后续价格变动之前购买大约 5700 万股股票。经济效益取决于相对于内在价值所支付的价格，而不仅仅是标题的大小。即使总收益不变，也能提高每股收益的股票数量较少。购买高于账面价值的股票也会改变账面价值轨迹，因此仅靠收益减去股息进行前滚是不够的。

ca6868956f21ad73913e66760a56b7212db9de73.src: All amounts and household sizes are original hypothetical inputs, not survey observations, population averages or low-income thresholds. The first two charts illustrate Statistics Canada’s documented private-household square-root adjustment: annual household after-tax income divided by the square root of household size. The cited standard was approved 21 March 2016, modified 23 July 2026 and reviewed 25 October 2026. This comparison measure is separate from unadjusted household income and from a per-person division; it does not create or remove cash. The monthly budget is independent. Its net cash is separately entered, shared costs stay fixed and the additional cost per person is the same for every member. That cost rule is a teaching assumption, not a cost forecast derived from the equivalence scale. No taxes, benefits, survey-group assignment, age-specific needs, location costs, other expenses, intra-month payment timing, saving return or borrowing facility is calculated. Negative monthly results identify a gap in the entered cash budget, not an actual overdraft balance.
ca6868956f21ad73913e66760a56b7212db9de73.zh: 所有金额和家庭规模均为最初的假设输入，而不是调查观察结果、人口平均数或低收入阈值。前两张图表说明了加拿大统计局记录的私人家庭平方根调整：家庭税后年收入除以家庭规模的平方根。引用的标准于2016年3月21日批准，2026年7月23日修改，并于2026年10月25日审查。该比较措施与未调整的家庭收入和人均收入分开；它不会创造或消除现金。每月预算是独立的。其净现金是单独输入的，共享成本保持固定，每个成员的每人额外成本是相同的。该成本规则是一种教学假设，而不是从等价范围得出的成本预测。不计算税费、福利、调查组分配、特定年龄需求、地点成本、其他费用、月内付款时间、储蓄回报或借贷便利。负月度结果表明输入的现金预算存在缺口，而不是实际透支余额。

cbe3ef781c4c73a837c7bca62c222ef71533c8fa.src: At the defaults, four weeks of CAD 200 available cash total CAD 800; four CAD 120 invoices total CAD 480, leaving CAD 320. A CAD 250 weekly quote would leave an unfunded CAD 200 with the same cash input, while all time results remain unchanged. The model neither values unpaid work at a wage nor converts saved hours into earnings. Timing within the four weeks could create an additional cash need.
cbe3ef781c4c73a837c7bca62c222ef71533c8fa.zh: 默认情况下，四个星期 200 加元的可用现金总计 800 加元；四张 120 加元的发票总计 480 加元，还剩下 320 加元。这笔可用现金是在其他预算承诺之后输入的，不是从工作时间推断的。如果每周报价为 250 加元，则在所有时间结果保持不变的情况下，现金投入相同，而无资金的则为 200 加元。该模型既不以工资来衡量无偿工作，也不将节省的时间转化为收入。四个星期内的时间可能会产生额外的现金需求。

cb9e271ed160d550cbe6811e973b81b2bb13e5e2.src: Original four-state illustration, not an employment-risk estimate. Each entered probability is the assumed chance that one net income is absent throughout the entire selected window; it is not an annual unemployment rate, a monthly hazard or a forecast. Each state begins at the start and persists for all selected months, with absent income set to zero. Essential spending is fixed; available income offsets expenses within each month. Only positive monthly deficits draw on the starting reserve, with no later surplus deposits, interest, borrowing or intramonth timing. Benefits, severance, replacement income, tax calculations and changing employment status are excluded. Dependence setting 0 gives independent receipt states. Positive settings interpolate the overlap probability toward its feasible maximum; negative settings toward its feasible minimum. The setting is an artificial stress control, not an estimated Pearson correlation. Changing the window retains the entered probability assumptions, which must be reconsidered for the new meaning. All probabilities and expected cash needs are conditional on this selected model.
cb9e271ed160d550cbe6811e973b81b2bb13e5e2.zh: 原始的四个州插图，不是就业风险估计。每个输入的概率是在整个选定窗口中不存在一项净收入的假设概率；它不是年度失业率、月度风险或预测。每个状态从一开始就开始，并持续所有选定的月份，缺席收入设置为零。基本支出是固定的；每月可用收入抵消支出。只有正月度赤字才会动用起始准备金，而没有后续的盈余存款、利息、借款或月内时间安排。福利、遣散费、替代收入、税收计算和就业状况变化不包括在内。相关性设置 0 给出独立的接收状态。正设置将重叠概率插值到其可行的最大值；朝向其可行最小值的负设置。该设置是人工压力控制，而不是估计的皮尔逊相关性。更改窗口会保留输入的概率假设，必须重新考虑新的含义。所有概率和预期现金需求均以该选定模型为条件。

Adding the separate effects from the first figure generally gives a different result because these inputs interact.

cb04f15e656088195ce8ef979982181b690a7b3e.src: Two invented annual fee formulas use the same rates, fixed thresholds, minimum asset charge and fixed annual account fee. Neither is a provider quote, a typical-market estimate or a recommended fee. The fee base is constant for this one-year quote; no average-balance, quarterly, prorated or market-value billing convention is inferred. Progressive charges apply each rate only to its slice. Whole-balance charges apply one rate to the entire fee base: up to and including CAD 100,000 uses the first rate; above CAD 100,000 through CAD 500,000 inclusive uses the middle rate; above CAD 500,000 uses the top rate. The minimum is applied to the asset charge FIRST, and the fixed annual fee is added once afterward. The hypothetical account remains open and both minimum and fixed fee can apply even at a zero base; no zero-balance waiver is assumed. Fees are a quote payable from outside the modeled asset base. No account deduction, investment path, return, tax deduction, sales tax, fund expense, transaction cost or service-quality adjustment is calculated. Rates may be edited in any order; statements about lower higher-band rates refer to the default schedule.
cb04f15e656088195ce8ef979982181b690a7b3e.zh: 两个发明的年费公式使用相同的费率、固定阈值、最低资产费用和固定年费。供应商报价、典型市场估算或顾问费用都不是。此一年报价的费用基础是不变的；没有推断出平均余额、季度、按比例或市场价值的计费惯例。累进费用仅适用于其所属的部分。总余额收费对整个费用基数应用一个费率：100,000 加元以下（含）使用第一个费率； 10万加元至50万加元（含）以上采用中间费率； 50万加元以上使用最高费率。资产费用首先适用最低限额，之后再添加一次固定年费。假设账户保持开放状态，即使在零基数下也可以适用最低费用和固定费用；不假定零余额豁免。费用是从建模资产基础外部支付的报价。不计算账户扣除、投资路径、回报、税收扣除、销售税、资金费用、交易成本或服务质量调整。价格可以按任何顺序编辑；有关较低较高利率的声明参考默认时间表。

cd0a3c8f6ae2df13a2c13aa26422773dd1d94733.src: The bridge uses a fixed sequence to reconcile the actual combined result. Each step measures the change after all previous steps have already occurred. Reordering the steps can change their individual amounts while preserving the same final combined case. The steps are therefore an accounting explanation of this chosen path, not a unique allocation of causation to each input.
cd0a3c8f6ae2df13a2c13aa26422773dd1d94733.zh: 桥梁使用固定顺序来协调实际组合结果。每个步骤都会衡量所有先前步骤发生后的变化。对步骤重新排序可以更改其各自的数量，同时保留相同的最终组合情况。因此，这些步骤是对所选路径的会计解释，而不是对每个输入的因果关系的唯一分配。

These are variance contributions, not capital weights or contributions to standard deviation.
cd6e92ef14864632052df5f3a990e25b0ad03b71.zh: 此插图将加权交叉项的一半分配给每个资产：A 接收 wA²σA² + wAwBρσAσB，B 接收 wB²σB² + wAwBρσAσB。这两个金额之和就是投资组合方差。负相关性下可能出现负贡献；它并不意味着负的独立差异或有保证的对冲。这些是方差贡献，而不是资本权重或标准差贡献。

cda095a728db67a9ad289c3133a13b803fc09463.src: The loan formula uses a monthly rate equal to the nominal annual rate divided by twelve, with payments at month-end. cda095a728db67a9ad289c3133a13b803fc09463.zh: 贷款公式使用的月利率等于名义年利率除以十二，并在月底付款。如果 B 是融资余额，r 是月利率，n 是付款次数，则付​​款金额为 Br ÷ [1 − (1 + r)−n]。零利率时，其结果为 B ÷ n。

cd54eab6d243e4a73697a63700216b22cd19c678.src: Simplified CPP age-adjustment illustration, not a personal benefit estimate. The same assumed age-65 entitlement is held fixed across start ages. All amounts use constant purchasing-power dollars with no tax, benefit interactions or further contribution accrual. A full payment year runs from one birthday to the next, with payments at month-end. Discounted receipts are valued at age 60 using the selected real rate. Survival probabilities, survivor benefits and QPP rules are excluded.
cd54eab6d243e4a73697a63700216b22cd19c678.zh: 简化的 CPP 年龄调整说明，而不是个人福利估算。假定 65 岁的权利在各个起始年龄中都是固定的。所有金额均使用恒定购买力美元，没有税收、福利互动或进一步应计缴款。全额付款年度从一个生日到下一个生日，并在月底付款。折扣收据按 60 岁使用选定的实际汇率进行估价。生存概率、幸存者福利和 QPP 规则被排除在外。

cd581dd4d942fbcfc3f05a9675246c137402ab91.src: The five-year service assumption is a condition of the illustration, not a reliability finding. A repair that provides less service, another breakdown, a different replacement cycle or a change in usage needs additional dated cash flows. Changing the horizon also requires reviewing both final sale values rather than treating them as guaranteed amounts at any date.
cd581dd4d942fbcfc3f05a9675246c137402ab91.zh: 五年服役假设是说明的一个条件，而不是可靠性发现。提供较少服务的维修、另一次故障、不同的更换周期或用途的变化需要额外的有日期的现金流。更改期限还需要审查最终销售价值，而不是将其视为任何日期的保证金额。

cca1f335fe84f253dd469343a8ddfab72fe2e061.src: This page isolates the arithmetic with an ideal account and original synthetic benchmark paths. It does not model any actual ETF or recommend a product. The account is assumed to deliver the chosen positive multiple exactly every day before fees, financing costs, taxes or tracking differences. Only 1x, 2x and 3x positive daily multiples are offered.
cca1f335fe84f253dd469343a8ddfab72fe2e061.zh: 此页面将算术与理想帐户和原始综合基准路径隔离。它不会对任何实际的 ETF 进行建模或推荐产品。假定该账户每天准确交付所选的正倍数，扣除费用、融资成本、税收或跟踪差异。仅提供 1 倍、2 倍和 3 倍正每日倍数。

cca42feaca7f0ceb2e057a8a2a88e49eac5f5325.src: The selected saving share applies to that accumulated pool. With a 50% rule, half of each increase adds to monthly saving and half adds to spending. Earlier saving increases continue when the next increase arrives. The first chart annualizes both parts, so each bar equals twelve times that year’s monthly pool.
cca42feaca7f0ceb2e057a8a2a88e49eac5f5325.zh: 所选储蓄份额适用于该累积池。按照 50% 的规则，每次增加的一半会增加每月储蓄，一半会增加支出。当下一次增加到来时，先前的储蓄增加将继续。第一个图表将这两个部分按年化，因此每个条形等于当年每月资金池的 12 倍。

cdbc131c44cd9ce93e78838ca77e54d83c821df8.src: Default five-year scenarios using the currently loaded snapshot, independent of your saved edits. Annual forecasts inform a uniform-accrual NTM timing model. Publisher-year calendar alignment and unspecified forward horizons remain disclosed assumptions. Other periods remain reference observations, with sourced long-term EPS proxies supplying the scenario. Published figures remain uncapped. The resulting path is a scenario, not five-year consensus. Only assessed compatible historical multiples default the exit; other references require your selection. Model payout = dividend-anchor % × entry P/E. It is a calibrated scenario input, not a publisher-reported payout ratio. STOXX 600’s net return-spread statistic is reference only; cash returns are withheld without an eligible cash-dividend assumption. EPS CAGR measures earnings growth; cash-flow IRR also includes valuation and dividends. Terminal wealth includes cash dividends held at 0% interest, starting from 100. Valuation dates and dividend constructions differ. These are conditional scenarios, not expected returns or a comparable ranking. FX, taxes, fees, drawdowns and funding feasibility require separate analysis.
cdbc131c44cd9ce93e78838ca77e54d83c821df8.zh: 使用当前加载的快照的默认五年情景，与您保存的编辑无关。年度预测为统一应计 NTM 计时模型提供信息。出版商年份日历调整和未指定的未来范围仍然是已披露的假设。其他时期仍然是参考观察，来源长期 EPS 代理提供了情景。公布的数字仍然没有上限。由此产生的路径是一种设想，而不是五年共识。仅评估兼容的历史倍数默认退出；其他参考需要您的选择。模型支付 = 股息锚定% × 入场市盈率。这是经过校准的场景输入，而不是发布商报告的支付比率。 STOXX 600 的净回报利差统计数据仅供参考；如果没有符合条件的现金股息假设，则扣留现金回报。 EPS CAGR衡量盈利增长；现金流IRR还包括估值和股息。终期财富包括以 0% 利率持有的现金股息（从 100 起）。估值日期和股息结构有所不同。这些是有条件的场景，而不是预期回报或可比较的排名。外汇、税收、费用、提款和融资可行性需要单独分析。

ceae9e795fe3183648768e7d5927838d72d61be3.src: CRA’s corporate-rate page lists a 9% federal net rate for qualifying Canadian-controlled private corporations claiming the small business deduction and a 15% general federal net rate, before adding provincial or territorial tax. In the provinces and territories shown on the CRA page (except Alberta and Quebec, where CRA does not collect the corporate tax), lower and higher rates differ; eligibility, business limits and income type affect which rate applies. The model therefore starts at an editable 15% only as a hypothetical, not as “the Canadian small-business rate.”
ceae9e795fe3183648768e7d5927838d72d61be3.zh: CRA 的企业税率页面列出了在添加省或地区税之前，对符合条件的加拿大控制的私营公司申请小企业扣除的 9% 联邦净税率和 15% 的一般联邦净税率。在 CRA 页面显示的省份和地区（艾伯塔省和魁北克省除外，CRA 不征收公司税），较低和较高的税率有所不同；资格、业务限制和收入类型会影响适用的税率。因此，该模型从可编辑的 15% 开始，仅作为假设，而不是“加拿大小企业利率”。

ceb0de68362aa2ee1b5594af81c1381885ec2705.src: The fractional rule uses that CAD 50 to buy about 0.1995 additional shares. Its security value is about CAD 5,061.36 and its cash is zero. The whole-share account’s security plus cash is also CAD 5,061.36.
ceb0de68362aa2ee1b5594af81c1381885ec2705.zh: 分数规则使用 50 加元购买约 0.1995 股额外股票。其安全价值约为 5,061.36 加元，现金为零。整体股票账户的担保加现金也为 5,061.36 加元。

ceb2c7852bb775ed87f310ea1c5decd77a518a98.src: The matrix changes the lender’s bill month and the delay applied to the original repayment schedule. Each cell calculates the extra starting cash needed over the whole selected window. It is not simply the cash balance on the bill date or the amount expected from the borrower at the end.
ceb2c7852bb775ed87f310ea1c5decd77a518a98.zh: 该矩阵更改了贷款人的账单月份以及适用于原始还款计划的延迟。每个单元格计算整个选定窗口内所需的额外起始现金。它不仅仅是帐单日期的现金余额或最终借款人预期的金额。

ceb352af84fb448ae4d2d6bfd00493f2fcc65470.src: The tool reports unfunded withdrawals because a zero balance must not look like a successfully financed spending plan. In a depleted path, actual funded spending can differ between the two sequences even though the requested rule is identical.
ceb352af84fb448ae4d2d6bfd00493f2fcc65470.zh: 该工具报告无资金提款，因为零余额决不能看起来像一个成功融资的支出计划。在耗尽路径中，即使请求的规则相同，两个序列之间的实际资助支出也可能不同。

cedcad52a24156c290f21147d2760ecf3ea866a1.src: Use the source views to read what an elapsed-duration statistic measures. Use the cash views to test an explicit future funding assumption and the reserve left now. Keep hiring expectations, benefit eligibility and actual payment dates as their own evidence-based inputs, rather than letting one published average stand in for all three.
cedcad52a24156c290f21147d2760ecf3ea866a1.zh: 使用源视图来了解经过的持续时间统计数据的测量内容。使用现金视图来测试明确的未来融资假设和现在剩余的准备金。将招聘期望、福利资格和实际付款日期作为自己的基于证据的输入，而不是让一个已发布的平均值代替所有三者。

cfe1214f6eca2ea2d46b5d57c577c107ac3921bc.src: An invented 30-day billing cycle with one eligible purchase, no prior balance and no other transactions, fees, cash advances or transfers. The purchase posts within the cycle and the full statement is assumed due the selected number of days after day 30. These numbered days are not actual calendar dates or an issuer statement. Cash is reserved on the posting day and equal new allocations arrive on each following day, including the due day, before the planned payment. No interest is earned on the reserve. This is a full-statement funding exercise, not a calculation of charged interest, minimum payments, grace restoration, payment processing, weekends or legal deadlines. The full-balance payment must actually reach the issuer as required; the model does not execute it or presume that an unfunded payment occurred. Negative residuals remain funding gaps. Days from purchase posting to due date include time before the statement closes; they are not the length of the post-statement grace period.
cfe1214f6eca2ea2d46b5d57c577c107ac3921bc.zh: 发明的 30 天计费周期，包含一次符合条件的购买，没有先前余额，也没有其他交易、费用、现金预支或转账。假定周期内的采购过帐和完整的报表在第 30 天之后选定的天数内到期。这些编号的天数不是实际的日历日期或发行人报表。现金在过帐日保留，并在计划付款之前的每一天（包括到期日）收到同等的新分配。储备金不赚取利息。这是一项完整的资金声明，而不是计算收取的利息、最低还款额、宽限恢复、付款处理、周末或法定期限。全额付款必须按要求实际到达发行人；该模型不执行它或假设发生了无资金支持的付款。负残差仍然是资金缺口。从购买过帐到到期日的天数包括报表关闭之前的时间；它们不是结单后宽限期的长度。

Neither amount is an investment loss or newly created wealth. Availability and lender acceptance are not assumed.

d010c9ad704ca17d995ceb1eff91d65ae5fb5ba4.src: These triggers are analytical review rules, not automatic instructions to buy or sell. d015689818aa10e92296e360b95d1aa57f458eb7.src: Observed source: Statistics Canada Table 14-10-0327-01, 2025 annual LFS estimates, Canada excluding the territories, Total - Gender, age 15 years and over. d198960f1cd92e1b6edb7cf963afb2e441352e68.src: Three original simple-accrual examples use the same constant principal, unchanged hypothetical annual quote and exact civil dates. The selected start is 2027-12-15 and is included; the closing date 2028-03-15 is excluded. There are 91 actual days, including weekends and holidays without payment-date shifts. Fixed-365 interest is principal × annual quote × actual days / 365. The fixed-360 example changes only that denominator to 360. The separately authored calendar-year example sums principal × annual quote / 365 for each included day in 2027 and / 366 for each included day in leap-year 2028. It illustrates an explicitly chosen denominator rule and is not asserted to be a universal Actual/Actual convention or a product contract. All examples are SIMPLE accrual without compounding, rate resets, principal changes, taxes, fees or cash payment before the closing date. Displayed accrual is neither a bank receipt nor a fee debit; no settlement or principal repayment is calculated. d1e176ae2aaf5ac5a6e0f63d5ad46ac23d3220b7.src: Original single-event illustration, with hypothetical nominal CAD amounts and assumed probabilities for one common comparison window. There are three mutually exclusive states: no repair, one eligible repair or one excluded repair. At most one event is modeled. Eligibility is conditional on that event occurring; it is not an observed approval rate or a promise about a particular claim. For an eligible event the provider pays the smaller of the cap and the positive repair cost less the deductible; otherwise it pays zero. The contract price is paid once at the start and never refunded. The same repair price is used for eligible and excluded events. Totals ignore discounting, financing, taxes beyond entered all-in amounts, shipping, downtime, multiple failures, repair-versus-replacement choices, depreciation and claim delays. Existing manufacturer, legal and card protection are outside the numerical comparison and must be reviewed before assigning any extra benefit to the purchased contract. Cost equality occurs at a whole-window event probability of 51.43%, holding eligibility, repair size, deductible and cap fixed.
d1e176ae2aaf5ac5a6e0f63d5ad46ac23d3220b7.zh: 原始单事件插图，包含假设的标称 CAD 金额和一个公共比较窗口的假设概率。存在三种互斥状态：无维修、一项合格维修或一项排除维修。最多对一个事件进行建模。资格取决于该事件的发生；它不是观察到的支持率或对特定主张的承诺。对于符合条件的事件，提供商支付上限和正维修费用减去免赔额中的较小者；否则赔付为零。合同价在开始时一次性支付，永不退还。符合条件和排除的事件使用相同的维修价格。总计忽略了折扣、融资、超出输入总金额的税费、运输、停机时间、多次故障、维修与更换选择、折旧和索赔延迟。现有的制造商、法律和卡保护不在数字比较范围内，在为购买的合同分配任何额外利益之前必须进行审查。成本平等发生在全窗口事件概率为 51.43% 的情况下，资格、维修规模、免赔额和上限固定。

d20c08e5d3485c652f183d1f25961f0a574de57a.src: Original nominal-CAD illustration for a hypothetical vacation ownership or right-to-use arrangement. The purchase is paid from cash at time zero. Annual dues grow at the entered constant rate whether or not any nights are used. One annual booking fee is paid only in a year with positive usage; one assessment is included only if its selected year falls within the reporting window. Comparable rental cost uses the same number of nights each year and its own price-growth assumption. All annual costs are placed at year-end for the present-value calculation; actual due dates can be earlier. No financing, resale proceeds, rental income from unused rights, tax, travel costs, additional fees or exit payments are included. Night availability and equivalence of lodging are assumed, not verified. The window is only a measurement period: it does not mean the real contract ends or that fees can be cancelled. Present values discount the same cash costs and are not added to nominal totals.

Initial earnings E₀ = 100 ÷ entry P/E is a synthetic anchor, not an independently verified official index EPS series. Under an illustrative rolling-NTM interpretation, E₀ covers approximately the first holding year; Eₜ at valuation date t covers the following earnings period. After n years the exit multiple applies to Eₙ, approximately holding year n + 1. Exactly n growth factors are applied; no extra growth year is added. FY-based or unspecified publisher multiples and annual growth estimates are retained only as qualified synthetic scenario inputs, with their period definitions visible. They do not establish a date-matched NTM forecast.
d2a2cf5c31cdeda1a4075cd6c0179e3986123bbe.zh: 初始价格标准化为 100。初始收益 E₀ = 100 ÷ 入场市盈率是合成锚定值，并非独立验证的官方指数 EPS 系列。根据滚动 NTM 解释，E₀ 大约涵盖第一个持有年份；估值日 t 的 Eₜ 涵盖以下盈利期。 n年后，退出倍数适用于Eₙ，大约持有年n + 1。恰好应用了n个增长因子；不添加额外的生长年份。基于财政年度或未指定的发行商倍数和年度增长估计仅保留作为合格的综合场景输入，其期间定义可见。他们没有建立日期匹配的 NTM 预测。

d2fea3d8ad04a8d565b8700714627dd8c884b8a5.src: Now add one job to person A, taking that person from two to three. Positions rise from six to seven. The number of jobholding people stays at three, and the number with multiple jobs stays at two. A different edit can move the other counts: giving person D a first job would raise jobholding people from three to four while leaving the multiple-jobholding count at two. The point is not the arithmetic but the separation of units. An added position is not automatically an added worker, and an added worker is not automatically an added multiple jobholder.
d2fea3d8ad04a8d565b8700714627dd8c884b8a5.zh: 现在为 A 增加一份工作，使该人从 2 人增加到 3 人。职位从六名上升至七名。在职人数维持在3人，同时兼任人数维持在2人。不同的编辑可以改变其他计数：给 D 人第一份工作将使同时拥有工作的人数从 3 人增加到 4 人，同时将多重工作人数保留为 2 人。重点不在于算术，而在于单位的分离。添加的职位不会自动成为添加的员工，添加的员工也不会自动成为添加的多重工作人员。

d2e9000f0ca7c8f881956d7dd07bc99b48a56855.src: Imagine an unchanged order book with a bid of 49.95 and ask of 50.05. Buying 200 units at the ask costs 10,010. An immediate sale at the bid returns 9,990, a loss of 20 before commissions. Relative to the 50 midpoint, the initial purchase costs 10 and the sale another 10. This full round-trip spread is 0.20% of the 10,000 midpoint value.
d2e9000f0ca7c8f881956d7dd07bc99b48a56855.zh: 想象一下订单簿未更改，出价为 49.95，要价为 50.05。按要价购买 200 件的价格为 10,010 美元。按出价立即出售可返回 9,990 美元，扣除佣金前损失 20 美元。相对于 50 中点，首次购买成本为 10，出售成本为 10。此完整往返价差为 10,000 中点价值的 0.20%。

d2578a6816977730b87172a43739de94fbf8604d.src: At every point, subtract mandatory redemption cash from the alternative cash price, divide by the required points and convert CAD to cents. A higher hypothetical cash price makes the implied value larger without changing the reward. A negative value means the mandatory redemption cash alone exceeds the matched cash price. This measure ignores point-buying costs and does not replace the cash-outlay or opportunity-value comparison.
d2578a6816977730b87172a43739de94fbf8604d.zh: 在每个点，从替代现金价格中减去强制赎回现金，除以所需的点并将加元转换为美分。假设现金价格越高，隐含价值就越大，而奖励不会改变。负值意味着仅强制赎回现金就超过了匹配的现金价格。该衡量标准忽略了积分购买成本，并且不取代现金支出或机会价值比较。

d3f635dc1f5e2cd6887b4a926ee0f96af6851e1e.src: Fixed 2026 educational calendar with independently entered recurring monthly benefit receipts. CRA’s published schedule and base-tax-year mapping are reference facts, not eligibility or amount calculations. Other household cash is assigned on each month’s first day, then the selected child bill is paid; a benefit arriving that same day is credited afterward. The calendar-day lag is an authored stress after each scheduled date, not a forecast of CRA or bank delays. Receipt amounts stay constant within each half-year as a simplifying assumption. Actual entitlements, reassessments, custody or age changes, combined provincial amounts, stopped payments and low-entitlement lump sums are outside this model. Use actual confirmed payment information; inputs do not certify a monthly entitlement. No interest, borrowing or costs outside this dedicated budget are included. Year-end metrics stop on 31 December; the path continues only to collect any delayed 2026 receipts, with no new 2027 costs or resources added.
d3f635dc1f5e2cd6887b4a926ee0f96af6851e1e.zh: 固定 2026 年教育日历，并独立输入定期每月福利收据。 CRA 公布的时间表和基本纳税年度映射是参考事实，而不是资格或金额计算。其他家庭现金在每个月的第一天分配，然后支付选定的孩子账单；当日到达的福利随后记入。日历日滞后是在每个预定日期之后编写的压力，而不是对 CRA 或银行延误的预测。作为一个简化的假设，收款金额在每半年内保持不变。实际权利、重新评估、监护权或年龄变化、省级合并金额、停止付款和低权利一次性付款不在此模型之外。使用实际确认的付款信息；输入并不证明每月的权利。此专用预算之外不包括任何利息、借款或费用。年终指标于 12 月 31 日停止；该路径仅继续收集任何延迟的 2026 年收据，不会添加新的 2027 年成本或资源。
