d403c70bce3886b3215054e41968355fa3bf1c76.src: Original hypothetical single-purchase comparison in nominal CAD. The cash and reward alternatives are assumed available for the same product or journey, with identical dates, quality, cancellation terms and all other benefits; otherwise this comparison is incomplete. The reward needs the entered points and mandatory cash. Existing points are used up to the requirement; any missing points are assumed purchasable immediately in the exact required quantity at the entered all-in cents-per-point cost, with no minimum bundle, transfer delay or purchase restriction. That availability is a scenario assumption, not a program offer. The selected case uses 15,000 existing points and buys 15,000 missing points. The chosen alternative-use value applies only to existing points consumed, not to unused points or a second charge on the newly purchased points. It is an authored opportunity-value assumption, not guaranteed cash value or an accounting valuation. Implied gross redemption value is 1.667 cents per required point, before point-acquisition costs. No point-earning spending, annual card fee, debt interest, tax calculation, expiry, devaluation or probability is modeled. Cash avoided is a comparison with an alternative payment, not cash credited to a bank account.
d403c70bce3886b3215054e41968355fa3bf1c76.zh: 原始以名义加元计算的假设单次购买比较。假设现金和奖励替代方案适用于相同的产品或旅程，具有相同的日期、质量、取消条款和所有其他优惠；否则这个比较是不完整的。奖励需要输入积分和强制现金。现有积分已达到要求；任何缺失的积分都假定可以立即以输入的每积分总美分成本购买所需的确切数量，没有最低捆绑、转移延迟或购买限制。该可用性是一个场景假设，而不是一个计划报价。所选案例使用 15,000 个现有积分并购买 15,000 个缺失积分。所选的替代使用价值仅适用于已消耗的现有积分，不适用于未使用的积分或对新购买的积分进行二次收费。它是一个书面的机会价值假设，而不是保证现金价值或会计估值。每个所需积分的隐含总兑换价值为 1.667 美分（扣除积分获取成本）。没有对赚取积分的支出、年卡费用、债务利息、税收计算、到期、贬值或概率进行建模。避免现金是与替代付款方式进行比较，而不是与存入银行账户的现金进行比较。

d507cae720571b60e078f45d713e2b0b84e04cfc.src: Use that account’s own annual interest amounts. Subtracting its tax from the untouched reference account’s much larger interest total would combine two different balance paths. The tax also changes later interest, so the ending-value difference between paths is not generally equal to the simple sum of tax payments.
d507cae720571b60e078f45d713e2b0b84e04cfc.zh: 使用该账户自己的年利息金额。从未受影响的参考账户的大得多的利息总额中减去税收将结合两种不同的平衡路径。税收也会改变后来的利息，因此路径之间的最终价值差异通常不等于纳税的简单总和。

d50e17c831649ff7ecfe0e9d83251b437ceb4e3c.src: A timing strategy needs an exit, a re-entry and a fair accounting of cash, costs and contributions. Test the rule on paths where it helps and paths where it hurts before confusing hindsight with a plan.

d5622f8e8019ea906753b825f8d8b7c11dc70294.src: Hypothetical comparison with remaining in the current job for 120 months. Upfront costs are paid at time zero. Reduced take-home income lasts through both training and the job-search delay; no new-job uplift arrives before then. Later monthly gain equals the extra take-home income less extra work costs. No tax credit, grant, borrowing, investment return or probability of employment is assumed. Foregone income is an opportunity cost, not an invoice or the cash reserve needed to live. Discounting uses the entered effective annual nominal rate.

d5cc2d7d148455d3e83f606bc24e84286851f1db.src: This is why a “jobs” headline and a “workers” headline can move in opposite directions without either being wrong. d5cd4c4f7a81155542c8cec54a54d1919a1e71dc.src: The example assumes contributions arrive before bills at month-end. If a payment is due earlier than the transfer, an end-of-month model may hide an intra-month shortage. Add actual paydays, transfer settlement times and bill deadlines to the detailed plan. No interest is earned here, so the results depend on cash timing rather than an investment forecast.
d5cd4c4f7a81155542c8cec54a54d1919a1e71dc.zh: 该示例假设捐款在月底账单之前到达。如果付款早于转账，月末模型可能会隐藏月内短缺。在详细计划中添加实际发薪日、转账结算时间和账单截止日期。这里不会赚取利息，因此结果取决于现金时机而不是投资预测。

d7598fa2399beed56b64edbd9592377e8145ad78.src: At the starting inputs, cash falls to negative CAD 300 after the first new-rent payment on day fifteen. It reaches negative CAD 1,200 after the living-cost payment on day twenty-two. The day-thirty-five refund cannot pay either earlier obligation without another identified source.

d75bbb5bd1131947e6ba392d425f166bc6136698.src: Original equal-end-date comparison, with the same initial deposit and same earlier bill. Hypothetical cashable terms permit principal-only partial withdrawal after thirty completed days; the remaining principal and accrued interest stay until day 365, when all interest is paid. Simple daily interest uses a 365-day year: full principal for the selected completed days, then remaining principal for 365 minus those days. The locked deposit releases nothing before day 365 and earns simple annual interest for the full year. Its bill is funded only by an independently assumed available bridge advance equal to that bill; simple bridge interest and principal are paid together at day 365. Credit availability is a prerequisite, not an automatic response to a cash gap. No fees, minimum remaining-balance rule, taxes, compounding, rollover, changing rates or additional borrowing is modeled. A negative settlement endpoint requires outside cash. No actual issuer’s withdrawal terms, credit approval or product offer is established.
d75bbb5bd1131947e6ba392d425f166bc6136698.zh: 原始的同等结束日期比较，具有相同的初始存款和相同的早期账单。假设的可兑现条款允许在三十个完整天后仅提取本金的部分；剩余本金和应计利息保留到第 365 天，届时所有利息均已支付。简单每日利息使用 365 天的一年：选定已完成天数的全部本金，然后减去这些天数的 365 天的剩余本金。锁定存款在第 365 天之前不会释放任何内容，并赚取全年的简单年利息。其账单仅由独立假定的等于该账单的可用过桥预付款提供资金；简单的过桥利息和本金在第 365 天一起支付。信贷可用性是先决条件，而不是对现金缺口的自动反应。没有对费用、最低余额规则、税收、复利、展期、利率变化或额外借款进行建模。负结算端点需要外部现金。未制定实际发行人的提款条款、信贷审批或产品报价。

d764f9ed56c9c914dbb8430fb50ae6beb80251ba.src: The curve spans foreign asset returns from −50% to +50%. A −50% asset result requires a 100% quote increase, which exceeds the quote-change control’s maximum; it remains visible on the curve rather than being clipped to the control range. A complete 100% unlevered asset loss cannot be repaired by any finite positive exchange rate. That boundary is excluded from the controls and curve.
d764f9ed56c9c914dbb8430fb50ae6beb80251ba.zh: 曲线跨越外国资产回报率从 -50% 到 +50%。 -50% 的资产结果需要 100% 的报价增加，这超出了报价更改控制的最大值；它在曲线上保持可见，而不是被剪切到控制范围内。任何有限的正汇率都无法修复完全 100% 无杠杆资产损失。该边界被排除在控制和曲线之外。

This is a transparent stress denominator, distinct from the issuer’s average-loan and day-count convention. d8362223c965c5c52ded3d830ee7da0d7bf8086c.src: Original twelve-month bookkeeping illustration. Each month receives take-home income first, pays the preceding month’s card purchases, pays direct chequing purchases, makes the new card purchases and transfers the selected share of the after-purchase surplus to separate savings. The card starts at zero and its purchases are repaid in the following model month without interest or fees; this is an authored timing assumption, not a statement-date or grace-period calculation. All purchases are consumed services/goods with no retained asset value. Spending percentages are nested: the card share applies only to income left after direct purchases; the saving share applies only after both purchase categories. These definitions keep total consumption within income. Position 13 settles the last card bill only, with no new income, purchase or savings transfer; it is not a forecast of a thirteenth ordinary month. Bank balances earn no return. Listed net financial assets equal chequing plus savings minus the card purchase liability, not a complete household net-worth statement. Monthly aggregates do not establish cash availability on actual payment dates.
d8362223c965c5c52ded3d830ee7da0d7bf8086c.zh: 原始的十二个月簿记插图。每个月首先收到实得收入，支付上个月的卡购买额，支付直接支票购买额，进行新的卡购买额，并将购买后盈余的选定份额转移到单独的储蓄中。该卡从零开始，其购买的金额将在下一个模型月份偿还，无需利息或费用；这是一个编写的时间假设，而不是报表日期或宽限期计算。所有购买都是消耗的服务/商品，没有保留资产价值。消费百分比是嵌套的：卡份额仅适用于直接购买后剩余的收入；节省份额仅适用于两种购买类别之后。这些定义将总消费控制在收入范围内。位置13仅结算最后一张卡账单，没有新的收入、购买或储蓄转账；这不是对普通第十一个月的预测。银行存款没有任何回报。列出的金融资产净值等于支票加储蓄减去卡购买负债，而不是完整的家庭净资产报表。每月汇总并不能确定实际付款日期的现金可用性。

d84bc158282795720aa5174a6f9a315fc5c1f84a.src: Research judgment: TD is best framed as a capital-return and earnings-durability test. At the October 23, 2026 TSX close of C$174.47, the shares trade at a calculated 17.86 times trailing adjusted EPS and 2.50 times July book value. That valuation already anticipates substantial recovery. It leaves less room for a thesis built only on improving sentiment.
d84bc158282795720aa5174a6f9a315fc5c1f84a.zh: 研究判断：TD 最好作为资本回报和盈利耐久性测试。该投资案需要的不仅仅是该特许经营权在美国合规失败中幸存下来的证据。截至 2026 年 10 月 23 日多伦多证券交易所收盘价为 174.47 加元，该股的交易价格经计算为追踪调整后每股收益的 17.86 倍和 7 月账面价值的 2.50 倍。这一估值已经预示着大幅复苏。它为仅以改善情绪为基础的论文留下了更少的空间。

d84e6660c185faff1338de31a4deaf6d498a9979.src: The calculator always reads a ratio as new shares for old shares. Its quantity multiplier is new divided by old. Three new for two old gives 3 ÷ 2 = 1.5, so 121 × 1.5 = 181.5 new shares.

d873f38bbf41512c40b2ddf0ef1b5715f53e6871.src: Portfolio exits introduce another distinction. BMO completed the 138-branch sale in September; the Transportation and Vendor Finance sale was announced with a retained minority interest. Exiting lower-return assets can improve capital efficiency, but the foregone income must leave the earnings forecast. Capital released becomes valuable only through productive reinvestment or disciplined distributions. We would not add a full capital benefit, retain all disposed earnings and assume unchanged funding costs. The clean test is whether recurring common earnings per dollar of equity improve after transaction effects settle. A rising capital ratio with declining per-share earning power would be weaker evidence than the ratio alone suggests.
d873f38bbf41512c40b2ddf0ef1b5715f53e6871.zh: 投资组合退出引入了另一个区别。 BMO于9月完成了138家分行的出售；宣布出售运输和供应商融资，并保留少数股权。退出低回报资产可以提高资本效率，但放弃的收入必须脱离盈利预测。释放的资本只有通过生产性再投资或严格的分配才变得有价值。我们不会增加全部资本收益，保留所有可处置收益并假设融资成本不变。干净的测试是交易影响解决后每美元股本的经常性共同收益是否会有所改善。资本比率上升且每股盈利能力下降，这一证据比该比率本身所显示的证据要弱。

d8e1a9f049dccd9c5d45a3087c553b604fd43e1f.src: Two original non-registered capital-appreciation illustrations start with the same investment value and ACB and receive no new money. All return is assumed positive or zero price appreciation, with no distributions or other taxable events. In the annual case, all holdings are sold each year, that year’s gain is multiplied by the entered gain-tax fraction, tax is paid immediately from proceeds, and the remaining amount is reinvested as the new cost base. The final sale case makes no intervening disposition or distribution and pays modeled tax from the final sale proceeds. The same tax fraction applies to each full dollar of gain in both cases; it is not an inclusion rate, calculated personal marginal rate or actual assessment. No credits, deductions, loss rules, fees, trading spreads, registered accounts, deemed dispositions, special deferrals, foreign exchange, tax-rate changes or real payment deadlines are calculated. The appreciation and tax inputs are constant assumptions, not a product offer or forecast. Intermediate deferred-net points show hypothetical liquidation values, not taxes actually paid every year.
d8e1a9f049dccd9c5d45a3087c553b604fd43e1f.zh: 两个原始的非注册资本增值插图以相同的投资价值和 ACB 开始，并且没有收到新资金。所有回报均假定为正值或零价格升值，没有分配或其他应税事件。在年度情况下，每年出售所有资产，当年的收益乘以输入的收益税分数，立即从收益中缴纳税款，剩余金额作为新的成本基础进行再投资。最终销售案例不进行任何干预处置或分配，并从最终销售收益中缴纳模拟税。在这两种情况下，每一美元的收益都适用相同的税率；它不是包容率、计算出的个人边际率或实际评估。不计算抵免、扣除、损失规则、费用、交易点差、注册账户、视同处置、特别延期、外汇、税率变化或实际付款期限。升值和税收投入是恒定的假设，而不是产品报价或预测。中间递延净积分显示假设的清算价值，而不是每年实际支付的税款。

d8ec81a8d8f1e9abb7441ff53cd817262b7bd6c3.src: Original interest-free family-loan cash illustration, not a contract, collection forecast or fair-value estimate. The principal leaves accessible cash at month zero. Scheduled principal receipts begin at the entered first repayment month and repeat monthly, capped at the unpaid principal; the delayed case shifts the entire receipt schedule by the entered delay. Repayment is a transfer from unpaid principal into cash, not additional interest income. Each month’s ordinary cash surplus and any repayment arrive before the lender’s separate bill is paid at that month-end. Negative ledger values show an unfunded amount, not an authorised overdraft or an automatically financed payment. Extra initial cash is the amount needed to lift the entire selected ledger to zero or above; it includes any underlying budget deficit as well as the loan’s timing effect. No interest, tax, fees, default probability, collateral, enforcement or assumed credit line is modeled. Unpaid principal is a nominal record of original principal not yet received, not proof of collectability or spendable wealth. Only events within the reporting window appear; an excluded later bill or repayment is not cancelled. The keep-cash control advances no family money and therefore does not provide the same assistance.
d8ec81a8d8f1e9abb7441ff53cd817262b7bd6c3.zh: 原创免息家庭贷款现金说明，并非合同、收款预测或公允价值估计。委托人在零月份留下可用现金。预定本金收入从输入的第一个还款月份开始，每月重复一次，上限为未付本金；延迟的情况会根据输入的延迟改变整个收货时间表。还款是将未付本金转为现金，而不是额外的利息收入。每个月的普通现金盈余和任何还款都会在贷款机构当月月底支付单独的账单之前到达。负账本值显示未提供资金的金额，而不是授权透支或自动融资付款。额外的初始现金是将整个选定的账本提升到零或以上所需的金额；它包括任何潜在的预算赤字以及贷款的时间效应。没有对利息、税收、费用、违约概率、抵押品、执行或假定信用额度进行建模。未付本金是尚未收到的原始本金的名义记录，而不是可收回性或可花费财富的证明。仅显示报告窗口内的事件；排除的后续账单或还款不会被取消。保留现金控制不会预支家庭资金，因此不会提供相同的帮助。

d7b66402569bfcd323d3d2d50b2a69551c7b6453.src: Original hypothetical comparison in nominal CAD of the same usable product, quality and monthly quantity. All package prices and sizes are assumptions, not live offers or survey observations. Both alternatives start with no stock. At each month’s start, buy the fewest whole packages needed to cover that month’s consumption after using stock carried forward. Any unused quantity remains usable for the next month without spoilage, loss or storage cost. Prices and package sizes stay constant throughout the selected horizon. The purchase cost assigned to unused stock reconciles prior cash paid; it is not cash in the bank, a resale quote or a guaranteed recoverable value. No sales tax, coupons, delivery fees, interest, membership cost, nutrition comparison or change in consumption is calculated. A unit-price comparison should use the same measurement unit and genuinely comparable contents.
d7b66402569bfcd323d3d2d50b2a69551c7b6453.zh: 相同可用产品、质量和每月数量的名义加元的原始假设比较。所有套餐价格和尺寸均为假设，并非实时报价或调查观察结果。两种选择都是从没有库存开始的。在每个月开始时，使用结转的库存后，购买满足当月消耗所需的最少整包。任何未使用的数量仍可在下个月使用，不会损坏、丢失或产生存储成本。价格和包装尺寸在整个选定范围内保持不变。分配给未使用库存的购买成本与之前支付的现金相一致；它不是银行现金、转售报价或保证可收回价值。不计算销售税、优惠券、送货费、利息、会员费、营养比较或消费变化。单价比较应使用相同的计量单位和真正可比的内容。

d8816d26b818703799a4cd55c5886516f4b1e226.src: An authored seasonal pattern allocates the cost across twelve abstract months. Its weights add to twelve. The first month has a weight of 1.5, so its allocated cost is CAD 345: CAD 2,760 divided by twelve and multiplied by 1.5. This is a mathematical allocation, not a weather forecast, meter reading or issued bill.

d8829be15b4e55bfe01d0717c5ef7b3b2c05d309.src: A contingency holds capacity for an uncertain requirement. It is not automatically paid to a contractor, an investment loss or a prediction that costs will rise by the entered percentage. If unused, it remains household cash.

d9ef67d2c3c3b7ccfe58b7eb1f88c67f938e1744.src: Real contracts can use monthly payments, different start dates and different beneficiary settlement terms. Those terms need their own reading. This example assumes continued scheduled instalments and does not convert them into a lump-sum settlement.
d9ef67d2c3c3b7ccfe58b7eb1f88c67f938e1744.zh: 真实合同可以使用每月付款、不同的开始日期和不同的受益人结算条款。这些术语需要自己阅读。本示例假设持续按计划分期付款，并且不会将其转换为一次性结算。

d9f4293913672b0d6e2e029dc321f3d724b41f81.src: Two half-year coupons form each year’s nominal total. The reference-date comparison first divides each individual payment by the model index on its own payment date, then adds those two amounts. It stays constant because the coupon base and the deflator use the same index. This is a flow comparison, not an end-of-year account valuation. No price-index principal adjustment is counted as coupon cash.
d9f4293913672b0d6e2e029dc321f3d724b41f81.zh: 每年的名义总额由两张半年期优惠券组成。参考日期比较首先将每笔付款除以其付款日期的模型指数，然后将这两个金额相加。它保持不变，因为息票基础和平减指数使用相同的指数。这是流量比较，而不是年终账户估值。价格指数本金调整不计为息票现金。

d9f964cdae8544dd687df26595ca969e6b46e7b9.src: A deduction may cross several tax brackets. Its total income-tax reduction divided by the deduction amount can therefore differ from the marginal rate on the next dollar of income. A real comparison should estimate the return with and without the deduction and review any other affected items separately.
d9f964cdae8544dd687df26595ca969e6b46e7b9.zh: 扣除额可能会跨越多个税级。因此，其所得税减免总额除以扣除金额可能与下一美元收入的边际税率不同。真正的比较应该估计扣除和不扣除的回报，并分别审查任何其他受影响的项目。

db91a744e2de7dcab4addcea039d67e4e308a3f0.src: Original hypothetical nominal-CAD cash-flow comparison. Both cases begin with the same face-value purchase price, face amount, annual coupon and original maturity. They are matched teaching cases, not two actual bonds offered at an identical market price. Coupons arrive at each year-end. The assumed issuer call happens immediately after the selected coupon and returns face value, with no call premium or accrued-interest adjustment. No later coupons are paid in that case. The no-call comparator returns face value at original maturity. Every coupon and redemption receipt is retained in a separate reinvestment pool: prior receipts earn the constant selected annual return before new year-end receipts arrive. No spending, additional saving, tax, fees, issuer default, secondary-market sale, interim bond valuation or call probability is modeled. The issuer’s decision is assumed rather than predicted, and the reinvestment return is independent of that decision. Pool values before original maturity exclude any bond still outstanding; at the common endpoint both bonds have redeemed.
db91a744e2de7dcab4addcea039d67e4e308a3f0.zh: 原始假设名义与加元现金流比较。两种情况均以相同的面值购买价格、面额、年息和原始期限开始。它们是匹配的教学案例，而不是以相同市场价格提供的两种实际债券。优惠券于每年年底到达。假定的发行人赎回权在所选优惠券之后立即发生，并返回面值，没有赎回权溢价或应计利息调整。在这种情况下，不会再支付后续优惠券。无赎回比较器返回原始到期时的面值。每张优惠券和兑换收据均保留在单独的再投资池中：之前的收据将在新的年终收据到达之前赚取恒定的选定年度回报。没有对支出、额外储蓄、税收、费用、发行人违约、二级市场销售、中期债券估值或赎回概率进行建模。发行人的决定是假设的而不是预测的，再投资回报独立于该决定。原始到期前的池值不包括任何尚未偿还的债券；在共同终点，两种债券都已赎回。

dbca9f5197569617b45f0a0c34027523d406894d.src: Public 2022–2024 period life table for Canada, released 13 January 2026, reviewed 25 October 2026. Metadata identifies this period as preliminary even though the selected row STATUS cells are blank. Source sex categories are retained. The age input conditions on reaching that exact birthday; it does not change mortality rates or estimate personal health. Expected remaining life assumes the reference-period mortality schedule continues. Published 95% margins describe uncertainty in the population mean, not the spread of individual lifespans. Conditional-survival ratios use rounded lx counts from a hypothetical radix of 100,000 births, with no derived confidence interval or future mortality improvement. Displayed survival stops at 100 with no assumption that survival becomes zero afterward. The final chart is separate hypothetical arithmetic: constant real annual cash gap times years to a chosen age, zero real return, no tax or payment-timing calculation and no mortality weighting. It is not a recommended funding age or an insurance quote.

Whole-balance pricing chooses a band from the total asset base and applies that band's single rate to every dollar.
db99a7f65e8c12b846ed8c0e002ef261fdc6b865.zh: 本指南比较了两个特意指定的公式。累进定价按第一费率收取前 100,000 加元的费用，接下来的 400,000 加元按中间费率收费，超过 500,000 加元的部分按最高费率收取。整体余额定价从总资产基础中选择一个区间，并将该区间的单一利率应用于每一美元。

dc053c34ae83c787d977bbeb7e4db32ec4393dab.src: Suppose a retired person wants CAD 12,000 for a one-time expense. A withdrawal from a regular RRSP is generally included in income in the calendar year it is withdrawn. Tax may be withheld at the source, but the withheld amount is a prepayment; the final tax depends on the return. The RRSP withdrawal rule is confirmed in CRA Guide T4040.
dc053c34ae83c787d977bbeb7e4db32ec4393dab.zh: 假设一位退休人员需要 12,000 加元作为一次性费用。从常规 RRSP 中提取的资金通常计入提取当年的收入中。可以在源泉扣缴税款，但扣缴的金额为预缴税款；最终税额取决于申报表。 RRSP 提款规则在 CRA 指南 T4040 中确认。

dc6a46dad4afd76636d74c8216e57716186f0963.src: The separate regulatory issue is the U.S. bank subsidiaries’ US$434 billion asset cap established in the October 2024 resolution. It does not cover all TD businesses. Nevertheless, the constraint reduces management’s strategic freedom where controls failed. Capital strength can absorb costs and support distributions, but a high CET1 ratio cannot substitute for accepted remediation or authorize unrestricted U.S. growth.
dc6a46dad4afd76636d74c8216e57716186f0963.zh: 另一个监管问题是 2024 年 10 月决议中规定的美国银行子公司 4,340 亿美元的资产上限。并不涵盖所有TD业务。然而，当控制失败时，这种限制会减少管理层的战略自由。资本实力可以吸收成本并支持分配，但高 CET1 比率不能替代可接受的补救措施或授权不受限制的美国增长。

dc7a54026f966985969952e6a0d169937bfcbbf8.src: Imagine opening a card statement and seeing that the required payment has fallen. That can be welcome cash-flow relief. It does not tell you how quickly the remaining debt will disappear. When the payment is a percentage of a falling balance, less money may go toward repayment every month, creating a long tail of small payments.
dc7a54026f966985969952e6a0d169937bfcbbf8.zh: 想象一下，打开卡对账单，发现所需付款已经下降。这可能是值得欢迎的现金流缓解。它不会告诉您剩余债务将多快消失。当付款占余额下降的一定百分比时，每月用于还款的金额可能会减少，从而形成小额付款的长尾。

dc7de87366ff3cd6c9262bb0d39c1928955914da.src: At a zero discount rate, the model values every dated dollar equally, so the timing rows show the same difference for a given total. That does not eliminate a household’s need for cash before a payment arrives. It shows the consequence of using zero as the analytical rate. The schedule still identifies those earlier periods without receipts.
dc7de87366ff3cd6c9262bb0d39c1928955914da.zh: 在零折扣率下，模型对每一美元的日期进行同等评估，因此时间行显示给定总额的相同差异。这并不能消除家庭在付款到达之前对现金的需求。它显示了使用零作为分析速率的结果。该明细表仍然标识了那些没有收据的早期时期。

dc7fbaaadb07b9110d43420ba608c1caf1e159b6.src: All three illustrative schedules have the same annual total. The comparison therefore isolates timing, rather than assuming the seasonal household earns less. It does not estimate whether the entered annual income will actually arrive. Income uncertainty requires a separate downside test.
dc7fbaaadb07b9110d43420ba608c1caf1e159b6.zh: 所有三个说明性明细表具有相同的年度总额。因此，这种比较隔离了时间，而不是假设季节性家庭的收入较少。它不会估计输入的年收入是否会实际到达。收入不确定性需要单独的下行测试。

dc84828304790b03e68a7bb4f410284f739d0666.zh: 将每笔费用按付款日期计算并预算现金。

dc858f4f05bdc541bff408df2e2c49a07e9ceff7.src: The original example assumes an effective annual asset return of 5% and cash return of 2%, converted to weekly factors. At ten model years, weekly buying ends at approximately CAD 63,705 and four-week buying at approximately CAD 66,165. Both have received the same CAD 52,000 of contributions.
dc858f4f05bdc541bff408df2e2c49a07e9ceff7.zh: 原始示例假设有效的年度资产回报率为 5%，并且现金回报率为 2%，换算为每周因素。在十个车型年中，每周购买量约为 63,705 加元，四周购买量约为 66,165 加元。两者都收到了相同的 52,000 加元的捐款。

dc8717e0e625863aa8116123e6bc3c9fbe82c6de.src: A larger monthly allocation can reduce the extra starting cash required, but it does not make the allocation affordable. Reconcile it with regular expenses, other debt payments and the household’s emergency reserve. Money already promised to another goal is not simultaneously available for instalments unless that goal’s plan changes.
dc8717e0e625863aa8116123e6bc3c9fbe82c6de.zh: 较大的每月拨款可以减少所需的额外起始现金，但并不能使拨款负担得起。将其与常规开支、其他债务支付和家庭紧急储备金进行核对。已向另一个目标承诺的资金不会同时用于分期付款，除非该目标的计划发生变化。

dc89500db7e844c27e4da2593393de4a0ebd5e28.src: The third chart makes independent changes to the same opening group. Paying CAD 500 toward Card A’s opening debt leaves CAD 400 on A. With no other transactions, its own ratio becomes 40% and the combined ratio becomes 4%.

dc4020b8a25aa19ec29b033b142d22c89ff536a5.src: The model compares two schedules on an assumed facility, rather than two actual loan offers. Each finances the same CAD 60,000 project. One draws CAD 60,000 now; the other draws CAD 20,000 for each of three bills. Approval, continued access and payment of every bill are assumptions that require separate evidence in an actual plan.
dc4020b8a25aa19ec29b033b142d22c89ff536a5.zh: 该模型比较假定设施的两个时间表，而不是两个实际的贷款要约。每个项目都为同一个项目提供 60,000 加元的资金。现在一张可以提取6万加元；另一个则为三张钞票每张提取 20,000 加元。每张账单的批准、持续访问和支付都是需要在实际计划中提供单独证据的假设。

dc8fe85d75f98447682af78ead739273c5d13c2d.src: With no additional deposits, CAD 20,000 at a 5% nominal annual rate for four monthly credits earns about CAD 335.42. It does not earn CAD 1,000 simply because the quoted annual rate is 5%. That larger amount would be a simple full-year calculation before considering the actual crediting convention.
dc8fe85d75f98447682af78ead739273c5d13c2d.zh: 在没有额外存款的情况下，四个月积分按 5% 名义年利率计算，可赚取 20,000 加元，约为加元335.42。它不会仅仅因为报价的年利率是 5% 就赚取 1,000 加元。在考虑实际计入惯例之前，较大的金额将是一个简单的全年计算。

dc9102d96b200c345e807b8bcb7fa19e0ca83d29.src: The columns are stress assumptions. They do not represent promised insurer processing times or contractual choices. If a selected receipt falls after the displayed horizon, it contributes nothing within that window. The tool does not credit a future payment against an earlier deficit or assume the household can borrow against it.
dc9102d96b200c345e807b8bcb7fa19e0ca83d29.zh: 这些列是压力假设。它们并不代表保险公司承诺的处理时间或合同选择。如果选定的收据落在显示的水平线之后，则它在该窗口内没有任何贡献。该工具不会将未来的付款记入先前的赤字，也不会假设家庭可以以此为抵押进行借贷。

dc928684e519df65ef818857a7d3517612188758.src: At the first default boundary, the progressive annual charge rises by CAD 0.50, while the whole-balance charge falls by CAD 299.50. At the second, the progressive charge rises by CAD 0.30 and the whole-balance charge falls by CAD 999.70. These are conditional differences in the selected formulas, not promised savings from adding assets to a real account.
dc928684e519df65ef818857a7d3517612188758.zh: 在第一个默认边界，累进年度费用增加 0.50 加元，而整体余额费用下降 299.50 加元。第二次，累进费用增加 0.30 加元，总余额费用减少 999.70 加元。这些是所选公式中的条件差异，而不是承诺通过将资产添加到真实账户而节省的费用。

dc932def9174b064b29fcc3d6a93d9c4937a6e50.src: One-time setup cost at the start (CAD)
dc932def9174b064b29fcc3d6a93d9c4937a6e50.zh: 开始时的一次性设置成本（加元）

dc98a50302979f4ca580963c3731d97a90a83a74.src: The matrix reruns the monthly comparison for different home-value changes and investment returns. Each signed cell is owner ending wealth minus renter ending wealth. It also recalculates the carrying costs tied to modeled home value. A positive result favors the owner within the model; a negative result favors the renter.
dc98a50302979f4ca580963c3731d97a90a83a74.zh: 该矩阵会重新运行不同房屋价值变化和投资回报的每月比较。每个带符号的单元格都是所有者期末财富减去租客期末财富。它还重新计算与模型房屋价值相关的持有成本。积极的结果有利于模型中的所有者；负结果对承租人有利。

dc9a3487a00124af2f4bf0b62c23a2c16e5bf473.src: At day 365, after all six sales have been collected and all suppliers paid, the original cash plus net trading cash is CAD 20,700. That positive endpoint does not remove the earlier trough. This is why a household cannot rely on an annual business profit figure alone when planning withdrawals for personal bills.
dc9a3487a00124af2f4bf0b62c23a2c16e5bf473.zh: 在第 365 天，在收集了所有六笔销售额并向所有供应商付款后，原始现金加上净交易现金为 20,700 加元。该积极终点不会消除之前的低谷。这就是为什么家庭在计划个人账单提款时不能仅依赖年度商业利润数据。

dc9a92730109006989ecff622ac464f9b32ac372.src: Columns replace the first January payday and continue that 14-day sequence through 2027. Rows replace the monthly bill date. Pay and costs stay selected. Changing the first date can change the number of in-year receipts; each cell uses its actual calendar, not an assumed equal annual salary.
dc9a92730109006989ecff622ac464f9b32ac372.zh: 列取代 1 月第一个发薪日，并延续该 14 天序列直至 2027 年。行取代每月账单日期。薪酬和成本保持选定。更改第一个日期可以更改当年收据的数量；每个单元格都使用其实际日历，而不是假设的相等年薪。

dca4afee9faeff72188e6f65cc5207255b47bc46.zh: 该债务持有者的中位数 · 2023 年恒定加元 · 95% 置信区间

dca58c5c23266b7aff58a896b9195f5bb959c1e5.src: The opening and later bars repeat earlier contributions. Do not add the bars together to calculate deposits. New cash contributed over the selected horizon is the monthly contribution multiplied by the number of months. At the defaults that is CAD 18,000, while CAD 23,000 is the ending record including the prior CAD 5,000.
dca58c5c23266b7aff58a896b9195f5bb959c1e5.zh: 开头和后面的柱重复了之前的贡献。请勿将条形图加在一起来计算存款。在选定期限内贡献的新现金是每月贡献乘以月数。默认为 18,000 加元，而最终记录为 23,000 加元，包括之前的 5,000 加元。

dcaa0952862b820ec84d39e87474e91ee34ce748.zh: 假设发行人确认的援助扣留金额 (CAD)

dcabe4c831c8caadbfe1568514d73e2205fb720b.src: For transparency, the model funds the assumed tax at the end of each completed investment year, after that month’s reserve transfer. At the end of the final investment year, it first receives the maturity proceeds and then funds the last modeled tax amount.
dcabe4c831c8caadbfe1568514d73e2205fb720b.zh: 为了提高透明度，该模型在每个已完成的投资年度结束时、当月的准备金转移之后为假设的税款提供资金。在最终投资年度结束时，它首先收到到期收益，然后为最后建模的税额提供资金。

dcacb0d62ccd8d2861a6684aba1059dee001e3e4.src: All three percentages can be correct at once because their denominators differ. Describing the 60% unit-price reduction as a 60% bill saving would apply a limited change to a much larger base.
dcacb0d62ccd8d2861a6684aba1059dee001e3e4.zh: 所有三个百分比都可以同时正确，因为它们的分母不同。将 60% 的单价降低描述为 60% 的账单节省，将对更大的基数进行有限的改变。

dccd1e893f1c1e4a3ba0f6245cb186dcd5dedea2.src: That earlier cash retention can matter to a household with a tight reserve. It also comes with a continuing payment obligation and, for the financed case, interest. This tool does not assign a return to retained cash or decide how much liquidity is appropriate. Read the early cash need and the full-term cost together rather than treating either number alone as the answer.
dccd1e893f1c1e4a3ba0f6245cb186dcd5dedea2.zh: 对于储备紧张的家庭来说，提前保留现金可能很重要。它还附带持续付款义务，对于融资案例，还附带利息。该工具不会分配保留现金的回报或决定适当的流动性。将早期现金需求和整个期限成本放在一起，而不是单独将任一数字作为答案。

dcdc6ec09144a4150e781be17fbd8eacd9559ab6.zh: 在不削减输入的食品数量的情况下协调收入减少的月份·加元

dddc14d160f35de326ccbb104dd90670cf966432.src: All fund names, benchmark returns, return gaps and attribution entries are invented. The fund and benchmark use the same opening CAD value, dates, currency and total-return basis with distributions reinvested. The annual fund NAV return equals the benchmark assumption plus the entered percentage-point gap, which can have either sign. It is already net of any costs reflected in that assumed NAV return: no second expense-ratio deduction is made. Annual factors repeat without contributions, withdrawals or probabilities. The benchmark wealth line is a calculation reference, not a directly purchasable investment. No investor tax, brokerage charges, spread, premium/discount or FX conversion is included. The separate four-month sample and attribution bridge remain fixed original illustrations; they do not generate the selected annual gap. These figures do not estimate a real fund’s tracking error or future performance.
dddc14d160f35de326ccbb104dd90670cf966432.zh: 所有基金名称、基准回报、回报差距和归属条目都是虚构的。该基金和基准使用相同的加元开盘价值、日期、货币和总回报基础，并进行再投资分配。年度基金资产净值回报率等于基准假设加上输入的百分点差距（可以有任一符号）。它已经扣除了假设资产净值回报中反映的任何成本：没有进行第二次费用比率扣除。年度因素重复，没有贡献、提款或概率。基准财富线只是计算参考，并非可直接购买的投资。不包括投资者税、经纪费用、点差、溢价/折扣或外汇兑换。单独的四个月样本和归因桥保持固定的原始插图；它们不会产生选定的年度差距。这些数字并未估计真实基金的跟踪误差或未来表现。

de07d81935274a876ecb0276e4e569a714612950.src: Credit sensitivity should be expressed through earnings and capital together. In an illustrative C$800 billion average-loan portfolio, 20 additional basis points of annual losses would cost C$1.6 billion before tax. The accompanying reduction in retained earnings would also narrow distribution flexibility. The thesis strengthens if impaired formations improve while capital remains resilient after growth and distributions. It weakens if provision relief precedes another rise in impaired assets or requires increasingly optimistic macroeconomic assumptions.

ddbb0c628048fb1fabd782c44ab767b474ed7cde.src: Simplified hypothetical history with basic CESG only. Assume Canadian residence and basic eligibility from birth through the calendar year of age 17, valid SIN and promoter arrangements, and no other RESP transactions. The selected earlier contribution years are capped at the number of prior calendar years and placed in the earliest such years, with CAD 2,500 per year and no withdrawals. Earlier basic grants are CAD 500 per funded year, capped at the CAD 7,200 lifetime maximum; no additional CESG was ever received. Unused basic room therefore starts at CAD 500 times prior calendar years less earlier grants. Each modeled year adds CAD 500 of basic room. New grants are 20% of placed contributions, subject to available room, CAD 1,000 per year, the shared lifetime CESG cap and the special pre-age-16 contribution-history condition. New contributions stop at the CAD 50,000 lifetime total; excess requests are unplaced. Delayed years still accrue basic room. No investment return, additional CESG, CLB, provincial benefit, transfer, withdrawal, repayment of grants, real account eligibility or payment-processing lag is calculated. Unused room after age 17 does not extend the grant deadline.

dcb605d11d8d6bf88b57d7dfa5b4993b495fe1a4.src: Original CAD illustration, not an actual employee award, option valuation, tax estimate or recommendation to exercise. Each option unit buys one share at the entered strike price. The fixed authored schedule vests nothing through month 11, catches up completed service at month 12, then vests cumulatively each completed month through month 48. Cumulative units are rounded down to whole units; all remaining units vest at month 48. Continued service and an open exercise window are assumed at the chosen checkpoint; no expiry date, forfeiture, prior exercise, rolling grant, performance condition or blackout is modeled. All units remain unexercised when the snapshot is taken. Intrinsic spread is vested units times max(share price minus strike, zero); it is not full option fair value, owned stock or money already received. The exercise-and-sale waterfall assumes a permitted immediate sale at the same selected price, with no change between exercise and sale. It shows zero transaction flows at or below strike, a plotting convention rather than an exercise policy. The separate cash comparison concerns exercise and hold, which receives shares rather than sale cash. Uncommitted cash is not spent in the model. Taxes, withholding, fees, trading restrictions, settlement, borrowing and subsequent price changes are excluded; actual terms and cash requirements can differ.
dcb605d11d8d6bf88b57d7dfa5b4993b495fe1a4.zh: 原始 CAD 插图，而非实际的员工奖励、期权估值、税务估算或行使建议。每个期权单位以输入的执行价格购买一股。固定编写的时间表在第 11 个月之前不归属，在第 12 个月追上已完成的服务，然后在每个完成的月份累积归属到第 48 个月。累积单位向下舍入到整个单位；所有剩余单位将于第 48 个月归属。假定在所选检查点继续服务并开放行权窗口；没有对到期日、没收、提前行使、滚动授予、绩效条件或限制进行建模。拍摄快照时，所有单位均保持未执行状态。内在利差是既得单位乘以最大值（股价减去行使价，零）；它不是完整的期权公允价值、拥有的股票或已收到的资金。行权和销售瀑布假设允许以相同的选定价格立即出售，行权和销售之间没有变化。它显示在罢工或低于罢工的情况下交易流量为零，这是一种策划惯例，而不是执行政策。单独的现金比较涉及行使和持有，即接收股票而不是出售现金。未承诺的现金不会花在模型中。税收、预扣税、费用、交易限制、结算、借款和随后的价格变动不包括在内；实际条款和现金要求可能有所不同。

de50b3e3410a5388432c03b62e6c55a769881266.src: Original cash-flow illustration, not tax advice or a salary/dividend recommendation. It assumes the full salary is deductible from the selected profit pool, the remaining amount is taxed once at the user-entered illustrative corporate rate, and all after-tax residual profit is paid immediately as a dividend. The 15% default is an editable hypothetical assumption, not a quoted combined statutory rate. No personal tax, payroll withholding, employer payroll cost, refundable tax, retained earnings, dividend gross-up or credit cash effect, other income, CPP contribution amount, EI/QPP treatment or timing is calculated. RRSP room uses 18% of this illustrative salary only, capped at the official 2027 annual dollar limit of CAD 35,390, before pension adjustments and all other room factors; the taxpayer’s CRA notice of assessment controls.
de50b3e3410a5388432c03b62e6c55a769881266.zh: 原始现金流图，不是税务建议或工资/股息建议。它假设全额工资可从选定的利润池中扣除，剩余金额按用户输入的说明性公司税率征税一次，所有税后剩余利润立即作为股息支付。 15% 的违约率是一个可编辑的假设，而不是引用的综合法定利率。不计算个人税、工资预扣税、雇主工资成本、可退税、留存收益、股息总额或信用现金效应、其他收入、CPP 缴款金额、EI/QPP 处理或时间安排。 RRSP 房间仅使用此说明性工资的 18%，上限为 2027 年官方年度美元限额 35,390 加元（不包括养老金调整和所有其他房间因素）；纳税人的 CRA 评估控制通知。

dee7349a9dec004c59b5225252c4e9ac363962ec.src: Credit sensitivities apply an extra annual charge to a fixed C$991.00bn loan proxy: 31 July 2026 net loans, a period-end balance rather than an average. e0895c64f3a6173a2212289deb6844eed13ee942.src: The Insurance Bureau of Canada likewise advises insuring the cost to rebuild with like-quality materials and omitting the market price of the underlying land. Its wildfire guidance states that a home policy does not insure the land, and that an owner who takes a cash settlement still owns the land. These are separate valuation concepts, so the difference between a market price and a rebuilding estimate is not itself a measurement of land value. This calculator uses the market figure only as context and does not subtract it from, or add it to, the rebuilding comparison.
e0895c64f3a6173a2212289deb6844eed13ee942.zh: 加拿大保险局同样建议使用同等质量的材料为重建成本投保，并忽略底层土地的市场价格。其野火指南指出，房屋保险不为土地提供保险，接受现金结算的业主仍然拥有土地。这些是单独的估值概念，因此市场价格和重建估算之间的差异本身并不是土地价值的衡量标准。此计算器仅使用市场数据作为背景，不会将其从重建比较中减去或添加到重建比较中。

e0811ca5a2ed30520223beb7942eeb0b3ff850cb.src: A mortgage payment can become smaller each time it leaves the account while the total paid during a year becomes larger. The labels matter because “biweekly” and “accelerated biweekly” describe different cash commitments.
e0811ca5a2ed30520223beb7942eeb0b3ff850cb.zh: 每次离开账户时，抵押贷款付款可能会减少，而一年内支付的总额会增加。这些标签很重要，因为“双周”和“加速双周”描述了不同的现金承诺。

e08234b81bbcb753eb243f88386ca0b008da04f8.src: The first chart shows the signs from the participant’s perspective: negative, positive, negative. A payment and a receipt one year apart cannot simply be netted as though they occur on the same date. That separation matters to both valuation and the eventual cash required.
e08234b81bbcb753eb243f88386ca0b008da04f8.zh: 第一个图表显示了参与者角度的迹象：负面、正面、负面。相隔一年的付款和收款不能简单地计算为在同一天发生的净额。这种分离对于估值和最终所需现金都很重要。

e0872b85d5d0fe7da7d26ed29b5ddaeedcd02e39.src: A payment calendar can also reveal costs hidden by a monthly average. Suppose the CAD 4,500 monthly figure excludes a separate CAD 1,200 obligation due in the second month. Three months then require CAD 14,700, leaving CAD 4,700 to fund. Entering CAD 400 more per month reproduces that three-month total, but spreads the obligation across dates. That shortcut cannot establish whether enough cash is available on its actual due date.
e0872b85d5d0fe7da7d26ed29b5ddaeedcd02e39.zh: 付款日历还可以揭示月平均隐藏的成本。假设每月 4,500 加元的数字不包括第二个月到期的 1,200 加元的单独债务。三个月需要 14,700 加元，剩下 4,700 加元可供资助。每月再输入 400 加元即可重现三个月的总额，但将义务分摊到各个日期。该捷径无法确定在实际到期日是否有足够的现金可用。

e1689bc2f3d7d326ccadfee77440992783bdced7.src: The model reserves the assumed tax amount immediately, making it unavailable for the goal. It does not assert that a broker withholds that amount or that the tax is due on the trade date. An earmark is a household planning choice, while an actual payment date belongs on a separate tax cash calendar.
e1689bc2f3d7d326ccadfee77440992783bdced7.zh: 模型立即保留假设的税额，使其无法用于目标。它并不断言经纪商预扣该金额或应在交易日缴纳税款。专项拨款是家庭规划的选择，而实际付款日期则属于单独的税收现金日历。

e16fa81e2832e26f5de8ea436d4e5e72c666aeb3.src: Price CAGR annualizes the change in the original unit’s price. Cash-flow IRR uses a negative initial purchase, annual dividends, and a final sale. It captures when the cash arrives; it is not obtained by simply adding today’s yield to a multi-year price CAGR.
e16fa81e2832e26f5de8ea436d4e5e72c666aeb3.zh: 价格复合年增长率将原始单位价格的变化按年计算。现金流 IRR 使用负初始购买、年度股息和最终销售。它捕获现金何时到达；它不是通过简单地将今天的收益率与多年价格复合年增长率相加而获得的。

e10160edcf069edfabc9f7c83e6e7adf3a90dc69.src: Wealthsimple’s sale guidance distinguishes cash balance, available-to-trade funds and available-to-withdraw funds. e104b67a6f697f7dc28a78ef12e0a6041295a7d8.src: A fourteen-day sequence can place twenty-six or twenty-seven paydays inside a calendar year, depending on the first date. They answer a cash-calendar question using the actual in-year receipts created by each selected date.

e10fafa2e90e84457740acf2c966c8a0a09488e3.src: Interest for an incomplete path is only the amount charged within those 120 months. It must not be read as a full-life repayment cost. The matrix reports NR instead of a full-cost figure for such a case. A rising balance indicates that the entered payments do not cover modeled interest.
e10fafa2e90e84457740acf2c966c8a0a09488e3.zh: 不完整路径的利息仅为这 120 个月内收取的金额。不得将其解读为终身还款成本。对于这种情况，矩阵报告的是 NR，而不是全部成本数字。余额增加表明输入的付款不涵盖模型利息。

e1101f56c234c8cdbdc2364068d39a5d02f19e07.src: This comparison changes a price assumption, rather than measuring the effect of switching payment methods. Relabeling the same completed purchases while preserving all final prices leaves total spending unchanged. A real discount, surcharge, interest cost or reward would need its own cash treatment; none is automatically inserted into this tally.
e1101f56c234c8cdbdc2364068d39a5d02f19e07.zh: 此比较改变了价格假设，而不是衡量转换付款方式的效果。在保留所有最终价格的同时重新标记相同的已完成购买将使总支出保持不变。真正的折扣、附加费、利息成本或奖励需要单独的现金处理；不会自动将任何内容插入到此统计中。

e110f849e522141033a0099a2f090fe6d0ee89e6.src: The model stops after one year and assumes no renewal. A real annual plan might renew automatically at a different price. e1131834f4ef987c20ce0bcd78b9e5bc3bbf0a6f.src: All charts use the same public 13 April 2026 release vintage, with 25 annual observations for 2021–2025. No confidence interval, significance test, causal attribution or within-group distribution is supplied.

Assume a Canadian-resident beneficiary remains eligible in a qualifying full-time program beyond the first 13 consecutive weeks, with the entered contribution and EAP amounts confirmed available after all applicable plan, grant, beneficiary and expense checks. No eligibility, EAP approval, CESG allocation/lifetime limit, administrative threshold, tax return or grant repayment is calculated. Gross EAP is capped at the request, confirmed capacity and the remaining education budget after outside funding, before the allowance; the last cap is a voluntary budgeting convention. Contribution withdrawals fill the remaining net need up to the entered available amount. The allowance is hypothetical, not withholding or final student tax. No account return or payment-date schedule is modeled.
e2280430c7b6ecab27ac5f3a3d68fe0fbc66cc6b.zh: 发起人验证后的假设教育预算分类账。假设加拿大居民受益人在连续前 13 周之后仍然有资格参加合格的全日制计划，并且在所有适用的计划、补助金、受益人和费用检查后确认输入的捐款和 EAP 金额可用。不计算资格、EAP 批准、CESG 分配/终身限制、管理门槛、纳税申报表或补助金偿还。 EAP 总额的上限取决于请求、确认的能力以及外部资助后、津贴前的剩余教育预算；最后一个上限是自愿预算公约。捐款提款将填补剩余的净需求，直至输入的可用金额。该津贴是假设的，不是预扣税或最终学生税。没有对帐户回报或付款日期时间表进行建模。

e2b2396e016bb2c419af4958fc7feedbab160a2e.src: The U.S. business requires a different lens. The asset restriction makes balance-sheet allocation and customer economics especially important. Shedding low-return assets can improve margins and capital efficiency even as total loans contract. But runoff is finite. Once that comparison is exhausted, the business must demonstrate healthier core relationships, better deposit mix and greater fee contribution. Faster reported growth against restructuring losses is a weaker signal than recurring operating improvement.
e2b2396e016bb2c419af4958fc7feedbab160a2e.zh: 美国企业需要不同的视角。资产限制使得资产负债表配置和客户经济变得尤为重要。即使贷款总额收缩，剥离低回报资产也可以提高利润率和资本效率。但径流是有限的。一旦比较完毕，企业必须展示更健康的核心关系、更好的存款组合和更大的费用贡献。与经常性运营改善相比，较快的报告增长相对于重组损失来说是一个较弱的信号。

e2446bad2562356fe26a6fc14d994a9f5f98cdcc.src: Different obligations can have different end dates. Childcare may end before education begins; a partner may retire later; an outstanding debt may be repaid along the way. A detailed plan can replace the single smooth income-gap curve with dated cash flows. Keeping those dates visible is more informative than hiding every obligation in one rounded salary multiple.
e2446bad2562356fe26a6fc14d994a9f5f98cdcc.zh: 不同的义务可以有不同的结束日期。儿童保育可能会在教育开始之前结束；合伙人可以稍后退休；未偿还的债务可以一路偿还。详细的计划可以用过时的现金流量取代单一的平滑收入差距曲线。保持这些日期可见比将每项义务隐藏在一个四舍五入的工资倍数中更能提供信息。

e333f94f26a83cef92015b86faf969f51d4dc6c2.src: Original hypothetical equal-service comparison, not a product quote, lifespan forecast or personal purchase recommendation. Both options deliver the same required service continuously. Each cycle’s purchase is paid at its start; running cost is paid at every completed year-end for the year just used, including the final service year. Both have zero salvage value. Every later cycle repeats the same purchase price, life and running cost in unchanged nominal CAD; no inflation, technological change, quality difference, downtime, tax, fee, grant or financing is modeled. The entered discount assumption is effective annual and applied to that same unchanging nominal price basis. A cycle’s present cost equals its immediate price plus discounted year-end running costs. Dividing by its own year-end annuity factor gives an equivalent annual cost: a valuation transformation, not a bill, depreciation charge or required saving contribution. The common horizon is the least common multiple of the two whole service lives, at most 56 years under these controls. Each option is replaced at its cycle boundaries before that horizon, with no new purchase at the final endpoint; final service costs still apply. Long repeated horizons make a conditional arithmetic comparison and are not a forecast that today’s prices or technology will persist. No bank balance, affordability, available replacement cash or future commitment is calculated.
e333f94f26a83cef92015b86faf969f51d4dc6c2.zh: 原始假设的同等服务比较，不是产品报价、寿命预测或个人购买建议。两种选项都可以持续提供相同的所需服务。每个周期的购买费用在开始时支付；运行成本在刚刚使用的年度的每个完整年终支付，包括最后服务年度。两者的残值均为零。随后的每个周期都以不变的名义加元重复相同的购买价格、使用寿命和运行成本；没有对通货膨胀、技术变革、质量差异、停机时间、税收、费用、赠款或融资进行建模。输入的折扣假设每年有效，并适用于相同不变的名义价格基础。一个周期的当前成本等于其直接价格加上折扣年末运行成本。除以自己的年终年金系数得出等效的年度成本：估值转换，而不是账单、折旧费用或所需的储蓄贡献。共同寿命是两个整个使用寿命的最小公倍数，在这些控制下最多 56 年。每个选项在该范围之前的周期边界处被替换，在最终端点没有新的购买；最终服务费用仍然适用。长期重复的视野进行了有条件的算术比较，并不是对今天的价格或技术将持续存在的预测。不计算银行余额、负担能力、可用替代现金或未来承诺。

e36613e68c5aadffb6ea70a53d4751784f81cb22.src: Profitability must also be measured after claims on earnings senior to ordinary common shares. e36914fda3b03ffd93dce2dbd2b695354b408973.src: A cash discount and a financing offer can make the same purchase look like two very different decisions. e3b1693f4986e2b171098a3c3102359619369bfd.src: Original hypothetical one-year deposit illustration, not a bank quote. A constant balance is held for a full year. Simple annual interest is paid once at the end, with no intra-year compounding, deposits, withdrawals, fees, tax, promotional window or balance qualification test. The first CAD 5,000 earns 1%; the next CAD 5,000 earns 3%; only the amount above CAD 10,000 earns the entered top rate. Crossing a threshold never reprices earlier slices. The comparison applies its entered flat rate to the same entire balance for the same full year. The blended rate is total annual interest divided by that balance. Actual accounts may use different tiers, all-balance rules, daily calculations, monthly credits or eligibility conditions. All rates and thresholds here are constructed assumptions, and no actual deposit-insurance eligibility, access terms or product recommendation is provided.

e4778cdf81276eee77a5380cfaf27d219a0b8ad1.src: Original hypothetical 12-month comparison of two draw schedules on an assumed approved facility. Both finance the same three equal bills, due at the start of months spacing, twice spacing and three times spacing. One draws the entire project amount at time zero. The other draws only the bill amount at each due date, with all later draws assumed available. Rates stay fixed and annual rates divided by 12 apply to the post-bill balance for each whole monthly period. This deliberately simplified convention is not a reproduction of daily contractual interest. Borrowing interest and fees are paid from separate household cash; they are not capitalized. Interest on unused borrowed cash is paid out separately, before tax, and is not reinvested in the project pot. Neither alternative repays principal during the modeled year. Net carrying cost means borrowing interest plus draw fees less cash interest, not total project cost or total future repayment. Negative net cost can occur under entered rates and is not an available borrowing/deposit arrangement.
e4778cdf81276eee77a5380cfaf27d219a0b8ad1.zh: 最初假设的 12 个月比较，在假设的已批准设施上进行两个抽奖时间表的比较。两者都提供相同的三张同等账单，分别在月初到期、两倍间隔和三倍间隔到期。人们在零时间提取整个项目金额。另一个只在每个到期日提取帐单金额，并假设所有后续提取都可用。费率保持固定，年费率除以 12 适用于每个月的账单后余额。这种刻意简化的惯例并不是日常合同利益的复制。借款利息和费用由单独的家庭现金支付；它们没有大写。未使用的借入现金的利息在税前单独支付，并且不会再投资于项目资金池中。这两种选择都不会在模型年度内偿还本金。净持有成本是指借款利息加上提款费用减去现金利息，而不是项目总成本或未来还款总额。输入的利率下可能会出现负净成本，并且不是可用的借贷/存款安排。

e34ce388ad080edca51f6e2e1d4e41a5cdc838f4.src: Hypothetical one-balance credit-card model with no new purchases. Interest is opening balance × nominal APR ÷ 12, posted before the payment. The modeled minimum is the greater of the dollar floor and the selected percentage of the balance after interest, capped at the full amount owed. The maintained strategy pays at least the selected amount or the modeled minimum, whichever is higher; the final payment is capped. This is not an issuer calculation, a universal Canadian minimum, or a calculation of Quebec requirements. Actual daily interest, grace periods, fees, purchase dates and payment allocation differ. Each schedule stops at payoff or 600 months. NR means not repaid within that limit, not zero cost. All payments are assumed available and timely. Post-payoff cash is not reinvested.
e34ce388ad080edca51f6e2e1d4e41a5cdc838f4.zh: 假设的单余额信用卡模型，没有新的购买。利息为期初余额 × 名义年利率 ÷ 12，在付款前过账。建模的最小值是美元下限和利息后余额的选定百分比中的较大者，上限为所欠全额。维持的策略至少支付选定的金额或模拟的最低金额，以较高者为准；最后付款有上限。这不是发行人的计算、加拿大通用最低标准或魁北克要求的计算。实际每日利息、宽限期、费用、购买日期和付款分配有所不同。每个计划在付款或 600 个月时停止。 NR是指在此限额内不偿还，而不是零成本。所有付款均假定可用且及时。付款后现金不会再投资。

e45128b3c948a4dcdf25a88436ba6f6b3a28f638.src: Hypothetical 24-month reserve ledger, with zero interest. Ordinary household income and bills are outside this ledger; the entered contribution must already be affordable after them. Each unexpected bill arrives at the start of its selected month, before that month’s contribution. Bills sharing a month are combined. A bill can use only cash already in the reserve: any excess is an unfunded need recorded separately, without automatic borrowing or a negative savings account. At month-end the reserve receives the smaller of the contribution and the amount needed to reach the target. Existing cash above target is retained; no contribution is forced out of that balance. Money not transferred is left outside the ledger. Later deposits rebuild the reserve and do not retrospectively pay an earlier unfunded bill. No claim reimbursements, interest, tax, insurance or event probabilities are assumed.
e45128b3c948a4dcdf25a88436ba6f6b3a28f638.zh: 假设的 24 个月储备金账本，零利息。普通家庭收入和账单不在此分类账之外；输入的捐款必须在他们之后已经可以负担。每份意外账单都会在所选月份的月初、该月的缴款之前到达。每月分摊的账单合并在一起。账单只能使用储备金中已有的现金：任何超出部分都是单独记录的无资金需求，没有自动借款或负储蓄账户。月底，储备金收到捐款和达到目标所需金额中的较小者。保留高于目标的现有现金；没有任何贡献是被迫脱离这种平衡的。未转移的资金留在账本之外。后来的存款会重建准备金，并且不会追溯支付之前无资金支持的账单。不假设索赔报销、利息、税收、保险或事件概率。

e566bd517401cea73523bd93b5f427972369b3d8.src: The two amounts sum to the entered contribution and do not reduce existing holdings. e5415cee77d432f92cd9c4dbf3af4a209dd3ca99.src: Two mutually exclusive hypothetical single receipts: one at time zero, the other after the selected whole years. CAD cash flows use the same nominal basis and are entered after any independently assumed deductions; no tax is computed. The comparison rate is effective annually and constant, not an available investment return, required lending rate or risk-free quote. The future-value comparison assumes the immediate amount could compound at that rate until the later date without withdrawals. No actual investment is selected. Full and timely payment is assumed; credit risk, access restrictions, inflation, fees and changing rates are not quantified. Present value is a valuation today, not cash already available to pay a bill.
e5415cee77d432f92cd9c4dbf3af4a209dd3ca99.zh: 两个相互排斥的假设单一收入：一个在零时间，另一个在选定的整年之后。加元现金流量使用相同的名义基础，并在任何独立假设的扣除后输入；不计算任何税款。比较利率每年有效且恒定，并非可用投资回报、所需贷款利率或无风险报价。未来价值比较假设即时金额可以按该比率复利，直到稍后的日期而不需要提款。未选择实际投资。假设全额并及时付款；信用风险、准入限制、通货膨胀、费用和利率变化均未量化。现值是今天的估值，而不是已可用于支付账单的现金。

e5446cb35eb315cc9ce658aac8c768def4ad243d.src: Original hypothetical comparison of two purchase rules for one fictional distribution-paying security. Both start with the same whole shares and no cash, add no outside money and consume nothing. Four equal periods per year share the same assumed total-return factor. Each period’s price first grows by that factor, then a fixed distribution per share is deducted: starting price × entered annual distribution percentage ÷ 4. This is a constructed valuation path, not an actual ex-dividend price prediction. Distributions depend on shares owned before that period’s purchase. Both rules pool old residual cash with the new distribution and purchase at the same post-distribution price. One buys the maximum whole shares; the other allows unlimited fractional precision. Remaining cash earns zero. Pooling old residual cash is an explicit purchase rule and may differ from a broker’s automatic plan. There are no fees, taxes, spreads, discounts, settlement delays, rounding to a broker’s precision, contribution-room calculations or guaranteed payments. All figures are nominal CAD. Fractional reinvestment maintains more exposure to the assumed security path; it does not ensure a better outcome in every return scenario.
e5446cb35eb315cc9ce658aac8c768def4ad243d.zh: 一种虚构的分配支付证券的两种购买规则的原始假设比较。两者都以相同的全部股份开始，没有现金，不添加外部资金，也不消耗任何东西。每年四个相同的时期具有相同的假定总回报系数。每个期间的价格首先按该因子增长，然后扣除每股固定分配：起始价格×输入的年度分配百分比÷4。这是构建的估值路径，而不是实际的除息价格预测。分配取决于该期间购买之前所拥有的股份。这两条规则都将旧的剩余现金与新的分配资金合并在一起，并以相同的分配后价格进行购买。 1人购买最大全股；另一个允许无限的分数精度。剩余现金收益为零。汇集旧的剩余现金是一项明确的购买规则，可能与经纪人的自动计划不同。没有费用、税收、点差、折扣、结算延迟、四舍五入到经纪商的精度、供款空间计算或保证付款。所有数字均为标称加元。部分再投资可以让更多人接触到假定的安全路径；它并不能确保在每种回报情况下都能获得更好的结果。

e67632b38530267ccd78d1acfb62f268087f3281.src: An expensive item can feel worth repairing because it cost a lot when new. A disappointing past purchase can also make replacement feel like an admission of loss. The forward cash question is more concrete: what money changes from today if the household repairs and retains the item, compared with replacing it now?
e67632b38530267ccd78d1acfb62f268087f3281.zh: 一件昂贵的物品可能会让人觉得值得修理，因为它在新的时候成本很高。过去购买的产品令人失望，也会让更换产品感觉像是承认损失。远期现金问题更具体：如果家庭修复并保留该物品，与现在更换相比，从今天开始会发生什么变化？

e67875356329d00349a786ea94852048406c8086.src: The 25% is an invented effective cash allowance on the full gain. It is neither the statutory inclusion rate nor a personal marginal income-tax rate. Entering a marginal rate directly could misstate the allowance. Actual tax requires the relevant year’s rules, other income and losses, account treatment and the taxpayer’s circumstances.
e67875356329d00349a786ea94852048406c8086.zh: 25% 是在全部收益的基础上发明的有效现金补贴。它既不是法定的包容率，也不是个人边际所得税率。直接输入边际利率可能会误报津贴。实际税收需要相关年份的规则、其他收入和损失、帐户处理以及纳税人的情况。

Recheck the current official rules before using the dates for an actual payment, particularly when the year, jurisdiction or personal circumstances differ from this fixed example.

e6a27701b8ed8e24359d7f2936c903644279b1dd.src: Hypothetical tax-exclusive trade-in with full settlement of the old loan and one new fixed-rate amortizing loan. Net trade equity equals trade proceeds less the old payout. Available cash is used only up to the remaining transaction need; surplus trade proceeds and unused offered cash do not create negative debt. For the attribution, cash first funds replacement price and charges; any remaining loan can include the prior shortfall. The attributed interest uses the same new rate and term, not the old loan terms. Nominal annual rate is divided by 12, payments occur at month-end and no balloon applies. Vehicle value follows an assumed constant annual decline. Taxes, running costs, sale expenses, penalties, optional products and investment opportunity costs are excluded. No lender approval, actual trade value or future resale price is implied.
e6a27701b8ed8e24359d7f2936c903644279b1dd.zh: 假设的不含税以旧换新，全额结算旧贷款和一笔新的固定利率摊销贷款。净贸易权益等于贸易收益减去旧支出。可用现金仅用于剩余交易需求；盈余贸易收益和未使用的现金不会产生负债务。对于归属，现金优先资金重置价格和费用；任何剩余贷款都可以包括之前的缺口。归属利息使用相同的新利率和期限，而不是旧贷款条款。名义年利率除以 12，在月底付款，不适用气球。车辆价值遵循假设的每年持续下降的趋势。税收、运营成本、销售费用、罚款、可选产品和投资机会成本不包括在内。不暗示贷款机构批准、实际交易价值或未来转售价格。

e714441b2a9db698fcb63802fe8d6606338e04ad.src: If the first-period CAD 100 difference is spent elsewhere, it is not available for the later premiums. The household would need a different funding plan, such as more cash assigned during the second period or a separately funded reserve. The illustration does not assume an emergency fund can be used twice or automatically restore cash spent on another goal.
e714441b2a9db698fcb63802fe8d6606338e04ad.zh: 如果第一期 100 加元的差额用于其他地方，则无法用于以后的保费。该家庭需要不同的资金计划，例如在第二阶段分配更多现金或单独资助的储备金。该插图并未假设应急基金可以使用两次或自动恢复用于另一个目标的现金。

e718151bf6adc41e4904e3e6a470d46e7e02fcdf.src: Borrowing can place a large amount in an investment account immediately. A comparison with a smaller account funded from monthly saving can then look persuasive simply because the opening gross balances are different. The debt and the ongoing cash commitment need to be included before interpreting that comparison.
e718151bf6adc41e4904e3e6a470d46e7e02fcdf.zh: 借款可以立即将大量资金存入投资账户。与每月储蓄资助的较小账户进行比较看起来很有说服力，因为期初总余额不同。在解释比较之前，需要包括债务和持续的现金承诺。

e71b7009f9b24f1afa3c3ec517ec600178070999.src: Within a year, principal arrives before the bill. Each path begins with the same separate opening cash and subtracts the same bill once. The final balances agree after all receipts, but the lowest cash points can differ. A negative segment is a funding gap, not an automatically financed account. Actual dates within a year must be checked before assuming a maturity can fund a bill that year.
e71b7009f9b24f1afa3c3ec517ec600178070999.zh: 一年之内，本金先于账单到达。每条路径都以相同的单独开仓现金开始，并减去相同的账单一次。所有收据后的最终余额一致，但最低现金点可能有所不同。负部分是资金缺口，而不是自动融资账户。在假设到期日可以为当年的账单提供资金之前，必须检查一年内的实际日期。

e7a55387d9ceeec59bed8baecfc2223ae2449106.src: The household-share series counts the fraction of households in each published grouping. The net-worth-share series divides the group’s weighted net worth by the total of all four weighted groups. The second series is a website calculation from rounded means, not a separately published precision estimate. The four groups form one partition, while the two series describe different totals. A small net-worth share does not show that every household in that group has positive wealth or no savings.
e7a55387d9ceeec59bed8baecfc2223ae2449106.zh: 家庭份额系列计算每个已发布分组中的家庭比例。净值份额系列将该组的加权净值除以所有四个加权组的总和。第二个系列是根据四舍五入平均值进行的网站计算，而不是单独发布的精度估计。这四个组形成一个分区，而两个系列描述不同的总数。净资产份额较小并不表明该组中的每个家庭都拥有正财富或没有储蓄。

e7a66f0458854faadc706232754380354cc949ef.src: The duration comparison also distinguishes maturity from duration. A zero-coupon bond pays only at its final date, so Macaulay duration equals maturity. Modified duration is maturity divided by 1 + annual yield; it equals maturity only when that yield is zero. The coupon and maturity matrix separately reprices complete payment schedules rather than treating one duration number as an exact formula for every bond.
e7a66f0458854faadc706232754380354cc949ef.zh: 久期比较还可以区分成熟度和久期。零息债券仅在最终日期支付，因此麦考利久期等于到期日。修正久期为期限除以1+年收益率；仅当收益率为零时才等于到期。息票和到期矩阵分别对完整的付款计划进行重新定价，而不是将一个久期数字视为每只债券的精确公式。

e7bc1a9ccd9843445389f562782ad21904eaf97c.src: A 99% top-up pays CAD 237.60 but leaves CAD 2.40. e82ecec4c8916aed9aed2443ef3d5f370ee5f029.src: An average loss is a probability-weighted calculation. Test the distribution of actual possible costs against the reserve before treating that average as sufficient cash.
e82ecec4c8916aed9aed2443ef3d5f370ee5f029.zh: 平均损失是概率加权计算。在将该平均值视为足够的现金之前，测试实际可能成本的分配情况。

e82fb1e4f1d07f62508ef06a811bc527b47d508f.src: These are independent hypothetical inputs. Include a cost once: if heat or parking is included in the rent, do not add it again as an outside charge. Savings remain household assets but are committed cash in this monthly plan. This residual is not a formal affordability, benefit or lending test.
e82fb1e4f1d07f62508ef06a811bc527b47d508f.zh: 这些是独立的假设输入。包含一次费用：如果租金中包含暖气或停车费，请勿再次将其添加为外部费用。储蓄仍然是家庭资产，但在这个月度计划中承诺是现金。该残差不是正式的负担能力、福利或贷款测试。

e83024a3d15d7b20e81fafa71f9693d65ab6b022.src: The endpoint equals (prepayment cash − prepayment debt) minus (keep-cash cash − keep-cash debt). Initial resources and monthly payment budgets are identical. Positive favors prepayment in this arithmetic; negative favors keeping cash. It does not value liquidity, taxes beyond the entered net return, penalties or uncertainty.
e83024a3d15d7b20e81fafa71f9693d65ab6b022.zh: 终点等于（预付款现金 - 预付款债务）减去（保留现金现金 - 保留现金债务）。初始资源和每月付款预算相同。在此算术中，正数有利于提前付款；负面有利于保留现金。它不重视流动性、超出输入的净回报的税收、罚款或不确定性。

e8b3868b53f541411e45f5ff55237c04f06365de.src: An offset feature is not free merely because the linked cash earns no taxable interest. Moneysmart warns that some banks charge for offset features through a higher interest rate, account fees or both, and it recommends comparing those costs with the interest expected to be saved. The calculator makes the rate difference and the fee explicit rather than assuming the offset loan is priced identically to the alternative.
e8b3868b53f541411e45f5ff55237c04f06365de.zh: 抵消功能并不是免费的，仅仅因为相关现金不赚取应税利息。 Moneysmart 警告称，一些银行通过提高利率、账户费用或两者兼而有之来收取抵消功能的费用，并建议将这些成本与预期节省的利息进行比较。计算器会明确显示利率差异和费用，而不是假设抵消贷款的定价与替代贷款相同。

e8bfb0502fa2b1885186d88aadc7c570084ca0d5.src: Under CRA’s 2026 RESP guide, a payment must be for a Canadian-resident subscriber and only one subscriber. e8c4f9fa4f433a59da9d1b4ed6a43c645f0a8ff1.src: The credit input here is the value after any required percentage, threshold or other calculation. If an invented eligible base of CAD 10,000 were multiplied by an invented 12% credit factor, the amount entered in this tool would be CAD 1,200. Neither invented number is a current Canadian rate or a claim that a specific expense qualifies.
e8c4f9fa4f433a59da9d1b4ed6a43c645f0a8ff1.zh: 此处输入的信用值是任何所需百分比、阈值或其他计算之后的值。如果发明的合格基础 10,000 加元乘以发明的 12% 信用系数，则在此工具中输入的金额将为 1,200 加元。这两个发明的数字都不是加拿大当前的费率，也不是特定费用符合条件的声明。

e9568e51007521bebfd5d659a6817a96e588f1cc.src: Original hypothetical same-date CAD ledger, assuming a carrier-approved ordinary minimum-payment illustration and a separate non-registered destination for securities. No source deductions, fees, sale, price change, settlement delay or return is modeled. All values use the same assumed transfer-date valuation. The selected gross payment is capped at entered available RRIF value; any unrepresented request is reported separately and is not a finding of a statutory breach. The calculator does not determine the legal minimum, issuer availability, tax liability, contribution room, benefit effects or cost basis. Income-tax cash is an independently entered earmark, not a tax calculation. Both tax and household spending are budget assignments; the displayed bank balance is measured before either is paid. A negative budget remainder is an unfunded assignment, not a negative bank account or automatic loan.
e9568e51007521bebfd5d659a6817a96e588f1cc.zh: 原始假设的同日加元账本，假设有运营商批准的普通最低付款说明和单独的非注册证券目的地。没有对来源扣除、费用、销售、价格变化、结算延迟或退货进行建模。所有价值均使用相同的假定转让日期估值。所选总付款额上限为输入的可用 RRIF 值；任何无人代理的请求均会单独报告，且不构成违法行为。该计算器无法确定法定最低限额、发行人可用性、纳税义务、供款空间、效益影响或成本基础。所得税现金是独立输入的专项资金，而不是税收计算。税收和家庭支出都是预算分配；显示的银行余额是在付款之前测量的。负预算余额是一项无资金分配的任务，而不是负银行账户或自动贷款。

e88c0144dc3ebd06b1f6e06a6b918131fdaae795.src: An independently authored, fully subscribed, pro-rata rights-issue benchmark; no company, security quote or actual offer is evaluated. The offer grants one new share per selected number of old shares. Subscription price is the entered old quote less its selected percentage discount. Existing business value is assumed unchanged; new subscription cash adds value dollar for dollar and all company new shares are ultimately taken up, regardless of this holder’s choice. The theoretical ex-rights price is (ratio × old quote + subscription price) / (ratio + 1), not a forecast of trading price. The eligible holding’s entitlement is calculated proportionally, including mathematical fractional new shares with no rounding or dealing restriction. Rights are assumed transferable and sold at the calculated theoretical value without fees in the sale scenario. Lapse receives no compensation. Neither term applies universally to actual offers. No issue fee, tax, spread, price movement, deadline date, receipt delay, interest, corporate-value change or tax cost basis is calculated. The outside cash is the only funding available to exercise; no asset sale or borrowing is invented. The entered cash covers the modeled full subscription. Resource totals include the same opening shares and outside cash in every displayed alternative. They are static theoretical comparisons, not guaranteed executable transactions, income or a judgment about whether participation is suitable.
e88c0144dc3ebd06b1f6e06a6b918131fdaae795.zh: 独立撰写、全额认购、按比例配股基准；不评估任何公司、证券报价或实际报价。此次要约授予每选定数量的旧股一股新股。订阅价格是输入的旧报价减去选定的折扣百分比。假设现有商业价值不变；新的认购现金会增加价值，并且无论持有人如何选择，所有公司新股最终都会被认购。理论除权价为（比例×旧报价+申购价）/（比例+1），并非交易价格预测。合格持股的权利按比例计算，包括没有四舍五入或交易限制的数学分数新股。在销售场景中，假设权利可以转让并按计算出的理论价值免费出售。失误不会得到任何补偿。这两个术语都普遍适用于实际报价。不计算发行费用、税费、利差、价格变动、截止日期、接收延迟、利息、公司价值变化或税收成本基础。外部现金是唯一可以行使的资金；没有发明资产出售或借贷。输入的现金涵盖了模拟的全额认购。资源总额包括每个显示的替代方案中相同的期初股票和外部现金。它们是静态的理论比较，不保证可执行交易、收入或对参与是否合适的判断。

e9769c8e61f48424a453f20bc3b4f17eedfb4609.src: This simplified example omits pensions, businesses, other property, taxes triggered by sale, transaction costs and additional obligations. A more complete inventory can include those items with clear definitions. Be careful when combining amounts before and after tax or treating a future income entitlement as an immediately spendable lump sum.
e9769c8e61f48424a453f20bc3b4f17eedfb4609.zh: 这个简化的示例省略了养老金、企业、其他财产、销售引发的税收、交易成本和额外义务。更完整的清单可以包括那些具有明确定义的项目。在合并税前和税后金额或将未来收入权利视为可立即支出的一次性总付时要小心。

e9793a00ab6bb74ceda1e38e774183961a197bae.src: Repurchasing shares can raise EPS by reducing the denominator, but the cash committed has an opportunity cost. At a material premium to book, a repurchase generally reduces book value per remaining share compared with retaining the same cash. It can still create value if the stock trades below conservatively estimated intrinsic value. The argument therefore depends on purchase price, sustainable earnings and the alternatives available for that capital.
e9793a00ab6bb74ceda1e38e774183961a197bae.zh: 回购股票可以通过减少分母来提高每股收益，但承诺的现金有机会成本。与保留相同现金相比，回购通常会降低每股剩余股份的账面价值，其账面价值显着溢价。如果股票交易价格低于保守估计的内在价值，它仍然可以创造价值。因此，争论取决于购买价格、可持续收入以及该资本可用的替代方案。

eab65afcf79290e0354eec052287ebfc2b5ce2ca.src: Two invented scenarios start with zero own-money investment equity. One borrows the selected principal and invests it immediately; the other borrows nothing. Both receive the same monthly household cash: the loan’s monthly interest plus the selected extra investing cash. The borrowing case pays interest from that budget and invests the remainder; the no-loan case invests the whole budget. All deposits arrive at month-end after growth. Loan principal stays unchanged until repayment at the final date; interest is fully paid monthly and never capitalized. Both investments receive the same constant effective annual total-return assumption, converted to monthly factors. All distributions are reinvested. There are no fees, taxes, interest deductions, collateral calls, forced sales, borrowing limits or changes in rates. Availability of the derived monthly cash and the loan is assumed, not assessed. Negative investment-minus-debt values remain liabilities requiring another repayment source. This narrow matched-cash calculation cannot determine suitability or reproduce an actual lending contract.
eab65afcf79290e0354eec052287ebfc2b5ce2ca.zh: 两个发明的场景从零自有资金投资权益开始。借入选定的本金并立即进行投资；另一个则不借任何东西。两人每月都会收到相同的家庭现金：贷款的每月利息加上选定的额外投资现金。借款案例从该预算中支付利息并将剩余部分用于投资；无贷款情况下投资全部预算。所有存款均在增长后于月底到达。贷款本金保持不变，直至最后日期还款；利息每月全额支付，且不资本化。两项投资均获得相同的恒定有效年度总回报假设（转换为月度因子）。所有分配均进行再投资。不存在任何费用、税收、利息扣除、抵押品催缴、强制出售、借贷限制或利率变化。所产生的每月现金和贷款的可用性是假设的，而不是评估的。负投资减去债务价值仍然是需要其他偿还来源的负债。这种狭隘的匹配现金计算无法确定适用性或重现实际的贷款合同。

ea6fe506f6d213beb42af6b1671776862dd31754.src: Likewise, the cash scenario stops at the chosen horizon. It assigns no cost to later years and supplies no automatic income beyond them. A different cell is a different conditional calculation, not stronger evidence that a target is safe. At zero dispersion, the result is either 0% or 100%, with equality counted as meeting the comparison amount.

ebad716c1b58f8c67d1841c69f392043dd8fc06c.src: Only interest appears in these bars. The principal is not added to it or counted as a charge. A 360 denominator produces more accrual than 365 for a positive identical principal, quote and day count. That mechanical difference does not establish which actual product offers a better return or borrowing cost.
ebad716c1b58f8c67d1841c69f392043dd8fc06c.zh: 这些条中仅显示利息。本金不计入其中或计为费用。对于相同的本金、报价和天数，360 分母比 365 产生更多的应计收益。这种机械差异并不能确定哪种实际产品提供更好的回报或借贷成本。

ebb13c054aa75f2235fd1be6b851bc6b385481f2.src: Dwelling condition is assessed by the respondent. A reported need does not provide a technical inspection, a repair scope, a cash price or a payment deadline. Those missing quantities matter when the question changes from describing housing conditions to deciding how much cash a particular bill requires.
ebb13c054aa75f2235fd1be6b851bc6b385481f2.zh: 居住条件由受访者评估。报告的需求不提供技术检查、维修范围、现金价格或付款期限。当问题从描述住房条件转变为决定特定账单需要多少现金时，这些缺失的数量就很重要。

ebd23e615e6234268a2bae445a2f00fd6a639334.src: Use common equity, not the common-share capital line alone or total equity including preferred and other instruments. The July share count is deliberately dated. A slightly newer provider count produces about C$387.65bn market value. The tangible-book subtraction is before deferred-tax offsets; do not pair it mechanically with a reported ROTCE using a different denominator.
ebd23e615e6234268a2bae445a2f00fd6a639334.zh: 使用普通股，而不是单独的普通股资本额度或包括优先股和其他工具在内的总股本。七月份的股票盘点是故意注明日期的。较新的供应商数量产生了约 3,876.5 亿加元的市场价值。有形账面扣除额是在递延税项抵销之前；不要将其与使用不同分母的报告 ROTCE 机械地配对。

ebd6cecf7334383537767b04e9935c07ce9cfe22.src: Four charts connect invoices, operating costs, collection delays, owner withdrawals and a separate hypothetical tax earmark.

ebd753aa401c5744e04e5b5352dd4d5d876b7547.src: Finally, distinguish amortization from the term over which an actual rate is fixed. The twenty-five-year interest total assumes no rate changes merely to make the arithmetic inspectable. Use a separate renewal and household-payment plan for real future obligations. A clear purchase ledger should show the cash used now, the principal borrowed now and the assumptions behind payments made later.
ebd753aa401c5744e04e5b5352dd4d5d876b7547.zh: 最后，将摊销与实际利率固定的期限区分开来。二十五年的利息总额假设利率没有变化，只是为了使算术易于检查。使用单独的续订和家庭付款计划来履行未来的实际义务。清晰的采购分类账应显示现在使用的现金、现在借入的本金以及以后付款背后的假设。

ebd89ffda0589e90e7d152bf9a46d2a13cb5f09c.src: A monthly budget of CAD 3,000 at a constant 3% inflation assumption becomes about CAD 6,281 after 25 years. This is an original calculation, not a forecast of Canadian prices. The increase compounds: applying 3% to the original budget every year without increasing the base would understate it.
ebd89ffda0589e90e7d152bf9a46d2a13cb5f09c.zh: 按恒定 3% 的通货膨胀假设，每月预算 3,000 加元在 25 年后变为约 6,281 加元。这是原始计算，而不是对加拿大价格的预测。增加的费用会增加：每年对原始预算应用 3%，而不增加基数，这会低估预算。

ebeac43893907d47e045ca04a2ed8029173ba1fe.src: The finished review should state the largest known exposures, the missing data, the tested scenarios, and the reason for any concentration retained. That record makes a later decision easier to evaluate when prices and portfolio weights change.
ebeac43893907d47e045ca04a2ed8029173ba1fe.zh: 完成的审核应说明最大的已知暴露、缺失的数据、测试的场景以及保留任何浓度的原因。当价格和投资组合权重发生变化时，该记录使得以后的决策更容易评估。

ebebda0199887d3562f112c974957cdd676db548.src: The controls and fixed ranges are original teaching choices, not confidence intervals, equally likely cases or measured error margins. A ranking has practical meaning only when the ranges themselves are defensible for the decision. A firm quote, an uncertain estimate and a voluntary deposit commitment may deserve different evidence and different ranges.
ebebda0199887d3562f112c974957cdd676db548.zh: 控制和固定范围是原始教学选择，而不是置信区间、同等可能的情况或测量的误差范围。只有当范围本身足以支持决策时，排名才具有实际意义。确定的报价、不确定的估计和自愿存款承诺可能需要不同的证据和不同的范围。

ebf600106336e5735eb6f20d71ce476ea7df8169.src: The capped amount is visibly larger than its starting amount. That is useful information about the number of dollars received, but it does not establish that the pension buys more. The spending basket has also risen. The index convention matters: the point labelled twenty-five includes twenty-five increases; it is not the twenty-fifth payment with only twenty-four increases.
ebf600106336e5735eb6f20d71ce476ea7df8169.zh: 上限金额明显大于起始金额。这是关于收到的美元数量的有用信息，但它并不能证明养老金可以购买更多美元。支出篮子也有所增加。指数惯例很重要：标记为二十五的点包括二十五次上涨；这不是第 25 次付款，只有 24 次增加。

Omitting sufficiently strong performers can make the listed mean lower than the complete-cohort mean. If no records are omitted, neither group calculation responds to this adjustment and the two curves coincide. This illustration cannot measure the size or sign of bias in an actual database.
ebfa77cdb699365c0426a6df36b667ab80c88fe9.zh: 水平调整仅在当前省略的记录中添加百分点。上市集团的回报保持不变。忽略足够强的表现者可能会使列出的平均值低于整个队列的平均值。如果没有遗漏任何记录，则两组计算均不会响应此调整，并且两条曲线重合。此图无法衡量实际数据库中偏差的大小或迹象。

ec6ee0c0b5759c23ac886412e53b406ab3bc5e9c.src: We underwrite the U.S. opportunity through customer economics. Commercial borrowers can support payments, treasury and wealth relationships, making the total relationship more valuable than a standalone loan spread. The bank must convert that potential into durable operating deposits and fees. Growing loans faster than relationship funding can weaken the funding mix, increase marginal costs and expose the franchise to a less forgiving credit cycle. Headline balance growth is therefore insufficient evidence of success.
ec6ee0c0b5759c23ac886412e53b406ab3bc5e9c.zh: 我们通过客户经济学承保美国机会。商业借款人可以支持付款、财务和财富关系，使整体关系比单独的贷款利差更有价值。银行必须将这种潜力转化为持久的运营存款和费用。贷款增长速度快于关系融资可能会削弱融资组合，增加边际成本，并使特许经营面临更宽松的信贷周期。因此，总体余额增长不足以证明成功。

ecdab7e8e58a0d839f1823c0f97d76c1949b5426.src: Original annual-pay, option-free fixed-coupon bond calculation at a coupon-date valuation point, with all remaining contractual payments assumed to be made in full. Starting modified duration is 7.72173 and annual convexity is 74.99768, calculated from derivatives with respect to the annual yield written as a fraction. Yield moves are entered in percentage points and divided by 100 in the formulas. Every shock is instantaneous: no time passes, no coupon is received and remaining maturity is unchanged. Exact means exact within this single-yield discounted-cash-flow model, not an observed execution price. No default, embedded option, spread decomposition, non-parallel curve move, tax, transaction fee, bid–ask spread or coupon reinvestment is modeled. Negative resulting yields are mathematical stresses, not available quotes.
ecdab7e8e58a0d839f1823c0f97d76c1949b5426.zh: 原始按息票日估值点计算年付、无期权固定息票债券，并假设所有剩余合同付款已全额支付。起始修正久期为 7.72173，年凸度为 74.99768，根据以分数形式书写的年收益率的衍生工具计算得出。收益率变动以百分比形式输入并在公式中除以 100。每次冲击都是瞬时的：没有时间流逝，没有收到息票，剩余期限不变。精确意味着在单收益贴现现金流模型中精确，而不是观察到的执行价格。没有对违约、嵌入期权、利差分解、非平行曲线移动、税收、交易费、买卖价差或息票再投资进行建模。产生的负收益率是数学压力，无法提供报价。

ed46136069b5f49ba2366a1c86932dbbe98685ed.src: Original 20-year scenario, not a historical return series, forecast, success probability or validated withdrawal strategy. Annual returns after costs are -18%, -8%, 7%, 12%, 6%, 9%, 4%, 5%, 8%, 3%, 6%, 4%, 5%, -10%, 10%, 7%, 4%, 6%, 3%, 5%. Withdrawals occur at each year’s start, before returns. From year 2, the rule indexes the prior request, tests request/opening portfolio against the initial rate plus the selected relative trigger, then applies at most one cut, bounded by the indexed essential floor. There is no catch-up restoration beyond later inflation increases. Actual payments are capped at assets; unfunded requests are separate. No pensions, tax, mandatory account minima, mortality or later years are modeled.
ed46136069b5f49ba2366a1c86932dbbe98685ed.zh: 原始 20 年情景，而不是历史回报系列、预测、成功概率或经过验证的提款策略。扣除成本后的年回报率为-18%、-8%、7%、12%、6%、9%、4%、5%、8%、3%、6%、4%、5%、-10%、10%、7%、4%、6%、3%、5%。提款发生在每年年初、返还之前。从第 2 年开始，该规则对先前的请求进行索引，根据初始利率加上所选的相对触发器来测试请求/开仓投资组合，然后最多应用一次削减，以索引的基本下限为界。除了随后的通胀上升之外，不会出现追赶性恢复。实际支付金额以资产为上限；未资助的请求是单独的。没有对养老金、税收、强制性账户最低限额、死亡率或晚年进行建模。

ed133a35b01cf7516b722aacfa2187e504dae1bd.src: Official anchor: Service Canada lists a maximum age-65 pension of CAD 762.50 per month for October–December 2026 and a 0.6% increase for each month after age 65, up to 36% at 70. The selected pension share is an editable teaching assumption, not an eligibility or residence calculation. Original arithmetic freezes today’s quarterly rate for every future payment and assumes 12 payments each year; actual OAS is adjusted quarterly for CPI. It excludes the separate 10% increase after age 75, tax/recovery tax, GIS, Allowance, other income, discounting, payment timing and mortality. The crossover is not a recommendation or forecast.
ed133a35b01cf7516b722aacfa2187e504dae1bd.zh: 官方锚点：加拿大服务部列出了 2026 年 10 月至 12 月期间 65 岁的养老金最高为每月 762.50 加元，65 岁以后每月增加 0.6%，70 岁时最高可达 36%。所选养老金份额是可编辑的教学假设，而不是资格或居住计算。最初的算术冻结了未来每笔付款的当前季度费率，并假设每年支付 12 次；实际的 OAS 每季度根据 CPI 进行调整。它不包括 75 岁后单独增加 10%、税收/恢复税、GIS、津贴、其他收入、折扣、付款时间和死亡率。交叉不是建议或预测。

ed137d3b9121e2d9fea8e77718c0187ae3de1a8b.src: Adding negative 20% and positive 25% would instead give positive 5%, which is not the compounded result. The second percentage applies to the smaller value after the first loss. A percentage recovery must be read against its own starting base.
ed137d3b9121e2d9fea8e77718c0187ae3de1a8b.zh: 添加负 20% 和正 25% 将得到正 5%，这不是复合结果。第二个百分比适用于第一次损失后的较小值。回收百分比必须根据其自身的起始基数来读取。

Using a nominal investment return against these real cash flows would mix measurement bases. The tool does not separately forecast CPI or reproduce actual annual CPP indexation.
ecb863c94dff0f53d889893ae76018cd2147aaa6.zh: 图中的所有付款均以恒定购买力美元表示。因此，贴现率也必须是真实的。使用名义投资回报与这些实际现金流量会混合衡量基础。该工具不会单独预测 CPI 或重现实际的年度 CPP 指数。

ecbb6916da94744ce8839425d8c0885b50e3b27c.src: The more revealing test is the bridge from revenue to common earnings. Subtract insurance service expenses from adjusted revenue, then deduct operating expenses and credit losses, apply tax, deduct preferred and other equity distributions, and divide by diluted shares. A gross insurance-revenue increase can overstate operating momentum if claims rise alongside it. Likewise, a lower share count can amplify EPS without producing equivalent growth in group profit.
ecbb6916da94744ce8839425d8c0885b50e3b27c.zh: 更具启发性的测试是从收入到共同收益的桥梁。从调整后的收入中减去保险服务费用，然后扣除营业费用和信用损失，应用税款，扣除优先股和其他股权分配，然后除以稀释股份。如果索赔额随之增加，保险总收入的增长可能会夸大运营势头。同样，较低的股份数量可以提高每股收益，但不会产生同等的集团利润增长。

ecbdbddc1e121db28658bad1289dbf9f4617458b.src: The Government of Canada’s CPP start-age guidance states that the standard start age is 65, with starts available from 60 to 70. Before 65, the monthly amount is reduced by 0.6% for each month early. After 65, it increases by 0.7% for each month delayed, through age 70.
ecbdbddc1e121db28658bad1289dbf9f4617458b.zh: 加拿大政府 CPP 起始年龄指南规定，标准起始年龄为 65 岁，起始年龄为 60 岁至 70 岁。65 岁之前，每月金额每个月初减少0.6%。 65 岁之后，每推迟一个月，直至 70 岁，该比例就会增加 0.7%。
