The total loss rate was 41 basis points; CET1 was 13.0%. These figures are starting observations, not through-cycle forecasts. The key distinction is between losses on borrowers already in difficulty and changes in expected losses on performing exposures. A quieter allowance quarter can improve profit without proving that new problem-loan formation has stopped. Our credit thesis requires evidence across several quarters: stable formations, manageable watch-list migration, cash recoveries and losses consistent with the risk embedded in new lending. A falling impaired-loan balance alone is insufficient because write-offs and loan sales can also reduce it. Commercial files can make quarterly losses uneven, so a single favorable quarter should not set the terminal loss assumption. Stress cases should combine weaker revenue, higher impaired losses and renewed performing allowances rather than vary only one benign input. Portfolio exits introduce another distinction. BMO completed the 138-branch sale in September; the Transportation and Vendor Finance sale was announced with a retained minority interest. Exiting lower-return assets can improve capital efficiency, but the foregone income must leave the earnings forecast. Capital released becomes valuable only through productive reinvestment or disciplined distributions. We would not add a full capital benefit, retain all disposed earnings and assume unchanged funding costs. The clean test is whether recurring common earnings per dollar of equity improve after transaction effects settle. A rising capital ratio with declining per-share earning power would be weaker evidence than the ratio alone suggests. BMO Q3 2026 Report to Shareholders · Tables 1–5, 8–9 and 12; printed pp. 7–12, 15–19 BMO Completes Sale of 138 U.S. Branches · Opening announcement BMO Announces Strategic Sale of Transportation and Vendor Finance · Capital efficiency and retained minority interest Dividends and buybacks Cash returns help, but the repurchase price matters ↑ The declared quarterly dividend is C$1.71 , payable November 26 to holders of record October 30. Annualizing that declaration gives C$6.84, a 2.89% yield at the reference price and approximately 47.6% of our trailing adjusted EPS measure. The annualized dividend is a convention, not a promise of future payments. Its contribution to total return is meaningful, but a low earnings multiple or an attractive entry price cannot be inferred from dividend continuity alone. The September authorization permits up to 25 million share repurchases through September 7, 2027. It is permission to buy, not proof of execution. The approval release identified 695.1 million shares outstanding at August 31. Our model must reconcile future share reductions with the cash and equity spent to achieve them. Buying above book value can increase EPS while reducing book value per remaining share; whether that creates value depends on the return the repurchased earnings stream offers compared with other uses of capital. The Moneris agreement adds a separate capital event: BMO expects an approximately C$600 million after-tax gain and roughly 15 basis points of CET1 benefit on closing, anticipated by the end of Q1 FY2027. We exclude that gain from recurring earning power. Sale proceeds, accounting gains and free capital are different quantities. Our preferred distribution policy retains capacity for credible lending opportunities and adverse credit outcomes, then repurchases shares when their prospective return is attractive. Maximizing the near-term EPS lift would be a weaker objective than improving long-term value per share. A successful operating recovery can coexist with modest prospective share returns when the starting valuation incorporates a much stronger franchise. The latest quarter provides evidence of execution: adjusted diluted EPS reached C$2.28 and adjusted annualized ROE reached 14.2%. Those results strengthen the case that the bank can earn an acceptable return on its capital. They also raise the burden of proof. Investors need to establish that the mix of margins, credit costs and capital-markets income can survive less favourable conditions before treating one quarter’s return as a durable earnings base. The historical bridge is useful because an annualized quarter and trailing earnings answer different questions. Our central question is the sustainable return required to justify the price. A steady-state diagnostic using 10.5% cost of equity and 4% growth implies approximately 17% sustainable ROE at two times book. The diagnostic shows why the investment needs continued improvement beyond the latest 14.2% result. Clear evidence of stronger recurring returns would support the price; progress that plateaus near today’s profitability would leave limited room for disappointment. The decision hinge The recovery is real; the easy valuation argument has gone ↑ Research judgment: TD is best framed as a capital-return and earnings-durability test. The investment case needs more than evidence that the franchise survived its U.S. compliance failure. At the October 23, 2026 TSX close of C$174.47, the shares trade at a calculated 17.86 times trailing adjusted EPS and 2.50 times July book value. That valuation already anticipates substantial recovery. It leaves less room for a thesis built only on improving sentiment. The central question is whether incremental earnings come from deeper relationships and a better operating model, or from favourable credit comparisons, buoyant markets and fewer shares. These sources can coexist, but they deserve different multiples. Customer relationships and repeatable service efficiency support a durable premium. Market activity and provision normalization can lift earnings quickly while offering less protection when conditions reverse. TD has an attractive route to value creation: retain the Canadian franchise, improve U.S. returns within existing constraints and distribute genuinely surplus capital. The combined route is more credible than assuming a rapid reopening of unrestricted U.S. expansion. The base underwriting should therefore allow operating improvement without assigning a removal date to the U.S. asset cap. A favourable business view does not automatically establish an attractive entry price. The valuation must still work after normalizing market-sensitive income, retaining a continuing control-cost burden and charging a sensible cost of equity. Upside requires earnings to outperform that disciplined baseline or a premium multiple to persist. Downside can arise from multiple compression even when absolute earnings continue to grow. It is neither a forecast nor an assertion that the latest quarter can be repeated unchanged. The more revealing test is the bridge from revenue to common earnings. Subtract insurance service expenses from adjusted revenue, then deduct operating expenses and credit losses, apply tax, deduct preferred and other equity distributions, and divide by diluted shares. A gross insurance-revenue increase can overstate operating momentum if claims rise alongside it. Likewise, a lower share count can amplify EPS without producing equivalent growth in group profit. FY2025 reported earnings include the Schwab sale and should not anchor a recurring P/E argument. Equally, adjusted earnings should not become a licence to remove every inconvenient expense. AML remediation and related governance investments already burden the operating result. A model that adds them back again would create an earnings number that the published adjusted measure does not support. The forward model should preserve these distinctions. Allow a normal credit charge, avoid extrapolating a particularly strong capital-markets quarter indefinitely, and make tax and share assumptions visible. A conservative model can still recognize real productivity benefits. The falsifier is not simply a smaller adjusted-to-reported gap; it is a failure of common earnings to grow after the unusually helpful comparisons and repurchase effects fade. Those figures describe distinct engines. Treating TD as a single interest-rate exposure obscures the different operating risks, capital requirements and cyclicality underneath the consolidated result. The Canadian relationship bank is the anchor. The relevant question is whether deposit gathering, mortgage execution and business-client penetration expand together without sacrificing pricing or underwriting discipline. Volume growth purchased through aggressive rates would be less valuable than growth from customers using several products. Watch the relation between loan growth, deposit growth, margin and acquisition costs, rather than declaring victory from any one volume measure. The U.S. business requires a different lens. The asset restriction makes balance-sheet allocation and customer economics especially important. Shedding low-return assets can improve margins and capital efficiency even as total loans contract. But runoff is finite. Once that comparison is exhausted, the business must demonstrate healthier core relationships, better deposit mix and greater fee contribution. Faster reported growth against restructuring losses is a weaker signal than recurring operating improvement. Wealth, insurance and wholesale broaden the earnings base but bring their own sensitivities. Rising asset markets support fees; active financing and trading support wholesale; insurance claims can interrupt the apparent annuity. Diversification helps most when the engines respond differently to stress. The underwriting should not give every business its best environment simultaneously. Segment ROEs also use allocated capital, so their levels should not be read as directly interchangeable with consolidated shareholder returns. Q3 credit losses were C$917 million, with C$865 million impaired and C$52 million performing provisions; gross impaired loans were C$5.143 billion. These figures support a better aggregate credit picture. They do not establish that every portfolio has reached the same point in its loss cycle. The distinction matters because commercial resolutions can improve the group total while consumer migration worsens elsewhere. Provision releases and builds are forward-looking estimates, not cash receipts or losses already realized. The model should therefore distinguish the loss-rate assumption from loan growth and test both together. A weaker economy can raise provisions at the same time that slower lending restrains revenue, producing a disproportionate hit to common earnings. The separate regulatory issue is the U.S. bank subsidiaries’ US$434 billion asset cap established in the October 2024 resolution. It does not cover all TD businesses. Nevertheless, the constraint reduces management’s strategic freedom where controls failed. Capital strength can absorb costs and support distributions, but a high CET1 ratio cannot substitute for accepted remediation or authorize unrestricted U.S. growth. TD’s August 2026 update raised expected FY2026 remediation and related control spending to US$550 million and envisaged important work through 2027. Completion of management actions is only one stage; testing, sustainability and external review still matter. The base case should retain uncertainty after 2027. The downside mechanism is a longer period of elevated costs and constrained deployment, not merely another one-time fine. A fresh timetable or cost increase would warrant an immediate model review. At the reference price, C$10 billion would purchase roughly 57 million shares before subsequent price changes. The economic benefit depends on the price paid relative to intrinsic value, not simply the size of the headline. Fewer shares can raise EPS even when total earnings are unchanged. Buying above book value also changes the book-value trajectory, so an earnings-minus-dividends rollforward alone is insufficient. The model must reduce cash capital and share count together. It should then test how much capital remains after risk-weighted asset growth, ordinary dividends and continuing control investment. Repurchases are most compelling when the bank can distribute surplus resources without constraining high-return customer opportunities. An eventual slowdown in repurchases is not inherently negative if capital is being reinvested productively; the accompanying return evidence determines the interpretation. The declared quarterly common dividend is C$1.12, implying C$4.48 annualized and a calculated 2.57% yield at the reference close. The shareholder proposition therefore relies substantially on earnings growth and capital allocation, rather than income alone. Future increases remain decisions of the board. Avoid counting both a falling share count and an unchanged stock of surplus capital as independent sources of value. What changes the view Demand proof of durability after the helpful comparisons fade ↑ The next scheduled results conference call is 3 December 2026 at 9:30 a.m. ET . Test whether core U.S. relationships improve as portfolio runoff matures, whether Canadian customer depth supports margin without undue pricing concessions, and whether fee businesses maintain acceptable returns when market activity is less generous. These are monitoring windows tied to subsequent results; no unverified regulatory milestone is treated as a scheduled catalyst here. Capital return is more measurable. Compare completed repurchases with the authorized program, average prices paid, diluted shares and the CET1 bridge. A reduction in surplus capital should be explained by distributions or productive deployment. Persistent excess capital with weak reinvestment returns would weaken the efficiency thesis; aggressive payouts accompanied by deteriorating credit or operating controls would weaken its resilience. The thesis would be materially impaired by another substantial remediation-cost increase, a longer validation timetable, persistent deterioration in core U.S. deposits, or consumer losses that outweigh commercial improvement. It would also weaken if market-fee softness exposed poor underlying cost control. None requires a solvency crisis to hurt shareholders: a premium valuation can fall as investors reassess the persistence of earnings. Conversely, the strongest upside proof would combine repeatable pre-provision growth, sound consumer credit, accepted control improvements and capital returned at sensible prices. That combination would support confidence in a durable return on equity. The research stance should change with that evidence and the entry valuation together. A higher EPS forecast alone is insufficient if the risk-adjusted multiple required to justify the share price has risen just as much. 04a41cfc5218ba120b0330c7b09e47cb615187e0.src: Pounds sterling (GBP) throughout; no CAD conversion. Public GOV.UK automatic-enrolment rules checked 25 October 2026: 5% employee and 3% employer minimums on qualifying earnings between £6,240 and £50,270, with 8% combined. Tax relief is modelled at the 20% basic rate up to £50,270 of earnings and the 40% higher rate between £50,270 and £100,000, using the £12,570 personal allowance stated for the tax year 6 April 2026 to 5 April 2027. Earnings are capped at £100,000 so the personal-allowance taper, additional rate, Scottish rates and Welsh rates remain outside the model. The model holds one annual earnings figure constant, ignores bonuses or irregular pay, and does not determine eligibility, scheme pensionable pay, annual allowance, carry-forward, salary sacrifice, National Insurance, student loan, other deductions, investment return, fees, or the timing of actual payroll and relief payments. Employer contributions are not deducted from the employee’s pay. Net pay means the contribution comes out before Income Tax; relief at source means the employee pays net and the provider claims basic-rate relief. Neither route is assumed to be available in every scheme.
04a41cfc5218ba120b0330c7b09e47cb615187e0.zh: 全程英镑（GBP）；没有 CAD 转换。公共 GOV.UK 自动注册规则于 2026 年 10 月 25 日进行了检查：合格收入在 6,240 英镑至 50,270 英镑之间的雇员最低比例为 5%，雇主最低比例为 3%，合计为 8%。税收减免的模型为收入50,270英镑以下的20%基本税率和50,270英镑至100,000英镑之间40%的较高税率，使用2026年4月6日至2027年4月5日纳税年度规定的12,570英镑个人免税额。收入上限为100,000英镑，因此个人免税额、附加税率、苏格兰税率和威尔士利率仍处于模型之外。该模型保持一项年收入数字不变，忽略奖金或不定期工资，并且不确定资格、计划养老金工资、年度津贴、结转、工资牺牲、国民保险、学生贷款、其他扣除、投资回报、费用或实际工资和救济金的时间。雇主缴款不会从雇员的工资中扣除。净工资是指所得税前的供款；源头减免是指雇员支付净额并且提供者要求基本费率减免。假设这两条路线在每个方案中都不可用。

When higher-rate tax applies, the provider still adds only the basic 20%. Any additional higher-rate relief is claimed from HMRC and paid to the employee rather than added to the pension pot, so it is deliberately outside this bridge. The endpoint is the gross contribution credited before any investment movement or fee, not a cash amount available to spend. Scottish relief-at-source rules can differ, and the source notes that a 19% Scottish rate still receives a 20% at-source claim.

a018f1a8af67e39cc728f6e35a225eda36711874.src: Each pair uses the same earnings and rates. For a basic-rate taxpayer with enough taxable income, the two bars coincide because £100 of gross contribution costs £80 either way. Below the £12,570 personal allowance, net pay gives no Income Tax relief in this model while relief at source still adds 20%, so the net-pay bar is higher. The relief-at-source bar assumes any extra higher-rate relief is successfully claimed; it is not a promise that a claim will be made or paid on time.
a018f1a8af67e39cc728f6e35a225eda36711874.zh: 每对使用相同的收入和费率。对于拥有足够应税收入的基本税率纳税人来说，这两个标准是一致的，因为无论哪种方式，100 英镑的总缴款成本都是 80 英镑。在该模型中，低于 12,570 英镑的个人津贴，净工资不会带来所得税减免，而来源减免仍会增加 20%，因此净工资标准更高。源头救济标准假设任何额外的较高税率救济均已成功申请；这并不承诺按时提出或支付索赔。

a09ed9d12090e9b60b01a842bcdcf6f090df7b63.src: Higher-rate relief is different. The provider claims the basic 20%, and the additional relief is claimed through Self Assessment. The model treats that extra amount as a separate step that arrives later. If the claim is not made, or is delayed, the eventual take-home cost is higher than the chart’s relief-at-source bar assumes.
a09ed9d12090e9b60b01a842bcdcf6f090df7b63.zh: 较高利率的救济则不同。提供者索取基本的 20%，额外的减免则通过自我评估索取。该模型将额外的金额视为稍后到达的单独步骤。如果未提出索赔或索赔被延迟，最终带回家的成本将高于图表中源头救济栏的假设。

a0abd153cbbe14eaf76cf56e8b0358fd19628e47.src: The flat contribution above the upper limit is also an arithmetic result of the band, not a cap on what an employer or employee may contribute. Additional voluntary contributions, salary sacrifice and scheme-specific rates are outside the model.

b122af5a8fd481b06cbe9bb15ae53b84d9dcab7b.src: At £10,000 of earnings, qualifying earnings are £3,760. At 5%, the employee contribution is £188 and the employer contributes £112.80. Because £10,000 is below the £12,570 Personal Allowance, the model calculates no Income Tax to relieve. Net pay therefore reduces take-home pay by the full £188. Relief at source requires £150.40 from take-home pay, and the provider adds £37.60, so the same £188 reaches the pension for £37.60 less current cash.
b122af5a8fd481b06cbe9bb15ae53b84d9dcab7b.zh: 如果收入为 10,000 英镑，则合格收入为 3,760 英镑。按 5% 计算，雇员缴款为 188 英镑，雇主缴款为 112.80 英镑。由于 10,000 英镑低于 12,570 英镑的个人免税额，因此该模型不会计算需要减免的所得税。因此，净工资使实得工资减少了整整 188 英镑。源头救济需要从实得工资中扣除 150.40 英镑，而提供者则增加 37.60 英镑，因此同样的 188 英镑到达养老金时需减去当前现金 37.60 英镑。

b3b639b6ba70cb4817a9cfe393b6ca9b16501d9b.src: A real account balance can include earlier money, investment gains or losses, fees and other movements. The cumulative contribution total is therefore not labelled account value, investment return or bank cash available for an immediate bill.
b3b639b6ba70cb4817a9cfe393b6ca9b16501d9b.zh: 真实账户余额可以包括早期资金、投资收益或损失、费用和其他变动。因此，累计供款总额并未标记为账户价值、投资回报或可用于立即账单的银行现金。

b4cf35ad8162f32dce5780fec93f1ecad8f50c21.src: The legal minimum from April 2019 is 3% from the employer and 5% from the employee, for 8% in total. Scheme rules can require more, and a scheme may use a different definition of pensionable pay. The model therefore applies the selected rates to the band, not to gross salary, and states that choice rather than presenting it as every workplace scheme.

a5dd202beb00e756b7e9285c5238c9a1179316dd.src: CRA’s withdrawals page (modified 10 February 2026) lists the conditions that must be met at the time of a qualifying withdrawal. In plain terms, you must be a resident of Canada; you must have a written agreement to buy or build a qualifying home with an acquisition or construction-completion date before 1 October of the year after the withdrawal; you must not have acquired the home more than 30 days before the withdrawal; you must intend to occupy it as your principal residence within one year after acquiring it; and you must meet the first-time home buyer test that applies to withdrawals. You make the request to your issuer using Form RC725. Residency must continue from the first qualifying withdrawal until the earlier of acquiring the home or death.
a5dd202beb00e756b7e9285c5238c9a1179316dd.zh: CRA 的提款页面（于 2026 年 2 月 10 日修改）列出了合格提款时必须满足的条件。简单来说，您必须是加拿大居民；您必须签署购买或建造合格房屋的书面协议，且购置或建造完成日期必须在提款后当年的 10 月 1 日之前；您在提款前购买房屋的时间不得超过 30 天；您必须打算在购买后一年内将其作为您的主要居所；并且您必须满足适用于提款的首次购房者测试。您使用表格 RC725 向发行人提出请求。居住权必须从第一次符合资格的提款开始一直持续到获得房屋或死亡（以较早者为准）。

a9b9e01effba6bf580588d44a81d9a5d2c98938e.src: The contribution side of a First Home Savings Account (FHSA) is annual: participation room, carry-forward and deductions are counted by calendar year. The withdrawal side runs on dates. When you take money out to buy a home, the Canada Revenue Agency (CRA) tests that withdrawal against the date you acquire the home, the following 1 October, and when you move in. The same first qualifying withdrawal also moves forward the date by which every FHSA you hold must be closed.
a9b9e01effba6bf580588d44a81d9a5d2c98938e.zh: 首次置业储蓄账户（FHSA）的供款部分是每年的：参与空间、结转和扣除按日历年计算。提款方按日期运行。当您取出资金购买房屋时，加拿大税务局 (CRA) 会根据您购买房屋的日期（随后的 10 月 1 日）以及您搬入时测试提款。同样的首次合格提款还会将您持有的每份 FHSA 必须关闭的日期提前。

64e849ca3c95a651cd33949363f6c0ee806d520b.src: The first chart turns each checkpoint into days of margin. The 30-day rule leaves 75 days, because the home is acquired 45 days after the withdrawal rather than up to 30 days before it. The acquisition deadline leaves 520 days between 29 April 2027 and the last permitted day, 30 September 2028. Occupancy one month after acquisition leaves 336 days before the one-year mark of 29 April 2028. If any bar is negative, the withdrawal in this model would not be qualifying. CRA says it would then be a taxable withdrawal that must be included in income for the year received, reassessing an already-assessed return if necessary. CRA also states that a qualifying withdrawal cannot be cancelled once made.
64e849ca3c95a651cd33949363f6c0ee806d520b.zh: 第一个图表将每个检查点转化为保证金天数。 30 天的规则还剩 75 天，因为房屋是在提款后 45 天而不是提前 30 天购买的。收购截止日期从 2027 年 4 月 29 日到最后允许日 2028 年 9 月 30 日之间有 520 天。收购后一个月的入住距离 2028 年 4 月 29 日的一年标记还有 336 天。如果任何条为负，则此模型中的提款将不符合资格。 CRA表示，这将是一笔应税提款，必须计入当年的收入中，并在必要时重新评估已经评估的申报表。 CRA 还规定，符合条件的提款一旦进行就不能取消。

6d2ccb48ad2180420d7269296a60e0c152fd7996.src: The first-time home buyer test for withdrawals is not the same as the one for opening an account. For a withdrawal, you must not have lived in a home that you, alone or jointly, owned as your principal residence at any time in the current calendar year before the withdrawal (other than the 30 days immediately before it) or in any of the four preceding calendar years. In the default case the buyer has never owned a home, so the look-back is passed. The explorer’s simplified look-back only checks whether the last owner-occupied year is at least five years before the withdrawal year. Enter 2023 with a 2027 withdrawal to see it fail.

c7143f9223c45aa1ad56ee25f5d60f92251c7bfa.src: The fourth chart repeats the calculation for first-withdrawal years from 2024 onward. A withdrawal in any year from opening up to 2038 makes the following year the binding trigger. With no qualifying withdrawal, the 15th anniversary in 2039 binds for this buyer. Someone who opens an account at an older age can find the age-71 trigger binding instead: set the opening age to 60 and the period ends in 2035 without a withdrawal. Later qualifying withdrawals for the same purchase are possible while the account remains open and the conditions are met, but they do not restart the clock.

A taxable withdrawal or deemed income at the same rate would cost about CAD 1,050 in tax, leaving CAD 2,450. The final row shows the larger risk: if the CAD 30,000 withdrawal later turned out not to be qualifying — for example because the purchase fell through and no home was acquired before the deadline — the full amount would be taxable, about CAD 9,000 at the illustrative rate. 8746373f52271863f6a0c6efe572494a34d3e35a.zh: 第三张图表使用可编辑的 30% 边际利率来显示赌注。直接转账可将 3,500 加元的全额保留在注册计划内。按相同税率计算的应税提款或视为收入将花费约 1,050 加元的税费，剩下 2,450 加元。最后一行显示了更大的风险：如果 30,000 加元的提款后来被证明不符合资格——例如因为购买失败并且在截止日期之前没有购买房屋——则全额应纳税，按说明税率计算约为 9,000 加元。该税率是一个占位符，不是法定税率或任何人的税收预测；实际税额取决于省份、其他收入、抵免额和年份。

d2a621ee2a774cb6760eb2a451e37a189f5442db.src: A buyer does not have to withdraw the whole balance. In the default case CAD 3,500 is left after the CAD 30,000 qualifying withdrawal. CRA describes three outcomes for property still in an FHSA as the period approaches its end. You can generally transfer it directly to your RRSP or RRIF on a tax-deferred basis; the withdrawals page adds that such a direct transfer does not affect unused RRSP deduction room, whereas withdrawing cash and re-contributing it would. You can make a taxable withdrawal, which is income for the year you receive it and is reported in box 22 of the T4FHSA slip, with income tax withheld at source. If property remains after the period ends, the accounts stop being FHSAs and the fair market value at the end of 31 December is included in income, reported in box 26 of the T4FHSA. CRA recommends closing all FHSAs before the period ends.
d2a621ee2a774cb6760eb2a451e37a189f5442db.zh: 买家不必提取全部余额。在默认情况下，30,000 加元合格提款后还剩下 3,500 加元。 CRA 描述了随着该时期即将结束，仍在 FHSA 中的财产的三种结果。您通常可以在递延税款的基础上直接将其转入您的 RRSP 或 RRIF；提款页面补充说，这种直接转账不会影响未使用的RRSP扣除空间，而提取现金并重新存入则会影响。您可以进行应税提款，即您收到提款当年的收入，并在 T4FHSA 税单的第 22 格中报告，并在源头预扣所得税。如果该期间结束后财产仍然存在，则该账户不再是 FHSA，并且 12 月 31 月底的公平市场价值包含在 T4FHSA 第 26 框中报告的收入中。 CRA 建议在此期间结束之前关闭所有 FHSA。

a0a099b6f0e775a4aa9ea77957fd0f892d429d88.src: A buy-the-dip rule for new pay turns every paycheque into a timing decision. Cash can earn interest while it waits, but the rule can miss a rise, buy after a late dip at a higher price than earlier months, or never fire at all. Write the waiting limit before the first deposit.
a0a099b6f0e775a4aa9ea77957fd0f892d429d88.zh: 为新工资设定“逢低买入”规则，会把每一期工资都变成择时决定。现金在等待期间可以赚取利息，但这条规则可能错过上涨、在后期回调时以高于前几个月的价格买入，或者根本不会触发。请在第一笔存款之前写好等待上限。

0e3ff60791e33410e724218d274d55ce5c5d24b3.src: The question is about new money, not an existing lump sum
0e3ff60791e33410e724218d274d55ce5c5d24b3.zh: 问题针对的是新增资金，而不是现有的一笔整款

b21934ed9e80d4212f7e5bb30a1f3938687105e8.src: Many regular savers invest each deposit soon after their pay arrives. A common alternative is to hold new savings in cash and invest only after prices fall: “I will buy when the market is 10% below its high.” This guide tests that rule for money that arrives monthly from earnings.
b21934ed9e80d4212f7e5bb30a1f3938687105e8.zh: 许多定期储蓄者会在工资到账后不久投入每一笔存款。一种常见的替代做法是把新增储蓄留作现金，只在价格下跌后才投资：“等市场比高点低 10% 时我再买。”本指南针对每月来自工作收入的资金检验这条规则。

6f813b1c68a86c45bd0f68300d944bcd97264f7f.src: That is a different decision from staging a lump sum already on hand. With a lump sum, phased purchases leave part of an existing balance in cash by design; the lump-sum comparison covers that case. FINRA notes that the cash-drag concern applies mainly when a pool of cash is waiting, and that contributions invested as they are earned do not sit idle. A dip rule recreates a cash pool out of new pay.
6f813b1c68a86c45bd0f68300d944bcd97264f7f.zh: 这与分批投入手头已有的一笔整款是不同的决定。对一笔整款而言，分阶段买入按设计会让部分现有余额留在现金中；一笔整款比较涵盖了那种情况。FINRA 指出，现金拖累的问题主要出现在有一笔现金正在等待时，而随收入投入的供款并不会闲置。逢低规则则用新工资重新制造出一个现金池。

d85aa0e744298eb2d014eff8431b70554122fe87.src: The model gives both rules the same deposit at each of 36 month-ends. The regular rule buys at that month’s close. The waiting rule holds the deposit in cash, earns the entered interest rate, and buys everything waiting at the first close that is at least the trigger percentage below the highest close observed so far, or once the oldest waiting deposit reaches the entered waiting limit.
d85aa0e744298eb2d014eff8431b70554122fe87.zh: 模型在 36 个月末中的每一个都给两条规则同样的存款。定期规则按当月收盘价买入。等待规则把存款留作现金，按输入的利率计息，并在第一次收盘价比迄今最高收盘价低至少触发幅度时买入全部等待中的资金，或在最早一笔等待中的存款达到所输入的等待上限时买入。

a4e40a0b5eda9b3ce7fb711a155ef426bbbb84e5.zh: 等待中的现金会赚取利息，但价格也在继续变动

5b5e159526e20735c3f1726a0a05e5d24a6601e5.src: The first chart places two dated public figures side by side. Statistics Canada reported that all-items CPI rose 3.1% year over year in September 2026. The Bank of Canada’s target for the overnight rate was 2.25% on 22 October 2026. A deposit account, GIC or money market fund can pay a different rate, and neither figure says what inflation or interest will be while your cash waits.
5b5e159526e20735c3f1726a0a05e5d24a6601e5.zh: 第一张图把两个有日期的公开数字并列。加拿大统计局公布，所有项目 CPI 在2026年9月按年上升 3.1%。加拿大银行的隔夜利率目标在2026年10月22日为 2.25%。存款账户、GIC 或货币市场基金支付的利率可能不同，而且两个数字都不能说明在你的现金等待期间通胀或利息会是多少。

8425d2758b00271ed08bd11b5b097f7231e2a379.src: The scenario uses a separate cash rate, set by default to 2.25% as an illustration. Interest earned outside a registered account is generally taxable; tax is not deducted in the model. Inside a TFSA, CRA says income earned is generally tax-free, but a deposit still uses contribution room whether the money stays in cash or buys a fund. The account sets the tax rules; the investment inside it still carries its own risk, fees and liquidity terms.
8425d2758b00271ed08bd11b5b097f7231e2a379.zh: 情景使用另一个现金利率，默认设为 2.25% 作为示例。在注册账户以外赚取的利息一般需要纳税；模型没有扣除税款。在 TFSA 内，CRA 表示所赚取的收入一般免税，但无论资金留作现金还是买入基金，存款都会占用供款额度。税务规则由账户决定；账户内的投资本身仍有其风险、费用和流动性条款。

2f64afbbb4fe767157476a679db8d6a5fd9f54ec.src: A trigger based on the running peak can fire late, or not at all
2f64afbbb4fe767157476a679db8d6a5fd9f54ec.zh: 基于运行高点的触发条件可能来得晚，甚至根本不出现

4c207e6ee29d242061bea6d7d787d090d94a081a.src: The index chart shows the authored index and the trigger line, which follows the running peak. Because the peak keeps rising in a long advance, a dip can begin well above prices that regular purchases already paid. In the default early dip, then recovery path, the 10% trigger first fires at month five. Waiting cash is then invested through month ten while the index stays below the line. After the recovery, new deposits wait again until the 12-month limit forces purchases at months 23 and 36.
4c207e6ee29d242061bea6d7d787d090d94a081a.zh: 指数图显示设定指数和跟随运行高点的触发线。由于高点在长期上涨中不断抬升，回调的起点可能远高于定期买入已支付的价格。在默认的早期回调，随后回升路径中，10% 的触发条件在第五个月首次触发。随后在指数仍低于触发线期间，直到第十个月都会投入等待中的现金。回升之后，新存款再次等待，直到 12 个月上限迫使在第 23 和第 36 个月买入。

ded8188bd6ba377d642f2cba658ee9cc2cf52501.src: Under these defaults, the regular rule ends at about CAD 21,127 and the waiting rule at about CAD 20,760, including interest on waiting cash. The waiting rule’s average cost per unit is about 103.93 index points, versus 101.25 for investing every month. It caught a dip but paid more on average because later deposits waited through the rise.
ded8188bd6ba377d642f2cba658ee9cc2cf52501.zh: 在这些默认设定下，定期规则期末约为 CAD 21,127，等待规则约为 CAD 20,760（含等待现金的利息）。等待规则的每单位平均成本约为 103.93 个指数点，而每月投资为 101.25。它抓到了一次回调，但由于后来的存款在上涨期间一直等待，平均支付的价格反而更高。

1b34457f2b652cdfe135dac97e87f1b3a47079a4.src: The path comparison shows why one example settles nothing. On the steady rise path the 10% trigger never fires, so purchases happen only when the waiting limit forces them; the regular rule ends ahead, CAD 19,214 versus CAD 19,003. On the long rise, late dip path the waiting rule ends ahead, CAD 18,826 versus CAD 18,603. Neither result is a probability or a backtest.
1b34457f2b652cdfe135dac97e87f1b3a47079a4.zh: 路径比较说明为何单一例子什么也决定不了。在稳步上涨路径上，10% 的触发条件从未触发，因此只有在等待上限强制时才会买入；定期规则领先，CAD 19,214 对 CAD 19,003。在长期上涨，后期回调路径上，等待规则领先，CAD 18,826 对 CAD 18,603。两个结果都不是概率，也不是回测。

660d3b0bd1c181b19ee83dc609702570d4686830.src: The waiting limit is the rule’s most important setting
660d3b0bd1c181b19ee83dc609702570d4686830.zh: 等待上限是这条规则最重要的设定

9e197672a0120a7deca7b58823caf468118aaf11.src: Set the waiting limit to zero and the waiting rule becomes regular investing: each deposit is bought at the close on which it arrives. Raise the limit and the rule can hold more money in cash for longer. If the trigger never arrives, the cash queue can keep growing, and so can the gap if prices rise.
9e197672a0120a7deca7b58823caf468118aaf11.zh: 把等待上限设为零，等待规则就变成定期投资：每笔存款都在到账当天的收盘价买入。提高上限，规则就可能把更多资金留在现金中更长时间。如果触发条件始终不出现，现金队列会持续增长；如果价格上涨，差距也会扩大。

9c2ec3ac986522bbde87b54dd3650f16a39d4ad1.src: FINRA’s market-timing guidance warns that short-term price moves are difficult to predict and that some of the strongest market days can occur during volatile periods. A rule written in advance avoids changing the threshold after seeing prices, but it does not make the decision free. Before using a dip trigger, decide:
9c2ec3ac986522bbde87b54dd3650f16a39d4ad1.zh: FINRA 的市场择时指引提醒，短期价格变动难以预测，而一些表现最强的交易日可能出现在波动较大的时期。事先写好的规则可以避免在看到价格后改变门槛，但并不会让这个决定没有代价。在使用回调触发条件之前，请先决定：

6634279186786ed2da76d1821586b576a1ad1ff8.src: the exact trigger and the price series it uses;
6634279186786ed2da76d1821586b576a1ad1ff8.zh: 确切的触发条件及其使用的价格序列；

59b2b12b3a56091eb82b8bce51d11f431a4534c1.src: Concern about a large decline is reasonable, especially near a spending date. Holding every new deposit until a dip mixes two decisions: how much risk the portfolio should carry and when to buy it. Often the clearer adjustment is the allocation itself, for example a balanced fund with a bond portion, a larger cash reserve for near-term spending, or a smaller monthly amount that the budget can sustain through an income interruption.
59b2b12b3a56091eb82b8bce51d11f431a4534c1.zh: 担心大幅下跌是合理的，尤其是在临近用钱日期时。把每一笔新存款都留到回调时才投资，会把两个决定混在一起：投资组合应承担多少风险，以及何时买入。更清楚的调整往往是资产配置本身，例如选择带有债券部分的平衡基金、为近期开支预留更多现金储备，或设定一个即使收入中断预算也能维持的较小每月金额。

73726e65bda6f325093bf3f013a91c38b59a9795.src: Regular investing does not avoid losses or guarantee a lower cost per unit. It does keep each deposit’s purchase date tied to when money is earned rather than to a forecast. Read the selected fund’s Fund Facts for its risk rating, fees and holdings, and review the account’s contribution and withdrawal rules separately. The companion guides on exiting and re-entering the market and keeping a cash floor beside regular purchases test related rules.
73726e65bda6f325093bf3f013a91c38b59a9795.zh: 定期投资不能避免亏损，也不保证更低的每单位成本。它的作用是让每笔存款的买入日期与赚到钱的时间挂钩，而不是与预测挂钩。请阅读所选基金的基金概览（Fund Facts），了解其风险评级、费用和持仓，并另行查看账户的供款和提款规则。关于退出并重新进入市场以及在定期买入旁保留现金底线的配套指南检验了相关规则。

When equities fall much more than bonds, the equity share shrinks even though nobody traded. In the default scenario, a CAD 100,000 portfolio at 60% equity loses 35% on equity and gains 2% on bonds in year one. It ends the year at CAD 79,800, with only 48.9% in equity.
d87eb4c5cd50b065baeb279c3f9b7450a22165ad.zh: 平衡投资组合按选定比例持有股票和债券。当股票跌幅远大于债券时，即使没有人交易，股票占比也会缩小。在默认情景中，一个 CAD 100,000、60% 股票的投资组合在第一年股票亏损 35%、债券上涨 2%。年末价值为 CAD 79,800，股票只占 48.9%。

653cfcd54988398446d92644366491485be9af49.src: FINRA describes rebalancing as adjusting periodically to stay near a target allocation, by redirecting new money, adding to lagging assets or selling part of outperforming holdings. It also says there is no official timeline for when to rebalance and suggests considering it as part of an annual review. The first chart shows both portfolios’ equity share after any year-end trade.
653cfcd54988398446d92644366491485be9af49.zh: FINRA 将再平衡描述为定期调整以保持接近目标配置，方法包括把新资金引导到别处、增持落后的资产或卖出部分表现较好的持仓。它也指出，何时再平衡并没有官方时间表，并建议把它作为年度检视的一部分来考虑。第一张图显示两个投资组合在任何年末交易之后的股票占比。

c035500e103e6b8e35e97d82d9f999024d6f6a39.src: Rebalancing after a crash means buying what just fell
c035500e103e6b8e35e97d82d9f999024d6f6a39.zh: 崩盘后再平衡意味着买入刚刚下跌的资产

aa8c7e67a76b2a504a79c877235eabe52bfcdd18.src: The rebalanced portfolio trades back to 60% when equity is more than five percentage points off target at a year-end. After the crash, it sells about CAD 8,880 of bonds and buys equity. That is uncomfortable by design: the rule follows the allocation, not the headlines.
aa8c7e67a76b2a504a79c877235eabe52bfcdd18.zh: 当股票在年末偏离目标超过五个百分点时，再平衡组合会交易回 60%。崩盘之后，它卖出约 CAD 8,880 的债券并买入股票。这在设计上就令人不安：规则跟随的是资产配置，而不是新闻标题。

42bb20713469abaebc05f229c42f32ff26adea0c.src: The trade chart shows each year-end purchase or sale. During the recovery the equity share rises again, so later trades sell equity. Over the default ten years, the rebalanced portfolio buys about CAD 8,880 of equity and sells about CAD 11,834.
42bb20713469abaebc05f229c42f32ff26adea0c.zh: 交易图显示每个年末的买入或卖出。在回升期间，股票占比再次上升，因此之后的交易是卖出股票。在默认的十年间，再平衡组合买入约 CAD 8,880 的股票，卖出约 CAD 11,834。

1e8a879604ffbaf8c24128709cff86b7d7df9b37.src: Inside a balanced mutual fund or asset-allocation fund, the portfolio manager rebalances within the fund according to its mandate. You do not place those trades, but they can still affect the fund’s taxable distributions in a non-registered account. In a self-managed non-registered account, CRA’s capital gains guide explains that disposing of capital property such as fund units or shares can produce a capital gain or loss. Within a TFSA, income earned is generally tax-free, and in an RRSP tax is generally deferred until withdrawal. The account’s tax rules belong to the wrapper, not the fund.
1e8a879604ffbaf8c24128709cff86b7d7df9b37.zh: 在平衡型共同基金或资产配置基金内，基金经理会根据基金的投资授权在基金内部进行再平衡。你不需要下这些交易指令，但在非注册账户中，这些交易仍可能影响基金的应税分配。在自行管理的非注册账户中，CRA 的资本收益指南说明，处置基金单位或股份等资本财产可能产生资本收益或亏损。在 TFSA 内，所赚取的收入一般免税；在 RRSP 内，税款一般递延至提款时。账户的税务规则属于账户这层“包装”，而不属于基金。

6384ebd2ccb960197f9d25a58caf8f138cfc3b8c.src: Recovery helps the rebalanced mix; a second decline hurts it first
6384ebd2ccb960197f9d25a58caf8f138cfc3b8c.zh: 回升有利于再平衡组合；第二次下跌则会先伤害它

ccf900ee7d192123a412710b9a9d88f1e5b5510e.src: The value chart follows both portfolios. With three 15% equity recovery years and 6% afterwards, the default rebalanced portfolio ends at about CAD 142,505, versus CAD 137,373 for the drifting portfolio. It held more equity when equities recovered.
ccf900ee7d192123a412710b9a9d88f1e5b5510e.zh: 价值图跟随两个投资组合。在连续三年 15% 的股票回升、之后每年 6% 的情况下，默认的再平衡组合期末约为 CAD 142,505，漂移组合则为 CAD 137,373。在股票回升时，它持有更多股票。

2f95120af45a250c04b0bac7ed9704ad7860e781.src: The variant chart changes the order of returns. If year two brings a second, smaller decline of 17.5% before the recovery, the rebalanced portfolio has already bought equity and its year-end value falls to about CAD 72,379, versus CAD 74,199 for the drifting mix. It still ends ahead in that variant only because a recovery is assumed afterwards. With no crash, the drifting portfolio’s equity share rises to about 67% and it ends slightly higher, CAD 161,208 versus CAD 160,715, while carrying more equity risk than its target.
2f95120af45a250c04b0bac7ed9704ad7860e781.zh: 变体图改变了回报出现的顺序。如果第二年在回升之前再出现一次较小的 17.5% 下跌，再平衡组合已经买入了股票，其年末价值会跌至约 CAD 72,379，而漂移组合为 CAD 74,199。在该变体中它最终仍然领先，只是因为之后假设了回升。如果没有崩盘，漂移组合的股票占比会升至约 67%，期末略高，CAD 161,208 对 CAD 160,715，但它承担的股票风险高于目标。

07060b954b16e19f3e0ee66331a52e12dd1bd611.src: No rule guarantees a better outcome. Rebalancing is mainly a way to keep the portfolio’s risk close to the level you chose, rather than letting recent returns choose it.
07060b954b16e19f3e0ee66331a52e12dd1bd611.zh: 没有任何规则能保证更好的结果。再平衡主要是一种让投资组合的风险保持在你所选水平附近的方法，而不是让近期回报替你选择风险。

a0699537f9e41fafca6ccadb1e2decd2a0cbe519.src: Choose the band, the calendar and the cash source in advance
a0699537f9e41fafca6ccadb1e2decd2a0cbe519.zh: 事先选定区间、日程和资金来源

1d1153c737792a4616ab72bf07612a71977bbdee.src: Set the band to zero to rebalance at every year-end. A wider band trades less often and lets the mix move further before acting. Every trade can involve costs, spreads, sales charges or tax in a non-registered account; this model deducts none of them, so its results flatter frequent trading.
1d1153c737792a4616ab72bf07612a71977bbdee.zh: 把区间设为零，即在每个年末都再平衡。较宽的区间交易次数较少，并让资产组合在采取行动前偏离得更远。每次交易都可能涉及成本、价差、销售费用，或在非注册账户中涉及税款；本模型均未扣除，因此其结果会美化频繁交易。

985c7ae61cfad31c7015f1610deb0f692859158c.src: New contributions can do some of the work without sales. Directing a regular deposit to the underweight asset can close part of the gap, as shown in the buy-only rebalancing guide. If you are withdrawing money, choosing which asset to sell can also move the mix; see withdrawal sale sources.
985c7ae61cfad31c7015f1610deb0f692859158c.zh: 新增供款可以在不卖出的情况下完成部分工作。把定期存款投向比重不足的资产，可以缩小部分差距，详见只买不卖的再平衡指南。如果你正在提款，选择卖出哪项资产也能调整资产组合；请参阅提款的卖出来源。

aac8bae20dba6c7f21de41a42f4e4518e949521e.src: A plan for crash worry that does not depend on predicting the crash
aac8bae20dba6c7f21de41a42f4e4518e949521e.zh: 一个不依赖预测崩盘的应对计划

f71df7f3c5ed0f5a192bcd425049978b8bd75bdf.src: Choose a target mix you could hold through a large equity decline, given your horizon, income and other cash.
f71df7f3c5ed0f5a192bcd425049978b8bd75bdf.zh: 根据你的期限、收入和其他现金，选择一个即使股票大幅下跌你也能坚持持有的目标组合。

530729d67e3101278297f53a4ceac79f52166f56.src: Keep near-term spending money outside the long-term portfolio.
530729d67e3101278297f53a4ceac79f52166f56.zh: 把近期需要花用的资金放在长期投资组合之外。

7f4c9045c86b9ddf23588042d8cd27ba5dd49218.src: Write the rebalancing rule: calendar date, band and whether new contributions are used first.
7f4c9045c86b9ddf23588042d8cd27ba5dd49218.zh: 写下再平衡规则：日历日期、区间，以及是否先使用新增供款。

37e123e67443093ea11945ce2dd6b7c169d92d75.src: For a fund, read the Fund Facts and prospectus for its target mix, rebalancing approach, fees and risk rating.
37e123e67443093ea11945ce2dd6b7c169d92d75.zh: 对于基金，请阅读基金概览（Fund Facts）和招股说明书，了解其目标组合、再平衡方法、费用和风险评级。

c214ecfabf645a177d3b9a6de9ccd63605c62607.src: For a self-managed account, check the tax effect of each sale outside registered plans before trading.
c214ecfabf645a177d3b9a6de9ccd63605c62607.zh: 对于自行管理的账户，在注册计划以外交易之前，先核查每次卖出的税务影响。

c7a6f762dd30686a0d2a9a79dd900fd22425fae7.src: Review the mix after a major life change, not after each market headline.
c7a6f762dd30686a0d2a9a79dd900fd22425fae7.zh: 在重大人生变化之后检视资产组合，而不是在每条市场新闻之后。

17236794604b9664057e7442a6461a9879641ecd.src: The balanced-fund stress guide adds inflation and fees to a crash scenario, and the loss-recovery guide separates recovering a dollar balance from recovering purchasing power.
17236794604b9664057e7442a6461a9879641ecd.zh: 平衡基金压力测试指南在崩盘情景中加入了通胀和费用，而亏损回升指南则把收复账面金额与收复购买力区分开来。

2d1506855a88fdc4054ea385cae18d136a170c75.src: The election does not change who receives the payment or the tax withheld at source. The CRA requires tax withheld on eligible pension income to be allocated between spouses in the same proportion as the pension, and it cannot approve reduced withholding because a split is planned. When a slip mixes eligible and non-eligible pension income, the withheld tax on the eligible part is the eligible share of the total multiplied by total tax withheld.
2d1506855a88fdc4054ea385cae18d136a170c75.zh: 此次选举不会改变谁收到付款或从源头扣缴的税款。 CRA 要求对符合资格的养老金收入预扣税款按照与养老金相同的比例在配偶之间分配，并且不能批准减少预扣税，因为计划进行分割。当单项混合了符合资格和不符合资格的养老金收入时，符合资格部分的预扣税额为符合资格的份额乘以预扣税总额。

Both spouses are assumed to be 65 or older on 31 December 2026, resident in Canada and not separated. Net income equals the entered income; there are no other deductions or credits, no provincial tax, and no dividend, capital-gain or foreign-income rules. OAS recovery for 2026 income is collected through the return and later OAS payments; it is counted here in one total. The result is not tax advice or a filing calculation.

An amendment needs a new jointly signed T1032; a revocation needs a letter signed by both.

8eed3e0c6018ef2d350d02fa2eab6a43884d9b3d.src: Splitting moves up to half of eligible pension income from one return to the other; household income does not change. The saving comes from rate differences, credits and clawbacks between the two spouses, so the right percentage depends on both incomes and can be zero.
8eed3e0c6018ef2d350d02fa2eab6a43884d9b3d.zh: 将最多一半的合格养老金收入从一项回报转移到另一项回报；家庭收入没有变化。储蓄来自配偶双方之间的利率差异、信贷和回扣，因此正确的百分比取决于双方的收入，并且可以为零。

90157c448181ceb890045ecf1aa9ee7eb459df7e.src: Example: if CAD 14,000 was withheld on Alex’s CAD 70,000 pension and 50% is allocated, CAD 7,000 of that withholding moves to Sam’s return through line 43700. Sam may still owe a balance or receive a refund depending on Sam’s own tax; the household can also face CRA instalment reminders if net tax owing exceeds the instalment threshold in successive years. The household cash-flow plan should allow for that timing rather than assume withholding already matches each return.
90157c448181ceb890045ecf1aa9ee7eb459df7e.zh: 示例：如果 Alex 的 70,000 加元养老金中预扣了 14,000 加元，并分配了 50%，则该预扣税中的 7,000 加元将通过第 43700 行转入 Sam 的纳税申报表。Sam 可能仍欠余额或收到退款，具体取决于 Sam 自己的税款；如果连续几年所欠净税款超过分期付款门槛，该家庭还可能面临 CRA 分期付款提醒。家庭现金流计划应该考虑到这个时间，而不是假设预扣税已经与每次回报相匹配。

af4f9c8ed5bb116a4b6219f00d1e4d0c59f1dca6.src: Three original scenarios from the model illustrate the range. With Alex’s pension raised to CAD 100,000 (net income CAD 125,000), Alex would face OAS recovery tax of CAD 4,451.55 (15% of CAD 29,677) without splitting; allocating about 30% brings Alex below the threshold and removes it, and the modelled federal saving keeps rising to CAD 9,563.73 at 43% before the curve goes flat. If Alex has CAD 60,000 of pension plus CAD 25,000 and Sam already has CAD 50,000 including a CAD 20,000 pension, the saving reaches about CAD 554 at 15%, stays flat through 44%, then falls to CAD 325.00 at 50%: beyond 44% Alex drops into the 14% band while Sam is still taxed at 20.5% on each extra dollar. If both start at CAD 60,000, splitting 50% of a CAD 40,000 pension costs CAD 1,339.07 more than not splitting, because it pushes Sam into the 20.5% band and shrinks Sam’s age amount.
af4f9c8ed5bb116a4b6219f00d1e4d0c59f1dca6.zh: 模型中的三个原始场景说明了该范围。随着 Alex 的养老金提高到 100,000 加元（净收入 125,000 加元），Alex 将面临 4,451.55 加元的 OAS 追缴税（29,677 加元的 15%），无需分割；分配大约 30% 使 Alex 低于阈值并将其删除，并且在曲线变平之前，模拟的联邦储蓄以 43% 的比例持续上升至 9,563.73 加元。如果 Alex 有 60,000 加元的养老金加上 25,000 加元，而 Sam 已经有 50,000 加元，其中包括 20,000 加元的养老金，那么在 15% 的情况下节省的金额约为 554 加元，在 44% 之前保持不变，然后在 50% 的情况下降至 325.00 加元：超过 44% 时 Alex 会进入 14% 的范围，而 Sam 仍按每增加一美元，可享受 20.5% 的优惠。如果两者起价均为 60,000 加元，则分割 40,000 加元养老金的 50% 比不分割多花费 1,339.07 加元，因为这会将 Sam 推入 20.5% 的范围并缩小 Sam 的年龄范围。

d01f567ceb1555c64ef91b06cd2ce988cecad4b1.src: Splitting saves money only while the receiving spouse’s combined marginal cost is lower than the transferring spouse’s. Once the two incomes sit in the same bracket and outside credit phase-outs, each extra dollar moved saves nothing, so the cost curve goes flat. Move further and the receiving spouse can cross into a higher bracket, past the CAD 46,432 point where the age amount starts shrinking, or above the CAD 95,323 OAS recovery threshold for 2026 income.
d01f567ceb1555c64ef91b06cd2ce988cecad4b1.zh: 只有当接收配偶的综合边际成本低于转移配偶的边际成本时，分居才能节省资金。一旦这两种收入处于同一水平并且在信贷逐步取消之外，每增加一美元就不会节省任何资金，因此成本曲线就会趋于平坦。再进一步，接收配偶可以跨入更高的等级，超过年龄金额开始缩小的 46,432 加元点，或高于 2026 年收入的 95,323 加元 OAS 恢复门槛。

2042b5c6595090116ad2a762b28ae3b61a1175a4.zh: 该交互式模型涵盖了阿尔伯塔省、魁北克省和努纳武特地区以外的 2026 年联邦 CWB。它将所有工作收入也计入净收入，忽略了第 122.7(1.1) 条对注册印第安人免税就业收入的选择，并且没有对配偶在 6 月 30 日之后去世时制定特殊规则进行建模。它是机械师的教学工具，而不是归档或权利计算。

2118e8a526e5491e1f64923c5c7cebbe5f3aa56d.src: Locate the zone first. Below the maximum, extra work increases the CWB; in the plateau it has no effect; in the phase-out every extra dollar of net income costs 15 cents (7.5 cents per supplement for two eligible spouses).
2118e8a526e5491e1f64923c5c7cebbe5f3aa56d.zh: 首先找到区域。低于最大值，额外的工作会增加 CWB；在高原没有影响；在逐步取消的过程中，净收入每增加一美元就要花费 15 美分（两个符合条件的配偶每增加 7.5 美分）。

225e26c698fe303d7ae56e9662cdf498e2ae3992.src: The advance is an estimate, not the entitlement. It is reported on an RC210 slip; the full CWB is claimed on line 45300 and the advances are entered through Schedule 6 on line 41500, so only the difference affects the refund or balance owing. In the default scenario Jordan received CAD 816.50—half of the CAD 1,633 2025 maximum Jordan qualified for in the prior year—and is entitled to CAD 1,273.80 for 2026, so CAD 457.30 arrives through the return. If Jordan’s income had climbed to CAD 40,000, the 2026 entitlement would be zero and the CAD 816.50 would be repaid. Only death, incarceration or emigration change advances during the year; other changes take effect only after a reassessment.
225e26c698fe303d7ae56e9662cdf498e2ae3992.zh: 预付款是估计值，而不是权利。据 RC210 单据报道；全额 CWB 在第 45300 行索取，预付款通过附表 6 在第 41500 行输入，因此只有差额影响退款或欠款。在默认情况下，乔丹收到 816.50 加元（乔丹在上一年获得的 2025 年最高限额 1,633 加元的一半），并有权在 2026 年获得 1,273.80 加元，因此通过退货收到 457.30 加元。如果乔丹的收入攀升至 4 万加元，2026 年的福利将为零，816.50 加元将被偿还。年内只有死亡、监禁或移民发生变化；其他更改仅在重新评估后生效。

2935cadad7992eb6e53de77bfce92892ccc5c830.src: Section 122.7 of the Income Tax Act sets the mechanics; the dollar amounts in it are indexed each year. The basic amount is the lesser of the maximum and 27% of working income above CAD 3,000 (combined working income for a family), minus 15% of adjusted net income above the phase-out threshold (adjusted family net income for a family). The disability supplement is the lesser of its maximum and 27% of the eligible person’s working income above CAD 1,150, minus 15% of adjusted net income above its own, higher threshold. When both spouses are eligible for the disability tax credit, each supplement is reduced at 7.5%.
2935cadad7992eb6e53de77bfce92892ccc5c830.zh: 《所得税法》第 122.7 条规定了机制；其中的美元金额每年都会被编入索引。基本金额是最高金额和 3,000 加元以上工作收入（家庭综合工作收入）的 27% 中的较小者，减去淘汰门槛以上调整后净收入（家庭调整后家庭净收入）的 15%。残疾补贴是其最高限额和合格人员工作收入超过 1,150 加元的 27% 减去高于其自身较高门槛的调整后净收入的 15%，两者中的较小者。当配偶双方都有资格获得残疾税收抵免时，每项补助金将减少 7.5%。

3be8592e6c86617ff28f3afb6cd45e4a5d1d2deb.src: The Canada workers benefit is a refundable tax credit for people with working income and low net income. It has a basic amount and, for people eligible for the disability tax credit (an approved Form T2201 on file), a disability supplement. Because it is refundable, it is paid even when no income tax is owing; it is claimed on Schedule 6 and line 45300 of the return.
3be8592e6c86617ff28f3afb6cd45e4a5d1d2deb.zh: 加拿大工人福利是为有工作收入和低净收入的人提供的可退还税收抵免。它有一个基本金额，对于有资格获得残疾税收抵免的人（已批准的T2201表格存档），还有残疾补充金。因为它是可退还的，所以即使没有缴纳所得税，也要缴纳；它在申报表附表 6 和第 45300 行中申报。

922a0114c960fbc02b9f72f9dbb6a44882c2d249.src: For a single person with the disability tax credit and CAD 20,000 of working income, the model gives the full basic amount of CAD 1,665 plus the full CAD 860 supplement: CAD 2,525. For a couple who both qualify, each person has a supplement based on their own working income and each is reduced at 7.5% rather than 15% above CAD 50,377. With CAD 40,000 and CAD 20,000 of working income, the secondary earner exemption brings adjusted family net income to CAD 43,286: the basic amount is CAD 2,869 − 15% × 12,035 = CAD 1,063.75, both supplements remain at CAD 860, and the family total is CAD 2,783.75.

9b0e0e8490d5b2fb1273e197c8905864bb9c082e.src: For a couple, the phase-in uses combined working income and the phase-out uses adjusted family net income. Without a special rule, a second earner’s first dollars would be clawed back at 15% as soon as the family crossed CAD 31,251. Section 122.7(1.3) prevents part of that: the lower earner’s adjusted net income is reduced by the lesser of their working income and the secondary earner exemption, CAD 16,714 for 2026.
9b0e0e8490d5b2fb1273e197c8905864bb9c082e.zh: 对于夫妇来说，逐步加入使用合并工作收入，逐步退出使用调整后的家庭净收入。如果没有特殊规定，一旦家庭收入超过 31,251 加元，第二个收入者的第一笔收入将被收回 15%。第 122.7(1.3) 条部分防止了这种情况的发生：低收入者的调整后净收入减去其工作收入和第二收入者免税额中的较低者，即 2026 年 16,714 加元。

9cf79b62dec19468e63247463df498da03b3520f.src: . Without the exemption, family income of CAD 40,000 would cut the benefit by CAD 1,312.35 to CAD 1,556.65. The second-earner chart traces that gap as the spouse’s earnings rise: the two lines separate once family income crosses the threshold and run parallel, CAD 2,507.10 apart, once the exemption is fully used at CAD 16,714 of spouse earnings, until the exemption line also reaches zero.
9cf79b62dec19468e63247463df498da03b3520f.zh: 。如果没有豁免，家庭收入为 40,000 加元，福利将减少 1,312.35 加元，至 1,556.65 加元。第二收入者图表追踪了配偶收入上升时的差距：一旦家庭收入超过门槛，两条线就会分开，并平行，一旦豁免在配偶收入为 16,714 加元时完全使用，则相距 2,507.10 加元，直到豁免线也达到零。

The exemption removes the lower earner’s working income, up to CAD 16,714, from adjusted family net income, so a second job delays the phase-out instead of triggering it immediately.
cf69682adb1b8192bb5ad2c80e194a9323ccfb5f.zh: 使用家庭规则（针对单个申报者的假设），将您的工作收入保持在 30,000 加元，并将其他投入固定。这项豁免将低收入者的工作收入（最高 16,714 加元）从调整后的家庭净收入中扣除，因此第二份工作会推迟逐步取消，而不是立即触发。

Residents of Alberta, Quebec and Nunavut have reconfigured amounts under agreements with the federal government; they are not modelled.
cf6db8dd1916d2b871512f61290c6a4df8cde83b.zh: 这里的“家庭”是指拥有符合资格的配偶或同居伴侣或符合资格的受抚养人（12 月 31 日与他们同住的 19 岁以下儿童，不符合 CWB 资格）的人。艾伯塔省、魁北克省和努勒维特地区的居民已根据与联邦政府达成的协议重新配置了金额；它们没有被建模。

f76e7270af3114e271672555bc6cce955732cf78.src: Since the Advanced Canada workers benefit (ACWB) began, eligible people receive up to 50% of their CWB in advance without applying; the CRA determines eligibility from the tax return, which must be received before 1 November of the July–June benefit period. Couples receive the basic advance through one spouse—the one with the higher working income, or the first to file if incomes are equal—and a spouse eligible for the disability tax credit receives their own supplement advance. CRA’s benefit-payment calendar (page dated 14 October 2026) lists ACWB dates of 12 January 2026, 10 July 2026 and 9 October 2026; the CRA’s claim page gives the pattern as 12 July, 11 October and 10 January, moved earlier when the date falls on a weekend or holiday.
f76e7270af3114e271672555bc6cce955732cf78.zh: 自加拿大高级工人福利 (ACWB) 开始以来，符合资格的人无需申请即可提前获得高达 50% 的 CWB； CRA 根据纳税申报表确定资格，纳税申报表必须在 7 月至 6 月福利期的 11 月 1 日之前收到。夫妻双方通过其中一方配偶（工作收入较高的一方，或者收入相同的情况下第一个申请的一方）获得基本预付款，而符合残疾税收抵免资格的配偶则获得自己的补充预付款。 CRA 的福利支付日历（日期为 2026 年 10 月 14 日的页面）列出了 ACWB 日期：2026 年 1 月 12 日、2026 年 7 月 10 日和 2026 年 10 月 9 日； CRA 的索赔页面给出的模式为 7 月 12 日、10 月 11 日和 1 月 10 日，当日期恰逢周末或节假日时，日期会提前。

f99f513b7c42181036933fa1cb50fbd92546f5b8.src: The same arithmetic runs in reverse for deductions. If Jordan earns the CAD 32,000 and contributes CAD 2,000 to an RRSP and deducts it, adjusted net income returns to CAD 30,000 and the CWB returns to CAD 1,273.80—a CAD 300.00 benefit gain on top of the income-tax saving from the deduction. A CAD 3,000 deduction at CAD 30,000 brings adjusted net income to CAD 27,000 and restores the full CAD 1,665. This is one of the few places where a modest RRSP or FHSA deduction has a 15% benefit effect for a low-income worker; whether the deduction is worth more later is a separate question covered in the related RRSP timing guide.
f99f513b7c42181036933fa1cb50fbd92546f5b8.zh: 同样的算术以相反的方式进行扣除。如果乔丹赚取 32,000 加元，向 RRSP 存入 2,000 加元并扣除，调整后的净收入将返回到 30,000 加元，CWB 将返回到 1,273.80 加元——除了因扣除而节省的所得税之外，还可以获得 300.00 加元的福利收益。如果按 30,000 加元扣除 3,000 加元，调整后的净利润将达到 27,000 加元，并恢复全额 1,665 加元。这是少数几个可以通过适度的 RRSP 或 FHSA 扣除额为低收入工人带来 15% 福利效果的地方之一；以后扣除是否值得更多是相关 RRSP 计时指南中涵盖的一个单独问题。

eead226c13ddd3ec67182298d57f29e0398471cd.src: That gives three zones for a single person in 2026. From CAD 3,000 to about CAD 9,167 of working income the benefit grows 27 cents per dollar. Between there and CAD 27,392 of adjusted net income it stays at CAD 1,665. Above CAD 27,392 it falls 15 cents per dollar and is gone at CAD 38,492. Working income is employment and business income; adjusted net income starts from net income, so employment insurance, interest or pension income raise it without adding working income, while RRSP and FHSA deductions lower it without reducing working income.
eead226c13ddd3ec67182298d57f29e0398471cd.zh: 到 2026 年，一个人可以享受三个区域。工作收入从 3,000 加元增至约 9,167 加元，每美元福利增加 27 美分。在此期间，调整后净利润为 27,392 加元，保持在 1,665 加元。高于 27,392 加元，兑美元下跌 15 美分，最终跌至 38,492 加元。工作收入是指就业和营业收入；调整后的净收入从净收入开始，因此就业保险、利息或养老金收入会在不增加工作收入的情况下提高它，而RRSP和FHSA扣除额会在不减少工作收入的情况下降低它。

4e9b02cb196d472019b0a1a556085ed19f698ade.src: Hypothetical example: Morgan earns CAD 28,000 and Casey starts a part-time job paying CAD 12,000. Combined working income is CAD 40,000, which fully phases in the CAD 2,869 family maximum. Casey’s CAD 12,000 is below the exemption, so adjusted family net income stays at CAD 28,000—below the threshold—and the family keeps the full CAD 2,869. Without the exemption, family income of CAD 40,000 would cut the benefit by CAD 1,312.35 to CAD 1,556.65. The second-earner chart traces that gap as the spouse’s earnings rise: the two lines separate once family income crosses the threshold and run parallel, CAD 2,507.10 apart, once the exemption is fully used at CAD 16,714 of spouse earnings, until the exemption line also reaches zero.
4e9b02cb196d472019b0a1a556085ed19f698ade.zh: 假设示例：摩根赚取 28,000 加元，凯西开始兼职工作，工资为 12,000 加元。总工作收入为 40,000 加元，家庭最高收入为 2,869 加元。凯西的 12,000 加元低于免税额，因此调整后的家庭净收入保持在 28,000 加元（低于门槛值），并且家庭保留全额2,869 加元。如果没有豁免，家庭收入为 40,000 加元，福利将减少 1,312.35 加元，至 1,556.65 加元。第二收入者图表追踪了配偶收入上升时的差距：一旦家庭收入超过门槛，两条线就会分开，并平行，一旦豁免在配偶收入为 16,714 加元时完全使用，则相距 2,507.10 加元，直到豁免线也达到零。

00e709703618ec9050118c9f3c4ce86f0c551a40.zh: CWB 将 3,000 加元以上的每 1 美元收入增加 27 美分，直至达到最高限额，然后将高于阈值的调整后净收入每 1 美元扣除 15 美分。在逐步取消的情况下，加薪的价值并不像看起来那么高，收入较低的配偶部分受到第二收入者豁免的保护，基于去年回报的预付款可以变成还款。

c2cf9b6bcea5900b8a1114a2a5c2699c58277730.src: To qualify for the basic amount, the CRA requires working income, net income below the threshold for the province or territory, Canadian residence for the whole year, and age 19 or older on 31 December—or living with a spouse, common-law partner or child. The same exclusions apply to the spouse.

46ccb9579066eb5f63f71f5fb5b72e7a5d6506d7.src: The model invests CAD 100,000 for 20 years at 6% a year before fees. Route one uses an advice-included series with a 1.95% MER. After 20 years the advice-included route is worth about CAD 221,229 and the fee-based route about CAD 217,509—CAD 3,720 less, because the sales tax lifts the separate fee slightly above the trailer it replaces.
46ccb9579066eb5f63f71f5fb5b72e7a5d6506d7.zh: 该模型投资 100,000 加元，为期 20 年，每年利率为 6%（不含费用）。路线一使用包含建议的系列，MER 为 1.95%。路线二采用收费系列，其中 MER 为 0.85%，加上 1% 的顾问费和 13% HST，总费用为 1.98%。 20 年后，包含建议的路线价值约为 221,229 加元，收费路线约为 217,509 加元，少 3,720 加元，因为销售税使单独费用略高于其所取代的拖车。

656893091a9769a677d4b8e494f7e54670be7da0.src: A mutual fund's management expense ratio (MER) is its yearly cost as a percentage of your investment. It is taken inside the fund before returns are reported, so you never see a bill. It covers portfolio management, administration, legal and audit costs, regulatory filings and—in most advice-sold series—a trailing commission paid to the dealer that services your account. Sales tax on those costs is already included.
656893091a9769a677d4b8e494f7e54670be7da0.zh: 共同基金的管理费用率 (MER) 是其年度成本占您投资的百分比。在报告回报之前，它会被存入基金内部，因此您永远不会看到账单。它涵盖投资组合管理、管理、法律和审计成本、监管备案以及（在大多数建议销售系列中）支付给为您的账户提供服务的交易商的尾随佣金。这些成本已包含销售税。

66a51f10e42241af9f409688144c9bd58f529aba.src: Original illustration. Both routes earn the same return before fees. The MER is deducted inside the fund each year (it already includes GST/HST on the fund's fees); the separate advice fee is charged on the year-end value, sales tax is added, and the total is paid from the account. Fee deductibility for non-registered accounts, distributions, taxes on growth and trading costs are not modelled. Fees and services vary by firm and series; check the Fund Facts and your fee agreement.

681f782c8e47215703ccd479c65b00eedf73908c.src: A real risk profile is broader than this two-number test. Regulators expect advisors to assess capacity alongside your age and family situation, income, assets and debts, liquidity needs, investment objectives and time horizon, and to discuss and record any inconsistency—for example a high-risk answer from someone with limited savings who needs cash soon. Questionnaires help, but staff have criticised firms that relied on risk-tolerance questions alone or used generic labels without a clear method.
681f782c8e47215703ccd479c65b00eedf73908c.zh: 真正的风险状况比这个两个数字测试更广泛。监管机构希望顾问根据您的年龄和家庭情况、收入、资产和债务、流动性需求、投资目标和时间范围来评估您的能力，并讨论和记录任何不一致之处，例如储蓄有限但很快需要现金的人的高风险答案。问卷调查有所帮助，但工作人员批评了仅依赖风险承受能力问题或在没有明确方法的情况下使用通用标签的公司。

A 0.5-point saving then takes about 20 years to break even, and a 0.25-point saving never catches up in 60 years: the lost growth on the tax paid early outweighs the fee saved each year. The break-even chart shows how quickly the answer flips as the fee gap narrows.
7ed9825f910893f35ef48ae3b60b8d58f7c55674.zh: 当收益较大而节省的费用较小时，情况就会发生变化。由于成本基础仅为 20,000 加元，转换会触发 16,000 加元的税费。节省 0.5 个百分点大约需要 20 年才能达到收支平衡，而节省 0.25 个百分点则需要 60 年才能达到收支平衡：提前缴纳的税款增长损失超过了每年节省的费用。盈亏平衡图显示了随着费用差距缩小，答案翻转的速度有多快。

98297bef33f4a5fb5faecaa8c75e78117fa2d598.src: Many funds offer the same portfolio in several series. An advice-included series has a trailing commission inside its MER. A fee-based series (often called F series) leaves the trailer out, so its MER is lower, and you pay your dealer a separate advice fee instead—usually a percentage of assets, with GST/HST added. Since 1 June 2022 Canadian rules stop fund companies paying trailing commissions to order-execution-only (discount) dealers, which do not provide suitability advice.
98297bef33f4a5fb5faecaa8c75e78117fa2d598.zh: 许多基金提供多个系列的相同投资组合。包含建议的系列在其 MER 中会有一个尾随佣金。收费系列（通常称为 F 系列）将预告片排除在外，因此其 MER 较低，您需要向经销商支付单独的顾问费 - 通常是资产的一定百分比，并添加 GST/HST。自 2022 年 6 月 1 日起，加拿大规定禁止基金公司向仅执行订单（折扣）交易商支付尾随佣金，因为这些交易商不提供适合性建议。

b82eb0054bcb8dcf5d7994f2c7fd830a14ac53ab.src: When you open an investment account in Canada, your advisor must work out your risk profile before recommending anything. Canadian securities regulators describe it as two separate factors. Risk tolerance is your willingness to accept risk—how you feel about seeing your account fall. Risk capacity is your ability to endure a financial loss—a more objective look at what a loss would actually do to you, given your income, savings, debts and when you need the money.
b82eb0054bcb8dcf5d7994f2c7fd830a14ac53ab.zh: 当您在加拿大开设投资账户时，您的顾问在提出任何建议之前必须先了解您的风险状况。加拿大证券监管机构将其描述为两个独立的因素。 风险承受能力是您接受风险的意愿，即您看到帐户失败时的感受。 风险承受能力是指您承受财务损失的能力 - 考虑到您的收入、储蓄、债务以及您何时需要资金，更客观地了解损失实际上会对您造成什么影响。

b8bd782f763f6fd6a05a32f79ea627f42b4fb73e.src: Fund Facts risk levels come from the 10-year standard deviation of monthly returns, annualised, under National Instrument 81-102 Appendix F. The ranges here assume returns spread roughly like a bell curve around the average you enter; real markets have more extreme years than this assumption suggests, so treat the 19-in-20 range as a floor for how bad a year can be, not a limit. A risk level describes past volatility, not the chance of loss or future returns.
b8bd782f763f6fd6a05a32f79ea627f42b4fb73e.zh: 基金事实风险水平来自 National Instrument 81-102 附录 F 下的月回报率的 10 年标准差（年化）。这里的范围假设回报率大致像钟形曲线一样围绕您输入的平均值分布；实际市场的极端年份比这一假设所暗示的要多，因此将 20 年中的 19 个范围视为一年可能有多糟糕的下限，而不是限制。风险水平描述的是过去的波动性，而不是损失或未来回报的机会。

e6b69a2b76fc4b5d872f848995e5d98348c1dca2.src: Standard deviation is easier to read as a range. If yearly returns spread roughly like a bell curve, about two years in three land within one standard deviation of the average and about 19 years in 20 within two. Take a fund with a 9% standard deviation—“low to medium”—and an assumed 5% average return. Two years in three would fall between −4% and 14%; 19 in 20 between −13% and 23%. On CAD 50,000, a year two standard deviations below average is a loss of about CAD 6,500.
e6b69a2b76fc4b5d872f848995e5d98348c1dca2.zh: 标准差作为一个范围更容易理解。如果年回报率大致呈钟形曲线分布，那么三年中大约有两年的回报率与平均值相差一个标准差，而二十年中大约有 19 年的回报率与平均值相差一个标准差以内。以标准差为 9%（“低至中等”）的基金为例，假设平均回报率为 5%。三年中的两年将下降到-4% 到 14% 之间； 20 人中有 19 人在 -13% 到 23% 之间。对于 50,000 加元，一年低于平均水平两个标准差将损失约 6,500 加元。

eb0aa2f940db8d0b7411ca2265ecf4134101de2b.src: Your risk profile should reflect the lower of two answers: how big a drop you are willing to sit through, and how big a drop your plans can absorb before you need the money. A portfolio that passes only one test is too risky.

eb893e9ff10957314a78d935834d9fda400cf636.src: In a non-registered (taxable) account, selling one fund to buy another is usually a disposition. If the fund is worth more than your adjusted cost base—roughly what you paid plus reinvested distributions—you have a capital gain. Only part of a gain is taxable: CRA's capital gains guide uses an inclusion rate of one-half, so half the gain is added to your income and taxed at your marginal rate. Switches inside an RRSP, RRIF, TFSA or FHSA do not create capital gains tax.
eb893e9ff10957314a78d935834d9fda400cf636.zh: 在非注册（应税）账户中，出售一种基金以购买另一种基金通常是一种处置。如果基金的价值高于您的调整后成本基础（大致为您支付的金额加上再投资分配），您将获得资本收益。只有部分收益需要纳税：CRA 的资本收益指南使用二分之一的包含率，因此一半收益会添加到您的收入中，并按您的边际税率征税。 RRSP、RRIF、TFSA 或 FHSA 内的转换不会产生资本利得税。

44879f68a0590735cc3ab13d439f4a46cdd2f7cd.src: A mutual fund or ETF is not tax-exempt by itself. Inside a TFSA, CRA says income such as interest, dividends or capital gains is generally tax-free, even when you withdraw. The same fund held in a non-registered account is taxed under the ordinary rules: CRA’s guidance on mutual funds explains that interest, dividends and capital gains distributed by a fund are reported in the year they are paid, even when the distribution is reinvested in more units.
44879f68a0590735cc3ab13d439f4a46cdd2f7cd.zh: 共同基金或 ETF 本身并不免税。CRA 表示，在 TFSA 内赚取的利息、股息或资本收益等收入一般免税，即使取款时也是如此。同一只基金若放在非注册账户中，则按一般规则征税：CRA 关于共同基金的说明指出，基金分派的利息、股息和资本收益须在支付当年申报，即使分派被再投资于更多单位也一样。

9dfc1aacbfdee668b8864283327189a8ed076766.src: A positive value means that placement leaves more after-tax money than putting the bond fund in the TFSA first. Annual tax on interest favours sheltering bonds; tax-free compounding of a higher expected equity return favours sheltering equity. The crossover depends entirely on the entered returns and tax rates.
9dfc1aacbfdee668b8864283327189a8ed076766.zh: 正值表示该配置方式留下的税后金额多于把债券基金优先放入 TFSA。每年对利息征税有利于把债券放入免税账户；较高但不确定的股票预期回报在免税环境中复利，则有利于把股票放入免税账户。交叉点完全取决于输入的回报率和税率。

fc7c2ffb4b31f9324d98643cb649d0fbb06367f4.src: A practical note: removing a fixed set of months gives the same ending value whatever order the months occur in. Order matters only once a person must choose an exit date, and that is where clustering becomes decisive.

c4fbbf5f4e3e729dc463aa40e0092e15a6f5f4bb.src: A single balanced fund held in both accounts, the “same mix” bar, gives up a little potential optimization in exchange for simplicity and an identical risk profile in each account. For many households that trade-off is reasonable. Provincial tax, foreign withholding tax on foreign dividends, dividend gross-up and credit details, and personal circumstances can all change the result; a tax professional can review the specifics.
c4fbbf5f4e3e729dc463aa40e0092e15a6f5f4bb.zh: 在两个账户中都持有同一只平衡基金，即“相同组合”这一栏，会放弃一点潜在的优化空间，换来简单以及两个账户完全相同的风险特征。对许多家庭来说，这种取舍是合理的。省税、外国股息的境外预扣税、股息加成与抵免细节以及个人情况，都可能改变结果；税务专业人士可以审阅具体情况。

0d6d8f30e0bd5b7f4633b279def5df9796fe0221.src: Equity first puts the more volatile fund in the TFSA. After a market fall, the TFSA balance drops more than in the bond-first layout. A loss inside a TFSA cannot be claimed as a capital loss, and the lower value does not create new contribution room; the TFSA loss guide traces that effect. Outside registered plans, CRA allows capital losses to offset capital gains, with any net capital loss carried back three years or forward indefinitely, though not against other income. The model gives a loss on sale no tax value, which understates the non-registered account’s flexibility.
0d6d8f30e0bd5b7f4633b279def5df9796fe0221.zh: 股票优先会把波动较大的基金放进 TFSA。市场下跌后，TFSA 余额的跌幅会大于债券优先的配置。TFSA 内的亏损不能申报为资本亏损，价值下降也不会产生新的供款额度；TFSA 亏损指南追踪了这一影响。在注册计划以外，CRA 允许资本亏损抵销资本收益，净资本亏损可向前结转三年或无限期向后结转，但不能抵销其他收入。模型对出售时的亏损不赋予任何税务价值，因此低估了非注册账户的灵活性。

389556b1f440e9720b9daf08534d7ac2084a9d2f.src: Every placement starts with the same $100,000: $40,000 in the TFSA, $60,000 in the non-registered account and 40% of the total in the bond fund. Only the location of each fund changes. Bond interest and equity distributions in the non-registered account are taxed in the year paid at the entered rates and the after-tax cash is reinvested. Unrealized equity growth is taxed only when the units are sold at the horizon, at the entered marginal rate times the one-half inclusion rate. Returns are constant hypothetical inputs, not forecasts. Fund fees are assumed to be inside the entered returns. No new contributions, withdrawals, rebalancing, foreign withholding tax, dividend gross-up or credit calculation, provincial details, or use of a capital loss is modeled.
389556b1f440e9720b9daf08534d7ac2084a9d2f.zh: 每种配置都从相同的 $100,000 开始：TFSA 中 $40,000，非注册账户中 $60,000，总额的 40% 投资于债券基金。只改变每只基金所在的账户。非注册账户中的债券利息和股票分派在支付当年按输入的税率征税，税后现金再投资。未实现的股票增长只在期末出售单位时征税，税率为输入的边际税率乘以二分之一的计入比例。回报率是固定的假设输入，不是预测。基金费用假定已包含在输入的回报中。模型未计入新增供款、取款、再平衡、境外预扣税、股息加成或抵免计算、省级细节，也未使用资本亏损。

36fe1ac301d5a2d8cacfcec830abf416eaaf0d0b.src: Expected returns are uncertain. An equity fund’s higher average return comes with larger losses in some years, and no allocation guarantees the higher return arrives during your holding period. A placement chosen on an optimistic equity assumption can still be the wrong one if returns disappoint.
36fe1ac301d5a2d8cacfcec830abf416eaaf0d0b.zh: 预期回报并不确定。股票基金较高的平均回报伴随着某些年份较大的亏损，任何资产配置都不能保证较高的回报恰好出现在您的持有期内。基于乐观的股票假设选出的配置方式，如果回报不如预期，仍可能是错误的选择。

c361ec4ddd3975ba595c4790df66de2f7cc0f83e.src: Investment articles often show that an investor who missed a handful of the market’s best days ended with far less money than one who stayed invested. A reply soon follows: an investor who missed the worst days would have done far better. Both calculations are correct and both are hindsight. Nobody can list the best or worst periods before they happen.
c361ec4ddd3975ba595c4790df66de2f7cc0f83e.zh: 投资文章经常指出，错过市场少数几个最好交易日的投资者，最终的钱远少于一直留在市场中的投资者。很快就会有人反驳：错过最差交易日的投资者会好得多。两种计算都正确，也都是事后诸葛亮。没有人能在事前列出最好或最差的时段。

039e32e1f4745f5a83f7a6554852b5386ee48424.src: Listed in calendar order. On average, each best month is 1.4 months from the nearest worst month in this path. An exit that avoids one of the worst months is likely to be out for one of the best, because both arrive during the same volatile stretch.
039e32e1f4745f5a83f7a6554852b5386ee48424.zh: 按时间顺序列出。在这条路径中，每个最好的月份平均距离最近的最差月份 1.4 个月。避开某个最差月份的离场，很可能也会错过某个最好的月份，因为两者都出现在同一段波动期间。

dd3b1792d5bb18afd63474848dbbf0d896da1c84.src: Many investors hold more than one fund and more than one account. If TFSA room is limited, a practical question follows: which fund should use the tax-free space first? This is often called asset location. It is a different decision from asset allocation. The combined mix, here 40% bond fund and 60% equity fund, stays the same in every comparison; only the account holding each fund changes.
dd3b1792d5bb18afd63474848dbbf0d896da1c84.zh: 许多投资者持有不止一只基金和不止一个账户。如果 TFSA 额度有限，一个实际问题随之而来：哪只基金应该优先使用免税空间？这通常称为资产位置配置（asset location），与资产配置是不同的决定。合并后的组合，这里为 40% 债券基金和 60% 股票基金，在每次比较中都保持不变；只改变持有每只基金的账户。

cb2a22936a2cb0d016fa181208262d2ca8843fb6.src: Room is usually filled in one of two ways. A person may contribute part of each paycheque as it is earned, or move an existing lump sum, perhaps a non-registered holding, into the TFSA. Moving existing units in kind counts as a contribution at market value and can realize a gain in the non-registered account, as the in-kind contribution guide shows. Either way, the room is finite, so what goes into it matters.
cb2a22936a2cb0d016fa181208262d2ca8843fb6.zh: 额度通常有两种填满方式。一种是每次领到工资时把其中一部分供款进去；另一种是把现有的一笔资金，例如非注册账户中的持仓，转入 TFSA。以实物转入现有单位按市值计为供款，并可能在非注册账户中实现收益，详见实物供款指南。无论哪种方式，额度都是有限的，因此放什么进去很重要。

a9da01d9deaecbf94bc0b27fc1a21ff25fd32f54.src: That arrangement is authored, but it reflects an observation regulators make about real markets. FINRA notes that some of the top trading days occur during periods of greater volatility, so an investor who sells during a sharp but temporary decline may miss the rebound. The months that test nerves and the months that reward patience tend to arrive together.
a9da01d9deaecbf94bc0b27fc1a21ff25fd32f54.zh: 这种安排是自拟的，但反映了监管机构对真实市场的观察。FINRA 指出，一些最佳交易日出现在波动较大的时期，因此在急剧但短暂的下跌中卖出的投资者可能会错过反弹。考验耐心的月份和回报耐心的月份往往同时到来。

c9578ef36e0105c720fc61d2297b3039b529beb3.src: The TFSA, not the fund, provides the tax shelter. Sheltering a bond fund avoids yearly tax on interest; sheltering an equity fund lets a higher but uncertain return compound without tax. Which helps more depends on the returns, the tax rates and the holding period, so test the placement rather than assume it.
c9578ef36e0105c720fc61d2297b3039b529beb3.zh: 提供税务庇护的是 TFSA，而不是基金。把债券基金放进免税账户可避免每年的利息税；把股票基金放进去，则让较高但不确定的回报免税复利。哪种帮助更大取决于回报率、税率和持有期，因此应测试配置方式，而不是想当然。

e87c6ea4deb1d74b453d44caee76e8727f3299fe.src: The calm months average under 1%, then months 41–54 alternate large losses and large gains before a recovery. The exit window earns cash interest for months 47–52 and then rejoins the path. It ends below the fully invested balance by $2,888.
e87c6ea4deb1d74b453d44caee76e8727f3299fe.zh: 平静月份的平均回报低于 1%，随后第 41–54 个月大跌与大涨交替出现，然后复苏。离场窗口在第 47–52 个月赚取现金利息，之后重新回到路径上。最终比全程投资的余额低 $2,888。

db14b884b94c3297ec3357773d3765a211cbdd7d.src: The count chart extends this from zero to ten months. Missing more best months keeps lowering the result; missing more worst months keeps raising it. The line for missing both stays within a few thousand dollars of the fully invested balance. Missing both is a closer description of what an imperfect exit does, because of where the months fall.
db14b884b94c3297ec3357773d3765a211cbdd7d.zh: 数量图把剔除的月份从零扩展到十个。错过越多最好的月份，结果越低；避开越多最差的月份，结果越高。两者都错过的那条线与全程投资的余额相差不超过几千加元。由于这些月份所处的位置，两者都错过更接近不完美离场的实际效果。

a6b9f6b49aa92d7c3521f9ccdc6f699f69b5f1d9.src: The default exit leaves after the close of month 46, just after the deepest monthly loss, when fear is likely to be greatest, and stays out for six months. The window skips four strong months and two weak ones. The balance ends at about CAD 15,157, about CAD 2,888 below staying invested.
a6b9f6b49aa92d7c3521f9ccdc6f699f69b5f1d9.zh: 默认的离场发生在第 46 个月收盘后，正好在最大单月亏损之后，此时恐惧可能最强烈，并离场六个月。这个窗口错过了四个强势月份和两个弱势月份。余额最终约为 15,157 加元，比全程投资低约 2,888 加元。

a0c16572949cd3063e8452e493d25e95f0a2bcc8.src: The difference chart shows the timing. Equity first trails by about CAD 247 at year five and CAD 223 at year ten, then moves ahead: CAD 408 at year 15 and CAD 2,201 at year 20. Over a short holding period, sheltering the interest won; over a longer one, sheltering the faster-growing fund won. A different set of inputs can reverse both.
a0c16572949cd3063e8452e493d25e95f0a2bcc8.zh: 差额图显示了时间的影响。股票优先在第五年落后约 247 加元，在第十年落后约 223 加元，之后转为领先：第 15 年领先 408 加元，第 20 年领先 2,201 加元。在较短的持有期内，庇护利息的做法胜出；在较长的持有期内，庇护增长较快的基金胜出。换一组输入，两种结论都可能反转。

3593adb763f626090891b7e04ad61e46fd2d9f29.src: The first chart shows CRA’s TFSA dollar limits. The limit was CAD 5,000 in 2009, CAD 10,000 in 2015, and has been CAD 7,000 for each of 2024, 2025 and 2026. The limits for 2009 to 2026 add up to CAD 109,000. That total applies only to someone who was 18 or older and resident in Canada since 2009 and has never contributed; your own room depends on your age, residency, contributions and withdrawals, and CRA’s My Account shows it.
3593adb763f626090891b7e04ad61e46fd2d9f29.zh: 第一张图显示 CRA 公布的 TFSA 年度额度。额度在 2009 年为 5,000 加元，2015 年为 10,000 加元，2024、2025 和 2026 年均为 7,000 加元。2009 至 2026 年的额度合计 109,000 加元。这个总额只适用于自 2009 年起年满 18 岁、居住在加拿大且从未供款的人；您自己的额度取决于年龄、居民身份、供款和取款，CRA 的 My Account 会显示。

8620d2998ce760f3ecbbef02ffefd036c154116a.src: The grid reruns the 20-year comparison while changing only the equity fund’s price growth and the bond fund’s return. With equity growth of 2% (4% total return including distributions) and a 4% bond fund, bond first is ahead by about CAD 9,771. With equity growth of 8% and a 6% bond fund, equity first is ahead by about CAD 3,669. When bonds pay more relative to equities, the yearly tax on interest weighs more; when equities are expected to earn much more, tax-free compounding of that return weighs more.
8620d2998ce760f3ecbbef02ffefd036c154116a.zh: 该网格重新计算 20 年的比较，只改变股票基金的价格增长和债券基金的回报。当股票增长为 2%（含分派的总回报为 4%）、债券基金为 4% 时，债券优先领先约 9,771 加元。当股票增长为 8%、债券基金为 6% 时，股票优先领先约 3,669 加元。债券回报相对股票越高，每年利息税的影响越大；股票预期回报远高于债券时，该回报免税复利的影响越大。

5511699eb08f67096e48a264a8c849a5fe42d73c.src: The heatmap shows fifteen windows. Leaving after month 40, before the trouble starts, and staying out for six months ends about CAD 5,043 ahead, because the window happens to skip the first crash months. Leaving after month 46 for twelve months ends about CAD 4,224 behind. The best cells require knowing that a crisis is about to start; the worst cells follow the natural reaction of selling after large losses and waiting for calm. Choosing the dates required the whole path, which no investor has.
5511699eb08f67096e48a264a8c849a5fe42d73c.zh: 热力图显示了十五个离场窗口。在第 40 个月后、麻烦开始之前离场六个月，最终领先约 5,043 加元，因为这个窗口恰好避开了最初的崩盘月份。在第 46 个月后离场十二个月，最终落后约 4,224 加元。最好的单元格要求事先知道危机即将开始；最差的单元格则对应大跌后卖出、等待平静的自然反应。选择这些日期需要看到整条路径，而没有投资者能做到。

657cd0e015f270afbe79f5e09d3ad04dfbe4078b.src: The model starts with CAD 40,000 in a TFSA and CAD 60,000 in a non-registered account. The bond fund returns 4% a year, all paid as interest. The equity fund grows 5% a year in price and also distributes 2% a year, which is reinvested. In the non-registered account:

0629fc20bc45355853e9105363f6ebf2e0b08e46.src: The placements also differ in after-tax risk. The government shares part of the gains and, through loss offsets, part of the losses in a taxable account, but nothing in a TFSA. Two portfolios with the same pre-tax 40/60 mix can therefore carry different after-tax exposure. That is one reason to treat asset location as a refinement after the allocation is right, not a replacement for it.
0629fc20bc45355853e9105363f6ebf2e0b08e46.zh: 不同配置的税后风险也不同。在应税账户中，政府分享部分收益，并通过亏损抵销分担部分亏损；在 TFSA 中则完全不分担。因此，两个税前同为 40/60 的组合，税后风险敞口可能不同。这也是为什么应在资产配置正确之后，再把资产位置配置当作微调，而不是替代品。
