61eb102721a830aa74ad1fa48194b71a90c8c3ea.src: The tax pattern differs much more than the result. Bond first pays about CAD 7,142 of tax on yearly income over the 20 years but leaves about CAD 17,855 of tax due on the final equity sale. Equity first pays about CAD 15,019 on yearly income, mostly interest, and only about CAD 5,952 on the sale. Deferral and the half inclusion rate make unrealized equity growth relatively tax-efficient outside the TFSA; interest has neither advantage.
61eb102721a830aa74ad1fa48194b71a90c8c3ea.zh: 税款模式的差异远大于结果的差异。债券优先在 20 年间为每年收入缴税约 7,142 加元，但最终出售股票时还需缴税约 17,855 加元。股票优先为每年收入缴税约 15,019 加元，主要是利息税，出售时只需缴税约 5,952 加元。递延缴税和二分之一的计入比例，使未实现的股票增长即使在 TFSA 以外也相对节税；利息则两项优势都没有。

a25269d88dfafe337bc423f347a45706ee0b7545.src: The useful question is what happens to someone who follows a rule they could actually follow, such as “move to cash after this month-end and come back in six months.” This guide answers both with one authored ten-year path for an existing CAD 10,000 balance. The path is deliberately simple: calm months averaging about 0.5%, a 14-month crisis in months 41 to 54 in which large losses and large gains alternate, then a recovery. Any month spent out of the market earns cash interest, 2.25% a year by default.
a25269d88dfafe337bc423f347a45706ee0b7545.zh: 真正有用的问题是：遵循一条可以实际执行的规则会怎样，例如“在这个月末转为现金，六个月后再回来”。本指南用一条现有 10,000 加元余额的十年自拟路径回答这两个问题。路径刻意简化：平静月份平均约 0.5%，第 41 至 54 个月为期 14 个月的危机中大跌与大涨交替，然后复苏。不在市场中的每个月都赚取现金利息，默认年利率为 2.25%。

3a2f0b384d01ef1e86b6e0ee7d3c48179d09c576.src: This guide follows a balance already invested. Money arriving from each paycheque raises a different question: whether to keep investing it on schedule during a volatile period. Regular contributions keep buying through a window like the one above, including some of the low-priced months. Holding new pay in cash until conditions look better turns each deposit into a timing decision; the dip-waiting guide tests that rule, and the cash-floor guide checks whether contributions remain affordable if income stops.
3a2f0b384d01ef1e86b6e0ee7d3c48179d09c576.zh: 本指南追踪的是已经投资的余额。每次领工资时到账的钱是另一个问题：在波动期间是否继续按计划投资。定期供款会在上述窗口期间继续买入，包括部分价格较低的月份。把新工资持有现金、等到情况看起来更好再投资，会让每笔存款都变成择时决定；等待回调指南测试了这一规则，现金底线指南检查收入中断时供款是否仍可负担。

2a8584dfad7a7b345dbec0da288f58a981d7b288.src: Three placements are compared. Bond first puts all CAD 40,000 of bond fund in the TFSA and holds the equity fund outside. Equity first puts CAD 40,000 of equity fund in the TFSA and leaves the bond fund and the remaining equity outside. Same mix holds 40/60 in each account. Fund fees are assumed to be included in the entered returns.

c37b7dd25db94e7b8647f2f9cfbe9ee2ce38b429.src: Worry about a financial-crisis-style fall is reasonable, especially for money needed within a few years. The Ontario Securities Commission’s investor education site suggests staying with a diversified portfolio that fits your plan and warns that trying to time the market can mean losses when prices drop and missed gains when they recover. Those points suggest acting on the allocation rather than the calendar:
c37b7dd25db94e7b8647f2f9cfbe9ee2ce38b429.zh: 担心出现金融危机式的下跌是合理的，尤其是对几年内就要用的钱而言。安大略省证券委员会的投资者教育网站建议坚持适合自身计划的多元化投资组合，并提醒择时可能导致价格下跌时亏损、价格回升时错过收益。这些要点表明，应针对资产配置而不是日历采取行动：

e5ee5507e20c3a41bfb4c5e97cb52d78d874852b.src: “Missing the best days” and “avoiding the worst days” are hindsight exercises. In volatile stretches the best and worst periods sit side by side, so an exit usually skips some of each. Whether an exit helps depends on dates nobody knows in advance, which is why a written allocation usually serves crash worry better than a forecast.
e5ee5507e20c3a41bfb4c5e97cb52d78d874852b.zh: “错过最好的交易日”和“避开最差的交易日”都是事后推演。在波动期间，最好和最差的时段并排出现，因此一次离场通常会两种都错过一些。离场是否有利取决于没有人能事先知道的日期，这就是为什么书面的资产配置通常比预测更能应对崩盘担忧。

0d980957fc9d219eba9353f1f1d0318f251e76ac.src: Pension sharing moves real CPP payments between spouses. Each base pension is shareable in the ratio of months lived together to months in the joint contributory period, half of each shareable amount goes to the other spouse, and only the difference changes hands. The couple’s combined CPP never changes; the tax result depends on who has the higher marginal rate, and the formula offers no percentage to choose.
0d980957fc9d219eba9353f1f1d0318f251e76ac.zh: 养老金共享在配偶之间转移了实际的 CPP 支付。每项基本养老金按照共同居住月数与共同缴费期间月数的比例进行分享，每项可分享金额的一半归另一方配偶，仅差额易手。这对夫妇的综合 CPP 从未改变；税收结果取决于谁的边际税率更高，并且该公式没有提供百分比可供选择。

0e7a6807b04494385a9f7be7d3bba3cabdd9e699.src: The base ratio is 420 ÷ 576 = 72.92%. Pat’s shareable amount is 72.92% × 1,100 + 150 = CAD 952.08; Lee’s is 72.92% × 400 + 40 = CAD 331.67. Half the difference, CAD 310.21 a month, moves from Pat to Lee: Pat now receives CAD 939.79 and Lee CAD 750.21, still CAD 1,690 together. Over 12 months that moves CAD 3,722.50 of taxable income.
0e7a6807b04494385a9f7be7d3bba3cabdd9e699.zh: 基本比率为 420 ÷ 576 = 72.92%。 Pat的可分享金额为72.92% × 1,100 + 150 = CAD 952.08；李氏的为 72.92% × 400 + 40 = 331.67 加元。差额的一半（每月 310.21 加元）从 Pat 转移到 Lee：Pat 现在收到 939.79 加元，Lee 收到 750.21 加元，总共仍然是 1,690 加元。 12 个月内转移了 3,722.50 加元的应税收入。

2e35161b9ea67101bc0443630715f775d5e8d27d.src: Service Canada requires that you live with your legal spouse or common-law partner and that you, your partner or both receive (or have applied for) a CPP retirement pension. A common-law partner under the CPP is someone who has lived with you in a conjugal relationship for at least one year, and spouses who are voluntarily separated when they apply cannot be approved. Either spouse can apply, online through My Service Canada Account or on paper with form ISP1002, and both social insurance numbers go on every document.

618231c8ea78f605386767d287a556668040f546.src: Pension sharing helps only when it moves income from the spouse with the higher marginal cost to the one with the lower cost. The formula is mechanical: there is no percentage to choose, and both pensions move. Reverse the default pensions so that Lee, the spouse with less other income, has the larger CPP, and sharing moves CAD 310.21 a month toward Pat. Pat pays about 16.1% on each extra dollar (14% plus the age-amount reduction), while Lee saves only the CAD 187.60 of tax Lee was paying; the couple pays an illustrative CAD 411.72 more federal tax. In that household the right decision is not to apply.
618231c8ea78f605386767d287a556668040f546.zh: 只有当养老金分享将边际成本较高的一方的收入转移到成本较低的一方时，养老金分享才会有帮助。公式很机械：没有百分比可供选择，而且两种养老金都会变动。扭转默认养老金，使李（其他收入较少的配偶）拥有更大的 CPP，并每月向帕特分享 310.21 加元。 Pat 为每多 1 美元支付约 16.1%（14% 加上年龄减少额），而 Lee 只节省了 Lee 所缴纳税款的 187.60 加元；这对夫妇缴纳了说明性的多缴 411.72 加元联邦税。在该家庭中，正确的决定是不申请。

730ad29f61a138af818eb3066d52e84832834ce2.src: Section 65.1(9) assigns, from each pension, 50% of the pension multiplied by the ratio of months of cohabitation to months in the joint contributory period. The joint contributory period starts in January 1966 or the month the older spouse turns 18, whichever is later, and ends when the later of the two individual contributory periods ends—usually when the second spouse’s pension starts. If only one spouse is a contributor, it ends at the earlier of the month the non-contributor turns 70 and the month of approval. Some excluded months, such as months of CPP disability, can be removed. Your Statement of Contributions shows the details Service Canada will use.
730ad29f61a138af818eb3066d52e84832834ce2.zh: 第 65.1(9) 条从每份养老金中分配养老金的 50% 乘以同居月数与共同缴费期月数的比率。共同缴款期从 1966 年 1 月或年长配偶满 18 岁的月份开始，以较晚者为准，并在两个个人缴款期中较晚的一个期结束时结束——通常是在第二位配偶的养老金开始时。如果只有一位配偶是缴款人，则在非缴款人年满 70 岁的月份和获得批准的月份中较早的月份结束。一些排除的月份，例如 CPP 残疾月份，可以删除。您的捐款声明显示了加拿大服务部将使用的详细信息。

3368a2bcc14dc0ae9da4470bc274f617cc336fd6.src: Original illustration of the Canada Pension Plan Act section 65.1(9) assignment formula with 12 months of sharing in 2026. Each spouse’s base pension is shareable in the ratio of months living together to months in the joint contributory period; the enhancement part uses the share you enter for the additional joint contributory periods that begin in 2019 and 2024. Half of each shareable amount goes to the other spouse, so the couple’s combined CPP is unchanged. The post-retirement benefit is excluded, as Service Canada states. Federal tax uses the 2026 brackets, basic personal amount, age amount, CAD 2,000 pension income amount and CAD 95,323 OAS recovery threshold from the site’s pension-splitting model; CPP is not eligible pension income. Both spouses are assumed 65 or older, resident in Canada, living together and not making a T1032 election. No provincial tax, survivor benefit or QPP rules. Not a Service Canada calculation.

7efa7f8cee553b3a545270a13efdfa3d947e35a1.src: When sharing ends, each pension returns to what it would have been without sharing. In the worked example, Lee’s payment would drop from CAD 750.21 back to CAD 440 and Pat’s would rise to CAD 1,250. A budget that treats the shared amount as permanent personal income can be exposed in a separation; on a death, the CPP survivor’s pension follows separate rules and is not modelled here. Pension sharing is also different from a division of CPP credits after separation, which redistributes contribution records rather than payments.
7efa7f8cee553b3a545270a13efdfa3d947e35a1.zh: 当共享结束时，每份养老金将恢复到没有共享时的水平。在实际示例中，Lee 的付款将从 750.21 加元降至 440 加元，Pat 的付款将增加至 1,250 加元。将共同金额视为永久个人收入的预算可能会因分居而暴露；如果死亡，CPP 遗属养老金遵循单独的规则，此处不进行建模。养老金共享也不同于离职后 CPP 积分的划分，后者重新分配缴款记录而不是付款。

8c4f4201d04f4e10016eedd5133e795ff2994eaa.src: CPP pension sharing—the Act calls it an assignment of a retirement pension—lets spouses or common-law partners who live together redistribute the part of their CPP retirement pensions earned while they were together. Unlike the T1032 pension income splitting election, which only reallocates income between two tax returns, sharing changes the monthly payments each person receives from Service Canada. Each spouse then reports their own adjusted CPP on their return.
8c4f4201d04f4e10016eedd5133e795ff2994eaa.zh: CPP 养老金共享（该法案将其称为退休金的分配）允许同居的配偶或同居伴侣重新分配他们在一起期间赚取的 CPP 退休金部分。与 T1032 养老金收入分割选举不同，T1032 养老金收入分割选举仅在两份纳税申报表之间重新分配收入，而分享则改变了每个人从加拿大服务部收到的每月付款。然后，每位配偶在返回时报告自己调整后的 CPP。

8ce66c82db0b8cec3d574590d09b2bef1274eec7.src: Sharing moves real monthly payments between the two pension accounts; the combined total does not change. Each person then receives and reports their own adjusted amount.

d8d0476120c43655b9da58da221f696e8fae3dde.src: Section 65.1 of the Canada Pension Plan Act sets out two situations. If both spouses are contributors, both must be receiving a retirement pension, and the assignment applies to both. If only one ever contributed to the CPP or a provincial plan, the non-contributor must be at least 60 and only the contributor’s pension is shared. A written agreement or court order generally does not bind the Minister; the Act’s narrow exception is a post-4 June 1986 agreement that refers to the Act and expresses an intention that no assignment be made, where provincial law permits it.
d8d0476120c43655b9da58da221f696e8fae3dde.zh: 《加拿大养老金计划法》第 65.1 条规定了两种情况。如果配偶双方都是缴款人，则双方都必须领取退休金，并且分配对双方都适用。如果只有一个人曾向 CPP 或省级计划缴款，则非缴款人必须年满 60 岁，并且只有缴款人的养老金可以共享。书面协议或法院命令一般对部长没有约束力；该法案的极少数例外是 1986 年 6 月 4 日之后的协议，该协议提及该法案并表示在省法律允许的情况下不进行转让。

fa8d7b8f6e121e591597eb7d1d3c9dd800e01248.src: Three features shape the planning. First, if both spouses have CPP pensions, both are shared; you cannot share only the larger one. Second, the couple’s combined CPP does not change—Service Canada states this directly—so any benefit comes from tax and income-tested benefits, not from more pension. Third, sharing begins the month after Service Canada approves the application and cannot be backdated, so the decision has a cost of delay when it is favourable.
fa8d7b8f6e121e591597eb7d1d3c9dd800e01248.zh: 规划的三个特点。首先，如果配偶双方都有CPP养老金，则双方共享；您不能只共享较大的一个。其次，这对夫妇的综合退休金并没有改变——加拿大服务部直接指出了这一点——因此任何福利都来自税收和收入测试福利，而不是更多的养老金。第三，共享从加拿大服务部批准申请后的一个月开始，并且不能回溯，因此，当决定有利时，会产生延迟成本。

5bfba8f8780195386e07110dcaaad9b7934eb34f.src: Two cash-flow points matter more than the arithmetic. First, the benefit can be applied to amounts owed for tax, earlier benefit overpayments or other government debts, so a household with a balance owing may not receive the cash. Second, a change in marital status can move a household between the single and couple tables in either direction: a single parent with one child below the threshold receives the same CAD 1,124 as a couple with one child, but the couple’s combined income is what gets tested against CAD 46,432.
5bfba8f8780195386e07110dcaaad9b7934eb34f.zh: 有两点对现金流的影响比算术更大。第一，补助可能被用来抵扣所欠税款、以往福利多付款项或其他政府债务，因此有欠款的家庭可能拿不到现金。第二，婚姻状况变化可能使家庭在单身表和夫妇表之间双向移动：门槛以下有一个子女的单亲家长与有一个子女的夫妇同样领取 1,124 加元，但用来与 46,432 加元比较的是夫妇的合并收入。

862db296eebae81885f4cc646245b7c754f74518.src: The annual amount is not fixed if the household changes. The CRA recalculates from the effective date when a spouse or partner relationship starts or ends, an eligible child is added or turns 19, a shared-custody arrangement starts or stops, a recipient dies, or a reassessment changes either spouse’s net income. Couples receive one payment for both, paid to whichever spouse’s return is assessed first; in shared custody each parent receives half of the child amounts.
862db296eebae81885f4cc646245b7c754f74518.zh: 如果家庭状况改变，年度金额并非固定不变。在以下情况下，CRA 会从生效日起重新计算：配偶或伴侣关系开始或结束、新增合资格子女或子女年满 19 岁、共同监护安排开始或停止、领取人去世，或重新评税改变了任何一方配偶的净收入。夫妇只领取一笔合并款项，发给报税表先被评定的一方；共同监护时，每位家长领取子女金额的一半。

94168febaf93946ea9a7938a6fd5c536c55e863a.src: Original illustration of the federal Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit (CGEB, formerly the GST/HST credit) for the payment period July 2026 to June 2027, based on 2025 adjusted family net income. Parameters are derived from the CRA payments chart dated 8 June 2026 (CAD 445 adult and spouse or eligible-dependant amounts, CAD 234 per other child, single supplement up to CAD 234 phased in at 2% above CAD 11,564, all reduced by 5% above CAD 46,432) and reproduce every row of that chart. Eligibility (age 19, residence, a filed 2025 return, a registered child) is assumed. Provincial and territorial programs paid with the benefit, the separately paid Ontario trillium benefit, shared custody, mid-year changes in marital status or children, and offsets against debts are not modelled. Quarterly amounts are the annual amount divided by four; CRA rounding can differ by a cent.

c53770689d7fff43b55ac4defab218195d1516df.src: So a single person with no income gets CAD 445, which rises 2 cents per dollar from CAD 11,564 until it reaches CAD 679 at CAD 23,264. A couple with no children gets CAD 890; with one child, CAD 1,124. A single parent with one child also gets CAD 1,124 (CAD 445 + 445 + 234 supplement), which is why the chart’s one-child columns are the same for both marital statuses below the threshold.
c53770689d7fff43b55ac4defab218195d1516df.zh: 因此，没有收入的单身人士可领取 445 加元，从 11,564 加元起每 1 加元收入增加 2 分，直到在 23,264 加元时达到 679 加元。无子女的夫妇可领取 890 加元；有一个子女则为 1,124 加元。有一个子女的单亲家长同样领取 1,124 加元（445 + 445 + 234 加元补充额），这就是为什么在门槛以下，该表中一个子女的两栏在两种婚姻状况下相同。

d37510ad0ca8435e3d61b33e902ba74a6911b783.src: The 2025–26 column matches the CRA’s top-up page, whose maximum top-ups (CAD 267 single, CAD 349 couple, CAD 441 with one child) are half of those annual maxima, rounded. f3d409d390887815b98934b67548e7e7738537f6.src: Single, no children, 2025 AFNI CAD 52,000. The maximum is CAD 679. Income is CAD 5,568 above CAD 46,432, so the reduction is 5% × 5,568 = CAD 278.40 and the annual benefit is CAD 400.60, paid as four payments of CAD 100.15. If a reassessment of the 2025 return lowered AFNI by CAD 3,000 to CAD 49,000, the reduction would fall to CAD 128.40 and the benefit would rise to CAD 550.60—CAD 150.00 more, or 5 cents per dollar. These are the model’s defaults.

f7a3470eab22153f9e18415acaaa94b4660e7517.src: The model applies one set of federal parameters to one household for the whole payment period. It assumes the eligibility conditions are met and leaves out provincial and territorial programs, shared custody, mid-year changes, debts offset against payments, and households with more than four children. Parameters are derived from the CRA chart rather than quoted from a CRA formula, and quarterly amounts are the annual amount divided by four, so a cent of rounding can differ. Check your CRA account or the CRA child and family benefits calculator for your actual entitlement.
f7a3470eab22153f9e18415acaaa94b4660e7517.zh: 模型对一个家庭在整个发放期内套用一套联邦参数。它假设已满足资格条件，不包括省和地区计划、共同监护、年内变化、用于抵债的扣款，以及子女超过四个的家庭。参数是从 CRA 表格推导而来，并非引用 CRA 公布的公式；季度金额为全年金额除以四，因此四舍五入可能相差一分。你的实际应得金额请查看 CRA 账户或 CRA 儿童与家庭福利计算器。

487e2093ca588d9691b0e3e6843ba7ca1c27cc04.zh: 确认资产配置与你能承受的亏损相符。风险档案压力测试会把股票比例换算成以金额计的亏损。如果股票部分下跌 30% 就会迫使你卖出，那么配置可能过于激进；一次性调整配置，与反复进出市场是两回事。

8cf44e629348430210fa6ecd5ab95bfcaa11b3f0.src: Crash size. For two years in cash, a 45% crash needs about a 14% hit rate; a 35% crash about 21%. Larger falls reward correct warnings more.
8cf44e629348430210fa6ecd5ab95bfcaa11b3f0.zh: 崩盘幅度。持有现金两年时，45% 的崩盘只需约 14% 的命中率；35% 的崩盘约需 21%。跌幅越大，正确预警的回报越高。

b87b4c6e7aefd8c193ac082d68333e0580395b55.src: Eligible Canadian dividends are grossed up: CRA’s instructions multiply the amount received by 138%, so CAD 100 becomes CAD 138 of taxable income. The federal dividend tax credit is 15.0198% of that grossed-up amount, about CAD 20.73, and Ontario’s 2025 worksheet applies 10% of the grossed-up amount, CAD 13.80. Net tax is about CAD 6.39.
b87b4c6e7aefd8c193ac082d68333e0580395b55.zh: 合格加拿大股息需要加计（gross-up）：CRA 的说明是将收到的金额乘以 138%，因此 100 加元变为 138 加元应税收入。联邦股息税抵免为加计后金额的 15.0198%，约 20.73 加元；安大略省 2025 年工作表按加计后金额的 10% 计算，即 13.80 加元。净税额约为 6.39 加元。

446bcfddfb53e15654684f34bfbfba3f3efdfe55.src: Hold spending money outside the market. Cash needed within a few years belongs in savings or short-term deposits, not in equities you hope to time.
446bcfddfb53e15654684f34bfbfba3f3efdfe55.zh: 把要花的钱放在市场之外。几年内需要用的现金应放在储蓄或短期存款中，而不是放在你希望择时进出的股票里。

283f118ec7c4ec6c5b3b3032c40b7cbdf8c918d8.src: If you do act, write the rule first. State what will trigger a move, how much, and when you will return, then test it here with your own assumptions.
283f118ec7c4ec6c5b3b3032c40b7cbdf8c918d8.zh: 如果真要行动，先写下规则。写明什么情况触发调整、调整多少、何时回到市场，然后在这里用你自己的假设测试。

09359b290f091da28a240dd1fbb256d7e30099aa.src: Interest is fully taxable: CAD 29.65 of tax on CAD 100.
09359b290f091da28a240dd1fbb256d7e30099aa.zh: 利息全额应税：100 加元缴税 29.65 加元。

d9a8e452a3cff2b20616fb399f87283149b60297.src: Keep new contributions going. Contributing part of each paycheque continues through declines; FINRA describes dollar-cost averaging as a way to limit the effect of a significant decline on purchases, though regular investing cannot prevent losses on money already invested or guarantee a profit. Staging an existing lump sum is a separate decision, compared in the phased-investing guide.
d9a8e452a3cff2b20616fb399f87283149b60297.zh: 继续新的供款。每期从工资中拿出一部分供款，可以在下跌期间持续进行；FINRA 将定期定额投资描述为一种在大幅下跌时限制对买入影响的方法，但定期投资无法防止已投资资金的亏损，也不能保证获利。把现有的一笔资金分批投入是另一项决定，可参阅分批投资指南中的比较。

86f14edd49d89d75ba93fc2d2b64e2f0013a42cc.src: Rebalance on a rule. A balanced fund or a written target mix sells some of what has risen and buys what has fallen; the rebalancing guide shows the drift during a crash.
86f14edd49d89d75ba93fc2d2b64e2f0013a42cc.zh: 按规则再平衡。平衡基金或书面的目标配置会卖出部分上涨的资产、买入下跌的资产；再平衡指南显示了崩盘期间的配置漂移。

f75e1a5f54e1494cfc813c96376a2cca283dc7da.src: Small crashes. With a 15% fall and a 25% rebound, staying out two years or more is “not reachable”: the rebound more than recovers the fall, so even a correct warning leaves the cash holder behind.
f75e1a5f54e1494cfc813c96376a2cca283dc7da.zh: 小幅崩盘。在下跌 15%、反弹 25% 的情况下，离场两年或以上属于“无法达到”：反弹足以弥补下跌，因此即使预警正确，持有现金的人也会落后。

7abebff4e31c8904c591bfe13a02b712da897640.src: Time in cash. With a 25% crash, the required hit rate rises from about 10% for one year in cash to about 37% for two years, 56% for three and 74% for four. Each extra year out costs a year of ordinary growth on every false alarm, and after a correct warning it means missing the rebound.
7abebff4e31c8904c591bfe13a02b712da897640.zh: 持有现金的时间。在 25% 的崩盘中，所需命中率从持有现金 1 年时的约 10%，升至 2 年约 37%、3 年约 56%、4 年约 74%。每多离场一年，每次误报都要损失一年的正常增长；而在正确预警之后，则意味着错过反弹。

eefe493b9de19b74786fd06fda67501da934b6c8.src: A crash warning has to be right often enough to pay for the false alarms, and the required accuracy rises the longer you stay in cash and the faster markets rebound. Because nobody knows a signal’s future hit rate, a written allocation that you can hold through a fall usually serves crash fear better than switching in and out.
eefe493b9de19b74786fd06fda67501da934b6c8.zh: 崩盘预警必须足够经常地正确，才能抵消误报的代价；持有现金的时间越长、市场反弹越快，所需的准确度就越高。由于没有人知道某个信号未来的命中率，一个能在下跌中坚持持有的书面资产配置，通常比反复进出市场更能应对崩盘恐惧。

ef0ca501920b14032a2d660602575eb15e67784c.src: A fund passes its income through to you, and the label on that income sets the tax
ef0ca501920b14032a2d660602575eb15e67784c.zh: 基金会把收入转给你，而这笔收入的类别决定税负

3f643f0c5bbcd816d92a8a59072b125253d0b640.src: A fund that is tax-efficient can still be a poor fit. A Canadian dividend fund concentrates in one country and often in a few sectors, such as banks, energy and utilities. A bond fund that pays fully taxable interest may be the part of a balanced portfolio that falls least in an equity crash. Diversification, risk tolerance, time horizon and fees usually matter more than the difference between tax rates on income types.
3f643f0c5bbcd816d92a8a59072b125253d0b640.zh: 节税的基金仍可能不适合你。加拿大股息基金集中于单一国家，而且往往集中在银行、能源和公用事业等少数行业。支付全额应税利息的债券基金，可能正是平衡组合中在股市崩盘时跌得最少的部分。分散投资、风险承受能力、投资期限和费用，通常比不同收入类型之间的税率差异更重要。

4d733d220f417dfcc24fd3a3684d17341a2df714.src: A fund’s income mix is not fixed. Bond funds pay mostly interest. Canadian equity funds often pay eligible dividends but may also distribute capital gains when the manager sells holdings. Index funds and ETFs with low turnover usually realize fewer gains, but can still distribute some. Fund Facts, annual reports and past tax slips show what a fund has paid; past distributions do not guarantee future ones, and a fund that changes its holdings can change its tax character.
4d733d220f417dfcc24fd3a3684d17341a2df714.zh: 基金的收入构成并非固定不变。债券基金主要支付利息。加拿大股票基金通常支付合格股息，但在基金经理卖出持仓时也可能分配资本利得。低周转的指数基金和 ETF 通常实现的收益较少，但仍可能有一些分配。基金概况（Fund Facts）、年度报告和过往税单可显示基金支付过什么；过往分配不保证未来分配，基金调整持仓也可能改变其税务性质。

025cfef1b8df762587c2f20ab2da662941be119a.src: A mutual fund or ETF held in a non-registered account is not taxed as one lump. CRA’s guidance on mutual funds explains that the interest, dividends and capital gains a fund distributes are reported by the investor in the year they are paid, even when they are reinvested in more units. Growth that stays inside the unit price is not taxed until the units are sold. The same 6% return can therefore produce very different tax bills depending on whether it arrives as interest, as Canadian dividends, as capital gains distributions or as a rising unit price.
025cfef1b8df762587c2f20ab2da662941be119a.zh: 在非注册账户中持有的共同基金或 ETF，并不是作为一个整体纳税。CRA 关于共同基金的指引说明，基金分配的利息、股息和资本利得，由投资者在支付当年申报，即使这些分配被再投资购买更多单位也是如此。留在单位价格中的增长，在出售单位之前不征税。因此，同样 6% 的回报，取决于它以利息、加拿大股息、资本利得分配还是单位价格上涨的形式出现，税负可能大不相同。

fa0344885c51a6801deb903dc1c360f146a7020b.src: A warning followed by a crash leaves the cash holder 12.1% ahead over that episode; a false alarm leaves them 6.5% behind. An unwarned crash affects both investors the same way.
fa0344885c51a6801deb903dc1c360f146a7020b.zh: 预警后确实发生崩盘时，持有现金的人在该阶段领先 12.1%；误报则使其落后 6.5%。没有预警的崩盘对两位投资者的影响相同。

22950e2c04ce0a47f974ba67befb37835bd55284.src: Acting on crash warnings: how often must a warning be right before moving to cash pays off?
22950e2c04ce0a47f974ba67befb37835bd55284.zh: 根据崩盘预警行动：预警要有多准，转为现金才划算？

e3e36e93ef5a125976f2744d98585789f4fa153d.zh: 20 年后，利息基金（114,307 加元）与 TFSA（160,357 加元）之间的差距为 46,049 加元。每年对收入征税会减慢复利；递延的增长则一直发挥作用，直到出售。

202dc20ebb93dd3c1e8dbc7dcf24062fab72306a.src: An existing $100,000 balance is followed over 25 years. Ordinary years return 6%. A crash year falls 25% and the next year gains 25%. After each of the 6 warnings the second investor holds cash earning 2.5% for 2 years, then rejoins the market; 2 warnings are followed by a crash and 4 are false alarms. 1 crash arrives with no warning and affects both investors. No tax, trading cost, spread or fund fee is modeled. Every return is a hypothetical input; nobody knows in advance which warnings will be right.
202dc20ebb93dd3c1e8dbc7dcf24062fab72306a.zh: 一笔现有的 100,000 加元余额被跟踪 25 年。普通年份回报 6%。崩盘年份下跌 25%，次年上涨 25%。在 6 次预警的每一次之后，第二位投资者持有利率 2.5% 的现金 2 年，然后重新进入市场；其中 2 次预警之后发生了崩盘，4 次是误报。另有 1 次崩盘在没有预警的情况下发生，并影响两位投资者。模型不计入税、交易成本、买卖价差或基金费用。所有回报都是假设输入；没有人事先知道哪些预警会是正确的。

c349d6f7d6eef3265108d9a9cfd39224c7085478.src: An existing CAD 100,000 balance is followed for 25 years. Ordinary years return 6%. A crash year falls 25% and the year after rebounds 25%, so a crash and its rebound together leave the market about 6.25% lower than before. The investor receives six warnings. After each one, they hold cash earning 2.5% a year for two years and then reinvest. Two warnings are followed by a crash, four are false alarms, and one crash arrives with no warning at all.
c349d6f7d6eef3265108d9a9cfd39224c7085478.zh: 一笔现有的 100,000 加元余额被跟踪 25 年。普通年份回报 6%。崩盘年份下跌 25%，次年反弹 25%，因此一次崩盘加上反弹，会使市场比之前低约 6.25%。投资者收到六次预警。每次预警之后，他们持有年利率 2.5% 的现金两年，然后再投资。其中两次预警之后发生了崩盘，四次是误报，另有一次崩盘完全没有预警。

8887835bfeeb54e09a3b12b15ae79a558a8f1335.zh: 上述任一基金放在 TFSA 中：约 160,357 加元，即完整的 6%。

14c1a43d633bc7fa5ce0b5c8cfbe26655a9aeede.src: At the default middle-bracket rates, eligible dividends are taxed more lightly than even a deferred capital gain. That does not hold everywhere. Using the top 2026 federal rate of 33% and Ontario’s top rate of 13.16%, the eligible-dividend rate rises to about 29.17% against 23.08% for capital gains. With those inputs the low-turnover fund ends at about CAD 134,886, ahead of the dividend fund at about CAD 124,255, while the interest fund falls to about CAD 94,433.
14c1a43d633bc7fa5ce0b5c8cfbe26655a9aeede.zh: 在默认的中间税级税率下，合格股息的税负甚至比递延的资本利得还轻。但这并非处处成立。若采用 2026 年联邦最高税率 33% 和安大略省最高税率 13.16%，合格股息税率升至约 29.17%，而资本利得为 23.08%。在这些输入下，低周转基金期末约为 134,886 加元，领先于股息基金的约 124,255 加元，而利息基金则降至约 94,433 加元。

986324987b4d193306d4518d8fa971ef8f5dd732.src: At the entered rates, CAD 100 of interest costs CAD 29.65 in tax, CAD 100 of eligible dividends costs CAD 6.39, and a CAD 100 capital gain costs CAD 14.83. The dividend figure follows the CRA mechanics: CAD 138 of taxable income, less a federal credit of CAD 20.73 and a provincial credit of CAD 13.80.
986324987b4d193306d4518d8fa971ef8f5dd732.zh: 按输入的税率，100 加元利息需缴税 29.65 加元，100 加元合格股息需缴税 6.39 加元，100 加元资本利得需缴税 14.83 加元。股息数字遵循 CRA 的计算方式：138 加元应税收入，减去 20.73 加元联邦抵免和 13.80 加元省级抵免。

Line 40425: the federal dividend tax credit is 15.0198% of the taxable amount of eligible dividends and 9.0301% for other dividends. The 2026 guide had not been released at review; the model applies these rates as entered constants.
7e45d495ad8887b975b94295ccefe4b653f678ac.zh: 2026 年 10 月 26 日下载并审阅（SHA-256 1f263de2…a316f）。第 12000 行：将收到的合格股息乘以 138%，其他股息乘以 115%。第 40425 行：联邦股息税抵免为合格股息应税金额的 15.0198%，其他股息为 9.0301%。审阅时 2026 年指南尚未发布；模型将这些税率作为输入常数使用。

b8ab982e04f119e86435a634d0d98bbd3683cc02.src: Each bar adds up to the TFSA ending value of $160,357. The last slice is the compound growth the tax payments would have earned had they stayed invested. Tax rates use one combined marginal rate throughout, so a large income or sale that crosses into a higher bracket is not modeled.
b8ab982e04f119e86435a634d0d98bbd3683cc02.zh: 每根柱的总和等于 TFSA 期末价值 160,357 加元。最后一段是这些税款若留在账户中本可赚取的复利增长。全程使用单一综合边际税率，因此不模拟大额收入或出售跨入更高税级的情况。

7787dc317871a70bcf4c92d15fd03237ee047886.src: Each cell keeps the entered 25% rebound, 6% ordinary return and 2.5% cash rate and changes only the crash size and time out. Higher cells demand a more accurate signal. "Not reachable" means even a correct warning leaves the cash holder behind.
7787dc317871a70bcf4c92d15fd03237ee047886.zh: 每个单元格保持输入的 25% 反弹、6% 普通回报和 2.5% 现金利率，只改变崩盘幅度和离场时间。数值越高，要求的信号越准确。“无法达到”表示即使预警正确，持有现金的人也会落后。

9999e979cf60fa4507b81b3ec91bfc31aaffc516.src: Each cell reruns the 20-year comparison at the entered tax rates and dividend yield, changing only the pre-tax return, and annualizes the after-tax ending value. When the pre-tax return is below the dividend yield, the dividend fund’s price falls; that loss is given no tax value on sale.
9999e979cf60fa4507b81b3ec91bfc31aaffc516.zh: 每个单元格按输入的税率和股息率重新计算 20 年的比较，只改变税前回报，并将税后期末价值年化。当税前回报低于股息率时，股息基金的价格会下跌；出售时该亏损不计任何税务价值。

85050cdbb43439fde2299df9ca87acf392e4bf89.src: Each fund starts with $50,000 and earns the same 6% a year before tax; only the form in which the return arrives changes. The combined marginal rate is 29.65% (20.5% federal plus 9.15% provincial or territorial). Interest is taxed at that rate, a realized capital gain at half of it, and an eligible dividend is grossed up by 38% and then reduced by the federal credit of 15.0198% and the entered provincial credit, both measured on the grossed-up amount. Income is taxed in the year paid and the after-tax cash is reinvested; unrealized growth is taxed only on the sale at the horizon. Returns are constant hypothetical inputs, not forecasts or the record of any fund, and this is not a personal tax calculation.
85050cdbb43439fde2299df9ca87acf392e4bf89.zh: 每只基金从 50,000 加元开始，每年税前回报同为 6%；唯一改变的是回报的形式。综合边际税率为 29.65%（联邦 20.5% 加省或地区 9.15%）。利息按此税率征税，已实现资本利得按其一半征税，合格股息先加计 38%，再减去联邦 15.0198% 的抵免和输入的省级抵免，两者均按加计后金额计算。收入在支付当年征税，税后现金再投资；未实现的增长只在期末出售时征税。回报为固定的假设输入，并非预测或任何基金的记录，也不是个人税务计算。

dd52ba01044a49de4f7cef78dd8abd6566be760c.src: Each fund starts with CAD 50,000 and earns 6% a year before tax for 20 years. Income is taxed in the year it is paid and the after-tax amount is reinvested. At the end, the non-registered units are sold and any remaining gain is taxed.

00e9eba58ea8cbe0fff370cf0787f5a717662121.src: Headlines about bubbles, recessions and “the next 2008” arrive every year. For someone with savings already invested, each one raises the same question: should I move to cash until it passes? A warning can turn out right, in which case cash avoids a loss. It can also be a false alarm, in which case the investor sits in cash while markets keep rising and then has to decide when to buy back. FINRA’s guidance on market timing warns that an investor who sells after a fall “very well might miss a subsequent recovery and rally.” A timing strategy therefore needs two decisions to go right: when to get out and when to get back in.
00e9eba58ea8cbe0fff370cf0787f5a717662121.zh: 关于泡沫、衰退和“下一个 2008”的新闻每年都有。对已有储蓄投资在市场中的人来说，每条新闻都引出同一个问题：我应该先转为现金，等风波过去吗？预警可能是对的，此时现金避免了亏损；也可能是误报，此时投资者持有现金而市场持续上涨，之后还得决定何时买回。FINRA 关于市场择时的指引提醒，在下跌后卖出的投资者“很可能会错过随后的复苏和反弹”。因此，择时策略需要两个决定都正确：何时离场，以及何时回来。

24cc601ed07d31cb3704e474ec80e2469f4b966c.src: In a non-registered account, the form of a fund’s return matters as much as its size. Interest is taxed fully every year, eligible Canadian dividends receive a credit, realized gains are half included, and unrealized gains wait until a sale. A TFSA removes the difference. None of this makes a fund tax-exempt or its returns certain.
24cc601ed07d31cb3704e474ec80e2469f4b966c.zh: 在非注册账户中，基金回报的形式与回报的大小同样重要。利息每年全额征税，合格加拿大股息可获得抵免，已实现收益按一半计入，未实现收益则等到出售时才征税。TFSA 消除了这些差异。但这些都不会让基金本身免税，也不会让其回报变得确定。

645ed6b9457be7a625c50ca4134366f138b356eb.src: In the lowest brackets the dividend credits can exceed the tax on the grossed-up amount. With 14% federal and Ontario’s 5.05%, the model shows a negative dividend rate of about −8.24%: each CAD 100 of eligible dividends reduces tax on other income by about CAD 8.24. The credits are non-refundable, so that only works if there is other tax to reduce. The gross-up also raises net income, which can increase the OAS recovery tax or reduce income-tested benefits; the OAS recovery guide shows how that clawback is calculated. Use your own province’s Form 428 rates before drawing a conclusion.
645ed6b9457be7a625c50ca4134366f138b356eb.zh: 在最低税级，股息抵免可能超过加计后金额的税款。在联邦 14% 加安大略省 5.05% 的情况下，模型显示股息税率约为 −8.24%：每 100 加元合格股息可减少其他收入的税款约 8.24 加元。这些抵免不可退还，因此只有在有其他税款可抵减时才有效。加计还会提高净收入，可能增加 OAS 回收税或减少与收入挂钩的福利；OAS 回收指南说明了这项回收如何计算。下结论前，请使用你所在省份 Form 428 的税率。

f8c21c4795edd1401d30755c4689a186d3da99f1.src: The correct warnings are generous: the cash period begins just before the crash year, so the investor avoids the whole fall. Real warnings are rarely so precise. An investor who moved to cash a year too early, or returned a year too late, would do worse than the model shows.
f8c21c4795edd1401d30755c4689a186d3da99f1.zh: 模型对正确预警相当宽松：持有现金的时段恰好在崩盘年份之前开始，因此投资者避开了整个跌幅。现实中的预警很少如此精准。早一年转为现金或晚一年回来的投资者，结果会比模型显示的更差。

a70a154b3a8c27a95901825bd14896425be15aa8.src: The dividend credit is designed to account for tax already paid by the corporation. It applies to dividends from taxable Canadian corporations; foreign dividends are taxed like interest and may have foreign tax withheld.
a70a154b3a8c27a95901825bd14896425be15aa8.zh: 股息抵免旨在考虑公司已缴纳的税款。它适用于来自应税加拿大公司的股息；外国股息像利息一样征税，并可能被预扣外国税。

ac7b45a07e2e03ce064652c759d4ceff2a69a116.src: The ending values do not depend on the order of the episodes. Growth multiplies year by year, so the same set of years gives the same result in any sequence. The chart’s order is arranged only for display.
ac7b45a07e2e03ce064652c759d4ceff2a69a116.zh: 期末价值不取决于各阶段的顺序。增长逐年相乘，因此同一组年份无论顺序如何，结果都相同。图表中的顺序仅为展示而安排。

a4a430af4833d60c02d9570df60e0d40c58bf4fd.src: The episode chart shows why. Each correct warning left the cash holder about 12.1% ahead of the invested path over that two-year episode: two years of cash at 2.5% against a 25% fall followed by a 25% rebound. Each false alarm left them about 6.5% behind: two years of cash against two ordinary 6% years. Four small losses outweighed two larger gains. The unwarned crash hit both investors equally; no signal catches every fall.
a4a430af4833d60c02d9570df60e0d40c58bf4fd.zh: 阶段图表显示了原因。每次正确预警使持有现金的人在该两年阶段中领先投资路径约 12.1%：两年 2.5% 的现金，对比 25% 的下跌加 25% 的反弹。每次误报则使其落后约 6.5%：两年现金对比两个 6% 的普通年份。四次小损失超过了两次较大的收益。没有预警的崩盘对两位投资者的影响相同；没有任何信号能捕捉每一次下跌。

d3d2761b21313e4c8792ab737e140b33d2006490.src: The first chart shows the tax on CAD 100 of each kind of income at the default combined marginal rate of 29.65%: the 2026 federal rate of 20.5% on income from CAD 58,523 to CAD 117,045, plus Ontario’s 9.15% second-bracket rate, both from CRA’s 2026 rate table. These defaults are an example, not a recommendation of a province or a description of your bracket.
d3d2761b21313e4c8792ab737e140b33d2006490.zh: 第一个图表显示了在默认综合边际税率 29.65% 下，每 100 加元各类收入的税款：2026 年联邦对 58,523 至 117,045 加元收入适用的 20.5% 税率，加上安大略省第二税级 9.15% 的税率，均来自 CRA 的 2026 年税率表。这些默认值只是示例，并非推荐某个省份，也不代表你的税级。

6c4a6144b513833f2c7fc2eb62f1e2d683c6b6f2.src: The heatmap repeats the 20-year comparison for pre-tax returns from 3% to 8%. At 3%, the interest fund keeps about 2.11% a year and the TFSA 3%. At 8%, the interest fund keeps about 5.63% and the TFSA 8%. The tax drag in percentage points grows with the return, because tax takes a share of every dollar of income.
6c4a6144b513833f2c7fc2eb62f1e2d683c6b6f2.zh: 热力图对 3% 至 8% 的税前回报重复 20 年的比较。在 3% 时，利息基金每年保留约 2.11%，TFSA 为 3%。在 8% 时，利息基金保留约 5.63%，TFSA 为 8%。以百分点计的税负拖累随回报增加，因为税款按每一元收入的一定比例征收。

fc0b3ac0b3f3b4567c672371d5e00ad8eaffe445.src: The heatmap shows what drives the break-even rate:
fc0b3ac0b3f3b4567c672371d5e00ad8eaffe445.zh: 热力图显示了影响盈亏平衡率的因素：

c23e64a2c14e8da3c2a51fef0bc0f42b2100f6d7.src: The line crosses zero at about 37% of warnings being right. That share is a property of the signal, which is not known in advance and can change over time.
c23e64a2c14e8da3c2a51fef0bc0f42b2100f6d7.zh: 当约 37% 的预警正确时，曲线穿过零点。这个比例是信号本身的特性，事先无法得知，而且可能随时间变化。

ac0c9d28128d11c9a07527e58fa23ed253b4101c.src: The model treats the hit rate as known. In practice it is the unknown that matters most. A signal that looked accurate in past data may have been fitted to those few episodes; markets and economies change; and crash warnings are often clustered, so an investor who acts on one may already be in cash when the next arrives. The OSC’s GetSmarterAboutMoney site cautions that trying to time the market often leads to losses when prices drop and opportunity costs when they rise, and that selling in a downturn locks in losses. Staying invested is not a promise of recovery by any date, and a long recovery can test even a patient investor.
ac0c9d28128d11c9a07527e58fa23ed253b4101c.zh: 模型把命中率当作已知。实际上，它正是最重要的未知数。在过去数据中看似准确的信号，可能只是拟合了那寥寥几次事件；市场和经济会变化；崩盘预警也常常扎堆出现，因此根据一次预警行动的投资者，在下一次预警到来时可能早已持有现金。OSC 的 GetSmarterAboutMoney 网站提醒，试图择时往往在价格下跌时造成亏损、在价格上涨时造成机会成本，而在下跌中卖出会锁定亏损。持续投资并不保证在任何日期前恢复，漫长的复苏也会考验最有耐心的投资者。

285e51658c182f3919699891922604f77b992f90.src: The third chart reconciles each bar to the TFSA value. For the interest fund, about CAD 27,103 went to yearly tax and about CAD 18,946 is growth those tax payments would have earned had they stayed invested. The low-turnover fund pays no yearly tax and loses no compounding; its whole cost, about CAD 16,360, falls due at the sale. That is why deferral matters: the tax is not smaller in rate, but the money stays at work longer.
285e51658c182f3919699891922604f77b992f90.zh: 第三个图表将每根柱与 TFSA 价值对账。对于利息基金，约 27,103 加元用于每年缴税，另有约 18,946 加元是这些税款若留在账户中本可赚取的增长。低周转基金不缴年税，也不损失复利；其全部税负约 16,360 加元，在出售时到期。这就是递延的意义：税率并没有更低，但资金留在账户中工作的时间更长。

9eb1ca405663cfc35074fcefd75f9750064fe39c.src: This guide holds the pre-tax return fixed and changes only its form. That separates two questions that are often blurred: how much a fund earns, which nobody knows in advance, and how the account and the type of income are taxed, which follows published rules. A fund is never tax-exempt on its own; the tax result belongs to the account and the investor.
9eb1ca405663cfc35074fcefd75f9750064fe39c.zh: 本指南固定税前回报，只改变其形式。这样可以区分两个常被混淆的问题：基金能赚多少，这没有人事先知道；以及账户和收入类型如何征税，这遵循已公布的规则。基金本身从来不免税；税务结果取决于账户和投资者。

15513172b1904175525e90f167a1ea4ed815fe9e.src: This guide prices those two outcomes with one simple, editable model. It does not ask whether a crash will happen; it asks how accurate a warning would have to be for acting on it to beat staying invested.
15513172b1904175525e90f167a1ea4ed815fe9e.zh: 本指南用一个简单、可编辑的模型为这两种结果定价。它不问崩盘是否会发生，而是问预警需要多准确，根据它行动才能胜过持续投资。

b96c5d9fecf548dcc6439c3898b46099e54249c6.src: Use registered room where it fits. A TFSA removes the tax difference between income types; an RRSP defers tax but taxes withdrawals as ordinary income, so dividends and gains lose their lower rates there. The RRSP and TFSA timing guide compares the two.
b96c5d9fecf548dcc6439c3898b46099e54249c6.zh: 在适合时使用注册账户额度。TFSA 消除了不同收入类型之间的税务差异；RRSP 递延税款，但提取时按普通收入征税，因此股息和收益在其中失去较低的税率。RRSP 与 TFSA 时机指南比较了两者。

21a4b88a89fa937d73d573f39926e1b65831a381.src: A couple is tested together. The couple threshold is higher, but it applies to combined income, so a partner’s raise can reduce the benefit. If both spouses are beneficiaries, each benefit falls by 10 cents per dollar, and the household still loses 20 cents. A spouse granted a filing waiver (for example a partner not resident in Canada, or a separation for reasons the person cannot control) is calculated as single since the September 2026 amendments.
21a4b88a89fa937d73d573f39926e1b65831a381.zh: 夫妇合并审查。夫妇的收入门槛较高，但适用于合计收入，因此伴侣加薪也可能减少福利。如果夫妇双方都是受益人，每人的福利按每 1 美元减少 10 分，家庭合计仍减少 20 分。获准豁免配偶报税要求的人（例如伴侣不是加拿大居民，或因本人无法控制的原因分居）自 2026 年 9 月修订起按单身计算。

efaf8617ac9348a0de142c50ebee5ec5d3c2c5b7.src: A one-time CAD 150 supplemental amount was paid from 17 September 2026 to people who received the benefit between July 2025 and June 2026. People who became eligible from July 2026, or who received a new DTC certificate, are to be paid in a second phase in winter 2027. It is paid automatically for each qualifying DTC certificate.
efaf8617ac9348a0de142c50ebee5ec5d3c2c5b7.zh: 一次性 150 加元补充金额自 2026 年 9 月 17 日起支付给在 2025 年 7 月至 2026 年 6 月期间领取过福利的人。自 2026 年 7 月起符合资格的人，或新获得 DTC 证明的人，将在 2027 年冬季的第二阶段获付。每份符合条件的 DTC 证明都会自动支付一次。

63ac88aecd8f7cbf1a547acbd38f95bc49c4b468.src: Count the whole stack. In the phase-out range the CDB’s 20% sits on top of income tax, payroll contributions and other income-tested benefits such as the Canada workers benefit and its disability supplement, the Canada Groceries and Essentials Benefit and provincial programs. Provinces and territories set their own treatment of the CDB in social assistance; check your program before counting the benefit as extra cash.
63ac88aecd8f7cbf1a547acbd38f95bc49c4b468.zh: 把各项叠加起来看。在递减区间内，CDB 的 20% 是叠加在所得税、工资供款以及其他按收入审查的福利之上的，例如加拿大工人福利及其残疾补充、加拿大食品杂货与生活必需品福利和各省项目。各省和地区自行决定社会救助如何对待 CDB；把这笔福利算作额外现金之前，请先核实你所在的项目。

8617833cec9a84458e247cad0bf24cb95c5d5090.src: Earnings are treated more gently than other income. Below the exemption cap a dollar of wages or self-employment income costs no CDB; above it, it costs the same as other income. The extra-income chart shows that difference.
8617833cec9a84458e247cad0bf24cb95c5d5090.zh: 工作收入比其他收入受到更宽松的对待。在豁免上限以内，每 1 美元工资或自雇收入不会减少 CDB；超过上限后，它与其他收入的影响相同。新增收入图表显示了这一差异。

ca857182a4e0c1338f61bc3dd07ad7a42c4b41d6.src: File every year, on time. Both spouses’ returns are a condition of eligibility, even with no income.
ca857182a4e0c1338f61bc3dd07ad7a42c4b41d6.zh: 每年按时报税。即使没有收入，夫妇双方报税也是领取资格的条件。

a29e0f0a15ecbecad7ac20f8dccd0649e1dce026.src: Monthly, on the third Thursday. The Government of Canada calendar lists 16 July, 20 August, 17 September, 15 October, 19 November and 17 December 2026. The same rule gives 21 January, 18 February, 18 March, 15 April, 20 May and 17 June 2027; those dates were not yet published when reviewed.
a29e0f0a15ecbecad7ac20f8dccd0649e1dce026.zh: 每月第三个星期四发放。加拿大政府日历列出了 2026 年 7 月 16 日、8 月 20 日、9 月 17 日、10 月 15 日、11 月 19 日和 12 月 17 日。按同一规则推算，2027 年为 1 月 21 日、2 月 18 日、3 月 18 日、4 月 15 日、5 月 20 日和 6 月 17 日；查阅时这些日期尚未公布。

82894d72ebabf0a35c552a5b7b94e426898ecdd0.src: Pausing is final for that period. ESDC says that if you pause or stop payments you cannot later request back payments for that time.
82894d72ebabf0a35c552a5b7b94e426898ecdd0.zh: 暂停后该期间不能补发。ESDC 表示，如果你暂停或停止领取，之后不能为该期间申请补发。

6fa578fc926c92460958edc0d0413b8921a124fb.src: RDSP withdrawals are excluded. Disability assistance payments from an RDSP are subtracted in adjusted family net income, so they do not reduce the CDB. RRSP and RRIF withdrawals are fully included, so the calendar year in which they are taken decides which payment period they reduce.
6fa578fc926c92460958edc0d0413b8921a124fb.zh: RDSP 提款不计入。RDSP 的残疾援助款会从调整后家庭净收入中扣除，因此不会减少 CDB。RRSP 和 RRIF 提款则全额计入，所以提款所在的日历年决定了它会减少哪个支付期的福利。

40c05c5e1d26aeac9fda983f54469edd9a203442.src: Small amounts are paid at once. If the monthly amount is CAD 20 or less (CAD 240 or less for the year), the whole period is paid as one lump sum on the next payment date.
40c05c5e1d26aeac9fda983f54469edd9a203442.zh: 小额款项一次付清。如果每月金额不超过 20 加元（全年不超过 240 加元），整个期间的款项会在下一个付款日一次付清。

c85a6a83a53cefb8aea18e491f41013a5734c54c.src: The 2025 return fixes the year. Income earned or withdrawn in 2026 affects the July 2027–June 2028 period, whose amounts have not been published. A reassessment of 2025, or a change in marital status, can change the current amount.
c85a6a83a53cefb8aea18e491f41013a5734c54c.zh: 2025 年报税表决定全年金额。2026 年赚取或提取的收入影响的是 2027 年 7 月至 2028 年 6 月的支付期，该期金额尚未公布。对 2025 年的重新评税或婚姻状况变化可能改变当前金额。

97c9458762d46812668e81b0e19e1f576f5025d3.src: The model’s default is a single person with CAD 36,000 of 2025 income: CAD 8,000 from a part-time job and CAD 28,000 from other sources such as a CPP disability benefit. All CAD 8,000 of earnings is exempt, so CAD 36,000 − 8,000 − 23,483 = CAD 4,517 is above the threshold. The reduction is CAD 903.40 a year and the benefit is (2,450.40 − 903.40) ÷ 12 = CAD 128.92 a month, or CAD 1,547.04 for the year.
97c9458762d46812668e81b0e19e1f576f5025d3.zh: 模型的默认情景是一位 2025 年收入 36,000 加元的单身人士：8,000 加元来自兼职工作，28,000 加元来自 CPP 残疾福利等其他来源。8,000 加元工作收入全部豁免，因此 36,000 − 8,000 − 23,483 = 4,517 加元超过门槛。每年减少 903.40 加元，福利为（2,450.40 − 903.40）÷ 12 = 每月 128.92 加元，全年 1,547.04 加元。

f934ef8de7b7e208655d89bc7d93e606e92cc344.src: A worked guide to the federal Canada Disability Benefit for July 2026 to June 2027: the regulation formula, the indexed CAD 204.20 monthly maximum and CAD 10,210 and 14,294 working-income exemptions, the derived income thresholds, why earnings and other income are treated differently, the third-Thursday payment calendar and what a couple’s combined income does. Five charts and an editable model.
f934ef8de7b7e208655d89bc7d93e606e92cc344.zh: 一份关于 2026 年 7 月至 2027 年 6 月联邦加拿大残疾福利金的计算指南：法规公式、经指数调整的每月最高 204.20 加元，以及 10,210 加元和 14,294 加元的工作收入豁免额、推算的收入门槛、为何工作收入与其他收入的处理不同、每月第三个星期四的付款日历，以及夫妇合计收入的影响。包含五张图表和一个可编辑模型。

95f28fc7c944f3c6306958f82a57529b2d3df152.src: Every published 2026–27 figure is exactly 1.021 times its 2024 value, which matches Statistics Canada’s rounded 2.1% annual-average CPI increase for 2025. The unrounded index levels, 164.2 for 2025 and 160.9 for 2024, give 1.02051 instead, which would mean CAD 204.10 a month and a CAD 10,205 exemption. This guide uses 1.021 because it reproduces what ESDC publishes. The model lets you change the factor. Treat the derived thresholds as estimates until ESDC publishes them; its online estimator and examples were still on 2025–26 figures when this guide was reviewed.
95f28fc7c944f3c6306958f82a57529b2d3df152.zh: 每个已公布的 2026–27 数字都正好是其 2024 年数值的 1.021 倍，与加拿大统计局四舍五入后 2025 年年平均 CPI 上升 2.1% 相符。若使用未四舍五入的指数水平——2025 年 164.2、2024 年 160.9——系数则为 1.02051，相当于每月 204.10 加元和 10,205 加元的豁免额。本指南采用 1.021，因为它能重现 ESDC 公布的数字。模型允许你更改该系数。在 ESDC 公布之前，请把推算的门槛视为估计值；查阅本指南时，其在线估算工具和示例仍使用 2025–26 年度数字。

4182730ef5b995840deacdf4c03cfbd04eebb845.src: For Dan in 2026–27: CAD 35,000 − 10,210 exempt − 23,483 threshold = CAD 1,307; 20% of that is a CAD 261.40 annual reduction; (CAD 2,450.40 − 261.40) ÷ 12 = CAD 182.42. 4182730ef5b995840deacdf4c03cfbd04eebb845.zh: Dan 在 2026–27 年度：35,000 加元 − 10,210 豁免 − 23,483 门槛 = 1,307 加元；其 20% 即每年减少 261.40 加元；（2,450.40 − 261.40 加元）÷ 12 = 182.42 加元。由于豁免额和门槛也上调了，指数调整使他每月增加的金额超过 4.20 加元。

5387054841dea1c60a282413b23b1d7347cadb9b.src: For July 2026 to June 2027 the benefit pays up to CAD 204.20 a month, based on 2025 adjusted family net income. Up to CAD 10,210 of working income (CAD 14,294 for a couple) is ignored; income above an indexed threshold then reduces the benefit by 20 cents per dollar, or 10 cents for each spouse when both receive it. A dollar of wages inside the exemption costs nothing; a dollar of CPP disability or pension income above the threshold costs 20 cents.
5387054841dea1c60a282413b23b1d7347cadb9b.zh: 2026 年 7 月至 2027 年 6 月，这项福利每月最高 204.20 加元，依据 2025 年调整后家庭净收入计算。最多 10,210 加元的工作收入（夫妇为 14,294 加元）不予计算；超过经指数调整门槛的收入，每 1 美元会使福利减少 20 分，夫妇双方都领取时每人减少 10 分。豁免额以内的 1 美元工资不会减少福利；超过门槛的 1 美元 CPP 残疾福利或养老金收入会减少 20 分。

8fb03b118fa279344dda328705fc22d0453b326b.src: Original calculation for: Single (or spousal waiver). The full amount is paid until income after the working-income exemption passes the indexed threshold (derived CAD 23,483); the gap between the lines is the exemption of up to CAD 10,210, which only working income can use.
8fb03b118fa279344dda328705fc22d0453b326b.zh: 原创计算，适用于：单身（或获配偶报税豁免）。在扣除工作收入豁免额后的收入超过经指数调整的门槛（推算为 23,483 加元）之前，福利按全额支付；线条之间的差距就是最多 10,210 加元的豁免额，只有工作收入可以使用。

ecbc74aa7f7cfecd079abf65062e9fdb9e6ef659.src: Original calculation from the entered household. Working income below the exemption cap (CAD 10,210) costs nothing; after that both kinds of income cost the same 20 cents per dollar until the benefit reaches zero. RDSP payments are subtracted from adjusted family net income, so they are not on either line. Income tax and other income-tested benefits are not included.

5ec102e2cf1ae3d733af56e1b2d994358da574f8.src: Original illustration of the federal Canada Disability Benefit (CDB) allocation for the payment period July 2026 to June 2027, based on 2025 adjusted family net income (line 23600 for you and any cohabiting spouse or partner, less RDSP and UCCB income). It applies section 6 of the Canada Disability Benefit Regulations: CAD 2,400, the CAD 10,000 or 14,000 working-income exemption and the CAD 23,000 or 32,500 threshold are each multiplied by the indexing factor you enter (default 1.021); the income above the threshold is reduced at 20%, or 10% for each spouse when both are beneficiaries; the monthly amount is rounded to the cent and an amount of CAD 20 or less a month is paid as one lump sum. ESDC publishes the 2026–27 maximum (CAD 204.20 a month) and exemptions (CAD 10,210 and 14,294) but not the indexed thresholds, so the thresholds here are derived. Eligibility (age 18–64, an approved Disability Tax Credit, filed 2025 returns, residence and status) is assumed. The one-time CAD 150 supplemental amount, provincial or territorial benefits, mid-year changes in marital status and retroactive payments are not modelled.

bfcbb8ef8ea57cc2aa7b253a2422829a4801627e.src: A lagging replacement. If the new fund returns half a point a year less, switching ends about CAD 2,990 behind after 10 years. A difference in fees alone can do that.
bfcbb8ef8ea57cc2aa7b253a2422829a4801627e.zh: 替代基金表现落后。如果新基金每年少赚半个百分点，10 年后转换的结果约落后 2,990 加元。仅费用差异就可能造成这种情况。

503f3fededccccb5bdc82ce70aca29cac1311575.zh: 债券收益：40,000 加元的 1.5% 增加 600 加元。

28e7e67be8019614d2f093d5cdc9f9fa03e473ee.src: Bond prices: 7 × 2 points = 14% of CAD 40,000, a loss of CAD 5,600. The bond sleeve returns about −12.5%, almost the same as stocks.
28e7e67be8019614d2f093d5cdc9f9fa03e473ee.zh: 债券价格：7 × 2 个百分点 = 40,000 加元的 14%，即亏损 5,600 加元。债券部分回报约为 −12.5%，几乎与股票相同。

56e3bf84e2fdc7f96b7b98a55157127dc0c1e781.src: Check the 61-day window. Look 30 days back and plan 30 days ahead for purchases of the same fund by you, your spouse, a corporation you control and your registered plans, including pre-authorized contributions and automatic reinvestment of distributions.
56e3bf84e2fdc7f96b7b98a55157127dc0c1e781.zh: 检查 61 天窗口。回看过去 30 天并规划未来 30 天，留意你本人、你的配偶、你控制的公司以及你的注册计划是否购买同一基金，包括预授权供款和分派自动再投资。

c450659b4b715b87aba2b3dcbba9252f5e2bcbb4.src: Check the mix against the loss you can live through. The risk-profile stress test turns a stock share into dollars. Choosing a lower-risk mix once, deliberately, differs from switching to cash after a bad year, which the crash-warning guide tests.
c450659b4b715b87aba2b3dcbba9252f5e2bcbb4.zh: 对照你能承受的亏损检查资产配置。风险画像压力测试把股票比例换算成金额。经过深思熟虑后一次性选择风险较低的配置，不同于在糟糕的一年后转为现金；后者由崩盘预警指南进行检验。

21e7fd54f3f4488eb97d60142eee803906a055e6.src: Confirm the ACB. Include reinvested distributions and subtract any return of capital; the fund cost-base guide shows how. An understated ACB understates the loss.
21e7fd54f3f4488eb97d60142eee803906a055e6.zh: 确认调整后成本基础（ACB）。计入再投资的分派，并减去任何资本返还；基金成本基础指南说明了做法。低估 ACB 会低估亏损。

53a11936f37ef11181723a5b54eba9895917d339.src: Costs. A 2% cost to sell and buy, from spreads, commissions or a remaining deferred sales charge on an older fund purchase, reduces the advantage to about CAD 82.
53a11936f37ef11181723a5b54eba9895917d339.zh: 成本。买卖成本为 2% 时（来自买卖价差、佣金或较早购买的基金仍需支付的递延销售费），优势降至约 82 加元。

23e30d25a12a12d95bdc49ceae8372ffe89a0818.src: Do not move a losing fund into a TFSA in kind. A transfer in kind is a sale at market value, and a loss on property transferred to a TFSA is denied; the in-kind contribution guide shows the arithmetic. Selling in the non-registered account and contributing cash is the usual alternative.
23e30d25a12a12d95bdc49ceae8372ffe89a0818.zh: 不要以实物方式把亏损的基金转入 TFSA。实物转移按市值视为出售，而转入 TFSA 的财产所产生的亏损会被拒绝；实物供款指南展示了计算过程。通常的替代做法是在非注册账户中卖出，再以现金供款。

51419d13fce8e0ba1e7aebf0e1526003b1a5d67a.src: Inflation: the fund ends the year at CAD 87,800, a −12.2% return, but after 6.3% inflation that buys what about CAD 82,596 bought at the start. The real loss is about 17.4%.
51419d13fce8e0ba1e7aebf0e1526003b1a5d67a.zh: 通胀：基金在年末为 87,800 加元，回报为 −12.2%，但在 6.3% 的通胀之后，它只能买到年初约 82,596 加元能买到的东西。实际亏损约为 17.4%。

bae1a58995395a35b8d649c6640d466d3694985b.src: Keep contributions and a lump-sum decision separate. Regular contributions from your paycheque can continue throughout; the decision here concerns only the existing non-registered units.
bae1a58995395a35b8d649c6640d466d3694985b.zh: 把供款与一次性资金的决定分开。来自工资的定期供款可以一直持续；这里的决定只涉及现有的非注册账户单位。

146f0b4bd9267193db87bad8465638dcc6635e5d.src: Keep contributions going from your paycheque. New money invested after a rate rise buys bonds at the higher yield and stocks at lower prices; FINRA describes dollar-cost averaging as a way to reduce the impact of a decline on purchases, without protecting money already invested. Moving an existing lump sum into the fund in stages is a different decision, compared in the phased-investing guide.
146f0b4bd9267193db87bad8465638dcc6635e5d.zh: 继续从工资中供款。加息后投入的新资金以更高收益率买入债券、以更低价格买入股票；FINRA 将定额定投描述为减少下跌对买入影响的一种方式，但它不能保护已经投入的资金。把现有的一笔资金分阶段投入基金是另一个决定，分阶段投资指南对此进行了比较。

534db7da2d2f65484f9269a128cdc22542ee9a55.src: Keep the account rules separate from the fund. A balanced fund in a TFSA or RRSP has no tax on its rebalancing; the same fund in a non-registered account distributes taxable income and gains. The account changes the tax, not the market risk.
534db7da2d2f65484f9269a128cdc22542ee9a55.zh: 把账户规则与基金分开看。TFSA 或 RRSP 中的平衡基金在再平衡时不产生税款；同一基金放在非注册账户中则会分派应税收入和收益。账户改变的是税，而不是市场风险。

0237cac1598ea39b88ae2ff0dd359f0eaee87220.src: Know what the loss will offset. Gains this year and in the three previous years produce a saving now; otherwise the loss waits for future gains. The carryback guide charts which years are eligible and the request form CRA uses.
0237cac1598ea39b88ae2ff0dd359f0eaee87220.zh: 弄清亏损能抵销什么。本年度及前三年的收益可以带来即时的节税；否则亏损要等待未来的收益。亏损追溯指南用图表说明哪些年份符合条件，以及 CRA 使用的申请表。

373d9035e6c39a796c2452c5f75ba4790bfe252d.src: Let the investment plan lead. A tax loss is a by-product of a fall, not a reason to change the portfolio’s risk. Selling in a crash and staying in cash is a market-timing decision with its own costs, tested in the crash-warning guide.
373d9035e6c39a796c2452c5f75ba4790bfe252d.zh: 让投资计划主导。税务亏损是下跌的副产品，不是改变投资组合风险的理由。在崩盘中卖出并持有现金是一个择时决定，有其自身成本，崩盘预警指南对此进行了检验。

50d4a1d3afd9a505c8319a0f673b2c9221f236c6.src: Look at the bond sleeve’s duration. Fund Facts and the fund’s reports describe the bond holdings. A longer duration means a larger price fall when yields rise, and a larger benefit when they fall.
50d4a1d3afd9a505c8319a0f673b2c9221f236c6.zh: 查看债券部分的久期。基金概要（Fund Facts）和基金报告会说明债券持仓。久期越长，收益率上升时价格跌幅越大，收益率下降时得益也越大。

206e94ed2cd09d53bb92042fdda70e8fda4c17cb.src: No gains to offset. With no gains in the current or three previous years, nothing is saved now; the switch costs about CAD 306 in the default case, and the carried-forward loss only shelters later gains.
206e94ed2cd09d53bb92042fdda70e8fda4c17cb.zh: 没有可抵销的收益。如果本年度和前三年都没有收益，现在就节省不了任何税；在默认情况下，转换约花费 306 加元，而结转的亏损只能为以后的收益提供抵销。

f52c2f070ce1265762ea09d919651d77495acd5a.src: Separate the money by when it is needed. Spending planned within a few years belongs in savings or short-term deposits whose value does not depend on bond prices. Money for goals ten or more years away can usually ride out the shock year described here.
f52c2f070ce1265762ea09d919651d77495acd5a.zh: 按用钱的时间把资金分开。计划在几年内使用的开支应放在储蓄或短期存款中，其价值不取决于债券价格。用于十年或更久之后目标的资金，通常可以熬过这里描述的冲击年份。

d5f9ea8e4b86841c7c29c9ba728b1f463a35c754.src: Stocks: 12% of CAD 60,000 is a loss of CAD 7,200.
d5f9ea8e4b86841c7c29c9ba728b1f463a35c754.zh: 股票：60,000 加元的 12% 即亏损 7,200 加元。

ff946c57f73edf0b2b1721f798917c3ca84a3973.src: A $100,000 fund holds 60% stocks and 40% bonds, rebalanced each year-end. In the shock year stocks fall 12% and bond yields rise 2 percentage points from 1.5%, so a bond sleeve with 7 years of duration returns about -12.5% (yield less duration × rise). Afterwards stocks return 6% and bonds earn the new 3.5% yield each year. Inflation is 6.3% in the shock year and 2.5% later. Fees are assumed to be inside the returns; tax, contributions and withdrawals are not modeled. Every return is a hypothetical input, not a forecast or the record of any fund.
ff946c57f73edf0b2b1721f798917c3ca84a3973.zh: 一只 $100,000 的基金持有 60% 股票和 40% 债券，每年年末再平衡。在冲击年份，股票下跌 12%，债券收益率从 1.5% 上升 2 个百分点，因此久期为 7 年的债券部分回报约为 -12.5%（收益率减去久期 × 升幅）。此后股票每年回报 6%，债券每年获得新的 3.5% 收益率。冲击年份通胀为 6.3%，之后为 2.5%。假设费用已包含在回报中；不模拟税款、供款和提款。所有回报都是假设输入，不是预测，也不是任何基金的业绩记录。

ed7b345d40ec1317de852d76c155f34ab9716cd2.src: A balanced fund holds stocks and bonds together so that a bad year for one is softened by the other. Most of the time that works: when stocks fall because the economy weakens, interest rates often fall too, and bond prices rise. The Ontario Securities Commission’s investor site notes the limit of that idea: diversification provides reasonable protection in normal markets but becomes less effective in extreme conditions, when the prices of most investments can drop together.
ed7b345d40ec1317de852d76c155f34ab9716cd2.zh: 平衡基金同时持有股票和债券，使其中一类资产的糟糕年份被另一类缓和。大多数时候这样做是有效的：当股票因经济走弱而下跌时，利率往往也会下降，债券价格随之上涨。安大略省证券委员会的投资者网站指出了这一想法的局限：分散投资在正常市场中能提供合理保护，但在极端情况下效果减弱，因为大多数投资的价格可能一起下跌。

581ca437b25e7d5ee8a8a0ee2482211f1fd9cdef.src: A checklist before selling for a loss
581ca437b25e7d5ee8a8a0ee2482211f1fd9cdef.zh: 为亏损而卖出前的检查清单

ea672d0f3c45f826602ead39515f09c4e370d46d.src: A different kind of bad year arrives when inflation is the problem. Central banks raise rates to slow prices, bond yields rise, and the prices of bonds already held fall at the same time as stocks. For a balanced-fund investor this year can feel worse than a larger stock crash, because the part of the portfolio that was supposed to be safe is also down, and the money that remains buys less.
ea672d0f3c45f826602ead39515f09c4e370d46d.zh: 另一种糟糕的年份出现在通胀成为问题的时候。央行加息以抑制物价，债券收益率上升，已持有债券的价格与股票同时下跌。对平衡基金投资者来说，这一年可能比一次更大的股市崩盘更难受，因为本应安全的部分也在下跌，而剩下的钱能买到的东西更少。

4b63149e516b87b36d0eba8b254941f2947f689b.src: A paper loss can have a tax value, but only if it is realized correctly
4b63149e516b87b36d0eba8b254941f2947f689b.zh: 账面亏损可能有税务价值，但前提是正确地实现它

c2819dc509580257d3cd9553fd2d7736824e3d2c.src: Added to the cost base of the repurchased units
c2819dc509580257d3cd9553fd2d7736824e3d2c.zh: 加入回购单位的成本基础

2b068d589a8cc82efab40c4c63c64e99180a3517.src: Adjusted cost base of the fund units (CAD)
2b068d589a8cc82efab40c4c63c64e99180a3517.zh: 基金单位的调整后成本基础（加元）

bc85fe38e41bf9f7a75a3dabf9da8d9c3fa735f3.src: After a market fall, a fund held in a non-registered account may be worth less than its adjusted cost base (ACB), the total paid for the units including reinvested distributions. That difference is only a paper loss until the units are sold. Selling them realizes a capital loss. Half of it is an allowable capital loss, which CRA says must first be applied against taxable capital gains of the same year; any remainder becomes a net capital loss that can reduce taxable capital gains in any of the three previous years or any future year.
bc85fe38e41bf9f7a75a3dabf9da8d9c3fa735f3.zh: 市场下跌后，非注册账户中持有的基金价值可能低于其调整后成本基础（ACB），即为这些单位支付的总额，包括再投资的分派。在卖出之前，这一差额只是账面亏损。卖出单位会实现资本亏损。其中一半是可扣除资本亏损；CRA 表示必须先用它抵销同一年度的应税资本收益，剩余部分成为净资本亏损，可以减少前三年中任何一年或未来任何一年的应税资本收益。

f9a745b611606c2e75c93fc06df8d36de3f7da40.src: Bonds usually cushion a stock decline, but when inflation forces interest rates up, bond prices can fall at the same time. The same higher yields then raise the bond sleeve’s later income, so the damage is partly repaid over roughly the bond fund’s duration. Purchasing power, not the nominal balance, is the measure that recovers last.
f9a745b611606c2e75c93fc06df8d36de3f7da40.zh: 债券通常能缓冲股市下跌，但当通胀迫使利率上升时，债券价格可能同时下跌。同样更高的收益率随后会提高债券部分日后的收益，因此损失会在大约相当于债券基金久期的时间内部分偿还。最后恢复的是购买力，而不是名义余额。

c98b19ddc207610c8b4e20c8b2cb712a5ae9ddd6.src: Both nominal paths share the same stock returns. The yield rise costs the fund $5,600 in the shock year, but afterwards its bonds earn 3.5% instead of 1.5%. It catches up with the no-rise path by year 10; the bond sleeve’s duration is a rough guide to that catch-up time. In start-year dollars the fund is back to $100,000 in year 9.
c98b19ddc207610c8b4e20c8b2cb712a5ae9ddd6.zh: 两条名义路径的股票回报相同。收益率上升在冲击年份让基金损失 $5,600，但此后其债券获得 3.5% 而不是 1.5% 的收益。它在第 10 年赶上没有加息的路径；债券部分的久期可以粗略说明追赶所需的时间。以起始年份购买力计，基金在第 9 年回到 $100,000。

0c1568cef6ee304cf832ddd359451b3885dc9fb6.src: Break a balanced fund’s bad year into its stock loss, bond income, bond price fall and lost purchasing power, then follow how a higher bond yield works afterwards and how long the real value takes to come back.
0c1568cef6ee304cf832ddd359451b3885dc9fb6.zh: 把平衡基金的糟糕年份拆分为股票亏损、债券收益、债券价格下跌和购买力损失，然后观察更高的债券收益率此后如何发挥作用，以及实际价值需要多长时间才能恢复。

58ed49e87fcafb2d8deb74695541736c802f5505.src: CRA describes a superficial loss as a loss on a sale where both of these are true:
58ed49e87fcafb2d8deb74695541736c802f5505.zh: CRA 将表面亏损描述为出售时同时满足以下两项条件的亏损：

01f81a2e7bc9262a426b7303bb70c6f325ac0b59.src: CRA lists a spouse or common-law partner, and a corporation controlled by you or your spouse, among affiliated persons. A superficial loss cannot be deducted. If you are the person who acquires the substituted property, you can usually add the denied loss to its ACB, which lowers the gain or raises the loss when that property is sold later.
01f81a2e7bc9262a426b7303bb70c6f325ac0b59.zh: CRA 列出的关联人士包括配偶或同居伴侣，以及由你或你的配偶控制的公司。表面亏损不能扣除。如果你是取得替代财产的人，通常可以把被拒绝的亏损加入该财产的 ACB；日后出售该财产时，这会减少收益或增加亏损。

c8952a62d271c974844e58e9481303b3e7996763.src: CRA treats a loss as superficial when you or an affiliated person, such as a spouse, buy the same or identical property in the 30 calendar days before or after the sale and still hold it 30 days after. A superficial loss cannot be deducted. When you are the buyer you can usually add it to the cost base of the new units, which only postpones the benefit. When the substituted property is bought in a registered plan, the loss is generally denied without a cost-base addition you can use. Confirm a specific case with a tax professional.
c8952a62d271c974844e58e9481303b3e7996763.zh: 如果你或关联人士（例如配偶）在出售前后 30 个日历日内购买相同或同一的财产，并在出售 30 天后仍然持有，CRA 会将该亏损视为表面亏损。表面亏损不能扣除。如果买方是你本人，通常可以把它加入新单位的成本基础，这只是推迟了好处。如果替代财产是在注册计划中购买的，亏损通常会被拒绝，而且没有你可以使用的成本基础增加。具体情况请向税务专业人士确认。

70e988d05e811861dd84560483aa8ab058cb56e2.src: In the default case, units bought for CAD 100,000 are worth CAD 75,000. Selling realizes a CAD 25,000 loss. CAD 20,000 offsets other gains taxed at a 40% marginal rate, so half of it, CAD 10,000, comes off taxable income and saves CAD 4,000. The remaining CAD 5,000 is carried forward. The proceeds, less a 0.25% switching cost, plus the CAD 4,000 saving, buy a different fund. Both funds then return 6% a year for 10 years.
70e988d05e811861dd84560483aa8ab058cb56e2.zh: 在默认情况下，以 100,000 加元买入的单位现值 75,000 加元。卖出实现 25,000 加元的亏损。其中 20,000 加元抵销按 40% 边际税率征税的其他收益，因此其中一半，即 10,000 加元，从应税收入中扣除，节省 4,000 加元。剩余的 5,000 加元结转。出售所得扣除 0.25% 的转换成本，加上 4,000 加元的节税额，用于买入另一只基金。之后两只基金在 10 年内每年回报 6%。

7a65a6a8199762997008533e72f2646280884144.src: Selling a fund at a loss in a non-registered account can turn a paper loss into a tax saving now, but it lowers the cost base of the replacement and raises tax at the final sale. The benefit is mostly timing, it depends on gains to offset and on future tax rates, and it disappears if the same fund is bought back within 30 days.
7a65a6a8199762997008533e72f2646280884144.zh: 在非注册账户中亏本卖出基金，可以把账面亏损变成现在的节税，但会降低替代基金的成本基础，并提高最终出售时的税款。这一好处主要在于时间安排，取决于是否有可抵销的收益以及未来税率；如果在 30 天内买回同一基金，好处就会消失。

1cfaa007533cee3043bb0845a469ee45cf95aecb.src: Selling at a loss mostly moves tax in time: it lowers tax now and raises the gain, and the tax, at the final sale. The net result is a gain of $2,225. It grows with the years the saving compounds and with a lower tax rate at the final sale; it shrinks or turns negative with a higher later rate, higher switching costs or a replacement fund that lags.
1cfaa007533cee3043bb0845a469ee45cf95aecb.zh: 亏本卖出主要是把税款在时间上移动：它降低现在的税款，提高最终出售时的收益和税款。净结果为增加 $2,225。节税额复利增长的年数越长、最终出售时税率越低，它就越大；以后税率越高、转换成本越高或替代基金表现落后，它就会缩小甚至变为负数。

fbbd43157a74eb4a784667e7d4b56b86c799a784.zh: 测试平衡基金在股票下跌、债券收益率上升和通胀跳升的一年中的表现

cced775e8364d20faeaa0956006e4550a39cff73.src: The catch-up time is close to the bond sleeve’s duration, which is no coincidence: duration is also roughly the holding period over which a yield change’s price effect and its income effect balance out. The bond reinvestment guide shows that mechanism for a single bond. Two caveats matter. The model holds the new yield constant, while real yields keep moving. And it gives every duration the same yield, while longer bonds often, but not always, pay more; a short-duration bond fund is not simply a better version of a long one.
cced775e8364d20faeaa0956006e4550a39cff73.zh: 追赶时间接近债券部分的久期，这并非巧合：久期也大致是收益率变化的价格效应与收益效应相互抵消所需的持有期。债券再投资指南以单只债券展示了这一机制。有两点需要注意。模型假设新的收益率保持不变，而现实中的收益率会持续变动。模型还给所有久期相同的收益率，而较长期的债券往往（但并非总是）收益更高；短久期债券基金并不只是长久期基金的更好版本。

0c313046e8dfc0e36a7073edb16048a7b87f98a9.src: The default fund starts at CAD 100,000 with 60% in stocks and 40% in bonds. In the shock year stocks fall 12%. Bond yields start at 1.5% and rise by 2 percentage points, and the bond sleeve has a duration of 7 years. Duration is a measure of interest-rate sensitivity: a bond fund with a duration of 7 loses roughly 7% of its value for each 1-point rise in yields. Inflation is 6.3% in the shock year.
0c313046e8dfc0e36a7073edb16048a7b87f98a9.zh: 默认基金以 100,000 加元起步，60% 为股票，40% 为债券。在冲击年份，股票下跌 12%。债券收益率从 1.5% 起步并上升 2 个百分点，债券部分的久期为 7 年。久期是衡量利率敏感度的指标：久期为 7 的债券基金，收益率每上升 1 个百分点，价值大约下降 7%。冲击年份的通胀为 6.3%。

654f5e721b4810b91c14a6789f1813be78b290c2.src: The first chart plots three dated series for Canada. Consumer price inflation, measured by Statistics Canada as the 12-month change in the all-items CPI, rose from 4.8% in December 2021 to a peak of 8.1% in June 2022. The Bank of Canada raised its target for the overnight rate from 0.25% in early 2022 to 4.25% by December 2022 and 5% by July 2023. The Government of Canada 10-year benchmark bond yield ended December 2021 at 1.42% and December 2022 at 3.30%, a rise of almost two percentage points in one year.
654f5e721b4810b91c14a6789f1813be78b290c2.zh: 第一张图表绘制了加拿大的三组有日期的数据。加拿大统计局以全项目 CPI 的 12 个月变化衡量的消费者价格通胀，从 2021 年 12 月的 4.8% 升至 2022 年 6 月 8.1% 的峰值。加拿大央行把隔夜利率目标从 2022 年初的 0.25% 上调至 2022 年 12 月的 4.25%，并在 2023 年 7 月达到 5%。加拿大政府 10 年期基准债券收益率在 2021 年 12 月底为 1.42%，在 2022 年 12 月底为 3.30%，一年内上升了将近两个百分点。

c35a942b900988ea9828712d7fdc884563288c76.src: The first chart sorts a CAD 25,000 loss into what happens under four choices. Selling and buying a different fund lets CAD 20,000 offset available gains now, with CAD 5,000 carried forward. Rebuying the same fund within 30 days moves the whole loss into the new units’ cost base, so the benefit is postponed, not lost. Buying the same fund inside your TFSA or RRSP is the trap: the loss is generally denied, and the cost-base addition belongs to the registered plan, where it does you no good. Reinvested distributions inside the window, including automatic reinvestment in the fund being sold, can also count as purchases. When in doubt, have a tax professional review the specific transactions.
c35a942b900988ea9828712d7fdc884563288c76.zh: 第一张图表把 25,000 加元的亏损在四种选择下的去向进行分类。卖出并买入另一只基金，可以让 20,000 加元现在就抵销可用收益，另有 5,000 加元结转。在 30 天内买回同一基金，会把全部亏损转入新单位的成本基础，因此好处是被推迟，而不是失去。在你的 TFSA 或 RRSP 中买入同一基金是一个陷阱：亏损通常会被拒绝，而成本基础的增加属于注册计划，对你没有帮助。窗口期内的再投资分派，包括被卖出基金的自动再投资，也可能算作购买。如有疑问，请让税务专业人士审核具体交易。

466d797ca50afa05e3a6ae577306d6799db078a4.src: The fund ends the shock year at $87,800 in nominal dollars, a -12.2% return. In this example the bonds lose 12.5%, so they add to the fall instead of offsetting it. After 6.3% inflation, the year-end value buys what $82,596 bought at the start.
466d797ca50afa05e3a6ae577306d6799db078a4.zh: 基金在冲击年份年末的名义价值为 $87,800，回报为 -12.2%。在这个例子中，债券亏损 12.5%，因此它们加剧了下跌，而不是抵消下跌。在 6.3% 的通胀之后，年末价值只能买到年初 $82,596 能买到的东西。

c61afbed8a5fbe67bd17e7c8a0403fb4f0a05fba.src: The heatmap repeats the calculation for stock shares from 20% to 100% and stock falls from 0% to 40%, keeping the entered rate rise and inflation. Two patterns stand out:
c61afbed8a5fbe67bd17e7c8a0403fb4f0a05fba.zh: 热力图对 20% 至 100% 的股票比例和 0% 至 40% 的股票跌幅重复这一计算，保持输入的加息幅度和通胀不变。有两个规律值得注意：

da1e78892edbe1f1ed5079d3e293ce2d9ec68b41.src: The heatmap varies the years until the final sale and the marginal rate at that sale. With a 20% rate at the sale, for example in a low-income retirement year, switching ends about CAD 4,526 ahead after 10 years. With a 50% rate, about CAD 1,074. The pattern is not always smooth: after 5 years with a 50% rate at the sale, switching is about CAD 220 behind, because the held fund is barely above its old cost base while the replacement already has a taxable gain beyond the carried-forward loss.
da1e78892edbe1f1ed5079d3e293ce2d9ec68b41.zh: 热力图改变距最终出售的年数和最终出售时的边际税率。如果出售时税率为 20%（例如在低收入的退休年份），10 年后转换约领先 4,526 加元。如果税率为 50%，约领先 1,074 加元。这一规律并不总是平滑的：在 5 年后、出售时税率为 50% 的情况下，转换约落后 220 加元，因为继续持有的基金仅略高于其原来的成本基础，而替代基金在扣除结转亏损之后已经产生了应税收益。

7ee3e7ec549aba1f08df2ac8b5aaac97e9ab204a.src: The loss on bonds from rising yields has a second side. After the shock, the bond sleeve earns 3.5% a year instead of 1.5%. In the third chart, the fund that went through the rate rise trails the no-rise version by CAD 5,600 after year one, then closes the gap each year and passes it in year 10. After 15 years it is worth about CAD 173,838 against about CAD 166,148 for the fund whose yields never rose.
7ee3e7ec549aba1f08df2ac8b5aaac97e9ab204a.zh: 收益率上升造成的债券亏损还有另一面。冲击之后，债券部分每年获得 3.5%，而不是 1.5%。在第三张图表中，经历加息的基金在第一年后比没有加息的版本落后 5,600 加元，然后每年缩小差距，并在第 10 年超过它。15 年后，它价值约 173,838 加元，而收益率从未上升的基金约为 166,148 加元。

d5b73379a2eb20af012bcf0155181515f67a29d5.src: The model assumes the tax saving is reinvested immediately. In practice it arrives as a refund or a smaller balance owing after the return is filed, which can be more than a year later. It also assumes one combined marginal rate; a large final sale can push income into a higher bracket.
d5b73379a2eb20af012bcf0155181515f67a29d5.zh: 模型假设节省的税款立即再投资。实际上，它会在报税后以退税或减少应缴余额的形式到来，可能要一年多以后。模型还假设单一的综合边际税率；大额的最终出售可能会把收入推入更高的税级。

bedf3824bcce9baf58d420212387cb2a85d0024e.src: The real concern for most savers is not the nominal balance but what it will buy. In the default case the fund is back above CAD 100,000 in nominal terms in year 4, but in start-year dollars it regains CAD 100,000 only in year 9. After 15 years it is worth about CAD 115,738 in start-year dollars. Inflation in the shock year is a permanent step up in the price level: prices do not fall back when inflation slows, they just rise more slowly, as the inflation and purchasing power guide explains.
bedf3824bcce9baf58d420212387cb2a85d0024e.zh: 对大多数储蓄者来说，真正的关切不是名义余额，而是它能买到什么。在默认情况下，基金在第 4 年按名义计回到 100,000 加元以上，但以起始年份购买力计，直到第 9 年才回到 100,000 加元。15 年后，以起始年份购买力计约为 115,738 加元。冲击年份的通胀是价格水平的永久性抬升：通胀放缓时价格不会回落，只是上涨得更慢，通胀与购买力指南对此有说明。

9b636b4811ec6fa8ce55f63256088fb9fb3dfee0.src: The replacement also needs to fit the plan. If the point is to stay invested in a similar mix, the new fund should hold a comparable asset mix and risk level. A switch that changes the portfolio’s risk is an investment decision, not just a tax step. The fund-switch break-even guide covers the reverse case, a switch that realizes a gain.
9b636b4811ec6fa8ce55f63256088fb9fb3dfee0.zh: 替代基金也需要符合计划。如果目的是继续投资于类似的组合，新基金应持有可比的资产配置和风险水平。改变投资组合风险的转换是一个投资决定，而不只是一个税务步骤。基金转换盈亏平衡指南涵盖了相反的情况，即实现收益的转换。

f6b2dbf06990f82d414147081bb436508ecff111.src: The rule turns on whether the replacement is identical property. Units of the same ETF or the same mutual fund are identical property. Whether a different series of the same fund, or another provider’s fund tracking the same index, is identical is less clear-cut and calls for professional judgement. Funds with different mandates from different providers are generally treated as different property. This guide does not decide that question; it measures what is at stake once it has been answered.
f6b2dbf06990f82d414147081bb436508ecff111.zh: 这条规则取决于替代品是否属于同一财产。同一 ETF 或同一共同基金的单位属于同一财产。同一基金的不同系列，或另一家提供商跟踪同一指数的基金是否属于同一财产，则不那么明确，需要专业判断。来自不同提供商、投资目标不同的基金，通常被视为不同的财产。本指南不判断这个问题；它衡量的是在得出答案后，有多少利害关系。

0dd3964f932d33607f09297c54d3e01577d39bc0.src: Units bought for $100,000 are worth $75,000. Selling realizes a $25,000 capital loss; half of it is an allowable loss. $20,000 offsets available gains at a 40% marginal rate, saving $4,000, and $5,000 is carried forward to the final sale. The proceeds less a 0.25% switching cost, plus the tax saving, buy a different fund that returns 6% a year, against 6% for the original. Both holdings are sold after 10 years, with half of any gain taxed at 40%. A loss still unused at the final sale is given no value. Returns and tax rates are hypothetical inputs; this is not a personal tax calculation.
0dd3964f932d33607f09297c54d3e01577d39bc0.zh: 以 $100,000 买入的单位现值 $75,000。卖出实现 $25,000 的资本亏损；其中一半是可扣除亏损。$20,000 按 40% 的边际税率抵销可用收益，节省 $4,000，另有 $5,000 结转至最终出售。出售所得扣除 0.25% 的转换成本，加上节税额，用于买入另一只每年回报 6% 的基金，原基金为 6%。两项持仓都在 10 年后卖出，任何收益的一半按 40% 征税。最终出售时仍未使用的亏损不计任何价值。回报和税率都是假设输入；这不是个人税务计算。

a002df5e0459abeaf7c0ab564062a3406a69fd9b.zh: 净收入高于此数时，门槛固定为 2,890 加元$96,333.33低于此数时，门槛为申报人净收入的 3%

8389773e76d3dd83cbcd7cb5868877663bd1cd6a.src: Calendar years: 2026 claim CAD 2,250 − 780 + 1,530 dependant = CAD 3,000, credit CAD 420; 2027 claim CAD 2,250 − 780 = CAD 1,470, credit CAD 205.80. Total CAD 625.80.
8389773e76d3dd83cbcd7cb5868877663bd1cd6a.zh: 按日历年：2026 年申报 2,250 − 780 + 1,530（受抚养人）= 3,000 加元，抵免 420 加元；2027 年申报 2,250 − 780 = 1,470 加元，抵免 205.80 加元。合计625.80 加元。

d74284f9b7a76d2dcabaa98fa0a6959ad1ee6cc6.src: Claim dependants separately. An adult child or parent with low income has a small threshold of their own.
d74284f9b7a76d2dcabaa98fa0a6959ad1ee6cc6.zh: 受抚养人分开计算。低收入的成年子女或父母有自己较小的门槛。

b19012eec0cd84174802d54ead72a282c05d8a8e.src: Keep receipts and plan statements. Claim only the part not reimbursed by an insurer or employer plan, and include your own share of private health plan premiums.
b19012eec0cd84174802d54ead72a282c05d8a8e.zh: 保存收据和保险计划结算单。只申报未获保险公司或雇主计划报销的部分，并计入你自己负担的私人医疗计划保费。

0d88548ca624a098d13dc3d1417d850a479dc8d4.src: One window, May 2026 to April 2027, claimed on the 2027 return: CAD 4,500 − 780 + 1,530 = CAD 5,250, credit CAD 735.
0d88548ca624a098d13dc3d1417d850a479dc8d4.zh: 一个期间：2026 年 5 月至 2027 年 4 月，在 2027 年报税表申报：4,500 − 780 + 1,530 = 5,250 加元，抵免735 加元。

6fe7b8acfca88824f6719df1fe6f967a2741434c.src: Pick the window. Look at the last 24 months of receipts and choose the 12-month period ending this year that holds the most unclaimed expenses.

f26875213615f7087136986a4a5d2f3b5d66822e.src: Remember what does not carry. An unused non-refundable credit is not transferable to the other spouse and does not carry forward, but expenses never claimed can still fall in next year’s window.
f26875213615f7087136986a4a5d2f3b5d66822e.zh: 记住哪些不能结转。未用完的不可退还抵免不能转给另一位配偶，也不能结转到以后年度；但从未申报过的费用仍可落入下一年的期间。

a8aa0d51bc8a44d8bfc11d261e2aa641be32365d.src: The model’s default is that couple. Person A has CAD 70,000 of employment income; Person B has CAD 26,000 of net income, CAD 20,000 of it from employment. They paid CAD 4,500 of eligible family expenses and CAD 1,800 for an adult child with CAD 9,000 of net income.
a8aa0d51bc8a44d8bfc11d261e2aa641be32365d.zh: 模型默认情景就是这对夫妇。A 有 70,000 加元受雇收入；B 的净收入为 26,000 加元，其中 20,000 加元来自受雇。他们支付了 4,500 加元符合条件的家庭医疗费用，以及为一名净收入 9,000 加元的成年子女支付的 1,800 加元。

998726720c23202fb58c18ba22f30b799870d88d.src: Try each spouse. Compare the federal value for each, counting the supplement and the tax actually left to absorb the credit; add the provincial credit, which has its own threshold and rate.
998726720c23202fb58c18ba22f30b799870d88d.zh: 两位配偶都试算。比较各自的联邦价值，计入补助以及实际剩余、可以吸收抵免的税额；再加上省级抵免，省级有自己的门槛和税率。

4d44ea3ceacff22f08a420938499a86048bfe586.src: A CAD 150,000 employment; B no income; CAD 4,500 expenses
4d44ea3ceacff22f08a420938499a86048bfe586.zh: A 受雇收入 150,000 加元；B 无收入；费用 4,500 加元

9ff0b138ae61f7c5ef9ad6eeda3593391e42386b.src: A CAD 40,000 employment; B CAD 12,000 net, CAD 6,000 employment; CAD 6,000 expenses
9ff0b138ae61f7c5ef9ad6eeda3593391e42386b.zh: A 受雇收入 40,000 加元；B 净收入 12,000 加元，其中受雇收入 6,000 加元；费用 6,000 加元

947a68c9b0882bf0a747ca244c8346ed80c2a003.src: A non-refundable credit only reduces tax that would otherwise be payable. If the lower-income spouse owes little or no federal tax, the lower threshold does not help, and the unused medical credit cannot be transferred to the other spouse or carried forward. (Unclaimed expenses can sometimes be claimed in a later year if they fall in a 12-month window ending in that year, but not ones already claimed.)
947a68c9b0882bf0a747ca244c8346ed80c2a003.zh: 不可退还抵免只能减少本来要缴的税。如果收入较低的配偶几乎不用或完全不用缴联邦税，较低的门槛就帮不上忙，而未用完的医疗抵免既不能转给另一位配偶，也不能结转。（从未申报过的费用，如果落在截至以后某年的 12 个月期间内，有时可以在那一年申报；已申报过的则不行。）

58b8c9b9232db85163001c3778a2ea29b1970a32.src: A worked guide to the 2026 federal medical expense tax credit: the lesser-of-3%-or-CAD-2,890 threshold, why the lower-income spouse usually claims and when that advice fails, choosing the 12-month period, separate claims for adult dependants, the refundable medical expense supplement and CRA statistics on who claims. Six charts and an editable model.
58b8c9b9232db85163001c3778a2ea29b1970a32.zh: 2026 年联邦医疗费用税收抵免详解：取 3% 或 2,890 加元中较低者的门槛、为什么通常由收入较低的配偶申报以及这个建议何时失效、如何选择 12 个月期间、成年受抚养人的单独申报、可退还医疗费用补助，以及 CRA 关于申报人群的统计。六张图表和一个可编辑模型。

40fbf3d02156625f4b6917122615ebace914dfd9.zh: 净收入低于 96,333.33 加元时，门槛是收入的 3%；高于此数时，门槛固定为 2,890 加元。把申报从收入 70,000 加元的配偶（门槛 2,100 加元）改为收入 26,000 加元的配偶（门槛 780 加元），可申报费用增加 1,320 加元，联邦抵免增加 184.80 加元。

85eefecac5743aa13699e991d3f380549d9e2ed3.src: Family net income is the claimant’s plus their spouse’s, so the reduction is the same whichever spouse claims; what changes is the claimant’s allowable amount and whether that claimant meets the working-income minimum. For a single person with CAD 18,000 of net income (CAD 9,000 from work) and CAD 3,000 of expenses, the allowable amount is CAD 2,460, the supplement is CAD 615 and the non-refundable credit is wasted because no federal tax is owed. With no working income, as for many retirees, there would be no supplement either.

3b73154d9622dacc7669f6eb4a862381b75300d1.src: In the default, the adult child’s CAD 9,000 of income gives a CAD 270 threshold, so CAD 1,530 of the CAD 1,800 counts. Either spouse can include it, and it is added to the claimant’s line 33200, so it also enlarges the base for the supplement.
3b73154d9622dacc7669f6eb4a862381b75300d1.zh: 在默认情景中，成年子女 9,000 加元的收入对应 270 加元门槛，所以 1,800 加元中有 1,530 加元可计入。任何一位配偶都可以把它计入，它会加到申报人的第 33200 行，因此也扩大了补助的计算基数。

9eb68e2d26a25c7cc7d85589741a58e6dc3ce998.src: In the first case Person B’s threshold is lower (CAD 360), but B has no federal tax left after the basic personal amount, so B could only collect the refundable supplement. Person A uses the whole CAD 672 credit and also qualifies for a smaller supplement, because the supplement depends on family net income, which is the same whoever claims. In the second case the spouse with no income cannot use any of the credit. The test is simple: compare the federal value, including the supplement, for each spouse. Tax software does this if you try both.
9eb68e2d26a25c7cc7d85589741a58e6dc3ce998.zh: 在第一个例子中，B 的门槛较低（360 加元），但扣除基本个人免税额后 B 已没有联邦税，所以 B 只能领取可退还补助。A 能用尽 672 加元抵免，还能领取较少的补助，因为补助取决于家庭净收入，无论谁申报都一样。在第二个例子中，没有收入的配偶完全用不上这项抵免。检验方法很简单：比较每位配偶的联邦价值（包括补助）。报税软件在你两种都试算时会替你比较。
