f258193e5a664c5dd407e35e65eaf0f331b77c52.src: Original illustration of the 2026 federal medical expense tax credit (METC) and refundable medical expense supplement (RMES) for hypothetical households. Expenses on line 33099 are reduced by the lesser of 3% of the claimant’s net income and CAD 2,890; line 33199 expenses for another dependant are reduced by the lesser of 3% of that dependant’s net income and CAD 2,890. The total (line 33200) earns a 14% non-refundable federal credit, usable only against federal tax left after the basic personal amount, Canada employment amount and base CPP and EI credits, which are calculated from the employment income entered with 2026 payroll parameters (taxable income is taken to equal net income). The supplement is the lesser of CAD 1,534 and 25% of line 33200, reduced by 5% of family net income above CAD 33,960, for a claimant with at least CAD 4,478 of working income. Provincial and territorial credits, the disability supports deduction, other credits (age, pension, tuition, disability, donations), the top-up tax credit and Quebec abatement are left out, and all expenses are assumed to be eligible and receipted.
f258193e5a664c5dd407e35e65eaf0f331b77c52.zh: 针对假设家庭的 2026 年联邦医疗费用税收抵免（METC）和可退还医疗费用补助（RMES）原创示例。第 33099 行的费用要减去“申报人净收入的 3%”与“2,890 加元”中较低者；为其他受抚养人支付的第 33199 行费用要减去“该受抚养人净收入的 3%”与“2,890 加元”中较低者。合计（第 33200 行）可获 14% 的不可退还联邦抵免，但只能抵减扣除基本个人免税额、加拿大就业额以及 CPP 和 EI 基本抵免后剩余的联邦税；这些抵免按所输入的受雇收入和 2026 年工资参数计算（应税收入视同净收入）。补助为 1,534 加元与第 33200 行 25% 两者中较低者，再按家庭净收入超过 33,960 加元部分的 5% 扣减，申报人须至少有 4,478 加元工作收入。省和地区抵免、残疾支援扣除、其他抵免（年龄、退休金、学费、残疾、捐款）、补足抵免和魁北克减免均未计入，并假设所有费用均合资格且有收据。

e2b50bf6beb342ef7b8ada9300be0749d45daf4e.src: The 2026 amounts are CRA’s published figures, indexed by 2.0%. The 14% rate follows the cut in the lowest federal rate from 15% (14.5% for 2025 as a whole). The two “at which” rows are derived: CAD 2,890 ÷ 3% and CAD 33,960 + 1,534 ÷ 5%; the 2025 supplement end point matches the CAD 63,374 limit CRA publishes.
e2b50bf6beb342ef7b8ada9300be0749d45daf4e.zh: 2026 年金额为 CRA 公布的数字，按 2.0% 指数化。14% 的税率来自联邦最低税率由 15% 下调（2025 全年为 14.5%）。两行“达到……时”的数字是推算的：2,890 加元 ÷ 3%，以及 33,960 加元 + 1,534 ÷ 5%；推算出的 2025 年补助终点与 CRA 公布的 63,374 加元上限一致。

4dec3e180089063bf27effda570513a0111531b9.src: The claim rate peaks at about 30% of returns in the CAD 30,000–50,000 ranges and falls at higher incomes, where the fixed threshold (CAD 2,759 for 2024) applies and couples tend to claim on the lower-income spouse’s return. These are counts of returns, not households, and the averages are allowable amounts after the threshold, not total spending. The pattern is descriptive and does not show why people do or do not claim.
4dec3e180089063bf27effda570513a0111531b9.zh: 申报比例在 30,000–50,000 加元区间达到约 30% 的峰值，在较高收入区间下降；那里适用固定门槛（2024 年为 2,759 加元），而且夫妇往往在收入较低配偶的报税表上申报。这些是报税表份数，而非家庭数；平均值是扣除门槛后的可申报金额，而非总支出。这一规律只是描述性的，并不能说明人们为何申报或不申报。

9226652b5fbc983d6feb86d9caf7a8f8f4879da0.src: The difference, CAD 109.20, is one threshold (CAD 780) at 14%. The cost is waiting a year to claim the 2026 bills, and the 2026 bills cannot also be claimed in 2026. When one year’s share is below the threshold, splitting can lose its credit entirely; the window chart shows this across splits. The model keeps both years at 2026 incomes and amounts; in practice the 2027 threshold and rate may differ.
9226652b5fbc983d6feb86d9caf7a8f8f4879da0.zh: 差额 109.20 加元，正是一个门槛（780 加元）乘以 14%。代价是 2026 年的账单要晚一年申报，而且这些 2026 年账单不能同时在 2026 年申报。若某一年的部分低于门槛，分开申报可能使该部分完全得不到抵免；期间图表展示了不同拆分比例下的结果。模型两年都采用 2026 年的收入和金额；实际上 2027 年的门槛和税率可能不同。

3d9ec1ab3c793920ecd7d708051f612b21fe7bc0.src: The medical expense tax credit (METC) is a non-refundable federal credit for eligible medical expenses paid by you or your spouse or common-law partner. It reduces federal tax payable; it cannot create a refund on its own. Every province and territory has its own version with its own rate and threshold.
3d9ec1ab3c793920ecd7d708051f612b21fe7bc0.zh: 医疗费用税收抵免（METC）是一项不可退还的联邦抵免，适用于你或你的配偶或同居伴侣支付的合资格医疗费用。它减少应缴联邦税，本身不能产生退税。每个省和地区都有自己的版本，税率和门槛各不相同。

13818d44d6e3f2d7a416c81e721617d3b4a4d51a.src: The model is federal only and uses 2026 amounts. It estimates federal tax with the 2026 brackets, treats net income as taxable income, and allows only the basic personal amount, Canada employment amount and base CPP and EI credits on the employment income entered (self-employment is treated as employment for these credits). Other credits that would use up tax first, such as the age, pension, disability, tuition and donation credits, are not included, so the tax left may be overstated. It assigns all family and dependant expenses to one claimant, assumes every expense is eligible and unreimbursed, and leaves out provincial and territorial credits, the disability supports deduction, the top-up tax credit and the Quebec abatement. Use tax software or the CRA worksheets for your actual return.
13818d44d6e3f2d7a416c81e721617d3b4a4d51a.zh: 模型只涵盖联邦部分，并使用 2026 年金额。它按 2026 年税级估算联邦税，把净收入视同应税收入，只计入基本个人免税额、加拿大就业额以及按所输入受雇收入计算的 CPP 和 EI 基本抵免（自雇收入在这些抵免中按受雇收入处理）。其他会先用掉税额的抵免，例如年龄、退休金、残疾、学费和捐款抵免，并未计入，因此剩余税额可能被高估。模型把所有家庭和受抚养人费用都分配给同一位申报人，假设每笔费用都合资格且未获报销，并略去省和地区抵免、残疾支援扣除、补足抵免和魁北克减免。实际报税请使用报税软件或 CRA 工作表。

dfe3acf94204e4c3ab147c4b75b5aab005b1d7c4.src: The supplement (line 45200) is refundable: it is paid even if no tax is owed. For 2026 it is the lesser of CAD 1,534 and 25% of the allowable expenses on line 33200 (plus 25% of any disability supports deduction), reduced by 5% of family net income above CAD 33,960. The claimant must be at least 18 at the end of the year, resident in Canada all year, and have at least CAD 4,478 of employment and self-employment income.
dfe3acf94204e4c3ab147c4b75b5aab005b1d7c4.zh: 补助（第 45200 行）是可退还的：即使无需缴税也会发放。2026 年的补助为 1,534 加元与第 33200 行可申报费用 25%（加上任何残疾支援扣除的 25%）两者中较低者，再按家庭净收入超过 33,960 加元部分的 5% 扣减。申报人必须在年底时年满 18 岁、全年居住在加拿大，并有至少 4,478 加元受雇和自雇收入。

bb07abffd2a831a703ff6041be2e5fa4eebd1bfe.src: The threshold is based on the net income of the spouse who claims, not on family income. The CRA page itself notes that it may benefit you if the spouse with the lower net income claims. Either spouse can claim expenses for either of them and for their children, whoever’s name is on the receipt, as long as the same expense is not claimed twice.
bb07abffd2a831a703ff6041be2e5fa4eebd1bfe.zh: 门槛按申报那位配偶的净收入计算，而不是按家庭收入。CRA 页面本身也指出，由净收入较低的配偶申报可能对你有利。无论收据上是谁的名字，任何一位配偶都可以申报两人及其子女的费用，只要同一笔费用不重复申报。

274d859d9f0244d167a6ef5d1743b9966b9ed600.zh: 选择申报人：由联邦税足够的人申报，或在扶养人之间分摊，让每一份申报都能用上。

b39f27a63697c3fc034f70752a7a26edc4bbc932.src: File the dependant’s return, even with little income, so their taxable income and line 98 credits are on record; the transfer is calculated from them.
b39f27a63697c3fc034f70752a7a26edc4bbc932.zh: 为受抚养人报税，即使收入很少也要报，这样其应税收入和第 98 行抵免才有记录；转移额正是据此计算的。

295b0fe0822b475e7c3b678807aee9152c06a889.src: Get the T2201 approved first. Nothing transfers until the CRA approves it; approval can cover past years.
295b0fe0822b475e7c3b678807aee9152c06a889.zh: 先让 T2201 获批。CRA 批准之前什么都转不了；批准可以覆盖以往年度。

59ba750ff406006fa7a62484a07aa5a11f6decee.src: Line 31800, for a dependant who is your (or your spouse’s) parent, grandparent, child, grandchild, brother, sister, aunt, uncle, niece or nephew, or for whom you claimed or could have claimed the eligible dependant amount.
59ba750ff406006fa7a62484a07aa5a11f6decee.zh: 第 31800 行：适用于是您（或您配偶）的父母、祖父母、子女、孙子女、兄弟、姐妹、叔伯姑姨、侄甥的受抚养人，或您已申报或本可申报合资格受抚养人额的受抚养人。

4d6b72d45f89e962322b21299db4e630bed2dc59.src: Line 32600 (Schedule 2), when the person with the disability is your spouse or common-law partner. That route is separate and is not modelled here.
4d6b72d45f89e962322b21299db4e630bed2dc59.zh: 第 32600 行（附表 2）：适用于残疾人士是您的配偶或同居伴侣的情况。这是另一条途径，本模型不涵盖。

6ceb98b16d60092c6e078c5f3eef63bd1eac34ec.src: Remember the province. Provincial credits have their own amounts and rates and transfer through the provincial forms.
6ceb98b16d60092c6e078c5f3eef63bd1eac34ec.zh: 别忘了省级抵免。省级抵免有各自的金额和税率，并通过省级表格转移。

9e1e8464b7312050a16260e0c3b7f6eeb3577948.src: The caregiver amount runs on a separate clock: the full CAD 8,773 until the dependant’s net income passes CAD 20,601, then down a dollar per dollar to zero at CAD 29,374.
9e1e8464b7312050a16260e0c3b7f6eeb3577948.zh: 照顾者额另有一套计算：受抚养人净收入超过 20,601 加元之前为全额 8,773 加元，之后每 1 加元收入减少 1 加元，到 29,374 加元时降为零。

435da46f88ad96ee9968f0dc2412d2a208882624.src: The model’s default is an adult child, 24, with CAD 24,000 of net income, CAD 18,000 of it from a part-time job, supported by a parent with CAD 85,000 of employment income.
435da46f88ad96ee9968f0dc2412d2a208882624.zh: 模型的默认情景是一名 24 岁的成年子女，净收入 24,000 加元，其中 18,000 加元来自兼职工作，由受雇收入 85,000 加元的父母扶养。

8f7701b6436648e3591f0f6edb557c7edcccf160.src: Watch large care bills. Claiming full-time nursing-home or unlimited attendant care as a medical expense rules out the disability amount for that year; compare both routes.
8f7701b6436648e3591f0f6edb557c7edcccf160.zh: 留意高额照护账单。若把全职养老院照护或不设上限的看护费用作为医疗费用申报，当年就不能申报残疾额；请比较两种做法。

e72ff86252f4fc7980b70cd8333f14be8c3fb7bb.src: A child under 18: the supplement and care expenses
e72ff86252f4fc7980b70cd8333f14be8c3fb7bb.zh: 18 岁以下儿童：补充额与照护费用

4d12e94d653b71cdd1490bdaf38cedd4c1d29297.src: A child with no income needs none of it, so the whole amount transfers to the parent approved on the T2201. The caregiver amount on line 30450 is for dependants 18 or older; for an infirm child under 18, a separate CAD 2,740 amount (line 30500) applies and is not modelled here.
4d12e94d653b71cdd1490bdaf38cedd4c1d29297.zh: 没有收入的儿童完全用不上这笔额度，因此全部可以转移给在 T2201 上获批的父母。第 30450 行的照顾者额适用于 18 岁或以上的受抚养人；18 岁以下体弱儿童另有 2,740 加元的额度（第 30500 行），本模型不涵盖。

edfe9e289356899bc947e97a94415816fae89c58.src: A separate rule matters for families paying for care: if full-time care in a nursing home, or attendant care beyond the limited amount, is claimed as a medical expense for the person, nobody can claim the disability amount for them that year. The CRA’s Medical Expenses guide allows attendant-care wages of up to CAD 10,000 (CAD 20,000 in the year of death) alongside the disability amount; families with large care bills should compare both routes.
edfe9e289356899bc947e97a94415816fae89c58.zh: 为照护付费的家庭还要注意一条规则：如果把养老院全职照护费用，或超过限额的看护费用，作为该人的医疗费用申报，当年任何人都不能为其申报残疾额。CRA 的《医疗费用》指南允许在申报残疾额的同时申报最多 10,000 加元的看护工资（去世当年为 20,000 加元）；照护费用高的家庭应比较两种做法。

1530bbb8d463393046d0a8de70ffc93cfde918dd.src: A worked guide to moving the unused 2026 disability amount from a dependant to the parent, child or other relative who supports them: who qualifies, the CRA worksheet that decides how much is left to transfer, the child supplement, the Canada caregiver amount, splitting between supporters, when the supporter has too little tax to use it, and CRA statistics on who claims. Six charts and an editable model.
1530bbb8d463393046d0a8de70ffc93cfde918dd.zh: 一篇实例指南，讲解如何把 2026 年未用完的残疾额从受抚养人转给扶养他们的父母、子女或其他亲属：谁符合资格、决定还剩多少可转移的 CRA 工作表、儿童补充额、加拿大照顾者额、扶养人之间的分摊、扶养人税款太少用不上的情况，以及 CRA 关于谁在申报的统计。六张图表和一个可编辑模型。

7067c00eea877dc80deaf0dd813ffc4b456eda5a.src: Each CAD 1 of transferred amount is worth 14 cents of federal tax to the supporter, if the supporter owes that much. Provincial credits add more at their own rates and amounts.
7067c00eea877dc80deaf0dd813ffc4b456eda5a.zh: 转移额每 1 加元可为扶养人抵减 14 分联邦税，前提是扶养人欠这么多税。省级抵免按各自的税率和金额另有增加。

f501a2efd3de9fa88a5d9b3680ea18b81125b6b8.src: Employment income is held at the lesser of CAD 18,000 and the dependant’s net income. The transfer is complete until the dependant’s income passes their own line 98 credits, then falls dollar for dollar and reaches zero near CAD 29,305. The caregiver amount falls dollar for dollar from CAD 20,601 to CAD 29,374.
f501a2efd3de9fa88a5d9b3680ea18b81125b6b8.zh: 受雇收入取 18,000 加元与受抚养人净收入两者中较低者。在受抚养人收入超过其本人第 98 行抵免之前可全额转移，之后逐元递减，在约 29,305 加元处降为零。照顾者额从 20,601 加元到 29,374 加元逐元递减。

cb38c5869b6bd2c757227a3184f534d226a903c0.src: For 2026 the disability amount is CAD 10,341 (up to CAD 16,373 for a child under 18). A supporting relative can claim only the part the dependant does not need: the lesser of the disability amount and that amount plus the dependant’s basic credits minus their taxable income. An adult dependant with little income may also make the supporter eligible for a Canada caregiver amount of up to CAD 8,773. Both are worth 14% federally, and only against tax the supporter actually owes.
cb38c5869b6bd2c757227a3184f534d226a903c0.zh: 2026 年残疾额为 10,341 加元（18 岁以下儿童最多 16,373 加元）。扶养亲属只能申报受抚养人用不上的部分：即残疾额，与“残疾额加受抚养人基本抵免再减其应税收入”两者中较低者。收入很少的成年受抚养人还可能让扶养人有资格申报最多 8,773 加元的加拿大照顾者额。两者在联邦层面都按 14% 计值，而且只能抵减扶养人实际应缴的税。

0999f368e1c0bed030bc6bf9c691a46c32d90d23.src: For a child under 18 at the end of the year, the disability amount includes a supplement of up to CAD 6,032, reduced by child care and attendant care expenses claimed for the child (by anyone, for example as child care expenses or medical expenses) above CAD 3,533. The total therefore runs from CAD 16,373 down to the CAD 10,341 base once those expenses reach CAD 9,565.
0999f368e1c0bed030bc6bf9c691a46c32d90d23.zh: 对于年底未满 18 岁的儿童，残疾额包括最多 6,032 加元的补充额，但要按为该儿童申报的儿童照护及看护费用（任何人申报的，例如作为儿童照护费用或医疗费用）超过 3,533 加元的部分扣减。因此合计从 16,373 加元逐步降到 10,341 加元的基本额，费用达到 9,565 加元时降至基本额。

8c51b5cd7a4d7f8cfbaec4ce330a881669e57ff2.src: For a child under 18, the parent or guardian approved on the T2201 makes the claim. You cannot claim it if the person’s spouse or common-law partner already claims the disability amount or any other non-refundable credit (other than medical expenses) for them, and generally not if you pay support for that child. Several supporters may split the claim, but together they cannot claim more than the dependant’s maximum, and nobody can split it with a person who claimed the eligible dependant amount for that dependant.
8c51b5cd7a4d7f8cfbaec4ce330a881669e57ff2.zh: 18 岁以下儿童由在 T2201 上获批的父母或监护人申报。如果该人的配偶或同居伴侣已为其申报残疾额或任何其他不可退还抵免（医疗费用除外），您就不能申报；如果您为该子女支付抚养费，一般也不能申报。几位扶养人可以分摊申报，但合计不得超过该受抚养人的上限；若有人为该受抚养人申报了合资格受抚养人额，则任何人都不能与其分摊。

9c3cb8a82ef853c920ef430b0da4a71939d751bd.src: For a dependant with no income at all, the parent can claim CAD 10,341 + CAD 8,773 = CAD 19,114, worth CAD 2,675.96 federally. At CAD 24,000 the dependant uses part of the disability credit themselves, so the family total is CAD 705.02 + CAD 1,495.08 = CAD 2,200.10: less in the parent’s hands, but the dependant also pays no federal tax on CAD 24,000.

a9de09ce1b77ba684f7ed7ba96d6a70df1a2c0b8.src: Original illustration of the 2026 federal disability amount (line 31600) transferred to a supporting person (line 31800), using the 2025 Federal Worksheet chart with 2026 amounts. The transferable part is the lesser of the dependant’s disability amount and that amount plus their line 98 credits minus their taxable income. Line 98 here includes only the basic personal amount, the Canada employment amount and base CPP and EI credits on the employment income entered; age, pension, caregiver, home buyers’ and other amounts the dependant may have are left out, so the transfer may be understated for a dependant with them. For a child under 18 the CAD 6,032 supplement is reduced by child care and attendant care expenses above CAD 3,533. The Canada caregiver amount for an infirm dependant 18 or older is CAD 8,773, reduced by the dependant’s net income above CAD 20,601. Credits are 14% of the amounts and only reduce federal tax the supporter actually owes after their own basic, CPP, EI and employment credits. Provincial and territorial credits, the spouse transfer on Schedule 2 (line 32600), the eligible dependant amount, medical expenses and the attendant-care rules in Guide RC4065 are left out.
a9de09ce1b77ba684f7ed7ba96d6a70df1a2c0b8.zh: 2026 年联邦残疾额（第 31600 行）转移给扶养人（第 31800 行）的原创示例，采用 2025 年联邦工作表的计算方法和 2026 年金额。可转移部分为受抚养人的残疾额，与“残疾额加其第 98 行抵免再减其应税收入”两者中较低者。此处第 98 行只包括基本个人免税额、加拿大就业额，以及按所输入受雇收入计算的 CPP 和 EI 基本抵免；受抚养人可能有的年龄额、养老金额、照顾者额、购房者额等未计入，因此对有这些额度的受抚养人，转移额可能被低估。18 岁以下儿童的 6,032 加元补充额按超过 3,533 加元的儿童照护及看护费用扣减。18 岁或以上体弱受抚养人的加拿大照顾者额为 8,773 加元，按受抚养人净收入超过 20,601 加元的部分扣减。抵免为金额的 14%，且只能抵减扶养人在扣除其本人基本、CPP、EI 及就业抵免后实际应缴的联邦税。省级和地区抵免、附表 2 的配偶转移（第 32600 行）、合资格受抚养人额、医疗费用以及 RC4065 指南中的看护规则均未计入。

a3a281e0bcd0a2e5a2127ae4d60063e524bf724b.src: The CRA’s Federal Worksheet for line 31800 works it out in three steps:

29922602a2f4dfff78298ee429024c5e5670ba46.src: The dependant’s own federal tax before the disability amount is CAD 3,360 − 14% × CAD 18,964.15 = CAD 705.02, which is exactly 14% of the CAD 5,035.85 they keep, so the worksheet leaves them owing nothing federally. The parent has about CAD 10,458 of federal tax left after their own basic credits, enough to use the CAD 1,495.08 in full. In the model, line 98 includes only the basic personal amount and the credits from employment income; a dependant with other amounts would keep less and transfer more.
29922602a2f4dfff78298ee429024c5e5670ba46.zh: 受抚养人在计入残疾额之前的联邦税为 3,360 加元 − 14% × 18,964.15 加元 = 705.02 加元，正好是其保留的 5,035.85 加元的 14%，所以按工作表计算后其联邦税为零。父母扣除自身基本抵免后约有 10,458 加元联邦税，足以全额用上 1,495.08 加元。在模型中，第 98 行只包括基本个人免税额和来自受雇收入的抵免；有其他额度的受抚养人会保留得更少、转移得更多。

7641ba4f1b6d54c257a38f74e77350a783fe1c1e.src: The disability tax credit (DTC) is a non-refundable credit for a person with a severe and prolonged impairment whose Form T2201 has been approved by the CRA. It is claimed on line 31600 of that person’s return. Many people who qualify have little or no taxable income, so the credit would be wasted on their own return. The tax system lets the unused part move to someone who supports them:
7641ba4f1b6d54c257a38f74e77350a783fe1c1e.zh: 残疾税收抵免（DTC）是一项不可退还的抵免，适用于有严重且长期功能障碍、且 T2201 表已获 CRA 批准的人。它在本人报税表的第 31600 行申报。许多符合资格的人应税收入很少或没有，抵免在其本人报税表上会被浪费。税制允许把未用部分转给扶养他们的人：

b5a1915885cfe5ffdf9fad662dfcd024da369141.src: The first chart moves the dependant’s income with everything else fixed. Three ranges matter:
b5a1915885cfe5ffdf9fad662dfcd024da369141.zh: 第一张图只改变受抚养人的收入，其他保持不变。有三个区间值得注意：

42a1f8db48bdb75d9fd7babfb9b0a2ff4a70126b.src: The line 31800 average is above the 2024 base amount (CAD 9,872) because transfers for children include the supplement and one return can include more than one dependant. Measured against all returns in each total-income range, line 31800 claims rise from about 6 per 1,000 returns under CAD 10,000 to about 24 per 1,000 at CAD 150,000–249,999. That pattern fits transfers going to the relative who has tax to reduce, but the table counts returns, not families, and does not show why people claim or not. Counts are rounded to the nearest ten.
42a1f8db48bdb75d9fd7babfb9b0a2ff4a70126b.zh: 第 31800 行的平均数高于 2024 年基本额（9,872 加元），因为儿童的转移额包括补充额，而且一份报税表可以包括不止一名受抚养人。按各总收入区间的全部报税表计算，第 31800 行的申报从收入低于 10,000 加元时每 1,000 份约 6 份，上升到 150,000–249,999 加元时每 1,000 份约 24 份。这一规律与转移额流向有税可抵的亲属相符，但该表统计的是报税表而非家庭，也不说明人们为何申报或不申报。份数四舍五入至最接近的十位。

675b103e07fc44b31991b516136932cdc8379b67.src: The model is federal only and uses 2026 amounts with the structure of the 2025 worksheet. It treats net income as taxable income for both people and includes in the dependant’s line 98 only the basic personal amount, Canada employment amount and base CPP and EI credits on the employment income entered; age, pension, home buyers’ and other amounts are left out. The supporter’s tax is estimated from 2026 brackets after the same basic credits, so other credits that would use up the supporter’s tax first are ignored. It does not model the spouse transfer (Schedule 2), the eligible dependant amount, the line 30500 child amount, medical expenses, the attendant-care choice, provincial credits or the Registered Disability Savings Plan and Canada Disability Benefit, which use DTC eligibility but are separate programs. Use tax software or the CRA worksheets for an actual return.
675b103e07fc44b31991b516136932cdc8379b67.zh: 本模型仅计联邦部分，采用 2026 年金额和 2025 年工作表的结构。两人的应税收入均视同净收入；受抚养人的第 98 行只包括基本个人免税额、加拿大就业额，以及按所输入受雇收入计算的 CPP 和 EI 基本抵免，年龄额、养老金额、购房者额等未计入。扶养人的税款按 2026 年税级扣除同样的基本抵免后估算，因此忽略了会先用掉扶养人税款的其他抵免。模型不涵盖配偶转移（附表 2）、合资格受抚养人额、第 30500 行儿童额、医疗费用、看护费用的取舍、省级抵免，也不涵盖注册残疾储蓄计划（RDSP）和加拿大残疾福利；后两者以 DTC 资格为前提，但属于独立的项目。实际报税请使用报税软件或 CRA 工作表。

acbd335a1030ec0562acbe40ea5ed9fcff375f30.src: The supplement is CAD 6,032 less care expenses above CAD 3,533, so the total runs from CAD 16,373 to the CAD 10,341 base amount once expenses reach CAD 9,565. A child with no income can usually transfer the whole amount to the parent approved on Form T2201.
acbd335a1030ec0562acbe40ea5ed9fcff375f30.zh: 补充额为 6,032 加元减去超过 3,533 加元的照护费用，因此合计从 16,373 加元降到 10,341 加元的基本额，费用达到 9,565 加元时降至基本额。没有收入的儿童通常可以把全部金额转给在 T2201 表上获批的父母。

3b662f71236103edad142016e09442428bdb7f06.src: The supporter needs federal tax of CAD 1,495.08 after their own basic, CPP, EI and employment credits to use the whole credit. Below that, the excess is lost: it cannot go back to the dependant or carry forward.
3b662f71236103edad142016e09442428bdb7f06.zh: 扶养人在扣除自身基本、CPP、EI 及就业抵免后，需要有 1,495.08 加元的联邦税才能用上全部抵免。不足部分会损失：既不能退回给受抚养人，也不能结转。

5d319000048d0d80801409cb21d09ebce84e67dc.src: The transfer moves an amount, not cash. It becomes valuable only if the supporter has federal tax to reduce. In the default, a parent with CAD 20,000 of employment income has only CAD 126.59 of federal tax left after the basic personal amount, Canada employment amount and CPP and EI credits. The CAD 1,495.08 credit would be cut to CAD 126.59 and the other CAD 1,368.49 would be lost: it does not go back to the dependant, and it does not carry forward.
5d319000048d0d80801409cb21d09ebce84e67dc.zh: 转移的是一笔额度，不是现金。只有扶养人有联邦税可抵时它才有价值。在默认情景中，受雇收入 20,000 加元的父母在扣除基本个人免税额、加拿大就业额以及 CPP 和 EI 抵免后，只剩 126.59 加元联邦税。1,495.08 加元的抵免会被削减到 126.59 加元，其余 1,368.49 加元会损失：既不会退回给受抚养人，也不能结转。

544f9c23a079f65c7d914335f39d130de775e7be.zh: 不要忽视市场风险。税单较低并不会让基金更安全。回报并不确定，提款初期的下跌会造成持久损害；提款来源指南说明如何卖出而不偏离既定配置。

e0bcd82fe2d223de207794842155da1b5b8aa169.src: Know which income-tested amounts are affected. Taxable capital gains and fund distributions are part of net income, which income-tested benefits and credits use. The GIS withdrawal-timing guide shows how the source of a withdrawal changes them.
e0bcd82fe2d223de207794842155da1b5b8aa169.zh: 了解哪些按收入审查的金额会受影响。应税资本收益和基金分派都计入净收入，而按收入审查的福利和税收抵免以净收入为准。GIS 提款时机指南说明提款来源如何改变这些金额。

deaaaf6e838ccf75601676a454242923a3a8c897.src: Separate the cash from the tax. Only the gain portion is taxed, but the tax still has to be paid. The sale-proceeds guide earmarks it before spending.
deaaaf6e838ccf75601676a454242923a3a8c897.zh: 把现金和税款分开。只有收益部分要交税，但税款终究要付。出售所得指南在花钱之前先把税款预留出来。

521216cc8ff25cc3de40a6fb2b2fb0a0cae35f29.src: Tax: at a combined 29.65% marginal rate, CAD 889.50. That is 4.9% of the cash redeemed.
521216cc8ff25cc3de40a6fb2b2fb0a0cae35f29.zh: 税款：按 29.65% 的合并边际税率计算，为 889.50 加元，相当于赎回现金的 4.9%。

fb56800a700b3d77f95460733965a04a93a0dd7d.src: Taxable capital gain: half of CAD 6,000, CAD 3,000, is added to income.
fb56800a700b3d77f95460733965a04a93a0dd7d.zh: 应税资本收益：6,000 加元的一半，即 3,000 加元，计入收入。

e649b4c72f7f8d6cdced9333442fd7492734d451.src: The fund was the wrong choice to begin with. If the fall revealed a risk level you cannot live with, change the mix deliberately, for future contributions, rather than stopping and starting with the headlines. The balanced-fund crash guide compares mixes.
e649b4c72f7f8d6cdced9333442fd7492734d451.zh: 这只基金一开始就选错了。如果这次下跌暴露出你无法承受的风险水平，应针对今后的供款有意识地调整配置，而不是随新闻头条时停时续。平衡基金崩盘指南比较了不同配置。

9098b068de5b604d428071f6c129ea6aedbcc49b.src: The money has a near deadline. Savings for a home deposit or tuition within a few years should not depend on a recovery date. The short-term goal guide shows how a loss close to a deadline cannot be waited out.
9098b068de5b604d428071f6c129ea6aedbcc49b.zh: 这笔钱很快就要用。几年内要用的购房首付或学费储蓄，不应寄望于市场何时恢复。短期目标指南说明，临近期限时的亏损无法靠等待弥补。

650077da6e2d0534fda4974c8d3f6b65b776fec3.src: Watch for losses as well as gains. A redemption made while units are below cost realizes a capital loss, which can offset gains under CRA’s rules; this model gives such losses no value. The tax-loss selling guide covers them, including the 30-day rule.
650077da6e2d0534fda4974c8d3f6b65b776fec3.zh: 既要留意收益，也要留意亏损。在单位价格低于成本时赎回会实现资本亏损，可按 CRA 规则抵销收益；本模型不计算这类亏损的价值。税务亏损出售指南对此有说明，包括 30 天规则。

369e31250b5ddcc52c17a55679ee5bb741a99cd6.src: Your income is at risk. If a layoff or a cut in hours is plausible, building an emergency reserve comes first. The income-interruption guide sets a cash floor before contributions resume.
369e31250b5ddcc52c17a55679ee5bb741a99cd6.zh: 你的收入有风险。如果可能被裁员或减少工时，应先建立应急储备。收入中断指南在恢复供款前先设定现金底线。

15b600308855453657d0fced86e999b53e97dc35.src: A $20,000 balance is invested at a market peak and $500 is added at each month-end. The market falls 35% over 18 months, takes 42 more months to regain the old peak, and then grows 6% a year. The paused plan holds contributions in cash at 2.5% until the peak returns, invests that cash in one purchase and then resumes. The path is a hypothetical teaching shape, not the history of any index or fund, and no tax, fee or trading cost is modeled beyond the market path itself.
15b600308855453657d0fced86e999b53e97dc35.zh: 在市场高点投入 $20,000 余额，并在每个月底追加 $500。市场在 18 个月内下跌 35%，再用 42 个月回到原高点，之后每年增长 6%。暂停方案把供款以 2.5% 的利率存为现金，直至市场回到高点，再一次性投入这笔现金，然后恢复供款。这条路径是假设的教学形态，并非任何指数或基金的历史；除市场路径本身外，不计算任何税款、费用或交易成本。

34cbc6e31460bb55924a24f5dc1c69a481057cc4.src: CRA describes two separate ways a mutual fund in a non-registered account is taxed. While you own the units, the distributions the fund pays are taxable each year, even when they are reinvested in more units. When you sell or redeem units, you are taxed on the gain, if any, usually as a capital gain. A redemption therefore has three parts: your own cost coming back, which is not taxed; half of the gain, which is left out of income; and the other half of the gain, which is taxed at your marginal rate.
34cbc6e31460bb55924a24f5dc1c69a481057cc4.zh: CRA 说明，非注册账户中的共同基金有两种不同的征税方式。持有单位期间，基金支付的分派每年都要征税，即使再投资于更多单位也一样。卖出或赎回单位时，你要为收益（如有）纳税，通常作为资本收益。因此，一次赎回由三部分组成：取回自己的成本，不征税；一半收益，不计入收入；另一半收益，按你的边际税率征税。

1b56260006040b7506b709858d852fbcde76d0fb.src: Contributions into a TFSA or RRSP use room that is not otherwise used, and growth inside those accounts is not taxed while it stays there; pausing does not normally lose the room, which carries forward, but cash parked outside the account earns taxable interest. In a non-registered account, every month’s purchase adds to the adjusted cost base, and units bought near the low carry larger future gains, which are taxed only when units are sold. The fund itself does not change its tax treatment; the account’s rules decide it.
1b56260006040b7506b709858d852fbcde76d0fb.zh: 向 TFSA 或 RRSP 供款使用的是原本闲置的额度，而且这些账户内的增长在留存期间不征税；暂停供款通常不会失去额度，额度可以结转，但停放在账户外的现金所赚利息要征税。在非注册账户中，每个月的买入都会增加调整后成本基础，在低点附近买入的单位将来收益更大，但只在卖出单位时才征税。基金本身不会改变其税务处理；决定税务的是账户规则。

e6f9493c016f1928567d110f3487b5104525eec4.src: Contributions made during a fall buy more units, so an account fed from pay can be back above its contributions well before the market regains its old peak. Pausing in cash avoids buying into further losses, but if a recovery comes, it waits for prices to return before buying. Neither choice makes a recovery happen, and money you may need soon should not be in the fund at all.
e6f9493c016f1928567d110f3487b5104525eec4.zh: 下跌期间的供款能买到更多单位，因此靠工资供款的账户可以在市场回到原高点之前很久，就回到供款总额以上。以现金暂停可以避免在继续下跌中买入，但如果市场恢复，它要等到价格回升后才买入。两种选择都不能促成市场恢复，而近期可能要用的钱本来就不应放在基金里。

38f1242cebd98a806ac3bf516dcc2ad635e21335.src: Costs matter too. Check whether your plan charges a commission or fee on each purchase; if it does, many small purchases can cost more than a few larger ones. The fund’s own ongoing fees apply to every dollar invested either way, and are already inside the market path in this model.

These are gains on paper only, and they exist only if the market does recover; the recovery length is an assumption you enter, not a promise.

67312f9baaacf0cac507fe496f409db9f07ffed4.src: Each cell keeps the entered 18-month fall and 42-month recovery, so the market always regains its peak in month 60; only the depth of the fall and the starting balance change. A starting balance is shown as a number of monthly contributions of $500.

b9ccc391cbd0f059831775a7c3f1de520ff68305.src: In year 1, a third of the redemption is gain. By year 20 the redemption has grown to about CAD 26,223 and about 58.5% of it is gain; the tax on that year’s redemption is about CAD 2,274, plus about CAD 415 on that year’s distributions. Over the 20 years, CAD 437,353 is redeemed and total tax is about CAD 50,674: CAD 31,605 on redemption gains and CAD 19,069 on distributions. That is about 11.6% of the cash redeemed, far below the 29.65% that would apply if every dollar were income.

950a7d697b8f03c77491ea6929945aeea9aadd05.src: None of this predicts the next crash or its recovery. The OSC cautions that diversification provides reasonable protection in normal markets but can be less effective in extreme conditions, when most investments fall together, and warns against selling in a downturn. The decision that holds up in most scenarios is less about timing the market and more about making sure each contribution is money you will not need before a recovery could plausibly arrive.
950a7d697b8f03c77491ea6929945aeea9aadd05.zh: 这些都无法预测下一次崩盘或其后的恢复。OSC 提醒，分散投资在正常市场中能提供合理的保护，但在极端情况下大多数投资同时下跌时，效果可能较差，并告诫不要在市场下跌时卖出。在大多数情境下都站得住的决定，与其说是择时入市，不如说是确保每一笔供款都是在市场可能恢复之前不会用到的钱。

4a1df97f46ef424fd9f5a0ed898c016d7b49157e.src: Redeeming fund units in a non-registered account is not fully taxed: part of each withdrawal returns your own cost, and only half of the gain is taxable. That makes early withdrawals light on tax. As withdrawals continue and the fund grows, the cost base shrinks and the taxable share rises, while reinvested distributions are taxed every year whether or not any units are sold.
4a1df97f46ef424fd9f5a0ed898c016d7b49157e.zh: 在非注册账户中赎回基金单位并不是全额征税：每次提款有一部分是取回自己的成本，而收益只有一半需要征税。因此，早期提款的税负较轻。随着持续提款和基金增长，成本基础缩小，应税比例上升；而再投资的分派每年都要征税，无论是否卖出单位。

9e2e0738d3a5bd7ab2185c9a6835e4ddeb7ceb8f.src: Redemptions remove cost base in proportion to value; reinvested distributions add to it. The gap between the two lines is unrealized gain. It is taxed when units are sold or are considered sold (a deemed disposition), so deferral postpones the tax; it does not cancel it.
9e2e0738d3a5bd7ab2185c9a6835e4ddeb7ceb8f.zh: 赎回按价值比例扣减成本基础；再投资的分派则增加成本基础。两条线之间的差距就是未实现收益。它在单位卖出或被视为卖出（视同处置）时征税，所以递延只是推迟税款，并不能免除税款。

a4cfd06096ef77c97f821df966d8e430d9f4026e.src: Set the cash rate to 0% and the paused plan ends at about CAD 79,172; the interest on the waiting cash is worth roughly CAD 2,260 here, not enough to close the gap. The result reverses if the market keeps falling or stays below the old peak for the whole horizon: then every unit bought during the fall is still at a loss, and holding cash would have been better. The model does not know which world you are in.
a4cfd06096ef77c97f821df966d8e430d9f4026e.zh: 把现金利率设为 0%，暂停方案期末约为 79,172 加元；在这里，等待中现金的利息约值 2,260 加元，不足以弥补差距。如果市场持续下跌，或在整个期间都低于原高点，结果就会反过来：下跌期间买入的每个单位仍然亏损，持有现金会更好。模型并不知道你身处哪一种情况。

10aadbb622e07406a005325ddeec730c1560c3e6.src: Someone who invests a fixed amount from every paycheque into a balanced or equity fund will, sooner or later, open a statement showing that the account is worth less than the money put in. A common reaction is to stop the automatic contribution and keep the money in savings “until things settle down”. It feels like the cautious choice: why buy more of something that is falling?
10aadbb622e07406a005325ddeec730c1560c3e6.zh: 每期从工资中固定投资平衡基金或股票基金的人，迟早会打开一份结单，发现账户价值低于投入的资金。常见的反应是停止自动供款，把钱留在储蓄里，“等局势稳定再说”。这感觉是谨慎的选择：为什么要多买正在下跌的东西？

21a63db0013e62eca6a14dc268386f3ff8f54eff.src: Split each redemption from a non-registered mutual fund into returned cost, untaxed gain and taxable gain, using CRA’s average-cost rule. 39e33b4f9f7974022159bc519a5a3ece50cdb252.src: That has practical consequences. Keeping a careful ACB record matters, because without one an investor may overpay by treating too much of a redemption as gain; the reinvested-distributions guide shows how reinvestments and returns of capital change it. Distributions are taxed every year even when nothing is sold, which is one reason the asset-location guide places the most heavily taxed income in registered accounts where room allows.
39e33b4f9f7974022159bc519a5a3ece50cdb252.zh: 这有实际意义。仔细记录 ACB 很重要，因为没有记录的投资者可能把过多的赎回额当作收益而多缴税；再投资分派指南说明再投资和资本返还如何改变 ACB。即使什么都没卖出，分派每年都要征税，这也是资产配置位置指南在额度允许时把税负最重的收入放进注册账户的原因之一。

Your rate depends on your income and province, so change the two inputs; Ontario’s surtax, credits and income-tested benefits are not modeled.
3f4fc142fd8063556a3882f9d9e148ecd5b57a0d.zh: 默认的 29.65% 是 2026 年联邦 20.5% 加安大略省 9.15%；根据 CRA 的税率表，两者在 2026 年同时适用于约 58,523 加元至 107,785 加元之间的应税收入。你的税率取决于收入和所在省份，请修改这两个输入；本模型不计算安大略省附加税、税收抵免和按收入审查的福利。

a406b608303f31674b0570c015625105dd3b1993.src: The case for continuing rests on contributions that can stay invested for many years. Pausing, or redirecting, can be the right call when the reason is your own cash flow rather than the market:
a406b608303f31674b0570c015625105dd3b1993.zh: 继续供款的理由，建立在供款能长期保持投资的前提上。如果原因是你自己的现金流而不是市场，暂停或转移供款可能是正确的选择：

2864f5cd0c5a0ac1e282169190c6732154e5d571.src: The comparison plan stops buying in month 1, holds every contribution in cash earning 2.5% a year, invests all of that cash in one purchase in month 60 when prices are back at the old peak, and then resumes the monthly contribution. Both plans put in exactly the same money: CAD 50,000 by month 60 and CAD 68,000 by month 96.
2864f5cd0c5a0ac1e282169190c6732154e5d571.zh: 对比方案从第 1 个月起停止买入，把每笔供款以年利率 2.5% 的现金持有，在第 60 个月价格回到原高点时一次性投入全部现金，然后恢复每月供款。两种方案投入的资金完全相同：到第 60 个月为 50,000 加元，到第 96 个月为 68,000 加元。

bcf6a8354c06a807f7d47533f7e025899c1f83c8.src: The default fund is worth CAD 300,000 and has an adjusted cost base (ACB) of CAD 200,000: the total paid for the units, including reinvested distributions. The investor redeems CAD 18,000 at the start of the year.
bcf6a8354c06a807f7d47533f7e025899c1f83c8.zh: 默认基金价值 300,000 加元，调整后成本基础（ACB）为 200,000 加元，即购买这些单位支付的总额，包括再投资的分派。投资者在年初赎回 18,000 加元。

726fa0561609b01acb9b93ec18a6eb77795e1a7c.src: The default scenario starts with CAD 20,000 already invested at a market peak and adds CAD 500 at each month-end. The market falls 35% over 18 months, so the price at the low is 65% of the old peak. It then takes 42 more months to climb back, regaining the old peak in month 60, and grows 6% a year afterwards. Each phase moves by the same percentage every month, a smooth shape chosen so that each effect can be seen; real markets move in jumps and false starts.
726fa0561609b01acb9b93ec18a6eb77795e1a7c.zh: 默认情景以在市场高点已投资的 20,000 加元开始，并在每个月底追加 500 加元。市场在 18 个月内下跌 35%，因此低点价格为原高点的 65%。之后再用 42 个月回升，在第 60 个月回到原高点，此后每年增长 6%。每个阶段每月按相同百分比变动，这种平滑形态是为了让每种效应都清晰可见；真实市场则会跳跃和反复。

ad8e78de1d2dfbf79fd3e876427e2d40ae7bda9e.src: The first chart compares the tax on the same CAD 18,000 at the same 29.65% rate. A TFSA withdrawal is not taxed. Non-registered units bought recently, with a cost near their value, produce almost no gain. With the entered cost base the tax is CAD 889.50. If the units had no cost base left, the whole CAD 18,000 would be gain and the tax would be CAD 2,668.50. An RRSP or RRIF withdrawal is fully taxable, CAD 5,337 at this rate.
ad8e78de1d2dfbf79fd3e876427e2d40ae7bda9e.zh: 第一张图比较同一笔 18,000 加元在同样 29.65% 税率下的税款。TFSA 提款不征税。最近买入、成本接近价值的非注册单位几乎没有收益。按输入的成本基础计算，税款为 889.50 加元。如果这些单位没有剩余成本基础，18,000 加元全部是收益，税款为 2,668.50 加元。RRSP 或 RRIF 提款全额征税，按此税率为 5,337 加元。

60f11700f7743229f58211b3c1619ca27a6b2562.src: The first chart plots both account values against the money put in. At the low in month 18, the continued plan is worth about CAD 20,400 against CAD 29,000 contributed; the paused plan is worth about CAD 22,159, because the CAD 9,000 held in cash did not fall. This is the stretch that makes pausing feel right.
60f11700f7743229f58211b3c1619ca27a6b2562.zh: 第一张图将两种账户价值与投入资金作对比。在第 18 个月的低点，继续供款方案价值约 20,400 加元，而供款为 29,000 加元；暂停方案价值约 22,159 加元，因为以现金持有的 9,000 加元没有下跌。正是这一段让人觉得暂停是对的。

4e67e4167f0bff8988b699a6576b8b83af7c2d6e.src: The first year, step by step

d5c9eb47a42e7d2a0602086f537fab712abe19f9.src: The fund also pays distributions of 1.5% a year on the remaining CAD 282,000, CAD 4,230, which are reinvested. The model taxes them at the full marginal rate, CAD 1,254.20, which is conservative: distributions of eligible dividends or capital gains would be taxed less, as the fund income-type guide shows. After both amounts, about CAD 15,856 of the CAD 18,000 is left to spend if the tax is paid from it.
d5c9eb47a42e7d2a0602086f537fab712abe19f9.zh: 基金还按剩余的 282,000 加元每年支付 1.5% 的分派，即 4,230 加元，并再投资。本模型按全额边际税率对其征税，为 1,254.20 加元，这是保守的做法：合格股息或资本收益形式的分派税负会较低，见基金收入类型指南。扣除这两项后，若税款从中支付，18,000 加元中约有 15,856 加元可供花费。

c31020c39e56c7e4ec120136f71b9a17bd6acb79.src: The fund itself has no special tax status; a fund held in a TFSA or RRSP follows that account’s rules instead. This guide is about the non-registered case.
c31020c39e56c7e4ec120136f71b9a17bd6acb79.zh: 基金本身没有特殊的税务地位；放在 TFSA 或 RRSP 中的基金则遵循该账户的规则。本指南讨论的是非注册账户的情况。

619bd6f95221e251b4a2aa4662cf5ce2fb4c9b80.src: The fund starts at $300,000 with an adjusted cost base of $200,000. $18,000 is redeemed at the start of the first year, rising 2% a year. Each redemption uses the average cost per unit, so only the part above cost is a capital gain, and half of that gain is taxed at the combined 29.65% marginal rate (20.5% federal plus 9.15% provincial or territorial). Units then grow 4% a year and distributions of 1.5% a year are reinvested and taxed at the full marginal rate, a conservative simplification: eligible dividends and capital gains distributions would be taxed less. Tax is paid from the redeemed cash. Returns are hypothetical, not a forecast, and this is not a personal tax calculation.
619bd6f95221e251b4a2aa4662cf5ce2fb4c9b80.zh: 基金初始价值为 $300,000，调整后成本基础为 $200,000。第一年年初赎回 $18,000，此后每年增加 2%。每次赎回使用每单位平均成本，因此只有高于成本的部分才是资本收益，其中一半按 29.65% 的合并边际税率征税（联邦 20.5% 加省或地区 9.15%）。之后单位每年增长 4%，每年 1.5% 的分派再投资并按全额边际税率征税，这是保守的简化：合格股息和资本收益分派的税负会较低。税款从赎回的现金中支付。回报是假设的，并非预测，这也不是个人税务计算。

dcf99f639c9da6269a999d6a92b0ac10364584aa.src: The fund still holds about CAD 98,468 at the end, with an ACB of about CAD 40,150. The tax on that unrealized gain, about CAD 8,646 at the same rate, has been deferred, not avoided: gains are taxed when units are sold or are considered to be sold (a deemed disposition). The gain-timing guide values what deferral is worth. Extend the plan to 25 years and the default fund runs out in year 24: lower tax does not make a withdrawal rate sustainable.
dcf99f639c9da6269a999d6a92b0ac10364584aa.zh: 期末基金仍有约 98,468 加元，ACB 约为 40,150 加元。这部分未实现收益的税款按同一税率约为 8,646 加元，只是被递延而非免除：收益在单位卖出或被视为卖出（视同处置）时征税。收益时机指南评估递延的价值。若把计划延长到 25 年，默认基金在第 24 年耗尽：较低的税负并不会让提款率变得可持续。

c6e185d053ee6e534334649a001304b36bd3e903.src: The heatmap repeats the break-even month for different fall sizes and starting balances, keeping the 60-month round trip. Two patterns stand out. With no starting balance, the account is back above its contributions by month 32 or 33 whatever the depth of the fall, because a deeper fall also means cheaper units. With a starting balance of 240 monthly contributions, CAD 120,000 here, break-even moves out to month 55 or 56: a large existing balance follows the market, and new contributions are too small to pull the average down much. The earlier in a saving life a crash happens, the more the contributions dominate.
c6e185d053ee6e534334649a001304b36bd3e903.zh: 热力图在保持 60 个月往返的前提下，按不同跌幅和初始余额重复计算回本月份。有两个规律很明显。没有初始余额时，无论跌幅多深，账户都在第 32 或 33 个月回到供款总额以上，因为跌得更深也意味着单位更便宜。初始余额为 240 次每月供款（这里为 120,000 加元）时，回本推迟到第 55 或 56 个月：大额现有余额随市场波动，新的供款太少，难以明显拉低平均成本。崩盘在储蓄生涯中发生得越早，供款的作用就越大。

c1f2ee69040064502370bea230c463c295a9196a.src: The heatmap reruns the 20-year plan for starting cost bases from 100% to 0% of value and unit growth from 0% to 8% a year. A fund bought recently with no growth pays about 3.2% of its withdrawals in tax, all of it on distributions. A fund with no cost base left that grows 8% a year pays about 21.7%. In between, the starting ACB sets the level and growth sets the slope.
c1f2ee69040064502370bea230c463c295a9196a.zh: 热力图按初始成本基础从价值的 100% 到 0%、单位年增长从 0% 到 8%，重新计算 20 年计划。最近买入且没有增长的基金，税款约占提款额的 3.2%，全部来自分派。没有剩余成本基础且每年增长 8% 的基金，税款约占 21.7%。介于两者之间时，初始 ACB 决定水平，增长决定斜率。

b8f276450f73c56c2b75fdb2f6b133932e597655.src: The market regains its old peak in month 60. With contributions continued, the account is back above the money put in by month 46, 14 months earlier. The larger the starting balance compared with each contribution, the closer the account follows the market line.
b8f276450f73c56c2b75fdb2f6b133932e597655.zh: 市场在第 60 个月回到原高点。继续供款时，账户在第 46 个月回到投入资金以上，提前 14 个月。初始余额相对于每次供款越大，账户走势就越贴近市场线。

d7fde4c3fe74ef75495db9dacc7cfae6d2272075.src: The month the statement turns red

f0824378261934d833a6a68906ceab13c0de2129.src: The picture changes on the way back up. In month 60, when the market is exactly at its old peak, the continued plan is worth about CAD 57,500, while the paused plan is worth about CAD 51,898 after investing its cash at the peak price. By month 96 the values are about CAD 88,104 and CAD 81,432. The gap of roughly CAD 6,672 comes from the units that the monthly contributions bought below the old peak, less the interest the paused cash earned.
f0824378261934d833a6a68906ceab13c0de2129.zh: 回升途中情况发生变化。第 60 个月市场正好回到原高点时，继续供款方案价值约 57,500 加元，而暂停方案按高点价格投入现金后价值约 51,898 加元。到第 96 个月，两者分别约为 88,104 加元和 81,432 加元。约 6,672 加元的差距来自每月供款在原高点以下买入的单位，再减去暂停期间现金所赚的利息。

d2fdf6a19728dea702cb247095168a8126744654.src: The reason is the average price. The 60 contributions made until the peak returned bought their units at an average price of about 80% of the old peak. FINRA describes this as a benefit of regular investing in a decline: a fixed amount buys more units when prices are lower. The same page sets out the limits: holding cash and spreading purchases out often produces lower returns than investing at once, especially over longer periods, and per-transaction fees can erode returns.
d2fdf6a19728dea702cb247095168a8126744654.zh: 原因在于平均价格。市场回到高点之前的 60 次供款，平均买入价约为原高点的 80%。FINRA 将此描述为下跌期间定期投资的好处：固定金额在价格较低时能买到更多单位。同一页面也说明了局限：持有现金并分批买入，往往比一次性投资回报较低，尤其是在较长期间内；按笔收费也会侵蚀回报。

8466d305a649ad2db50232e5c6dff4427f8c82e8.src: The recovery length is the decisive assumption, and it is the one nobody knows in advance. The Ontario Securities Commission’s investor site notes that markets have historically recovered from declines but that this can take months or several years. Change the inputs to try a faster bounce, a slower climb, or a recovery that does not arrive within the horizon.
8466d305a649ad2db50232e5c6dff4427f8c82e8.zh: 恢复所需时间是决定性的假设，而且没有人能事先知道。安大略证券委员会的投资者网站指出，市场在历史上都曾从下跌中恢复，但这可能需要数月或数年。修改输入，试试更快的反弹、更慢的回升，或在追踪期内没有出现的恢复。

d9fe6d5aa7bacdb488e1180a7c0fa89d2fb250a1.src: The same withdrawal from different accounts
d9fe6d5aa7bacdb488e1180a7c0fa89d2fb250a1.zh: 从不同账户提取同样的金额

3521553716dcb21b322f2398faf90a5fbdb50cf7.src: The second and third charts follow the plan for 20 years, with the withdrawal rising 2% a year and units growing 4% a year after fund costs. Each redemption removes cost base in proportion to value, and growth adds value but not cost. Reinvested distributions add to both. Over time the ACB falls behind the market value, so each dollar redeemed carries less cost and more gain.
3521553716dcb21b322f2398faf90a5fbdb50cf7.zh: 第二和第三张图追踪 20 年计划，提款额每年增加 2%，单位扣除基金成本后每年增长 4%。每次赎回按价值比例扣减成本基础，增长只增加价值而不增加成本。再投资的分派则同时增加两者。随着时间推移，ACB 落后于市值，因此每赎回一元所含的成本越来越少，收益越来越多。

2946291f188602eda7ebea867c8153ad0b6a778f.src: The second chart compares two ratios: the market price as a share of the old peak, and the account value as a share of the money put in. With contributions continued, the account is back above its contributions in month 46, 14 months before the market regains its peak. At that point the market price is still about 13% below the peak. The paused plan crosses in month 53, helped by its cash interest and by the partial recovery of its starting balance.
2946291f188602eda7ebea867c8153ad0b6a778f.zh: 第二张图比较两个比率：市场价格占原高点的比例，以及账户价值占投入资金的比例。继续供款时，账户在第 46 个月回到供款总额以上，比市场回到高点早 14 个月。此时市场价格仍比高点低约 13%。暂停方案在第 53 个月越过，得益于现金利息以及初始余额的部分回升。

5de86ca36d656fbbf415e848f68bc922e9c39805.src: The taxable share grows as the fund’s gain grows relative to its cost base. In year 1, 33.3% of the redemption is gain; by year 20 it is 58.5%.
5de86ca36d656fbbf415e848f68bc922e9c39805.zh: 应税比例随基金收益相对于成本基础的增长而上升。第 1 年，赎回额的 33.3% 是收益；到第 20 年为 58.5%。

83e5e0417aa14d7fa0f3bd575bdee0614a2b4b89.src: The third chart values each year’s block of purchases at the old peak price in month 60. Contributions made in months 13 to 24, around the low, show a paper gain of about 46.7%. Contributions in the first year of the fall show about 17.2%, and those made in the last year before the peak returned show only about 5.9%. The starting balance, bought at the peak, shows nothing.
83e5e0417aa14d7fa0f3bd575bdee0614a2b4b89.zh: 第三张图按第 60 个月的原高点价格，计算每年一组买入的价值。第 13 至 24 个月、低点前后的供款，账面收益约为 46.7%。下跌第一年的供款约为 17.2%，而高点恢复前最后一年的供款只有约 5.9%。在高点买入的初始余额则没有收益。

ebe3f1c5bd092b1c79c85a75d03878c7e98c7f4f.src: These are the purchases that a pause skips. They also show why a pause is hard to undo in practice: the months that turned out best were the months when statements looked worst, and an investor waiting for “things to settle down” usually restarts after prices have risen. The waiting-for-a-dip guide tests the opposite habit, holding new money back until prices fall, and finds the same difficulty from the other side.
ebe3f1c5bd092b1c79c85a75d03878c7e98c7f4f.zh: 这些正是暂停时错过的买入。它们也说明了为什么暂停在实际中很难恢复：事后表现最好的月份，正是结单看起来最糟的月份；而“等局势稳定”的投资者，往往要到价格上涨后才重新开始。等待回调指南测试了相反的习惯，即把新资金留到价格下跌时再投入，并从另一面发现了同样的困难。

9097422418654bbe6144d595b6b08a2b03866d7a.src: This guide follows the arithmetic of that choice month by month. It is about new money arriving from earned pay, a stream of contributions that would not exist all at once. Deciding how to invest an existing lump sum, such as an inheritance or the proceeds of a sale, is a different question, compared in the lump-sum and phased-investing guide. Deciding whether to sell what is already invested is different again, and is tested in the exit-and-re-entry guide.
9097422418654bbe6144d595b6b08a2b03866d7a.zh: 本指南逐月追踪这个选择的计算。它讨论的是来自工资收入的新资金，这笔供款流本来就不会一次性出现。如何投资一笔现有的整笔资金，例如遗产或出售所得，是另一个问题，整笔与分批投资指南对此作了比较。是否卖出已投资的资产又是另一个问题，退出与重新入市指南对此作了测试。

c48c17a94902bb78bd19c41fc435bdf5de22a421.zh: 整个计划期间每赎回一元所缴的总税款，按初始成本基础和价格增长划分 · 百分比

052f13ee3882831762cdfd1b6d07bc9970939a1a.src: Two cautions keep this from being a ranking of accounts. The RRSP contributions were deducted from income when they were made, so taxing the withdrawal completes a deal that began with a refund; the RRSP and TFSA timing guide compares the full cycle. And the RRSP cash flow differs: for a lump-sum withdrawal, CRA says the institution withholds tax at source, 30% outside Quebec on an amount over CAD 15,000, which may be more or less than the final tax, as the withholding guide explains. Non-registered redemptions have no such withholding, so the tax is settled with the return or through instalments.
052f13ee3882831762cdfd1b6d07bc9970939a1a.zh: 有两点提醒，避免把这当成账户排名。RRSP 供款在当初已从收入中扣除，因此对提款征税只是完成一个以退税开始的安排；RRSP 与 TFSA 时机指南比较了完整周期。此外，RRSP 的现金流也不同：对于一次性提款，CRA 表示金融机构会在源头预扣税款，魁北克省以外超过 15,000 加元的部分预扣 30%，可能多于或少于最终税款，见预扣税指南。非注册账户的赎回没有这种预扣，税款在报税时或通过分期预缴结清。

f36096c07472e3a4fef57e4e06237d62f00fd217.src: Above CAD 16,452, the spouse amount is zero and each extra dollar of the spouse’s income keeps one more dollar of age and pension amounts on their own return. In the default, the transfer reaches zero at CAD 16,452 + 9,208 + 2,000 = CAD 27,660.
f36096c07472e3a4fef57e4e06237d62f00fd217.zh: 高于 16,452 加元时，配偶额为零，配偶收入每多 1 加元，就有 1 加元的年龄额和养老金额留在其本人报税表上。在默认情景中，转移额在 16,452 + 9,208 + 2,000 = 27,660 加元时降为零。

1f843ccfaec8dea45257b81dca4a27f9f6233e50.src: Age amount only (CPP and OAS, no RRIF or pension): the full CAD 9,208 moves until the spouse’s income passes CAD 16,452, and nothing is left at CAD 25,660.
1f843ccfaec8dea45257b81dca4a27f9f6233e50.zh: 只有年龄额（CPP 和 OAS，没有 RRIF 或退休金）：配偶收入超过 16,452 加元之前，全部 9,208 加元都可转移，到 25,660 加元时一分不剩。

74ab532a6a0c0dbbfb5eb19151aba574cf78385f.src: Age and pension amounts: CAD 11,208 at most, ending at CAD 27,660. Drawing CAD 2,000 a year from a RRIF from 65 is often enough to create the pension amount, which then transfers in part or in full.
74ab532a6a0c0dbbfb5eb19151aba574cf78385f.zh: 年龄额加养老金额：最多 11,208 加元，在 27,660 加元时结束。从 65 岁起每年从 RRIF 提取 2,000 加元，通常就足以产生养老金额，之后可部分或全部转移。

2fc1df0125d6a003390add194bb5493a33a4edf7.src: Age, pension and disability: CAD 21,549 at most, and CAD 8,001 is still left at CAD 30,000 of income; the transfer ends at CAD 38,001. With 2026 rates that combination is worth up to CAD 3,016.86 to the claimant.
2fc1df0125d6a003390add194bb5493a33a4edf7.zh: 年龄额、养老金额加残疾额：最多 21,549 加元，收入 30,000 加元时仍剩 8,001 加元；转移在 38,001 加元时结束。按 2026 年税率，这一组合对申报人最多值 3,016.86 加元。

0e89930c9f4be816144218fbb354e7fe2d516e81.src: CAD 8,000 of tuition, under 65: at most CAD 5,000 moves. A student spouse with CAD 20,000 of income uses CAD 3,548 of the tuition themselves, transfers CAD 1,452 and carries the other CAD 3,000 forward to their own future years.
0e89930c9f4be816144218fbb354e7fe2d516e81.zh: 学费 8,000 加元，65 岁以下：最多可转 5,000 加元。收入 20,000 加元的学生配偶自己使用 3,548 加元学费，转出 1,452 加元，其余 3,000 加元结转到自己以后的年度。

9f890c2ce328105dc78c36b10f3ab71aa080a02a.src: CPP, QPP and OAS are not pension income for the pension amount. Eligible pension income at 65 or older includes registered pension plan lifetime payments, RRIF and LIF payments, annuity payments and pension income split to you under an election. Under 65, it is mainly a lifetime pension from a registered pension plan, plus certain amounts received because of a spouse’s death. A 66-year-old with CPP and OAS only has no pension amount to transfer; CAD 2,000 a year from a RRIF creates the full one.
9f890c2ce328105dc78c36b10f3ab71aa080a02a.zh: CPP、QPP 和 OAS 不属于养老金收入，不能产生养老金额。65 岁或以上的合资格养老金收入包括注册退休金计划的终身给付、RRIF 和 LIF 提款、年金给付，以及按选择分配给你的养老金收入。65 岁以下主要是注册退休金计划的终身退休金，以及因配偶去世而收到的某些款项。只有 CPP 和 OAS 的 66 岁人士没有养老金额可转；每年从 RRIF 提取 2,000 加元即可产生全额。

b0d7d954afd2c1d306b1b8e48f6b4b56837991e5.src: Disability amount, under 65: CAD 10,341 until the spouse’s income passes the basic personal amount, ending at CAD 26,793.
b0d7d954afd2c1d306b1b8e48f6b4b56837991e5.zh: 残疾额，65 岁以下：配偶收入超过基本个人免税额之前为 10,341 加元，在 26,793 加元时结束。

18279d032c6d05656bd1f1eb14aac531a8f3aacc.src: Only current-year tuition moves. Tuition carried forward from an earlier year stays with the student. The CAD 5,000 cap is reduced by the current-year tuition the student uses themselves, even if some of the year’s amount is still unused.
18279d032c6d05656bd1f1eb14aac531a8f3aacc.zh: 只有本年度学费可转移。以前年度结转的学费留给学生本人。5,000 加元上限要扣除学生本人使用的本年度学费，即使当年额度仍有未用部分。

65f9a7a1dc9b32f6221755cba4292d9ac50d2605.src: The age amount depends on the spouse’s own net income, not the couple’s. A spouse with CAD 60,000 of income has an age amount of CAD 9,208 − 15% × (60,000 − 46,432) = CAD 7,172.80, but with that income they would need it all.
65f9a7a1dc9b32f6221755cba4292d9ac50d2605.zh: 年龄额取决于配偶本人的净收入，而不是夫妻合计。收入 60,000 加元的配偶，年龄额为 9,208 − 15% × (60,000 − 46,432) = 7,172.80 加元，但有这样的收入，他们会全部自用。

e5d600f5729bb02bff524863fff046b354b2ab81.src: The model’s default is a retired couple. The lower-income spouse is 67 with CAD 20,000 of income: CAD 16,000 of CPP and OAS and a CAD 4,000 RRIF payment. The claimant is 68 with CAD 85,000, CAD 40,000 of it from a workplace pension.
e5d600f5729bb02bff524863fff046b354b2ab81.zh: 模型默认情景是一对退休夫妇。收入较低的配偶 67 岁，收入 20,000 加元：16,000 加元 CPP 和 OAS，加上 4,000 加元 RRIF 提款。申报人 68 岁，收入 85,000 加元，其中 40,000 加元来自雇主退休金。

04158b2d0b8dd0e97470098b3da48ddee1d4420b.src: Up to CAD 16,452, the spouse amount falls dollar for dollar, while the transfer stays complete because the spouse’s basic personal amount alone covers their income.
04158b2d0b8dd0e97470098b3da48ddee1d4420b.zh: 不超过 16,452 加元时，配偶额逐元下降，而转移保持全额，因为配偶的基本个人免税额本身已足以覆盖其收入。

ddb4b0a3221b66680b74113153231f224e6deecf.src: With no income, the spouse needs none of their amounts. The claimant gets the full CAD 16,452 spouse amount and the full age amount of CAD 9,208 on line 32600 (CAD 3,592.40 together at 14%; the pension amount is zero because there is no pension income).
ddb4b0a3221b66680b74113153231f224e6deecf.zh: 没有收入时，配偶完全不需要自己的额度。申报人可获得全额 16,452 加元配偶额，并在第 32600 行获得全额 9,208 加元年龄额（按 14% 合计 3,592.40 加元；由于没有养老金收入，养老金额为零）。

585a844632111811bb9c7125ff0812fb9510a51f.src: A spouse with employment income also has CPP, EI and Canada employment credits on line 96, which raise line 11 and leave more to transfer. In the model’s tuition example, a student spouse earning CAD 12,000 has CAD 18,569.35 of basic and payroll credits, more than their income, so they transfer the full CAD 5,000.
585a844632111811bb9c7125ff0812fb9510a51f.zh: 有就业收入的配偶在第 96 行还有 CPP、EI 和加拿大就业额抵免，会提高第 11 行，留下更多可转移额度。在模型的学费例子中，收入 12,000 加元的学生配偶有 18,569.35 加元的基本和工资相关抵免，高于其收入，因此可转出全部 5,000 加元。

90f1295ab334635902a02bd4b8a7f5eb66abcd52.src: A worked guide to line 32600 for 2026: which of a spouse’s or common-law partner’s credits can move to the other, how Schedule 2 decides the unused part, how it sits beside the spouse amount on line 30300, why CPP and OAS do not create a pension amount, the CAD 5,000 tuition cap, when the claimant has too little tax to use it, and CRA statistics on who claims. Six charts and an editable model.
90f1295ab334635902a02bd4b8a7f5eb66abcd52.zh: 2026 年第 32600 行实例指南：配偶或同居伴侣的哪些抵免可以转给另一方，附表 2 如何确定未用部分，它与第 30300 行配偶额的关系，为何 CPP 和 OAS 不会产生养老金额，5,000 加元学费上限，申报人税款太少用不上的情况，以及 CRA 关于谁在申报的统计。六张图表和可编辑模型。

fda672dbd705e4626140ebe27eed15c7c52ba321.src: Claims are most frequent among claimants with CAD 10,000 to 30,000 of income: about 87 to 89 per 1,000 returns, against about 20 to 22 per 1,000 above CAD 100,000. That pattern is consistent with older couples on modest incomes moving age and pension amounts, but the table does not record ages, the amounts transferred by type or whether the claimant could use them. Counts are rounded to the nearest ten; the grouped amounts add to CAD 10,665,311 thousand against the CAD 10,665,312 thousand total because of rounding.
fda672dbd705e4626140ebe27eed15c7c52ba321.zh: 申报最集中于收入 10,000 至 30,000 加元的申报人：每 1,000 份报税表约 87 至 89 份，而收入 100,000 加元以上约为每 1,000 份 20 至 22 份。这一模式与收入不高的年长夫妇转移年龄额和养老金额的情况相符，但该表没有记录年龄、按类型划分的转移额，或申报人能否用上。份数四舍五入至十位；由于四舍五入，分组金额合计 10,665,311 千加元，而总数为 10,665,312 千加元。

8ab59f2c02f1ad098a40570a328c43ae53f18fbe.src: Default couple: Schedule 2 and line 32600 (2026 federal)
8ab59f2c02f1ad098a40570a328c43ae53f18fbe.zh: 默认夫妇：附表 2 和第 32600 行（2026 年联邦）

e06a988dcdac0712987de845f3df89f3fa3cedbe.src: Each CAD 1 transferred is worth 14 cents of federal tax to the claimant, if the claimant owes that much. The part the spouse needs is the smaller of their adjusted taxable income and the total they qualify to transfer.
e06a988dcdac0712987de845f3df89f3fa3cedbe.zh: 每转移 1 加元，对申报人值 14 分联邦税，前提是申报人有这么多税款。配偶需要的部分是其调整后应税收入与其符合转移条件的总额中较少者。

7572460b48ac28b059c6e3211e74f91f64b26734.src: Each bar is the spouse’s age, pension, disability and tuition amounts in CAD before the credit rate. A lost transfer is shown in proportion to the claimant’s unused credit across lines 30300 and 32600. Amounts other than tuition that neither spouse uses disappear: they cannot be carried forward.
7572460b48ac28b059c6e3211e74f91f64b26734.zh: 每根柱为配偶的年龄额、养老金额、残疾额和学费额，单位为加元，未乘抵免率。损失的转移额按申报人在第 30300 行和第 32600 行未用抵免的比例显示。学费以外、双方都用不上的额度会消失：它们不能结转。

436b29bb01d82a04c7f0ce1388795e5b078107f0.src: Eligible pension income in it: RRIF, annuity or registered pension, not CPP, OAS or GIS (CAD)
436b29bb01d82a04c7f0ce1388795e5b078107f0.zh: 其中的合资格养老金收入：RRIF、年金或注册退休金，不含 CPP、OAS 或 GIS（加元）

8ec6e378118b90b78dee46cb45d3df838f6a0991.src: Eligible pension income is held at the lesser of CAD 4,000 and the spouse’s income, and employment income at the lesser of CAD 0 and what remains. The spouse amount ends when the spouse’s income reaches the claimant’s basic personal amount; the transfer runs further, because the spouse keeps only enough of the amounts to clear their own tax, and here reaches zero near CAD 27,660.
8ec6e378118b90b78dee46cb45d3df838f6a0991.zh: 合资格养老金收入取 4,000 加元与配偶收入中较少者，就业收入取 0 加元与剩余收入中较少者。配偶收入达到申报人的基本个人免税额时，配偶额结束；转移延续得更远，因为配偶只保留足以抵清自身税款的额度，在此约于 27,660 加元降为零。

84f156b8589a9fe6fe30bb8c688d16c2231322c0.src: For 2026 a spouse can pass the other the part of their age amount (up to CAD 9,208), pension income amount (up to CAD 2,000), disability amount (CAD 10,341) and current-year tuition (up to CAD 5,000) that they do not need to bring their own federal tax to zero. Schedule 2 takes those amounts, subtracts the spouse’s taxable income less their basic personal amount and payroll credits, and the rest goes on line 32600. It is worth 14% federally, and only against tax the claimant actually owes.
84f156b8589a9fe6fe30bb8c688d16c2231322c0.zh: 2026 年，配偶可以把自己不需要用来使联邦税降为零的那部分年龄额（最多 9,208 加元）、养老金收入额（最多 2,000 加元）、残疾额（10,341 加元）和本年度学费（最多 5,000 加元）转给另一方。附表 2 先加总这些额度，再减去配偶的应税收入扣除其基本个人免税额和工资相关抵免后的余额，剩下的填入第 32600 行。联邦层面按 14% 计值，而且只能抵减申报人实际应缴的税款。

72ed815f3217e5e7f91537de105cce26f8668579.src: For a new disability claim, the spouse needs an approved Form T2201.
72ed815f3217e5e7f91537de105cce26f8668579.zh: 新的残疾申报需要配偶有已获批准的 T2201 表格。

ff999d7e02f57189777031480dbdd365e9992f71.src: For tuition, the student designates the amount on the back of the T2202; carried-forward tuition stays with them.
ff999d7e02f57189777031480dbdd365e9992f71.zh: 学费方面，学生在 T2202 背面指定转移金额；结转学费留给学生本人。

7cde1c6ed63a6f8358b98a028118b441bd700376.src: If both spouses have CAD 20,000 of income, the claimant’s own CAD 16,452 basic, CAD 9,208 age and CAD 2,000 pension amounts already exceed their income, so the CAD 1,072.40 credit from the transfer is entirely wasted. It cannot go back to the spouse, and unused age, pension and disability amounts cannot be carried forward. The claimant-income chart shows the credit becoming usable only once the claimant’s income passes about CAD 27,660, and fully usable a little above CAD 35,000.
7cde1c6ed63a6f8358b98a028118b441bd700376.zh: 如果双方收入都是 20,000 加元，申报人自己的 16,452 加元基本额、9,208 加元年龄额和 2,000 加元养老金额已超过其收入，因此转移带来的 1,072.40 加元抵免全部浪费。它不能退回给配偶，未用的年龄额、养老金额和残疾额也不能结转。申报人收入图显示，申报人收入超过约 27,660 加元后抵免才开始可用，略高于 35,000 加元时才可全部用上。

1c3a02b6c27f6b445ad42d0e2cff79e01039f916.zh: 第 11 行：基本个人免税额 16,452 加元 + 第 96 行 0 加元 + 学费 0 加元

3454a46d9676819d7db3ebc6d2b48cd36a43ef99.src: Line 12: adjusted taxable income (the part the spouse needs)
3454a46d9676819d7db3ebc6d2b48cd36a43ef99.zh: 第 12 行：调整后应税收入（配偶需要的部分）

2b206bb59782d994032e351b95a68c1b9141d43e.src: Line 12: line 7 minus line 11, not below zero. This is the spouse’s adjusted taxable income, the part of the five amounts they need.
2b206bb59782d994032e351b95a68c1b9141d43e.zh: 第 12 行：第 7 行减第 11 行，不低于零。这是配偶的调整后应税收入，即五项额度中他们自己需要的部分。

65a5bcf3bbda9a7a47a9e79543f5567e2d9c4446.src: Line 13: line 6 minus line 12, not below zero, goes on line 32600 of your return.
65a5bcf3bbda9a7a47a9e79543f5567e2d9c4446.zh: 第 13 行：第 6 行减第 12 行，不低于零，填入你报税表的第 32600 行。

a3a535c3751c9db3aae4c922e71c446a1a9adccb.zh: 第 13 行：转入第 32600 行

a6c19ccb8baad44e35ee96c04ddcb670f5f47057.src: Line 30300, the spouse or common-law partner amount, is a different credit. It is the claimant’s basic personal amount (CAD 16,452 for 2026 below CAD 181,440 of the claimant’s net income) minus the spouse’s net income, and it applies at any age. The claimant can make both claims in the same year.
a6c19ccb8baad44e35ee96c04ddcb670f5f47057.zh: 第 30300 行的配偶或同居伴侣额是另一项抵免。它等于申报人的基本个人免税额（2026 年申报人净收入低于 181,440 加元时为 16,452 加元）减去配偶的净收入，适用于任何年龄。申报人可在同一年同时申报两项。

3702bf1631dad00b084bc82f8c1cc87d8ff7933b.src: Line 6: total the spouse qualifies to transfer
3702bf1631dad00b084bc82f8c1cc87d8ff7933b.zh: 第 6 行：配偶符合转移条件的总额

0785af591dc0abec844bc7621a58f0b4a0fb500a.zh: 第 7 行：配偶的应税收入

351a8399501b1f5bd5b93c80411f088ecaf44fc0.src: Line 7: the spouse’s taxable income. If it is above the top of the lowest bracket (CAD 57,375 on the 2025 form), use their federal tax on that income divided by the lowest rate instead, which turns higher-rate tax into an equivalent amount at 14.5% (14% for 2026).
351a8399501b1f5bd5b93c80411f088ecaf44fc0.zh: 第 7 行：配偶的应税收入。如果高于最低税级上限（2025 年表格为 57,375 加元），则改用其该收入的联邦税除以最低税率，把较高税率的税款换算为按 14.5%（2026 年为 14%）计的等值金额。

The spouse first uses them to bring their own federal tax to zero after the basic personal amount and the CPP, EI and Canada employment credits on employment income entered. The claimant’s credit is limited to federal tax left after their own basic, age, pension, CPP and EI credits. Net income is taken as taxable income for both people; provincial and territorial Schedule 2 amounts, the caregiver amount for infirm children (line 30500), the infirm-spouse addition to line 30300, medical expenses, donations, dividend credits and pension income splitting are left out.

591d1350be4422c147fb348a24d1ba9dff26ad75.src: Schedule 2 only moves amounts the spouse cannot use. If the spouse needs all of them, line 13 is zero whatever the claimant’s income, so the transfer never pushes tax onto the lower-income spouse.
591d1350be4422c147fb348a24d1ba9dff26ad75.zh: 附表 2 只转移配偶用不上的额度。如果配偶全部需要，无论申报人收入多少，第 13 行都是零，因此转移绝不会把税负推给收入较低的配偶。

31b6ec4c5a8366cee0a2be438cf8371e3e0730ab.src: So the transfer reaches further up the income scale than the spouse amount. For a pensioner couple, the spouse amount often ends with OAS and CPP alone, while line 32600 can still carry several thousand dollars of age amount.
31b6ec4c5a8366cee0a2be438cf8371e3e0730ab.zh: 因此，转移在收入阶梯上比配偶额延续得更远。对于领取养老金的夫妇，仅 OAS 和 CPP 往往就使配偶额归零，而第 32600 行仍可转移数千加元的年龄额。

31763b6828313161f9c5aac03f872611e57aca9e.src: The 2026 figures are CRA’s published amounts after 2.0% indexation; the CAD 2,000 and CAD 5,000 caps are fixed dollar amounts. The age amount reaches zero at CAD 46,432 + 9,208 ÷ 15% ≈ CAD 107,819 of net income (derived). 448b9df5a020b2c06609592c9414850dc0da74a2.src: The model covers federal amounts only and treats net income as taxable income. It includes the basic personal amount and the CPP, EI and Canada employment credits from employment income on the spouse’s line 11, but not the home buyers’, home accessibility, adoption or volunteer amounts, nor the caregiver amount for infirm children. The claimant’s room allows for their own basic, age, pension, CPP and EI credits but not medical expenses, donations, dividend tax credits or other claims that would also use their tax. It does not model the infirm-spouse addition to line 30300, pension splitting, OAS recovery tax or provincial credits. Use CRA’s schedules or tax software for an actual return.
448b9df5a020b2c06609592c9414850dc0da74a2.zh: 模型只涵盖联邦额度，并把净收入视作应税收入。配偶第 11 行包括基本个人免税额以及就业收入产生的 CPP、EI 和加拿大就业额抵免，但不包括购房者额、住房无障碍改造、领养或义工额，也不包括体弱子女照顾者额。申报人的可用税额已考虑其本人的基本额、年龄额、养老金额、CPP 和 EI 抵免，但未考虑医疗费用、捐款、股息抵免或其他同样会用掉税款的申报。模型未处理第 30300 行的体弱配偶附加额、养老金分配、OAS 回收税或省级抵免。实际报税请使用 CRA 附表或报税软件。

e840b7be6e80352722f4baf6cd16fe5fd4ca0bdc.src: The schedule is short. It adds up what the spouse qualifies for, measures how much of that they need, and transfers the difference:

02c1fa681e49da69083e2d066ca62c77b6161ad8.src: The spouse’s own federal tax is 14% × CAD 20,000 = CAD 2,800. Their basic personal amount and the CAD 3,548 of age and pension amounts they keep give 14% × CAD 20,000 = CAD 2,800 of credits, so they owe nothing federally and the CAD 7,660 they could not use moves across. The claimant has about CAD 10,559 of federal tax left after their own basic, age and pension credits, so they use the CAD 1,072.40 in full. Without the transfer that value would simply be lost.
02c1fa681e49da69083e2d066ca62c77b6161ad8.zh: 配偶本人的联邦税为 14% × 20,000 加元 = 2,800 加元。其基本个人免税额加上保留的 3,548 加元年龄额和养老金额，带来 14% × 20,000 加元 = 2,800 加元抵免，因此其联邦税为零，用不上的 7,660 加元转给对方。申报人在扣除自己的基本额、年龄额和养老金额抵免后约有 10,559 加元联邦税，可全额用上 1,072.40 加元。没有转移，这笔价值就会白白损失。

efaba0f991edbcd15ee3f06f68042cd2ffedc1e9.src: The transfer helps only if the claimant has federal tax left after their own credits. For a retired claimant those include their own basic personal amount, their own age amount (reduced by their income) and their own pension amount. In the default, the claimant at CAD 85,000 has an age amount of CAD 3,422.80 and about CAD 10,559 of tax left.
efaba0f991edbcd15ee3f06f68042cd2ffedc1e9.zh: 只有申报人在扣除自己的抵免后仍有联邦税，转移才有帮助。对退休申报人而言，这些抵免包括其本人的基本个人免税额、本人的年龄额（按其收入递减）和本人的养老金额。在默认情景中，收入 85,000 加元的申报人年龄额为 3,422.80 加元，约剩 10,559 加元税款。

e53b8a224344b7d00b60f64914283fe672d03434.src: The two tools therefore do not add up simply. Tax software usually tests split percentages and then runs Schedule 2 on the result. This model holds incomes as entered and does not optimise a split; the separate pension income splitting guide models the election, including the age amount and OAS recovery.
e53b8a224344b7d00b60f64914283fe672d03434.zh: 因此两种工具的效果并不能简单相加。报税软件通常先测试不同分配比例，再按结果计算附表 2。本模型按输入的收入计算，不优化分配比例；另一篇养老金收入分配指南模拟了这一选择，包括年龄额和 OAS 回收。

f5320dd726574dcd33274451f9aeae05947685dc.src: $20,000 buys units in a non-registered account either just before or just after a distribution of 8% of the unit price. Bought before, the $1,600 distribution is reinvested, so both buyers end up with the same units and the same market value; the difference is tax. 75% of the distribution is treated as capital gains (half taxed) and the rest as income taxed in full at 29.65%, a conservative simplification: eligible dividends would be taxed less and return of capital is not taxed now. That tax is paid from cash that would otherwise earn 2.5% after tax. Units grow 5% a year and are all sold in year 10. In a TFSA, RRSP or other registered plan none of this tax arises. Figures are hypothetical, not a forecast or a personal tax calculation.
f5320dd726574dcd33274451f9aeae05947685dc.zh: 20,000 加元在非注册账户中买入基金单位，时间是在相当于单位价格 8% 的分派之前或之后。若在分派前买入，1,600 加元的分派会再投资，因此两位买家最终持有相同的单位和相同的市值，差别只在税务。分派中 75% 视为资本利得（一半计税），其余视为收入，按 29.65% 全额计税，这是偏保守的简化：合资格股息的税会更低，资本返还当期不计税。这笔税款以原本可获得 2.5% 税后回报的现金支付。单位每年增长 5%，并于第 10 年全部卖出。在 TFSA、RRSP 或其他注册计划中不会产生这些税。数字均为假设，不是预测，也不是个人税务计算。

53189276467ce47108c2dc680bf9a8647976227d.src: Section 117.1 sets the yearly factor. It divides the average CPI for the 12 months ending on 30 September before the year by the average for the 12 months before that, subtracts one, and rounds to the nearest 0.1%. The same factors index the federal tax brackets and many credits, which is why the TFSA step and the bracket increase are announced together each autumn.
53189276467ce47108c2dc680bf9a8647976227d.zh: 第 117.1 条规定每年的调整系数：以该年之前截至 9 月 30 日的 12 个月平均 CPI，除以再之前 12 个月的平均值，减去一，并取整到最接近的 0.1%。同一系数也用于调整联邦税级和许多税收抵免，因此 TFSA 台阶与税级上调每年秋季一同公布。

e4769e21134d552ea2833614d0f05476ade45ae5.src: Section 207.01 of the Income Tax Act defines the “TFSA dollar limit”. For 2009 to 2012 it was $5,000; for 2013 and 2014, $5,500; for 2015, $10,000. For every year after 2015 it is “$5,000 adjusted for each year after 2009” under section 117.1, rounded to the nearest multiple of $500, with an exact tie rounded up. CRA’s indexation page describes the same rule: the limit is fixed at $5,000, indexed for each year after 2009 and rounded to the nearest $500.
e4769e21134d552ea2833614d0f05476ade45ae5.zh: 《所得税法》第 207.01 条定义了“TFSA 金额上限”。2009 年至 2012 年为 $5,000；2013 年和 2014 年为 $5,500；2015 年为 $10,000。2015 年之后的每一年，则是依照第 117.1 条“按 2009 年之后每一年调整的 $5,000”，取整到最接近的 $500 倍数，恰好居中时向上取整。CRA 的指数化页面描述了同一规则：额度固定为 $5,000，按 2009 年之后的每一年指数化，并取整到最接近的 $500。

e31ca69875061449989855b630634018aed90ccc.src: CRA’s guidance on mutual funds explains why. Distributions are taxed while you own the units, and if you reinvest them you must still report them, because you are considered to have received them before reinvesting. Reinvesting buys more units, which raises your average cost per unit. The early buyer’s cost base is $21,600 against the later buyer’s $20,000. That higher cost base is the record of the tax already paid.
e31ca69875061449989855b630634018aed90ccc.zh: CRA 关于互惠基金的说明解释了原因。持有单位期间的分派要计税；即使再投资，也必须申报，因为你被视为先收到分派再进行再投资。再投资会买入更多单位，从而提高每单位平均成本。较早买家的成本基础是 $21,600，较晚买家是 $20,000。这较高的成本基础，就是已缴税款的记录。

8065458031135687d0f94df040ec374412188c29.src: Distinguish new pay from an existing lump sum. Saving from each paycheque grows with income and the limit rises occasionally; moving an existing non-registered holding into a TFSA is a different decision, because transferring units in kind is a disposition at market value. The in-kind contribution guide covers it.
8065458031135687d0f94df040ec374412188c29.zh: 区分新的工资储蓄与现有的一笔资金。每份工资的储蓄随收入增长，额度偶尔上调；把现有的非注册持仓转入 TFSA 则是另一项决定，因为以实物转入单位属于按市值处置。实物供款指南对此有说明。

acf1cdc781b77d889ec266116c66eedcbb6dfadf.src: Do not let tax drive the choice of fund. Diversification, fees, risk and the time until you need the money matter more than one distribution. Returns are uncertain; a fund bought after its distribution can still fall.
acf1cdc781b77d889ec266116c66eedcbb6dfadf.zh: 不要让税务决定基金选择。分散投资、费用、风险以及你何时需要用钱，比一次分派重要得多。回报并不确定；在分派后买入的基金同样可能下跌。

53646ef1465d985f4e3379245bbbe5ffd4fc35b4.src: In a taxable account, compare a few days with the cost. If the record date is days away and the estimated distribution is large, waiting for it to pass is a reasonable, low-cost habit. Waiting weeks or months to save a cost of this size is market timing, and missing a rise could easily cost more; the waiting-for-a-dip guide shows how cash rules drift.
53646ef1465d985f4e3379245bbbe5ffd4fc35b4.zh: 在应税账户中，把几天的等待与成本作比较。如果登记日只差几天且预计分派很大，等它过去是合理而低成本的习惯。为节省这种规模的成本而等待数周或数月，就是择时，错过一段上涨的代价很可能更高；等待回调指南展示了现金规则如何逐渐走样。

e5720cad891bf5d815ae48190467718baf24db34.src: Index your own contributions, not just the room. If your plan is to save a fixed share of income, the inflation-adjusted contribution guide shows why a flat dollar amount loses ground over decades. The RRSP and TFSA comparison covers which account to fill first.
e5720cad891bf5d815ae48190467718baf24db34.zh: 为自己的供款做指数化，而不只是额度。如果你的计划是储蓄收入的固定比例，通胀调整供款指南说明了为何固定金额在数十年间会落后。RRSP 与 TFSA 比较讨论先填满哪个账户。

e4989ca5a82a250dd1cf2a3382c3e2b5fe83332f.src: Inside a registered account, ignore it. In a TFSA, RRSP, RRIF, RESP or FHSA the distribution is not taxed when paid. The account’s rules, not the fund, decide that: a fund is not tax-exempt in itself.
e4989ca5a82a250dd1cf2a3382c3e2b5fe83332f.zh: 在注册账户内可以忽略。在 TFSA、RRSP、RRIF、RESP 或 FHSA 中，分派在支付时不计税。决定这一点的是账户规则，而不是基金：基金本身并不免税。

5561416823a72ce2f54ea4ad4203477a2cc01d78.src: Keep the account and the investment separate. Income and gains earned inside a TFSA are generally not taxed and withdrawals are not taxable, but those are account rules. A balanced fund held in a TFSA is still exposed to market falls, fund fees and uncertain returns. The asset location guide compares what to hold where.
5561416823a72ce2f54ea4ad4203477a2cc01d78.zh: 把账户和投资分开看。TFSA 内赚取的收入和收益一般不计税，提款也不计税，但这些都是账户规则。放在 TFSA 里的平衡基金仍会受到市场下跌、基金费用和回报不确定的影响。资产配置位置指南比较了什么适合放在哪里。

d252188470af67400d290374ba97ad9222694d6a.src: Keep the cash for the tax. A reinvested distribution produces no cash. The tax cash provision guide shows how to set money aside for it.
d252188470af67400d290374ba97ad9222694d6a.zh: 为税款留出现金。再投资的分派不会带来现金。税款现金准备指南说明了如何为它预留资金。

3c83a8159c44e5b73a35e3c5a92d10d8e667728a.src: Keep the cost base records. Reinvested distributions raise your adjusted cost base. Many platforms track it, but CRA expects you to calculate it for each fund and series. Missing the reinvested amounts means paying tax twice on the same money when you sell.
3c83a8159c44e5b73a35e3c5a92d10d8e667728a.zh: 保留成本基础记录。再投资的分派会提高你的调整后成本基础。许多平台会代为记录，但 CRA 要求你按每只基金和每个系列自行计算。漏记再投资金额，卖出时就会对同一笔钱重复缴税。

025180010752eb3371cff5c8121901509698bae1.src: Know your own room. The yearly limit is only one part. Unused room carries forward; amounts withdrawn are added back on 1 January of the following year; and over-contributions are taxed at 1% a month. The TFSA recontribution calendar follows those rules. Losses inside the account do not restore room; the loss and room guide shows why.
025180010752eb3371cff5c8121901509698bae1.zh: 了解自己的额度。每年的额度只是一部分。未用额度可结转；提取的金额在次年 1 月 1 日加回；超额供款每月按 1% 征税。TFSA 再供款日历遵循这些规则。账户内的亏损不会恢复额度；亏损与额度指南解释了原因。

08f69803e49f14bdea9f9690e0f1a4d74d53cbd4.src: A December purchase and a February tax slip
08f69803e49f14bdea9f9690e0f1a4d74d53cbd4.zh: 十二月的买入与二月的税单

297211b532750d7b661f884a199866038ad580e7.src: A distribution paid days after you buy hands part of your own money back as taxable income. Follow the same purchase made just before and just after the distribution: identical units and value, a higher cost base, tax paid now and partly won back later. See how the cost depends on distribution size, its tax character and how long you hold.
297211b532750d7b661f884a199866038ad580e7.zh: 在你买入几天后支付的分派，会把你自己的一部分钱作为应税收入还给你。比较同一笔买入在分派前和分派后进行：单位和市值相同，成本基础更高，税款现在缴、之后部分收回。看看成本如何取决于分派规模、税务性质和持有期。

a83059add130e6d54d844ba59a85f7325b417d5d.src: A fund distribution can be capital gains, Canadian dividends, foreign income, interest, other income or return of capital, or a mix, and the T3 or T5 slip says which. Each is taxed differently. Capital gains are half included in income. Interest and foreign income are fully taxed. Eligible Canadian dividends get the gross-up and dividend tax credit. Return of capital is not taxed now; it lowers the cost base instead.
a83059add130e6d54d844ba59a85f7325b417d5d.zh: 基金分派可以是资本利得、加拿大股息、外国收入、利息、其他收入或资本返还，或它们的组合，T3 或 T5 税单会注明。各类的税务处理不同。资本利得一半计入收入。利息和外国收入全额计税。合资格加拿大股息适用加计和股息税收抵免。资本返还当期不计税，而是降低成本基础。

91039c7a9d071932777d8598653c41fd99448b97.src: A fund that distributes little and grows mostly through unrealized gains defers tax for its holders in general, which is one reason fund turnover and distribution history matter for non-registered accounts beyond the December question.
91039c7a9d071932777d8598653c41fd99448b97.zh: 一只分派很少、主要通过未实现收益增长的基金，一般会为持有人递延税款，这也是基金周转率和分派历史对非注册账户重要的原因之一，不仅限于十二月的问题。

e250de841130928281e0cc1cb157d83b759a3604.src: A fund’s unit price is its net asset value per unit. When the fund pays a distribution, that cash leaves the fund, so the unit price falls by the distribution, all else being equal. With the defaults, $20,000 buys units just before a distribution of 8% of the price. The distribution is $1,600 and the units are then worth $18,400. Reinvested at the lower price, the $1,600 buys more units, and the holding is back to $20,000.
e250de841130928281e0cc1cb157d83b759a3604.zh: 基金的单位价格是每单位资产净值。基金支付分派时，这笔现金离开基金，因此在其他条件不变时，单位价格会下降相当于分派的金额。按默认值，$20,000 在相当于价格 8% 的分派之前买入单位。分派为 $1,600，之后单位价值为 $18,400。按较低价格再投资后，这 $1,600 买入更多单位，持仓回到 $20,000。

556832661a55761601013244494a588c33a5da7f.src: A higher limit adds room on 1 January. It does not change room you already have, does not raise the limit on past years, and does not make any investment inside the account safer or more rewarding.
556832661a55761601013244494a588c33a5da7f.zh: 更高的额度会在 1 月 1 日增加额度。它不会改变你已有的额度，不会提高以往年份的上限，也不会让账户内的任何投资更安全或回报更高。

26d82cbf4be7b7794e70be6ba11bf5a0da70e533.src: Added up, the $109,000 of limits from 2009 to 2026 is worth about $138,617 in September 2026 prices. If you turned 18 after 2009, enter your age; someone aged 29 at the end of 2026, first eligible in 2015, has $78,000 of limits worth about $94,148. These totals describe room, not wealth. Room only becomes wealth when money is contributed and invested, and they apply only to someone who has been 18 or older and resident in Canada in every year counted.
26d82cbf4be7b7794e70be6ba11bf5a0da70e533.zh: 合计起来，2009 年至 2026 年 $109,000 的额度按 2026 年 9 月价格约值 $138,617。如果你在 2009 年之后才年满 18 岁，请输入年龄；2026 年底 29 岁、2015 年首次符合资格的人，额度合计 $78,000，约值 $94,148。这些总额描述的是额度，而不是财富。只有把钱存入并投资，额度才会变成财富；而且它们只适用于在所计算的每一年都年满 18 岁并居住在加拿大的人。

b2549d5c5d311526f7fcbe62c049297e946b6330.src: After-tax return on the cash used to pay the tax (%)
b2549d5c5d311526f7fcbe62c049297e946b6330.zh: 用于缴税的现金的税后回报（%）

11c7adaa23431bb9dea35847dd3e588b25f21dad.zh: 每年 TFSA 金额上限

a227d4760af39b41221afc5a045e3ae9ecbc446e.src: At 2% a year, the limit reaches $8,000 in four years, $9,000 in ten and $10,000 in sixteen. At 1% a year it takes seven years to reach $8,000 and thirty to reach $10,000. At 3% it reaches $10,000 in eleven. Each $500 step needs the unrounded amount to grow by about $500, which is around 7% of the current limit, so at 2% inflation a step arrives roughly every three to four years.
a227d4760af39b41221afc5a045e3ae9ecbc446e.zh: 按每年 2%，额度在 4 年后达到 $8,000，10 年后达到 $9,000，16 年后达到 $10,000。按每年 1%，需要 7 年达到 $8,000，30 年达到 $10,000。按 3%，11 年达到 $10,000。每升一级 $500，需要取整前金额增长约 $500，约为当前额度的 7%，因此在 2% 通胀下大约每三到四年升一级。

6514f237b3670e2e7ca0474dfecbc48aa02e5b02.zh: 加拿大银行 · Valet API，序列 V41690973（总体 CPI） ↗

dd8cee7ef02deb39ec8796efc2b8e5bbe7072a29.src: Because the early buyer’s cost base is $1,600 higher, their capital gain on sale is $1,600 smaller. At half inclusion and 29.65%, that saves $237.20 of tax in the year of sale, whatever the sale price. If the units are sold for less than cost, the same $1,600 enlarges a capital loss instead.
dd8cee7ef02deb39ec8796efc2b8e5bbe7072a29.zh: 由于较早买家的成本基础高出 $1,600，卖出时的资本利得就少 $1,600。在一半计入和 29.65% 税率下，无论卖出价格如何，卖出当年可节省 $237.20 的税。若以低于成本的价格卖出，同样的 $1,600 会扩大资本亏损。

52dd96bc3c8e39c4fc54a54d7e54941af04d46a6.src: Because the law compounds the unrounded amount, not the rounded limit, these gaps do not build up. A year when rounding gives less room is not carried forward as a deficit, and a generous year is not taken back. Over many years the published limits track the indexed amount closely; the bars bounce within $250 either side of zero.
52dd96bc3c8e39c4fc54a54d7e54941af04d46a6.zh: 由于法律复利计算的是取整前金额，而不是取整后的额度，这些差额不会累积。某一年取整少给的额度不会作为亏欠结转，多给的一年也不会被收回。多年来公布的额度紧贴指数化金额；柱形在零上下 $250 以内波动。

9f1c90f84541b2f38b7e04e3a0dff9bb6d0cc2b6.src: Buy a non-registered fund just before its distribution, or just after?
9f1c90f84541b2f38b7e04e3a0dff9bb6d0cc2b6.zh: 在分派前还是分派后买入非注册账户中的基金？

e0403cf9bb7e93006087d044dbb3fd0825a7db75.src: Buying a fund in a taxable account just before a distribution does not lose you any investment value, but it pulls tax forward. The cost base rises by the distribution, so part of that tax comes back when you sell. The lasting cost is the growth on the tax cash and, if the distribution is income rather than capital gains, the difference in tax rates. It is usually modest, it is zero in a TFSA or RRSP, and it is rarely worth staying out of the market for long to avoid.
e0403cf9bb7e93006087d044dbb3fd0825a7db75.zh: 在应税账户中于分派前买入基金，并不会损失任何投资价值，但会把税提前。成本基础会增加相当于分派的金额，因此部分税款会在卖出时回来。持久的成本是税款现金的增长，以及如果分派属于收入而非资本利得，两者税率的差别。成本通常不大，在 TFSA 或 RRSP 中为零，很少值得为此长时间离场。

c8ceccb6bb9a244510ee086151151ed84c339e35.src: By 2026 the unrounded amount is about $7,184.92. That is closer to $7,000 than to $7,500, so the limit stayed at $7,000. Unless inflation is very low, a few more years of growth push it past $7,250 and the limit steps up. The large 2023 factor (6.3%) explains the quick move from $6,000 in 2022 to $6,500 in 2023 and $7,000 in 2024: high inflation brought the steps closer together.
c8ceccb6bb9a244510ee086151151ed84c339e35.zh: 到 2026 年，取整前金额约为 $7,184.92。它离 $7,000 比离 $7,500 更近，所以额度保持在 $7,000。除非通胀非常低，再过几年的增长就会把它推过 $7,250，额度随之上一级。2023 年的高系数（6.3%）解释了额度为何从 2022 年的 $6,000 迅速升至 2023 年的 $6,500 和 2024 年的 $7,000：高通胀让台阶靠得更近。

These projections only apply the rule; they do not predict prices, and Parliament can change the rule itself, as it did in 2015 and 2016.
15abf6d2bf4848f07a4e9791421fdf8a1ed59e10.zh: 改变通胀假设，预测的台阶就会移动。若 2027 年后每年 2%，预测额度在 2030 年达到 $8,000，2033 年达到 $8,500，2039 年达到 $9,500。若为 1%，下一级台阶要晚好几年。这些预测只是套用规则；它们不预测物价，而且议会可以修改规则本身，正如 2015 年和 2016 年那样。
