3506fa3dd7bdc4c74f92427f68390085618fa7be.src: Each bar is the limit minus the unrounded indexed amount. A bar can be as large as $250 either way. Because the unrounded amount keeps compounding, rounding in one year does not carry into the next: the gaps do not accumulate.
3506fa3dd7bdc4c74f92427f68390085618fa7be.zh: 每根柱形是额度减去取整前的指数化金额。柱形在任一方向最多可达 $250。由于取整前金额持续复利，一年的取整不会带到下一年：差额不会累积。

b9d5ce26d75d403577ec74dd197a79df36f81804.src: Each cell reruns the model with the entered capital-gains share (75%), tax rate, growth and cash return, changing only the distribution size and the year of sale, and scales the result to CAD 10,000 invested.
b9d5ce26d75d403577ec74dd197a79df36f81804.zh: 每个单元格都以输入的资本利得比例（75%）、税率、增长和现金回报重新运行模型，只改变分派规模和卖出年份，并把结果换算为每投资 CAD 10,000。

940a582367bfe02df38f85d8240392ac3fa0e4f8.src: Each limit is multiplied by CPI for September 2026 (170) divided by CPI for January of its own year, the month the room arrives. The $5,000 of 2009 is worth about $7,522 in September 2026 prices, so the $7,000 limit of 2026 is not a large real increase. This values the room only; it says nothing about the return on anything held in the account.
940a582367bfe02df38f85d8240392ac3fa0e4f8.zh: 每个额度乘以 2026 年 9 月的 CPI（170），再除以该年 1 月的 CPI，即额度到来的月份。2009 年的 $5,000 按 2026 年 9 月价格约值 $7,522，所以 2026 年 $7,000 的额度在实际上并没有大幅增加。这里只衡量额度的价值，不涉及账户内任何持仓的回报。

35149474df098a6e6aece48e51f7da558541aa7f.src: For a saver, the lesson is not to read policy into a single year’s figure. A flat limit after a year of inflation means the unrounded amount has not yet crossed the next halfway mark. A $500 jump after a mild year usually means it just did.
35149474df098a6e6aece48e51f7da558541aa7f.zh: 对储蓄者来说，教训是不要从某一年的数字中解读政策。通胀一年后额度不变，表示取整前金额还没越过下一个中点。温和的一年后跳升 $500，通常表示它刚刚越过。

2d86e531ca058020e1389fc72f958958fe53ee91.src: Inflation does not arrive at a constant rate, so the real calendar will be lumpier than any single row. The rows are useful for planning a contribution budget: if you plan to fill your room each year from pay, expect the required amount to rise in occasional $500 jumps rather than every year.
2d86e531ca058020e1389fc72f958958fe53ee91.zh: 通胀不会以固定速度出现，所以实际的时间表会比任何一行都更不规则。这些行有助于规划供款预算：如果你打算每年用工资填满额度，应预期所需金额偶尔跳升 $500，而不是每年都增加。

8fc641722538c27e1b431787c56081167468583e.src: Large year-end distributions usually come from funds that sold appreciated holdings during the year, for example after a strong market, a manager change or heavy redemptions by other investors. Fund companies often publish estimated year-end distributions in November or early December, with a record date that decides who receives them. Checking the estimate before a large December purchase is cheap; the actual amount and its character are confirmed only on the tax slip.
8fc641722538c27e1b431787c56081167468583e.zh: 大额年终分派通常来自年内卖出了升值持仓的基金，例如在强劲行情、更换基金经理或其他投资者大量赎回之后。基金公司常在 11 月或 12 月初公布预计的年终分派，并以登记日决定谁能获得分派。在十二月大额买入前查看预计金额成本很低；实际金额和性质要到税单上才能确认。

c9a86636a11b89e6fdb5487652a0c79df3f47c64.src: Limits for 2009 to 2026 are CRA’s published figures. Since 2016 the law sets the limit at $5,000 indexed for each year after 2009 by the section 117.1 CPI factor and rounded to the nearest $500 (a tie rounds up). The 2027 factor of 2.6% is this page’s calculation from Statistics Canada CPI to September 2026; CRA had not published the 2027 limit when it was checked on 26 October 2026. From 2028 the chart applies the 2% inflation you enter every year (rounded to 0.1 percentage point, as the factor is), which is an assumption, not a forecast, and Parliament can change the limit. Room is counted from the year you turned 18, assuming Canadian residence in every year since. Contribution room also depends on your own history: unused room carries forward, withdrawals are added back the following year, and over-contributions are taxed.
c9a86636a11b89e6fdb5487652a0c79df3f47c64.zh: 2009 年至 2026 年的额度为 CRA 公布的数字。自 2016 年起，法律规定额度为按第 117.1 条 CPI 系数对 2009 年之后每一年进行指数化的 $5,000，并取整到最接近的 $500（恰好居中时向上取整）。2027 年 2.6% 的系数是本页根据加拿大统计局截至 2026 年 9 月的 CPI 计算得出的；本页于 2026 年 10 月 26 日核对时，CRA 尚未公布 2027 年额度。从 2028 年起，图表每年套用你输入的 2% 通胀（与系数一样取整到 0.1 个百分点），这是假设而非预测，议会也可以修改额度。额度从你年满 18 岁那年起计算，并假设此后每年都居住在加拿大。供款额度还取决于你自己的记录：未用额度可结转，提款在次年加回，超额供款要缴税。

5532ef869ec8a37dc6fad7f1422f933df0c99aa2.src: Many mutual funds and ETFs pay most of their yearly distribution in December, especially the capital gains the fund realized during the year. Someone who invests a bonus or a year-end lump sum in a non-registered account in mid-December may find, a few days later, that the fund has paid a distribution, the unit price has dropped by about the same amount, and a tax slip is on the way for income they feel they never earned.

3278e5f3b251efd20d4076b2e6346e7801991400.src: One distinction runs through the whole page. The TFSA is an account with tax rules; it is not an investment. The limit decides how much you may put in. What happens to that money depends on what you buy inside the account, which can be a savings deposit, a GIC, a balanced fund or an equity fund, each with its own risk, fees and liquidity.

54be7b6931bce6d6563bbfc326a320750fd1b970.src: Read it as a timing cost, not a loss of investment value. Both buyers own the same units throughout, and the after-tax value of the early buyer’s holding, net of the tax already paid, trails the later buyer’s by only that amount. A large fall in the market a few weeks after either purchase would matter far more than this difference.
54be7b6931bce6d6563bbfc326a320750fd1b970.zh: 应把它看作时间成本，而不是投资价值的损失。两位买家始终持有相同的单位；较早买家在扣除已缴税款后的税后价值，只比较晚买家少这个金额。任一买入后几周内市场大跌，影响都远大于这个差额。

e2fbabd5db98948df180c1286151c4ae1690eaf1.src: So the tax is not doubled; it is moved. The cost is in three places. First, the tax is paid now rather than years later, and the cash used to pay it cannot grow in the meantime. Second, the income part of the distribution was taxed in full, but it is recovered only through a capital gain that is half taxed: in the default, $118.60 paid on income comes back as $59.30 at sale. Third, the early buyer needs cash for the tax this year.
e2fbabd5db98948df180c1286151c4ae1690eaf1.zh: 所以税并没有翻倍，而是被移动了。成本体现在三处。第一，税是现在缴而不是多年后缴，用来缴税的现金在这期间无法增长。第二，分派中的收入部分被全额征税，但只能通过一半计税的资本利得收回：在默认情况下，收入部分缴的 $118.60 在卖出时只回来 $59.30。第三，较早买家今年需要准备缴税的现金。

3a5994bd3eed85dd93dbc332fb5b57a322b4ee9d.src: Someone who waits and buys just after the distribution pays the lower price for the same $20,000 and ends up with exactly the same number of units. The first chart shows the result: equal market value, but a different adjusted cost base and a different tax bill this year.
3a5994bd3eed85dd93dbc332fb5b57a322b4ee9d.zh: 等待并在分派后买入的人，以较低价格投入同样的 $20,000，最终持有完全相同数量的单位。第一张图显示了结果：市值相同，但调整后成本基础和今年的税单不同。

bb35a298316e5aaa22d5a54a593ecf07ae1007a6.src: Statistics Canada’s CPI for September 2026 completes the averaging window for the 2027 factor. The average CPI for October 2025 to September 2026 is 167.525, against 163.275 for October 2024 to September 2025. The ratio gives a factor of 2.6% after rounding. Applied to the unrounded 2026 amount, it gives about $7,371.72, which rounds to $7,500.
bb35a298316e5aaa22d5a54a593ecf07ae1007a6.zh: 加拿大统计局 2026 年 9 月的 CPI 补齐了 2027 年系数的平均窗口。2025 年 10 月至 2026 年 9 月的平均 CPI 为 167.525，而 2024 年 10 月至 2025 年 9 月为 163.275。两者之比取整后得出 2.6% 的系数。套用于 2026 年取整前金额，约为 $7,371.72，取整为 $7,500。

6360d8a94e71ba5992c86615a556d259c2118a36.src: That feeling is correct in one sense. The distribution is not new profit for the buyer: it is a slice of their own purchase money handed back. But CRA taxes it like any other distribution. This guide puts numbers on the trade-off. The tool compares buying just before the distribution with buying just after, using the same amount of money, and follows both until the units are sold.
6360d8a94e71ba5992c86615a556d259c2118a36.zh: 从某种意义上说，这种感觉是对的。分派对买家而言不是新的利润，而是把他们自己买入资金的一部分还回来。但 CRA 会像对待其他分派一样对它征税。本指南把这种取舍量化。工具用相同金额比较分派前买入和分派后买入，并跟踪两者直到卖出单位。

854ac4f781cbdbfc4196f68627f90c7a94cc92a0.src: The fund income-type guide compares these characters in detail, and the return-of-capital guide shows how a non-taxable distribution works in the other direction.
854ac4f781cbdbfc4196f68627f90c7a94cc92a0.zh: 基金收入类型指南详细比较了这些性质，资本返还指南则展示了不计税的分派如何从相反方向起作用。

cb96e49cf7349f4c570735ddbe666ba7d68ad4bc.src: The TFSA dollar limit is $5,000 indexed to inflation since 2009, rounded to the nearest $500. That keeps new room roughly constant in real terms: the $109,000 of limits from 2009 to 2026 is worth about $138,600 in September 2026 prices. A flat limit is not a cut, and a jump is not a gift; both are rounding. Indexing protects the size of the room, not the value of what you hold in it.
cb96e49cf7349f4c570735ddbe666ba7d68ad4bc.zh: TFSA 金额上限是自 2009 年起按通胀指数化的 $5,000，取整到最接近的 $500。这让每年新增额度在实际上大致不变：2009 年至 2026 年 $109,000 的额度按 2026 年 9 月价格约值 $138,600。额度不变不是削减，跳升也不是赠予；两者都是取整。指数化保护的是额度的大小，而不是你在其中持有资产的价值。

f94bc850ffecc5cb762623e6a6e78ffbf1074b45.src: The TFSA dollar limit moves in CAD 500 steps behind a smoothly indexed amount
f94bc850ffecc5cb762623e6a6e78ffbf1074b45.zh: TFSA 金额上限在平滑的指数化金额之后以 CAD 500 为台阶移动

b7f94c00e74da0f0b0f5a51d93a53cd8c1e1b69b.zh: TFSA 金额上限在平滑的指数化金额之后以 CAD 500 为台阶移动 数据

431f9ce35a9c03124d48249f3c475e03fddd6fb3.zh: TFSA 金额上限在平滑的指数化金额之后以 CAD 500 为台阶移动 · CAD

0ede8396b37e84b17ccb9420716e12fc0465d7c4.src: The TFSA dollar limit was $7,000 in 2024, 2025 and 2026. Prices rose in each of those years, so it is natural to ask whether the room is quietly shrinking, or whether the government has stopped indexing it. Neither is the case. The limit is still tied to inflation; it simply moves in steps of $500, and inflation of about 2% a year takes several years to add up to a step.
0ede8396b37e84b17ccb9420716e12fc0465d7c4.zh: TFSA 金额上限在 2024、2025 和 2026 年均为 $7,000。这几年物价每年都在上涨，人们自然会问额度是否在悄悄缩水，或政府是否已停止指数化。两者都不是。额度仍与通胀挂钩；只是以 $500 为台阶移动，而每年约 2% 的通胀要累积好几年才够升一级。

eb42a5c5267df9bf9e061189d8a26717f36ce318.src: The character of the distribution sets the first bill
eb42a5c5267df9bf9e061189d8a26717f36ce318.zh: 分派的性质决定第一笔税

4af5e0d1e1f42b1c3035dae048f4024311a2e82b.src: The cost rises with the size of the distribution, the share taxed as income, your marginal rate and the length of time before you sell. It falls if the distribution is mostly return of capital, if you are in a low bracket this year and expect a higher one later, or if you were going to sell soon anyway.
4af5e0d1e1f42b1c3035dae048f4024311a2e82b.zh: 成本随分派规模、按收入计税的比例、你的边际税率以及卖出前的时间而上升。如果分派主要是资本返还、你今年处于较低税级而预计以后较高，或者你本来就打算很快卖出，成本就会下降。

9f30c6b0a17a10cd3ad6a5fd3ee2745a137a0657.src: The day after the distribution: same units and value, different cost base and tax
9f30c6b0a17a10cd3ad6a5fd3ee2745a137a0657.zh: 分派后一天：单位和价值相同，成本基础和税不同

fe7eb5150e26591f2aafc3d04e0b83b5ba56871a.src: The early buyer’s $20,000 became $18,400 of units plus a $1,600 distribution that was reinvested, so both hold $20,000. The distribution handed part of the purchase money back as taxable income; the higher cost base is the record of that.
fe7eb5150e26591f2aafc3d04e0b83b5ba56871a.zh: 较早买家的 $20,000 变成 $18,400 的单位加上 $1,600 的分派，而分派已再投资，所以两人都持有 $20,000。分派把部分买入资金作为应税收入还了回来；较高的成本基础就是它的记录。

f34b6705ae33c15ec3bd6d79f5686a64a8b40ab4.src: The first chart shows both lines. The dashed line is $5,000 compounded by each year’s factor. The solid line is the limit you actually receive. Recomputing the factors from Statistics Canada CPI gives 0.6% for 2010, 2.8% for 2012, 1.0% for 2021, then 6.3%, 4.7%, 2.7% and 2.0% for 2023 to 2026; the last four are exactly the rates CRA lists, and the rounded results reproduce every published limit from 2016 to 2026.
f34b6705ae33c15ec3bd6d79f5686a64a8b40ab4.zh: 第一张图显示两条线。虚线是按每年系数复利计算的 $5,000。实线是你实际获得的额度。根据加拿大统计局 CPI 重新计算的系数为：2010 年 0.6%，2012 年 2.8%，2021 年 1.0%，2023 年至 2026 年依次为 6.3%、4.7%、2.7% 和 2.0%；最后四个与 CRA 列出的比率完全一致，取整结果也重现了 2016 年至 2026 年公布的每一个额度。

e253670d259d8c23f061ea269f657d13eacc6e28.src: The first two steps are paid this year. The growth forgone is what that cash would have earned by the sale. The last step is the higher cost base doing its work when the units are sold. The result is a cost of timing, not a loss of investment value.
e253670d259d8c23f061ea269f657d13eacc6e28.zh: 前两步在今年缴付。放弃的增长是这笔现金到卖出时本可赚取的金额。最后一步是较高的成本基础在卖出单位时发挥作用。结果是时间成本，而不是投资价值的损失。

7f16c074f33170340ce5d8c627889321238c2257.src: The heatmap asks how many years after 2026 the limit first reaches $7,500, $8,000, $8,500, $9,000 and $10,000, for constant inflation rates from 0.5% to 4% after 2027. Every row starts from the calculated $7,500 for 2027, so the first column is one year throughout.
7f16c074f33170340ce5d8c627889321238c2257.zh: 热力图回答：在 2027 年后每年 0.5% 至 4% 的固定通胀下，2026 年之后要过多少年额度才首次达到 $7,500、$8,000、$8,500、$9,000 和 $10,000。每一行都从计算得出的 2027 年 $7,500 开始，所以第一列都是一年。

367cae53bc6576587a1b821b2c1318c9fe6f798d.src: The heatmap scales the result to $10,000 invested and varies the distribution from 2% to 16% of the unit price and the year of sale from 1 to 30. With the other defaults, a 2% distribution costs about $8 to $23 in today’s dollars per $10,000; an 8% distribution about $33 to $92; an unusually large 16% distribution about $65 to $183.
367cae53bc6576587a1b821b2c1318c9fe6f798d.zh: 热力图把结果换算为每投资 $10,000，分派从单位价格的 2% 变到 16%，卖出年份从 1 年变到 30 年。其他输入保持默认时，2% 的分派按今天货币计每 $10,000 成本约 $8 至 $23；8% 的分派约 $33 至 $92；罕见的 16% 大额分派约 $65 至 $183。

8562d52e8b472f8ec374446d512cb08e9b61ad4f.src: The question only exists in a non-registered (taxable) account. Inside a TFSA, RRSP, RRIF, RESP or FHSA, distributions are not taxed in the year they are paid, so the date of purchase relative to a distribution makes no tax difference there.
8562d52e8b472f8ec374446d512cb08e9b61ad4f.zh: 这个问题只存在于非注册（应税）账户。在 TFSA、RRSP、RRIF、RESP 或 FHSA 中，分派在支付当年不计税，因此相对于分派的买入日期在那里不会造成税务差别。

e7eca77ce7a1a1769d590b5e70b6044ef6685f6b.src: The rule: $5,000, indexed since 2009, rounded to the nearest $500
e7eca77ce7a1a1769d590b5e70b6044ef6685f6b.zh: 规则：$5,000，自 2009 年起指数化，取整到最接近的 $500

15e4399a81a92875fceb62b3075e439d594365c1.src: The second chart shows how far each year’s limit is from the unrounded amount. In 2018 the limit of $5,500 was about $222 below the indexed $5,721.70; in 2019 the limit of $6,000 was about $152 above $5,847.57. In 2026 the limit is about $185 below.
15e4399a81a92875fceb62b3075e439d594365c1.zh: 第二张图显示每年额度与取整前金额相差多少。2018 年 $5,500 的额度比指数化的 $5,721.70 低约 $222；2019 年 $6,000 的额度比 $5,847.57 高约 $152。2026 年额度约低 $185。

78aa2c1bccbfa1922b9b8f20e55f41fdae48b8e5.src: The second chart shows the net cost by the year of sale. A sale right after the distribution leaves a net cost of $59.30, the tax-rate difference alone. After 10 years, with the tax cash earning 2.5% after tax, the net cost is about $142 in year-10 dollars, or about $111 in today’s dollars, roughly 0.56% of the $20,000 invested. In today’s dollars about 62% of the first-year tax is won back.
78aa2c1bccbfa1922b9b8f20e55f41fdae48b8e5.zh: 第二张图按卖出年份显示净成本。分派后立即卖出，净成本为 $59.30，仅是税率差。10 年后，在税款现金税后赚取 2.5% 的情况下，净成本以第 10 年货币计约为 $142，以今天货币计约为 $111，约占投入的 $20,000 的 0.56%。以今天货币计，第一年税款约有 62% 被收回。

3f0c3aad69dcf5a742e8d1346c5c21d77966de8a.src: The third chart converts each year’s limit into September 2026 prices using the all-items CPI (Statistics Canada table 18-10-0004-01), dividing CPI for September 2026 (170.0) by CPI for January of the year the room arrived. The 2009 limit of $5,000 is worth about $7,522 in those prices. The 2026 limit of $7,000 is worth about $7,212, because prices rose between January and September 2026.
3f0c3aad69dcf5a742e8d1346c5c21d77966de8a.zh: 第三张图用总体 CPI（加拿大统计局表 18-10-0004-01）把每年额度换算为 2026 年 9 月的价格，即以 2026 年 9 月的 CPI（170.0）除以额度到来那年 1 月的 CPI。2009 年 $5,000 的额度按这些价格约值 $7,522。2026 年 $7,000 的额度约值 $7,212，因为 2026 年 1 月至 9 月间物价上涨。

e67cb32d03867701093cd71a029dc2e181823437.src: The tool splits the distribution into a capital-gains part and an “everything else” part, and taxes the second at the full marginal rate. That is conservative for dividends and wrong for return of capital, which would cost nothing now. With 75% capital gains and a 29.65% rate, the $1,600 distribution brings $296.50 of tax: $177.90 on the capital-gains part and $118.60 on the rest. Year-end distributions of equity funds are often mostly capital gains; bond and balanced funds pay more interest through the year.
e67cb32d03867701093cd71a029dc2e181823437.zh: 工具把分派拆分为资本利得部分和“其他一切”部分，并对后者按全额边际税率征税。这对股息而言偏保守，对资本返还而言则不正确，因为资本返还当期没有成本。在 75% 资本利得和 29.65% 税率下，$1,600 的分派带来 $296.50 的税：资本利得部分 $177.90，其余 $118.60。股票基金的年终分派往往以资本利得为主；债券和平衡基金全年支付更多利息。

559746e940e4e3b00b6d62e8a029c27c9fa9e07e.src: The waterfall breaks the year-10 cost into its parts: $177.90 of tax on the capital-gains part, $118.60 on the income part, $83.05 of growth forgone on that $296.50, less the $237.20 of capital-gains tax saved at the sale. The total is $142.35.
559746e940e4e3b00b6d62e8a029c27c9fa9e07e.zh: 瀑布图把第 10 年的成本拆成几部分：资本利得部分的税 $177.90，收入部分的税 $118.60，这 $296.50 放弃的增长 $83.05，减去卖出时节省的资本利得税 $237.20。合计为 $142.35。

537917f463d78cdd26f34560ef89e1a118c0d8fb.src: This guide rebuilds the limit from the law, year by year, using the same consumer price index the law uses. It then answers four practical questions: why the limit sits still and then jumps, how much the room has really been worth, what the 2027 figure is likely to be, and how quickly future steps come under different inflation rates. The tool below lets you change your age, which sets your first eligible year, the inflation you assume after 2027 and how far ahead to look.
537917f463d78cdd26f34560ef89e1a118c0d8fb.zh: 本指南按法律逐年重建额度，使用的正是法律所用的消费者价格指数。然后回答四个实际问题：额度为何不动又突然跳升，额度的真实价值有多少，2027 年的数字可能是多少，以及在不同通胀率下未来台阶来得多快。下面的工具可以让你更改年龄（它决定你首次符合资格的年份）、2027 年后假设的通胀，以及要预测多远。

027421dbfd133513c45c6471b08d97c4372425f6.src: Three years at $7,000 is not a freeze
027421dbfd133513c45c6471b08d97c4372425f6.zh: 连续三年 $7,000 并不是冻结

3f1eb3c09ade0147622f04ac5725a96b8aa59aaa.src: To 2026 the solid line is CRA’s published limit; 2027 is calculated from published CPI; later years assume 2% inflation. The 2015 limit of $10,000 and the 2013–2014 limit of $5,500 were set directly in the law rather than by indexing. The projection contains 4 further $500 steps after 2027.
3f1eb3c09ade0147622f04ac5725a96b8aa59aaa.zh: 至 2026 年，实线为 CRA 公布的额度；2027 年根据已公布的 CPI 计算；之后各年假设通胀 2%。2015 年 $10,000 的额度和 2013–2014 年 $5,500 的额度是直接写入法律的，而不是来自指数化。预测在 2027 年之后还有 4 次 $500 的台阶。

2464bcabd9853e9e7e63996cf464f38cdf0e739f.src: Treat this as a calculation, not an announcement. When this page was checked on 26 October 2026, CRA’s limits page listed TFSA limits only to 2026 and CRA’s indexation page showed factors only to 2026. Section 117.1 also allows the CPI to be “adjusted in such manner as may be prescribed”. The margin here is wide: the unrounded amount would need to fall below $7,250 to keep the limit at $7,000, which would take a factor of 0.9% or less. Even so, contribute based on CRA’s published figure and your own room in My Account, not on this projection.
2464bcabd9853e9e7e63996cf464f38cdf0e739f.zh: 请把它视为计算，而不是公告。本页于 2026 年 10 月 26 日核对时，CRA 的额度页面只列出至 2026 年的 TFSA 额度，CRA 的指数化页面也只显示至 2026 年的系数。第 117.1 条还允许 CPI“按规定的方式调整”。这里的余地很宽：取整前金额要低于 $7,250 才会让额度保持在 $7,000，这需要系数为 0.9% 或更低。即便如此，供款时请以 CRA 公布的数字和你在 My Account 中的个人额度为准，而不是以此预测为准。

873b047df4353c9723108529f1a9ebb0f95847b5.src: Two features matter. First, the unrounded amount keeps compounding every year, whether or not the published limit moves. Second, the 2013–2014 and 2015 limits were written directly into the law, so they sit above or off the indexed path. Since 2016 every limit has been the rounded indexed amount.
873b047df4353c9723108529f1a9ebb0f95847b5.zh: 有两点很重要。第一，无论公布的额度是否变化，取整前金额每年都在复利增长。第二，2013–2014 年和 2015 年的额度直接写入法律，因此高于或偏离指数化路径。自 2016 年起，每年的额度都是取整后的指数化金额。

34ae0a9049badb5f9d4341800af9f7384cd8e5b9.src: Year 0 is a sale immediately after the distribution: the higher cost base creates a capital loss that offsets $237 of tax. The later the sale, the longer the tax cash has been missing and the less a dollar of future tax saving is worth today. Because part of the distribution is taxed as income in full but recovered only as a half-included capital loss or smaller gain, the cost never falls to zero.
34ae0a9049badb5f9d4341800af9f7384cd8e5b9.zh: 第 0 年表示分派后立即卖出：较高的成本基础产生资本亏损，抵消 $237 的税。卖出越晚，税款现金缺席的时间越长，未来每一元节税在今天的价值就越低。由于分派的一部分按收入全额征税，却只能以一半计入的资本亏损或较小的收益收回，成本永远不会降到零。
